normalised_text: yakob n lo tsele dzughusi, num u mele, nugho wela u fe dze yeso wela ghe tonglo enyea a lo kelesto.

name: Aghem
text: ù lo dzə̄a wò wɛ ù nuu, ghù lo tsʉ tsughu zən e wə̄n zo enyəa à lò Yɛso; tɔŋlo enyəa ù kè bə̀ghasəa ghì a wə̄n aŋ ghùu bòo tə ghee to.
normalised_text: u lo dzea wo we u nuu, ghu lo tsu tsughu zen e wen zo enyea a lo yeso; tonglo enyea u ke beghasea ghi a wen ang ghou buo te ghee to.

name: Aghem
text: Ghəa ghən fə̀ bala kə ni kɔʼ aleluesō tsughu lâŋ kə ushwaʼ u Mughu ù te wəla ghùwshʉ̀ghà fə̀ dzɛ̂ tsughu enyəa:.
normalised_text: ghea ghen fe bala ke ni ko alelueso tsughu lang ke ushwa u mughu u te wela ghuwshugha fe dze tsughu enyea.

name: Aghem
text: Dzùghùsî n zòo è kɔʼ, bɔɔm ghəəŋ ndùw sùghò ghəa yia tsə̀ndə̄ghā è Mughu ù te mô dzɛ an dzǒo; ù n nì ndùw Mèle aŋ wī.
normalised_text: dzughusi n zuo e ko, boom gheeng nduw sugho ghea yia tsendegha e mughu u te mo dze an dzuo; u n ni nduw mele ang wi.

name: Aghem
text: A m bùghò Hɛlɔ̀d zuw tsughu ghəa ghən gho ghèe ghê ghì a Yɛ̀lusalɛ̀m gho a dzə̀m, ghəa a te ghə m fəmso mìasò ndùw ghee enyə.
normalised_text: a m bugho helod zuw tsughu ghea ghen gho ghie ghe ghi a yelusalem gho a dzem, ghea a te ghe m femso miaso nduw ghee enye.

name: Aghem
text: Ghe n dzɛ̀ â wə̄n enyəa, À lò an naʼ e Bɛtə̀lɛ̀hɛ̂m, am mbùʼ è Dzùdîa, tɔŋlo enyəa ghùwshʉ̀ghà fə̀ tɔm tsughu enyəa.
normalised_text: ghe n dze a wen enyea, a lo an na e betelehem, am mbu e dzudia, tonglo enyea ghuwshugha fe tom tsughu enyea.

name: Aghem
text: Hɛlɔ̀d n daŋso nyɛʼɛ tɔŋɔ tsughu ghî a tɔɔ yì, bvʉ tɔ̀ʼn kɔʼ nəgha zəla ghe mò tso zeʼē kôʼ kɔʼ sə̀ghàbəlà fə̀n a te, aŋ ghùu ghee.
normalised_text: helod n dangso nyee tongo tsughu ghi a too yi, bvu ton ko negha zela ghe mo tso zee ko ko seghabela fen a te, ang ghou ghee.

name: Aghem
text: Ghəa ghe tso kôʼ kɔʼ sə̀ghàbəlà fi êzə̀, ghe n duʼn mìasò ndùw ènyə.
normalised_text: ghea ghe tso ko ko seghabela fi eze, ghe n dun miaso nduw enye.

name: Aghem
text: Ù fi nughù kɔ̀ʼ sùghò nù, nì kɔ̀ʼ zə̂awɛ̀, ghèe wɛ̀ ù te, nùghù tsùghù ndùw an Edzìpt â tsuʼ wo.
normalised_text: u fi nughu ko sugho nu, ni ko zeawe, ghie we u te, nughu tsughu nduw an edzipt a tsu wo.

name: Aghem
text: Ghəa ghən fə̀ fɛ sə kɔʼ alelueso tsughu lâŋ kə fəgha kəla ghùwshʉ̀ghà Dzɛ̀lɛ̀mîa fə̀ dzɛ̂ naŋa enyəa.
normalised_text: ghea ghen fe fe se ko alelueso tsughu lang ke fegha kela ghuwshugha dzelemia fe dze nanga enyea.

name: Aghem
text: Ghe zuw bɔŋ kə edì kə kûm zɛʼɛ̄ wo an Lamàʼ, Lashìɛl, ù dìi wɛ a wə̄n gho; vʉ̀ ù tue enyəa ghe ka wən gɔ̂ŋlò, bòʼ wɛ a wə̄n ghə m kpuwnlō.
normalised_text: ghe zuw bong ke edi ke kum zee wo an lama, lashiel, u dei we a wen gho; vu u tue enyea ghe ka wen gonglo, bo we a wen ghe m kpuwnlo.

name: Aghem
text: Hɛlɔ̀d n daŋso bùghò kpùw è tsughu, tsə̀ndə̄ghā è Mughu ù te n ndùw bùghò an dzǒo, dzɛ̀ â Dzùghùsî enyəa.
normalised_text: helod n dangso bugho kpuw e tsughu, tsendegha e mughu u te n nduw bugho an dzuo, dze a dzughusi enyea.

name: Aghem
text: Dzùghùsî n nùghù kɔʼ è sugho, nì kɔʼ sùghò wɛ vʉ̀ ghèe zə̀, ghe n nùghù ndùw èbàm an naʼ zə Ezə̀lɛ̂.
normalised_text: dzughusi n nughu ko e sugho, ni ko sugho we vu ghie ze, ghe n nughu nduw ebam an na ze ezele.

name: Aghem
text: An tsuʼu n te mò, Dzɔ̌n fùghùu mùghù ŋ Kə̀zə̀ ŋ kaʼ tsughu tsə̀ndə̄ghā è Kə̀zə̀ a lùʼû naʼn wo aŋ ŋgwə̀n è Dzùdîa.
normalised_text: an tsuu n te mo, dzon fughou mughu ng keze ng ka tsughu tsendegha e keze a luu nan wo ang nggwen e dzudia.

name: Aghem
text: Ù n nâʼn wò enyəa, Ti màʼa nlò ghəa ghɛʼɛ à biigh gho, tɔŋlo enyəa fɔ̂e u kəwālā wə n sū.
normalised_text: u n nan wo enyea, ti maa nlo ghea ghee a biigh gho, tonglo enyea foe u kewala we n su.

name: Aghem
text: Ghe m bughò zàa wò vùŋ u ghee enyəa ghe ŋ ghəəŋ bonlo, Dzɔ̌n m fughuu tsughu ghee â mùghù ŋ Kə̀zə̀ mo an dzughù è Dzodàn.
normalised_text: ghe m bugho zea wo vung u ghee enyea ghe ng gheeng bonlo, dzon m fughuu tsughu ghee a mughu ng keze mo an dzughu e dzodan.

name: Ajiri
text: Ɛlɛ gba akwu Ɛdɔ iyi Ɔzhizɔsi Okrasi umɛ uwu Odevidi umɛ uwu Aburamu le.
normalised_text: ele gba akwu edo iyi ozhizosi okrasi ume uwu odevidi ume uwu aburamu le.

name: Ajiri
text: Aburamu akwu ete uwu Aziki, Ɔzhɛkɔbu akwu ete uwu Ozhuda Mbala ɛmanyi wu;.
normalised_text: aburamu akwu ete uwu aziki, ozhekobu akwu ete uwu ozhuda mbala emanyi wu;.

name: Ajiri
text: Ozhuda akwu ete uwu Ɔpɛrɛzi mbala Ɔzɛra, umba bɔkɔ anyi mba akwu Otama awu. Ɔpɛrɛzi akwu ete uwu Ɛzirɔ, Ɛzirɔ akwu ete uwu Oramu.
normalised_text: ozhuda akwu ete uwu operezi mbala ozera, umba boko anyi mba akwu otama awu. operezi akwu ete uwu eziro, eziro akwu ete uwu oramu.

name: Ajiri
text: Oramu akwu ete uwu Aminadabu, Aminadabu akwu ete uwu Ɔnashɔ, Ɔnashɔ akwu ete uwu Ɔsalamɔ.
normalised_text: oramu akwu ete uwu aminadabu, aminadabu akwu ete uwu onasho, onasho akwu ete uwu osalamo.

name: Ajiri
text: Ɔsalamɔ akwu ete uwu Obowazi, uwu anyi wu akwu Ɔrawabu awu, Obowazi akwu ete uwu Ɔbɛdi, uwu anyi wu akwu Orutu, Ɔbɛdi akwu ete uwu Ozhese.
normalised_text: osalamo akwu ete uwu obowazi, uwu anyi wu akwu orawabu awu, obowazi akwu ete uwu obedi, uwu anyi wu akwu orutu, obedi akwu ete uwu ozhese.

name: Ajiri
text: Ozhese ba akwu ete uwu Odevidi, uwu bɔkɔ e ri ɛsu awu. Odevidi akwu ete uwu Ɔsɔlɔmɔ, uwu bɔkɔ anyi wu akwu oko uwu Uriya dɛ-ɛ awu.
normalised_text: ozhese ba akwu ete uwu odevidi, uwu boko e ri esu awu. odevidi akwu ete uwu osolomo, uwu boko anyi wu akwu oko uwu uriya dee awu.

name: Ajiri
text: Ɔsɔlɔmɔ akwu ete uwu Orehobowa, Orehobowa akwu ete uwu Abizha, Abizha akwu ete uwu Asa.
normalised_text: osolomo akwu ete uwu orehobowa, orehobowa akwu ete uwu abizha, abizha akwu ete uwu asa.

name: Ajiri
text: Asa akwu ete uwu Ozhehoshafa, Ozhewoshafa akwu ete uwu Ozhoramu, Ozhoramu akwu ete uwu Uzaya.
normalised_text: asa akwu ete uwu ozhehoshafa, ozhewoshafa akwu ete uwu ozhoramu, ozhoramu akwu ete uwu uzaya.

name: Ajiri
text: Uzaya akwu ete uwu Ɔzhɔta, Ɔzhɔta akwu ete uwu Awazi, Awazi akwu ete uwu Ɛzɛkaya.
normalised_text: uzaya akwu ete uwu ozhota, ozhota akwu ete uwu awazi, awazi akwu ete uwu ezekaya.

name: Ajiri
text: Ɛzɛkaya akwu ete uwu Omanase, Omanase akwu ete uwu Amoni, Amoni akwu ete uwu Ozhosaya.
normalised_text: ezekaya akwu ete uwu omanase, omanase akwu ete uwu amoni, amoni akwu ete uwu ozhosaya.

name: Ajiri
text: Ozhosaya akwu ete uwu Ozhekoniya, mbala ɛmanyi wu kwuye ungwu rinye igbomo mu Ɔbabilɔ.
normalised_text: ozhosaya akwu ete uwu ozhekoniya, mbala emanyi wu kwuye ungwu rinye igbomo mu obabilo.

name: Ajiri
text: Mizhikembo iyi rinye mbo igbomo mu Ɔbabilɔ akwɛyi: Ozhekoniya a mba Ɔshiyɛtiyɛ, Ɔshiyɛtiyɛ a mba Ɔzɛrubabɛ.
normalised_text: mizhikembo iyi rinye mbo igbomo mu obabilo akweyi ozhekoniya a mba oshiyetiye, oshiyetiye a mba ozerubabe.

name: Ajiri
text: Ɔzɛrubabɛ a mba Abiwudu, Abiwudu a mba Eliyaki, Eliyaki a mba Azɔ.
normalised_text: ozerubabe a mba abiwudu, abiwudu a mba eliyaki, eliyaki a mba azo.

name: Ajiri
text: Azɔ a mba Ɔzadɔki, Ɔzadɔki a mba Akimu, Akimu a mba Ɛliwudu.
normalised_text: azo a mba ozadoki, ozadoki a mba akimu, akimu a mba eliwudu.

name: Ajiri
text: Ɛliwudu a mba Ɛlɛyaza, Ɛlɛyaza a mba Omata, Omata a mba Ɔzhɛkɔbu.
normalised_text: eliwudu a mba eleyaza, eleyaza a mba omata, omata a mba ozhekobu.

name: Ajiri
text: Ɔzhɛkɔbu a mba Ɔzhɔsɛfu, uwu akwu ɔnu uwu Omeri uwu a mba Ɔzhizɔsi, uwu o ya wu tee Okrasi awu.
normalised_text: ozhekobu a mba ozhosefu, uwu akwu onu uwu omeri uwu a mba ozhizosi, uwu o ya wu tee okrasi awu.

name: Ajiri
text: Ɔzhɔsɛfu, ɔnu wu, akwu onzu ototo, uwu ba a gyi tee la ta wu undu kwudu, kaa le lo wu lovya mo. Akwɛyi a ka amasa tee, a lu wu afyima, kyokyokyo byi.
normalised_text: ozhosefu, onu wu, akwu onzu ototo, uwu ba a gyi tee la ta wu undu kwudu, kaa le lo wu lovya mo. akweyi a ka amasa tee, a lu wu afyima, kyokyokyo byi.

name: Ajiri
text: Aa mba umɛ ɔzɔnu, akwɛyi ŋɔ kpowu ɛnyi tee Ɔzhizɔsi - moo a sa enzu wu ma mu ingbomo mbo.>>.
normalised_text: aa mba ume ozonu, akweyi ngo kpowu enyi tee ozhizosi moo a sa enzu wu ma mu ingbomo mbo..

name: Ajiri
text: Iwomo ɛlɛ lɛɛbi i wo tee kaa Ii nyɔlɔ iyi Ɔkwu e so mu kenzu unga anukenzu wu tee.
normalised_text: iwomo ele leebi i wo tee kaa ii nyolo iyi okwu e so mu kenzu unga anukenzu wu tee.

name: Ajiri
text: <<Oko uwu o do lu wu eza mo, e shi rifo a mba umɛ ɔnzɔnu, akwɛyi oo kpowu ɛnyi tee Imanuwɛ>> awu.
normalised_text: oko uwu o do lu wu eza mo, e shi rifo a mba ume onzonu, akweyi oo kpowu enyi tee imanuwe awu.

name: Ajiri
text: Tabɔkɔ Ɔzhɔsɛfu a nyeyimo mondo, e wo iyi ɔlɔgbulɔ uwu Ɔkwu e so wu awu.
normalised_text: taboko ozhosefu a nyeyimo mondo, e wo iyi ologbulo uwu okwu e so wu awu.

name: Ajiri
text: Uwu ba a nɔ mbala wu mo nzhii ba a mba umɛ ɔnzɔnu wu ma. Akwɛyi Ɔzhɔsɛfu e kpowu ɛnyi tee Ɔzhizɔsi.
normalised_text: uwu ba a no mbala wu mo nzhii ba a mba ume onzonu wu ma. akweyi ozhosefu e kpowu enyi tee ozhizosi.

name: Ajiri
text: Mizhikembo iyi kwɔmba ungwu Ɔzhizɔsi, mu Ɔbɛtilɛhɛ uwu Ozhudiya, mu ɔyi uwu ɔsu Ɛrɔdu, wayitu ɔ wɔ mu ɔnu uwu kwoto o bo mu Ɔzhɛrusalɛ.
normalised_text: mizhikembo iyi kwomba ungwu ozhizosi, mu obetilehe uwu ozhudiya, mu oyi uwu osu erodu, wayitu o wo mu onu uwu kwoto o bo mu ozherusale.

name: Ajiri
text: Kwuye ungwu ɔsu Ɛrɔdu a pwa iso ɛlɛ, uwu mbala enzu umba Ɔzhɛrusalɛ lɛɛbi, ubwu mbo e fomo gyɔɔ.
normalised_text: kwuye ungwu osu erodu a pwa iso ele, uwu mbala enzu umba ozherusale leebi, ubwu mbo e fomo gyoo.

name: Ajiri
text: Akwɛyi Ɔsu a ya eboshi umbakɔ ma, mbala wa zɔ Ɛrama. Akwɛyi e yo mbo tee, <<Muna ba o zɔ tee o mba Okrasi?>>.
normalised_text: akweyi osu a ya eboshi umbako ma, mbala wa zo erama. akweyi e yo mbo tee, muna ba o zo tee o mba okrasi?.

name: Ajiri
text: O gba wu opwu tee, <<Mu Ɔbɛtilɛhɛ mu ɛzhi iyi Ozhudiya. Tegba gba anukenzu a ka yi le tee.
normalised_text: o gba wu opwu tee, mu obetilehe mu ezhi iyi ozhudiya. tegba gba anukenzu a ka yi le tee.

name: Ajiri
text: Ɛrɔdu a ya wayitu mbamba ma mɛmba kaa lo so wu kwuyengwu bɔkɔ umba o gwo la kwulovyo kwɔngu imama shɛ.
normalised_text: erodu a ya wayitu mbamba ma memba kaa lo so wu kwuyengwu boko umba o gwo la kwulovyo kwongu imama she.

name: Ajiri
text: Tabɔkɔ o ma kwulovyo kwɔngu, akwɛyi ɔnyɛ a ga mba ma.
normalised_text: taboko o ma kwulovyo kwongu, akweyi onye a ga mba ma.

name: Ajiri
text: Ukpo a ta mba ɔkpa mu ondo kpeke-e te lo zɛ mbaa Ɛrɔdu fo. Kwuwo kwɔngwu o zɛ mu ɔgwuzɛ owa o ka mu ɛzhi mba.
normalised_text: ukpo a ta mba okpa mu ondo kpekee te lo ze mbaa erodu fo. kwuwo kwongwu o ze mu ogwuze owa o ka mu ezhi mba.

name: Ajiri
text: Akwɛyi Ɔzhɔsɛfu e yimo e to umɛ awu ma mbala anyi wu mu utuweka akwu luzɛ mba undu Izhipiti.
normalised_text: akweyi ozhosefu e yimo e to ume awu ma mbala anyi wu mu utuweka akwu luze mba undu izhipiti.

name: Ajiya
text: Awọ iwọọ iMusa ute iYesu iKristi, anọ iDauda, anga ute Ibrahim.
normalised_text: awo iwoo imusa ute iyesu ikristi, ano idauda, anga ute ibrahim.

name: Ajiya
text: Ibrahim jee Ishaku, Ishaku jee iYakubu, IYakubu jee iYahuza kina anayuru nga.
normalised_text: ibrahim jee ishaku, ishaku jee iyakubu, iyakubu jee iyahuza kina anayuru nga.

name: Ajiya
text: IYahuza ate iFeresa kina iZera ayuru bọ nga shi iTama, IFeresa nga shi ate iHesruna, IHesruna nga shi ate Aram.
normalised_text: iyahuza ate iferesa kina izera ayuru bo nga shi itama, iferesa nga shi ate ihesruna, ihesruna nga shi ate aram.

name: Ajiya
text: Aram nga shi ate Amminadab, Amminadab nga shi ate iNashon, INashon nga shi ate iSalmọn.
normalised_text: aram nga shi ate amminadab, amminadab nga shi ate inashon, inashon nga shi ate isalmon.

name: Ajiya
text: ISalmọn nga shi ate IBọaza, ayuru jee nga anga shi iRahab, IBowaz nga shi ate Obida, ayuru nga anga shi iRut, Obida nga shi ate iYesse.
normalised_text: isalmon nga shi ate iboaza, ayuru jee nga anga shi irahab, ibowaz nga shi ate obida, ayuru nga anga shi irut, obida nga shi ate iyesse.

name: Ajiya
text: IYesse nga shi ate agọm iDauda, IDauda nga shi ate iSulemanu ayuru nga anga sa shi ayiri Uriya.
normalised_text: iyesse nga shi ate agom idauda, idauda nga shi ate isulemanu ayuru nga anga sa shi ayiri uriya.

name: Ajiya
text: ISulemanu nga shi ate iRehobowam, IRehobowam nga shi ate Abiya, Abiya nga shi ate Asa.
normalised_text: isulemanu nga shi ate irehobowam, irehobowam nga shi ate abiya, abiya nga shi ate asa.

name: Ajiya
text: Asa nga shi ate iYehoshafat, IYehoshafat nga shi ate iYoram, IYoram nga shi ate Azariya.
normalised_text: asa nga shi ate iyehoshafat, iyehoshafat nga shi ate iyoram, iyoram nga shi ate azariya.

name: Ajiya
text: Azariya nga shi ate iYotam, IYotam nga shi ate Ahaz, Ahaz nga shi ate iHezekiya.
normalised_text: azariya nga shi ate iyotam, iyotam nga shi ate ahaz, ahaz nga shi ate ihezekiya.

name: Ajiya
text: iHezekiya nga shi ate iManassa, IManassa nga shi ate Amọn, Amọn nga shi ate iYosiya.
normalised_text: ihezekiya nga shi ate imanassa, imanassa nga shi ate amon, amon nga shi ate iyosiya.

name: Ajiya
text: IYosiya nga shi ate iYekoniya kina anayuru nga akyua mani ayẹri bu ki kya bu aBabila wu.
normalised_text: iyosiya nga shi ate iyekoniya kina anayuru nga akyua mani ayeri bu ki kya bu ababila wu.

name: Ajiya
text: Aya kya bọ aBabila ni, IYekoniya va jee iSheyaltiyel, ISheyaltiyel nga shi ate iZarubabel.
normalised_text: aya kya bo ababila ni, iyekoniya va jee isheyaltiyel, isheyaltiyel nga shi ate izarubabel.

text: IZarubabel nga shi ate Abihudu, Abihudu nga shi ate Eliyakim, Eliyakim nga shi ate Azuro.
normalised_text: izarubabel nga shi ate abihudu, abihudu nga shi ate eliyakim, eliyakim nga shi ate azuro.

name: Ajiya
text: Azuro nga shi ate iSaduku, ISaduku nga shi ate Akimu, Akimu nga shi ate Aliyudu.
normalised_text: azuro nga shi ate isaduku, isaduku nga shi ate akimu, akimu nga shi ate aliyudu.

name: Ajiya
text: Aliyudu nga shi ate Eliyazara, Eliyazara nga shi ate iMatana, IMatana nga shi ate iYakubu.
normalised_text: aliyudu nga shi ate eliyazara, eliyazara nga shi ate imatana, imatana nga shi ate iyakubu.

name: Ajiya
text: IYakubu nga shi ate iYusufu aghẹmẹ iMaryamu aghọmani ajee iYesu mani ayọrọ nga si iKristi.
normalised_text: iyakubu nga shi ate iyusufu agheme imaryamu aghomani ajee iyesu mani ayoro nga si ikristi.

name: Ajiya
text: Umani ujee iYesu iKristi sa shi, ayuru nga iMaryamu akọ cira nga ki ma iYusufu, ata kọ takwyuẹ ni avasa nu nga na afo anga aghing Ọnọng.
normalised_text: umani ujee iyesu ikristi sa shi, ayuru nga imaryamu ako chira nga ki ma iyusufu, ata ko takwyue ni avasa nu nga na afo anga aghing onong.

name: Ajiya
text: Ni aghẹmẹ nga iYusufu, aghọmani aka ju ima ushi na kikya, ata wang ọsa nga ighọng ba, na ava wang usheri nga ya naikẹr.
normalised_text: ni agheme nga iyusufu, aghomani aka ju ima ushi na kikya, ata wang osa nga ighong ba, na ava wang usheri nga ya naiker.

name: Ajiya
text: Aki jee anọ, ni ingọ ki ma nga uca si iYesu, ka aki foo ajiya kọ vulu bọ.
normalised_text: aki jee ano, ni ingo ki ma nga ucha si iyesu, ka aki foo ajiya ko vulu bo.

name: Ajiya
text: Uma ri ba kọ ma hwura umumani Ate aYaya tẹri ka anyu Atina nga.
normalised_text: uma ri ba ko ma hwura umumani ate ayaya teri ka anyu atina nga.

name: Ajiya
text: Uwẹ ni, anayiri mani aye nga aghẹmẹ ba ki kpaa afo ka jee anọ anaghẹmẹ, na aki yọrọ nga si Immanuwel. .

name: Akoose
text: Ḿmê nkuu děn, Josɛbɛ anhidé ásē, atéd mwǎn bɔ́ nyaŋ, ákɛ̄ɛ̄n bɔ́ nkuu ne nkuu, átimnád bɔ́ á Egipto.
normalised_text: mme kuu den, josebe anhide ase, ated mwan bo nyang, akeen bo kuu ne kuu, atimnad bo a egipto.

name: Akoose
text: Nɛ́n dêmbɛnléd âlóned eʼyale ábe Dyǒb dénlōmɛ̄nnē nkal éʼdəə́dəŋ Jeremayaa. Jeremayaa anhɔ́b aá.
normalised_text: nen debenled aloned eyale abe dyob denlomenne kal ediedeng jeremayaa. jeremayaa anhob ea.

name: Akoose
text: Ámbīd e kwééd eche Hɛrɔdɛ, ángɛl e Dyǒb empií Josɛbɛ á nló-te áde ámbɛ̄ɛ̄ abɛ́ á Egipto, élāŋgē mɔ́ nɛ́n aá.
normalised_text: abid e kweed eche herode, angel e dyob empei josebe a nlote ade abee abe a egipto, elage mo nen ea.

name: Akoose
text: <<Téd awǒŋ mwaád bɔ́ mwǎn, nyétime ámbīd á aloŋ á Israɛl. Hɛrɔdɛ ne ábē bad ábe béhɛ́déʼáá ane mwǎn awúu bémáá awɛ́.>>.
normalised_text: ted awong mwead bo mwan, nyetime abid a along a israel. herode ne abe bad abe behedeaa ane mwan awou bemaa awe..

name: Akoose
text: Nɛ́ɛ Josɛbɛ áwógé nɛ̂, anlad yə̌l, atéd Maria bɔ́ mwǎn, bɔ́bɔ́ɔ bétīm ámbīd á aloŋ á Israɛl.
normalised_text: nie josebe awoge ne, anlad yel, ated maria bo mwan, bobuo betim abid a along a israel.

name: Akoose
text: Etûn é póndé ámbīd enɛ̂, Jɔnɛ, Ndusɛnɛ ambíd nkal éʼdəə́dəŋ a Dyǒb. Akaléʼáá eyale é Dyǒb á ehyáŋge á Judeya, álāŋgē bad aá.
normalised_text: etun e ponde abid ene, jone, ndusene abid kal ediedeng a dyob. akaleaa eyale e dyob a ehyage a judeya, alage bad ea.

name: Alaba-K’abeena
text: እብራሂም ኢሳቀ እሎ፤ ኢሳቅ ያቁበ እሎ፤ ያቁብ ይሁደለከ አመስ ኦሱተ እሎ፤.
normalised_text: eberaahime isaaqa elo; isaaqe yaaquba elo; yaaqube yehudalaka amase osuta elo;.

name: Alaba-K’abeena
text: ይሁድ ትማሬች ፋሬሰለከ ዛረ እሎ፤ ፋሬስ ሄስሮነ እሎ፤ ሄስሮንን አራሜ እሎ፤.
normalised_text: yehude temaareeche faareesalaka zaara elo; faareese heeserona elo; heeseronene araamee elo;.

name: Alaba-K’abeena
text: ሰልሞን ራኣቤች ቦኤዘ እሎ፤ ቦኤዝ ሩቴች ኢዮቤደ እሎ፤ ኢዮቤድን እሴዬ እሎ፤.
normalised_text: salemone raaaabeeche boeeza elo; boeeze ruteeche iyobeeda elo; iyobeedene eseeyee elo;.

name: Alaba-K’abeena
text: አሳፍን ኢዮሳፌጠ እሎ፤ ኢዮሳፌጥን ኢዮራመ እሎ፤ ኢዮራምን ኦዝየ እሎ፤.
normalised_text: asaafene iyosaafeeta elo; iyosaafeetene iyoraama elo; iyoraamene ozeya elo;.

name: Alaba-K’abeena
text: ኦዝየን ኢዮኣታመ እሎ፤ ኢዮኣታምን አካዘ እሎ፤ አካዝን ሕዝቅያሰ እሎ፤.
normalised_text: ozeyane iyoaataama elo; iyoaataamene akaaza elo; akaazene hhezeqeyaasa elo;.

name: Alaba-K’abeena
text: ኢዮስያስ እስራኤል ኡመቱ ባብሎነ አገንት መርቶ ወክት እኮንያኔለከ አመስ ኦሱተ እሎ።.
normalised_text: iyoseyaase eseraaeele umatu baabelona aganete mareto wakete ekoneyaaneelaka amase osuta elo..

name: Alaba-K’abeena
text: ባብሎናን አገንት መርቶች ኤተሮን እኮንያን ሰላቴለ እሎ፤ ሰላቴልን ዘሩባቤሌ እሎ፤.
normalised_text: baabelonaane aganete maretoche eetarone ekoneyaane salaateela elo; salaateelene zarubaabeelee elo;.

name: Alaba-K’abeena
text: ዘሩባቤልን አብዮደ እሎ፤ አብዮድን ኤልያቄመ እሎ፤ ኤልያቄምን ኣዞረ እሎ፤.
normalised_text: zarubaabeelene abeyoda elo; abeyodene eeleyaaqeema elo; eeleyaaqeemene aazora elo;.

name: Alaba-K’abeena
text: ያቁብን ዩሱፈ እሎ፤ ዩሱፍን «መሲህ» ዬኖ ኢሰ እልቶ መርየመ ምኒ አነ እኮ።.
normalised_text: yaaqubene yusufa elo; yusufene "masihe" yeeno isa eleto mareyama meni ana eko..

name: Alaba-K’abeena
text: ህካን እኮቤቺሃ እብራሂሚች ደዉዴ ኢለ ቶነ ሾሎ እለንሸ፤ ህትን ደዉዴች ባብሎን አግተእ መርቶኢሃ ኢለ ቶነ ሾሎ እለንሸ እኮ፤ ህትን ባብሎን አግቶች መሲህ ኢለ ቶነ ሾሎ እለንሸ።.
normalised_text: hekaane ekobeechihaa eberaahimiche dawudee ila tona sholo elanesha; hetene dawudeeche baabelone agetae maretoihaa ila tona sholo elanesha eko; hetene baabelone agetoche masihe ila tona sholo elanesha..

name: Alaba-K’abeena
text: መሲህ ኢስ እለንሹ ህትጎታን፤ አመስ መርየመ ዩሱፍሃ ኣሰንት ዮሃኔን ደቀንቱዕናን ጠሊለ አያን ወልቃን ላፈተ እካን መኑ ጉዕሙንኩ ደጎ።.
normalised_text: masihe ise elaneshu hetegotaane; amase mareyama yusufehaa aasanete yohaaneene daqanetuenaane talila ayaane waleqaane laafata ekaane manu guemuneku dago..

name: Alaba-K’abeena
text: ጠዕሜ ዩሱፍ ፈየ መንቹ እኮቤቺሃ መናን ፍሹዕነ ጠወስ አጉሮተ ሰውዬእ።.
normalised_text: taemee yusufe faya manechu ekobeechihaa manaane feshuena tawase agurota saweyeee..

name: Alaba-K’abeena
text: ህካን ሰውየንን ቀርች መላይኬቹ ሀቄን ለልስ «ዩሱፋ ደዉዴ ቤቶ! ኣሴመሄ መርየመ ላፈተ እኮኢሁ ጠሊለ አያኒን እኮቤቺሃ እሴተ ኣእቶተ ዋጅቶት።.
normalised_text: hekaane saweyanene qareche malaayekeechu haqeene lalese "yusufaa dawudee beeto! aaseemahee mareyama laafata ekoihu talila ayaanine ekobeechihaa eseeta aaetota waajetote..

name: Alaba-K’abeena
text: እሴን ለቤ ጩል እልታአ፤ እስን ኡመትስ ጩቢችሰ ጡምሰኖቤቺሃ ሱዕመስ ‹ኢሰ› ይታንት» ዬስ።.
normalised_text: eseene labee chule eletaaa; esene umatese chubichesa tumesanobeechihaa suemase isa yetaanete" yeese..

name: Alaba-K’abeena
text: «ሀፍቱት ላፈተ እክ ለበ ጩል እልታአ፤ ህትን ሱዕመስ ‹አማኑኤለ› ይት ገእታአ» አማኑኤለ ዩ «መገኑ ኒንት» ዩሃን።.
normalised_text: "hafetute laafata eke laba chule eletaaa; hetene suemase amaanueela yete gaetaaa" amaanueela yu "maganu ninete" yuhaane..

name: Alaba-K’abeena
text: ህካን እኮቤቺሃ ዩሱፍ ግሰኛች በቅዬ ወክት ቀርች መላይኬቹ አዘዦገን መርየመ ኣኤሴ።.
normalised_text: hekaane ekobeechihaa yusufe gesanyaache baqeyee wakete qareche malaayekeechu azazhogane mareyama aaeesee..

name: Alaba-K’abeena
text: ጠዉ እኮጎሬ መርየመ ዎኔሴ ጩል እልቶተ ኢለ እሴን ደቀሞበአ እቅ፤ ዩሱፍን እለሞ ጩል «ኢሰ» ይ ሱዕመ ፉሼስ።.
normalised_text: tawu ekogoree mareyama woneesee chule eletota ila eseene daqamobaa eqe; yusufene elamo chule "isa" ye suema fusheese..

name: Alaba-K’abeena
text: ሄሮድስ ዎመ እኮ ዘማን ኢስ ይሁድ ባዶን ቤተሌም ከተማን እለሞ ወክት ቤዜተ ዎለኣ ኤንኬዕናሙ መኑ ሸርቂች ዬሩሳሌመ አሜቶኡ።.
normalised_text: heerodese woma eko zamaane ise yehude baadone beetaleeme katamaane elamo wakete beezeeta wolaaa eenekeeenaamu manu shareqiche yeerusaaleema ameetou..

name: Alaba-K’abeena
text: እሰን «አይሁድ ዎመ እሀኖ ጩሉ እለሞሁ ሀከንቤቾንት? ሸርቂን ቤዜተ ለዕን እሲሃ ሰገንዶተ አሜንቶም» ይት ጠዕምቶኡ።.
normalised_text: esane "ayehude woma ehano chulu elamohu hakanebeechonete? shareqine beezeeta laene esihaa saganedota ameenetome" yete taemetou..

name: Alaba-K’abeena
text: ዎሙ ሄሮድስ ህካን ሞጮጬ ወክት አበ ህልቆ፤ ህትን ዬሩሳሌም መኑ ጉዕሙንኩ ህልቆኡ።.
normalised_text: womu heerodese hekaane mochochee wakete aba heleqo; hetene yeerusaaleeme manu guemuneku heleqou..

name: Alaba-K’abeena
text: እስን ኡመትስ ቂስ አዎንሳኑተለከ ሕግ አስተማረተ ጉዕመንከ ጭምአዕይ «ቡረሞ መሲህ እለመኖሁ ሀከቤቹ» እሁስ ጠዕሜሰ።.
normalised_text: esene umatese qise awonesaanutalaka hhege asetamaarata guemaneka chemeaeye "buramo masihe elamanohu hakabeechu" ehuse taemeesa..

name: Alaba-K’abeena
text: «ቤተሌም ከተመ! አት ይሁድ ባድ አዎንሳኖች ጉዕሚችን ሆፈኣንትበአ፤ ህካን እኮቤቺሃ ኪች ኢ መነ እስራኤለ አገረኖለከ አዎንሰኖሁ እለመኖ ይ ከተቦኡ» ይቶኡ።.
normalised_text: "beetaleeme katama! ate yehude baade awonesaanoche guemichene hofaaanetebaa; hekaane ekobeechihaa kiche i mana eseraaeela agaranolaka awonesanohu elamano ye katabou" yetou..

name: Alaba-K’abeena
text: ህከኒች ኤተሮን ሄሮድስ ህከ ኤንኬዕናሙ መነ ማጭ ገእ ጠወስ ፎፎጅ ቤዜት ለልቶ ወክት ጠዕም ደጎ።.
normalised_text: hekaniche eetarone heerodese heka eenekeeenaamu mana maache gae tawase fofoje beezeete laleto wakete taeme dago..

name: Alaba-K’abeena
text: እስን እሰንተ «መርቴን ህከን ጩልተኔሃ ጡመገ አጥረመቼ፤ ደጌንተጎሬ አሜቴን ኩልቴነንተኤ፤ አኒሁ ሰገዶተ መራም» ይ ቤተሌመ ሶኮ።.
normalised_text: esene esaneta "mareteene hekane chuletaneehaa tumaga ateramachee; dageenetagoree ameeteene kuleteenanetaee; anihu sagadota maraame" ye beetaleema soko..

name: Alaba-K’abeena
text: እሰን ሄሮድሴች ሞጮጭት ፉልቶ ወክት ሸርቂን ለኦ ቤዜት አዎንስተንሰ ለኦ ወክት አበ ሙንደኦኡ፤ ሁኩ ሸርቃን ለኦ ቤዜንት ጩሉ ዮ ምኒ ቡዕላን ኡርታኢሃ ኢለ አዎንስቶሰ።.
normalised_text: esane heerodeseeche mochochete fuleto wakete shareqine lao beezeete awonesetanesa lao wakete aba munedaou; huku shareqaane lao beezeenete chulu yo meni buelaane uretaaihaa ila awonesetosa..

name: Alaba-K’abeena
text: እሰን ህከ ምኒ ኣጎ ወክት ጩሉ አማንተስ መርየማን ሜጡበ ዮኢሃ ለእ ብሬስ ጉሉጵት ሰገዶኡ፤ ህከኒች ኤተሮን ሳጥነ ፈንት ዎርቀ፥ ህጣነለከ ከርቤተ ዬኖ ህጣነ ፉሽት ኣቶኡ።.
normalised_text: esane heka meni aago wakete chulu amaanetase mareyamaane meetuba yoihaa lae bereese guluphete sagadou; hekaniche eetarone saatena fanete woreqa hetaanalaka karebeeta yeeno hetaana fushete aatou..

name: Alaba-K’abeena
text: ሁኩ ኤንኬዕናሙ መኑ ሄሮድሴበ ፈንቀልት መርታበእገ መገኑ ሀቄን ኩላን ዎሎ ዎቄን ባዱሰ ፈንቀልቶኡ።.
normalised_text: huku eenekeeenaamu manu heerodeseeba faneqalete maretaabaega maganu haqeene kulaane wolo woqeene baadusa faneqaletou..

name: Alaba-K’abeena
text: እሰን መርቶች ኤተሮን ቀርች መላይኬቹ ሀቄን ዩሱፊሃ ለልስ «ሄሮድስ ጩል ሾተ ሀሰኖቤቺሃ ጩልለከ አመተ ኣእት ግብጽ ባዱ ሁን፤ አን ኩሎሄተ ኢለ ህከኔ አፉዕል» ዬስ።.
normalised_text: esane maretoche eetarone qareche malaayekeechu haqeene yusufihaa lalese "heerodese chule shota hasanobeechihaa chulelaka amata aaete gebetse baadu hune; ane kuloheeta ila hekanee afuele" yeese..

name: Alaba-K’abeena
text: ህከኔን ሄሮድስ ሬሆተ ኢለ አፉዕሌእ፤ ሁኩን እኮሁ ቀርቹ ነብዬቾን «ቤቱኤ ግብጺች ገኤም» ዬ ላገት ዊንቶታት እቅ።.
normalised_text: hekaneene heerodese reehota ila afueleee; hukune ekohu qarechu nabeyeechone "beetuee gebetsiche gaeeme" yee laagate winetotaate eqe..

name: Alaba-K’abeena
text: ሄሮድስ ቤዜተ ለኦ መኑ ጣንሱሰ ደጎ ወክት አበ ኡሙዕሬእ፤ ቤተሌማንለከ ህከን አዳን ጉዕማንን ዮ ለሞ ዘማንለከ ለሞ ዘማኒች ዎሮን ዮ ለቤ ኦሱተ ጉዕመንከ ሾኖተ አዘዦ፤ ህከ ወክትንከ ደጎሁ ኤንኬዕናሙ መኑ ኩልቶስጋት እቅ።.

name: Alladian
text: Nyàn Zhezü Krisì nɛ́n nancüì hɔ̀n bi, nɛ́n léyi nɛ̀n dú Davidɛ̀n cokomɛ̀n-wrɔn hɩ Davidɛ̀n mumù mán dú Abrahamɛ̀n mɛ̀n mɛ̀n-wrɔn nɔn.

name: Alladian
text: Abrahamɛ̀n dú Izaakɛ̀n nɛ́n zi; Izaakɛ̀n dú Zhakɔbɛ̀n nɛ́n zi; Zhakɔbɛ̀n dú Zhüda mán nɛ́n muan-ẅì hɔ̀n yɔ zi;.

name: Alladian
text: Zhüda dú Farɛsɛ̀n mán Zara yɔ zi ; Farɛsɛ̀n dú Esrɔmɛ̀n nɛ́n zi; Esrɔmɛ̀n dú Aramɛ̀n nɛ́n zi;.

name: Alladian
text: Aramɛ̀n dú Aminadabɛ̀n nɛ́n zi; Aminadabɛ̀n dú Nasɔn nɛ́n zi; Nasɔn dú Salmɔn nɛ́n zi;.

name: Alladian
text: Salmɔn dú Boozɛ̀n nɛ́n zi ; Boozɛ̀n dú Obɛdɛ̀n nɛ́n zi ; Obɛdɛ̀n dú Zhese nɛ́n zi;.

name: Alladian
text: Zhese dú ɛnnɛ̀ncüì Davidɛ̀n nɛ́n zi. Davidɛ̀n dú Salomɔn nɛ́n zi ;.

name: Alladian
text: Salomɔn dú Roboamɛ̀n nɛ́n zi; Roboamɛ̀n dú Abia nɛ́n zi; Abia dú Asafɛ̀n nɛ́n zi;.

name: Alladian

name: Alladian
text: Oziasɛ̀n dú Zhoatamɛ̀n nɛ́n zi; Zhoatamɛ̀n dú Ashazɛ̀n nɛ́n zi; Ashazɛ̀n dú Ezèkiasɛ̀n nɛ́n zi;.
normalised_text: oziasen du zhoatamen nen zi; zhoatamen du ashazen nen zi; ashazen du ezekiasen nen zi;.

name: Alladian
text: Ezèkiasɛ̀n dú Manase nɛ́n zi; Manase dú Amɔn nɛ́n zi; Amɔn dú Zhoziasɛ̀n nɛ́n zi;.
normalised_text: ezekiasen du manase nen zi; manase du amon nen zi; amon du zhoziasen nen zi;.

name: Alladian
text: Zhoziasɛ̀n dú Yekonia mán nɛ́n muan-ẅì hɔ̀n yɔ zi, ɛnvra léyi Izraɛlɛ̀n ẅì hɔ̀n dú *anwɔ̀nẅìemɛ̀n Babilɔnɛ̀n anmàn nɔn.

text: Ɛnvra zri lɔ mɛ̀n de Yekonia dú Salatiɛlɛ̀n nɛ́n zi; Salatiɛlɛ̀n dú Zorobabɛlɛ̀n nɛ́n zi;.

name: Alladian

name: Alladian
text: Zhakɔbɛ̀n dú Zhozɛfɛ̀n nɛ́n zi, Mari nɛ́n cüì, Mari léyi dú Zhezü, Ebɩdie-wrɔn, nɛ́n muan nɔn.

name: Alladian
text: Zhozɛfɛ̀n, Mari nɛ́n cüì dú ɔwrɔn léyi ke bɩ́ Ɔwɔ ankà, kɩ ne ji nɛ̀n teze Mari ɛbán mɛ̀n, ô anwrɔn ke bɩ́ nyriɛn le Mari sî ɛmɛ̀ntɛ̀ ɛntrɛ.
normalised_text: zhozefen, mari nen chui du owron leyi ke bi owo anka, ki ne ji nen teze mari eban men, o anwron ke bi nyrien le mari si emente entre.

name: Alladian
text: Ne le bî ɛncɔnwrɔn-ẅì tɔ̀n, ɛ̀ wá nɛ̀n ebi Zhezü, ɔmuhi nɛ lɛ mrɛ́n nɛ́n fɛcüè lɔ ɛgbàn mɛ̀n nɛ̀n sɔhɔ́ nɔn.

name: Alladian
text: Eci ndɔ lɔ fɛn hán, ô ankà léyi Ɛẅɛnwrɔn dɔ́ Ɔwɔ-mùanwú-ankà-dɔ́-wrɔn mùan wú nɔn, kɛ̀ sá nmù:.

name: Alladian
text: Ɛnnyɔnwrɔn léyi kè sɩ̀ nyrì ɛncɔnwrɔn ankà nɔn ke le sî ɛmɛ̀ntɛ̀ kɩ ke le bî ɛncɔnwrɔn-ẅì tɔ̀n, ye le bi nɛ̀n Emanüɛlɛ̀n.
normalised_text: ennyonwron leyi ke si nyri enchonwron anka non ke le si emente ki ke le bi enchonwronwi ton, ye le bi nen emanuelen.

name: Alladian
text: Ɛnvra léyi Zhozɛfɛ̀n dú ndà mɛ̀n gbɛ́ ɛvɛ̀ nɔn, nɛ̀n hán eci léyi Ɔwɔ kùyüre-wrɔn wá tán nɛ̀n nɛ̀n hán nɔn, kɩ nɛ̀n bɩ́ Mari nɛ̀n sɩ́ ɛbemɛ̀n.

text: Nɛ̀n sɩ̀ cì yi ɛtɛ̀sɛ̀n hàn kɩ cɔ́ ɛnvra léyi Mari bî ɛncɔnwrɔn-ẅì tɔ̀n, hɩ Zhozɛfɛ̀n wá ebi Zhezü nɔn.

name: Alladian
text: Ɛnvra léyi Herɔdɛ̀n yá ankà ndɔ lɔ nɔn, nɛ̀n dú gbɔ̀gbɔ̀ mɛ̀n, nɛ́n mán Zherüzalɛmɛ̀n anmàn-bɔ̀ mɛhi.

name: Alladian
text: Yɔ mrɛ́n nɛ̀n ɔmùan le: Bɛtlehɛmɛ̀n anmàn, Zhüde kpɔsɔ wú. Ɔmuhi nyàn ankà léyi Ɔwɔ-mùanwú-ankà-dɔ́-wrɔn merɛ́n nɔn:.

name: Alladian
text: Zɛtɛn Herɔdɛ̀n bi owrú-kán-bɔ̀ cüìcüì hɔ̀n lɔ ɛshremɛ̀n kɩ ke yrɛ yɔ ɛnvra lɔ mɛ̀n cehɛ́n léyi okùcànkrò lɔ srɔ nɔn.

name: Alladian
text: Yɔ dú pɔ̀püɛ̀ vri mɛ̀n ɛnvra léyi yɔ kán nɛ̀n nanvrɛn lɔ nɔn.

name: Alladian
text: Zɛtɛn, ndà mɛ̀n lɔ Ɔwɔ kɛ dɔ́ yɔ, yɔ bɩ́ vru ɛmɛẅi yɔ hɔ́n Herɔdɛ̀n yri; yɔ bɩ́ ɛnlevri nyàntɛn yɔ hɔ́n y'anmàn ɛnhi wú.

name: Alladian
text: Zhozɛfɛ̀n tɔhú ɛnnyran lɔ, bɩ́ ɛnẅì lɔ mán nɛ́n muan kɩ hɔ́n Ezhiptɛ̀n ɛnhi wú anmàn.

name: Alladian

name: Alumu-Tesu
text: Ata areh a bu amgbasho tsifa Yeso Kristi ata a zizi ŋoh, amehreh Dawuda, nza anyi ma alohsoh Ibrahim.

name: Alumu-Tesu
text: Ibrahim ka mara Ishaku, Ishaku ka mara Yakubu, Yakubu ka mara Yahuda mboh ma atsini mboh.

text: Yahuda ka a mara Ferez tasa Zera. Akre amoh a bu Tamar, Ferez ka a mara Hezron, Hezron ka a mara Aram.
normalised_text: yahuda ka a mara ferez tasa zera. akre amo a bu tamar, ferez ka a mara hezron, hezron ka a mara aram.

text: Salmon ka a mara Bowaz akre a bu Rahab, Bowaz ka a mara Obida akre bu Rutu, Obida ka a mara Yesse.

text: Solomon ka a mara Rehobowam, Rehobowam ka a mara Abiya, Abija ka a mara A sa.

text: Hezekiya ka a mara Manasse, Manasse ka a mara Amon, Amon ka a mara Yosiya.

text: Yosiya ka a mara Yekoniya tasa atsini mboh, na ameh ata mata ka a fira mboh a nati te ahwra ma akpo afiya Babila reh.
normalised_text: yosiya ka a mara yekoniya tasa atsini mbo, na ame ata mata ka a fira mbo a nati te ahwra ma akpo afiya babila re.

text: Yakubu ka a mara Yusufu atsifa Maryamu ata nza a mara Yeso reh, ata nza maka a fi ŋoh la Kristi reh.

text: Ŋoh a nati a mara amehreh, ni nati gya ŋoh isa la Yeso, a bu ŋoh nza a nati a nga kyangwri mboh nvara anyi na kpakpana amoh mboh reh.>>.

name: Alumu-Tesu
text: Ma lisa amboh areh nambri la, tsifa Ada reh ta a su, ta ka a bleh anyi ma aniye kyangwri sa tohmoh Nnoh a bleh reh la.

text: Yusufu nza ka a hinga anyi ma mla reh, ka a tufa tsifa amehreh tohmoh Ada reh. Yusufu neh ka a gu Maryamu ta ka bu afya ŋoh.

name: Alumu-Tesu
text: A sohroh a leh na ŋoh kpeh, nza ka a mara amehreh a ŋoh reh, ka a gya ŋoh isa la, Yeso.

name: Alumu-Tesu
text: Agohmoh Hirudus nza ka a sehreh dehreh agohsoh a ŋoh ka a hinga, ka wa kyangwri Urushalima mboh za nambri.

text: Ka a fi agba firist mboh tasa amboh tsana akpi Musa mboh reh, ka luhu mboh atsi ata nza ma mara Kristi reh.

name: Bambalang
text: Joshɛ ndaoŋ vi ni mbɔ ŋoŋ ndɨndɨ ki lɔ ntāʼa nu māʼaŋ lrithɔ thɔ yu, nnɛ a lɔ̄gɔ nthí mi nɔ shāaŋ nu pugu yu pi njiŋnjiŋ.

name: Bambalang
text: A shi mbhi muuŋ mimbia, ɔ chhɔ̄ ligi yi ni Jishɔ nthɛ ŋa a shi ŋkwe ŋgwa pi moŋ phɨ yugu.

name: Bambalang
text: Ŋguoŋ nnu pei ni ndɔ̄gɔ lɨʼɨ nɔ chwīe nu nnu ŋa Taathɔ ni nchhu ntɔgɔ mbɨŋ pa njəɨlɨʼɨ yi nɛ pɔ nnu shini ŋa:.

name: Bambalang
text: Līi njəɨ, Miŋgwɛ haʼaŋ a shi yaʼa ji mimbia nɛ shi nshūu mbhi muuŋ mimbia Pi chhɔ̄ ligi yi ŋa Emanue, njiŋ yi pɔ ŋa, Minnwi pɔ pia pugu kaʼa. .

name: Bambalang
text: Joshɛ ni ŋga ŋgūʼu lɔgɔ, nchwīe nɔ haʼaŋ ŋgaŋ ntaoŋ Taathɔ ghɔ chhu nɛ, ndɔ̄gɔ ŋgwɛ vi.

text: Ndɔ paʼa ndɔ nji vi nɔ ŋgwɛ vi ti a nuʼuŋ mbhi muuŋ mimbia, Joshɛ chhɔ̄ ligi yi ni Jishɔ.

name: Bambalang
text: Fùoŋ Hɛrɔ ni ŋga njaʼo yei, nnu ghɔ ghana vi pugu pa ŋguoŋ ŋgwa Jerushalɛiŋ.

name: Bambalang
text: Pugu ni ŋkhwɛ̄ ghɔ ŋa, Bɛtɛlɛhɛiŋ moŋ Judia nthɛ ŋa yei yaoŋ ŋa *njəɨlɨʼɨ Minnwi ni nāʼaŋ nɛ:.

name: Bambalang
text: Nɛnnɛ Hɛrɔ mɛ̄iŋ pa ghaŋ shiethɔ pighɔ njiŋnjiŋ ntou vugu ti nji ndɨɨ ŋa fɨ́nəɨ ghɔ ni ŋkuʼɔ nɛ.

name: Bambalang
text: Ntaoŋ vugu Bɛtɛlɛhɛiŋ, nchhu nu ŋa, P̂əɨ ghə̄ɨ ntāʼa muuŋ ghɔ pɔpɔrɔ, ŋga njəɨ vi, pəɨ chwīe ǹji. Nnɛ ŋa mmu ŋkaa mu nthɛ ŋ̀gə̄ɨ ŋgaʼo vi.

name: Bambalang
text: Pugu ni ŋga njəɨ fɨ́nəɨ ghɔ tithi, njùʼɔ yugu pwa ti ŋgaʼa.

name: Bambalang
text: Nthɛ ŋa Minnwi ni ŋkwo shūu tə́nə yugu moŋ njə̀ɨŋ ŋa kiʼi pugu nuʼuŋ ŋgə̄ɨ njəɨ Fùoŋ Hɛrɔ nɛ, pugu tɔgɔ ndaoŋ nduoŋ mbɨnɨ laʼa pugu.

name: Bambalang
text: A lɔllɔ tɔthɨ, ndɔ̄gɔ muuŋ ghɔ pugu mǔuŋ vi ni tuʼu pugu tei ŋgə̄ɨ Ijipti.

name: Bambalang
text: Yei nnu ni nchwīe nnu ŋa njəɨlɨʼɨ Minnwi Jɛrimaya ni nchhu nɛ lɔ̄gɔ lɨʼɨ. Njəɨ lɨʼɨ Minnwi ghɔ mbɔ Jɛrimaya ni nchhu ŋa:.

name: Bamunka
text: Nɔ bɛ ŋwɔʼnə nɔ ndə i tʉʼ dʉ̀ʼ yie bətietie Jiso Klai*, ndə ɔ lɔ̀ hə kəlɔŋ Dɛbi*, ndə ɔ lɔ̀ hə kəlɔŋ Ablahaŋ.

name: Bamunka
text: Ablahaŋ nɔ nə bɛ tie Aisi. Aisi nɔ nə bɛ tie Jakɔ. Jakɔ kə́ bɛ tie Juda leʼnə bəliŋ-bi.

name: Bamunka
text: Juda kə́ bɛ tie Bɛlɛsh ghɔŋ Sela ndə ŋkwê-yʉə nə bɛ Tama. Bɛlɛsh kə́ bɛ tie Hɛslɔŋ. Hɛslɔŋ kə́ bɛ tie Alam.

name: Bamunka

name: Bamunka
text: Josia kə́ bɛ tie Jɛkonia ghɔŋbə bəliŋ-bi ndə bə kə bí ghɔŋ bɔŋ ndʉʉ ndə bə kə jə̀ŋ bɔŋ kɔ́ Babilɔŋ.

name: Bamunka
text: Jakɔ kə́ bɛ tie Jɔsɛ, ləŋ Mɛli. Mɛli bí Jiso ndə bə kə́ tíi ɔ nə mbʉ Wo ndə Nyii Kùŋ Tə́ŋ.

name: Bamunka
text: Ɔ bu bí vaabələŋ, a tyú yie-e nə Jiso, bʉʼka ɔ bu kwáa tʉ-bʉə-bi-kə ndə bʉ̂ʼtə-ʉə.

name: Bamunka

name: Bamunka
text: Ndʉʉmɛ, Hɛlo tíi mbʉ bʉə yétə bəlɔʼɔ mu bəliinə tyúutə bɔŋ nə ndʉʉ ndə mbʉ lɔʼ kə fyú chɔ yuo.

name: Bamunka
text: Ɔ tə́ŋ bɔŋ Bɛtələhɛŋ ghɔ̀ŋ mbɔ, B̈ii gɛ̀ bíehə tòʼ bíʼtə mbʉ vaa, ndʉʉ ndə b̈ii nyíɛ ɔŋ nɔ, b̈ii gwè shyíi mɔ, mbəŋ-ɔŋ chʉʼ leʼ gwè ghɔ lə̀ʼtə ɔŋ.

name: Bamunka

name: Bana

name: Bana
text: Mbaꞌa Zhəwda yakə kar Peresə lə Zara. Tamar na mbəghəshi kar Peresə lə Zara. Mbaꞌa Peresə yakə Esərəm, baw Esərəm yakə Ram.

name: Bariba

name: Bariba
text: Mɑ yɑm bururɑm mɛ, mu nùn wɛ̃re. Sɑɑ yerɑ u mu wunɑnɑ kɑ yɑm wɔ̃kuru.

name: Bariba
text: Mɑ u yɑm bururɑm sokɑ sɔ̃ɔ sɔɔ, yɑm wɔ̃kuru mɑɑ wɔ̃kuru. Mɑ sɔ̃ɔ sɔɔ ɡe kɑ wɔ̃ku te, n swĩinɑ mɑ n kuɑ tɔ̃ɔ ɡbiikiru.

name: Bariba
text: Mɑ Gusunɔ u nɛɛ, ɡɑ̃ɑnu nu tɛrio wɔllɔ nɡe ɡɔnɑ kpɑ mu n nim bɔnu sɑ̃ɑ.
normalised_text: ma gusuno u nee, gaanu nu terio wollo nge gona kpa mu n nim bonu saa.

name: Bariba
text: Ye u ɡeruɑ mɛ, mɑ wom mu tɛriɑ mu nim mɛ bɔnu kuɑ. Sukum wɑ̃ɑ nim wɔllɔ, sukum mɑɑ wɑ̃ɑ temɔ.
normalised_text: ye u gerua me, ma wom mu teria mu nim me bonu kua. sukum waa nim wollo, sukum maa waa temo.

name: Bariba
text: Mɑ u ɡɑ̃ɑ ni sokɑ wɔllu. Sɑɑ ye u yebɑ mɔ̀, sɔ̃ɔ sɔɔ kɑ wɔ̃kuru n swĩinɑ mɑ n kuɑ tɔ̃ru yiruse.

name: Bariba

name: Bariba

name: Bariba
text: Tem mu ɡɑ̃ɑ dɑbinu kpiɑ, kɑ yɑkɑ bwese bwesekɑ si su binu mɑrumɔ, kɑ dɑ̃ɑ binuɡii bwese bwesekɑ ni nu bweseru mɔ nin mɑrum sɔɔ. Mɑ n nùn wɛ̃re.

name: Bariba
text: Ye u yebɑ mɔ̀, sɔ̃ɔ sɔɔ kɑ wɔ̃kuru n swĩinɑ mɑ n kuɑ tɔ̃ru itɑse.

name: Bariba
text: Mɑ Gusunɔ u nɛɛ, fitilɑnu nu kooro wom dirum sɔɔ kpɑ nu sɔ̃ɔ sɔɔ kɑ wɔ̃kuru wunɑnɑ, kpɑ nu n sɔ̃ɔsimɔ sɑɑ ye wɔ̃su kɑ tɔ̃ɔ bɑkɑnu koo tore.

name: Bariba
text: Kpɑ nu n sɑ̃ɑ fitilɑnu wom dirum sɔɔ nu kɑ tem yɑm bururɑsiɑ. Ye u ɡeruɑ mɛ, mɑ n koorɑ.

name: Bariba
text: U fitilɑ bɑkɑnu yiru kuɑ, niyɑ sɔ̃ɔ kɑ suru. U mɑɑ kperi kuɑ. U sɔ̃ɔ kuɑwɑ u n kɑ bɑndu dii sɔ̃ɔ sɔɔ, mɑ u suru kuɑ u n kɑ bɑndu dii wɔ̃kuru.

name: Bariba

name: Bariba
text: Yen biru u yi domɑru kuɑ u nɛɛ, yi kɔwɑro yi dɑbiɑ yi yibu nim wɔ̃kun nim sɔɔ kpɑ ɡunɔsu su dɑbiɑ hɑnduniɑ sɔɔ.

name: Bariba
text: Sɑɑ ye u yebɑ mɔ̀, sɔ̃ɔ sɔɔ kɑ wɔ̃kuru n swĩinɑ mɑ n kuɑ tɔ̃ru nɔɔbuse.

name: Bariba
text: U ɡbeeku yɛɛ kuɑ bwese bwesekɑ kɑ kpɑɑku yɛɛ kɑ yɛɛ yi yi rɑ kɑbiri. Mɑ n nùn wɛ̃re.

name: Bariba
text: Ye u ɡeruɑ mɛ, mɑ u tɔnu tɑkɑ kuɑ u kɑ nùn weenɛ mɑm mɑm. U bu kuɑwɑ durɔ kɑ kurɔ.

name: Bariba
text: U mɑɑ nɛɛ, wee ye i ko n dɑ di. Yeyɑ yɑkɔ bweseru bɑɑtere tem sɔɔ kpuro te tɑ rɑ binu mɑ, kɑ dɑ̃ɑ binuɡiru bɑɑtere te tɑ ten bweseru mɔ ten mɑrum sɔɔ.

name: Bariba
text: Yerɑ u mɛɛrɑ kpuro ye u kuɑ, mɑ n nùn wɛ̃re ɡem ɡem. Sɑɑ ye u yebɑ mɔ̀, sɔ̃ɔ sɔɔ kɑ wɔ̃kuru n swĩinɑ mɑ n kuɑ tɔ̃ru nɔɔbɑ tiɑse.

name: Bariba
text: Nɡe mɛyɑ Gusunɔ u kɑ wɔllu kɑ tem kɑ kpuro ye yɑ wɑ̃ɑ sɔɔ tɑkɑ kuɑ u wiru ɡo.

name: Bariba
text: Tɔ̃ru nɔɔbɑ tiɑse sɔɔrɑ u win sɔmɑ ye u kuɑ kpuro wiru ɡo mɑ u wɛ̃rɑ tɔ̃ru nɔɔbɑ yiruse.

name: Basa
text: Aka na Agwatana karɛ azuba keeni unyizo nu umozhigo.

name: Basa
text: Nazhɛ Agwatana hiɛŋ, Go uhioko-uhwaŋna nama, nazhɛ uhioko-uhwaŋna namɛ.

name: Basa
text: Ta Agwatana kwụbɛ maa uhioko-uhwaŋna ata zhɛmɛ, boo bogwu uhioko-uhwaŋna ne tishi.

name: Basa
text: Agwatana po uhioko-uhwaŋna izeci maa uwaŋna, boo po tishi izeci maa ụjita. Ụrụmɛ namba, uvwungwa kaa namba, ụjita uhiiŋ ta.

name: Basa
text: Nazhɛ Agwatana hiɛŋ, ga araranga nama na ashashɛ maa e shiri ogwungwu ne meni ma azuba na mu na mɛ cɛnjɛ.

name: Basa
text: Nazhɛ Agwatana po araranga ata izeci maa tụla. Ụrụmɛ namba, uvwungwa kaa namba, ụjita uyebi ta.

name: Basa
text: Nazhɛ Agwatana hiɛŋ, Ge meni mu na mu namɛ tuta ta azuba mu sutono urubwo uko, maa cɛnjɛ tu hwoo tu banɛ. Yaa shɛ ga gana ata.

name: Basa
text: Nazhɛ Agwatana hiɛŋ, Ga ambɛ, ni i'w'ɛwɛ ye elele nɛ 'yajɛ izɛgwu keeni inɛɛ nɛ ya 'wala unshɛ na cɛnjɛ. Yaa shɛ ga gana ata.

name: Basa
text: Ibɛ po ambɛ unshɛ na cɛnjɛ keeni i'wɛ'wɛ ye elele nɛ 'yajɛ izɛgwu. Agwatana kwụbɛ maa i zhɛmɛ.

name: Basa
text: Ga i nama apata maa i shɛ uhioko-uhwaŋna na tụla, maa i no hiokono unyizo uhwaŋna. Yaa shɛ ga gana ata.

text: Ụrụmɛ namba, uvwungwa namba, ụjita uneshi ta.

name: Basa
text: Nazhɛ Agwatana hiɛŋ, Ge iyi-uumwa swoswoswo shini ne meni, ga shanụnụ shɛ na hila na azuba.

name: Bedjond

name: Bekwarra
text: Yè kˈo kpi iku, Atabuchi a shi irihung ataba ahe nˈiye angin.
normalised_text: ye ko kpi iku, atabuchi a shi irihung ataba ahe niye angin.

name: Bekwarra
text: Atabuchi a ka dee, <<Okung-gboo i tan nung,>> okung-gboo a ne tan nung.
normalised_text: atabuchi a ka dee, okunggboo i tan nung, okunggboo a ne tan nung.

name: Bekwarra
text: Atabuchi a ne de okung-gboo a taanung. Ehe a ka kung okung-gboo che tung ifufu.
normalised_text: atabuchi a ne de okunggboo a taanung. ehe a ka kung okunggboo che tung ifufu.

name: Bekwarra
text: Atabuchi a kuo okung-gboo dee, <<irite,>> ka kuo ifufu dee, <<uchu.>> Uchu a ji, achi a tan, ugbugbe irite ha yi ana.
normalised_text: atabuchi a kuo okunggboo dee, irite, ka kuo ifufu dee, uchu. uchu a ji, achi a tan, ugbugbe irite ha yi ana.

name: Bekwarra
text: Yè ngana Atabuchi a dee, <<Iriwongo i naa fuo kˈudyuudyen umo angˈuchi ahe nˈumo angˈitang.>>.
normalised_text: ye ngana atabuchi a dee, iriwongo i naa fuo kudyuudyen umo anguchi ahe numo angitang..

name: Bekwarra
text: Nang ana Atabuchi a shi iriwongo angin kˈa che umo angˈitang tung umo angˈuchi. A tum shi nang.
normalised_text: nang ana atabuchi a shi iriwongo angin ka che umo angitang tung umo anguchi. a tum shi nang.

name: Bekwarra
text: Atabuchi a kuo iriwongo angin dee, <<Ataba.>> Uchu a ji, achi a tan, irite angˈirihaa ha yi ana.
normalised_text: atabuchi a kuo iriwongo angin dee, ataba. uchu a ji, achi a tan, irite angirihaa ha yi ana.

name: Bekwarra
text: Nang ana Atabuchi a dee, <<Umo angˈitang e gung kˈipi kin, kˈitang inwom i naa kˈiye.>> A tum shi nang.
normalised_text: nang ana atabuchi a dee, umo angitang e gung kipi kin, kitang inwom i naa kiye. a tum shi nang.

name: Bekwarra
text: Atabuchi a kuo itang inwom dee, <<Itang,>> ka kuo umo angˈa gung dee, <<Irishaa ikaani.>> Atabuchi a ne he de ataanung.
normalised_text: atabuchi a kuo itang inwom dee, itang, ka kuo umo anga gung dee, irishaa ikaani. atabuchi a ne he de ataanung.

name: Bekwarra
text: Atabuchi a dee, <<Iyem e mi kˈitang: Abwan abˈe wum itáng rˈuchi abe wum igbii ha itáng e mi yè kˈitang ke wum unana igbii ibere.>> A tum shi nang.
normalised_text: atabuchi a dee, iyem e mi kitang abwan abe wum itang ruchi abe wum igbii ha itang e mi ye kitang ke wum unana igbii ibere. a tum shi nang.

name: Bekwarra
text: Abwan atitye-atitye abˈe wum itang rˈuchi atitye-atitye abe wum igbii ha itáng e mi yè kˈitang. Atabuchi a ne he dee ataanung.
normalised_text: abwan atityeatitye abe wum itang ruchi atityeatitye abe wum igbii ha itang e mi ye kitang. atabuchi a ne he dee ataanung.

name: Bekwarra
text: Uchu a ji, achi a tan, irite angˈichia ha yi ana.

name: Bekwarra
text: Atabuchi a ka dee, <<Iyem abˈe ka okung-gboo e hum kˈataba kˈiché irite tung uchu. Abe e chi uchia kˈi tyung unyang atitye-atitye, irite ahe nˈirije.
normalised_text: atabuchi a ka dee, iyem abe ka okunggboo e hum kataba kiche irite tung uchu. abe e chi uchia ki tyung unyang atityeatitye, irite ahe nirije.

text: Iyem abin e chi okung-gboo abˈe yi kˈataba kˈe tan nung kˈiye-angin.>> A tum shi nang.
normalised_text: iyem abin e chi okunggboo abe yi kataba ke tan nung kiyeangin. a tum shi nang.

name: Bekwarra
text: Atabuchi a shi iyem ikaani ihaa bˈe ka okung-gboo. Angˈa dyem fu i tan nung rˈichie, angˈunwatung i tan rˈuchu. Ehe a mang shi ukpin gbuduu pee.

normalised_text: ke tan nung richie ahe nuchu, ke tum mang che, okunggboo tung ifufu. atabuchi a ne de ataanung.

text: Uchu a ji, achi a tan, irite angˈirine ha yi ana.

normalised_text: atabuchi a ka dee, inyam atityeatitye e chie kumo, unwanyin e puru kuchi kataba..

name: Bekwarra
text: Atabuchi a ke abe ukwun kung kang dee, <<Amin e nyie irifen kˈe nyi he chie umo irishaa, anyin e tebe nyi he kˈiye angin.>>.
normalised_text: atabuchi a ke abe ukwun kung kang dee, amin e nyie irifen ke nyi he chie umo irishaa, anyin e tebe nyi he kiye angin..

name: Bekwarra
text: Uchu a ji, achi a tan, irite angˈrˈidyang ha yi ana.
normalised_text: uchu a ji, achi a tan, irite angridyang ha yi ana.

name: Bekwarra
text: Nang ana Atabuchi a shi uniom bii ufo-imin, ehe a shi he bii ufo-imin; ehe a shi abe unyiche ahe nˈunyinye.
normalised_text: nang ana atabuchi a shi uniom bii ufoimin, ehe a shi he bii ufoimin; ehe a shi abe unyiche ahe nunyinye.

name: Bekwarra
text: Atabuchi a ka dee, <<M ke amin abwan abˈé cha rˈitáng, rˈuchi abˈé wum igbii ha itáng woo kˈiye angin. Abe e ba cha iriji nga kˈamin.
normalised_text: atabuchi a ka dee, m ke amin abwan abe cha ritang, ruchi abe wum igbii ha itang woo kiye angin. abe e ba cha iriji nga kamin.

name: Bekwarra
text: M ke inyam iribu woo, rˈanyin kˈuchi rˈinyam abˈé faa irihung kˈitang rˈiyem woo bˈe yi irikpen, abwan ikwun kˈe ji.>> A tum shi nang.
normalised_text: m ke inyam iribu woo, ranyin kuchi rinyam abe faa irihung kitang riyem woo be yi irikpen, abwan ikwun ke ji. a tum shi nang.

name: Bekwarra
text: Nang ana Atabuchi a ne iyem abˈahe a shi bin woo chuo dee e taanung gbaa. Uchu a ji, achi a tan, irite angˈrˈidyakin ha yi ana.
normalised_text: nang ana atabuchi a ne iyem abahe a shi bin woo chuo dee e taanung gbaa. uchu a ji, achi a tan, irite angridyakin ha yi ana.

name: Bekwarra
text: Kˈukwo angin hˈAtabuchi a shi ataba ha rˈitang rˈiyem woo kˈaha ibere ngin.
normalised_text: kukwo angin hatabuchi a shi ataba ha ritang riyem woo kaha ibere ngin.

name: Bekwarra
text: Kˈunyang angˈAtabuchi a mia rˈokulo abin ashini, Ehe a nyang kˈirite angˈrˈidiehaa.
normalised_text: kunyang angatabuchi a mia rokulo abin ashini, ehe a nyang kirite angridiehaa.

name: Bekwarra
text: Atabuchi a kung ukwun ke irite angˈrˈidiehaa, mang shi irite yen ka shiri kataa, kˈucheche de ehe a nyang ye kˈokulo kˈirite angin.
normalised_text: atabuchi a kung ukwun ke irite angridiehaa, mang shi irite yen ka shiri kataa, kucheche de ehe a nyang ye kokulo kirite angin.

name: Bekwarra
text: Angin ha yi ubuo ne nˈe shi ataba ahe nˈiye-angin. Kˈunyang Onyua-Iye Atabuchi a shi iye angin ahe nˈataba.
normalised_text: angin ha yi ubuo ne ne shi ataba ahe niyeangin. kunyang onyuaiye atabuchi a shi iye angin ahe nataba.

name: Bekwarra
text: Ayinikin, umo irishaa i mang dim yè kˈitang ba kˈuchi kwun itang kˈi cha kpataa.
normalised_text: ayinikin, umo irishaa i mang dim ye kitang ba kuchi kwun itang ki cha kpataa.

name: Bekwarra
text: Ké kiimkpet kyikû, Osówo o/chi bubóng ne esí.
normalised_text: ke kiimkpet kyiku, osowo ochi bubong ne esi.

name: Bekwarra
text: Ne Osówo o-kye busa o/fu, kiinwángé kyibyí, ne kiinwángé kyi-byí.
normalised_text: ne osowo okye busa ofu, kiinwange kyibyi, ne kiinwange kyibyi.

name: Bekwarra
text: Ne Osówo o-ri o/fu, kiinwángé ánkyi nkyi kanong, ne o-kyii kiinwángé ne kyifip.
normalised_text: ne osowo ori ofu, kiinwange ankyi nkyi kanong, ne okyii kiinwange ne kyifip.

name: Bekwarra
text: Osówo o/kó kiinwángé, dyicí, o-kó kyifip, buchú. Ne dyikurúku dyi-fyi, dyicófóróng dyi-cé, dyicí dyibónge dyi-shwôm.
normalised_text: osowo oko kiinwange, dyici, oko kyifip, buchu. ne dyikuruku dyifyi, dyicoforong dyice, dyici dyibonge dyishwom.

name: Bekwarra
text: Osówo o/kó chwǒm ánkyi wǎ mbwôm, bubóng. Ne dyikurúku dyi-fyi, dyicófóróng dyi-cé, ací afee a-shwôm.
normalised_text: osowo oko chwom ankyi wa mbwom, bubong. ne dyikuruku dyifyi, dyicoforong dyice, aci afee ashwom.

name: Bekwarra
text: Ne Osówo o-kye busa o/fu, baya ḿbé kyísí bacibi ba-jâ kyicê kyibónge, eringe nyí esí edabyí. Ne kyi-chi éné.
normalised_text: ne osowo okye busa ofu, baya mbe kyisi bacibi baja kyice kyibonge, eringe nyi esi edabyi. ne kyichi ene.

name: Bekwarra
text: Osówo o/kó esí, esí, o-kó baya ḿbé ba/cibi ba-jâ kyicê kyibónge, baya ḿbé baryên. Ne Osówo o-ri o/fu, nkyi kanong.
normalised_text: osowo oko esi, esi, oko baya mbe bacibi baja kyice kyibonge, baya mbe baryen. ne osowo ori ofu, nkyi kanong.

name: Bekwarra
text: Ne Osówo o-kye busa o/fu, byichí ḿbyí byidazím esang ne ḿbyí byidazím byirim byibyí ké esí ké azong ké azong. Ne kyi-chi éné.
normalised_text: ne osowo okye busa ofu, byichi mbyi byidazim esang ne mbyi byidazim byirim byibyi ke esi ke azong ke azong. ne kyichi ene.

name: Bekwarra
text: Ne byichí byi-byí kâng ké esí, ḿbyí byidazím esang ne byirim ké azong ké azong. Ne Osówo o-ri o/fu, nkyi kanong.
normalised_text: ne byichi byibyi kang ke esi, mbyi byidazim esang ne byirim ke azong ke azong. ne osowo ori ofu, nkyi kanong.

name: Bekwarra
text: Ne dyikurúku dyi-fyi, dyicófóróng dyi-cé, ací achât a-shwôm.
normalised_text: ne dyikuruku dyifyi, dyicoforong dyice, aci achat ashwom.

name: Bekwarra
text: Ne Osówo o-kye busa o/fu, byěm ḿbyí byidakûkye kiinwángé byibyí kyíbóng, byi-kyii buchú ne esû, byi-tông ekap nyí ací ne aje ne ajî-byifen.
normalised_text: ne osowo okye busa ofu, byem mbyi byidakukye kiinwange byibyi kyibong, byikyii buchu ne esu, byitong ekap nyi aci ne aje ne ajibyifen.

name: Bekwarra
text: byi-kûsan kyíbóng eringe nyí byidakûkye kiinwángé ké ejíí. Ne kyi-chi éné.
normalised_text: byikusan kyibong eringe nyi byidakukye kiinwange ke ejii. ne kyichi ene.

name: Bekwarra
text: Ne o-tî byěm ámbyi ḿbyí byidakye kiinwángé ké bubóng byi-kûkye kiinwángé ké ejíí.
normalised_text: ne oti byem ambyi mbyi byidakye kiinwange ke bubong byikukye kiinwange ke ejii.

name: Bekwarra
text: byi-kûkyú batu ḿbé buchú ne esû, byi-kyii kiinwángé ne kyifip. Ne Osówo o-ri o/fu, nkyi kanong.
normalised_text: byikukyu batu mbe buchu ne esu, byikyii kiinwange ne kyifip. ne osowo ori ofu, nkyi kanong.

name: Bekwarra
text: Ne dyikurúku dyi-fyi, dyicófóróng dyi-cé, ací anyii a-shwôm.
normalised_text: ne dyikuruku dyifyi, dyicoforong dyice, aci anyii ashwom.

name: Bekwarra
text: Ne Osówo o-kye busa o/fu, azong-enyam chwóó ne ekworê byisú ké baya, ne bunurung ḿbú budabyí kyíbóng bubyí.
normalised_text: ne osowo okye busa ofu, azongenyam chwoo ne ekwore byisu ke baya, ne bunurung mbu budabyi kyibong bubyi.

name: Bekwarra
text: Ne dyikurúku dyi-fyi, dyicófóróng dyi-cé, ací atánge a-shwôm.
normalised_text: ne dyikuruku dyifyi, dyicoforong dyice, aci atange ashwom.

name: Bekwarra
text: Ne Osówo o-kye busa o/fu, enyam ebyí ké ejíí ké azong ké azong, byitú ne enyam-dyikán nyí eryên ne nyí boǒníng. Ne kyi-chi éné.
normalised_text: ne osowo okye busa ofu, enyam ebyi ke ejii ke azong ke azong, byitu ne enyamdyikan nyi eryen ne nyi booning. ne kyichi ene.

name: Bekwarra
text: Ne Osówo kâng o-chi banet wǎ nyǐ oyén. O/chi kámbé onyinchéng ne onyinyi.
normalised_text: ne osowo kang ochi banet wa nyi oyen. ochi kambe onyincheng ne onyinyi.

name: Bekwarra
text: Ne Osówo o-raa ne banet o/fu, me nn/kye běn kángkáng byichí ḿbyí mbyi byi-zím m byirim ne ḿbyí mbyi byi-zím m esang ké ejíí. Kû n̂g eryí kámbyí.
normalised_text: ne osowo oraa ne banet ofu, me nnkye ben kangkang byichi mbyi mbyi byizim m byirim ne mbyi mbyi byizim m esang ke ejii. ku ng eryi kambyi.

name: Bekwarra
text: Ne Osówo o-ri kángkáng byěm ḿbyí o/chi, ne byi/mû byi-nwa ng kanong kanong. Ne dyikurúku dyi-fyi, dyicófóróng dyi-cé, ací nyâchât a-shwôm.
normalised_text: ne osowo ori kangkang byem mbyi ochi, ne byimu byinwa ng kanong kanong. ne dyikuruku dyifyi, dyicoforong dyice, aci nyachat ashwom.

name: Bekwarra
text: Osówo o/chi bubóng ne esí ne kángkáng byěm ḿbyí mbyi ké mbyí byi-man.
normalised_text: osowo ochi bubong ne esi ne kangkang byem mbyi mbyi ke mbyi byiman.

name: Bekwarra
text: Ké ací káchâtkányi, ányi Osówo oo/man kángkáng bǎmkpóngé emen.
normalised_text: ke aci kachatkanyi, anyi osowo ooman kangkang bamkponge emen.

name: Bekwarra
text: Osówo o/jware dyicí ńdyí ací káchâtkányi o-tî dyicí ándyi o/fu, dyijá ǎ nyǐ, ké nǎ, ké dyicí ándyi, nyǐ o/man bǎmkpóngé emen ḿbé o/chi ejíí.
normalised_text: osowo ojware dyici ndyi aci kachatkanyi oti dyici andyi ofu, dyija a nyi, ke na, ke dyici andyi, nyi oman bamkponge emen mbe ochi ejii.

name: Bekwarra
text: Éné nké Osówo o/chi bubóng ne esí. Ké nkéré mú Osówo Óburúkpâbí o/chi bubóng ne esí.
normalised_text: ene nke osowo ochi bubong ne esi. ke nkere mu osowo oburukpabi ochi bubong ne esi.

name: Bekwarra
text: byichí byi/mû byi*fí* osang-kyichí nang obónge o/mû o*da/byí ne* ké nǎ, nyǐ o/mû o*da/twóm ne omu* ne nang onet to o/mû o*fí mú odakpang byiryíng*.
normalised_text: byichi byimu byifi osangkyichi nang obonge omu odabyi ne ke na, nyi omu odatwom ne omu ne nang onet to omu ofi mu odakpang byirying.

name: Bekwarra
text: Ne Osówo Óburúkpâbí o-kpere kâng ecing kyísí o-mee onet ké nyǐ, ne o-tuu bufú-dyikpen ké efâ-nzóng emen, ne onyinchéng ámu o-firi ne dyikpen.
normalised_text: ne osowo oburukpabi okpere kang ecing kyisi omee onet ke nyi, ne otuu bufudyikpen ke efanzong emen, ne onyincheng amu ofiri ne dyikpen.

name: Bekwarra
text: Ne Osówo Óburúkpâbí o-chi kyifát ńkyí o/kwón byěm ké Édin, ké kyicê ńkyí esû edabyí, ne o-tî onyinchéng ámu mú o/chi ké kyifát ánkyi.
normalised_text: ne osowo oburukpabi ochi kyifat nkyi okwon byem ke edin, ke kyice nkyi esu edabyi, ne oti onyincheng amu mu ochi ke kyifat ankyi.

name: Bekwarra
text: Kace ka/mû ka-fím m ké Édin ka-sen n ka-bâ ng ekye kyifát ánkyi omu. Â a/shwôm kyifát ánkyi, kace ánke ka/kyii ka-firi buce bunyii.
normalised_text: kace kamu kafim m ke edin kasen n kaba ng ekye kyifat ankyi omu. a ashwom kyifat ankyi, kace anke kakyii kafiri buce bunyii.

name: Bekwarra
text: Mbwôp kashú-kace ba/mû ba-kó ng Pyíshon. Nké nke ka-sen n ké esí nyí Habyíla.
normalised_text: mbwop kashukace bamu bako ng pyishon. nke nke kasen n ke esi nyi habyila.

name: Bekwel
text: Beeka dhaad ɛ Yezu Klisto, mɔn ɛ Dhavid, dha ɛ Abalaam:.
normalised_text: beeka dhaad e yezu klisto, mon e dhavid, dha e abalaam.

name: Bekwel
text: Yɛ ɛ́ Abalaam ɛ nabya Izak, Izak ɛ nabya Zakɔɔb, Zakɔɔb kabya yɛ ɛ́ Yuda nɛ bɔn-nyɛɛg.
normalised_text: ye e abalaam e nabya izak, izak e nabya zakoob, zakoob kabya ye e yuda ne bonnyeeg.

name: Bekwel
text: Tin, Yuda kabya ɛ́ Pelɛɛz bɛ nɛ Zaala. Din ɛ nyɛɛg'ɔɔ nabɛ ɛ́ Tamaad. Pelɛɛz kabya ɛ́ Ɛslɔm, Ɛslɔm kabya yɛ ɛ́ Alam.
normalised_text: tin, yuda kabya e peleez be ne zaala. din e nyeegoo nabe e tamaad. peleez kabya e eslom, eslom kabya ye e alam.

name: Bekwel
text: Mɔn Alam kadi ɛ́ Aminadaab, Aminadaab nakabya yɛ ɛ́ Naasɔn. Naasɔn kabya ɛ́ Salman.
normalised_text: mon alam kadi e aminadaab, aminadaab nakabya ye e naason. naason kabya e salman.

name: Bekwel
text: Salman bɛ nɛ myɛl Layaab ɛ́ nabya Bhooz. Bhooz bɛ nɛ ngbɛ myɛl Luth nakabya ɛ́ Obɛɛd. Obɛɛd nabya ɛ́ Yese.
normalised_text: salman be ne myel layaab e nabya bhooz. bhooz be ne ngbe myel luth nakabya e obeed. obeed nabya e yese.

name: Bekwel
text: Yese kabya ɛ́ mɛkoozi Dhavid. Mɛkoozi Dhavid kabya ɛ́ Salomɔŋ, nyɛ nabya Salomɔŋ ɛ́ bɛ nɛ mwaa Uli .
normalised_text: yese kabya e mekoozi dhavid. mekoozi dhavid kabya e salomong, nye nabya salomong e be ne mwaa uli.

name: Bekwel
text: Salomɔŋ nabɛ ɛ́ sɛɛg ɛ Loboam, Loboam nakabya yɛ ɛ́ Abya, Abya kazɛbya ɛ́ Asaf.
normalised_text: salomong nabe e seeg e loboam, loboam nakabya ye e abya, abya kazebya e asaf.

name: Bekwel
text: Asaf nabya yɛ ɛ́ Yozafat, Yozafat kabya ɛ́ Yolam. Mɔn Yolam nabɛ ɛ́ Ozias.
normalised_text: asaf nabya ye e yozafat, yozafat kabya e yolam. mon yolam nabe e ozias.

name: Bekwel
text: Ozias nadi ɛ́ sɛɛg ɛ Yotam, Yotam kabya ɛ́ Akaaz, Akaaz eezɛbya Ezekias.
normalised_text: ozias nadi e seeg e yotam, yotam kabya e akaaz, akaaz eezebya ezekias.

name: Bekwel
text: Ezekias kabya ɛ́ Manase. Manase kabya ɛ́ Amɔn, Amɔn kabya ɛ́ Zozias.
normalised_text: ezekias kabya e manase. manase kabya e amon, amon kabya e zozias.

name: Bekwel
text: Zozias kadi ɛ́ sɛɛg ɛ Zekonias nɛ bɔn-nyɛɛg, yɛ é ghɛŋ bɔn ɛ Yisalaɛl natɔ́ é ekwom pɛ kyee dik Bhabhilɔn ɛ.
normalised_text: zozias kadi e seeg e zekonias ne bonnyeeg, ye e gheng bon e yisalael nato e ekwom pe kyee dik bhabhilon e.

name: Bekwel
text: Bhii bɔn ɛ Yisalaɛl natɔ́ é ekwom pɛ kyee dik Bhabhilɔn ɛ, Zekonias naakɛbya Salatyɛl. Bhii tak, Salatyɛl eezɛbya Zoolobhabhɛl.
normalised_text: bhii bon e yisalael nato e ekwom pe kyee dik bhabhilon e, zekonias naakebya salatyel. bhii tak, salatyel eezebya zoolobhabhel.

name: Bekwel
text: Zoolobhabhɛl kabya ɛ́ Abyuud. Abyuud nabɛ ɛ́ sɛɛg ɛ Eliakim, Eliakim kadi ɛ́ sɛɛg ɛ Azɔɔd.
normalised_text: zoolobhabhel kabya e abyuud. abyuud nabe e seeg e eliakim, eliakim kadi e seeg e azood.

name: Bekwel
text: Azɔɔd eezɛbya Sadɔk, Sadɔk kabya ɛ́ Akim. Mɔn ɛ Akim kadi ɛ́ Eliyuud.
normalised_text: azood eezebya sadok, sadok kabya e akim. mon e akim kadi e eliyuud.

name: Bekwel
text: Eliyuud kadi ɛ́ sɛɛg ɛ Eleazaad, Eleazaad kabya ɛ́ Matan. Matan eezɛbya Zakɔɔb.
normalised_text: eliyuud kadi e seeg e eleazaad, eleazaad kabya e matan. matan eezebya zakoob.

name: Bekwel
text: Zakɔɔb kadi ɛ́ sɛɛg ɛ Zozɛf ngom ɛ Maali. Yɛ ɛ́ Maali tak ɛ nabya Yezu bot di edjóo Mɛsia ɔ.
normalised_text: zakoob kadi e seeg e zozef ngom e maali. ye e maali tak e nabya yezu bot di ejuo mesia o.

name: Bekwel
text: Zozɛf, mwaaz'ɛ nabɛ ɛ́ mot epiki, nyɛ nabɛ ɛ́ ààkwyɛl ɛdhusal nyɛ é mis mɛ bot. Nyɛ ɛ́ boozɛke náá, emwaaz bɛ nɛ Maali si tɔ syaab.
normalised_text: zozef, mwaaze nabe e mot epiki, nye nabe e aakwyel edhusal nye e mis me bot. nye e boozeke naa, emwaaz be ne maali si to syaab.

name: Bekwel
text: Nyɛ waabya mɔn mɔɔ motom, bi aaget nyɛ ɛ Yezu, etɛɛ náá, nyɛy ɛ́ kwaatsik bot ɛ mbyak'ɛ tɔ mesyem mɔɔ.».
normalised_text: nye waabya mon moo motom, bi aaget nye e yezu, etee naa, nyey e kwaatsik bot e mbyake to mesyem moo.".

name: Bekwel
text: Esesɛɛ binek djas aasael ɛ, etɛɛ náá, etɛp djas Ghɛŋ nalɛɛ tɔ nuub ngoolel-Mɛkpa ɛ Zɛɛb ɛ neebela ɛsuk. Ye nabɛ ɛ́ náá:.
normalised_text: esesee binek jas aasael e, etee naa, etep jas gheng nalee to nuub ngoolelmekpa e zeeb e neebela esuk. ye nabe e naa.

name: Bekwel
text: «Mɔn ɛsyes ɛ moma di ààgu botom ɔ waabela ɛbum. Bhii tak, nyɛ waabya mɔn mɔɔ motom, nyɛ aaget nyɛ ɛ́ Emanuɛl. » Ye kwyɛl ɛlɛɛ ɛ́: «Zɛɛb ɛ́ nɛ nena.».
normalised_text: "mon esyes e moma di aagu botom o waabela ebum. bhii tak, nye waabya mon moo motom, nye aaget nye e emanuel. " ye kwyel elee e "zeeb e ne nena.".

name: Bekwel
text: Dáa Zozɛf kadjem é gɔ́ ɛ, nyɛ zokasa ɛ́ dáa fofop ɛ Ghɛŋ nalɛɛ nyɛ ɛ, nyɛ ɛ́ boozɛbeeb myɛl Maali.
normalised_text: dea zozef kajem e go e, nye zokasa e dea fofop e gheng nalee nye e, nye e boozebeeb myel maali.

name: Bekwel
text: Tin, nyɛ nabɛ ɛ́ ààsɛɛga goŋ bɛ nɛ myɛl kɛkum dwoo myɛl nabya mɔn motom, Zozɛf naget Yezu ɛ.
normalised_text: tin, nye nabe e aaseega gong be ne myel kekum dwoo myel nabya mon motom, zozef naget yezu e.

name: Bekwel
text: Tin, bɛ moo zɛdji náá: «Mɛkoozi mɛ eYuda, tɔlɔɔ mɔn byel ɔ, nyɛ ɛ́ wo? Bis eebee kwyikwyen yɛ edus pɛ ɛdjem ɛ dwoo, bis ɛ́ bookazyɛ zɛduwal nyɛ.».
normalised_text: tin, be moo zeji naa "mekoozi me eyuda, toloo mon byel o, nye e wo? bis eebee kwyikwyen ye edus pe ejem e dwoo, bis e bookazye zeduwal nye.".

name: Bekwel
text: Dáa mɛkoozi Eelood nagwak deenek ɛ́, ye naanɛɛg nyɛ lo zɛm-zɛm, nyɛy nɛ bot ɛdi tɔ ghaada Yeluzalɛm ɔ.
normalised_text: dea mekoozi eelood nagwak deenek e, ye naaneeg nye lo zemzem, nyey ne bot edi to ghaada yeluzalem o.

name: Bekwel
text: Wɔ gwaa, nyɛ zɛdjóo bot ɛ nadi kɔ elo e eboo bɛghaa-Zɛɛb ɔ djas, nɛ bɛghaŋ ɛ mɛkana mɛ etsi djas, nyɛ needji bɛ di Mɛsia di esiŋa nɛ ɛbyel ɔ.
normalised_text: wo gwaa, nye zejuo bot e nadi ko elo e eboo beghaazeeb o jas, ne beghang e mekana me etsi jas, nye neeji be di mesia di esinga ne ebyel o.

name: Bekwel
text: Bɛ eezɛbɔɔza nɛ nɛ náá: «Pɛ Bheteleɛm, pɛ kyee dik Yude etɛɛ náá, ngoolel-Mɛkpa ɛ Zɛɛb naakwyal náá:.
normalised_text: be eezebooza ne ne naa "pe bheteliem, pe kyee dik yude etee naa, ngoolelmekpa e zeeb naakwyal naa.

name: Bekwel
text: Deenek, wɔ gwaa, mɛkoozi Eelood zɛdjóo bɛtsoŋ ɛ bot binɔk tɔ syaab. Tin, bɛ eezɛlɛɛ nyɛ sum di nɛ ɛwala ɛ kwyikwyen tak nanyen tɔ gwoo ɛ.
normalised_text: deenek, wo gwaa, mekoozi eelood zejuo betsong e bot binok to syaab. tin, be eezelee nye sum di ne ewala e kwyikwyen tak nanyen to gwoo e.

name: Bekwel
text: Dáa bɛ nabee kwyikwyen ɛ, bɛ nabɛ ɛ́, bɛ naamyaala ɛbuɛpe.
normalised_text: dea be nabee kwyikwyen e, be nabe e, be naamyaala ebuepe.

name: Bekwel
text: Bhii tak, wɔ gwaa Zɛɛb zɛlu bɛ tɔ dhyam náá, bɛ nàdhaa pɛ daa Eelood. Tin, é ɛsik ɛ lɔɔ pɛ dɛl, bɛ nakadhaŋ ɛ́, pɛ ze sis.
normalised_text: bhii tak, wo gwaa zeeb zelu be to dhyam naa, be nadhaa pe daa eelood. tin, e esik e loo pe del, be nakadhang e, pe ze sis.

name: Bekwel
text: Tin, Zozɛf ɛ́ boozɛwyɛl, nɔɔ mɔn nɛ myɛl, zɛkaab pum nɛ pum, tɔ́, kɛsɔwa pɛ Eziptɛ.

name: Birifor, Malba
text: A *Jeeju-Kirisi sãa-kʋnbɔ nɩ a basɩmɛ ba na sɛb, wa nyɔw nɩ a Abʋraham wa ta nɩ a Davɩtɩ ɩ̃ cen na ta a Jeeju-Kirisi.
normalised_text: a jeejukirisi sanakunbo ni a basime ba na seb, wa nyow ni a aburaham wa ta ni a daviti in chen na ta a jeejukirisi.

name: Birifor, Malba
text: A Abʋraham dɔw na a Ɩjakɩ, a Ɩjakɩ mɩ dɔw a Jakɔb, a Jakɔb mɩ ɩraa ɩ̃ dɔw a Juda nɩ a ʋ yɛɛr.
normalised_text: a aburaham dow na a ijaki, a ijaki mi dow a jakob, a jakob mi iraa in dow a juda ni a u yeer.

name: Birifor, Malba
text: a Juda mɩ lɛ dɔw a ɩ nɩ a Jara , a Farɛsɩ mɩ dɔw a Ɛsɩrɔ̃, a Ɛsɩrɔ̃ mɩ ɩraa ɩ̃ dɔw a Aram.
normalised_text: a juda mi le dow a i ni a jara, a faresi mi dow a esiron, a esiron mi iraa in dow a aram.

name: Birifor, Malba
text: a Aram mɩ lɛ dɔw a Aminadab, a Aminadab mɩ dɔw a Naasõ, a Naasõ mɩ ɩraa ɩ̃ dɔw a Salmɔ̃.
normalised_text: a aram mi le dow a aminadab, a aminadab mi dow a naason, a naason mi iraa in dow a salmon.

name: Birifor, Malba
text: a Salmɔ̃ mɩ lɛ dɔw a Booji , a Booji mɩ dɔw a Obɛdɩ , a Obɛdɩ mɩ ɩraa ɩ̃ dɔw a Jɛsɩ.
normalised_text: a salmon mi le dow a booji, a booji mi dow a obedi, a obedi mi iraa in dow a jesi.

name: Birifor, Malba
text: a Jɛsɩ mɩ lɛ dɔw a jamana Davɩtɩ. A Davɩtɩ dɔw na a Salʋmɔ̃ .

name: Birifor, Malba
text: a Salʋmɔ̃ mɩ dɔw a Orobom, a Orobom mɩ ɩraa ɩ̃ dɔw a Abiya, a Abiya mɩ lɛ dɔw a Asafi.
normalised_text: a salumon mi dow a orobom, a orobom mi iraa in dow a abiya, a abiya mi le dow a asafi.

name: Birifor, Malba
text: a Asafi mɩ dɔw a Jojafati, a Jojafati mɩ ɩraa ɩ̃ dɔw a Joram, a Joram mɩ lɛ dɔw a Ojaasi.
normalised_text: a asafi mi dow a jojafati, a jojafati mi iraa in dow a joram, a joram mi le dow a ojaasi.

name: Birifor, Malba
text: a Ojaasi mɩ dɔw a Jowatam, a Jowatam mɩ ɩraa ɩ̃ dɔw a Akaji, a Akaji mɩ lɛ dɔw a Ejekasi.
normalised_text: a ojaasi mi dow a jowatam, a jowatam mi iraa in dow a akaji, a akaji mi le dow a ejekasi.

name: Birifor, Malba
text: a Ejekasi mɩ dɔw a Manase, a Manase mɩ ɩraa ɩ̃ dɔw a Amɔ̃, a Amɔ̃ mɩ lɛ dɔw a Jojiya.
normalised_text: a ejekasi mi dow a manase, a manase mi iraa in dow a amon, a amon mi le dow a jojiya.

name: Birifor, Malba
text: a Jojiya mɩ dɔw a Jekɔnya nɩ a ʋ yɛɛr a daar ʋlɔ ba na nyɔɔr a *Ɩsɩrayɛl nɩbɛ cenʼɩ̃ a *Babɩlɔ̃-tẽw.

name: Birifor, Malba
text: A mɩnɛ ba na nyɔɔr a Ɩsɩrayɛl nɩbɛ cenʼɩ̃ a Babɩlɔ̃-tẽw baar, a Jɛkɔnya dɔw na a Salatɩɛl a be, a Salatɩɛl mɩ dɔw a Jorobabɛl.
normalised_text: a mine ba na nyoor a isirayel nibe chenin a babilontenw baar, a jekonya dow na a salatiel a be, a salatiel mi dow a jorobabel.

normalised_text: yakubu cha, ara chen yusufu, mawal mareyama ma mbawaza yesu maa ey kayaba almaseyhu.

name: Buwal
text: Yusufu, səbe anta wese ca, ara ɗala ma taŋtaŋ, a kaɗaw ŋ ghwalaza ma anta a tama hejəye səkwaw, a ɗaw ŋ geɓza aka a werwer.
normalised_text: yusufu, sebe anta wese cha, ara dala ma tangtang, a kadaw ng ghwalaza ma anta a tama hejeye sekwaw, a daw ng gebza aka a werwer.

name: Buwal
text: A nambawaha mba mawal, hwa necene zlam anta Yesu. Cemey, ara mbe ma kenerehzata hejəye anta ege aza, ŋ gay tata ege.».
normalised_text: a nambawaha mba mawal, hwa nechene dlam anta yesu. chemey, ara mbe ma kenerehzata hejeye anta ege aza, ng gay tata ege.".

name: Buwal
text: Səkan anta tewtew a laha ana ebe ŋghe ca, ndar zlap Bay Madakal maa a zlap ta ŋ pakam mba ma zlap ma anta a la njenjəwen.
normalised_text: sekan anta tewtew a laha ana ebe nghe cha, ndar dlap bay madakal maa a dlap ta ng pakam mba ma dlap ma anta a la njenjewen.

name: Buwal
text: A zlap, a ŋgaya: «Haldəma dalay a nala a dəmas, a nambawaha mba mawal, əy nayaɓa Əymanuyəyla, ana zlap ca: Gazlavay mbəy a heje.».
normalised_text: a dlap, a ngaya "haldema dalay a nala a demas, a nambawaha mba mawal, ey nayaba eymanuyeyla, ana dlap cha gadlavay mbey a heje.".

name: Buwal
text: Aya, maa Yusufu a fədaha aza ca, a law, ana maa malaɓ Gazlavay Madakal a zlepene wese. A ŋta dəma anta Marəyama aza a wata.
normalised_text: aya, maa yusufu a fedaha aza cha, a law, ana maa malab gadlavay madakal a dlepene wese. a ngta dema anta mareyama aza a wata.

name: Buwal
text: Cemey, əy kajav kusam a mbe askwaw, ha hwas ata vah maa a mbawaza mba anta aza. A təwse ca, Yusufu a cene zlam anta, Yesu.
normalised_text: chemey, ey kajav kusam a mbe askwaw, ha hwas ata vah maa a mbawaza mba anta aza. a tewse cha, yusufu a chene dlam anta, yesu.

name: Buwal
text: Aya, Həyrudus a yata hejəye kəleŋ ege wese ata deh, a ɗawzata, a ŋgaya: «Gamzla anta a ghwalha ca, ata vah vekey?».
normalised_text: aya, heyrudus a yata hejeye keleng ege wese ata deh, a dawzata, a ngaya "gamdla anta a ghwalha cha, ata vah vekey?".

name: Buwal
text: Maa əy gəre gamzla wese ca, əy sasam dakala mambaza.
normalised_text: maa ey gere gamdla wese cha, ey sasam dakala mambaza.

name: Buwal
text: A dəwze anta ca, Gazlavay a zlepetene ta ŋ seŋseŋ, əy ɗaw ŋ zen ta ara bay Həyrudus səkwaw. Aya, əy ŋta taf matakan ŋ zen ŋ hayak tata.
normalised_text: a dewze anta cha, gadlavay a dlepetene ta ng sengseng, ey daw ng zen ta ara bay heyrudus sekwaw. aya, ey ngta taf matakan ng zen ng hayak tata.

name: Buwal
text: A təwse ca, Yusufu a gwarzam, a ŋta ata mbaw ey maman, aya, a hey anta ŋ hayak Məysəra a zaɗaw.
normalised_text: a tewse cha, yusufu a gwarzam, a ngta ata mbaw ey maman, aya, a hey anta ng hayak meysera a zadaw.

name: Buwal
text: A təwse ca, zlap ma Yereməya, mba ma zlap ma mala Gazlavay maa a zlap zlezle, a ŋgaya:.
normalised_text: a tewse cha, dlap ma yeremeya, mba ma dlap ma mala gadlavay maa a dlap dledle, a ngaya.

name: Buwal
text: Aya, maa Həyrudus a mac anta ca, malaɓ Bay Madakal a ghwelene kusam ŋ Yusufu ta ŋ seŋseŋ ŋ hayak Məysəra.
normalised_text: aya, maa heyrudus a mac anta cha, malab bay madakal a ghwelene kusam ng yusufu ta ng sengseng ng hayak meysera.

name: Buwal
text: A təwse ca, Yusufu a gwarzam, a ŋta ata ata mbaw ey maman, əy zen tata ŋ hayak Əysərayəyla.

name: Buwal
text: Ata vah wese ca, heje wende aka, zlam anta Yuhana, ma la Baptəysma, a ndaha ata darzlam ma ŋ hayak Yahudəya, a kaghwal zlap.

name: Bwile
text: Mu emwakonkanine ifikolwe fyakwa Yesu Klistu, umwana wakwa Davidi, uwali mwana wakwa Abulahamu.

text: Yosefu ali muntu uwalekita ifyalungama, eikyo talefwaya ukumukanina palwalala kabili aalepinga ukubwesya ubwimashi mubumfisolo.
