name: Bété, Daloa
text: Ablaamö -yɛ Davidɩ 'sɔ, ngëyi -ɛɛ 'mö Zezwi 'Kli 'wlʋ-a, ɛ 'möö nɩkpa 'kadɩ -bha. Ɔ -tɩbhatɩbhangwa -mʋabha 'bhuoo nglɩ-ɛ la'a:.
normalised_text: ablaama ye davidi so, ngeyi ee ma zezwi kli wlua, e maa nikpa kadi ba. o tibatibangwa muaba buoo nglie laa.

name: Bété, Daloa
text: Ablaamö gwalɩ-a Izakö, Izakö gwalɩ-a Zakɔpö, Zakɔpö gwalɩ-a Zwida -yɛ ɔ -dagwie 'sɔ.
normalised_text: ablaama gwalia izaka, izaka gwalia zakopa, zakopa gwalia zwida ye o dagwie so.

name: Bété, Daloa
text: Zwida -yɛ Tamalɩ sɔ-ɔ gwalɩ-a Falɛsɩ -yɛ Zala 'sɔ. Falɛsɩ gwalɩ-a Ɛzlɔmö, Ɛzlɔmö gwalɩ-a Alamö.
normalised_text: zwida ye tamali soo gwalia falesi ye zala so. falesi gwalia ezloma, ezloma gwalia alama.

name: Bété, Daloa
text: Alamö gwalɩ-a Aminadabö, Aminadabö gwalɩ-a Nasɔ, Nasɔ gwalɩ-a Salɩmɔ.
normalised_text: alama gwalia aminadaba, aminadaba gwalia naso, naso gwalia salimo.

name: Bété, Daloa
text: Davidɩ -yɛ 'nglɔ ɔ -sa-a Wili yawʋ sɔ-ɔ gwalɩ-a Salomɔ.
normalised_text: davidi ye nglo o saa wili yawu soo gwalia salomo.

name: Bété, Daloa
text: Salomɔ gwalɩ-a Ghlobʋamö, Ghlobʋamö gwalɩ-a Abia, Abia gwalɩ-a Aza.
normalised_text: salomo gwalia globuama, globuama gwalia abia, abia gwalia aza.

name: Bété, Daloa
text: Aza gwalɩ-a Zozafa, Zozafa gwalɩ-a Zolamö, Zolamö gwalɩ-a Oziasɩ.
normalised_text: aza gwalia zozafa, zozafa gwalia zolama, zolama gwalia oziasi.

name: Bété, Daloa
text: Oziasɩ gwalɩ-a Zʋatamö, Zʋatamö gwalɩ-a Akazɩ, Akazɩ gwalɩ-a Ezekiasɩ.
normalised_text: oziasi gwalia zuatama, zuatama gwalia akazi, akazi gwalia ezekiasi.

name: Bété, Daloa
text: Ezekiasɩ gwalɩ-a Manase, Manase gwalɩ-a Amɔ, Amɔ gwalɩ-a Zoziasɩ.
normalised_text: ezekiasi gwalia manase, manase gwalia amo, amo gwalia zoziasi.

name: Bété, Daloa
text: La Zoziasɩ gwalɩnɩ-a Zekoniasɩ -yɛ ɔ -dagwie 'sɔ-ɔ, -bha wa kwanɩ-a Izlayɛlɩɛ ngëyi -ma Babilɔnɩɛ dʋdʋ -gömö gïyikwla 'mö.
normalised_text: la zoziasi gwalinia zekoniasi ye o dagwie soo, ba wa kwania izlayelie ngeyi ma babilonie dudu gama giyikwla ma.

name: Bété, Daloa
text: Wa-a -ma Babilɔnɩ gïyikwla 'mö 'n Zekoniasɩ ji-a Salasiɛlɩ gwalɩ. 'N Salasiɛlɩ ji-a Zolobabɛlɩ gwalɩ.
normalised_text: waa ma babiloni giyikwla ma n zekoniasi jia salasieli gwali. n salasieli jia zolobabeli gwali.

name: Bété, Daloa
text: Zolobabɛlɩ gwalɩ-a Abiudɩ, Abiudɩ gwalɩ-a Eliakimö, Eliakimö gwalɩ-a Azɔlɩ.
normalised_text: zolobabeli gwalia abiudi, abiudi gwalia eliakima, eliakima gwalia azoli.

name: Bété, Daloa
text: Azɔlɩ gwalɩ-a Sadɔkö, Sadɔkö gwalɩ-a Akimö, Akimö gwalɩ-a Eliudɩ.
normalised_text: azoli gwalia sadoka, sadoka gwalia akima, akima gwalia eliudi.

name: Bété, Daloa
text: Eliudɩ gwalɩ-a Eleazalɩ, Eleazalɩ gwalɩ-a Mata, Mata gwalɩ-a Zakɔpö.
normalised_text: eliudi gwalia eleazali, eleazali gwalia mata, mata gwalia zakopa.

name: Bété, Daloa
text: Zakɔpö gwalɩ-a Zezwi 'Klie -da Malie 'luwli Zozɛfö.
normalised_text: zakopa gwalia zezwi klie da malie luwli zozefa.

name: Bété, Daloa
text: Nyɩbhɛlʋgu ɔ ji-a gwalɩɛ 'pɔ Zezwi. -Wʋʋ yɛ-a, mɔ-ɔ ji-a ɔ 'bhɩa wa 'jinylolie gbʋ -gömö -saa.
normalised_text: nyibelugu o jia gwalie po zezwi. wuu yea, moo jia o bia wa jinylolie gbu gama saa.

name: Bété, Daloa
text: -Wʋʋ yɛ ɩ 'plɩ-ɛ -sɩbha, -benyido'o -Lagɔ 'plɩnɩ-a ʋ 'mögbanɩnyɔ Ezayi 'mö -ɩ ʋ gba la-a ɩ 'yɛ 'wʋ 'wlenɩɛ yɛ -bha.
normalised_text: wuu ye i plie siba, benyidoo lago plinia u magbaninyo ezayi ma i u gba laa i ye wu wlenie ye ba.

name: Bété, Daloa
text: Zozɛfö galɔ-a, -ɩ -Lagɔzuzuko gba la-a 'jɩla 'mö ɔ de, 'n ɔ jiɩ-a nʋ. 'N ɔ ji-a ɔ bheyi Mali ɔjɩ yawʋ nyinianɩ.
normalised_text: zozefa galoa, i lagozuzuko gba laa jila ma o de, n o jeia nu. n o jia o beyi mali oji yawu nyiniani.

name: Bété, Daloa
text: Ɔ -nyɔɔ 'nɩ-ɛ 'wlu yawʋ kwanɩ 'lɩlɩlɩ, 'n Mali ji-a nyɩbhɛlʋgu la'a 'wlu -sa. 'N Zozɛfö jio-a Zezwi 'pa.
normalised_text: o nyoo nie wlu yawu kwani lilili, n mali jia nyibelugu laa wlu sa. n zozefa jioa zezwi pa.

name: Bété, Daloa
text: Dʋdʋnyininyɔ Elodɩ 'nʋ-a wɛlɩ la'a, ɔ -yɛ Zelwizalɛmöö nɩkpa 'bhuo 'sɔ dlɩ-ɩ wʋlɔnʋʋa-a 'mö.
normalised_text: dudunyininyo elodi nua weli laa, o ye zelwizalemaa nikpa buo so dlii wulonuuaa ma.

name: Bété, Daloa
text: Wa nɛ -bha ɔ de naa: Ma'a Zwidee dʋdʋ -gömöö -glɔ wa la-a Bɛtɩlɛmö -bha. -Wʋʋ yɛ-a, sa'a -Lagɔɔ 'mögbanɩnyɔ 'cɛlɩ-ɛ sa'a -ma ɔ -Lagɔbɔgʋ 'mö naa:.
normalised_text: wa ne ba o de naa maa zwidee dudu gamaa glo wa laa betilema ba. wuu yea, saa lagoo magbaninyo chelie saa ma o lagobogu ma naa.

name: Bété, Daloa
text: Wa yɩlɩ-a 'mɛ -zɛlɩjeyi la'a, 'mʋna 'kada 'lɩbhʋa -bha.
normalised_text: wa yilia me zelijeyi laa, muna kada libua ba.

name: Bété, Daloa
text: -Lagɔzuzuko 'nyɛ-ɛ sa'a Zozɛfö 'dɩ-ɛ, dʋdʋnyɩdɩ 'n ɔ ji-a 'gu -yɛ ɔ -da 'sɔ 'wʋ 'libhï, 'n wa ji-e -ma Ezipötɩɛ dʋdʋ -gömö mö.
normalised_text: lagozuzuko nyee saa zozefa die, dudunyidi n o jia gu ye o da so wu liby, n wa jie ma ezipatie dudu gama ma.

name: Bété, Daloa
text: Ɩ 'plɩ-ɛ -sɩbha, wɛlɩ -ɩ -Lagɔɔ 'mögbanɩnyɔ Zelemi 'cɛlɩ la-a -ma ɔ -Lagɔbɔgʋ 'mö 'yɛ 'wʋ 'wlenɩɛ yɛ -bha.
normalised_text: i plie siba, weli i lagoo magbaninyo zelemi cheli laa ma o lagobogu ma ye wu wlenie ye ba.

name: Bété, Daloa
text: Elodɩ tlɩ-a, -ma Ezipötɩɛ dʋdʋ -gömö 'n -Lagɔzuzuko -bhlʋ ji-a 'jɩla 'mö Zozɛfö 'wʋ ghlanɩ.
normalised_text: elodi tlia, ma ezipatie dudu gama n lagozuzuko blu jia jila ma zozefa wu glani.

name: Bété, Daloa
text: Zozɛfö -sɔ-a 'wʋ, ɔ 'libhï-a 'gu -yɛ ɔ -da 'sɔ 'wʋ, 'n wa ji-e -ma Izlayɛlɩɛ dʋdʋ -gömö nimï mö.
normalised_text: zozefa soa wu, o libya gu ye o da so wu, n wa jie ma izlayelie dudu gama nimy ma.

name: Bété, Daloa
text: -Bhaa do'o, -ma Zwidee dʋdʋ -gömöö 'mïsekpa 'klʋ, nɩkpɛ -bhlʋ ji-e -ma 'mɔ wa la-a Za Badizɩ, 'n ɔ gba-a nɩkpaa de -Lagɔwɛlɩ.
normalised_text: baa doo, ma zwidee dudu gamaa mysekpa klu, nikpe blu jie ma mo wa laa za badizi, n o gbaa nikpaa de lagoweli.

name: Bété, Daloa
text: 'n ɔ nʋ-a: A ligba a 'yɛ a 'jinyloli 'ji 'tatinɩ. -Lagɔɔ nyininyinipɩ yɛ -kɔnyɩ nyini 'bhë.
normalised_text: n o nua a ligba a ye a jinyloli ji tatini. lagoo nyininyinipi ye konyi nyini be.

name: Bété, Daloa
text: 'Mɔ Za Badizɩ, nɩmakubana ɔ ka la-a 'mö, 'n ɔ jia-a nɩmakubɛdlʋ -gömö bhlɩ. -Gagö -yɛ lʋɔ 'kpö 'sɔ mɩ-ɩ -yɛ la-a ɔ lili.
normalised_text: mo za badizi, nimakubana o ka laa ma, n o jiaa nimakubedlu gama bli. gaga ye luo kpa so mii ye laa o lili.

name: Bété, Daloa
text: Wa -yɛ wa 'jinylolie 'bui -sa, 'n ɔ badizenʋa-a -ma Zludɛ 'mö.
normalised_text: wa ye wa jinylolie bui sa, n o badizenuaa ma zlude ma.

name: Bété, Gagnoa
text: Zezu Kli 'na 'gwɛlenya 'na kukoweli ne lɛ: Zezu Kli, Davide 'na yu 'na yu yɔ -lɔ ne Davide, Ablame 'na yu 'na yu yɔ -lɔ.
normalised_text: zezu kli na gwelenya na kukoweli ne le zezu kli, davide na yu na yu yo lo ne davide, ablame na yu na yu yo lo.

name: Bété, Gagnoa
text: Ablame -gwɛle -lɔ Izake, ne Izake yi -lɔ Zakɔbo gwɛle-, ne Zakɔbo yi -lɔ Zuda -nyɛ 'ɔ nowlia 'wɔ bhaa gwɛle-.
normalised_text: ablame gwele lo izake, ne izake yi lo zakobo gwele, ne zakobo yi lo zuda nye o nowlia wo baa gwele.

name: Bété, Gagnoa
text: Ne Zuda -gwɛle -lɔ Falɛse, Zela 'ɔ nɔŋɔ Tamale me. Ne Falɛse yi -lɔ Eselɔne gwɛle-, ne Eselɔne yi -lɔ Ylame gwɛle-.
normalised_text: ne zuda gwele lo falese, zela o nongo tamale me. ne falese yi lo eselone gwele, ne eselone yi lo ylame gwele.

name: Bété, Gagnoa
text: Ne Ylame yi -lɔ Aminadabo gwɛle-, ne Aminadabo yi -lɔ Nasɔne gwɛle-; ne Naasɔ yi -lɔ Salema gwɛle-.
normalised_text: ne ylame yi lo aminadabo gwele, ne aminadabo yi lo nasone gwele; ne naaso yi lo salema gwele.

name: Bété, Gagnoa
text: Ne Salema yi -lɔ Booze gwɛle-, Ylaabo me, ne Booze yi -lɔ Obɛde gwɛle-; Wlute me, ne Obɛde yi -lɔ Jese gwɛle-.
normalised_text: ne salema yi lo booze gwele, ylaabo me, ne booze yi lo obede gwele; wlute me, ne obede yi lo jese gwele.

name: Bété, Gagnoa
text: Ne Jese yi -lɔ -klɔgbɔnyɔ Davide gwɛle-. Ne Davide yi -lɔ Salomɔ gwɛle-, Uli nɔŋɔ me.
normalised_text: ne jese yi lo klogbonyo davide gwele. ne davide yi lo salomo gwele, uli nongo me.

name: Bété, Gagnoa
text: Ne Salomɔ yi -lɔ Wloboame gwɛle-; ne Wloboame yi -lɔ Abia gwɛle-; ne Abia yi -lɔ Azafo gwɛle-.
normalised_text: ne salomo yi lo wloboame gwele; ne wloboame yi lo abia gwele; ne abia yi lo azafo gwele.

name: Bété, Gagnoa
text: Ne Azafo yi -lɔ Zozafa gwɛle-; ne Zozafa yi -lɔ Zolame gwɛle-; ne Zolame yi -lɔ Oziase gwɛle-.
normalised_text: ne azafo yi lo zozafa gwele; ne zozafa yi lo zolame gwele; ne zolame yi lo oziase gwele.

name: Bété, Gagnoa
text: Ne Oziase yi -lɔ Yotame gwɛle-; ne Yotame yi -lɔ Akaze gwɛle-; ne Akaze yi -lɔ Ezeciase gwɛle-.
normalised_text: ne oziase yi lo yotame gwele; ne yotame yi lo akaze gwele; ne akaze yi lo ezechiase gwele.

name: Bété, Gagnoa
text: Ne Ezeciase yi -lɔ Manase gwɛle-; ne Manase yi -lɔ Amɔ gwɛle-; ne Amɔ yi -lɔ Zoziase gwɛle-;.
normalised_text: ne ezechiase yi lo manase gwele; ne manase yi lo amo gwele; ne amo yi lo zoziase gwele;.

name: Bété, Gagnoa
text: Ne Zoziase yi -lɔ Yekonia -nyɛ 'ɔ nowlia 'wɔ bhaa gwɛle-, lɔbhɔ 'ye 'wa -kɔmoa 'awɔ -lɔ galu 'yli Babilɔne.
normalised_text: ne zoziase yi lo yekonia nye o nowlia wo baa gwele, lobo ye wa komoa awo lo galu yli babilone.

name: Bété, Gagnoa
text: 'Ɛ kɛ 'ple bhuɔ ne, ne Yekonia yi -lɔ Salatiɛle gwɛle-; ne Salatiɛle yi -lɔ Zolobabɛle gwɛle-.
normalised_text: e ke ple buo ne, ne yekonia yi lo salatiele gwele; ne salatiele yi lo zolobabele gwele.

name: Bété, Gagnoa
text: Ne Zolobabɛle yi -lɔ Abiude gwɛle-; ne Abiude yi -lɔ Eliacime gwɛle-; ne Eliacime yi -lɔ Azɔle gwɛle-.
normalised_text: ne zolobabele yi lo abiude gwele; ne abiude yi lo eliachime gwele; ne eliachime yi lo azole gwele.

name: Bété, Gagnoa
text: Ne Azɔle yi -lɔ Sadɔke gwɛle-; ne Sadɔke yi -lɔ Acime gwɛle-; ne Acime yi -lɔ Eliude gwɛle-.
normalised_text: ne azole yi lo sadoke gwele; ne sadoke yi lo achime gwele; ne achime yi lo eliude gwele.

name: Bété, Gagnoa
text: Ne Eliude yi -lɔ Eleazale gwɛle-; ne Eleazale yi -lɔ Mata gwɛle-; ne Mata yi -lɔ Zakɔbo gwɛle-.
normalised_text: ne eliude yi lo eleazale gwele; ne eleazale yi lo mata gwele; ne mata yi lo zakobo gwele.

name: Bété, Gagnoa
text: Ne Zakɔbo yi -lɔ Mali luwli Zozɛfo gwɛle-, ne Mali yi -lɔ Zezu -ye 'wa la Klise -wɛ gwɛle-.
normalised_text: ne zakobo yi lo mali luwli zozefo gwele, ne mali yi lo zezu ye wa la klise we gwele.

name: Bété, Gagnoa
text: 'Ɔ yi 'widiyu gwɛle-, ne -e yu Zezu ziɛle-, naa-, 'ɔɔ kɛ 'ce -lɔ 'ɔnɛɛ -gligbɛnya 'fuɔ, ne 'ɔ koa 'ce -lɔ 'wanɛɛ 'nyinyonoli 'na gbo 'wlime -sɛ.».
normalised_text: o yi widiyu gwele, ne e yu zezu ziele, naa, oo ke che lo onee gligbenya fuo, ne o koa che lo wanee nyinyonoli na gbo wlime se.".

name: Bété, Gagnoa
text: Zaa, -ye Anyinɛnyɔ -bhulɛ 'awɔ guɔkwɔmenyɔ 'na nuɛ me -wɛ, 'ɛɛ 'wlole- -lɔ 'yli:.
normalised_text: zaa, ye anyinenyo bule awo guokwomenyo na nue me we, ee wlole lo yli.

name: Bété, Gagnoa
text: 'A -gɛ 'yli, 'ŋuyu digbɔ -ɔ -namlɛ 'widi yibhlele- yi go 'ye, ne 'ɔ yi 'widiyu gwɛle- ne 'wa yu 'ce Emanuɛle la, 'Ɛ sɛ zɔ nɛɛ: Lagɔ bhaa -a -kole ku.
normalised_text: a ge yli, nguyu digbo o namle widi yiblele yi go ye, ne o yi widiyu gwele ne wa yu che emanuele la, e se zo nee lago baa a kole ku.

name: Bété, Gagnoa
text: Zozɛfo kɛ gɔlɔ- ne, -ye Anyinɛnyɔ 'na nɔgɔzilɔ -bhulɛlo -wɛ, 'ɛyi 'ye 'ɔ -no -lɔ. Ne Zozɛfo yi -lɔ Mali ku 'libhi ne 'ɔ yu -lɔ sueme kɔme-.
normalised_text: zozefo ke golo ne, ye anyinenyo na nogozilo bulelo we, eyi ye o no lo. ne zozefo yi lo mali ku libi ne o yu lo sueme kome.

name: Bété, Gagnoa
text: -Mɔ, Mali bhaa 'wa ne ku -kole -kaa ne 'ɔ yi -lɔ widiyu gwɛle- ne Zozɛfo yu -lɔ Zezu ziɛle-.
normalised_text: mo, mali baa wa ne ku kole kaa ne o yi lo widiyu gwele ne zozefo yu lo zezu ziele.

name: Bété, Gagnoa
text: -Klɔgbɔnyɔ yitɔ Elode 'cɛ 'no ne, 'dle 'yiɔ- -lɔ nuɔ, 'ɔ -nyɛ Zeluzalɛme 'na konya 'klekle bhaa.
normalised_text: klogbonyo yito elode che no ne, dle yio lo nuo, o nye zeluzaleme na konya klekle baa.

name: Bété, Gagnoa
text: Ŋwɛnɛɛ: «Beteleɛme Zude -glɔ me, sɛne 'ye guɔkwɔmenyɔ 'kɛle- -lɔ:.
normalised_text: ngwenee "betelieme zude glo me, sene ye guokwomenyo kele lo.

name: Bété, Gagnoa
text: Ne Elode yi -lɔ 'diɛɛ me ɛ -zeli -ciɛnya -wɛ lale-, ne 'ɔ yua -lɔ lo 'yɔbhɔ 'tee nɛɛ: «-sɔɔdɛku ɛ -zeli -wɛ 'wlo- bhɔ zɔ 'a?».
normalised_text: ne elode yi lo diee me e zeli chienya we lale, ne o yua lo lo yobo tee nee "soodeku e zeli we wlo bo zo a?".

name: Bété, Gagnoa
text: 'Ɛ 'ple- lɛ bhuɔ ne, Lagɔ -bhulɛloa 'yla me nɛɛ: 'A te -kɛ Elode yɔko 'wlizɔ zi. Ne 'wa yi -lɔ -gwe 'na -vinɛ bhli. Ne 'wa yi -lɔ 'wa 'luku me.
normalised_text: e ple le buo ne, lago buleloa yla me nee a te ke elode yoko wlizo zi. ne wa yi lo gwe na vine bli. ne wa yi lo wa luku me.

name: Bété, Gagnoa
text: Ne ɛ sabo -bhele -wɛ me Zozɛfo libhi- ɛ yu -nyɛ 'ɔ nɔ bhaa ku, ne 'wa yi -lɔ Ezipte 'gule -ka me.
normalised_text: ne e sabo bele we me zozefo libi e yu nye o no baa ku, ne wa yi lo ezipte gule ka me.

name: Bété, Gagnoa
text: Sɔbhɔ 'ye guɔkwɔmenyɔ Zelemi 'na bhulɛweli 'wlole- -lɔ 'yli:.
normalised_text: sobo ye guokwomenyo zelemi na buleweli wlole lo yli.

name: Bété, Gagnoa
text: Weli 'bhale Ylama 'lugbu jiji gbɔ Ylasɛle tu 'ɔnɛɛ yua za. 'Ɔ ne dɛpe dɛpeɛ -kɛ, naa-, sɛko -wɛ, ɛ yua -wɛ ne 'ce -la -le zɛ.
normalised_text: weli bale ylama lugbu jiji gbo ylasele tu onee yua za. o ne depe depie ke, naa, seko we, e yua we ne che la le ze.

name: Bété, Gagnoa
text: Elode ku- lɛ bhuɔ ne, ne Anyinɛnyɔ 'na nɔgɔzilɔ yi -lɔ Ezipte 'yla me Zozɛfo bhulɛle-.
normalised_text: elode ku le buo ne, ne anyinenyo na nogozilo yi lo ezipte yla me zozefo bulele.

name: Bété, Gagnoa
text: 'Ɔ nɛɛ: «-Sɔ ku, 'libhi yu -nyɛ 'ɔ nɔ bhaa ku -se 'a zi Izlayɛle 'wlizɔ, naa-, -wa no -gbɔ 'wa kɛ yu 'lɔbhɔ -wɛ ku- zɛ.».
normalised_text: o nee "so ku, libi yu nye o no baa ku se a zi izlayele wlizo, naa, wa no gbo wa ke yu lobo we ku ze.".

name: Bété, Guiberoua
text: Zezwii Kliisɩ , Ablaamö ‑nyɛ Daviidɩ 'sɔ, 'wa ngëyii 'mö ‑mä ɔ 'bhöönɩɛ. Ɔ dɩba a dɩbawa 'wuë, 'wa nglɩɩ miɛ dɛ'ɛ.
normalised_text: zezwii kliisi, ablaamo nye daviidi so, wa ngeyii mo ma o boonie. o diba a dibawa wue, wa nglii mie dee.

name: Bété, Guiberoua
text: Ablaamö mɔɔ gwälɩɛ Yizaakö, Yizaakö mɔɔ gwälɩɛ Zakɔɔbö, Zakɔɔbö mɔɔ gwälɩɛ Zwidaa ‑nyɛ ɔ ‑daayuë 'sɔ.
normalised_text: ablaamo moo gwalie yizaako, yizaako moo gwalie zakoobo, zakoobo moo gwalie zwidaa nye o daayue so.

name: Bété, Guiberoua
text: Zwidaa ‑nyɛ ɔ 'lɛnglɛ Tamaa 'sɔ, mʋa gwälɩɛ Falɛɛsɩ ‑nyɛ Zalaa 'sɔ. Falɛɛsɩ mɔɔ gwälɩɛ Ɛzlɔɔmö, Ezlɔɔmö mɔɔ gwälɩɛ Aghlamö.
normalised_text: zwidaa nye o lengle tamaa so, mua gwalie faleesi nye zalaa so. faleesi moo gwalie ezloomo, ezloomo moo gwalie aghlamo.

name: Bété, Guiberoua
text: Aghlamö mɔɔ gwälɩɛ Aminadaabö, Aminadaabö mɔɔ gwälɩɛ Naasɔɔ, Naasɔɔ mɔɔ gwälɩɛ Salɩmɔɔ.
normalised_text: aghlamo moo gwalie aminadaabo, aminadaabo moo gwalie naasoo, naasoo moo gwalie salimoo.

name: Bété, Guiberoua
text: Salɩmɔɔ ‑nyɛ ɔ 'lɛnglɛ Ghlaabö 'sɔ mʋa gwälɩɛ Boozɩ, Boozɩ ‑nyɛ ɔ 'lɛnglɛ Ghlitɩ 'sɔ mʋa gwälɩɛ Obɛɛdɩ, Obɛɛdɩ mɔɔ gwälɩɛ Yizayii.
normalised_text: salimoo nye o lengle ghlaabo so mua gwalie boozi, boozi nye o lengle ghliti so mua gwalie obeedi, obeedi moo gwalie yizayii.

name: Bété, Guiberoua
text: Yizayii mɔɔ gwälɩɛ 'bhlɩlowli Daviidɩ. Daviidɩ ‑nyɛ nglɔɔ ɔ ‑sɛɛ Wilii yɔwʋ 'sɔ mʋa gwälɩɛ Salomɔɔ.
normalised_text: yizayii moo gwalie blilowli daviidi. daviidi nye ngloo o see wilii yowu so mua gwalie salomoo.

name: Bété, Guiberoua
text: Salomɔɔ mɔɔ gwälɩɛ Ghlobʋamö, Ghlobʋamö mɔɔ gwälɩɛ Abia, Abia mɔɔ gwälɩɛ Azaa.
normalised_text: salomoo moo gwalie ghlobuamo, ghlobuamo moo gwalie abia, abia moo gwalie azaa.

name: Bété, Guiberoua
text: Azaa mɔɔ gwälɩɛ Zʋzafaatɩ, Zozafaatɩ mɔɔ gwälɩɛ Zolaamö, Zolaamö mɔɔ gwälɩɛ Oziasɩ.
normalised_text: azaa moo gwalie zuzafaati, zozafaati moo gwalie zolaamo, zolaamo moo gwalie oziasi.

name: Bété, Guiberoua
text: Oziasɩ mɔɔ gwälɩɛ Zʋataamö, Zʋataamö mɔɔ gwälɩɛ Akaazɩ, Akaazɩ mɔɔ gwälɩɛ Ezekiasɩ.
normalised_text: oziasi moo gwalie zuataamo, zuataamo moo gwalie akaazi, akaazi moo gwalie ezekiasi.

name: Bété, Guiberoua
text: Ezekiasɩ mɔɔ gwälɩɛ Manasee, Manasee mɔɔ gwälɩɛ Amɔɔ, Amɔɔ mɔɔ gwälɩɛ Zoziasɩ.
normalised_text: ezekiasi moo gwalie manasee, manasee moo gwalie amoo, amoo moo gwalie zoziasi.

name: Bété, Guiberoua
text: Yizlaɛlɩ 'a ngëyii ‑wʋ ‑bhlɛ ‑mä Babilɔɔnɩ‑bhölɩɩ 'mö 'n Zekoniasɩ yiɛ Salatiɛlɩ gwälɩ. Salatiɛlɩ mɔɔ gwälɩɛ Zolobabɛɛlɩ.
normalised_text: yizlaeli a ngeyii wu ble ma babiloonibolii mo n zekoniasi yie salatieli gwali. salatieli moo gwalie zolobabeeli.

name: Bété, Guiberoua
text: Zolobabɛɛlɩ mɔɔ gwälɩɛ Abiudɩ, Abiudɩ mɔɔ gwälɩɛ Eliakiimö, Eliakiimö mɔɔ gwälɩɛ Azɔɔ.
normalised_text: zolobabeeli moo gwalie abiudi, abiudi moo gwalie eliakiimo, eliakiimo moo gwalie azoo.

name: Bété, Guiberoua
text: Azɔɔ mɔɔ gwälɩɛ Sadɔɔkö, Sadɔɔkö mɔɔ gwälɩɛ Akiimö. Akiimö mɔɔ gwälɩɛ Eliudɩ.
normalised_text: azoo moo gwalie sadooko, sadooko moo gwalie akiimo. akiimo moo gwalie eliudi.

name: Bété, Guiberoua
text: Eliudɩ mɔɔ gwälɩɛ Eleazaa, Eleazaa mɔɔ gwälɩɛ Mataa, Mataa mɔɔ gwälɩɛ Zakɔɔbö.
normalised_text: eliudi moo gwalie eleazaa, eleazaa moo gwalie mataa, mataa moo gwalie zakoobo.

name: Bété, Guiberoua
text: Zakɔɔbö mɔɔ gwälɩɛ Zezwii Kliisɩ a ‑da Malii a 'luwlii Zɩzɛɛfʋ.
normalised_text: zakoobo moo gwalie zezwii kliisi a da malii a luwlii zizeefu.

name: Bété, Guiberoua
text: Zɩzɛɛfʋ gɔlɔɔ, sɛɛ Lagɔzuzukwëa nyɔɔ 'yɛla 'mö 'dɩɩ, ‑sɩbhä ɔ 'zʋä 'klʋkpamö 'n ɔ yiɛ Malii kwä.
normalised_text: zizeefu goloo, see lagozuzukwea nyoo yela mo dii, siba o zua klukpamo n o yie malii kwa.

name: Bété, Guiberoua
text: ‑Maa ɔ ‑nyɔɔ 'nɩɛ ‑lɛ ‑wʋ, ‑këë 'n Malii yiɛ 'ɔ tɛkäyuu gwälɩ. 'N Zɩzɛɛfʋ yoo Zezwii 'pä.
normalised_text: maa o nyoo nie le wu, kee n malii yie o tekayuu gwali. n zizeefu yoo zezwii pa.

name: Bété, Guiberoua
text: ‑Maa 'bhlɩlowli Eloodɩ 'nʋä wɛlɩ 'laa, zuzu yɩ ‑sɔɔ ‑gömö ɔ ‑nyɛ Zeluzalɛɛmö a ‑nʋa 'wuë 'sɔ.
normalised_text: maa blilowli eloodi nua weli laa, zuzu yi soo gomo o nye zeluzaleemo a nua wue so.

name: Bété, Guiberoua
text: Wa yee 'ylɩmö ɛ 'nɩgböä ‑mä ‑buduu ‑gömöö, 'n 'mäna yuëë zinɩ.
normalised_text: wa yee ylimo e nigboa ma buduu gomoo, n mana yuee zini.

name: Bété, Guiberoua
text: Wa 'bhööä ‑lɛ, 'n Lagɔ yuëë 'yɛla 'mö 'dɩ 'nyɛ nɩɩ, wa nɩ tɩ ‑mä Eloodɩ a mä'a ghlɛnɩ, zaa käböyio wa bhliɛ 'n wa yiɛ wa 'bhele mö.
normalised_text: wa booa le, n lago yuee yela mo di nye nii, wa ni ti ma eloodi a maa ghleni, zaa kaboyio wa blie n wa yie wa bele mo.

name: Bété, Guiberoua
text: Sabʋ ‑bhʋlʋ ‑kpɔ 'la, 'n Zɩzɛɛfʋ yiɛ yuu ‑nyɛ ɔ ‑da 'sɔ 'wʋ 'libhï, 'n wa yiɛ Ezipötɩ ‑guë mö.
normalised_text: sabu bulu kpo la, n zizeefu yie yuu nye o da so wu libi, n wa yie ezipoti gue mo.

name: Bété, Guiberoua
text: Lagɔ a 'möbhïlanɩnyɔ Zelemii, wɛlɩɩ ɔ 'cɛlɩ a‑a ‑mä 'ɔ Lagɔbɔgʋʋ 'möö, sa'a ‑sɩbhä yɩ 'wlʋnɩɛ 'yli. Sɛ'ɛ ɔ gbä a‑a nɩɩ:.
normalised_text: lago a mobilaninyo zelemii, welii o cheli aa ma o lagoboguu moo, saa siba yi wlunie yli. see o gba aa nii.

name: Bété, Guiberoua
text: Eloodɩ 'kuä 'wëë, Zɩzɛɛfʋ ‑wʋ ‑bhlɛ ‑mä Ezipötɩ 'n Lagɔzuzukwë ‑bhlʋ yiɛ 'yɛla 'mö yi 'n a yoo 'dɩ 'nyɛ, a lɛ naa:.
normalised_text: eloodi kua wee, zizeefu wu ble ma ezipoti n lagozuzukwe blu yie yela mo yi n a yoo di nye, a le naa.

name: Bété, Guiberoua
text: 'N Zɩzɛɛfʋ yiɛ 'wʋ ‑sɔ, 'n ɔ yiɛ yuu ‑nyɛ ɔ ‑da 'sɔ 'wʋ 'libhï, 'n wa yiɛ ‑mä Yizlaɛlɩ a bhlɩɩ 'mö nimï mö.
normalised_text: n zizeefu yie wu so, n o yie yuu nye o da so wu libi, n wa yie ma yizlaeli a blii mo nimi mo.

name: Bété, Guiberoua
text: ‑Lɛ a 'tɛnyɩ 'la 'mö, nɩkpɛ ‑bhlʋ wa laa Zaa Batisɩ, mɔɔ 'wlʋnɩɛ ‑mä Zwidee‑bhölɩɩ 'mö a 'muse 'klʋ 'yli, 'n ɔ nyɛɛ nɩkpa Lagɔwɛlɩ.

name: Chumburung
text: To, Abraham mò̱ gyi e̱ gye̱ Isak, ne̱ Isak mɔ mò̱ gyi e̱ gye̱ Yakubu, ne̱ Yakubu mɔ mò̱ gyi‑ana e̱ gye̱ Yudaa na mò̱ daa‑ana na mò̱ tire‑ana.
normalised_text: to, abraham mu ji i ji isak, ni isak mo mu ji i ji yakubu, ni yakubu mo mu jiana i ji yudaa na mu daaana na mu tireana.

name: Chumburung
text: Ne̱ Aram mɔ mò̱ gyi e̱ gye̱ Aminadabi, ne̱ Aminadabi mɔ mò̱ gyi e̱ gye̱ Naasɔŋ, ne̱ Naasɔŋ mɔ mò̱ gyi e̱ gye̱ Salamɔŋ.
normalised_text: ni aram mo mu ji i ji aminadabi, ni aminadabi mo mu ji i ji naasong, ni naasong mo mu ji i ji salamong.

name: Chumburung
text: Ne̱ Salamɔŋ mɔ na mò̱ ka Rahab a ko̱we̱ Bowas, ne̱ Bowas mɔ na mò̱ ka Rut a ko̱we̱ Obid, ne̱ Obid mɔ mò̱ gyi e̱ gye̱ Yɛse̱e̱.
normalised_text: ni salamong mo na mu ka rahab a kuwi bowas, ni bowas mo na mu ka rut a kuwi obid, ni obid mo mu ji i ji yesii.

name: Chumburung
text: Ne̱ Solomɔŋ mɔ mò̱ gyi e̱ gye̱ Rɛkabo̱wam, ne̱ Rɛkabo̱wam mɔ mò̱ gyi e̱ gye̱ Abiya, ne̱ Abiya mɔ mò̱ gyi e̱ gye̱ Asa.
normalised_text: ni solomong mo mu ji i ji rekabuwam, ni rekabuwam mo mu ji i ji abiya, ni abiya mo mu ji i ji asa.

name: Chumburung
text: Ne̱ Asa mɔ mò̱ gyi e̱ gye̱ Yɛhɔsafat, ne̱ Yɛhɔsafat mɔ mò̱ gyi e̱ gye̱ Yɛhɔram, ne̱ Yɛhɔram mɔ mò̱ gyi e̱ gye̱ Osiya.
normalised_text: ni asa mo mu ji i ji yehosafat, ni yehosafat mo mu ji i ji yehoram, ni yehoram mo mu ji i ji osiya.

name: Chumburung
text: Ne̱ Osiya mɔ mò̱ gyi e̱ gye̱ Yotam, ne̱ Yotam mɔ mò̱ gyi e̱ gye̱ Ahas, ne̱ Ahas mɔ mò̱ gyi e̱ gye̱ Hisikiya.
normalised_text: ni osiya mo mu ji i ji yotam, ni yotam mo mu ji i ji ahas, ni ahas mo mu ji i ji hisikiya.

name: Chumburung
text: Ne̱ Hisikiya mɔ mò̱ gyi e̱ gye̱ Manasee, ne̱ Manasee mɔ mò̱ gyi e̱ gye̱ Amɔŋ ne̱ Amɔŋ mɔ mò̱ gyi e̱ gye̱ Yosiya.
normalised_text: ni hisikiya mo mu ji i ji manasee, ni manasee mo mu ji i ji among ni among mo mu ji i ji yosiya.

name: Chumburung
text: Ne̱ Yosiya mɔ mò̱ gyi‑ana e̱ gye̱ Yikoniya na mò̱ tire‑ana. Saŋ amo̱‑rɔ ne̱ Isireelii awuye ado̱ŋ a yaa bamo̱ anya kusuŋ‑no Babilɔŋ swe̱e̱re̱ se̱.
normalised_text: ni yosiya mo mu jiana i ji yikoniya na mu tireana. sang amuro ni isireelii awuye adung a yaa bamu anya kusungno babilong swiiri si.

name: Chumburung
text: Bamo̱ ado̱ŋ a yaa bamo̱ Babilɔŋ‑ɔ, amo̱ kamɛɛ ne̱ Yikoniya a ko̱we̱ Salatiyɛl, ne̱ Salatiyɛl mɔ a ko̱we̱ Sirubabɛl.
normalised_text: bamu adung a yaa bamu babilongo, amu kamee ni yikoniya a kuwi salatiyel, ni salatiyel mo a kuwi sirubabel.

name: Chumburung
text: Ne̱ Sirubabɛl mɔ a ko̱we̱ Abiyud, ne̱ Abiyud mɔ a ko̱we̱ Iliyakim, ne̱ Iliyakim mɔ a ko̱we̱ Asɔɔ.
normalised_text: ni sirubabel mo a kuwi abiyud, ni abiyud mo a kuwi iliyakim, ni iliyakim mo a kuwi asoo.

name: Chumburung
text: Ne̱ Asɔɔ mɔ a ko̱we̱ Sadukii, ne̱ Sadukii mɔ a ko̱we̱ Akim, ne̱ Akim mɔ a ko̱we̱ Iliyud.
normalised_text: ni asoo mo a kuwi sadukii, ni sadukii mo a kuwi akim, ni akim mo a kuwi iliyud.

name: Chumburung
text: Ne̱ Iliyud mɔ a ko̱we̱ Iliyasa, ne̱ Iliyasa mɔ a ko̱we̱ Mataŋ, ne̱ Mataŋ mɔ a ko̱we̱ Yakubu.
normalised_text: ni iliyud mo a kuwi iliyasa, ni iliyasa mo a kuwi matang, ni matang mo a kuwi yakubu.

name: Chumburung
text: Amo̱‑ɔ pɛɛɛ a waa ne̱e̱ na ke̱tɔ ne̱ Wuribware̱ a sa ne̱ mò̱ akyaamɛɛ‑ɔ ɔko̱ a kyo̱rɛɛ waa abware̱se̱ŋ wo̱re̱‑ɔ‑rɔ‑ɔ nya waa kase̱ŋtiŋ fe̱yɛ.
normalised_text: amuo peee a waa nii na kito ni wuribwari a sa ni mu achaameeo oku a churee waa abwarising wurioroo nya waa kasingting fiye.

name: Chumburung
text: Kabregyii ne̱ ɔ mo̱ŋ nyi anyare̱‑ɔ e̱ nya kame, na ɔ ko̱we̱ ɔnyare̱, na bo̱ te̱e̱ mò̱ ɛ Imanuwɛl, kaase̱ e̱ kaapo̱ fe̱yɛ Wuribware̱-bo̱-ane̱‑ase̱.
normalised_text: kabrejii ni o mung nyi anyario i nya kame, na o kuwi onyari, na bu tii mu e imanuwel, kaasi i kaapu fiye wuribwaribuaniasi.

name: Chumburung
text: Amo̱se̱ se̱‑ɔ Yo̱sɛf a ko̱so̱‑ɔ, ne̱ ɔɔ gya Wuribware̱ kabɔɔ a kanɔ‑ɔ se̱, ne̱ ɔɔ waare̱e̱ Mariya taa mò̱ yaa mò̱ aye̱.
normalised_text: amusi sio yusef a kusuo, ni oo ja wuribwari kaboo a kanoo si, ni oo waarii mariya taa mu yaa mu ayi.

name: Chumburung
text: Amaa mò̱ aa mò̱ mo̱ŋ di ne̱ ɔɔ bo̱ ko̱we̱. Ne̱ ɔɔ ko̱we̱ ɔnyare̱, ne̱ Yo̱sɛf a sa kayaagyi‑o ke̱nyare̱ ɛ Yeesuu.
normalised_text: amaa mu aa mu mung di ni oo bu kuwi. ni oo kuwi onyari, ni yusef a sa kayaajio kinyari e yeesuu.

name: Chumburung
text: Owure Hɛrɔd a nu amo̱‑ɔ, ne̱ mò̱ aa Yɛro̱salɛm awuye pɛɛɛ iduŋ a te̱ŋ bamo̱.
normalised_text: owure herod a nu amuo, ni mu aa yerusalem awuye peee idung a ting bamu.

name: Chumburung
text: Owure‑o a nu amo̱‑ɔ, ne̱ ɔɔ te̱e̱ anyiase̱ŋpo̱‑ɔ lee keri si, ne̱ oo bise bamo̱ saŋ ko̱ŋko̱ ne̱ ke̱kye̱e̱‑e̱‑kpa‑agyi amo̱ a le̱e̱‑ɔ.
normalised_text: owureo a nu amuo, ni oo tii anyiasingpuo lee keri si, ni oo bise bamu sang kungku ni kichiiikpaaji amu a liio.

name: Chumburung
text: Amo̱se̱‑ɔ, Yo̱sɛf a ko̱so̱ kanye amo̱, ne̱ mò̱ aa kayaagyi‑o na mò̱ nyi a yɔ Igyipiti swe̱e̱re̱ se̱ ya kye̱na.
normalised_text: amusio, yusef a kusu kanye amu, ni mu aa kayaajio na mu nyi a yo ijipiti swiiri si ya china.

name: Chumburung
text: Ne̱ ke̱tɔ ne̱ Wuribware̱ kyaamɛɛ Yɛrɛme̱ya a kyo̱rɛɛ waa abware̱se̱ŋ wo̱re̱‑ɔ‑rɔ‑ɔ a waa kase̱ŋtiŋ fe̱yɛ.
normalised_text: ni kito ni wuribwari chaamee yeremiya a churee waa abwarising wurioroo a waa kasingting fiye.

name: Chumburung
text: Ne̱ Owure Hɛrɔd a wu. Mò̱ a wu‑o, ne̱ Wuribware̱ kabɔɔ ko̱ a be̱e̱ le̱e̱ Yo̱sɛf se̱ dee‑ro Igyipiti swe̱e̱re̱ se̱.
normalised_text: ni owure herod a wu. mu a wuo, ni wuribwari kaboo ku a bii lii yusef si deero ijipiti swiiri si.

name: Chumburung
text: Ne̱ Yo̱sɛf a ko̱so̱ taa kayaagyi‑o na mò̱ nyi, ne̱ baa kiŋŋi yɔ Isireelii swe̱e̱re̱ se̱.
normalised_text: ni yusef a kusu taa kayaajio na mu nyi, ni baa kingngi yo isireelii swiiri si.

name: Chumburung
text: Mo̱nꞌ nu mo̱ne̱ e̱ye̱e̱ na mo̱nꞌ kiŋŋi le̱e̱ mo̱ne̱ e̱bɔye̱‑rɔ, a le̱e̱ fe̱yɛ Wuribware̱ se̱ a kuwure‑o a tɔ‑rɔ.
normalised_text: mun nu muni iyii na mun kingngi lii muni iboyiro, a lii fiye wuribwari si a kuwureo a toro.

name: Chumburung
text: Nyɔma ifwii ne̱ baa bo̱ waa Yohanee atɔ buŋsɛ, ne̱ kabo̱ wo̱re̱ ke̱re̱se̱sɛ da mò̱ laare̱‑rɔ. Mò̱ ateese e̱ gye̱ akyaŋkyaŋka na gyabwe̱e̱kyu.
normalised_text: nyoma ifwii ni baa bu waa yohanee ato bungse, ni kabu wuri kirisise da mu laariro. mu ateese i ji achangchangka na jabwiichu.

name: Chumburung
text: Ne̱ baa tɔwe̱ bamo̱ e̱bɔye̱ gywii mò̱, ne̱ ɔɔ bɔ bamo̱ asuu Yo̱o̱daŋ bo̱ŋ‑nɔ.
normalised_text: ni baa towi bamu iboyi jwii mu, ni oo bo bamu asuu yuudang bungno.

name: Chumburung
text: Saŋ amo̱‑ɔ, Yeesuu a le̱e̱ Galile̱ya swe̱e̱re̱ se̱ ba Yo̱o̱daŋ bo̱ŋ‑nɔ na Yohanee bɔ mò̱ asuu.
normalised_text: sang amuo, yeesuu a lii galiliya swiiri si ba yuudang bungno na yohanee bo mu asuu.

name: Chumburung
text: Ne̱ bo̱re̱ ko̱ a le̱e̱ so̱so̱ tɔwe̱ fe̱yɛ, Ke̱e̱ mo̱ gyi timaa ne̱ mo̱ e̱ kpa mò̱ ase̱ŋ bwe̱e̱tɔ‑ɔ, ne̱ mo̱ akatɔ a gyi mò̱ se̱‑ɔ.
normalised_text: ni buri ku a lii susu towi fiye, kii mu ji timaa ni mu i kpa mu asing bwiitoo, ni mu akato a ji mu sio.

name: Chumburung
text: Ne̱ Yeesuu a gyi ŋke aduna mpase̱ na kanye kimukee‑ro mfe̱ŋ, na ɔ maa gyi ateese. Amo̱se̱‑ɔ saŋ ne̱ ŋke amo̱ a kyo̱ŋ‑ɔ, ako̱ŋ de mò̱.
normalised_text: ni yeesuu a ji ngke aduna mpasi na kanye kimukeero mfing, na o maa ji ateese. amusio sang ni ngke amu a chungo, akung de mu.

name: Chumburung
text: Ne̱ Ɔbɔnsam a be̱e̱ yaa Yeesuu Yɛro̱salɛm ne̱ bo̱ be̱e̱ ba te̱e̱ mfe̱ŋ ɛ maŋ kpe̱yaa‑ɔ, ne̱ ɔɔ taa mò̱ yaa bo̱ ye̱ra Wuribware̱ suŋkpa‑ɔ katwe̱e̱‑rɔ.
normalised_text: ni obonsam a bii yaa yeesuu yerusalem ni bu bii ba tii mfing e mang kpiyaao, ni oo taa mu yaa bu yira wuribwari sungkpao katwiiro.

name: Chumburung
text: Ne̱ ŋkee Ɔbɔnsam a taa Yeesuu yaa ke̱be̱e̱ so̱swe̱e̱ ko̱ se̱, ne̱ ɔɔ ba kaye̱‑rɔ e̱maŋ pɛɛɛ na e̱mo̱ ke̱dabe̱ bo̱ kaapo̱ mò̱.
normalised_text: ni ngkee obonsam a taa yeesuu yaa kibii suswii ku si, ni oo ba kayiro imang peee na imu kidabi bu kaapu mu.

name: Cibak
text: Kakadǝr Thlǝma kaká-kaká yarɛ nǝr Yɛsu Kǝrsti zǝr Dauda, zǝrǝr Ibrahim ni:.
normalised_text: kakader hlema kakakaka yare ner yesu kersti zer dauda, zerer ibrahim ni.

name: Cibak
text: Ibrahim ani atǝgǝra Isaku, Isaku ani atǝgǝra Yakubu, Yakubu ani atǝgǝra Yahuda ba madar angǝri.
normalised_text: ibrahim ani ategera isaku, isaku ani ategera yakubu, yakubu ani ategera yahuda ba madar angeri.

name: Cibak
text: Yahuda ani atǝgǝra Parisa aka Zara, nam tǝ mama dar Tamar, Parisa ani atǝgǝra Hizǝraun, Hizǝraun atǝgǝra Ramu.
normalised_text: yahuda ani ategera parisa aka zara, nam te mama dar tamar, parisa ani ategera hizeraun, hizeraun ategera ramu.

name: Cibak
text: Ramu ani atǝgǝra Aminadab, Aminadab ani atǝgǝra Nasaun, Nasaun atǝgǝra Salmaun.
normalised_text: ramu ani ategera aminadab, aminadab ani ategera nasaun, nasaun ategera salmaun.

name: Cibak
text: Salmaun ani atǝgǝra Bwasu, nam tǝ angǝri Rahapu, Bwasu ani atǝgǝra Aubɛd, nam tǝ angǝri Ruthlu, Aubɛd ani atǝgǝra Dzɛsi.
normalised_text: salmaun ani ategera bwasu, nam te angeri rahapu, bwasu ani ategera aubed, nam te angeri ruhlu, aubed ani ategera dzesi.

name: Cibak
text: ba Dzɛsi ani atǝgǝra kuhyi Dauda. Dauda ani atǝgǝra Sulaimanu nam tǝ dzǝ ya akwa mwalar Uriya.
normalised_text: ba dzesi ani ategera kushi dauda. dauda ani ategera sulaimanu nam te dze ya akwa mwalar uriya.

name: Cibak
text: Sulaimanu ani atǝgǝra Rahaubaum, Rahaubaum ani atǝgǝra Abidza, Abidza ani atǝgǝra Asaf.
normalised_text: sulaimanu ani ategera rahaubaum, rahaubaum ani ategera abidza, abidza ani ategera asaf.

name: Cibak
text: Asaf ani atǝgǝra Dzahausafat, Yahushafat ani atǝgǝra Dzauram, Dzauram ani atǝgǝra Uziya.
normalised_text: asaf ani ategera dzahausafat, yahushafat ani ategera dzauram, dzauram ani ategera uziya.

name: Cibak
text: Uziya ani atǝgǝra Dzauthlam, Dzauthlam ani atǝgǝra Ahazu, Ahazu ani atǝgǝra Hizikiya.
normalised_text: uziya ani ategera dzauhlam, dzauhlam ani ategera ahazu, ahazu ani ategera hizikiya.

name: Cibak
text: Hizikiya ani atǝgǝra Manasi, Manasi ani atǝgǝra Aman, Aman ani atǝgǝra Dzausaya.
normalised_text: hizikiya ani ategera manasi, manasi ani ategera aman, aman ani ategera dzausaya.

name: Cibak
text: Dzausaya ani atǝgǝra Dzakauniya kaka madar angǝri, akwa sakatǝ ndǝ tara fati tǝ dar ka falikur atǝra akwa diyir Babila.
normalised_text: dzausaya ani ategera dzakauniya kaka madar angeri, akwa sakate nde tara fati te dar ka falikur atera akwa diyir babila.

name: Cibak
text: Aghǝla tǝ ndǝ fati tǝ dar atǝra akwa Babila nda: Dzakauniya ani atǝgǝra Siltiyal, Siltiyal ani atǝgǝra Zirubabɛl.
normalised_text: aghela te nde fati te dar atera akwa babila nda dzakauniya ani ategera siltiyal, siltiyal ani ategera zirubabel.

name: Cibak
text: Zirubabɛl ani atǝgǝra Abihudu, Abihudu ani atǝgǝra Iliyakim, Iliyakim ani atǝgǝra Azur.
normalised_text: zirubabel ani ategera abihudu, abihudu ani ategera iliyakim, iliyakim ani ategera azur.

name: Cibak
text: Azur ani atǝgǝra Zadaku, Zadaku ani atǝgǝra Akim, Akim ani atǝgǝra Iliyud.
normalised_text: azur ani ategera zadaku, zadaku ani ategera akim, akim ani ategera iliyud.

name: Cibak
text: Iliyud ani atǝgǝra Iliyazar, Iliyazar ani atǝgǝra Mathlan, Mathlan ani atǝgǝra Yakubu.
normalised_text: iliyud ani ategera iliyazar, iliyazar ani ategera mahlan, mahlan ani ategera yakubu.

name: Cibak
text: ba Yakubu ani atǝgǝra Yusufu salǝr Maryamu, Maryamu nam tara yaba Yɛsu, nam tǝ ndǝ ada ká tǝ Kǝrsti.
normalised_text: ba yakubu ani ategera yusufu saler maryamu, maryamu nam tara yaba yesu, nam te nde ada ka te kersti.

name: Cibak
text: Dzǝ ata siya yai zǝr sal ka gǝ vǝti thlǝmari Yɛsu akuya dzǝ ani ata siya mbulba ndzǝrni akwa bikǝr dar.
normalised_text: dze ata siya yai zer sal ka ge veti hlemari yesu akuya dze ani ata siya mbulba ndzerni akwa biker dar.

name: Cibak
text: Sang sǝ yarni kǝ 'ya akuya ka dzǝ tsanti apǝri sǝ nam tǝ Thlaku tara nkǝrɛ atar nabi ni ka dzǝ ghǝiyabadzi, apǝri:.
normalised_text: sang se yarni ke ya akuya ka dze tsanti aperi se nam te hlaku tara nkere atar nabi ni ka dze gheiyabadzi, aperi.

name: Cibak
text: Dabugu ata siya kǝtǝ whur ka dzǝ siya yai zǝr sal, ndǝ ata kǝga tǝni Imaniwal—Karabwari ani, Hyal adzǝ Muri.
normalised_text: dabugu ata siya kete whur ka dze siya yai zer sal, nde ata kega teni imaniwalkarabwari ani, shal adze muri.

name: Cibak
text: Sakatǝ Yusufu tara hyati ata hanyi, antǝ dzǝ ka 'yati tsu apa tǝ ndǝr hyantǝr Thlaku tara tsau alari, antǝ dzǝ ka kǝtǝ Maryamu ka ndzai mwalarni.
normalised_text: sakate yusufu tara shati ata hanyi, ante dze ka yati tsu apa te nder shanter hlaku tara tsau alari, ante dze ka kete maryamu ka ndzai mwalarni.

name: Cibak
text: Ama dzǝ ta zǝndi tǝni wɛ, tar aghǝla tǝ dzǝ tara yaba zǝr ni. Antǝ Yusufu vǝti alari thlǝmɛ Yɛsu.
normalised_text: ama dze ta zendi teni we, tar aghela te dze tara yaba zer ni. ante yusufu veti alari hleme yesu.

name: Cibak
text: Sakatǝ kuhyi Hirudus tara ngati apani dzǝ damitsǝnidzi kaka sanga ndzǝ nam akwa Ursalima.
normalised_text: sakate kushi hirudus tara ngati apani dze damitsenidzi kaka sanga ndze nam akwa ursalima.

name: Cibak
text: Sakatǝ dzǝ kǝ tsaɓtsǝni sanga nggar fǝrist yarni kaka sanga malǝmǝr mabari yarni, dzǝ ka yuwɛ tǝ dar apǝri, Ama vui tǝ ndǝ ata siya yaba Kǝrsti ni.
normalised_text: sakate dze ke tsabtseni sanga nggar ferist yarni kaka sanga malemer mabari yarni, dze ka yuwe te dar aperi, ama vui te nde ata siya yaba kersti ni.

name: Cibak
text: Antǝ dar ka kalaktsǝni alari, Akwa Baitalahami akwa diyir Yahudiya tǝ ndǝ ata yaba tǝni, akuya ǝni ani sǝ nam tǝ nabi tara rǝbwai apǝri:.
normalised_text: ante dar ka kalaktseni alari, akwa baitalahami akwa diyir yahudiya te nde ata yaba teni, akuya eni ani se nam te nabi tara rebwai aperi.

name: Cibak
text: Antǝ Hirudus ka kǝgahǝ ndzǝ nam bǝrkawa-bǝrkawa ni ɗǝwa-ɗǝwa ka dzǝ ghyǝngaba aka dar vǝr nam tǝm tǝ tsambiya ni tara tsantǝdzi.
normalised_text: ante hirudus ka kegahe ndze nam berkawaberkawa ni dewadewa ka dze ghyengaba aka dar ver nam tem te tsambiya ni tara tsantedzi.

name: Cibak
text: Sakatǝ dar tara wula tsambiya ni dar 'ya kutsari wurwuri.
normalised_text: sakate dar tara wula tsambiya ni dar ya kutsari wurwuri.

name: Cibak
text: Aghǝla tǝ ndǝ galatsǝni tǝ dar akwa sǝni ta dar ta ɓakta mwari ata Hirudus, dar ka ɓita tǝra akwa diyir dar ata whal damwa.
normalised_text: aghela te nde galatseni te dar akwa seni ta dar ta bakta mwari ata hirudus, dar ka bita tera akwa diyir dar ata whal damwa.

name: Cibak
text: Ani tsu avǝrvǝr nda, Yusufu ka hyati, ka kǝtǝ Maryamu aka Yɛsu ba dar ka whuiya lǝkwa diyir Masar.
normalised_text: ani tsu averver nda, yusufu ka shati, ka kete maryamu aka yesu ba dar ka whuiya lekwa diyir masar.

name: Cibak
text: akwa vui nam tǝ dar ndzai har ka la ntǝr Hirudus. Ani ahani tara ghǝiyaba sǝ nam tǝ Thlaku tara gha atar nabi: apǝri, Yi kǝ kǝgaba zǝrna akwa Masar.
normalised_text: akwa vui nam te dar ndzai har ka la nter hirudus. ani ahani tara gheiyaba se nam te hlaku tara gha atar nabi aperi, yi ke kegaba zerna akwa masar.

name: Cibak
text: Antǝ sǝ nam tǝ ndǝ tara nkǝrɛ atar nabi Irimiya kǝ ghǝiyabadzi.
normalised_text: ante se nam te nde tara nkere atar nabi irimiya ke gheiyabadzi.

name: Cishingini
text: A ayin a̱ ugiti, Ka̱shile ka yaꞋan ta̱ gaɗi n iɗika.
normalised_text: a ayin e ugiti, keshile ka yaan te gadi n idika.

name: Cishingini

text: Mfwa Hɛrɔd aké awuú mechɔ ɛwe, metɔɔ́ ɛ́tyá ji mmu wyɛmbɔ ntó ne ɛ́pyɛɛ́ ne bɔɔ́ Jɛrosalɛ ako.
normalised_text: mfwa herod ake awou mecho ewe, metuo etya ji mmu wyembo nto ne epyie ne buo jerosale ako.

name: Denya
text: Áshuú ji meko aké, Ábɔ́ mambyɛ́ ji né Bɛtɛlɛhɛm, fa gebagé mewaá Judiya. Néndé, mbɔ ne Ɛsɔwɔ apyɛ bɔɔ́ ɛkpávé bií ásáme nnó.
normalised_text: ashou ji meko ake, abo mambye ji ne betelehem, fa gebage mewea judiya. nende, mbo ne esowo apye buo ekpave bei asame nno.

name: Denya
text: Ɛbwɔ́ ágɛgé membe yimbɔ ɛfɛɛ́, matɔɔ́ ágɔ ɛbwɔ́ dɔɔ́.
normalised_text: ebwo agege membe yimbo efie, matuo ago ebwo duo.

name: Denya
text: Josɛf apégé géjyá ne utuú bimbɔ, apyɛ wyɛ́ nkane ɛkiɛ́nné Ɛsɔwɔ ɛgaré ji ɛké. Kpá maá yimbɔ ne mmá wuú ɔjyɛ né Ijip.
normalised_text: josef apege gejya ne utou bimbo, apye wye nkane ekienne esowo egare ji eke. kpa mea yimbo ne mma wou ojye ne ijip.

name: Denya
text: Mechɔ ɛwéna ɛ́pyɛmbɔ nnó, genó ɛyígé Jɛrimaya muú ɛkpávé Ɛsɔwɔ ájɔɔ́ gepyɛ wáwálé.
normalised_text: mecho ewena epyembo nno, geno eyige jerimaya mou ekpave esowo ajuo gepye wawale.

name: Denya
text: Hɛrɔd ágbógé, ɛkiɛ́nné Ɛsɔwɔ ɛkwɔ́ Josɛf ushu né géjyá né Ijip.
normalised_text: herod agboge, ekienne esowo ekwo josef ushu ne gejya ne ijip.

name: Denya
text: ɛké Josɛf, kwilé ka ɔ́kpá maá yina ne mma wuú, ɛnyú dékéré meso né mme Isrɛli. Bɔɔ́ abi ákɛlege manwá ji ágboó.
normalised_text: eke josef, kwile ka okpa mea yina ne mma wou, enyu dekere meso ne mme isreli. buo abi akelege manwa ji agbuo.

name: Denya
text: Josɛf ápégé, asɛ maá yimbɔ ne mmá wuú áfɛ́ né mme Isrɛli.
normalised_text: josef apege, ase mea yimbo ne mma wou afe ne mme isreli.

name: Denya
text: Kwɔ́rege matɔɔ́ nyú délyá gabo néndé gébé ɛyigé Ɛsɔwɔ ágbárege gefwa ne bɔɔ́ bií géla kwɔ́kwɔ́lé.
normalised_text: kworege matuo nyu delya gabo nende gebe eyige esowo agbarege gefwa ne buo bei gela kwokwole.

name: Dii
text: Yesu Krístu aa yée gbo̧o̧ woo máa, yéé voo vu̵u̵ yɛ nɔ. Daavíd máa, ká Yesu aa yéeɨ, Ibrahí̧í̧ma máa, ká Daavíd aa yéeɨ.
normalised_text: yesu kristu aa yee gbonon woo maa, yee voo vuu ye no. daavid maa, ka yesu aa yeey, ibrahininma maa, ka daavid aa yeey.

name: Dii
text: Ibrahí̧í̧ma ha̧a̧ Iizág, Iizág ha̧a̧ Yaakúbu, Yaakúbu ha̧a̧ Yúúda kan daa sá̧ŋ́ vu̵.
normalised_text: ibrahininma hanan iizag, iizag hanan yaakubu, yaakubu hanan yuuda kan daa sanng vu.

name: Dii
text: Yúúda vu̵ kan kȩ́ȩ́ Tamár vu̵ ha̧a̧ Falée kan Zará, Falée ha̧a̧ Ɛslóm, Ɛslóm ha̧a̧ Arám.
normalised_text: yuuda vu kan kenen tamar vu hanan falee kan zara, falee hanan eslom, eslom hanan aram.

name: Dii
text: Arám ha̧a̧ Aminadáb, Aminadáb ha̧a̧ Naáso̧ŋ, Naáso̧ŋ ha̧a̧ Salmɔ́ŋ.
normalised_text: aram hanan aminadab, aminadab hanan naasonng, naasonng hanan salmong.

name: Dii
text: Salmɔ́ŋ vu̵ kan kȩ́ȩ́ Raháb vu̵ ha̧a̧ Bowáa, Bowáa vu̵ kan kȩ́ȩ́ Rúd vu̵ ha̧a̧ Yu̵bɛ́d, Yu̵bɛ́d ha̧a̧ Izáy .
normalised_text: salmong vu kan kenen rahab vu hanan bowaa, bowaa vu kan kenen rud vu hanan yubed, yubed hanan izay.

name: Dii
text: Izáy ha̧a̧ gbanii Daavíd. Daavíd vu̵ kan kȩ́ȩ́ gaga woo vu̵ ha̧a̧ Súlemáánu .
normalised_text: izay hanan gbanii daavid. daavid vu kan kenen gaga woo vu hanan sulemaanu.

name: Dii
text: Súlemáánu ha̧a̧ Robowám, Robowám ha̧a̧ Abía, Abía ha̧a̧ Asáb.
normalised_text: sulemaanu hanan robowam, robowam hanan abia, abia hanan asab.

name: Dii
text: Asáb ha̧a̧ Yu̵u̵safád, Yu̵u̵safád ha̧a̧ Yoráḿ, Yoráḿ ha̧a̧ Ozía.
normalised_text: asab hanan yuusafad, yuusafad hanan yoram, yoram hanan ozia.

name: Dii
text: Ozía ha̧a̧ Yu̵atám, Yu̵atám ha̧a̧ Akáaz, Akáaz ha̧a̧ Ezekía.
normalised_text: ozia hanan yuatam, yuatam hanan akaaz, akaaz hanan ezekia.

name: Dii
text: Ezekía ha̧a̧ Manasée, Manasée ha̧a̧ Amós, Amós ha̧a̧ Yoosía.
normalised_text: ezekia hanan manasee, manasee hanan amos, amos hanan yoosia.

name: Dii
text: Yoosía ha̧a̧ Yekonía kan daa sá̧ŋ́ vu̵. Sey woo sɨɨ fá̧á̧ waa Izraɛ́l vu̵ laan hág Baabilónné .
normalised_text: yoosia hanan yekonia kan daa sanng vu. sey woo syy fanan waa izrael vu laan hag baabilonne.

name: Dii
text: Sey ku̵u̵ ya̧ hág Baabilónné máa, Yekonía ha̧a̧ Salatiɛ́l, Salatiɛ́l ha̧a̧ Zorobábɛl.
normalised_text: sey kuu yan hag baabilonne maa, yekonia hanan salatiel, salatiel hanan zorobabel.

name: Dii
text: Zorobábɛl ha̧a̧ Abíyu, Abíyu ha̧a̧ Eliakím, Eliakím ha̧a̧ Azɔ́r.
normalised_text: zorobabel hanan abiyu, abiyu hanan eliakim, eliakim hanan azor.

name: Dii
text: Azɔ́r ha̧a̧ Sadóg, Sadóg ha̧a̧ Akíḿ, Akíḿ ha̧a̧ Elúud.
normalised_text: azor hanan sadog, sadog hanan akim, akim hanan eluud.

name: Dii
text: Elúud ha̧a̧ Eliazár, Eliazár ha̧a̧ Mátan, Mátan ha̧a̧ Yaakúbu.
normalised_text: eluud hanan eliazar, eliazar hanan matan, matan hanan yaakubu.

name: Dii
text: Yaakúbu ha̧a̧ Yu̵u̵séfu Maaríi wə̧ə̧, Maaríi ha̧a̧ Yesu ı̵́ ku̵u̵ beewu̵ ı̵́ nán sənné máa.
normalised_text: yaakubu hanan yuusefu maarii wenen, maarii hanan yesu y kuu beewu y nan senne maa.

name: Dii
text: Wə̧ə̧ sá̧á̧lȩ́ woo Yu̵u̵séfu ká kɔ́ hȩn hí̧í̧lí̧ Tayɨɨ woo, hí̧í̧ bi gbɔn Maaríi sȩ́ḿ né, hí̧í̧ bi yɔŋ gbɔgɔ simná.
normalised_text: wenen sananlen woo yuusefu ka ko henn hininlin taiiy woo, hinin bi gbon maarii senm ne, hinin bi yong gbogo simna.

name: Dii
text: Wú̵ń ha̧a̧ wayée waa, mɔ́ń 'yɛ́ddu̵ yéé, Yesu, moo wú̵ńnɔ səd zig woo vu̵ yúú hȩn ɓı̵́d kɔ́lı̵́ voo vu̵lı̵́.
normalised_text: wun hanan wayee waa, mon yeddu yee, yesu, moo wunno sed zig woo vu yuu henn byd koly voo vuly.

name: Dii
text: Ɨ́ 'yɛ́lı̵́ Tayɨɨ ká moo moo yȩ ya̧g anábi tóó woolı̵́, ma hȩn yȩ kɔ́y ı̵́ yo̧go̧, ká o̧:.
normalised_text: y yely taiiy ka moo moo yen yang anabi too wooly, ma henn yen koy y yongon, ka on.

name: Dii
text: I ki bɔ, náá gíb waa tóó wú̵ń nuŋ ha̧g, wú̵ń ha̧a̧ wayée waa. Vú̵ń 'yɛ́ddu̵ yéé Emanuɛ́l.
normalised_text: i ki bo, naa gib waa too wun nung hang, wun hanan wayee waa. vun yeddu yee emanuel.

name: Dii
text: Yu̵u̵séfu ka níḿ nəmmé máa, kɔ́ kɔ́ ı̵́ maleeka ı̵́ 'yɛ́lı̵́ Tayɨɨ woo ka o̧ddu̵ wɔgɔ, éé kȩ́ȩ́ woo.
normalised_text: yuusefu ka nim nemme maa, ko ko y maleeka y yely taiiy woo ka onddu wogo, ee kenen woo.

name: Dii
text: A̧máa vu̵ un á̧ḿ né, há̧á̧ sey waa ha̧a̧lȩ́ woo ya̧ wu̵lı̵́. Ha̧a̧ wayée waa, Yu̵u̵séfu 'yɛ́ddu̵ yéé, Yesu.
normalised_text: anmaa vu un anm ne, hanan sey waa hananlen woo yan wuly. hanan wayee waa, yuusefu yeddu yee, yesu.

name: Dii
text: vu̵ vi: Gbanaa nán Yúúda voo ku̵u̵ ha̧a̧wo̧ máa dɨ tɛ́lá? Vɔ́ ho̧ zoo waa woo ka' mam na'alȩ́, máa vɔ́ yaa bi nao̧ ó̧.
normalised_text: vu vi gbanaa nan yuuda voo kuu hananwon maa dy tela? vo hon zoo waa woo ka mam naalen, maa vo yaa bi naon on.

name: Dii
text: Sey gbanaa Heeród ka ki moo yȩ máa, zó̧ó̧ tó̧o̧. Zó̧ó̧ tó̧' nán kaa Yerúsalem tóó vu̵ ɓu̵u̵lı̵́ na'a á̧ḿ.
normalised_text: sey gbanaa heerod ka ki moo yen maa, zonon tonon. zonon ton nan kaa yerusalem too vu buuly naa anm.

name: Dii
text: Gbanaa bee gbanaa hȩn haı̵́ vu̵ kan nán moo Tayɨɨ túí hág woolı̵́ vu̵ 'waapád, vi yee ba vu̵n ha̧a̧ ı̵́ nán sənné máa tɛ́lá?.

name: Dii
text: Vu̵ hí̧i̧du̵: Hȩn anábi ka bíńda máa, tú' ban dɨ kaa Bɛ́tɛlɛhɛmmé hág Yúúdalı̵́, bíńda o̧:.
normalised_text: vu hinindu henn anabi ka binda maa, tu ban dy kaa betelehemme hag yuudaly, binda on.

name: Dii
text: Heeród duu bee nán hȩn gaalı̵́ pee vu̵, yu̵g laan, zú' vu̵ ya̧g, vi vu̵ du̵u̵lı̵́ na'a, zoo waa yȩ ba túd vu̵ bá' woo née yȩlá?.
normalised_text: heerod duu bee nan henn gaaly pee vu, yug laan, zu vu yang, vi vu duuly naa, zoo waa yen ba tud vu ba woo nee yenla?.

name: Dii
text: Sey ku̵u̵ ho̧ zoo waa máa, zó̧ó̧ voo dȩ' mbaa ná'.
normalised_text: sey kuu hon zoo waa maa, zonon voo den mbaa na.

name: Dii
text: Tayɨɨ o̧d nán hȩn gaalı̵́ pee vu̵ nəəgı̵́ ba u̵u̵ duu vȩ́' duu Heeród woolı̵́ sá, ma vu̵ daa duu hi̧naa tóó kə́d, vu̵ daa vȩ́' laa hág voolı̵́.
normalised_text: taiiy ond nan henn gaaly pee vu neegy ba uu duu ven duu heerod wooly sa, ma vu daa duu hinnaa too ked, vu daa ven laa hag vooly.

name: Dii
text: Yu̵u̵séfu níḿ lúú dɔg, ɓɛ waa kan na' woo Maaríi, vu̵ lúú ɗug viddí, vu̵ daa laa hág Mísiralı̵́.
normalised_text: yuusefu nim luu dog, be waa kan na woo maarii, vu luu dug viddi, vu daa laa hag misiraly.

name: Dinka Southwestern
text: Käkkä aa rin kuat kɔc ke dhiëëth Jethu thïn, kuat Bɛ̈nyŋaknhom Debit bɔ̈ cök tënë Abaram.
normalised_text: kakka aa rin kuat koch ke dhieeth jethu thihn, kuat benyngaknom debit bo chok tene abaram.

name: Dinka Southwestern
text: Abaram ë ye wun Ithäk. Ithäk ë ye wun Jakop. Yen cï Juda bɛ̈n dhiëëth kek wämäthakën kɔ̈k.
normalised_text: abaram e ye wun ithak. ithak e ye wun jakop. yen chih juda ben dhieeth kek wamathaken kok.

name: Dinka Southwestern
text: Juda ë ye wun pandiɛɛt, Peredh ku Dhara ku manden ë cɔl Tamar, Peredh ë ye wun Ɣedhron ku Ɣedhron ë ye wun Ram.
normalised_text: juda e ye wun pandieet, peredh ku dhara ku manden e chol tamar, peredh e ye wun ghedhron ku ghedhron e ye wun ram.

name: Dinka Southwestern
text: Ram ë ye wun Aminadap, ku Aminadap ë ye wun Nacon, ku Nacon ë ye wun Thalmon.
normalised_text: ram e ye wun aminadap, ku aminadap e ye wun nachon, ku nachon e ye wun thalmon.

name: Dinka Southwestern
text: Thalmon ë ye wun Boath, ku man ë cɔl Raɣäp. Boath ë ye wun Obet, ku man ë cɔl Ruth, ku Obet ë ye wun Jethe.
normalised_text: thalmon e ye wun boath, ku man e chol raghap. boath e ye wun obet, ku man e chol ruth, ku obet e ye wun jethe.

name: Dinka Southwestern
text: Ku Jethe ë wun Bɛ̈nyŋaknhom Debit, ku Debit ë ye wun Tholomon, ku man ëcï kaŋ aa tiŋ Uria.
normalised_text: ku jethe e wun benyngaknom debit, ku debit e ye wun tholomon, ku man echih kang aa ting uria.

name: Dinka Southwestern
text: Tholomon ë ye wun Raboam, ku Raboam ë ye wun Abija, ku Abija ë ye wun Atha.
normalised_text: tholomon e ye wun raboam, ku raboam e ye wun abija, ku abija e ye wun atha.

name: Dinka Southwestern
text: Atha ë ye wun Jocapat, Jocapat ë ye wun Joram, ku Joram ë ye wun Udhia.
normalised_text: atha e ye wun jochapat, jochapat e ye wun joram, ku joram e ye wun udhia.

name: Dinka Southwestern
text: Udhia ë ye wun Jotham, Jotham ë ye wun Aɣath, ku Aɣath ë ye wun Ɣedhekia.
normalised_text: udhia e ye wun jotham, jotham e ye wun aghath, ku aghath e ye wun ghedhekia.

name: Dinka Southwestern
text: Ɣedhekia ë ye wun Manathe, Manathe ë ye wun Amon, ku Amon ë ye wun Jothia.
normalised_text: ghedhekia e ye wun manathe, manathe e ye wun amon, ku amon e ye wun jothia.

name: Dinka Southwestern
text: Jothia ë ye wun Jekonia, ku wämäthakën kɔ̈k, ku jɔl ke peec ku ɣɛ̈th ke Babilonia.
normalised_text: jothia e ye wun jekonia, ku wamathaken kok, ku jol ke peech ku gheth ke babilonia.

name: Dinka Southwestern
text: Wën cï ke ɣäth Babilonia aacï la dhiëth këlä, Jekonia acï Cealtiel la dhiëëth. Cealtiel ë ye wun Dherubabel.
normalised_text: wen chih ke ghath babilonia aachih la dhieth kela, jekonia achih chealtiel la dhieeth. chealtiel e ye wun dherubabel.

name: Dinka Southwestern
text: Dherubabel ë ye wun Abiöt ku Abiöt ë ye wun Eliakim. Ku Eliakim ë ye wun Adhor.
normalised_text: dherubabel e ye wun abiot ku abiot e ye wun eliakim. ku eliakim e ye wun adhor.

name: Dinka Southwestern
text: Adhor ë ye wun Dhadok. Dhadok ë ye wun Acim, ku Acim ë ye wun Eliöt.
normalised_text: adhor e ye wun dhadok. dhadok e ye wun achim, ku achim e ye wun eliot.

name: Dinka Southwestern
text: Eliöt ë ye wun Aliadhër ku Aliadhër ë ye wun Mathan. Ku Mathan ë ye wun Jakop.
normalised_text: eliot e ye wun aliadher ku aliadher e ye wun mathan. ku mathan e ye wun jakop.

name: Dinka Southwestern
text: Ku Jakop ë ye wun Jothep mony Maria, ku ë yen acï Jethu cɔl Raan cï lɔc ku dɔc bɛ̈n dhiëëth.
normalised_text: ku jakop e ye wun jothep mony maria, ku e yen achih jethu chol raan chih loch ku doch ben dhieeth.

name: Dinka Southwestern
text: Dhiënh Jethu ë loi rot këlä. Maria ë wïc Jothep bï thiaak. Tɛ̈wën këc ye gam, ke yök ke cï liëc ë manh yök tënë Wëi Nhialic.
normalised_text: dhien jethu e loi rot kela. maria e wihch jothep bih thiaak. tewen kech ye gam, ke yok ke chih liech e man yok tene wei nialich.

name: Dinka Southwestern
text: Jothep, raan awën wïc ye bï thiaak ë ye raan path, ku akëc wïc bï Maria yɔ̈ɔ̈r guɔ̈p, go wïc bï puɔ̈l ke cïn raan piŋ ye.
normalised_text: jothep, raan awen wihch ye bih thiaak e ye raan path, ku akech wihch bih maria yoor guop, go wihch bih puol ke chihn raan ping ye.

name: Dinka Southwestern
text: Yeen abï mɛnh moc dhiëëth, ku aba cäk ke cɔl Jethu rin yen ë raan bï kɔc wɛ̈ɛ̈r bei adumuɔ̈ɔ̈mken yiic.
normalised_text: yeen abih men moch dhieeth, ku aba chak ke chol jethu rin yen e raan bih koch weer bei adumuoomken yiich.

name: Dinka Southwestern
text: Kënë acï rot looi këya, bï wɛ̈t Nhialic cï raan käkke tïŋ lueel yenhom tiɛɛŋ. Ku wɛ̈t kënë ëcï lueel ëlä.
normalised_text: kene achih rot looi keya, bih wet nialich chih raan kakke tihng lueel yenom tieeng. ku wet kene echih lueel ela.

name: Dinka Southwestern
text: Nyan bïm abï liëc, ku abï manh moc dhiëëth ku abï cɔl Emanuel. Ku wɛ̈tde yic, Nhialic atɔ̈ kek ɣook.
normalised_text: nyan bihm abih liech, ku abih man moch dhieeth ku abih chol emanuel. ku wetde yich, nialich ato kek ghook.

name: Dinka Southwestern
text: Këya, Jothep acï kë cï atuny Nhialic lɛ̈k ye gam, ku ɣɛ̈th Maria baai.
normalised_text: keya, jothep achih ke chih atuny nialich lek ye gam, ku gheth maria baai.

name: Dinka Southwestern
text: Ku aa këc rëër cïmën tik ke moc ɣet tɛ̈ dhiëëth Maria wënde, ku ciɛ̈k Jothep ke cɔl Jethu.
normalised_text: ku aa kech reer chihmen tik ke moch ghet te dhieeth maria wende, ku chiek jothep ke chol jethu.

name: Dinka Southwestern
text: Tɛ̈wën cï Jethu dhiëëth gen Bethalem pan Judia, wäär ye Ɣërot Bɛ̈ny. Ke bäny kɔ̈k ŋic käk Nhialic bɔ̈ piny ciëën ku ɣëëtkë Jeruthalem.
normalised_text: tewen chih jethu dhieeth gen bethalem pan judia, waar ye gherot beny. ke bany kok ngich kak nialich bo piny chieen ku gheetke jeruthalem.

name: Dinka Southwestern
text: ku thiëckë, Tɔ̈ Bɛ̈nyŋaknhom kɔc Itharel puɔc dhiëëth tɛ̈no? Ciɛ̈ɛ̈rde acuk tïŋ piny ciëën, yen abï ɣok buk bɛ̈n door.
normalised_text: ku thiechke, to benyngaknom koch itharel puoch dhieeth teno? chieerde achuk tihng piny chieen, yen abih ghok buk ben door.

name: Dinka Southwestern
text: Nawën piŋ Bɛ̈ny Ɣërot ë wɛ̈t kënë, ke jieth puɔ̈u, agut kɔcdït käk Nhialic Jeruthalem aya.
normalised_text: nawen ping beny gherot e wet kene, ke jieth puou, agut kochdiht kak nialich jeruthalem aya.

name: Dinka Southwestern
text: Go bänydït käk Nhialic, ku kɔc piööc lööŋ cɔɔl ëbën ku thiëëc ke, Ye tɛ̈nɛn bï Raan cï lɔc ku dɔc dhiëëth thïn.
normalised_text: go banydiht kak nialich, ku koch piooch loong chool eben ku thieech ke, ye tenen bih raan chih loch ku doch dhieeth thihn.

name: Dinka Southwestern
text: Gokë lueel, Abï dhiëëth gen Bethalem pan Judia, cït wɛ̈t cï raan käk Nhialic tïŋ gɔ̈t ëlä.
normalised_text: goke lueel, abih dhieeth gen bethalem pan judia, chiht wet chih raan kak nialich tihng got ela.

text: Ŋaablà Jaara Moo Yesù Kirisà bou tsu niì ɲàn, twɛy mòdzin neè rìì siin nèe: À bou Dawudà tsua ɲàn, Dawudà yè bo Ibraximà tsua ɲàn.

text: Vbe omuhẹn, vbe Osanobua yi agbọn kevbe emwi hia ni rre iso.
normalised_text: ve omuhen, ve osanobua yi agbon keve evni hia ni re iso.

name: Edo (Bini)
text: Osanobua keghi kha wẹẹ, Gie uwanmwẹ gha rrọọ, uwanmwẹ keghi gele ladian.
normalised_text: osanobua keghi kha wee, gie uwanvne gha roo, uwanvne keghi gele ladian.

name: Edo (Bini)
text: Emwi ne Osanobua dẹghe keghi sẹ ọre ọyẹnmwẹ. Rẹn keghi wannọ uwanmwẹ hin ebiebi rre.
normalised_text: evni ne osanobua deghe keghi se ore oyenvne. ren keghi wanno uwanvne hin ebiebi re.

name: Edo (Bini)
text: Rẹn keghi tie uwanmwẹ Avan kevbe ebiebi Asọn. Ẹdẹ keghi mu ẹdẹ keghi gbe ọnii kegha re ikpẹdẹ nokaro.
normalised_text: ren keghi tie uwanvne avan keve ebiebi ason. ede keghi mu ede keghi gbe onii kegha re ikpede nokaro.

name: Edo (Bini)
text: Ọ keghi tie ideghedeghe nii Iso Ẹdẹ keghi mu ẹdẹ keghi gbe, ọnii na gha re ikpẹdẹ ne ogieva.
normalised_text: o keghi tie ideghedeghe nii iso ede keghi mu ede keghi gbe, onii na gha re ikpede ne ogieva.

name: Edo (Bini)
text: Osanobua keghi kha wẹẹ, Gie amẹ ni rre ototọ iso si koko ye ihọkpa ne otọe miẹn ehe na ladian. Ọ keghi gha ye rriọ.
normalised_text: osanobua keghi kha wee, gie ame ni re ototo iso si koko ye ihokpa ne otoe mien ehe na ladian. o keghi gha ye rio.

name: Edo (Bini)
text: Rẹn keghi tie otọe nii Agbọn ọ keghi tie amẹ ne a si koko nii Okun. Emwi ne Osanobua bẹghe keghi sẹ ọre ọyẹnmwẹ.
normalised_text: ren keghi tie otoe nii agbon o keghi tie ame ne a si koko nii okun. evni ne osanobua beghe keghi se ore oyenvne.

name: Edo (Bini)
text: Rẹn keghi kha wẹẹ, Gie erhan vbe irunmwu hia zọ vbe otọe, ke ni gbe ihiagha kevbe eni mọ, ọ kegha ye rriọ.
normalised_text: ren keghi kha wee, gie erhan ve irunvnu hia zo ve otoe, ke ni gbe ihiagha keve eni mo, o kegha ye rio.

name: Edo (Bini)
text: Emwi hia keghi zọ ke otọe rre. Emwi ne Osanobua bẹghe, keghi sẹ ọre ọyẹnmwẹ.
normalised_text: evni hia keghi zo ke otoe re. evni ne osanobua beghe, keghi se ore oyenvne.

name: Edo (Bini)
text: Ẹdẹ keghi mu, ẹdẹ keghi gbe, ọnii na gha re ikpẹdẹ ne ogieha.
normalised_text: ede keghi mu, ede keghi gbe, onii na gha re ikpede ne ogieha.

name: Edo (Bini)
text: iran ghi gha baa vbe iso, ne iran gha rhie uwanmwẹ ye agbọn ọ kegha ye rriọ.
normalised_text: iran ghi gha baa ve iso, ne iran gha rhie uwanvne ye agbon o kegha ye rio.

name: Edo (Bini)
text: Ẹre Osanobua na yi uwanmwẹ nekhua eveva, ne owẹn gha kha yan avan, ne uki vbe gha kha yan asọn; ọ keghi yi avbe orhọnmwẹ ba ẹre.
normalised_text: ere osanobua na yi uwanvne nekhua eveva, ne owen gha kha yan avan, ne uki ve gha kha yan ason; o keghi yi ave orhonvne ba ere.

name: Edo (Bini)
text: Rẹn keghi viọ nene avbe uwanmwẹ ye iso ne iran gha wan mu otọe.
normalised_text: ren keghi vio nene ave uwanvne ye iso ne iran gha wan mu otoe.

name: Edo (Bini)
text: Ne iran gha kha yan avan kevbe asọn kevbe ne iran wannọ uwanmwẹ hin ebiebi rre. Emwi ne Osanobua bẹghe keghi sẹ ọre ọyẹnmwẹ.
normalised_text: ne iran gha kha yan avan keve ason keve ne iran wanno uwanvne hin ebiebi re. evni ne osanobua beghe keghi se ore oyenvne.

name: Edo (Bini)
text: Ẹdẹ keghi mu, ẹdẹ keghi gbe, ọnii na gha re ikpẹdẹ ne ogienẹ.
normalised_text: ede keghi mu, ede keghi gbe, onii na gha re ikpede ne ogiene.

name: Edo (Bini)
text: Osanobua keghi kha wẹẹ, Gie amẹ vuọn ne emwi ni hiọnrọn ughughan nibun, kevbe ne ahianmwẹ vbe vuọn iso.
normalised_text: osanobua keghi kha wee, gie ame vuon ne evni ni hionron ughughan nibun, keve ne ahianvne ve vuon iso.

name: Edo (Bini)
text: Rẹn keghi fiangbe iran hia, rẹn keghi tama emwi ni rre uwe amẹ ne iran gha muan yọ ne iran vuọn okun. Ọ tama avbe ahianmwẹ ne iran vbe gha muan yọ.
normalised_text: ren keghi fiangbe iran hia, ren keghi tama evni ni re uwe ame ne iran gha muan yo ne iran vuon okun. o tama ave ahianvne ne iran ve gha muan yo.

name: Edo (Bini)
text: Ẹdẹ keghi mu, ẹdẹ keghi gbe, ọnii na gha rre ikpẹdẹ ne ogisẹn.
normalised_text: ede keghi mu, ede keghi gbe, onii na gha re ikpede ne ogisen.

name: Edo (Bini)
text: Osanobua na kha wẹẹ, Gie emwi irri ughughan gha rre otọe, kevbe aranmwẹ oha ughughan nekhua kevbe negiẹrẹ. Ọ kegha ye rriọ.
normalised_text: osanobua na kha wee, gie evni iri ughughan gha re otoe, keve aranvne oha ughughan nekhua keve negiere. o kegha ye rio.

name: Edo (Bini)
text: Ẹre Osanobua na yi avbe emwi hia, emwi ne irẹn bẹghe keghi sẹ ọre ọyẹnmwẹ.
normalised_text: ere osanobua na yi ave evni hia, evni ne iren beghe keghi se ore oyenvne.

name: Edo (Bini)
text: Ẹre Osanobua na ma emwa nagbọn, ọ na ma iran ne iran ye vbe irẹn tobọ irẹn. Ọ keghi yi iran okpia kevbe okhuo.
normalised_text: ere osanobua na ma evna nagbon, o na ma iran ne iran ye ve iren tobo iren. o keghi yi iran okpia keve okhuo.

name: Edo (Bini)
text: I rhie avbe ikpẹ ọmọ erhan kevbe avbe ọmọ erhan hia nuẹn ne u gha re.
normalised_text: i rhie ave ikpe omo erhan keve ave omo erhan hia nuen ne u gha re.

name: Edo (Bini)
text: Sokpan ebe vbe irunmwu ọre I viọ ne avbe aranmwẹ oha nekhua kevbe negiẹrẹ kevbe avbe ahianmwẹ ne iran gha re. Ọ kegha ye rriọ.
normalised_text: sokpan ebe ve irunvnu ore i vio ne ave aranvne oha nekhua keve negiere keve ave ahianvne ne iran gha re. o kegha ye rio.

name: Edo (Bini)
text: Osanobua keghi ghe emwi hia ne irẹn yi, ẹko ke sẹ ọre ọyẹnmwẹ ẹsẹse. Ẹdẹ ghi gbe ẹdẹ keghi mu, ọnii na gha re ikpẹdẹ ne ogiehan.
normalised_text: osanobua keghi ghe evni hia ne iren yi, eko ke se ore oyenvne esese. ede ghi gbe ede keghi mu, onii na gha re ikpede ne ogiehan.

name: Edo (Bini)
text: Vbe ikpẹdẹ ne ogihinrọn, Osanobua keghi winna iwinna ne ọ gha winna hia fo, ọ keghi dobọ iwinna yi.
normalised_text: ve ikpede ne ogihinron, osanobua keghi winna iwinna ne o gha winna hia fo, o keghi dobo iwinna yi.

name: Edo (Bini)
text: Vberriọ ọre a ya yi otọe vbe ukhunmwu. Ẹghẹ ne Nọyaẹnmwa Osanobua na yi otọe vbe ukhunmwu.
normalised_text: verio ore a ya yi otoe ve ukhunvnu. eghe ne noyaenvna osanobua na yi otoe ve ukhunvnu.

name: Edo (Bini)
text: erhan rhọkpa ma gha rre otọe, emwi rhọkpa ma he vbe zọọ, rhunmwuda, rẹn ma he gie amẹ he rhọ, ọmwa rhọkpa i vbe rrọọ ne ọ gha kọ emwi ye otọe.
normalised_text: erhan rhokpa ma gha re otoe, evni rhokpa ma he ve zoo, rhunvnuda, ren ma he gie ame he rho, ovna rhokpa i ve roo ne o gha ko evni ye otoe.

name: Edo (Bini)
text: Sokpan amẹ kegha rọn ke uwe otọe rre, ọ keghi lẹ guagua otọe.
normalised_text: sokpan ame kegha ron ke uwe otoe re, o keghi le guagua otoe.

name: Edo (Bini)
text: Nọyaẹnmwa Osanobua ke do mu ogba ọkpa ye Idẹni, vbe odẹ ahọ ọ ke rhie okpia ne irẹn maẹn nii ye evba.
normalised_text: noyaenvna osanobua ke do mu ogba okpa ye ideni, ve ode aho o ke rhie okpia ne iren maen nii ye eva.

name: Edo (Bini)
text: Ẹzẹ ọkpa lẹ ke uwe Idẹni ladian do gba amẹ khakha ogba nii, ọ ghi gberra Idẹni nẹ, ọ keghi fian egbe ye ẹzẹ enẹ.
normalised_text: eze okpa le ke uwe ideni ladian do gba ame khakha ogba nii, o ghi gbera ideni ne, o keghi fian egbe ye eze ene.

name: Efik
text: Ndien isɔŋ edi ikpikpu, ye ukpɔk; ekim onyuŋ odu ke enyɔŋ inyaŋ. Spirit Abasi onyuŋ ɔkubɔ ke enyɔŋ mmɔŋ.
normalised_text: ndien isong edi ikpikpu, ye ukpok; ekim onyung odu ke enyong inyang. spirit abasi onyung okubo ke enyong mmong.

name: Efik
text: Ekem Abasi ɔdɔhɔ ete, Yak uŋwana odu: ndien uŋwana odu.
normalised_text: ekem abasi odoho ete, yak ungwana odu ndien ungwana odu.

name: Efik
text: Abasi onyuŋ adianare uŋwana ye ekim. Ndien Abasi okot uŋwana ete, Uwemeyo, onyuŋ okot ekim ete, Okoneyo. Ndien mbubreyo ye usenubɔk edi akpa usen.
normalised_text: abasi onyung adianare ungwana ye ekim. ndien abasi okot ungwana ete, uwemeyo, onyung okot ekim ete, okoneyo. ndien mbubreyo ye usenubok edi akpa usen.

name: Efik
text: Ndien Abasi ɔdɔhɔ ete, Yak ikpa-enyɔŋ odu ke ufɔt mmɔŋ, yak onyuŋ adiaŋare mmɔŋ ye mmɔŋ.
normalised_text: ndien abasi odoho ete, yak ikpaenyong odu ke ufot mmong, yak onyung adiangare mmong ye mmong.

name: Efik
text: Ndien mbubreyo ye usenubok edi udiana akpa usen.
normalised_text: ndien mbubreyo ye usenubok edi udiana akpa usen.

name: Efik
text: Ndien Abasi ete, Yak mmɔŋ ke idak enyɔŋ oboho ke ebiet kiet, yak edisat isɔŋ onyuŋ ɔwɔrɔ: ndien edi ntre.
normalised_text: ndien abasi ete, yak mmong ke idak enyong oboho ke ebiet kiet, yak edisat isong onyung oworo ndien edi ntre.

name: Efik
text: Ndien Abasi okot edisat isɔŋ ete, Obot; onyun okot mmɔŋ emi obohode, ete Inyaŋ: ndien Abasi okut ete efɔn.
normalised_text: ndien abasi okot edisat isong ete, obot; onyun okot mmong emi obohode, ete inyang ndien abasi okut ete efon.

name: Efik
text: Ndien mbubreyo ye usenubɔk edi ɔyɔhɔ usen ita.
normalised_text: ndien mbubreyo ye usenubok edi oyoho usen ita.

name: Efik
text: Yak mmɔ enyuŋ edi nte mme uŋwana ke ikpa-enyɔŋ, ndiyama nnɔ isɔŋ: ndien edi ntre.
normalised_text: yak mmo enyung edi nte mme ungwana ke ikpaenyong, ndiyama nno isong ndien edi ntre.

name: Efik
text: Ndien Abasi anam ikpɔ mme uŋwana mbiba oro; akamba uŋwana ete akara uwemeyo, ye ekpri uŋwana ete akara okoneyo: ye mme ntantafiɔŋ.
normalised_text: ndien abasi anam ikpo mme ungwana mbiba oro; akamba ungwana ete akara uwemeyo, ye ekpri ungwana ete akara okoneyo ye mme ntantafiong.

name: Efik
text: Abasi onyuŋ esin mmɔ ke ikpa-enyɔŋ heaven, ete eyama enɔ isɔŋ.
normalised_text: abasi onyung esin mmo ke ikpaenyong heaven, ete eyama eno isong.

name: Efik
text: enyuŋ ekara uwemeyo ye okoneyo, enyuŋ edianare uŋwana ye ekim: ndien Abasi okut ete efɔn.
normalised_text: enyung ekara uwemeyo ye okoneyo, enyung edianare ungwana ye ekim ndien abasi okut ete efon.

name: Efik
text: Ndien mbubreyo ye usenubɔk edi ɔyɔhɔ usen inaŋ.
normalised_text: ndien mbubreyo ye usenubok edi oyoho usen inang.

name: Efik
text: Ndien Abasi ɔdɔhɔ, ete, Yak mmɔŋ ɔyɔhɔ udim-udim unam eke edude uwem, yak inuen enyuŋ efefe ekpɔŋ isɔŋ ke iso ikpa-enyɔŋ.
normalised_text: ndien abasi odoho, ete, yak mmong oyoho udimudim unam eke edude uwem, yak inuen enyung efefe ekpong isong ke iso ikpaenyong.

name: Efik
text: Ndien Abasi ɔdiɔŋ mmɔ, ete, Mbufo etɔt, enyuŋ ewak, enyun eyɔhɔ ke mmɔŋ ke akamba inyaŋ; yak inuen enyuŋ ewak ke isɔŋ.
normalised_text: ndien abasi odiong mmo, ete, mbufo etot, enyung ewak, enyun eyoho ke mmong ke akamba inyang; yak inuen enyung ewak ke isong.

name: Efik
text: Ndien mbubreyo ye usenubɔk edi ɔyɔhɔ usen ition.
normalised_text: ndien mbubreyo ye usenubok edi oyoho usen ition.

name: Efik
text: Ndien Abasi ete, Yak isɔŋ osioŋo unam eke edude uwem ke oruk mmɔ, ufene, ye andinyɔni, ye unam obot ke oruk mmɔ: ndien edi ntre.
normalised_text: ndien abasi ete, yak isong osiongo unam eke edude uwem ke oruk mmo, ufene, ye andinyoni, ye unam obot ke oruk mmo ndien edi ntre.

name: Efik
text: Ndien Abasi anam unam obot ke oruk mmɔ, ye ufene ke oruk mmɔ, ye kpukpru andinyɔni ke isɔŋ ke oruk mmɔ; ndien Abasi okut ete efɔn.
normalised_text: ndien abasi anam unam obot ke oruk mmo, ye ufene ke oruk mmo, ye kpukpru andinyoni ke isong ke oruk mmo; ndien abasi okut ete efon.

name: Efik
text: Ntem ke Abasi obot owo esin ke mbiet esiemɔ, ke mbiet Abasi ke obot enye; eren ye ŋwan ke obot mmɔ.
normalised_text: ntem ke abasi obot owo esin ke mbiet esiemo, ke mbiet abasi ke obot enye; eren ye ngwan ke obot mmo.

name: Efik
text: Ndien Abasi okut kpukpru se enye akanamde, ndien, sese efɔn eti eti. Ndien mbubreyo ye usenubɔk edi ɔyɔhɔ usen itiokiet.
normalised_text: ndien abasi okut kpukpru se enye akanamde, ndien, sese efon eti eti. ndien mbubreyo ye usenubok edi oyoho usen itiokiet.

name: Efik
text: EKEM enam enyɔŋ ye isɔŋ, ye kpukpru udim mmɔ ema.
normalised_text: ekem enam enyong ye isong, ye kpukpru udim mmo ema.

name: Efik
text: Abasi onyuŋ anam utom esie emi enye akanamde, okure ke ɔyɔhɔ usen itiaba; ndien ke ɔyɔhɔ usen itiaba enye odop kpukpru utom esie emi enye akanamde.
normalised_text: abasi onyung anam utom esie emi enye akanamde, okure ke oyoho usen itiaba; ndien ke oyoho usen itiaba enye odop kpukpru utom esie emi enye akanamde.

name: Efik
text: Ndien Abasi ɔdiɔŋ ɔyɔhɔ usen itiaba, onyuŋ anam enye edi edisana; koro ke esit ke enye odop kpukpru utom esie emi Abasi okobotde okonyuŋ anamde.
normalised_text: ndien abasi odiong oyoho usen itiaba, onyung anam enye edi edisana; koro ke esit ke enye odop kpukpru utom esie emi abasi okobotde okonyung anamde.

name: Efik
text: Mme mmɔ emi edi emana enyɔŋ ye isɔŋ ke ebotde mmɔ, ke usen emi Jehovah Abasi anamde isɔn ye enyɔŋ.
normalised_text: mme mmo emi edi emana enyong ye isong ke ebotde mmo, ke usen emi jehovah abasi anamde ison ye enyong.

name: Efik
text: Ekem ntuhube oto ke isɔŋ ɔdɔk, ekebit ofuri iso obot.
normalised_text: ekem ntuhube oto ke isong odok, ekebit ofuri iso obot.

name: Efik
text: Ndien Jehovah Abasi obot owo ke ntan-isɔŋ, onyuŋ ɔduɔk ibifik uwem esin ke odudu ibuo esie; ndien owo akabare edi ukpɔŋ eke odude uwem.
normalised_text: ndien jehovah abasi obot owo ke ntanisong, onyung oduok ibifik uwem esin ke odudu ibuo esie; ndien owo akabare edi ukpong eke odude uwem.

name: Efik
text: Jehovah Abasi onyuŋ ɔtɔ iŋwaŋ ke Eden ke edem usiaha-utin; onyuŋ emen owo emi enye okobotde onim do.
normalised_text: jehovah abasi onyung oto ingwang ke eden ke edem usiahautin; onyung emen owo emi enye okobotde onim do.

name: Efik
text: Jehovah Abasi onyuŋ anam isɔŋ otibe kpukpru eto eke enemde ndise enyuŋ efɔnde ndidia; ye eto uwem ŋko ke ufɔt iŋwaŋ, ye eto ifiɔk eti ye idiɔk.
normalised_text: jehovah abasi onyung anam isong otibe kpukpru eto eke enemde ndise enyung efonde ndidia; ye eto uwem ngko ke ufot ingwang, ye eto ifiok eti ye idiok.

name: Efik
text: Akpa onyuŋ oto ke Eden edibit iŋwaŋ; ndien ɔtɔŋɔ do enye abahare, akabare edi mbuot inaŋ.
normalised_text: akpa onyung oto ke eden edibit ingwang; ndien otongo do enye abahare, akabare edi mbuot inang.

name: Efik
text: Enyiŋ kiet edi Pison: edi enye akan ofuri idut Havilah okuk, emi gold odude do;.
normalised_text: enying kiet edi pison edi enye akan ofuri idut havilah okuk, emi gold odude do;.

name: Eggon
text: Akpa he a wo akpa ba ogu ba moa a mbre Eyesu Ekristi. Aŋa a wo a ba ogu ba Adawuda ta la ogu ba Ebrahim angyiŋ.
normalised_text: akpa he a wo akpa ba ogu ba moa a mbre eyesu ekristi. anga a wo a ba ogu ba adawuda ta la ogu ba ebrahim angying.

name: Eggon
text: Ebrahim angyiŋ a wo adaŋ Eshaku. Eshaku angyiŋ a wo adaŋ Eyakubu. Eyakubu angyiŋ a wo adaŋ Eyahuda pa la moanáŋ Eyahuda.
normalised_text: ebrahim angying a wo adang eshaku. eshaku angying a wo adang eyakubu. eyakubu angying a wo adang eyahuda pa la moanang eyahuda.

name: Eggon
text: Eyahuda angyiŋ a wo adaŋ Eperaza, ta la Ezera. Animo a ri Atama. Eperaza angyiŋ a wo adaŋ Ehezoro. Ehezoro angyiŋ a wo adaŋ Aram.
normalised_text: eyahuda angying a wo adang eperaza, ta la ezera. animo a ri atama. eperaza angying a wo adang ehezoro. ehezoro angying a wo adang aram.

name: Eggon
text: Aram angyiŋ a wo adaŋ Aminadab. Aminadab angyiŋ a wo adaŋ Enashoŋ. Enashoŋ angyiŋ a wo adaŋ Esalmon.
normalised_text: aram angying a wo adang aminadab. aminadab angying a wo adang enashong. enashong angying a wo adang esalmon.

name: Eggon
text: Esalmon angyiŋ a wo adaŋ Oboz. Anaŋ Oboz a ri Arahab. Oboz angyiŋ a wo adaŋ Obed. Anaŋ a ri Arawuta. Obed angyiŋ a wo adaŋ Ejese.
normalised_text: esalmon angying a wo adang oboz. anang oboz a ri arahab. oboz angying a wo adang obed. anang a ri arawuta. obed angying a wo adang ejese.

name: Eggon
text: Ejese angyiŋ a wo adaŋ anyuŋ-areŋ moa a bzi ŋa ma Adawuda. Adawuda angyiŋ a wo adaŋ Osolomo. Anaŋ a wo ashe ba Oriya ayga.
normalised_text: ejese angying a wo adang anyungareng moa a bzi nga ma adawuda. adawuda angying a wo adang osolomo. anang a wo ashe ba oriya ayga.

name: Eggon
text: Osolomo angyiŋ a wo adaŋ Erohobom. Erohobom angyiŋ a wo adaŋ Abija. Abija angyiŋ a wo adaŋ Asa.
normalised_text: osolomo angying a wo adang erohobom. erohobom angying a wo adang abija. abija angying a wo adang asa.

name: Eggon
text: Asa angyiŋ a wo adaŋ Ojohoshafat. Ojohoshafat angyiŋ a wo adaŋ Ojoram. Ojoram angyiŋ a wo adaŋ Oziya.

name: Ekajuk

name: Elip
text: Yubu hiá nugɔg nuá Yésuse Klístus muɔ́n wa Dafíde, muɔ́n wa Áblahám híhiényé:.
normalised_text: yubu hia nugog nua yesuse klistus muon wa dafide, muon wa ablaham hihienye.

name: Elip
text: Áblahám uwebíén Isák, Isák uwebíén Yɔ́kɔba, Yɔ́kɔba uwebíén Yúdas na beliméen.
normalised_text: ablaham uwebien isak, isak uwebien yokoba, yokoba uwebien yudas na belimeen.

name: Elip
text: Yúdas uwebíén Falɛ́s na Salá, noódíe wɔb ɔhɛ́n áneé Tamál. Falɛ́s uwebíén Eslɔ́m, Eslɔ́m uwebíén Alám.
normalised_text: yudas uwebien fales na sala, noodie wob ohen anee tamal. fales uwebien eslom, eslom uwebien alam.

name: Elip
text: Alám uwebíén Aminadáb, Aminadáb uwebíén Nasɔ́n, Nasɔ́n uwebíén Salomɔ́ŋ.
normalised_text: alam uwebien aminadab, aminadab uwebien nason, nason uwebien salomong.

name: Elip

normalised_text: salomong uwebien bos, noodie bos umaba ohen anee lahab, bos uwebien yobed, noodie yobed umaba ohen anee lut. yobed uwebien yese.

name: Elip
text: Yesé uwebíén ofuŋ Dáfide. Dáfide uwebíén Salomɔ́ŋ na ugányɛ Ulí.
normalised_text: yese uwebien ofung dafide. dafide uwebien salomong na uganye uli.

name: Elip

normalised_text: salomong uwebien loboam, loboam uwebien abia, abia uwebien asa.

name: Elip

normalised_text: eliud uwebien eleasal, eleasal uwebien matan, matan uwebien yokoba.

name: Elip
text: Yɔ́kɔba uwebíén Yɔ́sɛba ɔnɛ́m Malía, Malía úmeébíén Yésuse uyɔɔ́ bɔ́dɔ́ŋɔnaá áneé Bémeyíde.

name: Elip
text: Gisɔg giég Yɔ́sɛba, hana úmabá súsɔ́n mɔndɔ wa gindényé, umasúguamba gubal ugányɛ agá eŋís ya bandɔ, uwabídágɛ́d pɛ́ŋ áneé wen yɔ́ uguá ninamba.
normalised_text: gisog gieg yoseba, hana umaba suson mondo wa gindenye, umasuguamba gubal uganye aga engis ya bando, uwabidaged peng anee wen yo ugua ninamba.

name: Elip
text: Gúu ugébíénenu muɔ́n ɔnúmɔndɔ uyɔɔ́ ágaluganɔ́ áneé Yésuse, gá giagiá, úgaháŋánɔ́ buán buég gɔ́b gá bifal.».
normalised_text: guu ugebienenu muon onumondo uyoo agalugano anee yesuse, ga giagia, ugahangano buan bueg gob ga bifal.".

name: Elip
text: Ubugányɛ gidigid búmabíalá gá gueleé nugálɔ nuá Ɔgúná unuɔ́ úmɔyɛ́d uguá niíd niá ebunebúné núbíhónye.
normalised_text: ubuganye gidigid bumabiala ga guelee nugalo nua oguna unuo umoyed ugua niid nia ebunebune nubihonye.

name: Elip
text: Yɔ́sɛba umaámáhunyɛg, uwal hana gilúna giá Ɔgúná gímɔyídɛ́n yɔ́, uwɔgɔ́l ugányɛ.
normalised_text: yoseba umaamahunyeg, uwal hana giluna gia oguna gimoyiden yo, uwogol uganye.

name: Elip
text: Gɔgaá, umasábídígɛn yɔ́ gueneg hana úmebíén muɔ́n, uwalɔg yɔ́ áneé Yésuse.
normalised_text: gogaa, umasabidigen yo gueneg hana umebien muon, uwalog yo anee yesuse.

name: Elip
text: Ofuŋ uhugɔ́n Helód, húmɔɔ́mɔ́b anagányɛ, manɔ́ŋ még amásúmbɛ́ɛg naá má bandɔ bá Yelusalɛ́m gidigid.

normalised_text: helod uwodongeen gog mbuisi ga isogi ga lens besee na besee gineng igie bamaan yoododi hihaman.

name: Elip
text: Símaámáan yoódódi gudélímin, isíébísenidinye na mefunde.
normalised_text: simaamaan yoododi gudelimin, isiebisenidinye na mefunde.

name: Elip
text: Egélém agányɛ, Uhaluá úmodógínyé siɛ́ uguá ilɛm áneé sídiondín agá Helód, isíɔ́gɔ́l ŋŋil idoódi gá gúg.

name: Elip
text: Yɔ́sɛba uwadigɛn gɔg na budúg, uwɔgɔ́l na muɔ́n na noódíe gá guɛ́d uguá gidɔŋ giá Egíbt.

normalised_text: ofung uhugon helod, humeemegue, giluna gia oguna igiebieniginye yoseba ugua ilem ugua gidong gia egibt.

text: Yɔ́sɛba uwadigɛn, uwɔgɔ́l na muúŋayɔ na noódíe gá guond uguá gibéyi giá guísi giá Íslayɛ́l.

name: Embu
text: Nake Ngai nîwaugire atîrî, Nî kûgîe ûtheri; nakuo nîkwagîre na ûtheri.
normalised_text: nake ngai newaughire atere, ne koghie odheri; nakuo nekwaghere na odheri.

name: Embu
text: Ngai nîwonire atî ûtheri nî mwaro; na akîgaania ûtheri na nduma.
normalised_text: ngai newonire ate odheri ne mwaro; na akeghaania odheri na nduma.

name: Embu
text: Ngai nîwetire ûtheri Mûthenya nayo nduma akîmîta Ûtukû. Nakuo nîgwatukire na gûgîcoka gûgîkîa. Ûcio nîguo warî mûthenya wa mbere.
normalised_text: ngai newetire odheri modhenya nayo nduma akemeta otuko. nakuo neghwatukire na ghogheshoka ghoghekea. oshio neghuo ware modhenya wa mbere.

name: Embu
text: Ngai nîwacokire akiuga atîrî, Nî kûgîe mwanya gatagatîrî ka manjî, nîguo wamûranie manjî maita maîrî.
normalised_text: ngai newashokire akiugha atere, ne koghie mwanya ghataghatere ka manje, neghuo wamoranie manje maita maere.

name: Embu
text: Nake Ngai nîwekîrire mwanya naguo ûkîamûrania manjî marîa maarî îgûrû rîaguo na marîa maarî rungu rwaguo. Na gûgîtuîka guo.
normalised_text: nake ngai newekerire mwanya naghuo okeamorania manje marea maare eghoro reaghuo na marea maare rungu rwaghuo. na ghoghetueka ghuo.

name: Embu
text: Ngai nîwetire mwanya ûcio Îgûrû. Nakuo gûgîtuka na gûgîcoka gûgîkîa. Ûcio nîguo warî mûthenya wa kaîrî.
normalised_text: ngai newetire mwanya oshio eghoro. nakuo ghoghetuka na ghogheshoka ghoghekea. oshio neghuo ware modhenya wa kaere.

name: Embu
text: Nake Ngai nîwaugire atîrî, Manjî marîa marî rungu rwa matu nîmacokanîrîre vamwe nîguo nthî nyûmû yumîre. Na gûgîtuîka guo.
normalised_text: nake ngai newaughire atere, manje marea mare rungu rwa matu nemashokanerere vamwe neghuo ndhe nyomo yumere. na ghoghetueka ghuo.

name: Embu
text: Ngai nîwetire nthî nyûmû Nthî namo manjî mau maacokanîrîrîte vamwe akîmeta Îria. Nake Ngai nîwonire ûndû ûcio ûrî mwaro.
normalised_text: ngai newetire ndhe nyomo ndhe namo manje mau maashokanererete vamwe akemeta eria. nake ngai newonire ondo oshio ore mwaro.

name: Embu
text: Nthî nîyarutire mîmera ya mîthemba yonthe. Nake Ngai nîwonire ûcio ûrî ûndû mwaro.

name: Embu
text: Nakuo nîgwatukire na gûgîcoka gûgîkîa. Ûcio nîguo warî mûthenya wa kathatû.
normalised_text: nakuo neghwatukire na ghogheshoka ghoghekea. oshio neghuo ware modhenya wa kadhato.

name: Embu
text: Ngai nîwacokire akiuga atîrî, Nîkûgîe motheri matuurî îgûrû ma kwamûranagia mûthenya na ûtukû na monanagie mavinda, mîthenya, na mîaka.
normalised_text: ngai newashokire akiugha atere, nekoghie modheri matuure eghoro ma kwamoranaghia modhenya na otuko na monanaghie mavinda, medhenya, na meaka.

name: Embu

name: Embu
text: Kwoguo Ngai nîwathondekire motheri maîrî manene. Riûa rîathage mûthenya na mweri wathage ûtukû. Nîwacokire akîthondeka njata.
normalised_text: kwoghuo ngai newadhondekire modheri maere manene. rioa readhaghe modhenya na mweri wadhaghe otuko. newashokire akedhondeka njata.

name: Embu
text: Ngai nîwaigire motheri mau kûu îgûrû nîguo matûmage nthî kûgîe na ûtheri.

name: Embu

normalised_text: madhaghe modhenya na otuko na mamoranie odheri na nduma. nake ngai newonire ate ondo oshio ware mwaro.

name: Embu
text: Nakuo nîgwatukire na gûgîkîa. Ûcio nîguo warî mûthenya wa kana.
normalised_text: nakuo neghwatukire na ghoghekea. oshio neghuo ware modhenya wa kana.

name: Embu
text: Nake Ngai nîwaugire atîrî, Manjîrî nî gwîcûre ciûmbe irîa irî mwoyo cia mîthemba mîîngî, nakuo rîerarî gwîcûre iconi.
normalised_text: nake ngai newaughire atere, manjere ne ghweshore shiombe irea ire mwoyo shia medhemba meenge, nakuo rierare ghweshore ishoni.

name: Embu
text: Ngai nîwarathimire ciûmbe icio na agîciîra atîrî, Ciaranani na mwîngîve na mwîcûre îriarî, nacio iconi ciîngîve gûkû nthî.
normalised_text: ngai newaradhimire shiombe ishio na agheshiera atere, shiaranani na mwengeve na mweshore eriare, nashio ishoni shiengeve ghoko ndhe.

name: Embu
text: Nakuo nîgwatukire na gûgîcoka gûgîkîa. Ûcio nîguo warî mûthenya wa gatano.
normalised_text: nakuo neghwatukire na ghogheshoka ghoghekea. oshio neghuo ware modhenya wa ghatano.

name: Embu
text: Kwoguo Ngai nîwaûmbire indo icio cionthe na agîkenua nî ûguo.
normalised_text: kwoghuo ngai newaombire indo ishio shiondhe na aghekenua ne oghuo.

name: Embu
text: Kwoguo Ngai nîwaûmbire andû mavana take. Aamaûmbire marî mûndû mûrûme na mûndû mûka.
normalised_text: kwoghuo ngai newaombire ando mavana take. aamaombire mare mondo morome na mondo moka.

name: Embu
text: Ngai nîwamarathimire na akîmera atîrî, Ciaranani mwîcûre nthî nthî yonthe na mûmîtoorie; mwathage nthamaki, iconi na nyamû cionthe.
normalised_text: ngai newamaradhimire na akemera atere, shiaranani mweshore ndhe ndhe yondhe na mometoorie; mwadhaghe ndhamaki, ishoni na nyamo shiondhe.

name: Embu
text: Nînamûva mîtî ya mîthemba yonthe îrîa îciaraga mvîndî, na matunda ma mîthemba yonthe irî irio cienyu cia kûrîa.

name: Embu
text: Nwatî nînava nyamû cionthe cia kîthaka, na iconi cionthe nyaki na mîtî îrîa îrî mathangû irîcage. Na gûgîtuîka guo.
normalised_text: nwate nenava nyamo shiondhe shia kedhaka, na ishoni shiondhe nyaki na mete erea ere madhango ireshaghe. na ghoghetueka ghuo.

name: Embu
text: Ngai nîwaroririe indo cionthe irîa aaûmbire na akîona irî mbaro. Nakuo nîgwatukire na gûgîcoka gûgîkîa. Ûcio nîguo warî mûthenya wa gatandatû.
normalised_text: ngai newaroririe indo shiondhe irea aaombire na akeona ire mbaro. nakuo neghwatukire na ghogheshoka ghoghekea. oshio neghuo ware modhenya wa ghatandato.

name: Embu
text: Ngai nîwarîkirie kûmba nthî na indo cionthe irîa irî kuo.
normalised_text: ngai newarekirie komba ndhe na indo shiondhe irea ire kuo.

name: Embu
text: Naguo mûthenya wa mûgwanja Ngai aarî mûrîkiu wîra ûrîa aarutaga, na akînogoka.

name: Embu
text: Ngai nîwarathimire mûthenya ûcio wa mûgwanja na akîwamûra, nîûndû mûthenya ûcio nîguo aanogokire arîkia wîra wake wa ûmbi.
normalised_text: ngai newaradhimire modhenya oshio wa moghwanja na akewamora, neondo modhenya oshio neghuo aanoghokire arekia wera wake wa ombi.

name: Embu
text: Ûguo nîguo îgûrû na nthî ciaûmbirwe. Vîndî îrîa Ngai-Mûnene, Ngai aûmbire nthî na îgûrû.

name: Embu
text: gûtiarî mûmera na gûtiarî mvîndî ciamerete nthî nîûndû Ngai-Mûnene, Ngai ndaarî murithiu mbura, na gûtiarî mûndû wa kûrîma.
normalised_text: ghotiare momera na ghotiare mvende shiamerete ndhe neondo ngaimonene, ngai ndaare muridhiu mbura, na ghotiare mondo wa korema.

name: Esimbi
text: Ɛni amu ɛli yi utuŋgu wɛ Jisɔs Wutuanə, wunu wu wɔkpəmə Devitə amu wunu wu Abəraham.
normalised_text: yni amu yli yi utungu wy jisos wutuane, wunu wu wokpeme devite amu wunu wu aberaham.

name: Esimbi
text: Abəraham ubi Azikə, Azikə ubi Jɔkɔbhə, Jɔkɔbhə ubi Juda nə wunuiŋgbi ibi mosoŋgulu.
normalised_text: aberaham ubi azike, azike ubi jokove, jokove ubi juda ne wunuingbi ibi mosongulu.

name: Esimbi
text: Juda nə vi ivi Tamə mobi Perezə nə Zera, Perezə ubi Hezrɔn, Hezrɔn ubi Ramə.
normalised_text: juda ne vi ivi tame mobi pereze ne zera, pereze ubi hezron, hezron ubi rame.

text: Sulemano è mbwa Rehobowam. Rehobowam è mbwa Abija, Abija è mbwa Asa.
normalised_text: sulemano e mbwa rehobowam. rehobowam e mbwa abija, abija e mbwa asa.

name: Etkywan
text: Asa è mbwa Jehoshafati, Jehoshafati è mbwa Yoram, Yoram è mbwa Uziya.
normalised_text: asa e mbwa jehoshafati, jehoshafati e mbwa yoram, yoram e mbwa uziya.

name: Etkywan
text: Uziya è mbwa Jotan, Jotan è mbwa Ahaza, Ahaza è mbwa Hezekaya.
normalised_text: uziya e mbwa jotan, jotan e mbwa ahaza, ahaza e mbwa hezekaya.

name: Etkywan
text: Ekǝnggwa, Josiya è mbwa Jekoniya ngge be nwenjwa ye adi ekpengga a bè fu be ya a Yahuda fí ken no a tswa sǝnsen mo Babila ángá.

name: Etkywan
text: Zerubabe è mbwa Abiyudu, Abiyudu è mbwa Eliyakim, Eliyakim è mbwa Azo.
normalised_text: zerubabe e mbwa abiyudu, abiyudu e mbwa eliyakim, eliyakim e mbwa azo.

name: Etkywan

normalised_text: azo e mbwa zadoku, zadoku e mbwa akimu, akimu e mbwa eliyudu.

name: Etkywan
text: Eliyudu è mbwa Eliyaza, Eliyaza è mbwa Matan, Matan è mbwa Yakubu.

name: Etkywan
text: Yakubu è mbwa Esufu nwene è no don Meri ayi Yeso a be fǝ́ anga Kristi ángá.
normalised_text: yakubu e mbwa esufu nwene e no don meri ayi yeso a be fe anga kristi anga.

name: Etkywan
text: Ga mbwa nwen ndedon, wa tso ye ti Yeso, adia ge ti a vǝ́ be ya mbwe ye a tswa be ebgen mo be.

name: Etkywan
text: Binbin mo be mò ena è bwe ken tén abu Ehwya Etsodwe è jan chá kpevǝ mo efojan mbwe ekpe ekpe ángá.
normalised_text: binbin mo be mo ena e bwe ken ten abu ehwya etsodwe e jan cha kpeve mo efojan mbwe ekpe ekpe anga.

name: Etkywan
text: Gè jan, Di, enwen-endà akan a no dgyèn na mbwa nwen ndedon, ba fǝ́ ye Emanowe.

name: Etkywan
text: Atan a Esufu è zǝbwa adi dan ángá, gè ti ekpengga nwofyan, nè ti Meri bwa a mbwe ye abu gwa ye, abu maleka mo Etsodwe è jan ye ángá.
normalised_text: atan a esufu e zebwa adi dan anga, ge ti ekpengga nwofyan, ne ti meri bwa a mbwe ye abu gwa ye, abu maleka mo etsodwe e jan ye anga.

name: Etkywan
text: Tea Esufu è chà dwa ye ngge ge ra, kpwà tén atan a Meri è mbwa ara nwen ye ndedon hon ángá. Ekǝnggwa, Esufu è tso nwen hon ti, Yeso.
normalised_text: tea esufu e cha dwa ye ngge ge ra, kpwa ten atan a meri e mbwa ara nwen ye ndedon hon anga. ekenggwa, esufu e tso nwen hon ti, yeso.

name: Etkywan
text: Atan a Tì Hiridu è fo fwa ena ángá, tsuruku mbwe è bgen àywá tangge binbin mo be ya a Urishelima.

name: Etkywan
text: Gè fǝ́ fǝn gú be Ekǝ́n echa ngge be etumo mo edon, nè ká be eka jan ne, zǝn a ge no ebam adi Afketa mo edon jan ba mbwa Kristi ángá, no a che?.
normalised_text: ge fe fen gu be eken echa ngge be etumo mo edon, ne ka be eka jan ne, zen a ge no ebam adi afketa mo edon jan ba mbwa kristi anga, no a che?.

name: Etkywan
text: Bè janfwe ye, A Betalami, a sǝnsen mo Yahudiya, adia ena a mò a efojan hon è bá ángá.

name: Etkywan
text: Atan a bè di ngǝkpe hon ángá, tsuruku mo be è tén ten àywá.

name: Etkywan
text: Adia Ehwya è twa ara be echa adi dá jan ne be e twabǝ e ken be a zǝn Hiridu efwe ra ángá, bè kpo efǝ efki, nè twabǝ ken chá eyasǝnsen mo be.
normalised_text: adia ehwya e twa ara be echa adi da jan ne be e twabe e ken be a zen hiridu efwe ra anga, be kpo efe efki, ne twabe ken cha eyasensen mo be.

name: Etkywan
text: No enona, Esufu è nyi tén etkyen etsǝ hon, nè ti nwen hon ngge ayi ye, bè gwa zǝn hon, ken a sǝnsen mo Masa.

name: Etkywan
text: Mò hon ena è bwe enò evǝa ge e tú ebwedefǝm mo mò a Eremiya, efojan mo Ehwya è jan.
