name: Etkywan
text: Bè fo aken a Rama, dwafǝ ekǝnm ngge dwavǝ ezam àywá, Rahila kǝndwafǝ mo mbǝgya mbwe anga, n se be e bwe e bon ye ekǝ̀n adia mbǝgya mbwe è fǝ ara ángá.
normalised_text: be fo aken a rama, dwafe ekenm ngge dwave ezam aywa, rahila kendwafe mo mbegya mbwe anga, n se be e bwe e bon ye eken adia mbegya mbwe e fe ara anga.

name: Etkywan
text: Atan a Tì Hiridu è fǝ ara ángá, maleka mo Etsodwe è mbwibwa a zǝn Esufu adi dá a sǝnsen mo Masa.

name: Etulo
text: Odzɛ etɔ mgbi iYesu iKrestu Ongwɛ iDevedi, ongwɛ Abrahan.

name: Etulo
text: Abrahan li otsɔ Adziki, Adziki li otsɔ iJeko, iJeko li otsɔ iJuda bɛyi emi ongwunɔn.
normalised_text: abrahan li otso adziki, adziki li otso ijeko, ijeko li otso ijuda beyi emi ongwunon.

name: Etulo
text: iJuda li otsɔ iPeredzi bɛyi iDzera, onɔ ma li iTama, iPeredzi li otsɔ iHezrɔn, iHerizɔn li otsɔ iRama.
normalised_text: ijuda li otso iperedzi beyi idzera, ono ma li itama, iperedzi li otso ihezron, iherizon li otso irama.

name: Etulo
text: iRama li otsɔ Aminada, Aminada li otsɔ iNashɔn; iNashɔn li otsɔ iSamon.
normalised_text: irama li otso aminada, aminada li otso inashon; inashon li otso isamon.

name: Etulo
text: iSamon li otsɔ iBoadzi, ongwu onɔn li iRaha, iBoadzi li otsɔ Obɛdi, ongwu onɔn li iRutu, Obɛdi li otsɔ iJese;.
normalised_text: isamon li otso iboadzi, ongwu onon li iraha, iboadzi li otso obedi, ongwu onon li irutu, obedi li otso ijese;.

name: Etulo
text: iJese li otsɔ Utɔ iDevedi; iDevedi li otsɔ iSolomu ongwu onɔn li owa Uria.
normalised_text: ijese li otso uto idevedi; idevedi li otso isolomu ongwu onon li owa uria.

name: Etulo
text: iSolomu li otsɔ iRehobuan, iRehobuan li otsɔ Abyija, Abyija li otsɔ Asa.
normalised_text: isolomu li otso irehobuan, irehobuan li otso abyija, abyija li otso asa.

name: Etulo
text: Asa li otsɔ iJehoshafa, iJehoshafa li otsɔ iJoran, iJoran li otsɔ Udzia;.
normalised_text: asa li otso ijehoshafa, ijehoshafa li otso ijoran, ijoran li otso udzia;.

name: Etulo
text: Udzia li otsɔ iJotan, iJotan li otsɔ Ahadzi, Ahadzi li otsɔ iHedzekia;.
normalised_text: udzia li otso ijotan, ijotan li otso ahadzi, ahadzi li otso ihedzekia;.

name: Etulo
text: iHedzekia li otsɔ iManase, iManase li otsɔ Amɔn, Amɔn li otsɔ iJosia.
normalised_text: ihedzekia li otso imanase, imanase li otso amon, amon li otso ijosia.

name: Etulo
text: iJosia li otsɔ iJekonia bɛyi emi ongwunɔn. Taman a kwu ma ofyɛɛ lu ɛsɛ iBabyilon.
normalised_text: ijosia li otso ijekonia beyi emi ongwunon. taman a kwu ma ofyee lu ese ibabyilon.

name: Etulo
text: Ngwi egbe mgbi ama mi iBabyilon wa ngyɛ nɛ; iJekonia mba iShetiɛ, iShetiɛ mba iDzerubabɛ.
normalised_text: ngwi egbe mgbi ama mi ibabyilon wa ngye ne; ijekonia mba ishetie, ishetie mba idzerubabe.

name: Etulo
text: iDzerubabɛ mba Abyidu, Abyidu mba Eliakin, Eliakin mba Azɔ;.

name: Etulo
text: Azɔ na di mba iDzadɔku, iDzadɔku mba Akin, Akin mba Elidu.

name: Etulo
text: Elidu mba Eliadza, Eliadza mba iMatan, iMatan mba iJeko;.
normalised_text: elidu mba eliadza, eliadza mba imatan, imatan mba ijeko;.

name: Etulo
text: iJeko mba iJose oba iMeri; li iMeri ongwu nmba iYesu ongwu a li kwun di iKrestu nani.
normalised_text: ijeko mba ijose oba imeri; li imeri ongwu nmba iyesu ongwu a li kwun di ikrestu nani.

name: Etulo
text: Nghaduu iJose oban li inggisɛ osuse, i minan onun ayiwi mi ododa ba nɛ, o kye weka gbɛɛ ongwu ka gha yan fyɛɛ.
normalised_text: nghaduu ijose oban li inggise osuse, i minan onun ayiwi mi ododa ba ne, o kye weka gbee ongwu ka gha yan fyee.

name: Etulo
text: O ka wa mba ongwongyulɔ, ta abu ka kwun iyi gbɛɛ iYesu, lubana o ka dulu emidan tɔ mi ali ibwubwe mgbi ama.>>.
normalised_text: o ka wa mba ongwongyulo, ta abu ka kwun iyi gbee iyesu, lubana o ka dulu emidan to mi ali ibwubwe mgbi ama..

name: Etulo
text: Ungwɔ ntonɛ duu kyɔ ikye ombwo ondu odzɛɛdzɛ mgbi Otsɛ ongwi o gbɔ nyɛ mbi oyegbɔ gbɛɛ.
normalised_text: ungwo ntone duu kyo ikye ombwo ondu odzeedze mgbi otse ongwi o gbo nye mbi oyegbo gbee.

name: Etulo
text: <<Ongwongyaa ibidrua ka wa byifu mba ongwongyulɔ, a ka kwun iyi di Imanue,>> itan gbɛɛ, <<Imgbasho dzɛ yi eyi nani.>>.
normalised_text: ongwongyaa ibidrua ka wa byifu mba ongwongyulo, a ka kwun iyi di imanue, itan gbee, imgbasho dze yi eyi nani..

name: Etulo
text: Ngwi iJose kyɛ una nɛta, o kyɔ dafi ongyesɔ mgbi Otsɛ nyan mani, o kyi kyelu iMeri lu udɛ mgban yɛɛ owan.
normalised_text: ngwi ijose kye una neta, o kyo dafi ongyeso mgbi otse nyan mani, o kyi kyelu imeri lu ude mgban yee owan.

name: Etulo
text: Kpaa o gbewo yan ba nghataa iMeri wa mba ongwongyulɔ, o si kwun iyi gbɛɛ iYesu.
normalised_text: kpaa o gbewo yan ba nghataa imeri wa mba ongwongyulo, o si kwun iyi gbee iyesu.

name: Etulo
text: Ngwi a mba iYesu mi iBɛtlɛhɛn mi iJudia duu nɛta, iHerude li utɔ mi onɔ nani, inggisɛ ama oyodzɛ mi onosa wa kaka iJerosalin.

normalised_text: le byita gbee, ongwe ongwu a mba nli uto mgbi emi ijuda ne, a kyon ladze ole? lubana eyi di mche mgban mi onosa, ngwi eyi ba owa sunun aani..

name: Etulo
text: Ngwi utɔ iHerude fwo odzɛ nɛ ngha nɛ, i kakan ewo bɛyi emi iJerosalin duu.

name: Etulo
text: O kwu engyukwo ama ofifɛ mgbi Imgbasho bɛyi ama otso ola duu kwakye, o byi ma gbɛɛ li mi ole ngwi a ka mba iMedzaya ma?.
normalised_text: o kwu engyukwo ama ofife mgbi imgbasho beyi ama otso ola duu kwakye, o byi ma gbee li mi ole ngwi a ka mba imedzaya ma?.

name: Etulo

name: Etulo
text: Ta iHerude kwu ama oyodzɛ ntona ela daada di byi ma ita klɛklɛ ni ongwu ye onɔ ngwi mcɛ na tsetu ma mani.

name: Etulo
text: O si nu ma ofɛ lu iBɛtlɛhɛn di nya ma gbɛɛ, <<Lu ka pitan saan na. Ni ema ka din taman yɛ wa nya ani, adzi ni ani kpaa ka su nun.>>.

name: Ezaa
text: Lẹ mbụlembu nteke Chileke meru igwe mee mgboko.

name: Ezaa

name: Ezaa

text: O noo ya, Chileke bya agọru ọnu-ọma nụ iwhe ono g'ọ ha sụ: Unu zụ̀a azụ̀zù ha l'igwe. Unu zụ-jia mini eze-ẹnyimu; ẹnu azụ-jia mgboko.

name: Ezaa
text: Chileke bya emee anụ-ẹgbudu l'ụdu iya l'ụdu iya; mee élwù l'ụdu iya l'ụdu iya; mee anụ, l'awụ l'ẹwho l'ụdu iya l'ụdu iya. Chileke bya awhụ l'ọ dụ ree.

name: Ezaa
text: Ọo ya bụ, Chileke mee madzụ, o shia ya. Ọ bụru gẹ Chileke dụ bụ g'o meru iya. Ọ bụru nwoke yẹle nwanyị b'o meru whẹ bụru.

text: Ọ waa g'e gude mee igwe yẹle mgboko nteke e meru whẹ. Nteke Onye-Nwe-Ọha, bụ Chileke meru mgboko yẹle igwe bẹ.

name: Ezaa

normalised_text: ahun no ton sin ko glo bo no ja do ayikungban o bi ji.

name: Fon
text: Mawu Mavɔmavɔ kán kɔ́ dó mɛ gbɛtɔ́, bó fún funfún e nɔ ná gbɛ mɛ ɔ́ dó awɔntín tɔn mɛ, bɔ gbɛtɔ́ ɔ́ húzú mɛ gbɛɖe.
normalised_text: mawu mavomavo kan ko do me gbeto, bo fun funfun e no na gbe me o do awontin ton me, bo gbeto o huzu me gbede.

name: Fon
text: Mawu Mavɔmavɔ ɖó jikpá ɖokpó ɖó Edɛ́ni, ɖo zǎnzǎnhwe jí wa jí, bó zé gbɛtɔ́ e è mɛ ɔ́ d'é mɛ.
normalised_text: mawu mavomavo do jikpa dokpo do edeni, do zanzanhwe ji wa ji, bo ze gbeto e e me o de me.

name: Fon
text: Tɔ ɖé jɔ ɖo Edɛ́ni, bó nɔ sa wá hú sin nú jikpá ɔ́, bó zɛ ala ɛnɛ sín fínɛ́.
normalised_text: to de jo do edeni, bo no sa wa hu sin nu jikpa o, bo ze ala ene sin fine.

name: Fon
text: Ala nukɔntɔn ɔ́ nɔ́ nyí Picɔ́ni. É nɔ́ sa lɛ́ lɛ̌ dó Hawíla. È nɔ mɔ siká ɖo Hawíla to ɔ́ mɛ.
normalised_text: ala nukonton o no nyi pichoni. e no sa le le do hawila. e no mo sika do hawila to o me.

name: Fon
text: Ala wegɔ́ ɔ́ nɔ́ nyí Gixɔ́ni; éyɛ́ wɛ nɔ́ sa lɛ́ lɛ̌ dó Kúci sín to ɔ́ bǐ.
normalised_text: ala wego o no nyi gikhoni; eye we no sa le le do kuchi sin to o bi.

name: Fon
text: Ala atɔngɔ́ ɔ́ nɔ́ nyí Tígli; éyɛ́ nɔ́ sa yi Asilíi sín zǎnzǎnhwe jí; ala ɛnɛgɔ́ ɔ́ nɔ nyí Efláti.
normalised_text: ala atongo o no nyi tigli; eye no sa yi asilii sin zanzanhwe ji; ala enego o no nyi eflati.

name: Fon
text: Mawu Mavɔmavɔ sɔ́ gbɛtɔ́ ɔ́ ɖó jikpá Edɛ́ni tɔn ɔ́ mɛ, bónú é ná nɔ́ lɛ, bó ná nɔ́ kpé nukún d'é wú.
normalised_text: mawu mavomavo so gbeto o do jikpa edeni ton o me, bonu e na no le, bo na no kpe nukun de wu.

name: Fon
text: Mawu Mavɔmavɔ ɖɔ nú gbɛtɔ́ ɔ́ ɖɔ: A sixú ɖu atín e ɖo jikpá ɔ́ mɛ ɔ́ bǐ sín sínsɛ́n.
normalised_text: mawu mavomavo do nu gbeto o do a sikhu du atin e do jikpa o me o bi sin sinsen.

name: Frafra
text: Azezi n de Adavidi yɩɩŋa, la Abraham yɩɩŋa yaabdõma n wãna:.
normalised_text: aziezei n die adaveidei yiinga, la abraham yiinga yaabdoma n wanna.

name: Frafra
text: Gulehegɔ wa dela tuuhum en de Yezu Kiresta en Deviti dayua, Aberaham dayua la.
normalised_text: guliehiego wa diela tuuhum en die yiezu keiriesta en dieveitei dayua, abieraham dayua la.

name: Frafra
text: Aberaham dela Aziki sɔ, ti Aziki dɛna Yakɔbe sɔ, ti Yakɔbe dɛna Yuda la a suurɔ sɔ.
normalised_text: abieraham diela azeikei so, tei azeikei dena yakobie so, tei yakobie dena yuda la a suuro so.

name: Frafra
text: Abraham n dɔgɛ A'izakɩ, tɩ A'izakɩ dɔgɛ Azakɔbɩ, tɩ Azakɔbɩ dɔgɛ Azuda, la a kẽendõma, la a yɩbsɩ.
normalised_text: abraham n doge aeizaki, ti aeizaki doge azakobi, ti azakobi doge azuda, la a kenendoma, la a yibsi.

name: Frafra
text: Ti Yuda dɛna Pɛrezi la Zera sɔ, ti ba ma dɛna Tama. Ti Pɛrezi dɛna Hɛzirɔn sɔ, ti Hɛzirɔn dɛna Aram sɔ.
normalised_text: tei yuda dena periezei la ziera so, tei ba ma dena tama. tei periezei dena hezeiron so, tei hezeiron dena aram so.

name: Frafra
text: Tɩ Azuda la a pɔga Atamaarɩ dɔgɛ Afarɛsɩ la Azara, tɩ Afarɛsɩ dɔgɛ A'ɛsrɔm, tɩ A'ɛsrɔm dɔgɛ Aram.
normalised_text: ti azuda la a poga atamaari doge afaresi la azara, ti afaresi doge aesrom, ti aesrom doge aram.

name: Frafra
text: Ti Aram dɛna Aminadabi sɔ, ti Aminadabi dɛna Nason sɔ, ti Nason dɛna Salemon sɔ.
normalised_text: tei aram dena aminadabei so, tei aminadabei dena nasuon so, tei nasuon dena saliemuon so.

name: Frafra
text: tɩ Aram dɔgɛ Aminadabɩ, tɩ Aminadabɩ dɔgɛ Anaasõ, tɩ Anaasõ dɔgɛ Asalmõ.
normalised_text: ti aram doge aminadabi, ti aminadabi doge anaaso, ti anaaso doge asalmo.

name: Frafra
text: Ti Salemon dɛna Boazi sɔ, ti a ma dɛna Arahab. Ti Boazi dɛna Ɔbɛd sɔ, ti a ma dɛna Arutu. Ti Ɔbɛd dɛna Yesi sɔ.
normalised_text: tei saliemuon dena buoazei so, tei a ma dena arahab. tei buoazei dena obed so, tei a ma dena arutu. tei obed dena yiesei so.

name: Frafra
text: Tɩ Asalmõ la a pɔga Arahabɩ dɔgɛ Aboozɩ, tɩ Aboozɩ la a pɔga Aruti dɔgɛ A'obɛɛdɩ, tɩ A'obɛɛdɩ dɔgɛ Azese.
normalised_text: ti asalmo la a poga arahabi doge abuouozi, ti abuouozi la a poga arutei doge auobeedi, ti auobeedi doge aziesie.

name: Frafra
text: Tɩ Azese dɔgɛ naba Adavidi. Tɩ Adavidi daan di A'uuri pɔkõorɛ, tɩ ba dɔgɛ Asalomõ.
normalised_text: ti aziesie doge naba adaveidei. ti adaveidei daan dei auurei pokouore, ti ba doge asaluomo.

name: Frafra
text: ti Yesi dɛna Naba Deviti sɔ. Ti Deviti dɛna Solomɔn sɔ, ti a ma dɛna Yuriya pɔga la.
normalised_text: tei yiesei dena naba dieveitei so. tei dieveitei dena suoluomon so, tei a ma dena yureiya poga la.

name: Frafra
text: Ti Solomɔn dɛna Yerobuam sɔ, ti Yerobuam dɛna Abiya sɔ, ti Abiya dɛna Asaf sɔ.
normalised_text: tei suoluomon dena yieruobuam so, tei yieruobuam dena abeiya so, tei abeiya dena asaf so.

name: Frafra
text: Tɩ Asalomõ dɔgɛ Aroboam, tɩ Aroboam dɔgɛ Abiya, tɩ Abiya dɔgɛ Aza.
normalised_text: ti asaluomo doge aruobuoam, ti aruobuoam doge abeiya, ti abeiya doge aza.

name: Frafra
text: Ti Asaf dɛna Yehosafate sɔ, ti Yehosafate dɛna Yoram sɔ, ti Yoram dɛna Yuziya sɔ.
normalised_text: tei asaf dena yiehuosafatie so, tei yiehuosafatie dena yuoram so, tei yuoram dena yuzeiya so.

name: Frafra
text: Tɩ Aza dɔgɛ Azozafatɩ, tɩ Azozafatɩ dɔgɛ Azoram, tɩ Azoram dɔgɛ A'oziasɩ.
normalised_text: ti aza doge azuozafati, ti azuozafati doge azuoram, ti azuoram doge auozeiasi.

name: Frafra
text: Ti Yuziya sɔ dɛna Yotan, ti Yotan sɔ dɛna Ahazi, ti Ahazi sɔ dɛna Hɛzekaya.
normalised_text: tei yuzeiya so dena yuotan, tei yuotan so dena ahazei, tei ahazei so dena heziekaya.

name: Frafra
text: Tɩ A'oziasɩ dɔgɛ Azɔtam, tɩ Azɔtam dɔgɛ Akaazɩ, tɩ Akaazɩ dɔgɛ A'ezekiasɩ.
normalised_text: ti auozeiasi doge azotam, ti azotam doge akaazi, ti akaazi doge aieziekeiasi.

name: Frafra
text: Ti Hɛzekaya sɔ dɛna Manaasɛ, ti Manaasɛ sɔ dɛna Amɔsi, ti Amɔsi dɛna Yoseya.
normalised_text: tei heziekaya so dena manaase, tei manaase so dena amosei, tei amosei dena yuosieya.

name: Frafra
text: Tɩ A'ezekiasɩ dɔgɛ Amanase, tɩ Amanase dɔgɛ Amõ, tɩ Amõ dɔgɛ Azoziasɩ.
normalised_text: ti aieziekeiasi doge amanasie, ti amanasie doge amo, ti amo doge azuozeiasi.

name: Frafra
text: Ti Yoseya sɔ dɛna Yekonaya la a suurɔ. Sankaŋa en de apɛregɛ loŋe Babilɔn la.
normalised_text: tei yuosieya so dena yiekuonaya la a suuro. sankanga en die aperiege luongie babeilon la.

name: Frafra
text: Tɩ Azoziasɩ dɔgɛ Azekoniyasɩ la a yɩbsɩ. Wakat-ẽŋa tɩ ba yõgɛ Ɩsrayɛlɩ dõma tarɩ sẽŋɛ Babilɔnɩ.
normalised_text: ti azuozeiasi doge aziekuoneiyasi la a yibsi. wakatennga ti ba yoge israyeli doma tari sennge babeiloni.

name: Frafra
text: La ban paagɛ Babilɔnɩ na poorʋm, tɩ Azekoniyasɩ dɔgɛ Asalatɩyɛlɩ, tɩ Asalatɩyɛlɩ dɔgɛ Azorobabɛlɩ.
normalised_text: la ban paage babeiloni na puouorum, ti aziekuoneiyasi doge asalatiyeli, ti asalatiyeli doge azuoruobabeli.

name: Frafra
text: Ti apɛregɛ-loŋe Babilɔn saŋa la pooren, ti Yekonia dɔgɛ a dayua Salatiɛle, ti Salatiɛle dɛna Zerubabɛle sɔ.
normalised_text: tei aperiegeluongie babeilon sanga la puouoren, tei yiekuoneia doge a dayua salateielie, tei salateielie dena zierubabelie so.

name: Frafra
text: Tɩ Azorobabɛlɩ dɔgɛ Abiyuudɩ, tɩ Abiyuudɩ dɔgɛ A'eliakim, tɩ A'eliakim dɔgɛ Azɔɔrɩ.
normalised_text: ti azuoruobabeli doge abeiyuudi, ti abeiyuudi doge aieleiakeim, ti aieleiakeim doge azoori.

name: Frafra
text: ti Zerubabɛle dɛna Abiyud sɔ, ti Abiyud dɛna Eliyakim sɔ, ti Eliyakim dɛna Azɔr sɔ.

name: Frafra
text: Tɩ Azɔɔrɩ dɔgɛ Asadɔkɩ, tɩ Asadɔkɩ dɔgɛ Akim, tɩ Akim dɔgɛ A'eliyuudɩ.
normalised_text: ti azoori doge asadoki, ti asadoki doge akeim, ti akeim doge aieleiyuudi.

name: Frafra
text: ti Azɔr dɛna Zadɔki sɔ, ti Zadɔki dɛna Akim sɔ, ti Akim dɛna Eliyud sɔ.
normalised_text: tei azor dena zadokei so, tei zadokei dena akeim so, tei akeim dena ieleiyud so.

name: Frafra
text: Tɩ A'eliyuudɩ dɔgɛ A'eleazaarɩ, tɩ A'eleazaarɩ dɔgɛ Amatã, tɩ Amatã dɔgɛ Azakɔbɩ.
normalised_text: ti aieleiyuudi doge aielieazaari, ti aielieazaari doge amatan, ti amatan doge azakobi.

name: Fulani
text: Ɗe'e ngoni inɗe maama'en Yeesu Almasiihu lenyol Dawda, Dawda lenyol Ibraahim.

name: Fulani
text: طٜعٜ نغٛنِ اِنْطٜ مَامَعٜنْ يٜىٰسُ اَلْمَسِيحُ لٜݧٛلْ دَوْدَ، دَوْدَ لٜݧٛلْ اِبْرَاهِمْ؞.

name: Fulani
text: اِبْرَاهِمْ دَݧِ اِشِيَاکُ، ندٜنْ اِشِيَاکُ دَݧِ يَاکُبُ، ندٜنْ يَاکُبُ دَݧِ يَحُودَ اٜ سَکِرَاٻٜ مَاکٛ،.

name: Fulani

normalised_text: yahuuda danyi feresa e jeera, maduujo jeera woni taamar, feresa danyi heseruuna, heseruuna danyi aram.

name: Fulani
text: يَحُودَ دَݧِ فٜرٜسَ اٜ جٜىٰرَ، مَدُوجٛ جٜىٰرَ وٛنِ تَامَرْ، فٜرٜسَ دَݧِ حٜسٜرُونَ، حٜسٜرُونَ دَݧِ اَرَمْ،.

name: Fulani
text: Aram danyi Amiinadab, Amiinadab danyi Naacon, Naacon danyi Salmon.

name: Fulani
text: اَرَمْ دَݧِ اَمِينَدَبْ، اَمِينَدَبْ دَݧِ نَاشٛنْ، نَاشٛنْ دَݧِ سَلْمٛنْ،.

name: Fulani
text: Salmon danyi Bo'aaja, maduujo Bo'aaja woni Rahab, Bo'aaja danyi Obida, maduujo Obida woni Rut, Obida danyi Jeesi.
normalised_text: salmon danyi boaaja, maduujo boaaja woni rahab, boaaja danyi obida, maduujo obida woni rut, obida danyi jeesi.

name: Fulani
text: سَلْمٛنْ دَݧِ بٛعَاجَ، مَدُوجٛ بٛعَاجَ وٛنِ رَحَبْ، بٛعَاجَ دَݧِ اٛبِدَ، مَدُوجٛ اٛبِدَ وٛنِ رُتْ، اٛبِدَ دَݧِ جٜىٰسِ،.

name: Fulani
text: Jeesi danyi Dawda Laamiiɗo, Dawda Laamiiɗo danyi Suleymaanu, maduujo Suleymaanu woni debbo Uriya ndenno.

text: جٜىٰسِ دَݧِ دَوْدَ لَامِيطٛ، دَوْدَ لَامِيطٛ دَݧِ سُلٜيْمَانُ، مَدُوجٛ سُلٜيْمَانُ وٛنِ دٜبّٛ اُرِيَ ندٜنّٛ،.

name: Fulani
text: سُلٜيْمَانُ دَݧِ رٜحٛبٛوَمْ، رٜحٛبٛوَمْ دَݧِ اَبِجَ، اَبِجَ دَݧِ اَاسَ،.

name: Fulani
text: Aasa danyi Jehoocafat, Jehoocafat danyi Jooram, Jooram danyi Ajaariya.
normalised_text: aasa danyi jehoochafat, jehoochafat danyi jooram, jooram danyi ajaariya.

name: Fulani
text: اَاسَ دَݧِ جٜحٛوشَفَتْ، جٜحٛوشَفَتْ دَݧِ جٛورَمْ، جٛورَمْ دَݧِ اَجَارِيَ،.

text: Ajaariya danyi Jootama, Jootama danyi Ahas, Ahas danyi Hejekaaya.
normalised_text: ajaariya danyi jootama, jootama danyi ahas, ahas danyi hejekaaya.

name: Fulani
text: اَجَارِيَ دَݧِ جٛوتَمَ، جٛوتَمَ دَݧِ اَحَسْ، اَحَسْ دَݧِ حٜجٜکَايَ،.

text: Hejekaaya danyi Manaase, Manaase danyi Amon, Amon danyi Joosaya.
normalised_text: hejekaaya danyi manaase, manaase danyi amon, amon danyi joosaya.

name: Fulani
text: حٜجٜکَايَ دَݧِ مَنَاسٜ، مَنَاسٜ دَݧِ اَمٛنْ، اَمٛنْ دَݧِ جٛوسَيَ،.

text: Joosaya danyi Jekooniya e sakiraaɓe maako worɓe, carel ko Yahuudanko'en nangaa njaaraa leydi Baabiila.
normalised_text: joosaya danyi jekooniya e sakiraabe maako worbe, charel ko yahuudankoen nangaa njaaraa leydi baabiila.

name: Fulani
text: جٛوسَيَ دَݧِ جٜکٛونِيَ اٜ سَکِرَاٻٜ مَاکٛ وٛرْٻٜ، شَرٜلْ کٛ يَحُودَنْکٛعٜنْ نَنْغَا نجَارَا لٜيْدِ بَابِيلَ؞.

text: Gaɗa ɗum yaariiɓe leydi Baabiila, Jekooniya danyi Ceyaltiyal, Ceyaltiyal danyi Jaruubabel.
normalised_text: gada dum yaariibe leydi baabiila, jekooniya danyi cheyaltiyal, cheyaltiyal danyi jaruubabel.

text: غَطَ طُمْ يَارِيٻٜ لٜيْدِ بَابِيلَ، جٜکٛونِيَ دَݧِ شٜيَلْتِيَلْ، شٜيَلْتِيَلْ دَݧِ جَرُوبَبٜلْ،.

text: Jaruubabel danyi Abiihudu, Abiihudu danyi Eliyaakim, Eliyaakim danyi Aajoro.
normalised_text: jaruubabel danyi abiihudu, abiihudu danyi eliyaakim, eliyaakim danyi aajoro.

name: Fulani
text: جَرُوبَبٜلْ دَݧِ اَبِيحُدُ، اَبِيحُدُ دَݧِ اٜلِيَاکِمْ، اٜلِيَاکِمْ دَݧِ اَاجٛرٛ،.

text: Aajoro danyi Jaadok, Jaadok danyi Aakim, Aakim danyi Aliiyudu.
normalised_text: aajoro danyi jaadok, jaadok danyi aakim, aakim danyi aliiyudu.

name: Fulani
text: اَاجٛرٛ دَݧِ جَادٛکْ، جَادٛکْ دَݧِ اَاکِمْ، اَاکِمْ دَݧِ اَلِييُدُ،.

text: Aliiyudu danyi Eleyaajar, Eleyaajar danyi Mataana, Mataana danyi Yaakubu.

name: Geji
text: Ga̱n ka̱ɗe taka̱rda gwe na̱ma mbokti ang ten mbala̱n jwe Yesu Almasihu yen ga̱ Dauda, yen ga̱ Iba̱rahim yil tet tumalsi wu.

name: Geji
text: Iba̱rahim ka̱ɗe aba ga̱ Ishaku, Ishaku ka̱ zi Yakubu, Yek Yakubu zi Yehuda suk yilkeni jwasi.

name: Geji
text: Yehuda ka̱ɗe aba ga̱ Peres suk Zera, ana gwasa̱n ka̱ɗe Tamar. Peres ka̱ zi Heza̱ron, Yek Heza̱ron zi Aram.

text: Aram ka̱ zi Aminadab, Aminadab ka̱ zi Nashon, Yek Nashon zi Salmon.

name: Geji
text: Salmon ka̱ zi Bo'az ma̱lgwe ana gwas ka̱ɗe Rahab wu. Bo'az ka̱ zi Obida ma̱lgwe ana gwas ka̱ɗe Rut wu. Yek Obida zi Yese.

name: Geji

name: Geji
text: Yek Sulemanu guu zi Rehobowam. Yek Rehobowam zi Abija, Abija ka̱ zi Asa.

name: Geji
text: Yek Yuziya zi Jotam, Jotam ka̱ zi Ahaz, Ahaz ka̱ zi Hezekiya.

name: Godié
text: Zozɛfʋ ‑ghlä lä 'ylaa 'nɩ ɔ ‑glɔɔ lä nä, sä ‑Laagɔzuzuu ‑sonöɔ bhlä nä, sɔɔ ɔ nää‑ yɩ. Kɔ bhlüü‑ yɩ Malii 'kʋ 'nɩ ɔ ŋʋɔ‑ gbëë'.

name: Godié
text: ‑Mä 'loyo Elodö nuu‑ lä wälɩɩ nä, kä plɛ ‑bhɔɔ 'mnö. 'Nɩ Zolizalɛmʋduu' nyɩkpaa ‑mä 'sɩɩ plɛ ‑bhʋwa 'mnö ɔmɔ 'bhisäkʋ.

name: Godié
text: 'Nɩ ɔ yi 'Cibhisänyʋaa' 'cifinyʋa ‑yä ‑Jlämöcɩanyʋa 'sɔ 'wlu 'wlää, 'nɩ ɔ yiwa 'ylä nynä ‑mä mä ‑sä Klisöɔ 'kä bhɛ ‑zi gänönöɔ 'naa‑?.

name: Godié
text: Wlä Zudee‑bhlɩɛɛ' 'duu‑ plöö‑ lä Bɛtlɛmʋ nä, ‑mɔɔ Klisöɔ 'kä lä gänöɔ. ‑N ni 'klüü 'plɔfɛtɩɔ ‑jɩjlä lä nä. Ɔ lä.

name: Godié
text: Ɩ ‑kä 'ŋnö 'nɩ Zozɛfʋ ‑bha 'kʋ 'nɩ, 'saboo, ɔ bhlüü‑ Malii ‑yä 'yuo 'sɔ 'kʋ 'nɩ ɔ ‑yʋwa 'sɔ yi Ejipiti mʋ.

name: Godié
text: 'Plɔfɛtɩ Zelemii' ciciwälɩɩ, sää ɩ ‑glää lä. Kä Zelemii cii‑ bhlä nynä.

name: Godié

name: Godié

name: Godié

normalised_text: bo gbo ye ni tin na hinhon le to dovlome olon ton me, nado na hinhon to aigba ji e soyin mo.

name: Gun
text: Jiwheyẹwhe sọ dá hinhọ́n daho awe; hinhọ́n he klohú nado dugán to okle, hinhọ́n he whehú nado dugán to ozánmẹ: é sọ dá sunwhlẹvu lẹ ga.
normalised_text: jikhweyekhwe so da hinhon daho awe; hinhon he klohu nado dugan to okle, hinhon he khwehu nado dugan to ozanme e so da sunkhwlevu le ga.

name: Gun
text: Jiwheyẹwhe sọ dotẹnna yé to dovlomẹ olọn tọn mẹ, nado na hinhọ́n to aigba ji.
normalised_text: jikhweyekhwe so dotenna ye to dovlome olon ton me, nado na hinhon to aigba ji.

name: Gun
text: podọ nado dugán to okle ji, podọ to ozan ji, podọ nado klán hinhọ́n po zinvlu po: Jiwheyẹwhe sọ mọ dọ é yón.
normalised_text: podo nado dugan to okle ji, podo to ozan ji, podo nado klan hinhon po zinvlu po jikhweyekhwe so mo do e yon.

name: Gun
text: Jiwheyẹwhe sọ dona ye, dọmọ, Mì yín sinsẹ́nnọ bo sọ sudeji bo gó osìn lẹ to ohù mẹ, bo gbọ ohẹ́ ni sudeji to aigba ji.
normalised_text: jikhweyekhwe so dona ye, domo, mi yin sinsenno bo so sudeji bo go osin le to ohu me, bo gbo ohe ni sudeji to aigba ji.

name: Gun
text: Jiwheyẹwhe sọ dọmọ, Gbọ aigba ni ji nútẹgbẹ́ kẹdẹdi etọn lẹ, owhékanlin po onú he nọ lìn po, podọ whékanlin aigba tọn kẹdẹdi etọn: é sọ yín mọ.
normalised_text: jikhweyekhwe so domo, gbo aigba ni ji nutegbe kededi eton le, okhwekanlin po onu he no lin po, podo khwekanlin aigba ton kededi eton e so yin mo.

name: Gun
text: Mowẹ Jiwheyẹwhe dá gbẹtọ to boṣio etọn titi mẹ, to bosiọ Jiwheyẹwhe tọn mẹ wẹ é dá ẹ do: asú de asi de wẹ é dá yé.
normalised_text: mowe jikhweyekhwe da gbeto to boshio eton titi me, to bosio jikhweyekhwe ton me we e da e do asu de asi de we e da ye.

name: Gun
text: Jiwheyẹwhe sọ mo onú he edá lẹpo, bo dayi e go é yọ́n talala. Whèjai wá, afọnnu sọ wá, azán sidopotọ.
normalised_text: jikhweyekhwe so mo onu he eda lepo, bo dayi e go e yon talala. khwejai wa, afonnu so wa, azan sidopoto.

name: Gun
text: LE wẹ yè dotana olọn po aigba po, po awhànpa yetọn lẹpo po.
normalised_text: le we ye dotana olon po aigba po, po akhwanpa yeton lepo po.

name: Gun
text: To azán sinawetọ gbè Jiwheyẹwhe dotana azón etọn he é basi; é sọ gbọjẹ to azán ṣinawetọ gbè sọn azọ́n etọn lẹpo mẹ he é ko basi.
normalised_text: to azan sinaweto gbe jikhweyekhwe dotana azon eton he e basi; e so gboje to azan shinaweto gbe son azon eton lepo me he e ko basi.

name: Gun
text: Jiwheyẹwhe sọ dona azán ṣinawetọ bo sọ klán ẹn do wiwé: na é mẹ wẹ é ko gbọje te sọn azọ́n etọn mẹ he Jiwheyẹwhe dá bo basi wutu.
normalised_text: jikhweyekhwe so dona azan shinaweto bo so klan en do wiwe na e me we e ko gboje te son azon eton me he jikhweyekhwe da bo basi wutu.

name: Gun
text: Ehelẹ wẹ owhẹndo olọn tọn po aigba ton po, whenuena yè dá yé, to azán he mẹ OKLUNỌ Jiwheyẹwhe dá aigba po ólọnpo.
normalised_text: ehele we okhwendo olon ton po aigba ton po, khwenuena ye da ye, to azan he me okluno jikhweyekhwe da aigba po olonpo.

name: Gun
text: ṣigba avìvì osìnnọ de fọ́n yìaga sọn aigba, bo húsìn nukunmẹ aigba tọn lẹpo.
normalised_text: shigba avivi osinno de fon yiaga son aigba, bo husin nukunme aigba ton lepo.

name: Gun
text: OKLUNỌ Jiwheyẹwhe do gbẹtọ sọn kógúdu aigba tọn mẹ; bo gbò do awòntinslo etọn lẹ mẹ gbigbọ ogbẹ̀ tọn; gbẹtọ sọ lẹzùn alindọn gbẹ̀tenọ.
normalised_text: okluno jikhweyekhwe do gbeto son kogudu aigba ton me; bo gbo do awontinslo eton le me gbigbo ogbe ton; gbeto so lezun alindon gbeteno.

name: Gun
text: OKLUNỌ Jiwheyẹwhe do ójipa dé do whèzẹtẹn dàli to Edẹni me; finẹ wẹ é yí sunnu he é do lọ do.
normalised_text: okluno jikhweyekhwe do ojipa de do khwezeten dali to edeni me; fine we e yi sunnu he e do lo do.

name: Gun
text: Otọ̀ de sọ ton sọn Eaẹni yì nado húsìn ojipa lọ; finẹ wẹ é klán sọn, bo lẹzùn ota ẹnẹ.
normalised_text: oto de so ton son eaeni yi nado husin ojipa lo; fine we e klan son, bo lezun ota ene.

name: Gun
text: Oyín tintan tọn wẹ Pisoni: enẹ wẹ ewọ he lédo aigba Havila tọn lẹpo péte, fie sika tin te.
normalised_text: oyin tintan ton we pisoni ene we ewo he ledo aigba havila ton lepo pete, fie sika tin te.

name: Gun
text: Sika aigba lọ tọn yónwhanpẹ: finẹ wẹ bdẹliumi po osé onikisi tọn po te.
normalised_text: sika aigba lo ton yonkhwanpe fine we bdeliumi po ose onikisi ton po te.

name: Gun
text: Oyín otò awetọ tọn wẹ Gihonì: enẹ wẹ ewọ he lédo aigba Etiopia tọn lepo péte.
normalised_text: oyin oto aweto ton we gihoni ene we ewo he ledo aigba etiopia ton lepo pete.

name: Gun
text: Oyin otò atọ̀ntọ tọn wẹ Hiddekẹli: enẹ wẹ ehe to sìsá to nukọn Assilia tọn. Ẹnẹtọ wẹ Euflate.
normalised_text: oyin oto atonto ton we hiddekeli ene we ehe to sisa to nukon assilia ton. eneto we euflate.

name: Gungu
text: Mu kutandika, Ruhanga yaahangi̱ri̱ iguru na nsi.
normalised_text: mu kutandika, ruhanga yaahangiri iguru na nsi.

name: Gungu
text: Nsi gyali gitali na kugikwisana kandi gitalimwo kantu, nti̱ti̱ gyali gi̱bbu̱mbi̱ri̱ itaka, Mwozo wa Ruhanga naakulibatira hakyendi̱ wa meezi̱.
normalised_text: nsi gyali gitali na kugikwisana kandi gitalimwo kantu, ntiti gyali gibbumbiri itaka, mwozo wa ruhanga naakulibatira hakyendi wa meezi.

name: Gungu
text: Mwomwo Ruhanga yaabaza naakoba yati, Leka habbeho kyererezi̱, kyererezi̱ kyabbaho.
normalised_text: mwomwo ruhanga yaabaza naakoba yati, leka habbeho kyererezi, kyererezi kyabbaho.

name: Gungu
text: Ruhanga yaaweeni̱ kyererezi̱ nikili kirungi, yaahu̱kani̱a kyererezi̱ na nti̱ti̱.
normalised_text: ruhanga yaaweeni kyererezi nikili kirungi, yaahukania kyererezi na ntiti.

name: Gungu
text: Kyererezi̱, yaakyeta mwinsi kandi nti̱ti̱, yaagyeta i̱jolo. B̯wi̱re b̯wasweki̱ri̱ b̯wei̱ra b̯wakya, kyabba kiro kyakubanza.
normalised_text: kyererezi, yaakyeta mwinsi kandi ntiti, yaagyeta ijolo. bwire bwaswekiri bweira bwakya, kyabba kiro kyakubanza.

name: Gungu
text: Mwomwo Ruhanga yaabaza naakoba yati, Leka habbeho mwanya hakati̱ wa meezi̱ ga hansi na hakyendi̱.
normalised_text: mwomwo ruhanga yaabaza naakoba yati, leka habbeho mwanya hakati wa meezi ga hansi na hakyendi.

name: Gungu
text: Kandi mwanya gu̱gwo Ruhanga yaagweti̱ri̱ iguru. B̯wi̱re b̯wasweki̱ri̱ b̯wei̱ra b̯wakya, kyabba kiro kyakabiri.
normalised_text: kandi mwanya gugwo ruhanga yaagwetiri iguru. bwire bwaswekiri bweira bwakya, kyabba kiro kyakabiri.

name: Gungu
text: Mwomwo Ruhanga yaabaza naakoba yati, Leka meezi̱ gali hansi weiguru geecooke hamwei̱, leka itehe lizooke. Kandi kwokwo kyabbeeri̱.
normalised_text: mwomwo ruhanga yaabaza naakoba yati, leka meezi gali hansi weiguru geechooke hamwei, leka itehe lizooke. kandi kwokwo kyabbeeri.

name: Gungu
text: Itehe, Ruhanga yaalyeti̱ri̱ nsi kandi meezi̱ gaanyakwecooka hamwei̱ yaageeta itaka. Kandi Ruhanga yaawona nikili kirungi.
normalised_text: itehe, ruhanga yaalyetiri nsi kandi meezi gaanyakwechooka hamwei yaageeta itaka. kandi ruhanga yaawona nikili kirungi.

name: Gungu
text: B̯wi̱re b̯wasweki̱ri̱ b̯wei̱ra b̯wakya, kyabba kiro kyakasatu.
normalised_text: bwire bwaswekiri bweira bwakya, kyabba kiro kyakasatu.

name: Gungu
text: byakirenge mu mwanya heiguru nibimulikira nsi. Kandi kwokwo kyabbeeri̱.
normalised_text: byakirenge mu mwanya heiguru nibimulikira nsi. kandi kwokwo kyabbeeri.

name: Gungu
text: Kasi mwomwo Ruhanga yaahanga byererezi̱ bikooto bibiri, kikooto kyakenge b̯wi̱re b̯wa mwinsi, kandi ki̱dooli̱ kyakenge i̱jolo kandi yaakora na nzota.
normalised_text: kasi mwomwo ruhanga yaahanga byererezi bikooto bibiri, kikooto kyakenge bwire bwa mwinsi, kandi kidooli kyakenge ijolo kandi yaakora na nzota.

name: Gungu
text: Byererezi̱ bi̱byo Ruhanga yaabi̱teeri̱ mu mwanya heiguru bimulikire nsi.
normalised_text: byererezi bibyo ruhanga yaabiteeri mu mwanya heiguru bimulikire nsi.

name: Gungu
text: lyoba lyakenge b̯wi̱re b̯wa mwinsi, mweri̱ gwakenge i̱jolo, kandi byahu̱kani̱a kyererezi̱ na nti̱ti̱. Kandi Ruhanga yaawona nikili kirungi.
normalised_text: lyoba lyakenge bwire bwa mwinsi, mweri gwakenge ijolo, kandi byahukania kyererezi na ntiti. kandi ruhanga yaawona nikili kirungi.

name: Gungu
text: B̯wi̱re b̯wasweki̱ri̱ b̯wei̱ra b̯wakya, kyabba kiro kyakanei.
normalised_text: bwire bwaswekiri bweira bwakya, kyabba kiro kyakanei.

name: Gungu
text: Nahab̯waki̱kyo, Ruhanga yaabiha mu̱gi̱sa naakoba yati, Mu̱byale mukanye, mwizuule mu meezi̱ ga mu mataka, kandi leka bi̱nyoni̱ bikanye mu nsi.
normalised_text: nahabwakikyo, ruhanga yaabiha mugisa naakoba yati, mubyale mukanye, mwizuule mu meezi ga mu mataka, kandi leka binyoni bikanye mu nsi.

name: Gungu
text: B̯wi̱re b̯wasweki̱ri̱ b̯wei̱ra b̯wakya, kyabba kiro kyakataanu.
normalised_text: bwire bwaswekiri bweira bwakya, kyabba kiro kyakataanu.

name: Gungu
text: Kwokwo yatyo Ruhanga yaahangi̱ri̱ bisolo byensei̱ mu mu̱li̱ngo gwabyo. Kandi Ruhanga yaawona nikili kirungi.
normalised_text: kwokwo yatyo ruhanga yaahangiri bisolo byensei mu mulingo gwabyo. kandi ruhanga yaawona nikili kirungi.

name: Gungu
text: Ruhanga kwokwo yaahangi̱ri̱ yati muntu mu kwisana kwamwe, mu kwisana kwa Ruhanga, yaamu̱hangi̱ri̱. Yaabahangi̱ri̱ mudulu na mu̱kali̱.
normalised_text: ruhanga kwokwo yaahangiri yati muntu mu kwisana kwamwe, mu kwisana kwa ruhanga, yaamuhangiri. yaabahangiri mudulu na mukali.

name: Gungu
text: Kandi Ruhanga yaawona byensei̱ bi̱yaakoori̱ nibili birungi, kandi birungi kwo. B̯wi̱re b̯wasweki̱ri̱ b̯wei̱ra b̯wakya, kyabba kiro kyamukaaga.
normalised_text: kandi ruhanga yaawona byensei biyaakoori nibili birungi, kandi birungi kwo. bwire bwaswekiri bweira bwakya, kyabba kiro kyamukaaga.

name: Gungu
text: Iguru na nsi na byensei̱ bigilimwo kwokwo yatyo byahangi̱i̱rwe.
normalised_text: iguru na nsi na byensei bigilimwo kwokwo yatyo byahangiirwe.

name: Gungu
text: Ha kiro kyamusanju, Ruhanga yaali amaari̱ milimo myamwe, yaahumula milimo myamwe myensei̱ mi̱yaakoori̱ ha kiro kyamusanju.
normalised_text: ha kiro kyamusanju, ruhanga yaali amaari milimo myamwe, yaahumula milimo myamwe myensei miyaakoori ha kiro kyamusanju.

name: Gungu
text: Kiro ki̱kyo kyamusanju Ruhanga yaaki̱heeri̱ mu̱gi̱sa, yaaki̱syani̱a hab̯wakubba kyokyo kiro ki̱yaahu̱mwi̱ri̱ milimo myamwe mi̱yaakoori̱.
normalised_text: kiro kikyo kyamusanju ruhanga yaakiheeri mugisa, yaakisyania habwakubba kyokyo kiro kiyaahumwiri milimo myamwe miyaakoori.

name: Gungu
text: Gugu gwogwo mu̱li̱ngo gweiguru na nsi ku̱byahangi̱i̱rwemwo. Mukama Ruhanga b̯u̱yaahangi̱ri̱ iguru na nsi.
normalised_text: gugu gwogwo mulingo gweiguru na nsi kubyahangiirwemwo. mukama ruhanga buyaahangiri iguru na nsi.

name: Gungu
text: bei̱tu̱ kiho kyabyokengi̱ nikitemba hakyendi̱, b̯utuntu ni̱b̯u̱lu̱bya nsi gyensei̱.
normalised_text: beitu kiho kyabyokengi nikitemba hakyendi, butuntu nibulubya nsi gyensei.

name: Gungu
text: kasi mwomwo Mukama Ruhanga yaakora muntu kuruga mwitehe lya mu nsi, yaamuhuuha rwoya lwa b̯womi mu nni̱ndo, muntu yaabba kihangwa kyomi.
normalised_text: kasi mwomwo mukama ruhanga yaakora muntu kuruga mwitehe lya mu nsi, yaamuhuuha rwoya lwa bwomi mu nnindo, muntu yaabba kihangwa kyomi.

name: Gungu
text: Hei̱nyu̱ma, Mukama Ruhanga yaasi̱mbi̱ri̱ musiri mu nsi gyʼEdeni̱, ha rubaju lwa b̯uhulukalyoba, ku̱kwo hooho yaateeri̱ muntu gi̱yaahangi̱ri̱.
normalised_text: heinyuma, mukama ruhanga yaasimbiri musiri mu nsi gyedeni, ha rubaju lwa buhulukalyoba, kukwo hooho yaateeri muntu giyaahangiri.

name: Gungu
text: Haalingiho mugira gunyakuhetanga nigurugira Edeni̱, niguleeta meezi̱ mu musiri, kuruga hahwo ni̱gwezahu̱kani̱amwo migira minei.
normalised_text: haalingiho mugira gunyakuhetanga nigurugira edeni, niguleeta meezi mu musiri, kuruga hahwo nigwezahukaniamwo migira minei.

name: Gungu
text: Ibara lya mugira gukubanza bagweta Pi̱soni̱, gwogwo gunyakuhetanga ni̱gwelogoleerya nsi gyensei̱ gya Havi̱la, hooho heicala zaabbu.
normalised_text: ibara lya mugira gukubanza bagweta pisoni, gwogwo gunyakuhetanga nigwelogoleerya nsi gyensei gya havila, hooho heichala zaabbu.

name: Gungu
text: Zaabbu gya mu nsi gi̱gyo gibba girungi, kandi hali̱yo mahi̱ga gabakweta bedoli̱u̱mu̱ na oni̱ki̱si̱.
normalised_text: zaabbu gya mu nsi gigyo gibba girungi, kandi haliyo mahiga gabakweta bedoliumu na onikisi.

name: Guro
text: Fɛkɛlɛle pélisia bléyi va, dé Kazambale la valé tɛrɛ kɛlɛ.
normalised_text: fekelele pelisia bleyi va, de kazambale la vale tere kele.

name: Guro
text: té tɛrɛ a munuɔɔ, té fɛ do kpen ka ana lo; yé a guru blɛn ta gunu a tiritiri, té Kazambale Léli éé giéan yinu ta loru.
normalised_text: te tere a munuoo, te fe do kpen ka ana lo; ye a guru blen ta gunu a tiritiri, te kazambale leli ee giean yinu ta loru.

name: Guro
text: Yé Kazambale léé: Fɛna fu é kɛlɛ. Yé fɛna fu kɛlɛ.
normalised_text: ye kazambale lee fena fu e kele. ye fena fu kele.

name: Guro
text: Kazambale a ye léé, fɛna fu a é zima; yé Kazambale fɛna fu valé gunu kini ékema.
normalised_text: kazambale a ye lee, fena fu a e zima; ye kazambale fena fu vale gunu kini ekema.

name: Guro
text: Kazambale fɛna fu laa, tu, yé é gunu laa, béli. Bɛ zo lé nyanadi kɛlɛ yé bladi kɛlɛ; bɛ ɛ ke a yi vininzan nya.
normalised_text: kazambale fena fu laa, tu, ye e gunu laa, beli. be zo le nyanadi kele ye bladi kele; be e ke a yi vininzan nya.

name: Guro
text: Kazambale léé: Fɛna pla é kɛlɛ yinu méléna, yé fɛna pla é yinu kini ékema.
normalised_text: kazambale lee fena pla e kele yinu melena, ye fena pla e yinu kini ekema.

name: Guro
text: Yé yinu lé ke fɛna pla ta loru koo, yinu lé ke a wuo koo, Kazambale wo kini ékema yé é wo méléna vo é pla.
normalised_text: ye yinu le ke fena pla ta loru koo, yinu le ke a wuo koo, kazambale wo kini ekema ye e wo melena vo e pla.

name: Guro
text: Yé bɛ kɛlɛ a zo. Kazambale fɛna pla laa, la. Bɛ zo lé nyanadi kɛlɛ yé bladi kɛlɛ; bɛ ɛ ke a yi fiézan nya.
normalised_text: ye be kele a zo. kazambale fena pla laa, la. be zo le nyanadi kele ye bladi kele; be e ke a yi fiezan nya.

name: Guro
text: Kazambale léé: Yinu lé wo ke la wuo, wo zén ékeva fɛdona, yé fɛna gale é bɔra. Yé bɛ kɛlɛ a zo.
normalised_text: kazambale lee yinu le wo ke la wuo, wo zen ekeva fedona, ye fena gale e bora. ye be kele a zo.

name: Guro
text: Kazambale fɛna gale laa, tɛrɛ, yé yinu lé wo zén ékeva bɛ, é bɛnu laa wɛyi. Yé Kazambale a ye léé, bɛ a é zima.
normalised_text: kazambale fena gale laa, tere, ye yinu le wo zen ekeva be, e benu laa weyi. ye kazambale a ye lee, be a e zima.

name: Guro
text: Bɛ zo lé nyanadi kɛlɛ, yé bladi kɛlɛ; bɛ ɛ ke a yi yaazan nya.
normalised_text: be zo le nyanadi kele, ye bladi kele; be e ke a yi yaazan nya.

name: Guro
text: Wo kɛlɛ fɛnakinifɛnu nya la gi, yé wo tɛrɛ ta kini. Yé bɛ kɛlɛ a zo.
normalised_text: wo kele fenakinifenu nya la gi, ye wo tere ta kini. ye be kele a zo.

name: Guro
text: Kazambale fɛnakinifɛ blɛn kɛlɛ fié; é a blɛnzan kɛlɛ yiéyizan nya, yé é a kiénézan kɛlɛ bélizan nya; yé é monénénu kɛlɛ é ziin.
normalised_text: kazambale fenakinife blen kele fie; e a blenzan kele yieyizan nya, ye e a kienezan kele belizan nya; ye e monenenu kele e ziin.

name: Guro
text: wo kɛlɛle yiéyi valé bélizannu nya koo, fɛna fu valé gunu kinile ékema koo, bɛ faa we gi. Kazambale a ye léé, bɛ a é zima.
normalised_text: wo kelele yieyi vale belizannu nya koo, fena fu vale gunu kinile ekema koo, be faa we gi. kazambale a ye lee, be a e zima.

name: Guro
text: Bɛ zo lé nyanadi kɛlɛ yé bladi kɛlɛ; bɛ ɛ ke a yi ziɛnzan nya.
normalised_text: be zo le nyanadi kele ye bladi kele; be e ke a yi zienzan nya.

name: Guro
text: Kazambale léé: Wi yuɛmalenu é kɛlɛ yinu va di, yé mianénu é si tɛrɛ ta loru la worona.
normalised_text: kazambale lee wi yuemalenu e kele yinu va di, ye mianenu e si tere ta loru la worona.

name: Guro
text: Kazambale wo drɔɔ vo yé é léé: Ka né yaa, ka kɛlɛ kiɛre, ka fan wɛyi va; yé mianénu é kɛlɛ kiɛre tɛrɛ la ma.
normalised_text: kazambale wo droo vo ye e lee ka ne yaa, ka kele kiere, ka fan weyi va; ye mianenu e kele kiere tere la ma.

name: Guro
text: Bɛ zo lé nyanadi kɛlɛ yé bladi kɛlɛ; bɛ ɛ ke a yi soruzan nya.
normalised_text: be zo le nyanadi kele ye bladi kele; be e ke a yi soruzan nya.

name: Guro
text: Yé Kazambale mi kɛlɛ é dɔbɛ gi, é a kɛlɛ Bale dɔbɛ gi, é gɔné valé le kɛlɛ.

name: Guro

name: Hun-Saare
text: Jo̱saya matu̱ru̱ Je̱ko̱niya u̱n hen-ne̱ ye̱ u̱n wu̱ ne̱, cin ba a u̱n ku̱u̱s ye̱ m-gu̱w so̱ u̱n dak-o̱ o- Babira .

name: Hun-Saare

text: Yakubu matu̱ru̱ Yusuhu campo̱ Meri , Meri inu Ye̱so wu̱ a m-ze̱e̱ Kiristi à.

name: Hun-Saare

text: Utakada u usuli u Yesu Kristi bwa bu Dauda, bwa bu Ibrahim:.

text: A mace Yesu na i'ogo i Baitalami ina i yiwa usala u Yahudiya, na uya uni Hiridus abe asa bugwama. Kwa aco na za cidaka̱ ci muginga ne kore Urshalima.

normalised_text: ba se ni irisim, ayong fe ba tes fe ayet agwom bayahuda me se ke? iyit di yit adat wu abatin, in bi in ku ya yit ntong.

text: Fɛ́ agwɔm aHiridus fok anɔng, a nɔ kudaam, gung nɛ banet aRushelima.
normalised_text: fe agwom ahiridus fok anong, a no kudaam, gung ne banet arushelima.

name: Ibaas
text: Ama fɛ́ a mi tusung ngma bagbat áware, nɛ bágwɔm irēn ntsi aMusa, a ka ba rip karɔ fɛ́ ba fɛ̀ ba di ki tes Anet-Isheshek e.
normalised_text: ama fe a mi tusung ngma bagbat aware, ne bagwom iren ntsi amusa, a ka ba rip karo fe ba fe ba di ki tes anetisheshek e.

name: Ibaas
text: Ba fɛ̀ ni wu, <<Ni wɔp aBatalami ni mben aJudiya, nek ikyɛng de fɛ́ atan e kin jɛk.
normalised_text: ba fe ni wu, ni wop abatalami ni mben ajudiya, nek ikyeng de fe atan e kin jek.

name: Ibani
text: Mịị anịị diri bie anị fịnị ḅara Jizọs tádọ́apụ, Jizọs Krais Deviti furotụ́wọ pịghị Ebraham furotụ́wọ:.
normalised_text: mii anii diri bie ani fini bara jizos tadoapu, jizos krais deviti furotuwo pighi ebraham furotuwo.

name: Ibani
text: Ebraham anịị Aizik daa, Aizik anịị Jekọpụ daa, Jekọpụ anịị Juda na ori amịna owiapụ awọ daa.
normalised_text: ebraham anii aizik daa, aizik anii jekopu daa, jekopu anii juda na ori amina owiapu awo daa.

name: Ibani
text: Juda anịị Pẹrẹzi na Zẹra daa, Táma anịị nna nyingi, Pẹrẹzi anịị Hẹzịrọn daa, Hẹzịrọn anịị Ram daa.
normalised_text: juda anii perezi na zera daa, tama anii nna nyingi, perezi anii heziron daa, heziron anii ram daa.

name: Ibani
text: Ram anịị Abinadabu daa, Abinadabu anịị Nasọnị daa, Nasọnị anịị Salmọnị daa.
normalised_text: ram anii abinadabu daa, abinadabu anii nasoni daa, nasoni anii salmoni daa.

name: Ibani
text: Salmọnị anịị Bowazi daa, Rahab anịị Bowazi nyingii, Bowazi anịị Obedi daa, Rutu anịị Obedi nyingii, Obedi anịị Jesi daa.
normalised_text: salmoni anii bowazi daa, rahab anii bowazi nyingii, bowazi anii obedi daa, rutu anii obedi nyingii, obedi anii jesi daa.

name: Ibani
text: Jesi anịị ámányánáḅọ Deviti daa. Deviti anịị Solomọn daa, o nyingi anịị parị Uraya taa.
normalised_text: jesi anii amanyanabo deviti daa. deviti anii solomon daa, o nyingi anii pari uraya taa.

name: Ibani
text: Solomọn anịị Rehobowam daa, Abija anịị Asa daa.
normalised_text: solomon anii rehobowam daa, abija anii asa daa.

name: Ibani
text: Asa anịị Jehosafat daa, Jehosafat anịị Jehoramu daa, Jehoramu anịị Uzaya daa.
normalised_text: asa anii jehosafat daa, jehosafat anii jehoramu daa, jehoramu anii uzaya daa.

name: Ibani
text: Uzaya anịị Jotamu daa, Jotamu anịị Ahazi daa, Ahazi anịị Hezekaya daa.
normalised_text: uzaya anii jotamu daa, jotamu anii ahazi daa, ahazi anii hezekaya daa.

name: Ibani
text: Hezekaya anịị Manasị daa, Manasị anịị Amọn daa, Amọn anịị Josaya daa.
normalised_text: hezekaya anii manasi daa, manasi anii amon daa, amon anii josaya daa.

name: Ibani
text: Josaya anịị Jekonaya na ori amịna owiapụ daa. Mịị sáá biri ma ḅụ anịị nnị Izirẹlịawọ dighiákị so Babịlọn muu sáá.
normalised_text: josaya anii jekonaya na ori amina owiapu daa. mii saa biri ma bu anii nni izireliawo dighiaki so babilon muu saa.

name: Ibani
text: Nnị n taa soofama Babịlọn mú sáá: Jekonaya anịị Seliteli daa, Seliteli anịị Zerubabeli daa.
normalised_text: nni n taa soofama babilon mu saa jekonaya anii seliteli daa, seliteli anii zerubabeli daa.

name: Ibani
text: Zerubabeli anịị Abihudu daa, Abihudu anịị Eliakim daa, Eliakim anịị Azọ daa.
normalised_text: zerubabeli anii abihudu daa, abihudu anii eliakim daa, eliakim anii azo daa.

name: Ibani
text: Azọ anịị Zadọk daa, Zadọk anịị Akịm daa, Akịm anịị Eliudu daa.
normalised_text: azo anii zadok daa, zadok anii akim daa, akim anii eliudu daa.

name: Ibani
text: Eliudu anịị Elieza daa, Elieza anịị Matan daa, Matan anịị Jekọpụ daa.
normalised_text: eliudu anii elieza daa, elieza anii matan daa, matan anii jekopu daa.

name: Ibani
text: Jekọpụ anịị Josẹf daa. Josẹf anịị Meri ma deeḅọ, Meri Jizọs yiim n pa Krais sịḅọ.
normalised_text: jekopu anii josef daa. josef anii meri ma deebo, meri jizos yiim n pa krais sibo.

name: Ibani
text: Árị owitụ́wọ yiibẹm, Jizọs anịị i pa ọ sịịbe ẹ́rẹ́, tegó, ori ọrẹ a túminị́ duaḅọ́rọ́mabẹm nna sii ḅụ.>>.
normalised_text: ari owituwo yiibem, jizos anii i pa o siibe ere, tego, ori ore a tumini duaboromabem nna sii bu..

name: Ibani
text: Mịnanyẹ mamgba kiriakịm Gbámásóḅọ ma ori ikiakoroapụ ḅụ ḅọ́rọ́ dughonyẹ ma karakárányẹ sọ bẹ ḅara.
normalised_text: minanye mamgba kiriakim gbamasobo ma ori ikiakoroapu bu boro dughonye ma karakaranye so be bara.

name: Ibani
text: <<Owitụ́wọ nimigha ọ́rụ́ḅọ tụwọ ma furabẹm, a pịghị owitụ́wọ yiibẹm n pịghị Imanụwẹlụ pa ọ sịịbẹm>> .
normalised_text: owituwo nimigha orubo tuwo ma furabem, a pighi owituwo yiibem n pighi imanuwelu pa o siibem.

name: Ibani
text: Josẹf múno ju saghị sáá, Gbámásóḅọ ma sookumuḅọ ma dugho ọ pịrị ḅara ma anịị ọ mịẹḅara ọ warị Meri akị soo ọ warị muu taḅọ ḅara.
normalised_text: josef muno ju saghi saa, gbamasobo ma sookumubo ma dugho o piri bara ma anii o miebara o wari meri aki soo o wari muu tabo bara.

name: Ibani
text: Kụ́ma ori árị na gbolomagha akị muu árị owitụ́wọ tụwọ ma yii sáá láa. Josẹf warị Jizọs pa ọ sịị.
normalised_text: kuma ori ari na gbolomagha aki muu ari owituwo tuwo ma yii saa laa. josef wari jizos pa o sii.

name: Ibani
text: Ámányánáḅọ Hẹrọd mịma náa sáá anị pịghị ḅụḅáláḅálá pa ọ pịrịm anị pịghị Jerusalem ḅụ fịnịapụ mamgba pịrị ḅara.
normalised_text: amanyanabo herod mima naa saa ani pighi bubalabala pa o pirim ani pighi jerusalem bu finiapu mamgba piri bara.

name: Ibani
text: Ọ túminị́ mamgba sị kobiri fama sáá, igwagwaalaapụ na ólóghó nyẹ́dieapụ ori nnị gbilam nnị, <<Krais ma yii bẹ angaá?>>.
normalised_text: o tumini mamgba si kobiri fama saa, igwagwaalaapu na ologho nyedieapu ori nni gbilam nni, krais ma yii be angaa?.

name: Ibani
text: Nnị warị ọ pagharaa, <<Judiya bie fịnị Bẹtịlịhẹm. Mịma anịị ikiakoroḅọ ma gịẹnyẹ:.
normalised_text: nni wari o pagharaa, judiya bie fini betilihem. mima anii ikiakorobo ma gienye.

name: Ibani
text: Hẹrọd warị ḅálōló gbólómanyẹ ma dawọapụ ma sị ọ ḅụ pịrị sị n gbíla ḅẹ́ ḅálōló ma anị tẹsá biri págháḅo.
normalised_text: herod wari balolo gbolomanye ma dawoapu ma si o bu piri si n gbila be balolo ma ani tesa biri paghabo.

name: Ibani
text: Tamuno nna biri nụ́nụ́máa ḅara ma dáwọ́ju ḅụ ḅẹ́ nnị pịghịma Hẹrọd damaḅo ma, nnị jẹ́ asọ akịm sị sọọ nna sẹ múm.
normalised_text: tamuno nna biri nunumaa bara ma dawoju bu be nni pighima herod damabo ma, nni je aso akim si soo nna se mum.

name: Ibani
text: Ọ warị saghị, sị tụwọ ma na nyingiḅọ taa mangị so Ijipiti muu dii bie.
normalised_text: o wari saghi, si tuwo ma na nyingibo taa mangi so ijipiti muu dii bie.

name: Ibani
text: Anịsáa nnị ikiakoro Jerimaya bịpị ḅọ́rọ́ dughonyẹ ma ḅọ́rọ́ karakárányẹ sọ ḅara:.
normalised_text: anisaa nni ikiakoro jerimaya bipi boro dughonye ma boro karakaranye so bara.

name: Ibani
text: <<Rama ḅụ n gbẹ́rẹ́ pụghọ naam owu na pịghị opu tẹ́mẹ́sii. Resel owu árị awọ pịrịarị aminigha nnị a biedịịnma, tegó n fịịmam.>>.
normalised_text: rama bu n gbere pugho naam owu na pighi opu temesii. resel owu ari awo piriari aminigha nni a biediinma, tego n fiimam..

name: Ibani
text: Hẹrọd fịị ḅọ́rọ́maa sáá, Gbámásóḅọ ma gbẹ́rẹ́ sookumuḅọ ọ ḅụ pa Josẹf diem dáwọ́ju Ijipiti bie.
normalised_text: herod fii boromaa saa, gbamasobo ma gbere sookumubo o bu pa josef diem dawoju ijipiti bie.

name: Ibibio
text: Ndin isọñ akedo ikpu-ikpu ye ukpọk. Ekịm amaayọhọ anyọñ akpammọọñ, ndin Sịbidịd Abasi amaafuum ke anyọñ mmọọñ.
normalised_text: ndin isong akedo ikpuikpu ye ukpok. ekim amaayoho anyong akpammoong, ndin sibidid abasi amaafuum ke anyong mmoong.

name: Ibibio
text: Ndin Abasi amaabo, Yak unwana aba, unwana amaanyʌñ aba.
normalised_text: ndin abasi amaabo, yak unwana aba, unwana amaanyang aba.

name: Ibibio
text: Abasi amaakịt ke unwana ado a-afọn, anye amaanyʌñ adiañña unwana ado akpọñ ekịm.
normalised_text: abasi amaakit ke unwana ado aafon, anye amaanyang adiangnga unwana ado akpong ekim.

name: Ibibio
text: Abasi amaakoot unwana uweemeayio, anyʌñ akoot ekịm akonayio. Ndin ndubiayio ye ubakusen emaeba ke akpa usen.
normalised_text: abasi amaakoot unwana uweemeayio, anyang akoot ekim akonayio. ndin ndubiayio ye ubakusen emaeba ke akpa usen.

name: Ibibio
text: Ndin Abasi amaabo, Yak ukpa aba ke ufọọd mmọọñ nọ adiañña mmọọñ ye mmọọñ.
normalised_text: ndin abasi amaabo, yak ukpa aba ke ufood mmoong no adiangnga mmoong ye mmoong.

name: Ibibio
text: Ndin Abasi amaanam ukpa anyʌñ adiañña mmọọñ idak ukpa ye mmọọñ anyọñ ukpa. Ndin amaado ntoro.
normalised_text: ndin abasi amaanam ukpa anyang adiangnga mmoong idak ukpa ye mmoong anyong ukpa. ndin amaado ntoro.

name: Ibibio
text: Abasi amaakoot ukpa ado ikpaanyọñ. Ndin ndubiayio ye ubakusen emaeba ke ayọhọ usen iba.
normalised_text: abasi amaakoot ukpa ado ikpaanyong. ndin ndubiayio ye ubakusen emaeba ke ayoho usen iba.

name: Ibibio
text: Ndin Abasi amaabo, Yak mmọọñ ke idak ikpaanyọñ aboho itie keed, yak nsaad isọñ anyʌñ awuọ ada. Ndin amaado ntoro.
normalised_text: ndin abasi amaabo, yak mmoong ke idak ikpaanyong aboho itie keed, yak nsaad isong anyang awuo ada. ndin amaado ntoro.

name: Ibibio
text: Abasi amaakoot nsaad isọñ isọñ, anyʌñ akoot mme mmọọñ e-ekebohoke mme akpainyañ. Abasi amaanyʌñ akịt ke amaafọn.
normalised_text: abasi amaakoot nsaad isong isong, anyang akoot mme mmoong eekebohoke mme akpainyang. abasi amaanyang akit ke amaafon.

name: Ibibio
text: Isọñ amaatịppe mbid. Mme eto emaesakka ke ñkpasi ekeene mme aduuk ammọ ye mme eto enwịmme mfịd ekeene mme aduuk ammọ. Abasi amaanyʌñ akịt ke a-afọn.
normalised_text: isong amaatippe mbid. mme eto emaesakka ke ngkpasi ekeene mme aduuk ammo ye mme eto enwimme mfid ekeene mme aduuk ammo. abasi amaanyang akit ke aafon.

name: Ibibio
text: Ndin ndubiayio ye ubakusen emaeba ke ayọhọ usen ita.
normalised_text: ndin ndubiayio ye ubakusen emaeba ke ayoho usen ita.

name: Ibibio
text: yak ammọ enyʌñ edo unwana ke ukpa ikpaanyọñ nọ ayamma anọ isọñ. Ndin amaado ntoro.
normalised_text: yak ammo enyang edo unwana ke ukpa ikpaanyong no ayamma ano isong. ndin amaado ntoro.

name: Ibibio
text: Abasi amaanam ikpọ unwana iba, unwana andikpon ñkan adikara uweemeayio ye etək unwana adikara akonayio. Anye amaanyʌñ anam mme ntantaafiọñ.
normalised_text: abasi amaanam ikpo unwana iba, unwana andikpon ngkan adikara uweemeayio ye etek unwana adikara akonayio. anye amaanyang anam mme ntantaafiong.

name: Ibibio
text: Abasi amaanịm ammọ ke ukpa ikpaanyọñ adinọ isọñ unwana.
normalised_text: abasi amaanim ammo ke ukpa ikpaanyong adino isong unwana.

name: Ibibio
text: adikara uweemeayio ye akonayio, anyʌñ adiañña unwana akpọñ ekịm. Ndin Abasi amaakịt ke a-afọn.
normalised_text: adikara uweemeayio ye akonayio, anyang adiangnga unwana akpong ekim. ndin abasi amaakit ke aafon.

name: Ibibio
text: Ndin ndubiayio ye ubakusen emaeba ke ayọhọ usen inaañ.
normalised_text: ndin ndubiayio ye ubakusen emaeba ke ayoho usen inaang.

name: Ibibio
text: Ndin Abasi amaabo Yak mmọọñ ayọhọ ye mme aduuwem ñkpọ, yak mme inuen enyʌñ efuurọ ekpọñ isọñ ke ukpa ikpaanyọñ.
normalised_text: ndin abasi amaabo yak mmoong ayoho ye mme aduuwem ngkpo, yak mme inuen enyang efuuro ekpong isong ke ukpa ikpaanyong.

name: Ibibio
text: Abasi amaadiọñ ammọ anyʌñ abo, Itọt inyʌñ iwak ke ibad inyʌñ iyọhọ mmọọñ ke mme akpainyañ, yak mme inuen enyʌñ etọt ke ederimbod.
normalised_text: abasi amaadiong ammo anyang abo, itot inyang iwak ke ibad inyang iyoho mmoong ke mme akpainyang, yak mme inuen enyang etot ke ederimbod.

name: Ibibio
text: Ndin ndubiayio ye ubakusen emaeba ke ayọhọ usen ition.
normalised_text: ndin ndubiayio ye ubakusen emaeba ke ayoho usen ition.

name: Ibibio
text: Ndin Abasi amaabot awo ke mbid idem amọ, ke mbid Abasi anye amaabot ammọ; anye amaabot ammọ, awodeen ye awonwaan.
normalised_text: ndin abasi amaabot awo ke mbid idem amo, ke mbid abasi anye amaabot ammo; anye amaabot ammo, awodeen ye awonwaan.

name: Ibibio
text: Abasi amaakịt afịd se anye akenam, ke amaanekke afọn. Ndin ndubiayio ye ubakusen emaeba ke ayọhọ usen itiokeed.
normalised_text: abasi amaakit afid se anye akenam, ke amaanekke afon. ndin ndubiayio ye ubakusen emaeba ke ayoho usen itiokeed.

name: Ibibio
text: Ntom ke ekenam mme hefịn ye isọñ ema ke afịd ayọhọ ndaha ammọ.
normalised_text: ntom ke ekenam mme hefin ye isong ema ke afid ayoho ndaha ammo.

name: Ibibio
text: Ke ayọhọ usen itiaba, Abasi amaama utom a-anye akenamma; ke ntoro, ke ayọhọ usen itiaba anye amaaduọk adudu ke afịd utom amọ.
normalised_text: ke ayoho usen itiaba, abasi amaama utom aanye akenamma; ke ntoro, ke ayoho usen itiaba anye amaaduok adudu ke afid utom amo.

name: Ibibio
text: Ndin Abasi amaadiọñ ayọhọ usen itiaba anyʌñ anam anye ado adisana, sia usen ado ke anye akeduọk adudu ke afịd utom a-anye akenamma.
normalised_text: ndin abasi amaadiong ayoho usen itiaba anyang anam anye ado adisana, sia usen ado ke anye akeduok adudu ke afid utom aanye akenamma.

name: Ibibio
text: Mbʌk e-ekewette naña ekebot mme anyọñ ye isọñ ado ami, ke ini Abọọñ Abasi akebotto isọñ ye mme anyọñ.
normalised_text: mbak eekewette nanga ekebot mme anyong ye isong ado ami, ke ini aboong abasi akebotto isong ye mme anyong.

name: Ibibio
text: Ado idịm amaasakka awuọ ke isọñ adiduọk mmọọñ ke afịd iso isọñ.
normalised_text: ado idim amaasakka awuo ke isong adiduok mmoong ke afid iso isong.

name: Ibibio
text: Ndin Abọọñ Abasi amaaben ntañ a-atooho isọñ abot awo anyʌñ anweek ibifịk uwem asịn anye ke aduiwuo, ndin awo ado amaakappa ado aduuwem ñkpọ.
normalised_text: ndin aboong abasi amaaben ntang aatooho isong abot awo anyang anweek ibifik uwem asin anye ke aduiwuo, ndin awo ado amaakappa ado aduuwem ngkpo.

name: Ibibio
text: Idaha ntoro Abọọñ Abasi amaatọ inwañ ke edem usakkautịn ke Idịn; ndin anye amaaben awo a-anye akebotto asịn do.
normalised_text: idaha ntoro aboong abasi amaato inwang ke edem usakkautin ke idin; ndin anye amaaben awo aanye akebotto asin do.

name: Ibibio
text: Inyañ a-akenọọhọ inwañ ado mmọọñ akewuọ ato Idịn; aketo do ke ekebakka anye esịn ke itie iwuod inyañ inaañ.
normalised_text: inyang aakenooho inwang ado mmoong akewuo ato idin; aketo do ke ekebakka anye esin ke itie iwuod inyang inaang.

name: Ibibio
text: Anyịñ akpa inyañ akedo Pisọn; anye afeghe ke afịd isọñ Hafila, a-kold abaaha.
normalised_text: anying akpa inyang akedo pison; anye afeghe ke afid isong hafila, akold abaaha.

name: Idoma
text: Anɔ́ɔ Ɔwɔicō kahíníī, Ofíyajɛ kú ɔlá kóō le yɔ̄. Ofíyajɛ kú ɔlá ā kē má yɔ̄.
normalised_text: anuo owoicho kahinei, ofiyaje ku ola kuo le yo. ofiyaje ku ola a ke ma yo.

name: Idoma
text: Abɔ̄ Ɔwɔicō má ka, ofíyajɛ ā ɔ́ɔ lɔhi ā, anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ ofíyajɛ mɛ́mla obū kɔ̄ hī uwā tá á.
normalised_text: abo owoicho ma ka, ofiyaje a uo lohi a, anuo o le ofiyaje memla obu ko hi uwa ta a.

name: Idoma
text: Ɔwɔicō hī ofíyajɛ kú ɔlā ā kahíníī, Ɔlɛ́ɛnɔ, anɔ́ɔ ó kē hī obū ā kahíníī, Otú. Anɔ́ɔ otú le bī, nɛ̄ eyī le nyā ā, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú pīya ɛ̄cī aflɛ́yí á.
normalised_text: owoicho hi ofiyaje ku ola a kahinei, olieno, anuo o ke hi obu a kahinei, otu. anuo otu le bi, ne eyi le nya a, anuo o kwu piya echi afleyi a.

name: Idoma
text: Ɔwɔicō ka ojuja kóō yɔ̄ ɔtāhɛ̄ kú éŋkpɔ̄ kú ɛháajɛ ā mɛ́mla éŋkpɔ̄ kú ɛhíicō ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō lɛ éŋkpɔ̄ ā kɔ̄ hīyī uwā tá.
