text: Bwu ọmwụ ọdada, Ohe Oluhye họ uhye-ọgba bala odehe ọlẹ.
normalised_text: bwu omwu odede, ohe oluhye ho uhyeogbe bala odehe ole.

name: Igede
text: Ụka ọọwa, Ohe Oluhye yẹkẹẹ, Ahịgboo, chị ka ẹga myị ẹga nya odehe ọlẹ mẹ. Ọọwa lẹ, ahịgboo a chị odehe ọlẹ wuu jaabwọ ká Ohe Oluhye ya lẹlẹ.
normalised_text: uke oowe, ohe oluhye yekee, ehigboo, chi ke ege myi ege nye odehe ole me. oowe le, ehigboo e chi odehe ole wuu jeebwo ke ohe oluhye ye lele.

name: Igede
text: Ụka ká Ohe Oluhye yẹ ahịgboo ọọwa, ọ họ́ọ lụmẹ. Ụka ọọwa, Ohe Oluhye chị ahịgboo ọọwa ebwo hi ukpowu.
normalised_text: uke ke ohe oluhye ye ehigboo oowe, o huo lume. uke oowe, ohe oluhye chi ehigboo oowe ebwo hi ukpowu.

name: Igede
text: Ohe Oluhye wụrụ ẹnyị nya ahịgboo ọọwa ahị ọpyẹpyẹ. Ọ wụrụ ukpowu ọọwa odu ohihi. Ụka nya ụtụrụ bala ụka nya obyi juwa lẹnụtụrụ nya ọgbanyẹ ọọwa.
normalised_text: ohe oluhye wuru enyi nye ehigboo oowe ehi opyepye. o wuru ukpowu oowe odu ohihi. uke nye uturu bala uke nye obyi juwe lenuturu nye ogbenye oowe.

name: Igede
text: Ohe Oluhye myịmyị ya ẹla lẹnụtụrụ oheeye yẹkẹẹ, Egbamwụ, hyeehe ká chị enyi oluhye bala enyi oleji ebwo hi awụlẹ mẹ.
normalised_text: ohe oluhye myimyi ye ele lenuturu oheeye yekee, egbemwu, hyeehe ke chi enyi oluhye bala enyi oleji ebwo hi ewule me.

name: Igede
text: Ọọwa lẹ, egbamwụ à hyeehe jaabwọ ká Ohe Oluhye ya lẹ, Ohe Oluhye a họ lẹ, egbamwụ ọọwa a chị enyi oluhye ebwo hi enyi oleji lẹlẹ.
normalised_text: oowe le, egbemwu e hyeehe jeebwo ke ohe oluhye ye le, ohe oluhye e ho le, egbemwu oowe e chi enyi oluhye ebwo hi enyi oleji lele.

name: Igede
text: Ohe Oluhye wụrụ ẹnyị nya egbamwụ ọọwa, uhye-ọgba. Ụka nya ụtụrụ bala ụka nya obyi juwa lẹnụtụrụ oheeye ọọwa ịnyịnyị.
normalised_text: ohe oluhye wuru enyi nye egbemwu oowe, uhyeogbe. uke nye uturu bala uke nye obyi juwe lenuturu oheeye oowe inyinyi.

name: Igede
text: Ohe Oluhye myịmyị yẹkẹẹ, Enyi ọlịpyị, chị ebwo hi ịpyị chajị ká ịpyị a hyeehe mẹ. Ọọwa lẹ, enyi oleji a chị ebwo hi ịpyị ịnyịlẹhị lẹlẹ.
normalised_text: ohe oluhye myimyi yekee, enyi olipyi, chi ebwo hi ipyi cheji ke ipyi e hyeehe me. oowe le, enyi oleji e chi ebwo hi ipyi inyilehi lele.

name: Igede
text: Ohe Oluhye wụrụ ẹnyị nya ẹga ọ-chọhụ ọọwa ịpyị, ọ wụrụ enyi ọyịlọlọ ịlẹga datị-datị ọọwa ihu ịtụka. Ụka ká Ohe Oluhye yọọ, ọ họ́ọ lụmẹ.
normalised_text: ohe oluhye wuru enyi nye ege ochohu oowe ipyi, o wuru enyi oyilolo ilege detideti oowe ihu ituke. uke ke ohe oluhye yoo, o huo lume.

name: Igede
text: Ụka nya ụtụrụ bala ụka nya obyi juwa lẹnụtụrụ ọhata ọọwa.
normalised_text: uke nye uturu bala uke nye obyi juwe lenuturu ohete oowe.

name: Igede
text: Ohe Oluhye myịmyị yẹkẹẹ, Anụ ang i-hu ahịgboo ha ịwẹ, anụ hu ahịgboo ha alodehe ọlẹ wuu moo! Ọọwa lẹ, ọ lịnyị ịnyịlẹhị lẹlẹ.
normalised_text: ohe oluhye myimyi yekee, enu eng ihu ehigboo he iwe, enu hu ehigboo he elodehe ole wuu moo! oowe le, o linyi inyilehi lele.

name: Igede
text: Ohe Oluhye họ ẹnụ bala ọya bala ịdịchụ chọpịla ụ-ụwa u-uhye-ọgba kị ka hu ahịgboo ha alodehe lụka nya ẹnụ bala alodu.
normalised_text: ohe oluhye ho enu bala oye bala idichu chopile uuwe uuhyeogbe ki ke hu ehigboo he elodehe luke nye enu bala elodu.

name: Igede
text: Ụka nya ụtụrụ bala ụka nya obyi juwa lẹnụtụrụ ohene ịnyịnyị.
normalised_text: uke nye uturu bala uke nye obyi juwe lenuturu ohene inyinyi.

name: Igede
text: Ụka nya ụtụrụ bala ụka nya obyi juwa lẹnụtụrụ ọharụ ọọwa ịnyịnyị.
normalised_text: uke nye uturu bala uke nye obyi juwe lenuturu oheru oowe inyinyi.

name: Igede
text: Ụka ká Ohe Oluhye yẹ ang myị ang ịlẹ wuu kọ họ lẹ, ị họ́ọ lụmẹ. Ụka nya ụtụrụ bala ụka nya obyi juwa lẹnụtụrụ ọharwọnyẹ ọọwa ịnyịnyị.
normalised_text: uke ke ohe oluhye ye eng myi eng ile wuu ko ho le, i huo lume. uke nye uturu bala uke nye obyi juwe lenuturu oherwonye oowe inyinyi.

name: Igede
text: Ọlẹ ri jaabwọ ká Ohe Oluhye bwu họ uhye-ọgba bala odehe ọlẹ bala ang myị ang ịlẹpwụ nyaa wuu.
normalised_text: ole ri jeebwo ke ohe oluhye bwu ho uhyeogbe bala odehe ole bala eng myi eng ilepwu nyee wuu.

name: Igede
text: Ohe Oluhye wahị kụrụ ẹnụtụrụ oharwiye ọwẹ. Ọọwa, ọ hwoo nọ nya ẹnụtụrụ nya ịlọmwụ lẹlẹ. Ẹnẹwẹ ọ hịnyọ lụkụrwọ nya odehe ọlẹ wuu kọ họ lẹ.
normalised_text: ohe oluhye wehi kuru enuturu oherwiye owe. oowe, o hwoo no nye enuturu nye ilomwu lele. enewe o hinyo lukurwo nye odehe ole wuu ko ho le.

name: Igede
text: Ma, jaabwọ kọ la lụka ọọwa ri yẹkẹẹ, enyi juwa rụ bwu ẹpwụ nya ịpyị kpehe gbee kọ họ, ká ịpyị la hyẹ̀hyẹ̀ ka ẹga myị ẹga nya odehe ọlẹ wuu.
normalised_text: me, jeebwo ko le luke oowe ri yekee, enyi juwe ru bwu epwu nye ipyi kpehe gbee ko ho, ke ipyi le hyehye ke ege myi ege nye odehe ole wuu.

name: Igede
text: Ịnyị lẹ, Amkpaa Ohe Oluhye a kpa ọpyị-ọpyị me ọngịnyị ehe wuu lẹ, ọọwa lẹ, ọ dịhụ nya ọhịhị jwoo ka okwinyi lẹ, ọngịnyị ọọwa a la ọhịhị lẹlẹ.
normalised_text: inyi le, emkpee ohe oluhye e kpe opyiopyi me onginyi ehe wuu le, oowe le, o dihu nye ohihi jwoo ke okwinyi le, onginyi oowe e le ohihi lele.

name: Igede
text: Ẹnyị nya ụpa nya ihu ọọwa ọhẹ ri iPichọn. IPichọn ọọwa juwa mwụ dagaga ju ọpyị ọhẹ ọlẹ kị wụrụ ịHavila. Okpoko ịgọm juwa ọ-ọpyị nya ịHavila ọọwa.
normalised_text: enyi nye upe nye ihu oowe ohe ri ipichon. ipichon oowe juwe mwu degege ju opyi ohe ole ki wuru ihevile. okpoko igom juwe oopyi nye ihevile oowe.

name: Igede
text: Ị wụrụ ẹnyị nya ụpa oheeye nya ihu ọtụka ọọwa, iGihọn. IGihọn ọọwa juwa mwụ dagaga ju ọpyị nya iKuchi.
normalised_text: i wuru enyi nye upe oheeye nye ihu otuke oowe, igihon. igihon oowe juwe mwu degege ju opyi nye ikuchi.

name: Igede
text: Amkpaa Ohe Oluhye myịmyị byi ọlẹng ọwẹ yẹkẹẹ, M̀ hu egbe nya ekeji myị ekeji ịlẹpwụ nya ẹrụ ọlẹ wuu hang kị ka yẹ ri ang oriri nyang lẹ.
normalised_text: emkpee ohe oluhye myimyi byi oleng owe yekee, m hu egbe nye ekeji myi ekeji ilepwu nye eru ole wuu hang ki ke ye ri eng oriri nyeng le.

name: Igede
text: Ịnyị lẹ, Amkpaa Ohe Oluhye a yẹkẹẹ, Ọ́ chịla ká ọlẹng ọlẹ ka hụ ụbwọọmwụ ka. Chajị nya ọọwa lẹ, m̀ ka họ ọngọdụbwọ nyamwụ ọlẹ kọ ka pwokwoo họọ lẹ.
normalised_text: inyi le, emkpee ohe oluhye e yekee, o chile ke oleng ole ke hu ubwoomwu ke. cheji nye oowe le, m ke ho ongodubwo nyemwu ole ko ke pwokwoo hoo le.

name: Igede
text: Ọlẹng nya ọgbanyẹ ọọwa bala ahụ nyamwụ juwa la awụlẹ lọhị-lọhị. Ma, ị́ tị ju oyi nya awụlẹ kpong-kpong ka.
normalised_text: oleng nye ogbenye oowe bala ehu nyemwu juwe le ewule lohilohi. me, i ti ju oyi nye ewule kpongkpong ke.

name: Igede
text: Ọnyang ọwẹ wẹ byoo yẹkẹẹ, Ehe, Ohe Oluhye wụ ọnụ hahị yẹkẹẹ, ahị nyị ri egbe nya ekeji myị ekeji ịlẹ kịị nyị jam ẹ-ẹrụ ọlẹ wuu.
normalised_text: onyeng owe we byoo yekee, ehe, ohe oluhye wu onu hehi yekee, ehi nyi ri egbe nye ekeji myi ekeji ile kii nyi jam eeru ole wuu.

name: Igede
text: Ilo wẹ byi ọnyang ọwẹ yẹkẹẹ, Ọ mẹ ọnụ, ọ́-ri kanụ ri ugbe nya okoji ọwẹ, ánụ juwa ka gbu ịlẹhị ka.
normalised_text: ilo we byi onyeng owe yekee, o me onu, ori kenu ri ugbe nye okoji owe, enu juwe ke gbu ilehi ke.

name: Igede
text: Ịnyị lẹ, Amkpaa Ohe Oluhye a be ẹkọ wụrụ ọlẹng ọwẹ yẹkẹẹ, Adam ee! Adam ee! Ale a tị́ ji-īì.
normalised_text: inyi le, emkpee ohe oluhye e be eko wuru oleng owe yekee, adam ee! adam ee! ale e ti jiei.

name: Igede
text: Adam wẹ byoo yẹkẹẹ, Ụka ká m wo anụ nyang ká juwa warị lẹ, ọọwa, m rụ kaka kpịbaa hing lẹ, chajị m̀ ji lọhị-lọhị.
normalised_text: adam we byoo yekee, uke ke m wo enu nyeng ke juwe weri le, oowe, m ru kaka kpibee hing le, cheji m ji lohilohi.

name: Igede
text: Ohe Oluhye byoo yẹkẹẹ, Oowo a tị́ ya jeng yẹkẹẹ, ahụ nyị ji lọhị-lọhị ene-è? Lee, a tị́ hya ugbe nya okoji ọlẹ kam dang ehile u-uhye nyamwụ ri lẹ.
normalised_text: ohe oluhye byoo yekee, oowo e ti ye jeng yekee, ehu nyi ji lohilohi enee? lee, e ti hye ugbe nye okoji ole kem dang ehile uuhye nyemwu ri le.

name: Igede
text: Adam wẹ byoo yẹkẹẹ, Me ọnyang ọlẹ ká hu ham ya nyị dam ụbwọ, a tị́ hya ugbe nya okoji ọọwa ham ri.
normalised_text: adam we byoo yekee, me onyeng ole ke hu ham ye nyi dam ubwo, e ti hye ugbe nye okoji oowe ham ri.

name: Ika
text: Isi mbidọn, kẹ Chuku ke elu-igwere lẹ elu-ụwa.
normalised_text: isi mbidon, ke chuku ke eluigwere le eluuwa.

name: Ika
text: ụwa enwọnni k'ọ nọ; ụwa gbachanrịn okpokoro; elu-ụwa ile gba ishi kitikpọ. Mmọn Chuku hụ a ghahunmẹ elu mirin hụn jun ụzọ ile.
normalised_text: uwa engwonni ko no; uwa gbachanrin okpokoro; eluuwa ile gba ishi kitikpo. mmon chuku hu a ghahunme elu mirin hun jun uzo ile.

name: Ika
text: Chuku e lee ukpẹ ahụn, ọ hụn a nị ukpẹ ahụn hụ mma. Chuku nọ kebepụ ukpẹ ahụn lẹ ishi.
normalised_text: chuku e lee ukpe ahun, o hun a ni ukpe ahun hu mma. chuku no kebepu ukpe ahun le ishi.

name: Ika
text: Chuku nọ kpọ ukpẹ ahụn efinaị, kpọ ishi ahụn uhinhin. Uhinhin a gharị, efinaị a gharị: ọhụn wụ ụhụọhịn ibuzọ.
normalised_text: chuku no kpo ukpe ahun efinai, kpo ishi ahun uhinhin. uhinhin a ghari, efinai a ghari ohun wu uhuohin ibuzo.

name: Ika
text: Chuku nọzị sị, Oghe ya rị mirinni n'ọ hụn ụzọ kebe ẹ ẹbụọ.
normalised_text: chuku nozi si, oghe ya ri mirinni no hun uzo kebe e ebuo.

name: Ika
text: Chuku e mẹmẹ oghe hụ, gi ẹ kebe mirin ahụn ụzọ ẹbụọ: hụn rị okpuru oghe lẹ hụn rị elu oghe. Ọ nọ rị ẹrịra.
normalised_text: chuku e meme oghe hu, gi e kebe mirin ahun uzo ebuo hun ri okpuru oghe le hun ri elu oghe. o no ri erira.

name: Ika
text: Ya Chuku nọ kpọ oghe ahụn elu-igwere. Uhinhin a gharị, efinaị a gharị: ọhụn mẹ ẹ akpọhịn ẹbụọ.
normalised_text: ya chuku no kpo oghe ahun eluigwere. uhinhin a ghari, efinai a ghari ohun me e akpohin ebuo.

name: Ika
text: Chuku nọzị sị, Mirin ile rị okpuru ogheni ya kụrụ ụzọ ohu; akpakalị ya pụha. Ọ nọ rị ẹrịra.
normalised_text: chuku nozi si, mirin ile ri okpuru ogheni ya kuru uzo ohu; akpakali ya puha. o no ri erira.

name: Ika
text: Chuku nọ kpọ alị kọrọnị akpakalị, kpọ mirin ahụn ile kụrụnị, ohimin. Chuku e lee wẹ, ọ nọ hụn a nị ọ hụ mma.
normalised_text: chuku no kpo ali koroni akpakali, kpo mirin ahun ile kuruni, ohimin. chuku e lee we, o no hun a ni o hu mma.

name: Ika
text: Uhinhin a gharị, efinaị a gharị: ọhụn mẹ ẹ akpọhịn ẹtọ.
normalised_text: uhinhin a ghari, efinai a ghari ohun me e akpohin eto.

name: Ika
text: Chuku nịzị sị, Ukpẹ ya rị oghe ahụn wụ igwere kẹni wẹ hụn ụzọ a kebe efinnaị lẹ uhinhin, lẹzi ni wẹ e gi wẹ a gụn ogẹn lẹ ụhụọhịn lẹ ahụa;.
normalised_text: chuku nizi si, ukpe ya ri oghe ahun wu igwere keni we hun uzo a kebe efinnai le uhinhin, lezi ni we e gi we a gun ogen le uhuohin le ahua;.

name: Ika
text: ukpẹ ndịnị wẹ nọdịsọnmẹ oghe ahụn wụ igwere, e nwunye imẹ ụwa. Ọ nọ mẹ —.
normalised_text: ukpe ndini we nodisonme oghe ahun wu igwere, e ngwunye ime uwa. o no me.

name: Ika
text: Chuku e mẹmẹ ukpẹ ẹbụọ hi ogbe: ukpẹ hụn kanị hụn k'a rị e nwun efinnaị lẹ ukpẹ hụn nta hụn k'a rị e nwun imẹ uhinhin lẹzi kokisẹ.
normalised_text: chuku e meme ukpe ebuo hi ogbe ukpe hun kani hun ka ri e ngwun efinnai le ukpe hun nta hun ka ri e ngwun ime uhinhin lezi kokise.

name: Ika
text: Chuku bu ukpẹ ndịnị che imẹ oghe ahụn wụ igwere kẹni wẹ gha ebẹhụ e nwunye elu ụwa.
normalised_text: chuku bu ukpe ndini che ime oghe ahun wu igwere keni we gha ebehu e ngwunye elu uwa.

name: Ika
text: e nwun efinaị lẹ uhinhin, e kebe ukpẹ lẹ ishi. Chuku e lee wẹ, ọ nọ hụn a nị wẹ hụ mma.
normalised_text: e ngwun efinai le uhinhin, e kebe ukpe le ishi. chuku e lee we, o no hun a ni we hu mma.

name: Ika
text: Uhinhin a gharị, efinaị a gharị: ọhụn mẹ ẹ akpọhịn ẹnọ.
normalised_text: uhinhin a ghari, efinai a ghari ohun me e akpohin eno.

name: Ika
text: Chuku nọzị sị, Ihiẹn rị ichẹn-ichẹn rị ndụn ya jun imẹ mirin; nnụnụ ya junzikwọ elu, e fehunmẹ.
normalised_text: chuku nozi si, ihien ri ichenichen ri ndun ya jun ime mirin; nnunu ya junzikwo elu, e fehunme.

name: Ika
text: Chuku nị gọzi wẹ, sị wẹ, Mụ nị ụmụ; mụba nị; jun ni ohimin ile. Nnụnụ ya junzikwọ imẹ ụwa ile.
normalised_text: chuku ni gozi we, si we, mu ni umu; muba ni; jun ni ohimin ile. nnunu ya junzikwo ime uwa ile.

name: Ika
text: Uhinhin a gharị, efinaị a gharị: ọhụn mẹ ẹ akpọhịn isẹn.
normalised_text: uhinhin a ghari, efinai a ghari ohun me e akpohin isen.

name: Ika
text: Chuku nọ ke ụdị anụ-ọfịa ile a kpa alị lẹ ụdị anụ-ụlọ ile kezikwọ ụdị ihiẹn ile a rịhunmẹ alị. Chuku e lee wẹ, ọ nọ hụn a n'ọ hụ mma.
normalised_text: chuku no ke udi anuofia ile a kpa ali le udi anuulo ile kezikwo udi ihien ile a rihunme ali. chuku e lee we, o no hun a no hu mma.

name: Ika
text: Chuku nọ nwan ke ịhịan, o yi ẹ; Chuku leri enwẹn ẹ ke ẹ — okẹn lẹ onyẹnnyẹ k'o ke wẹ.
normalised_text: chuku no ngwan ke ihian, o yi e; chuku leri engwen e ke e oken le onyennye ko ke we.

name: Ika
text: Chuku nọzị sị, Lee ẹ, e yegụọ m ụnụ ihiẹn ile rị elu-ụwa hụn e pu alị a mị mkpụrụ, ya lẹ osisi ndị a mị ogbe nwọn mkpụrụ: e ri ni wẹ.
normalised_text: chuku nozi si, lee e, e yeguo m unu ihien ile ri eluuwa hun e pu ali a mi mkpuru, ya le osisi ndi a mi ogbe ngwon mkpuru e ri ni we.

name: Ika
text: Chuku e lee ihiẹn ile o ke, ọ nọ hụn a nị wẹ ile a rịka mma. Uhinhin a gharị, efinaị a gharị: ọhụn mẹ ẹ akpọhịn isin.
normalised_text: chuku e lee ihien ile o ke, o no hun a ni we ile a rika mma. uhinhin a ghari, efinai a ghari ohun me e akpohin isin.

name: Ika
text: Ẹrịra kẹ Osolobuẹ dọn kechanrịn elu-igwere lẹ elu-ụwa lẹ ihiẹn ile rị imẹ wẹ.
normalised_text: erira ke osolobue don kechanrin eluigwere le eluuwa le ihien ile ri ime we.

name: Ika
text: Nke akpọhịn ẹsa, makẹni Chuku a rụngụọ ọrụn a, ọ nọ zu ikẹn ọrụn ile ọ rụn.
normalised_text: nke akpohin esa, makeni chuku a runguo orun a, o no zu iken orun ile o run.

name: Ika
text: Ya kẹ Chuku nọ gọzi ụhụọhịn nke ẹsa, dọn ẹ nsọ, makẹni ụhụọhịn hụ kẹ Chuku zu ikẹn ọrụn okike ile ọ rụn.
normalised_text: ya ke chuku no gozi uhuohin nke esa, don e nso, makeni uhuohin hu ke chuku zu iken orun okike ile o run.

name: Ika
text: Ọnwan wụ ihiẹn mẹ ogẹn Osolobuẹ wụ Chuku gi ke elu-igwere lẹ elu-ụwa: Ogẹn Osolobuẹ gi kegụ alị lẹ igwere.
normalised_text: ongwan wu ihien me ogen osolobue wu chuku gi ke eluigwere le eluuwa ogen osolobue gi kegu ali le igwere.

name: Ika
text: ihiẹn eke pu alị, kẹ ẹfịfịa rị ọfịa kẹ ihiẹn ọnụ e ri, makẹni Osolobuẹ wụ Chuku eke mẹ mirin zueye alị; o ke nwọnzikwọ onyẹ k'a rụn a ugbo.
normalised_text: ihien eke pu ali, ke efifia ri ofia ke ihien onu e ri, makeni osolobue wu chuku eke me mirin zueye ali; o ke ngwonzikwo onye ka run a ugbo.

name: Ika
text: Imẹ alị kẹ mirin a gha a pụha, e ru akpakalị ile.
normalised_text: ime ali ke mirin a gha a puha, e ru akpakali ile.

name: Ika
text: Ya kẹ Osolobuẹ wụ Chuku nọ gi ẹjan rị alị kpụ ịhịan, ọ nị kwọn uzun wẹ gi a rị ndụn ye ẹ imi, ịhịan nọ wụrụ onyẹ rị ndụn.
normalised_text: ya ke osolobue wu chuku no gi ejan ri ali kpu ihian, o ni kwon uzun we gi a ri ndun ye e imi, ihian no wuru onye ri ndun.

name: Ikizu
text: Ganʉ nego amariina gi ikishoko kɨnʉ Yɨɨsu Kiriisitʉ aaruuriirɨ. Yɨɨsu Kiriisitʉ akarwɨra murwibhʉrʉ rwʉ ʉmʉtɨmi Daudi ni ikishoko cha Abhurahaamu.
normalised_text: ganu nego amariina gi ikishoko kinu yiisu kiriisitu aaruuriiri. yiisu kiriisitu akarwira murwivuru rwu umutimi daudi ni ikishoko cha avurahaamu.

name: Ikizu
text: Abhurahaamu akiibhʉra Iisaka, Iisaka akiibhʉra Yaakobho, Yaakobho akiibhʉra Yuuda na abhahiiri bhaazɨ.
normalised_text: avurahaamu akiivura iisaka, iisaka akiivura yaakovo, yaakovo akiivura yuuda na avahiiri vaazi.

name: Ikizu
text: Yuuda akiibhʉra Pɨrɨɨsi na Zeera kwa Tamaari, Pɨrɨɨsi akiibhʉra Hɨzirʉʉni, Hɨzirʉʉni akiibhʉra Araamu.
normalised_text: yuuda akiivura piriisi na zeera kwa tamaari, piriisi akiivura hiziruuni, hiziruuni akiivura araamu.

name: Ikizu
text: Araamu akiibhʉra Aminadaabhu, Aminadaabhu akiibhʉra Nashʉni, Nashʉni akiibhʉra Sarimʉʉni.
normalised_text: araamu akiivura aminadaavu, aminadaavu akiivura nashuni, nashuni akiivura sarimuuni.

name: Ikizu
text: Sarimʉʉni akiibhʉra Bhoowazi kwa Rahaabhu, Bhoowazi akiibhʉra Ʉbhɨɨdi kwa Ruutu, Ʉbhɨɨdi akiibhʉra Yeese.
normalised_text: sarimuuni akiivura voowazi kwa rahaavu, voowazi akiivura uviidi kwa ruutu, uviidi akiivura yeese.

name: Ikizu
text: na Yeese akiibhʉra ʉmʉtɨmi Daudi. Daudi akiibhʉra Sɨrɨmaani kʉmʉkari wʉnʉ aarɨ kʉbha ʉmʉkari wa Uriya.
normalised_text: na yeese akiivura umutimi daudi. daudi akiivura sirimaani kumukari wunu aari kuva umukari wa uriya.

name: Ikizu
text: Sɨrɨmaani akiibhʉra Rehobhowamu, Rehobhowamu akiibhʉra Abhiya, Abhiya akiibhʉra Asa.
normalised_text: sirimaani akiivura rehovowamu, rehovowamu akiivura aviya, aviya akiivura asa.

name: Ikizu
text: Asa akiibhʉra Yehoshafaati, Yehoshafaati akiibhʉra Yoraamu, Yoraamu akiibhʉra Uziya.
normalised_text: asa akiivura yehoshafaati, yehoshafaati akiivura yoraamu, yoraamu akiivura uziya.

name: Ikizu
text: Uziya akiibhʉra Yosamu, Yosamu akiibhʉra Ahaazi, Ahaazi akiibhʉra Hɨzɨkiya.
normalised_text: uziya akiivura yosamu, yosamu akiivura ahaazi, ahaazi akiivura hizikiya.

name: Ikizu
text: Hɨzɨkiya akiibhʉra Manaasɨ, Manaasɨ akiibhʉra Amʉni, Amʉni akiibhʉra Yʉsiya.
normalised_text: hizikiya akiivura manaasi, manaasi akiivura amuni, amuni akiivura yusiya.

name: Ikizu
text: na Yʉsiya akiibhʉra Yɨkʉniya na bhaumwabhʉ. Ribhaga rɨkahɨta, Abhiiziraɨri bhakagwatwa, bhakahirwa mobhohocha mucharʉ cha Bhaabhɨɨri.
normalised_text: na yusiya akiivura yikuniya na vaumwavu. rivaga rikahita, aviizirairi vakagwatwa, vakahirwa movohocha mucharu cha vaaviiri.

name: Ikizu
text: Hanʉ Abhiiziraɨri bhaamarirɨ kʉsaamibhwa iyo, Yɨkʉniya akiibhʉra Sheyaritiyɨri, Sheyaritiyɨri akiibhʉra Zɨrubhabhɨɨri.
normalised_text: hanu aviizirairi vaamariri kusaamivwa iyo, yikuniya akiivura sheyaritiyiri, sheyaritiyiri akiivura ziruvaviiri.

name: Ikizu
text: Zɨrubhabhɨɨri akiibhʉra Abhihudi, Abhihudi akiibhʉra Ɨriyakimu, Ɨriyakimu akiibhʉra Azʉri.
normalised_text: ziruvaviiri akiivura avihudi, avihudi akiivura iriyakimu, iriyakimu akiivura azuri.

name: Ikizu
text: Azʉri akiibhʉra Zadʉki, Zadʉki akiibhʉra Akimu, Akimu akiibhʉra Ɨriudi.
normalised_text: azuri akiivura zaduki, zaduki akiivura akimu, akimu akiivura iriudi.

name: Ikizu
text: Ɨriudi akiibhʉra Ɨrɨazaari, Ɨrɨazaari akiibhʉra Matani, Matani akiibhʉra Yaakobho.
normalised_text: iriudi akiivura iriazaari, iriazaari akiivura matani, matani akiivura yaakovo.

name: Ikizu
text: Yaakobho akiibhʉra Yuusufu, umusubhɨ wa Mariyamu, na Mariyamu akiibhʉra Yɨɨsu wʉnʉ akubhirikirwa Kiriisitʉ.
normalised_text: yaakovo akiivura yuusufu, umusuvi wa mariyamu, na mariyamu akiivura yiisu wunu akuvirikirwa kiriisitu.

name: Ikizu
text: Yuusufu umusubhɨ waazɨ, aarɨ ʉmʉʉtʉ we eheene mʉbhʉtangɨ bhwa Mungu. Atɨɨndirɨ asuuchɨ Mariyamu, kʉgayo akeenda amwangɨ kimbisi.
normalised_text: yuusufu umusuvi waazi, aari umuutu we eheene muvutangi vwa mungu. atiindiri asuuchi mariyamu, kugayo akeenda amwangi kimbisi.

name: Ikizu
text: Ariibhʉra umwana wi ikisubhɨ, naawɨ ʉmʉrʉkɨ Yɨɨsu, kʉ kʉbha wuyo newe araasabhʉrɨ abhaatʉ bhaazɨ kurwa mʉbhʉbhɨ bhwabhʉ.
normalised_text: ariivura umwana wi ikisuvi, naawi umuruki yiisu, ku kuva wuyo newe araasavuri avaatu vaazi kurwa muvuvi vwavu.

name: Ikizu
text: Gayo gʉʉsi gaakʉriibhwɨ, korereke rɨbhɨ ringʼana rɨnʉ Ʉmʉkʉrʉ Mungu aagambirɨ kʉnzɨra yʉ ʉmʉrʉʉtɨrɨri kʉbha.
normalised_text: gayo guusi gaakuriivwi, korereke rivi ringana rinu umukuru mungu aagambiri kunzira yu umuruutiriri kuva.

name: Ikizu
text: Rora, umusiiti aragega ɨnda, neewe ariibhʉra umwana wi ikisubhɨ. Ararukwa Ɨmaanwɨri. Enzobhooro yaku, Mungu hamwɨmwɨ na niitwɨ.
normalised_text: rora, umusiiti aragega inda, neewe ariivura umwana wi ikisuvi. ararukwa imaanwiri. enzovooro yaku, mungu hamwimwi na niitwi.

name: Ikizu
text: Hanʉ Yuusufu aabhuukirɨ, akakora chɨmbu maraika wʉ Ʉmʉkʉrʉ Mungu aamubhuuriirɨ. Akakwɨra Mariyamu.
normalised_text: hanu yuusufu aavuukiri, akakora chimbu maraika wu umukuru mungu aamuvuuriiri. akakwira mariyamu.

name: Ikizu
text: nawe atarɨɨrɨ neewe kuhika hanʉ Mariyamu iitʉʉrɨɨnʼyɨ. Akamʉrʉka umwana wuyo, Yɨɨsu.
normalised_text: nawe atariiri neewe kuhika hanu mariyamu iituuriinyi. akamuruka umwana wuyo, yiisu.

name: Ikizu
text: Hanʉ ʉmʉtɨmi Heroode iigwirɨ amangʼana gaabhʉ, akahaha, hamwɨmwɨ na abhaatʉ bhʉʉsi bha Yɨrusarɨɨmu.
normalised_text: hanu umutimi heroode iigwiri amangana gaavu, akahaha, hamwimwi na avaatu vuusi va yirusariimu.

name: Ikizu
text: Neho Heroode akabhiringa abhakʉrʉ bhʉʉsi bha abhakuhaani na abhiija bhi imigirʉ ja Musa, akabhabhuurya, Kiriisitʉ ariibhurwa hayi.
normalised_text: neho heroode akaviringa avakuru vuusi va avakuhaani na aviija vi imigiru ja musa, akavavuurya, kiriisitu ariivurwa hayi.

name: Ikizu
text: Bhakamʉgarukirya, Ariibhurwa mʉrʉbhɨri rwa Bhɨtɨrɨhɨɨmu mucharʉ cha Yudeya. Tʉmɨnyirɨ riyo, kʉ kʉbha Mungu akagamba kʉhɨtɨra ʉmʉrʉʉtɨrɨri kʉbha.
normalised_text: vakamugarukirya, ariivurwa muruviri rwa vitirihiimu mucharu cha yudeya. tuminyiri riyo, ku kuva mungu akagamba kuhitira umuruutiriri kuva.

name: Ikizu
text: Neho Heroode akabhɨrɨkɨra abhamɨnyi bha zenzota bhayo kwa mbisi, korereke bhaazɨ bhamʉbhʉʉrɨrɨ bhwaheene ribhaga rɨnʉ bhaarʉʉzɨ enzota.
normalised_text: neho heroode akavirikira avaminyi va zenzota vayo kwa mbisi, korereke vaazi vamuvuuriri vwaheene rivaga rinu vaaruuzi enzota.

name: Ikizu
text: Hanʉ bhaarʉʉzɨ enzota yiyo, bhakazomerwa bhʉkʉngʼu.
normalised_text: hanu vaaruuzi enzota yiyo, vakazomerwa vukungu.

name: Ikizu
text: Mmbe, Mungu akabhahama mobherooto kʉbha, bhatagarʉka kwikɨ kwa Heroode. Bhakahʉrʉkɨra ɨnzɨra yɨndɨ kʉgarʉka ɨwaabhʉ.
normalised_text: mmbe, mungu akavahama moverooto kuva, vatagaruka kwiki kwa heroode. vakahurukira inzira yindi kugaruka iwaavu.

name: Ikizu
text: Mmbe, Yuusufu akabhʉʉka ubhutikʉ bhuyobhuyo, akagega mʉkaazɨ nu umwana, akangʼosera Miisiri.
normalised_text: mmbe, yuusufu akavuuka uvutiku vuyovuyo, akagega mukaazi nu umwana, akangosera miisiri.

name: Ikizu
text: Neho rɨkabha ringʼana rɨnʉ ʉmʉrʉʉtɨrɨri Yɨrɨmiya aagambirɨ.
normalised_text: neho rikava ringana rinu umuruutiriri yirimiya aagambiri.

name: Ikoma-Nata-Isenye
text: Ghano nigho amariina gha rwibhoro ro Yesu Kirisito uno arweriire mo‑rwibhoro ro mutëmi Tawuti o mo‑rwibhoro ro Abhurahamu .
normalised_text: ghano nigho amariina gha rwivoro ro yesu kirisito uno arweriire morwivoro ro mutemi tawuti o morwivoro ro avurahamu.

name: Ikoma-Nata-Isenye
text: Abhurahamu namwibhwire Isaka, Isaka akiibhora Yakobho, Yakobho akiibhora Yuuta na bhaömööbhö.
normalised_text: avurahamu namwivwire isaka, isaka akiivora yakovo, yakovo akiivora yuuta na vaomoovo.

name: Ikoma-Nata-Isenye
text: Yuuta akiibhora Bhereesi na Seera gho Tamaari, Bhereesi akiibhora Hesirooni, Hesirooni akiibhora Araamu.
normalised_text: yuuta akiivora vereesi na seera gho tamaari, vereesi akiivora hesirooni, hesirooni akiivora araamu.

name: Ikoma-Nata-Isenye
text: Araamu akiibhora Aminataabhu, Aminataabhu akiibhora Nashooni, Nashooni akiibhora Sarimooni.
normalised_text: araamu akiivora aminataavu, aminataavu akiivora nashooni, nashooni akiivora sarimooni.

name: Ikoma-Nata-Isenye
text: Sarimooni akiibhora Bhowaasi kwo Rahaabhu, Bhowaasi akiibhora Obheeti kwo Ruutu, Obheeti akiibhora Yeese.
normalised_text: sarimooni akiivora vowaasi kwo rahaavu, vowaasi akiivora oveeti kwo ruutu, oveeti akiivora yeese.

name: Ikoma-Nata-Isenye
text: na Yeese akiibhora omutëmi Tawuti. Tawuti akiibhora Seremaani kwo mukari uno are muka Huriya.
normalised_text: na yeese akiivora omutemi tawuti. tawuti akiivora seremaani kwo mukari uno are muka huriya.

name: Ikoma-Nata-Isenye
text: Seremaani akiibhora Rehobhowamu, Rehobhowamu akiibhora Abhiya, Abhiya akiibhora Asa.
normalised_text: seremaani akiivora rehovowamu, rehovowamu akiivora aviya, aviya akiivora asa.

name: Ikoma-Nata-Isenye
text: Asa akiibhora Yehoshabhaati, Yehoshabhaati akiibhora Yoraamu, Yoraamu akiibhora Usiya.
normalised_text: asa akiivora yehoshavaati, yehoshavaati akiivora yoraamu, yoraamu akiivora usiya.

name: Ikoma-Nata-Isenye
text: Usiya akiibhora Yotaamu, Yotaamu akiibhora Ahaasi, Ahaasi akiibhora Hesekiya.
normalised_text: usiya akiivora yotaamu, yotaamu akiivora ahaasi, ahaasi akiivora hesekiya.

name: Ikoma-Nata-Isenye
text: Hesekiya akiibhora Manase, Manase akiibhora Amooni, na Amooni akiibhora Yosiya.
normalised_text: hesekiya akiivora manase, manase akiivora amooni, na amooni akiivora yosiya.

name: Ikoma-Nata-Isenye
text: Yosiya akiibhora Yekoniya na bhaömööbhö, eriibhagha riyo niryo Abhayahuuti bhaahiruru mo‑saama iyo Bhabheeri .
normalised_text: yosiya akiivora yekoniya na vaomoovo, eriivagha riyo niryo avayahuuti vaahiruru mosaama iyo vaveeri.

name: Ikoma-Nata-Isenye
text: Wiiki, hano bhaare iyo, Yekoniya akiibhora Sherateeri, Sherateeri akiibhora Serubhabheeri.
normalised_text: wiiki, hano vaare iyo, yekoniya akiivora sherateeri, sherateeri akiivora seruvaveeri.

name: Ikoma-Nata-Isenye
text: Serubhabheeri akiibhora Abhihuuti, Abhihuuti akiibhora Eriyaakimu, Eriyaakimu akiibhora Asoori.
normalised_text: seruvaveeri akiivora avihuuti, avihuuti akiivora eriyaakimu, eriyaakimu akiivora asoori.

name: Ikoma-Nata-Isenye
text: Asoori akiibhora Satooki, Satooki akiibhora Akimu, Akimu akiibhora Eriwuti.
normalised_text: asoori akiivora satooki, satooki akiivora akimu, akimu akiivora eriwuti.

name: Ikoma-Nata-Isenye
text: Eriwuti akiibhora Ereyasaari, Ereyasaari akiibhora Matani, na Matani akiibhora Yakobho.
normalised_text: eriwuti akiivora ereyasaari, ereyasaari akiivora matani, na matani akiivora yakovo.

name: Ikoma-Nata-Isenye
text: Yakobho akiibhora Yusubhu, omosubhe o Mariyamu. Mariyamu akiibhora Yesu uno akobherekeru Kirisito.
normalised_text: yakovo akiivora yusuvu, omosuve o mariyamu. mariyamu akiivora yesu uno akoverekeru kirisito.

name: Ikoma-Nata-Isenye
text: Amare gho kubha Yusubhu, omosubhe waache naare omooto omuhëënë ambërë e Ryobha, tëëndiri amosooki Mariyamu. Niho ihëëbhiri komotigha gho kebhisere.
normalised_text: amare gho kuva yusuvu, omosuve waache naare omooto omuheene ambere e ryova, teendiri amosooki mariyamu. niho iheeviri komotigha gho kevisere.

name: Ikoma-Nata-Isenye
text: Nakwibhora omoona o ghesiite, niiye omoroke eriina reeche Yesu, gho kubha niwe akobhatoori abhaato bhaache koru mo‑masari ghaabho.
normalised_text: nakwivora omoona o ghesiite, niiye omoroke eriina reeche yesu, gho kuva niwe akovatoori avaato vaache koru momasari ghaavo.

name: Ikoma-Nata-Isenye
text: Ghoose ghayo ꞉ngaaköruru kubha ehikeerane angʼana ino Omutëmi Waryobha abhughiri gho nchëra e murööti waache kubha.
normalised_text: ghoose ghayo ngaakoruru kuva ehikeerane angana ino omutemi waryova avughiri gho nchera e murooti waache kuva.

name: Ikoma-Nata-Isenye
text: Hano Yusubhu abhookiri koru mo‑chandöörö, aghaköra kinya marayika o Mutëmi are amobhooriire. Yusubhu akamokwira Mariyamu.
normalised_text: hano yusuvu avookiri koru mochandooro, aghakora kinya marayika o mutemi are amovooriire. yusuvu akamokwira mariyamu.

name: Ikoma-Nata-Isenye
text: amare taamisiri nawe mbagha hano Mariyamu ꞉ibhwire omoona uyo o ghesubhe. Yusubhu akamoroka omoona uyo Yesu.
normalised_text: amare taamisiri nawe mbagha hano mariyamu ivwire omoona uyo o ghesuve. yusuvu akamoroka omoona uyo yesu.

name: Ikoma-Nata-Isenye
text: Bhakabhoori, Hayi anyi uno ibhwiru Omutëmi o Bhayahuuti? Ntoyerooche anchöta yaache erarwera roghoro, gho ghayo, ntwichiri komusëngëra.
normalised_text: vakavoori, hayi anyi uno ivwiru omutemi o vayahuuti? ntoyerooche anchota yaache erarwera roghoro, gho ghayo, ntwichiri komusengera.

name: Ikoma-Nata-Isenye
text: Hano omutëmi Herote oghwire amangʼana ghayo, aghiitumata, haghirohamu na abhaato bhoose bha Yerusareemu.
normalised_text: hano omutemi herote oghwire amangana ghayo, aghiitumata, haghirohamu na avaato voose va yerusareemu.

name: Ikoma-Nata-Isenye
text: Niho aghakoma abhakoro bha bhachaama bhoose na abheeghi bha meghiro , akabhabhoori akabhugha, Kirisito hayi akwibhoru.
normalised_text: niho aghakoma avakoro va vachaama voose na aveeghi va meghiro, akavavoori akavugha, kirisito hayi akwivoru.

name: Ikoma-Nata-Isenye
text: Niho Herote akabhabherekera abhamënyi bha chanchöta bhayo gho kobhisa kubha bhaache bhamobhoorere obhuhëënë n‑eriibhagha ke bharooche anchöta yiire.
normalised_text: niho herote akavaverekera avamenyi va chanchota vayo gho kovisa kuva vaache vamovoorere ovuheene neriivagha ke varooche anchota yiire.

name: Ikoma-Nata-Isenye
text: Hano bharooche anchöta yiire, bhaghachömëru chwee.
normalised_text: hano varooche anchota yiire, vaghachomeru chwee.

name: Ikoma-Nata-Isenye
text: Rekamara, Eryobha rekabhashaangʼi mo‑riröötö kubha bhatagharuka wiiki o‑Herote. Gho ghayo, bhaghagharuka bhowaabho gho kohetera anchëra ayende.
normalised_text: rekamara, eryova rekavashaangi morirooto kuva vatagharuka wiiki oherote. gho ghayo, vaghagharuka vowaavo gho kohetera anchera ayende.

name: Ikoma-Nata-Isenye
text: Niho Yusubhu akabhooka, akiimoki omukari waache no omoona, obhotiko bhuyo bhuyo bhaaghaye Miisiri.
normalised_text: niho yusuvu akavooka, akiimoki omukari waache no omoona, ovotiko vuyo vuyo vaaghaye miisiri.

name: Ikoma-Nata-Isenye
text: Niho ꞉ehikeriine angʼana yiire ighamburu no omurööti Yeremiya kubha.
normalised_text: niho ehikeriine angana yiire ighamburu no omurooti yeremiya kuva.

name: Ikoma-Nata-Isenye
text: Hano Herote akuure, mööhi, marayika o Mutëmi Waryobha akamorwera Yusubhu mo‑riröötö iyo Miisiri.
normalised_text: hano herote akuure, moohi, marayika o mutemi waryova akamorwera yusuvu morirooto iyo miisiri.

name: Ikwerre
text: Ọkwukwo osnusno ọmumu Jizọsi Karaịsi, nnwọ Devidi, nnwọ Ebereham.
normalised_text: okwukwo osnusno omumu jizosi karaisi, nnwo devidi, nnwo ebereham.

name: Ikwerre
text: Ebereham mụrnu Aziki, Aziki mụhia Jekọpu, Jekọpu mụhia Juda nụ rụmu nne a.
normalised_text: ebereham murnu aziki, aziki muhia jekopu, jekopu muhia juda nu rumu nne a.

name: Ikwerre

name: Ikwerre

name: Ikwo

name: Ikwo
text: Nchileke abya elee ẹnya; phụ iphemiphe ọbule, o meru; yọ dụkota mma. Nchi abya ejihu; bya abọhu. Ono abụru mbọku k'ishingu.

name: Ila
text: Jakobo wakazhala Jozefu mulumi Maliya wezo wakazhala Jeso uutewa ati Kilisito.

name: Ila
text: Ukaambo kakuti Jozefu mulumi kali muntu ululeme, wiina kuzanda kumusampula kaanzambwene, wakayana muzeezo wakumuleka kumabali buumwine.
normalised_text: ukaambo kakuti jozefu mulumi kali muntu ululeme, wiina kuzanda kumusampula kaanzambwene, wakayana muzeezo wakumuleka kumabali buumwine.

name: Ila
text: Ulakazhala mwana mweembezhi ngukaaulika izhina lya Jeso, nkaambo ulakanununa bantu kuhwa ku shibi shabo.

name: Ila
text: Sheshi shoonse shakacitika kuzuzucizha ngaakaamba Mwami kwiita mu mushinshimi Aizaya aakuti.

name: Ila
text: Nakalindu ulakemita, ulakazhala mwana mweembezhi ngubakaaulika ati Imanuwelo calo caamba ati, Leza uli aswe.
normalised_text: nakalindu ulakemita, ulakazhala mwana mweembezhi ngubakaaulika ati imanuwelo chalo chaamba ati, leza uli aswe.

name: Ila
text: Naakabuka Jozefu wakacita ceco anjelo wa Leza ncaakalailila u kumukokola Maliya.
normalised_text: naakabuka jozefu wakachita checho anjelo wa leza nchaakalailila u kumukokola maliya.

name: Ila
text: Pele bayina nibakaswaangana kushikila naakamuzhala mweembezhi amane wamuulika izhina ati ngu Jeso.

name: Ila
text: Nibakashika bakabuzha ati, Ulikwi wezo wakazhalwa Mwami waba Juda? Nkaambo tweebona intongwezhi yakwe kwiwe, ubobo tweza kumukomba.

name: Ila
text: Ateelele bobo mwami Helodi, wakapenga mu monzo cini cini ubamu Jelusalemu boonse.

name: Ila
text: Ngoonaawo wakababunganya bapaizhi bakando u balembi ba bantu, wakababuzha buzha koko nkwaakaakweelele kuzhalilwa Munanike wa Leza.

name: Ila
text: Bakamwaambila ati, Mu Betelehemu mucishi ca Judiya nkaambo imbubo mbwaakalemba mushinshimi ati.

name: Ila
text: Ngoonaawo mwami Helodi wakabeta babo balombwana basongo kumabali ukubabuzha buzha intongwezhi nibakeebona.

name: Ila
text: Amane wakabatuma ku Betelehemu u malailile akuti, Kamuya mukamukapule kabotu mwana, mwakamuyana mwize muŋambile kwaamba ame nkamukombe.

name: Ila
text: Inzho nibakateelela bobo bakaya, ngoonaawo intongwezhi njibakaakubwene kwiwe yakeendela kumbele mpaka mwini niyakaya kuzhima awo akaakuli mwana.

name: Ila
text: Intongwezhi niyakazhima awo bakabotelwa cini cini.

name: Iraqw
text: Iimu/uungo Mungú doori nee yaamu ngiwa tleéhh.
normalised_text: iimuuungo mungu doori nee yaamu ngiwa tleeh.

name: Iraqw
text: Mungú iri oó', «Gwa/aateema i deeruutiye'.» Nee gwa/aateema niri deeruutiyé'.
normalised_text: mungu iri oo, "gwaaateema i deeruutiye." nee gwaaateema niri deeruutiye.

name: Iraqw
text: Mungú gwa/aateema ngiwa ár, nguri qwal/atisiyé'. Naagáy Mungú gwa/aateema nee giwti giri paraátl.
normalised_text: mungu gwaaateema ngiwa ar, nguri qwalatisiye. naagay mungu gwaaateema nee giwti giri paraatl.

name: Iraqw
text: Gwa/aateema giri báy Tlaatla/aangw, nee giwti gari báy Xweera. Tay tsiindo, tay matlaatle, tari baalár geera.
normalised_text: gwaaateema giri bay tlaatlaaangw, nee giwti gari bay khweera. tay tsiindo, tay matlaatle, tari baalar geera.

name: Iraqw
text: Mungú iri oó', «Kaandaftá gawit i tleehharut baraá tla/ángw ma'aay, as ma'aay ngiwa paratl.».
normalised_text: mungu iri oo, "kaandafta gawit i tleeharut baraa tlaangw maaay, as maaay ngiwa paratl.".

name: Iraqw
text: Adoodá' iri tleehharút. Mungú kaandaftadá' gari tleéhh, ma'aay giri paraátl, kuqá' gawaá daanduú kaandafi, kuqá' baraá guruú kaandafi.
normalised_text: adooda iri tleeharut. mungu kaandaftada gari tleeh, maaay giri paraatl, kuqa gawaa daanduu kaandafi, kuqa baraa guruu kaandafi.

name: Iraqw
text: Mungú kaandaftadá' gari báy «Doori». Tay tsiindo tay matlaatle, tari baalár tsár.
normalised_text: mungu kaandaftada gari bay "doori". tay tsiindo tay matlaatle, tari baalar tsar.

name: Iraqw
text: Mungú iri oó', «Ma'aá dooriwo baraay i burumburiitiye' dír wák as yaamaá kaahaar iwa geehhouya'.» Adoodá' iri tleehharút.
normalised_text: mungu iri oo, "maaa dooriwo baraay i burumburiitiye dir wak as yaamaa kaahaar iwa geehouya." adooda iri tleeharut.

name: Iraqw
text: Mungú didá' kaahaar gari báy Yaamu, didá' ma'aay ni burumburiitiyé' gari báy Tlawi. Mungú adoodá' aa tleéhh gari ár naxés ka hhoohhoo'.
normalised_text: mungu dida kaahaar gari bay yaamu, dida maaay ni burumburiitiye gari bay tlawi. mungu adooda aa tleeh gari ar nakhes ka hoohoo.

name: Iraqw
text: Muruuwí gwa/aateemaá duxuúm masók i gawaá doorí dirii', as iwa gwa/aati baraá yaamií alé.» Adoodá' iri tleehharút.
normalised_text: muruuwi gwaaateemaa dukhuum masok i gawaa doori dirii, as iwa gwaaati baraa yaamii ale." adooda iri tleeharut.

name: Iraqw
text: Mungú muruudá' gwa/aateemaá duxuúm guri qaás gawaá doori as iwa gwa/aatiya' baraá yaamií alé.
normalised_text: mungu muruuda gwaaateemaa dukhuum guri qaas gawaa doori as iwa gwaaatiya baraa yaamii ale.

name: Iraqw
text: as tlaatla/aangw nguwa baaliya' nee xweera, nee as gwa/aateema nee giwti ngiwa paraatli. Mungú adoodá' aa tleéhh gari ár naxés ka hhoohhoo'.
normalised_text: as tlaatlaaangw nguwa baaliya nee khweera, nee as gwaaateema nee giwti ngiwa paraatli. mungu adooda aa tleeh gari ar nakhes ka hoohoo.

name: Iraqw
text: Tay tsiindo tay matlaatle, tari baalár tsiyáhh.
normalised_text: tay tsiindo tay matlaatle, tari baalar tsiyah.

name: Iraqw
text: Mungú iri oó', «Ma'aay i hatsiye' muruú slafa, nee tsir/ór baraá yaamaá kaahaar ar gáwtí tlatlaw i deerut.».
normalised_text: mungu iri oo, "maaay i hatsiye muruu hlafa, nee tsiror baraa yaamaa kaahaar ar gawti tlatlaw i deerut.".

name: Iraqw
text: Mungú giri tsuúq, giri báy, «Laqwaalé', tlahhé', ma'aá baraá tlawi hatsisaak, nee tsir/o sleeme i doogiin baraá yaamaá kaahaare.».
normalised_text: mungu giri tsuuq, giri bay, "laqwaale, tlahe, maaa baraa tlawi hatsisaak, nee tsiro hleeme i doogiin baraa yaamaa kaahaare.".

name: Iraqw
text: Tay tsiindo tay matlaatle, tari baalár kooán.
normalised_text: tay tsiindo tay matlaatle, tari baalar kooan.

name: Iraqw
text: Mungú hee guri tleéhh ar slaqsaywósuú kilá'. Hee guna tleéhh ar slaqsoó Mungú. Hhawaata nee /ameeni gina tleéhh.
normalised_text: mungu hee guri tleeh ar hlaqsaywosuu kila. hee guna tleeh ar hlaqsoo mungu. hawaata nee ameeni gina tleeh.

name: Iraqw
text: Mungú umuúqo gaaro ar aa tleéhh, gari ár naxés ka hhoohhoo'. Tay tsiindo tay matlaatle, tari baalár lahhoó'.
normalised_text: mungu umuuqo gaaro ar aa tleeh, gari ar nakhes ka hoohoo. tay tsiindo tay matlaatle, tari baalar lahoo.

name: Iraqw
text: Ala Mungú doori nee yaamu nee muruuwós sleémeero gay adoorír hhe'eés tleehhamooro.
normalised_text: ala mungu doori nee yaamu nee muruuwos hleemeero gay adoorir heees tleehamooro.

name: Iraqw
text: Mungú baalaadár faanqw gana tsuúq, gari hhoohhoeés. Asma ina hungu/uús gadiyeeduwós kudá' sleémeero ngiwa hhe'eés awa tleehhamór doori nee yaamu.
normalised_text: mungu baalaadar faanqw gana tsuuq, gari hoohoees. asma ina hunguuus gadiyeeduwos kuda hleemeero ngiwa heees awa tleehamor doori nee yaamu.

name: Iraqw
text: Kaangwí an alki/ituú adoodá' doori nee yaamu kira tleéhh. Qoomaadá' AAKOÓ Mungú yaamu nee doori ngiwa tleéhh.
normalised_text: kaangwi an alkiituu adooda doori nee yaamu kira tleeh. qoomaada aakoo mungu yaamu nee doori ngiwa tleeh.

name: Iraqw
text: gár naa ti'it i káhh baraá xatsoowo. Tam gitso naa ti'iitiká, asma AAKOÓ Mungú tluwaay gwa haniisiiká, laqaá tam heé yaamu gaa doosl i kaahh.
normalised_text: gar naa tiit i kah baraa khatsoowo. tam gitso naa tiiitika, asma aakoo mungu tluwaay gwa haniisiika, laqaa tam hee yaamu gaa doohl i kaah.

name: Iraqw
text: Kutli niri baraá yaamuú wa ti'ít, nee yaamu sleémeero giri naa/ás.
normalised_text: kutli niri baraa yaamuu wa tiit, nee yaamu hleemeero giri naaas.

name: Iraqw
text: AAKOÓ Mungú hee guri tleéhh ar hhape, guri hiinsluú slafíngw i ufaáhh, hee tari heé slaáf.
normalised_text: aakoo mungu hee guri tleeh ar hape, guri hiinhluu hlafingw i ufaah, hee tari hee hlaaf.

name: Iraqw
text: AAKOÓ Mungú asalmo guri dahaás bihhaá da/aáw baraá yaamaá Edeni. Heewós kudá' aa tleéhh guri baraadádí qaás.
normalised_text: aakoo mungu asalmo guri dahaas bihaa daaaw baraa yaamaa edeni. heewos kuda aa tleeh guri baraadadi qaas.

name: Iraqw
text: Yaae i deer ar baraá asalmoó Edenír wa wa/amiim, i asalmoó naa/amaamís. Aluuwo tiri qasmís tari yau tsiyáhh.
normalised_text: yaae i deer ar baraa asalmoo edenir wa waamiim, i asalmoo naaamaamis. aluuwo tiri qasmis tari yau tsiyah.

name: Iraqw
text: Umuú yaaér geera a Pishoni, an tidá' yaamaá Hawila gaa harwet. Baraadae sahaábu i deer.
normalised_text: umuu yaaer geera a pishoni, an tida yaamaa hawila gaa harwet. baraadae sahaabu i deer.

name: Iraqw
text: Nee sahaábuú yaamuudá' ku ló'wa hhohhó'. Slám baraadae tlaa/aá hhohho' awa ta bay bedoóla i dayá', nee tlaa/aá tlaxo gawden awa ta bay shohamu.
normalised_text: nee sahaabuu yaamuuda ku lowa hoho. hlam baraadae tlaaaa hoho awa ta bay bedoola i daya, nee tlaaaa tlakho gawden awa ta bay shohamu.

name: Iraqw
text: Nee umuú yaaér tsár a Gihoni, an yaaér yaamaá Kushi sleémeero gaa harwet.
normalised_text: nee umuu yaaer tsar a gihoni, an yaaer yaamaa kushi hleemeero gaa harwet.

name: Iraqw
text: Nee umuú yaaér tám a Tigri. An yaaeedá' aa waarahh ar bihhaá da/aáw awa yaamaá Ashuru. Nee umuú yaaér tsiyáhh a Eufrate.
normalised_text: nee umuu yaaer tam a tigri. an yaaeeda aa waarah ar bihaa daaaw awa yaamaa ashuru. nee umuu yaaer tsiyah a eufrate.

name: Irigwe
text: A ce̱ucwung, Be̱ne̱ i wu zinye̱ ngbe ne ebe ngwie̱.
normalised_text: a ceucwung, bene i wu zinye ngbe ne ebe ngwie.

name: Irigwe
text: Ebe ngwie̱ nna i shi hwerri we wuhluu, ne ewie ywing ngu ku cwuncwuu rishi nna. Nshe Be̱ne̱ e̱ grrá a zete rishi nna.
normalised_text: ebe ngwie nna i shi hwerri we wuhluu, ne ewie ywing ngu ku cwuncwuu rishi nna. nshe bene e grra a zete rishi nna.

name: Irigwe
text: Ngbe Be̱ne̱ e̱ he, <<Nde re bi nse̱.>> Ngbe ewie e̱ ne̱ ne si.
normalised_text: ngbe bene e he, nde re bi nse. ngbe ewie e ne ne si.

name: Irigwe
text: Ngbe Be̱ne̱ e̱ ri ewie si nna bi rina, ngu a ka ewie si ngbe ne ewie ywing.
normalised_text: ngbe bene e ri ewie si nna bi rina, ngu a ka ewie si ngbe ne ewie ywing.

name: Irigwe
text: Ngu a ye ewie si nna he, <<Te̱ne̱,>> ngu a ye ewie ywing nna he, <<Totu.>> ꞌNe̱ e̱ yhwe̱, mincwe e̱ kla. A a nyi otu na ꞌzrru.
normalised_text: ngu a ye ewie si nna he, tene, ngu a ye ewie ywing nna he, totu. ne e yhwe, mincwe e kla. a a nyi otu na zrru.

name: Irigwe
text: Ngbe Be̱ne̱ e̱ he, <<Nde re bi kyie a zetsi rishi, ngbe re ka re-rishi ne yá re-rishi.>>.
normalised_text: ngbe bene e he, nde re bi kyie a zetsi rishi, ngbe re ka rerishi ne ya rerishi..

name: Irigwe
text: Ngbe Be̱ne̱ e̱ nyi kyie nna, aa ka re-rishi na mbe shi tahwieng ngbe na zeteng. Aa a ci ni.
normalised_text: ngbe bene e nyi kyie nna, aa ka rerishi na mbe shi tahwieng ngbe na zeteng. aa a ci ni.

name: Irigwe
text: Be̱ne̱ e̱ ye kyie zete nna he, <<Zinye̱.>> ꞌNe̱ e̱ yhwe̱, mincwe e̱ kla. A a nyi otu na ꞌhwie.
normalised_text: bene e ye kyie zete nna he, zinye. ne e yhwe, mincwe e kla. a a nyi otu na hwie.

name: Irigwe
text: Ngbe Be̱ne̱ e̱ he, <<Nde re-rishi ne mbe shi tahwie kyie nna ré tsu nwie zunzrru, ngbe mbè hwahwa re wre̱.>> Aa a ci ni.
normalised_text: ngbe bene e he, nde rerishi ne mbe shi tahwie kyie nna re tsu nwie zunzrru, ngbe mbe hwahwa re wre. aa a ci ni.

name: Irigwe
text: Be̱ne̱ e̱ ye mbè hwahwa nna he, <<Ebe,>> ngu a ye re-rishi ne mbe tsu nna he, <<Nzhwó rishi.>> Ngbe ngu a ri, a bi rina.
normalised_text: bene e ye mbe hwahwa nna he, ebe, ngu a ye rerishi ne mbe tsu nna he, nzhwo rishi. ngbe ngu a ri, a bi rina.

name: Irigwe
text: Ngbe ebe e̱ wru mi ne retsi ngbe nzhwe ntsi wrú mi ne zhwe, ngbe rekwe ngwá ngbre ne mbe bi cwe nzhwe, ko zohu ne zhwe shî mbe. Be̱ne̱ e̱ ri bi rina.
normalised_text: ngbe ebe e wru mi ne retsi ngbe nzhwe ntsi wru mi ne zhwe, ngbe rekwe ngwa ngbre ne mbe bi cwe nzhwe, ko zohu ne zhwe shi mbe. bene e ri bi rina.

name: Irigwe
text: Ne̱hin e̱ ci, mincwe e̱ kla. A a nyi otu na ꞌtsie̱.
normalised_text: nehin e ci, mincwe e kla. a a nyi otu na tsie.

name: Irigwe
text: Ngbe Be̱ne̱ e̱ he, <<Nde re bi re-ro a nkyie zinye̱. Ré ka te̱ne̱ ngbe totu. Nde ré hwie̱ kyang hu re-zhe, ngbe rotu, ngbe re-rie.
normalised_text: ngbe bene e he, nde re bi rero a nkyie zinye. re ka tene ngbe totu. nde re hwie kyang hu rezhe, ngbe rotu, ngbe rerie.

name: Irigwe
text: Nde ré hwie̱ re-ro a nkyie zinye̱, ré si a be ngwie̱.>> Aa a ci ni.
normalised_text: nde re hwie rero a nkyie zinye, re si a be ngwie. aa a ci ni.

name: Irigwe
text: Ngbe Be̱ne̱ e̱ nyi ngbá re-ro wehwie ne mbe si, brrabrrang re ye ringgwe̱ te̱ne̱, ngbe ishing we̱ ye ringgwe̱ totu. Ngu a nyi re̱nde̱ wa.
normalised_text: ngbe bene e nyi ngba rero wehwie ne mbe si, brrabrrang re ye ringgwe tene, ngbe ishing we ye ringgwe totu. ngu a nyi rende wa.

name: Irigwe
text: Be̱ne̱ e̱ we sa a nkyie zinye̱ ngbe ré si a be ngwie̱.
normalised_text: bene e we sa a nkyie zinye ngbe re si a be ngwie.

name: Irigwe
text: Ré ye ringgwe̱ a te̱ne̱ ngbe totu, ré bra ka ewie si ngbe ne ewie ywing. Be̱ne̱ e̱ ri bi rina.
normalised_text: re ye ringgwe a tene ngbe totu, re bra ka ewie si ngbe ne ewie ywing. bene e ri bi rina.

name: Irigwe
text: ꞌNe̱ e̱ yhwe̱, mincwe e̱ kla. A a nyi otu na ꞌni.
normalised_text: ne e yhwe, mincwe e kla. a a nyi otu na ni.

name: Irigwe
text: Ngbe Be̱ne̱ e̱ he, <<Nde re-rishi ré wru mi ne ankya bi ce. Nde re̱mie̱ ré hrru a zete ebe ngwie̱ a nkyie zeteng.>>.
normalised_text: ngbe bene e he, nde rerishi re wru mi ne ankya bi ce. nde remie re hrru a zete ebe ngwie a nkyie zeteng..

name: Irigwe
text: Ngu a wé mwo rina he, <<Nyi hla nyi ci piriri, ngbe nyi shî nzhwó rishi. Re̱mie̱ ré ci piriri ma a ebe ngwie̱.>>.
normalised_text: ngu a we mwo rina he, nyi hla nyi ci piriri, ngbe nyi shi nzhwo rishi. remie re ci piriri ma a ebe ngwie..

name: Irigwe
text: ꞌNe̱ e̱ yhwe̱, mincwe e̱ kla. A a nyi otu na ꞌcwuoo.
normalised_text: ne e yhwe, mincwe e kla. a a nyi otu na cwuoo.

name: Irigwe
text: Ngbe Be̱ne̱ e̱ he, <<Nde ebe re wru mi ne ko zohu kya bi ce, ko zohu ne zhwe shî mbe: ankya rehwe, ngbe ne ankya kru be, ngbe nnyié̱ yi.>> Aa a ci ni.
normalised_text: ngbe bene e he, nde ebe re wru mi ne ko zohu kya bi ce, ko zohu ne zhwe shi mbe ankya rehwe, ngbe ne ankya kru be, ngbe nnyie yi. aa a ci ni.

name: Irigwe
text: Be̱ne̱ wu nneywi a shî ngu, aa ki nyi a yarri shî Be̱ne̱, aa mwe wu nne nto ngbe mbrru.
normalised_text: bene wu nneywi a shi ngu, aa ki nyi a yarri shi bene, aa mwe wu nne nto ngbe mbrru.

name: Irigwe
text: Be̱ne̱ e̱ ri ko nda ne ngu nyi e̱, a bi rina we yang. ꞌNe̱ e̱ yhwe̱, mincwe e̱ kla. A a nyi otu na rritsie̱.
normalised_text: bene e ri ko nda ne ngu nyi e, a bi rina we yang. ne e yhwe, mincwe e kla. a a nyi otu na rritsie.

name: Irigwe
text: Nyi ni ne e fro nyi zinye̱ ngbe ebe ngwie, ngbe ko nda ne ngu shi yarri mbe.
normalised_text: nyi ni ne e fro nyi zinye ngbe ebe ngwie, ngbe ko nda ne ngu shi yarri mbe.

name: Irigwe
text: Ne otu na natsie̱ rishi ci, Be̱ne̱ fro re-cwuo ne ngu nyi, a otu na natsie̱ng, ngu a srra cwu ne ga re-cwuo ne ngu nyi.
normalised_text: ne otu na natsie rishi ci, bene fro recwuo ne ngu nyi, a otu na natsieng, ngu a srra cwu ne ga recwuo ne ngu nyi.

name: Irigwe
text: Aha ni Be̱ne̱ mwo otu na natsie̱ nna rina, aa ki kyie re hwie̱ brra otu, aha nyi otu nna ne ngu ning srra cwu ne fro re-cwuo ne ngu nyi.
normalised_text: aha ni bene mwo otu na natsie nna rina, aa ki kyie re hwie brra otu, aha nyi otu nna ne ngu ning srra cwu ne fro recwuo ne ngu nyi.

name: Irigwe
text: Á i wu zinye̱ ngbe ebe ngwie̱ he ni. A zhe ne Yawe Be̱ne̱ wu ebe ngwie̱ ngbe ne zinye̱.

name: Irigwe
text: aha rishi wru a yarri be ngu ci mbè nna zhwozhwo re srra we cancancaa.

name: Irigwe
text: Wire Yawe Be̱ne̱ e̱ nyi nneywi ne ruvu mbè, ngu a ki yhwa nshe nce a nzhwu ngu, ngbe nneywi e̱ ci kya bi ce.

name: Isanzu
text: Ʉwʉ wʉwʉ mʉlongo nʉwa ndʉgʉ ang'wa Kilisito, ng'wana wang'wa Daudi, ng'wana wang'wa Ibulahimʉ.
normalised_text: uwu wuwu mulongo nuwa ndugu angwa kilisito, ngwana wangwa daudi, ngwana wangwa ibulahimu.

name: Isanzu
text: Ibulahimʉ wɨkamʉtuga Isaki nʉ Isaki wɨkamʉtuga Yakobo, nʉ Yakobo wɨkamʉtuga Yʉda nɨaluna akwe.
normalised_text: ibulahimu wikamutuga isaki nu isaki wikamutuga yakobo, nu yakobo wikamutuga yuda nialuna akwe.

name: Isanzu
text: Yʉda wɨkamʉtuga Pelesi nʉ Zela, nyinya wao aɨ Tamali, nʉ Pelesi wɨkamʉtuga Esilomu nʉ Esilomu wɨkamʉtuga Alamu.
normalised_text: yuda wikamutuga pelesi nu zela, nyinya wao ai tamali, nu pelesi wikamutuga esilomu nu esilomu wikamutuga alamu.

name: Isanzu
text: Alamu wɨkamʉtuga Aminadabu nʉ Aminadabu wɨkamʉtuga Nashoni nʉ Nashoni wɨkamʉtuga Salimoni.
normalised_text: alamu wikamutuga aminadabu nu aminadabu wikamutuga nashoni nu nashoni wikamutuga salimoni.

name: Isanzu
text: Salimoni wɨkamʉtuga Boazi nʉ nyinya wang'wa Boazi aɨ Lahabu nʉ Boazi wɨkamʉtuga Obedi nʉ nyinya wang'wa Obedi aɨ Luti nʉ Obedi wɨkamʉtuga Yese.
normalised_text: salimoni wikamutuga boazi nu nyinya wangwa boazi ai lahabu nu boazi wikamutuga obedi nu nyinya wangwa obedi ai luti nu obedi wikamutuga yese.

name: Isanzu
text: Yese wɨkamʉtuga Daudi naɨza Mʉtemi. Daudi wɨkamʉtuga Solomoni, ʉnyinya wang'wa Solomoni aɨ Bati Sheba yʉyo naɨ mʉkɨma wang'wa Ulia.
normalised_text: yese wikamutuga daudi naiza mutemi. daudi wikamutuga solomoni, unyinya wangwa solomoni ai bati sheba yuyo nai mukima wangwa ulia.

name: Isanzu
text: Solomoni wɨkamʉtuga Lehoboamu. Lehoboamu wɨkamʉtuga Abiya. Abiya wɨkamʉtuga Asa.
normalised_text: solomoni wikamutuga lehoboamu. lehoboamu wikamutuga abiya. abiya wikamutuga asa.

name: Isanzu
text: Asa wɨkamʉtuga Yehoshapati nʉ Yehoshapati wɨkamʉtuga Yolamʉ nʉ Yolamu wɨkamʉtuga Ʉzia.
normalised_text: asa wikamutuga yehoshapati nu yehoshapati wikamutuga yolamu nu yolamu wikamutuga uzia.

name: Isanzu
text: Ʉzia wɨkamʉtuga Yotamu nʉ Yotamu wɨkamʉtuga Ahazi nʉ Ahazi wɨkamʉtuga Hezekia.
normalised_text: uzia wikamutuga yotamu nu yotamu wikamutuga ahazi nu ahazi wikamutuga hezekia.

name: Isanzu
text: Hezekia wɨkamʉtuga Manase nʉ Manase wɨkamʉtuga Amoni nʉ Amoni wɨkamʉtuga Yosia.
normalised_text: hezekia wikamutuga manase nu manase wikamutuga amoni nu amoni wikamutuga yosia.

name: Isanzu
text: Yosia wɨkamʉtuga Yekonia nɨ aluna akwe. Itungo nɨlanso papo Ayahudi naɨahamɨgwe kʉtalwa kʉ Babeli.
normalised_text: yosia wikamutuga yekonia ni aluna akwe. itungo nilanso papo ayahudi naiahamigwe kutalwa ku babeli.

name: Isanzu
text: Ayahudi naɨ ahamigwe kʉtalwa kʉ Babeli, Yekonia wɨkamʉtuga Shealitieli nʉ Shealitieli wɨkamʉtuga Zelubabeli.
normalised_text: ayahudi nai ahamigwe kutalwa ku babeli, yekonia wikamutuga shealitieli nu shealitieli wikamutuga zelubabeli.

name: Isanzu
text: Zelubabeli wɨkamʉtuga Abiudi nʉ Abihudi wɨkamʉtuga Eliakimʉ, Eliakimʉ wɨkamʉtuga Azoli.
normalised_text: zelubabeli wikamutuga abiudi nu abihudi wikamutuga eliakimu, eliakimu wikamutuga azoli.

name: Isanzu
text: Azoli wɨkamʉtuga Sadoki nʉ Sadoki wɨkamʉtuga Akimʉ nʉ Akimʉ wɨkamʉtuga Eliʉdi.
normalised_text: azoli wikamutuga sadoki nu sadoki wikamutuga akimu nu akimu wikamutuga eliudi.

name: Isanzu
text: Eliʉdi wɨkamʉtuga Eliazali nʉ Eliazali wɨkamʉtuga Matani nʉ Matani wɨkamʉtuga Yakobo.
normalised_text: eliudi wikamutuga eliazali nu eliazali wikamutuga matani nu matani wikamutuga yakobo.

name: Isanzu
text: Yakobo wɨkamʉtuga Yusupu, Yusupu aɨ mʉgoha wang'wa Malia, Malia yʉyo aɨ ʉmʉtugile Yesʉ nʉ witangwa Kilisito.
normalised_text: yakobo wikamutuga yusupu, yusupu ai mugoha wangwa malia, malia yuyo ai umutugile yesu nu witangwa kilisito.

name: Isanzu
text: Ʉkʉtuga ng'wana mʉgoha, nʉewe ʉkʉmʉta lina Yesʉ, kʉnsoko nʉanso yʉyo ʉkʉaguna antʉ akwe mʉmɨlandʉao.
normalised_text: ukutuga ngwana mugoha, nuewe ukumuta lina yesu, kunsoko nuanso yuyo ukuaguna antu akwe mumilanduao.

name: Isanzu
text: Aya ɨhi aɨapʉmɨe kʉtimɨlya ʉlʉkani ni Itunda aɨʉtambʉe kʉkɨɨla mʉ amanga akwe kɨna.
normalised_text: aya ihi aiapumie kutimilya ulukani ni itunda aiutambue kukiila mu amanga akwe kina.

name: Isanzu
text: Ingɨ Yusupu shanga aɨ ʉtankanile kɨmʉɨlɨ nʉ Malia, kʉpikɨɨla Malia naɨ utugile ng'wana mʉgoha. Ʉʉgwa Yusupu wɨkamʉta ʉng'wana lina Yesʉ.
normalised_text: ingi yusupu shanga ai utankanile kimuili nu malia, kupikiila malia nai utugile ngwana mugoha. uugwa yusupu wikamuta ungwana lina yesu.

name: Isanzu
text: ɨkakolya, Itɨɨ, ʉkolɨ pɨɨ ng'wana nʉtugilwe? Mʉtemi nʉwa Ayahudi, kʉnsoko kʉmɨine nzota akwe ɨpembeeye kilya, nʉsese kaza kʉmʉkʉlya.
normalised_text: ikakolya, itii, ukoli pii ngwana nutugilwe? mutemi nuwa ayahudi, kunsoko kumeine nzota akwe ipembeeye kilya, nusese kaza kumukulya.

name: Isanzu
text: Mʉtemi Helode naɨwija ɨnkani izi wɨkahʉsha nangalu mʉnkolo akwe palʉng'wɨ nɨantʉ ɨhi nɨakʉ Yelʉsalemu.
normalised_text: mutemi helode naiwija inkani izi wikahusha nangalu munkolo akwe palungwi niantu ihi niaku yelusalemu.

name: Isanzu
text: Mʉtemi Helode wɨkitanga ɨanza la akʉlʉ a apolyi nɨ amanyisi a malagɨɨlyo ang'wa Musa, wɨkaakolya kina, Kilisito ʉkʉtugɨlwe pɨɨ.
normalised_text: mutemi helode wikitanga ianza la akulu a apolyi ni amanyisi a malagiilyo angwa musa, wikaakolya kina, kilisito ukutugilwe pii.

name: Isanzu
text: Nɨenso ɨkamʉsʉkɨɨlya, Ʉtugɨwe kʉ Betelehemu, mʉ mʉkɨsalɨ ka Yuda, kʉnsoko itɨ ʉʉ yandɨkilwe nʉ mʉmanga wang'wi Itunda kɨna.
normalised_text: nienso ikamusukiilya, utugiwe ku betelehemu, mu mukisali ka yuda, kunsoko iti uu yandikilwe nu mumanga wangwi itunda kina.

name: Isanzu
text: Papogwa, Helode wɨkaitanga kɨmpelo alɨngɨ amakani, wɨkaakolenkeelya kɨna matungo kɨ aɨ amɨɨne nzota nanso.
normalised_text: papogwa, helode wikaitanga kimpelo alingi amakani, wikaakolenkeelya kina matungo ki ai amiine nzota nanso.

name: Isanzu
text: Sʉnga Helode wɨkaalagɨɨlya, Longoli kʉ Betelehemʉ mʉkolenkeelye kɨsa nkani niya ng'wana nʉanso, anga mamʉona mʉze mʉmbɨle nʉnene nende nʉmʉkʉlya.
normalised_text: sunga helode wikaalagiilya, longoli ku betelehemu mukolenkeelye kisa nkani niya ngwana nuanso, anga mamuona muze mumbile nunene nende numukulya.

name: Isanzu
text: Alɨngi a nzota naɨ akondya kʉmʉtegeelya ʉ mʉtemi, ɨkalongola nɨ nzota naɨ amɨine kʉkilya ɨkaatongeela ɨkenda ɨkimɨka pigʉlya paɨ ʉkolɨ ʉ ng'wana.
normalised_text: alingi a nzota nai akondya kumutegeelya u mutemi, ikalongola ni nzota nai ameine kukilya ikaatongeela ikenda ikimika pigulya pai ukoli u ngwana.

name: Isanzu
text: Kʉnsoko Itunda aɨ waakania kʉkɨɨla ndoti aleke kʉsʉka kʉng'wa Helode, ʉʉgwa ɨkatʉlya mʉ mahɨɨ ao kʉkɨɨla nzɨla ngɨza.
normalised_text: kunsoko itunda ai waakania kukiila ndoti aleke kusuka kungwa helode, uugwa ikatulya mu mahii ao kukiila nzila ngiza.

name: Isanzu
text: Itɨ gwa, Yosepʉ wɨkaʉka ʉtikʉ wɨkamʉhola ng'wana ɨkakʉila nʉ nyinya nʉa ng'wana, ɨkalongola kihɨɨ akʉ Misili.
normalised_text: iti gwa, yosepu wikauka utiku wikamuhola ngwana ikakuila nu nyinya nua ngwana, ikalongola kihii aku misili.

name: Isanzu
text: Ʉʉgwa yɨkatula tai ɨnkani naɨ itambʉwe nʉ mʉmanga wang'wi Itunda ʉ Yelemia kɨna.
normalised_text: uugwa yikatula tai inkani nai itambuwe nu mumanga wangwi itunda u yelemia kina.

name: Isanzu
text: Nyangi yɨkigigwa kʉ Lama, kɨlɨlo nʉ kihongeelya, Laheli ʉkʉalɨɨla ana akwe, nʉyo shanga ʉloilwe kʉkilagigwa, kʉnsoko ana akwe ɨhi akuza.
normalised_text: nyangi yikigigwa ku lama, kililo nu kihongeelya, laheli ukualiila ana akwe, nuyo shanga uloilwe kukilagigwa, kunsoko ana akwe ihi akuza.

name: Isu
text: À wə̀ də̌ ŋwàʼà kə̀ kə dê nəniy azəd ə nə̀ tě Yesù Kə̀litò yìy, wà tu kə Devìd wə̀ ù kə də nəniy wà tu kə Ablàhâm kìy.
normalised_text: a we de ngwaa ke ke de neniy azed e ne te yesu kelito yiy, wa tu ke devid we u ke de neniy wa tu ke ablaham kiy.

name: Isu
text: Ablàhâm kə də̌ tè Ayzìk, Ayzìk ə də̌ tè Dzàkôb, Dzàkôb ə də̌ tè Dzudà nə̀ awizə̂ ə we yiy.
normalised_text: ablaham ke de te ayzik, ayzik e de te dzakob, dzakob e de te dzuda ne awize e we yiy.

name: Isu
text: Dzudà kə də̌ tè Pelèz nə̀ Zelàh. Zə̂ ghu kə də̌ Tamàl. Pelèz kə də̌ tè Hezlòn. Hezlòn ə də̌ tè Lâm.
normalised_text: dzuda ke de te pelez ne zelah. ze ghu ke de tamal. pelez ke de te hezlon. hezlon e de te lam.

name: Isu
text: Lâm kə də̌ tè Àminadàb. Àminadàb kə də̌ tè Nasòn, Nasòn kə də̌ tè Samùn.
normalised_text: lam ke de te aminadab. aminadab ke de te nason, nason ke de te samun.

name: Isu
text: Samùn kə də̌ tè Bowàs, Zə̂ Bowàs kə də̀ Lahàb. Bowàs ə də̌ tè Obèd, Zə̂ Obèd kə də̀ Lût. Obèt ə də̌ tè Dzesì.
normalised_text: samun ke de te bowas, ze bowas ke de lahab. bowas e de te obed, ze obed ke de lut. obet e de te dzesi.

name: Isu
text: Dzesì ə də̌ tè Devìd wə̀ ù kə də nəniy dòŋ kìy. Devìd ə də̌ tè Solomùn. Zə̂ Solomùn kə də̌ wìy Yulìyà.
normalised_text: dzesi e de te devid we u ke de neniy dong kiy. devid e de te solomun. ze solomun ke de wiy yuliya.

name: Isu
text: Solomùn kə də̌ tè Lèhobwàm, Lèhobwàm ə də̌ tè Abidzà, Abidzà ə də̌ tè Asàf.
normalised_text: solomun ke de te lehobwam, lehobwam e de te abidza, abidza e de te asaf.

name: Isu
text: Asàf ə də̌ tè Dzèhosafàt, Dzèhosafàt ə də̌ tè Dzulàm, Dzulàm ə də̌ tè Yuzìyà.
normalised_text: asaf e de te dzehosafat, dzehosafat e de te dzulam, dzulam e de te yuziya.

name: Isu
text: Yuzìyà ə də̌ tè Dzotàm, Dzotàm ə də̌ tè Ahàz, Ahàz ə də̌ tè Hèzèkayà.
normalised_text: yuziya e de te dzotam, dzotam e de te ahaz, ahaz e de te hezekaya.

name: Isu
text: Hèzèkayà ə də̌ tè Mànasè Manasè ə də̌ tè Amòn, Amòn ə də̌ tè Dzòsiyà.
normalised_text: hezekaya e de te manase manase e de te amon, amon e de te dzosiya.

name: Isu
text: Dzòsiyà ə də̌ tè Dzèkonayà nə̀ àwizə̂ we a sòŋə fə ghu kə dzûm na nəniy ghu a Babilòn.
normalised_text: dzosiya e de te dzekonaya ne awize we a songe fe ghu ke dzum na neniy ghu a babilon.

name: Isu
text: Zèlubabèl ə byi bə̀ Abiyùd, Abiyùd ə byi bə̀ Eliakìm, Eliakìm ə byi bə̀ Azòl.
normalised_text: zelubabel e byi be abiyud, abiyud e byi be eliakim, eliakim e byi be azol.

name: Isu
text: Azòl ə byi bə̀ Zadòk, Zadòk ə byi bə̀ Akìm, Akìm ə byi bə̀ Elwìd.
normalised_text: azol e byi be zadok, zadok e byi be akim, akim e byi be elwid.

name: Isu
text: Elwìd ə byi bə̀ Èliyazà, Èliyazà ə byi bə̀ Matàn, Matàn ə byi bə̀ Dzàkôb.
normalised_text: elwid e byi be eliyaza, eliyaza e byi be matan, matan e byi be dzakob.

name: Isu
text: Dzàkôb kə də̌ tè Yùsə̂f, ŋə̀m ə̀ Mə̀li wə ù kə byi nəniy Yesù wə̀ ghu kə tyoŋə we nə̀ à də̌ Kə̀litò.
normalised_text: dzakob ke de te yusef, ngem e meli we u ke byi neniy yesu we ghu ke tyonge we ne a de kelito.

name: Isu
text: Ù kì byikə bə̀ wà ùŋəmə̀, wò kî kwe tsə izəd i we nə̀ à də̀ Yesù, aŋwòə ù nì bii fyiə àghě we anə bɛb tə ghu.
normalised_text: u ki byike be wa ungeme, wo ki kwe tse ized i we ne a de yesu, angwoe u ni bii fyie aghe we ane beb te ghu.

name: Isu
text: Ayiə yə àdzə̀m kə bvami fyi kpe kə anə yiə yə Mwe ə̀ Mbyi, Kə̀zə̀ kə tɛb na zî bə̂ abidzəmə̀ wè ntwùm ə̀ Kə̀zə̀ nə̀.
normalised_text: ayie ye adzem ke bvami fyi kpe ke ane yie ye mwe e mbyi, keze ke teb na zi be abidzeme we ntwum e keze ne.

name: Isu
text: Abù Yùsə̂f zɛ̀mə̀ kə nəniy, u bvami nìy yə̀ sòʼò Mə̀li anə yiə yə tsə̀ndii ə̀ Kə̀zə̀ kə dzây nəniy â we.
normalised_text: abu yusef zeme ke neniy, u bvami niy ye soo meli ane yie ye tsendii e keze ke dzay neniy a we.

name: Isu
text: Abù Helòd zuw tsə nəniy ayiə yə ghii, ayiə ghè yə̀ ə ŋge fyimi we nə̀ àghě Yèlusalèm àdzə̀m.
normalised_text: abu helod zuw tse neniy ayie ye ghii, ayie ghe ye e ngge fyimi we ne aghe yelusalem adzem.

name: Isu
text: Helòd ə twoŋə na bə̀ ŋgəd tə aghè àlwaʼa yiy nə̀ àghè tyi dee ulàŋ wìy, u bəb tsə a ghu nə̀, Ghu kî byikə yiə Kə̀litò ə.
normalised_text: helod e twonge na be ngged te aghe alwaa yiy ne aghe tyi dee ulang wiy, u beb tse a ghu ne, ghu ki byike yie kelito e.

name: Isu
text: Ghu mee a we nə, À də̀ a Betlèhêm a mbwòʼ ə̀ Dzùdiyà, anə yiə yə wè ntwùm ə̀ Kə̀zə̀ kə twâ na nəniy nə̀.
normalised_text: ghu mee a we ne, a de a betlehem a mbwo e dzudiya, ane yie ye we ntwum e keze ke twa na neniy ne.

name: Isu
text: Abû wò a Betlèhêm a mbwòʼ ə̀ Dzùdiyà, wò də̀ inaʼ ìsoŋə̀ yìy ani nyə̀ fyi bə̀ dòŋ kə̀ kə kî yemə̀ nəniy azoŋə̀ àghù yam, Islàel. .
normalised_text: abu wo a betlehem a mbwo e dzudiya, wo de ina isonge yiy ani nye fyi be dong ke ke ki yeme neniy azonge aghu yam, islael..

name: Isu
text: Abù ghu kôʼ yə̂ nəniy sǐbə̂d fə̀, ghu kàm ŋge dwiʼi này yə̀ ghii.
normalised_text: abu ghu ko ye neniy sibed fe, ghu kam ngge dwii nay ye ghii.

name: Isu
text: Yùsə̂f ə ŋwò kə nə̀ ntsukə tə ghè tə̀, nìy kə wa nə, nə̀ zə̂ ŋwò zù anə inaʼ i Idzìp.
normalised_text: yusef e ngwo ke ne ntsuke te ghe te, niy ke wa ne, ne ze ngwo zu ane ina i idzip.

name: Isu
text: I bvami bù fyi kpe kə anə dzə̀ yə̀ wè ntwùm ə̀ Kə̀zə̀ Dzèlèmayà kə dzây na nəniy nə̀.
normalised_text: i bvami bu fyi kpe ke ane dze ye we ntwum e keze dzelemaya ke dzay na neniy ne.

name: Isu
text: A zuw kə̀bòŋ kə foŋə a Lamà, imwe nə̀ mbòŋ mə̀ dîy mìy, Làshêl wìy dìy nəniy awa ə we yiy, twe nə̀ wù kə we gwuŋì dzə̀, aŋwòə ghu mə pfə mà.
normalised_text: a zuw kebong ke fonge a lama, imwe ne mbong me diy miy, lashel wiy diy neniy awa e we yiy, twe ne wu ke we gwungi dze, angwoe ghu me pfe ma.

name: Isu
text: Abù Helòd pfə tsə nəniy, tsə̀ndii ə̀ Mwe ə̀ mbyi ə bù dè bə̀ ùwe â Yùsə̂f anə udzɛ̀mə̀ anə inaʼ i Idzìp.
normalised_text: abu helod pfe tse neniy, tsendii e mwe e mbyi e bu de be uwe a yusef ane udzeme ane ina i idzip.

name: Isu
text: Yùsə̂f ə ŋwò kə nìy kə wa nə nə̀ zə̂, zù dzwoŋi anə inaʼ i Islàel.
normalised_text: yusef e ngwo ke niy ke wa ne ne ze, zu dzwongi ane ina i islael.

name: Isu
text: A sòŋə fə ghà fə̀, Dzwan wə ù kə nyiə̀ nəniy mwi m-à-zə̀ mìy ə zù bù a mbvə̀n ə̀ kə̀sisi a mbwòʼ ə̀ Dzùdiyà, kaʼ yə̀ ani nàʼà ntwùm ə̀ Kə̀zə̀.
normalised_text: a songe fe gha fe, dzwan we u ke nyie neniy mwi maze miy e zu bu a mbven e kesisi a mbwo e dzudiya, ka ye ani naa ntwum e keze.

name: Isu
text: dzìy yə̀ awò àghù yìy a ghu nə, Ghà kyemì ŋwô bə̂ anə bɛb təli, aŋwòə fəkəmə̀ Zə̀kìy bû kaʼ ani saʼ aghee we.
normalised_text: dziy ye awo aghu yiy a ghu ne, gha kyemi ngwo be ane beb teli, angwoe fekeme zekiy bu ka ani sa aghee we.

name: Ivbie North-Okpela-Arhe
text: Ona o khi akẹkẹ shi ekẹ abi unuẹkpẹ oyi iJesu iKirisiti Omi iDefidi ni ọ khi Omi Aburaamu o li zẹ.

name: Ivbie North-Okpela-Arhe
text: Aburaamu ọ bia Aziki, Aziki ọ bia iGiekọpu, IGiekọpu ọ bia iJuda ali inyọghuo ọli nya.

name: Ivbie North-Okpela-Arhe
text: IJuda ọ bia iPẹrẹzi ali iZẹra, ọkpotso ni ọ bia wẹ, a lu iTama. IPẹrẹzi ọ bia Ezirọni. Ezirọni ọ bia iRamu.
normalised_text: ijuda o bia iperezi ali izera, okpotso ni o bia we, a lu itama. iperezi o bia ezironi. ezironi o bia iramu.

name: Ivbie North-Okpela-Arhe

name: Ivbie North-Okpela-Arhe

name: Ivbie North-Okpela-Arhe

name: Ivbie North-Okpela-Arhe
text: Ọ ya bia ọmọ ọmọse, eva ni u ya lu ọni ọmọ khi iJesu, irari khi ọ ya mie ẹgbọ eyọli olamhẹ pfuese.

text: Eri a mẹ enana ni a rọ bhẹ ya ẹ khi ingmemhi ni Ẹshinẹgba ọ rọte unu oyi ọmekẹguele ngme, ni e bhale ya tsẹ. Ni ọọ.

name: Izii
text: Chileke sụ: G'alị fushia iphe, dzụ ndzụ: iphe, amị mebyi; yẹe oshi-ọmi g'ọphu nọnu fushigbaa g'ọ dụ l'ụgbugba nkiya. Ọ dụ g'o pfuru.
normalised_text: chileke su gali fushia ife, dzu ndzu ife, ami mebyi; yie oshiomi gofu nonu fushigbaa go du lugbugba nkiya. o du go pfuru.

name: Izii
text: Tẹme g'iphe ono, echí echíchí ono, dụ l'akpaminigwe ono chije lẹ mgboko. Ọ dụ g'o pfuru.
normalised_text: teme gife ono, echi echichi ono, du lakpaminigwe ono chije le mgboko. o du go pfuru.

name: Izii
text: Chileke bya eworu phẹ dobe l'akpaminigwe g'ẹphe mee g'ìphóró dụ lẹ mgboko.
normalised_text: chileke bya eworu fe dobe lakpaminigwe gefe mee giforo du le mgboko.

name: Izii
text: G'ẹphe chije l'eswe yẹe ẹnyashi; tẹme waa g'ẹphe dokaha ìphóró yẹe ọchii. Chileke bya elee ya ẹnya bya ahụma l'ọ dụ ree.
normalised_text: gefe chije leswe yie enyashi; teme waa gefe dokaha iforo yie ochii. chileke bya elee ya enya bya ahuma lo du ree.

name: Izii
text: Chileke bya asụ: Gẹ mini kpofuta anụ, dụ igwerigwe g'o buru lẹ mini; ẹnu awata ephe l'eliphe lẹ mkpula akpaminigwe.
normalised_text: chileke bya asu ge mini kpofuta anu, du igwerigwe go buru le mini; enu awata efe lelife le mkpula akpaminigwe.

name: Izii
text: Noo ya; Chileke bya agọru ọnu-ọma nụ phẹ; sụ: Unu zụ̀a azụ̀zù zụ-jia mini, nọgbaa l'eze-ẹnyimu; ẹnu azụa ji mgboko ejiji.
normalised_text: noo ya; chileke bya agoru onuoma nu fe; su unu zua azuzu zujia mini, nogbaa lezeenyimu; enu azua ji mgboko ejiji.

name: Izii
text: Ọo ya bụ; Chileke woru nemadzụ mee; o yee ya; ọ bụru gẹ Chileke dụ bụ g'o meru iya; ọ dụ. Ọ bụru nwoke lẹ nwanyị bẹ o meru.
normalised_text: uo ya bu; chileke woru nemadzu mee; o yee ya; o buru ge chileke du bu go meru iya; o du. o buru ngwoke le ngwanyi be o meru.

name: Izii
text: Noo ya; Chileke sụ: Iphe, bụ iphe, aakọ̀ akọ̀kò lẹ mgboko; waa iphe, bụ oshi, amị amịmi l'ophu bẹ mu nụkotaru unu g'unu rije; g'ọ bụru unu nri.
normalised_text: noo ya; chileke su ife, bu ife, aako akoko le mgboko; waa ife, bu oshi, ami amimi lofu be mu nukotaru unu gunu rije; go buru unu nri.

name: Izii
text: Chileke bya elee ẹnya hụma iphemiphe, o meru. Ẹphe dụebekota rengurengu shii. Nchi jihu bya abọhu. Ono bụru mbọku k'ishii.
normalised_text: chileke bya elee enya huma ifemife, o meru. efe duebekota rengurengu shii. nchi jihu bya abohu. ono buru mboku kishii.

name: Izii
text: Noo g'e gude mee igwe; yẹe eliphe; mẹ iphemiphe, nọ iya nụ.
normalised_text: noo ge gude mee igwe; yie elife; me ifemife, no iya nu.

name: Izii
text: Tọbudu iya bụ; o betashia lẹ mbọku k'ẹsaa; Chileke jeẹbekotawaa ozi ono, o shi eje ono. Ọ bụru lẹ mbọku k'ẹsaa ono bẹ ọ tụtaru unme ozi, o jekọtaru.
normalised_text: tobudu iya bu; o betashia le mboku kesaa; chileke jiebekotawaa ozi ono, o shi eje ono. o buru le mboku kesaa ono be o tutaru unme ozi, o jekotaru.

name: Izii
text: Chileke gọru ọnu-ọma nụ mbọku k'ẹsaa ono; bya emee ya; ọ dụ nsọ; kẹle ọo mbọku ono bẹ ọ tụtaru unme eme iphemiphe, o meshiru ono.
normalised_text: chileke goru onuoma nu mboku kesaa ono; bya emee ya; o du nso; kele uo mboku ono be o tutaru unme eme ifemife, o meshiru ono.

name: Izii
text: Waa g'e gude mee igwe; yẹe eliphe; teke e meru iya baa. Teke Chipfu, bụ Chileke meru eliphe; yẹe igwe bẹ.
normalised_text: waa ge gude mee igwe; yie elife; teke e meru iya baa. teke chipfu, bu chileke meru elife; yie igwe be.

name: Izii
text: Ọ bụru iji bẹ o shi anọduje akwa gude agba alị l'ophu mini.
normalised_text: o buru iji be o shi anoduje akwa gude agba ali lofu mini.

name: Izii
text: Ọo ya bụ; Chipfu, bụ Chileke bya egude ẹja, shi l'alị kpụa nemadzụ; bya ekuru unme ndzụ ye iya l'imi; onye ono bya abụru onye dzụ ndzụ.
normalised_text: uo ya bu; chipfu, bu chileke bya egude eja, shi lali kpua nemadzu; bya ekuru unme ndzu ye iya limi; onye ono bya aburu onye dzu ndzu.

name: Izii
text: Chipfu, bụ Chileke bya eworu mgbabu gbaa l'ụzo ẹnyanwu-awawa lẹ Édẹnu; bya eworu nemadzụ-a, o meru-a dobe l'ẹka ono.
normalised_text: chipfu, bu chileke bya eworu mgbabu gbaa luzo enyangwuawawa le edenu; bya eworu nemadzua, o merua dobe leka ono.

name: Izii
text: Ọ bụru l'alị Édẹnu bẹ nggele, agba mini lẹ mgbabu ono shi asọshi. Nggele ono bya agbaa ẹno lẹ mgbabu ono.
normalised_text: o buru lali edenu be nggele, agba mini le mgbabu ono shi asoshi. nggele ono bya agbaa eno le mgbabu ono.

name: Izii
text: Ẹpha nggele kẹ mbụ bu Pishọnu; o shijaru echilabọ alị Havila l'ophu; ẹka mkpọla-ododo nọ.
normalised_text: efa nggele ke mbu bu pishonu; o shijaru echilabo ali havila lofu; eka mkpolaododo no.

name: Izii
text: Mkpọla-ododo, nọ l'alị ono dụ ree. Etse, eshi mkpọ, bụ iya bụ bedelọmu nọdu iya; tẹme mkpuma, aswa dụ, bụ ónìkùsù nọdukwa iya phọ.
normalised_text: mkpolaododo, no lali ono du ree. etse, eshi mkpo, bu iya bu bedelomu nodu iya; teme mkpuma, aswa du, bu onikusu nodukwa iya fo.

name: Izii
text: Ẹpha nggele k'ẹbo bụ Gihọnu. O shijaru echilabọ alị Kushi l'ophu.
normalised_text: efa nggele kebo bu gihonu. o shijaru echilabo ali kushi lofu.

name: Izii
text: Ẹpha nggele k'ẹto bụ Tigirisu; yẹbedua sọru shia ụzo ẹnyanwu-awawa l'ibiya kẹ Asiriya. Ẹpha nggele k'ẹno bụru Yufurétisu.
normalised_text: efa nggele keto bu tigirisu; yebedua soru shia uzo enyangwuawawa libiya ke asiriya. efa nggele keno buru yufuretisu.

name: Jibu
text: Wàníng í tarkada á shinn yàkúká bu Yesu Kristi wùn Dawuda, Dawuda í wùn Ibrahim.
normalised_text: waning i tarkada a shinn yakuka bu yesu kristi wun dawuda, dawuda i wun ibrahim.

name: Jibu
text: Ibrahim mà Ishaku, Ishaku mà Yakubu, Yakubu mà Yahuda ma shunwàuwá big ma wunzàwá big.
normalised_text: ibrahim ma ishaku, ishaku ma yakubu, yakubu ma yahuda ma shunwauwa big ma wunzawa big.

name: Jibu
text: Yahuda mà Parisa ma Zaraha, zìnn nàbá í Tamara. Parisa mà Hasaruna, Hasaruna mà Arama.
normalised_text: yahuda ma parisa ma zaraha, zinn naba i tamara. parisa ma hasaruna, hasaruna ma arama.

name: Jibu
text: Arama mà Aminadabu, Aminadabu mà Nahashuna, Nahashuna mà Salmuna.
normalised_text: arama ma aminadabu, aminadabu ma nahashuna, nahashuna ma salmuna.

name: Jibu
text: Salmuna mà Buaza, zyun-à nàwá í Rahab. Buaza mà Obida zyun-à nàwá í Rautha. Obida mà Yassa.
normalised_text: salmuna ma buaza, zyuna nawa i rahab. buaza ma obida zyuna nawa i rautha. obida ma yassa.

name: Jibu
text: Yassa mà kùr Dawuda. Dawuda bó mà Sulemanu zyun-à nàwá í wà ki Uriya.
normalised_text: yassa ma kur dawuda. dawuda bo ma sulemanu zyuna nawa i wa ki uriya.

name: Jibu
text: Sulemanu mà Rahabama, Rahabama mà Abiya, Abiya mà Asa.
normalised_text: sulemanu ma rahabama, rahabama ma abiya, abiya ma asa.

name: Jibu
text: Asa mà Yahushafata, Yahushafata mà Yurama, Yurama mà Uzzaja.
normalised_text: asa ma yahushafata, yahushafata ma yurama, yurama ma uzzaja.

name: Jibu
text: Uzzaja mà Yuthama, Yuthama mà Ahaza, Ahaza mà Hizkiya.
normalised_text: uzzaja ma yuthama, yuthama ma ahaza, ahaza ma hizkiya.

name: Jibu
text: Hizkiya mà Manassa, Manassa mà Amuna, Amuna mà Yushiya.
normalised_text: hizkiya ma manassa, manassa ma amuna, amuna ma yushiya.

name: Jibu
text: Yushiya mà Yakunya ma wunzà wàníng big, á sai-à big gbar zìg yag sig mpìr Israilaká ma gbam mà Babila.
normalised_text: yushiya ma yakunya ma wunza waning big, a saia big gbar zig yag sig mpir israilaka ma gbam ma babila.

name: Jibu
text: Barà big zìg yag big mà Babila, ásim Yakunya bi mà Shaaltila, Shaaltila mà Zarubabila.
normalised_text: bara big zig yag big ma babila, asim yakunya bi ma shaaltila, shaaltila ma zarubabila.

name: Jibu
text: Zarubabila mà Abihuda, Abihuda mà Aliyakima, Aliyakima mà Azura.
normalised_text: zarubabila ma abihuda, abihuda ma aliyakima, aliyakima ma azura.

name: Jibu
text: Azura mà Saduka, Saduka mà Ahima, Ahima mà Aliyuda.
normalised_text: azura ma saduka, saduka ma ahima, ahima ma aliyuda.

name: Jibu
text: Aliyuda mà Aliazara, Aliazara mà Mattana, Mattana mà Yakubu.
normalised_text: aliyuda ma aliazara, aliazara ma mattana, mattana ma yakubu.

name: Jibu
text: Yakubu mà Yusufu nù Maryamu, Maryamu zyun-à mà sig Yesu wà big ri bar rag í Almasihu.
normalised_text: yakubu ma yusufu nu maryamu, maryamu zyuna ma sig yesu wa big ri bar rag i almasihu.

name: Jibu
text: Kwá mà wùn wunù, wá bar zìnnwá Yesu, jir kai bàna wàníng má zìg zú nì mpìrká buwá á bu pyìrbá ni.
normalised_text: kwa ma wun wunu, wa bar zinnwa yesu, jir kai bana waning ma zig zu ni mpirka buwa a bu pyirba ni.

name: Jibu
text: Bu káníng sa sig àjirà bu-à mpìr adang kyann jir Shìdun dang sig sai-à rì níng, aku shi àràg barà ku rì dang sig.
normalised_text: bu kaning sa sig ajira bua mpir adang kyann jir shidun dang sig saia ri ning, aku shi arag bara ku ri dang sig.

name: Jibu
text: Ku dang rag, Aning myàng, uwà sáb zyun yì fig wunù bàna má yìm finn, má mà wùn wunù, bá bar zìnnwá Immanuel.
normalised_text: ku dang rag, aning myang, uwa sab zyun yi fig wunu bana ma yim finn, ma ma wun wunu, ba bar zinnwa immanuel.

name: Jibu
text: Barà Yusufu dù nann zu á na-à ni, ku sìr ban ma wàwá Maryamu àràg barà wùn aswam Shìdun dinya sig ku.
normalised_text: bara yusufu du nann zu a naa ni, ku sir ban ma wawa maryamu arag bara wun aswam shidun dinya sig ku.

name: Jibu
text: Ama ku yì fig wàníng í uwà bàna hár wàníng bi mà wùnwá. Ku bar zìnn wùn-à hi rag Yesu.
normalised_text: ama ku yi fig waning i uwa bana har waning bi ma wunwa. ku bar zinn wuna hi rag yesu.

name: Jibu
text: Barà kùr Hirudus fig àdòníng, pìkyinnwá í bai rìgwá ma bu mpìrká mà Urushalima bidìm pár.
normalised_text: bara kur hirudus fig adoning, pikyinnwa i bai rigwa ma bu mpirka ma urushalima bidim par.

name: Jibu
text: Ku bar kwonn rìg àgbamká ri twìb swànn bu á pyànn Shìdun ni, ma malamká, n bib big byar-à bá mà Almasihu, zyun-à Shìdun dang rag kwá swam bi níng.
normalised_text: ku bar kwonn rig agbamka ri twib swann bu a pyann shidun ni, ma malamka, n bib big byara ba ma almasihu, zyuna shidun dang rag kwa swam bi ning.

name: Jibu
text: Big dinya ku n rag, bá mà wàníng á finn swann Baitalami mà jànn Yahudiya, jir kai bàna í bu-à mpìr-à ri dang kyann jir Shìdun níng, ba sig n rag:.
normalised_text: big dinya ku n rag, ba ma waning a finn swann baitalami ma jann yahudiya, jir kai bana i bua mpira ri dang kyann jir shidun ning, ba sig n rag.

name: Jibu
text: Wù Baitalami swann Yahudiya, wù í swann títi bàna á finn jànn Yahudiya, jir kai bàna áyauwú ni bá zìg zu bi kùr zyun-à má shi kang mpìr Israilaká.
normalised_text: wu baitalami swann yahudiya, wu i swann titi bana a finn jann yahudiya, jir kai bana ayauwu ni ba zig zu bi kur zyuna ma shi kang mpir israilaka.

name: Jibu
text: A byar-à níng hi, kùr Hirudus bònn bar mpìr yar káníng n bib big ádàn n rag, big myàng sig asuswir-à níng ákaun rà?.
normalised_text: a byara ning hi, kur hirudus bonn bar mpir yar kaning n bib big adan n rag, big myang sig asuswira ning akaun ra?.

name: Jibu
text: Barà big myàng asuswir-à àdòníng, big fig àjwár á pìkyinnbá ni wàni.
normalised_text: bara big myang asuswira adoning, big fig ajwar a pikyinnba ni wani.

name: Jibu
text: Shìdun dinya big á la-à ni n rag abig kàng yag mà byar Hirudus bàna, abig bàg gbìb zyun kim ma abig kàng yag mà jànnbá ni.
normalised_text: shidun dinya big a laa ni n rag abig kang yag ma byar hirudus bana, abig bag gbib zyun kim ma abig kang yag ma jannba ni.

name: Jibu
text: Ku dù n zìg wùn-à ma nàwá á fi-à níng hi, n yag mà Masar.
normalised_text: ku du n zig wuna ma nawa a fia ning hi, n yag ma masar.

name: Jibu
text: A byar-à níng hi, bu-à Irimiya mpìr-à rìi dang kyann jir Shìdun dang sig níng, sa hing àràg barà ku dang sig.
normalised_text: a byara ning hi, bua irimiya mpira rii dang kyann jir shidun dang sig ning, sa hing arag bara ku dang sig.

name: Jita
text: Ecitabo co bwiburwa bwa Yesu Kristo, Omwana wa Daudi, Omwana wa Iburaimu.
normalised_text: echitabo cho bwiburwa bwa yesu kristo, omwana wa daudi, omwana wa iburaimu.

name: Jita
text: Ganu nigo amasiina ga oruganda rwa Yeesu Kirisito. Yeesu Kirisito ꞉aasookereeye mu‑ruganda rwa omukama Dawudi, mu‑rwibhuro rwa Bhurayimu.
normalised_text: ganu nigo amasiina ga oruganda rwa yeesu kirisito. yeesu kirisito aasookereeye muruganda rwa omukama dawudi, murwibhuro rwa bhurayimu.

name: Jita
text: Bhurayimu ꞉eebhuuye Isaaka, Isaaka ˆneebhura Yakobho, Yakobho ˆneebhura Yuuda na abhamura bhaabho.

name: Jita
text: Iburaimu e:buye Isaka. Isaka ne:bura Yakobo. Yakobo ne:bura Yuda na ba:na ba:bo.

name: Jita
text: Yuda ne:bura Faresi na Zera mu Tamari. Faresi ne:bura Esromu. Esromu ne:bura Aramu.

text: Araamu ˆneebhura Aminadaabhu, Aminadaabhu ˆneebhura Nasyoni, Nasyoni ˆneebhura Sarumooni.

name: Jita
text: Aramu ne:bura Aminadabu. Aminadabu ne:bura Nasoni. Nasoni ne:bura Salimoni.

normalised_text: na yeese neebhura omukama dawudi. omukama dawudi neebhura seremaani kumugasi wa uriya.

name: Jita

normalised_text: seremaani neebhura rewobhowamu, rewobhowamu neebhura abhiya, abhiya neebhura aasa.

text: Sulemani ne:bura Reoboamu. Reoboamu ne:bura Abiya. Abiya ne:bura Asa.
normalised_text: sulemani nebura reoboamu. reoboamu nebura abiya. abiya nebura asa.

text: Aasa ˆneebhura Jewosyafati, Jewosyafati ˆneebhura Joraamu, Joraamu ˆneebhura Wujiya.
normalised_text: aasa neebhura jewosyafati, jewosyafati neebhura joraamu, joraamu neebhura wujiya.

text: Asa ne:bura Yeosafati. Yeosafati ne:bura Aaji. Aaji ne:bura Ejekiya.

name: Jita

name: Jita
text: Yosiya ne:bura Yekoniya na ba:na ba:bo, mu siku jo kusirwa Babuloni.

text: Jerubabeli ne:bura Abiudi. Abiudi ne:bura Eliakimu. Eliakimu ne:bura Ajori.
normalised_text: jerubabeli nebura abiudi. abiudi nebura eliakimu. eliakimu nebura ajori.

name: Jita
text: Jerubhabheeri ˆneebhura Abhiwudi, Abhiwudi ˆneebhura Eriyaakimu, Eriyaakimu ˆneebhura Ajoori.

text: Aŋ Jooŋ bownu äkkene ogo äŋ jïñe. Aŋ mïïllä äkkene ogo wïïrïn jïñe. Aŋ biigin ti ḍakkä aŋ tïṇṇäŋänä äätin aŋ a nïïnnä kä keelok.
normalised_text: ang joong bownu akkene ogo ang jinye. ang meilla akkene ogo weirin jinye. ang biigin ti dhakka ang tinnangana eatin ang a neinna ka keelok.

name: Jumjum
text: Aŋ Jooŋ jaajjin ogo, Dalä kewnä wäätï ṭeejjük piitti, aŋ wäätï a waan piik ke piik.
normalised_text: ang joong jaajjin ogo, dala kewna weati theejjuk piitti, ang weati a waan piik ke piik.

name: Jumjum
text: Aŋ Jooŋ näŋŋä kewnä, aŋ piik yek mä ïñïnä ke piik yek mä ñaaloŋŋu kiimme gïtï. Aŋ wäättä.
normalised_text: ang joong nangnga kewna, ang piik yek ma inyina ke piik yek ma nyaalongngu kiimme giti. ang weatta.

name: Jumjum
text: Aŋ kewnä mä ñaaloŋŋu äkki Jooŋ ogo polloŋ. Aŋ biigin ti ḍakkä aŋ tïṇṇäŋänä äätin aŋ a nïïnkä kä yew.
normalised_text: ang kewna ma nyaalongngu akki joong ogo pollong. ang biigin ti dhakka ang tinnangana eatin ang a neinka ka yew.

name: Jumjum
text: Aŋ Jooŋ jaajjin ogo, Dale piik yaaka ïñï polloŋ ŋoy ye, yoken ḍülgü nänṭä keellä, aŋ nänṭä ïwon ükü woo. Aŋ wäättä.
normalised_text: ang joong jaajjin ogo, dale piik yaaka inyi pollong ngoy ye, yoken dhulgu nantha keella, ang nantha iwon uku woo. ang weatta.

name: Jumjum
text: Aŋ Jooŋ nänṭä ïwon äkkene ogo ŋommañ, aŋ nänṭ'a piik yoken agene kä ḍülgïn ye, äkkene ogo wiykä mäyken. Aŋ yoori Jooŋ aŋan ŋeraŋ.
normalised_text: ang joong nantha iwon akkene ogo ngommany, ang nantha piik yoken agene ka dhulgin ye, akkene ogo wiyka mayken. ang yoori joong angan ngerang.

name: Jumjum
text: Aŋ Jooŋ jaajjin ogo, Dalä wakkä garkä yül ŋommañ wic, aŋ gidok ṭulgen aŋ äcä käwkä, aŋ jengä gidok ṭulgen aŋ äcä käwkä daa kä biilken. Aŋ wäättä.
normalised_text: ang joong jaajjin ogo, dala wakka garka yul ngommany wich, ang gidok thulgen ang acha kawka, ang jenga gidok thulgen ang acha kawka daa ka biilken. ang weatta.

name: Jumjum
text: Aŋ ŋommañ wiñe yüllü kä wakkä garkä aŋ gidok ṭulgen aŋ äcä käwkä, aŋ jengä gidok ṭulgen ke käwken daa kä biilken. Aŋ yoori Jooŋ aŋan ŋeraŋ.
normalised_text: ang ngommany winye yullu ka wakka garka ang gidok thulgen ang acha kawka, ang jenga gidok thulgen ke kawken daa ka biilken. ang yoori joong angan ngerang.

name: Jumjum
text: Aŋ biigin ti ḍakkä aŋ tïṇṇäŋänä äätin aŋ a nïïnkä kä ḍäk.
normalised_text: ang biigin ti dhakka ang tinnangana eatin ang a neinka ka dhak.

name: Jumjum
text: Aŋ Jooŋ jaajjin ogo, Dalä wakkä bowku wäätï ñaalok polloŋ jï kïpï gïtï äŋ jïñe ke wïïrïn jïñe aŋ nüütï waadgä ke nïïnkä ke yuungu.
normalised_text: ang joong jaajjin ogo, dala wakka bowku weati nyaalok pollong ji kipi giti ang jinye ke weirin jinye ang nouti waadga ke neinka ke yuungu.

name: Jumjum
text: Aŋ dalä waak bowku wäätï ñaalok polloŋ jï aŋ dïïkïdï ïñï ŋommañ wic. Aŋ wäättä.
normalised_text: ang dala waak bowku weati nyaalok pollong ji ang deikidi inyi ngommany wich. ang weatta.

name: Jumjum
text: Aŋ iken ḍooci Jooŋ ñaalok polloŋ jï dïïkïdï ïñï ŋommañ wic.
normalised_text: ang iken dhoochi joong nyaalok pollong ji deikidi inyi ngommany wich.

name: Jumjum
text: aŋ tïïcï äŋ jïñe ke wïïrïn jïñe, aŋ kïpï gïtï bownu ke mïïllä. Aŋ yoori Jooŋ aŋan ŋeraŋ.
normalised_text: ang teichi ang jinye ke weirin jinye, ang kipi giti bownu ke meilla. ang yoori joong angan ngerang.

name: Jumjum
