name: Jumjum
text: Aŋ Jooŋ jaajjin ogo, Dalä piik kümok kä waak'a a üdïn ye, aŋ dalä ḍïïrgä päyok ŋommañ wic ke ñaalok polloŋ jï.
normalised_text: ang joong jaajjin ogo, dala piik kumok ka waaka a udin ye, ang dala dheirga payok ngommany wich ke nyaalok pollong ji.

name: Jumjum
text: Aŋ ŋüülkï Jooŋ aŋ kiinne ogo, Giide aŋ ḍiire aŋ piik yaaka wiykä mäyken gïtï ye küümge. Aŋ dalä ḍïïrgä ḍirä ŋommañ wic.
normalised_text: ang ngoulki joong ang kiinne ogo, giide ang dhiire ang piik yaaka wiyka mayken giti ye koumge. ang dala dheirga dhira ngommany wich.

name: Jumjum
text: Aŋ biigin ti ḍakkä aŋ tïṇṇäŋänä äätin aŋ a nïïnkä kä duuc.
normalised_text: ang biigin ti dhakka ang tinnangana eatin ang a neinka ka duuch.

name: Jumjum
text: Aŋ Jooŋ jaajjin ogo, Ŋommañ äcä woo waak'a a üdïn ye, kä biilken, ḍigärgä ke waak'a muulu ïñï ye ke wakkä luum jïñe kä biilken. Aŋ wäättä.
normalised_text: ang joong jaajjin ogo, ngommany acha woo waaka a udin ye, ka biilken, dhigarga ke waaka muulu inyi ye ke wakka luum jinye ka biilken. ang weatta.

name: Jumjum
text: Aŋ Jooŋ näŋŋä wakkä luum jïñe daa kä biilken, aŋ ḍigärgä daa kä biilken, ke waak'a muulu ïñï muure ye daa kä biilken. Aŋ yoori Jooŋ aŋan ŋeraŋ.
normalised_text: ang joong nangnga wakka luum jinye daa ka biilken, ang dhigarga daa ka biilken, ke waaka muulu inyi muure ye daa ka biilken. ang yoori joong angan ngerang.

name: Jumjum
text: Aŋ Jooŋ mänbaan naŋŋe kä biilke. Kä biilkä yeeke ike Jooŋ mänbaan naŋŋe. Naŋŋe oon ke iiŋ.
normalised_text: ang joong manbaan nangnge ka biilke. ka biilka yeeke ike joong manbaan nangnge. nangnge oon ke iing.

name: Jumjum
text: Aŋ Jooŋ wakkä yaaka naŋŋe ye, yoorre muureen ŋeraŋ kuckon. Aŋ biigin ti ḍakkä aŋ tïṇṇäŋänä äätin aŋ a nïïnkä kä ḍüügük.
normalised_text: ang joong wakka yaaka nangnge ye, yoorre muureen ngerang kuchkon. ang biigin ti dhakka ang tinnangana eatin ang a neinka ka dhouguk.

name: Jumjum
text: Naŋŋä polloŋ ke ŋommañ ke waak'a bilteen ye ḍaŋŋä.
normalised_text: nangnga pollong ke ngommany ke waaka bilteen ye dhangnga.

name: Jumjum
text: Aŋ Jooŋ ḍaŋŋä kä naŋŋä wakkä yeeke nïïnnä yaana kä ŋaṭükel ye ti, aŋ yore yïïkkene nïïnnä yaana kä ŋaṭükel ye ti kä nääŋkä yaaka naŋŋe ye muure.
normalised_text: ang joong dhangnga ka nangnga wakka yeeke neinna yaana ka ngathukel ye ti, ang yore yeikkene neinna yaana ka ngathukel ye ti ka neangka yaaka nangnge ye muure.

name: Jumjum
text: Aŋ Jooŋ nïïnnä ŋaṭükel ŋüülkene aŋ naŋŋe ladaŋ, kä yaana yore yïïkkeneeda kä ñuugula yen wakkä muure yaaka naŋŋe ye.
normalised_text: ang joong neinna ngathukel ngoulkene ang nangnge ladang, ka yaana yore yeikkeneeda ka nyuugula yen wakka muure yaaka nangnge ye.

name: Jumjum
text: Yaanni a gin'a näŋŋä ḍoŋe wääna Pïṭo Jooŋ näŋŋee kä polloŋ ke ŋommañ ye.
normalised_text: yaanni a gina nangnga dhonge weana pitho joong nangngee ka pollong ke ngommany ye.

name: Jumjum
text: Aŋ ñomuk ku on piik kääjïdï woo ŋommañ jï määtï ŋommañ wiñe muure.
normalised_text: ang nyomuk ku on piik keajidi woo ngommany ji meati ngommany winye muure.

name: Jur Modo
text: Di bi tisaki mo Bɔkoꞌba oꞌba mïtɔrɔ ni ti dɔliŋɔ.
normalised_text: di bi tisaki mu bokuba uba mitoro ni ti dolingo.

name: Jur Modo
text: Tine Bɔkoꞌba iya te, Iꞌdi bi kɔpɔ këdï. Kina bi kɔpɔ kɔdɔ ŋgï.
normalised_text: tine bokuba iya te, idi bi kopo kedi. kina bi kopo kodo ngi.

name: Jur Modo
text: Bɔkoꞌba ti mï këyï gɔ ame bo koŋgɔ ꞌdeni këdï laka, na bo koza bi kɔpɔ yaga di rɔ mandölu.
normalised_text: bokuba ti mi keyi go ame bu kungo deni kedi laka, na bu kuza bi kopo yaga di ro mandolu.

name: Jur Modo
text: Bo ïdëkï bi kɔpɔ rɔ bi këzë kina bo ïdëkï mandölu nima ŋgï rɔ korɔndɔ. Tine na dɔkɔpiyari kiteli dɔŋbɔ kuyï rönï. Ama na rɔ töꞌdö ma dɔgba.
normalised_text: bu ideki bi kopo ro bi keze kina bu ideki mandolu nima ngi ro kurondo. tine na dokopiyari kiteli dongbo kuyi roni. ama na ro todo ma dogba.

name: Jur Modo
text: Tine Bɔkoꞌba iya te, Iꞌdi a mɔtɔ këdï mï zana mini ꞌdɔ koza mï mini yaga bi rïyö.
normalised_text: tine bokuba iya te, idi a moto kedi mi zana mini do kuza mi mini yaga bi riyo.

name: Jur Modo
text: Kina bo koꞌdɔ a mɔtɔ koza mini ame bërï di rɔ ma koloma tɔrɔ ꞌdɔ kaꞌdi nima. Kina koꞌdɔ rönï ŋgï tara.
normalised_text: kina bu kudo a moto kuza mini ame beri di ro ma kuluma toro do kadi nima. kina kudo roni ngi tara.

name: Jur Modo
text: Bɔkoꞌba ïdëkï wa nima rɔ mïtɔrɔ. Tine na dɔkɔpiyari kiteli dɔŋbɔ kuyï rönï. Ama na rɔ töꞌdö ma dɔ rïyö.
normalised_text: bokuba ideki wa nima ro mitoro. tine na dokopiyari kiteli dongbo kuyi roni. ama na ro todo ma do riyo.

name: Jur Modo
text: Tine Bɔkoꞌba iya te, Iꞌdi mini ma bërï nime kotɔtɔ kpënnï bi kɔtɔ, kina iꞌdi yayi ma sari kɔdɔ. Kina koꞌdɔ rönï ŋgï tara.
normalised_text: tine bokuba iya te, idi mini ma beri nime kutoto kpenni bi koto, kina idi yayi ma sari kodo. kina kudo roni ngi tara.

name: Jur Modo
text: Bo ïdëkï yayi ma sari rɔ dɔyayi, kina bo ïdëkï mini ma kotɔtɔ kpënnï bi kɔtɔ naga nima rɔ yöpö. Bɔkoꞌba ti mï këyï gɔ ame bo koŋgɔ ꞌdeni këdï laka.
normalised_text: bu ideki yayi ma sari ro doyayi, kina bu ideki mini ma kutoto kpenni bi koto naga nima ro yopo. bokuba ti mi keyi go ame bu kungo deni kedi laka.

name: Jur Modo
text: Tine na dɔkɔpiyari kiteli dɔŋbɔ kuyï rönï. Ama na rɔ töꞌdö ma dɔ mota.
normalised_text: tine na dokopiyari kiteli dongbo kuyi roni. ama na ro todo ma do muta.

name: Jur Modo
text: Iꞌdi lïjë toyi bi di mïtɔrɔ kako dɔyayi. Kina koꞌdɔ rönï ŋgï tara.
normalised_text: idi lije tuyi bi di mitoro kaku doyayi. kina kudo roni ngi tara.

name: Jur Modo
text: Bo iꞌdi bi kɔpɔ naga nime mïtɔrɔ ꞌdɔ koyi bi dɔyayi.
normalised_text: bu idi bi kopo naga nime mitoro do kuyi bi doyayi.

name: Jur Modo
text: ꞌdɔ këdï rɔ ŋere ꞌba dɔ bi këzë ni ti korɔndɔ, gɔ koza bi kɔpɔ yaga di rɔ bi kölu. Bɔkoꞌba ti mï këyï gɔ ame bo koŋgɔ ꞌdeni këdï laka.
normalised_text: do kedi ro ngere ba do bi keze ni ti kurondo, go kuza bi kopo yaga di ro bi kolu. bokuba ti mi keyi go ame bu kungo deni kedi laka.

name: Jur Modo
text: Tine na dɔkɔpiyari kiteli dɔŋbɔ kuyï rönï. Ama na rɔ töꞌdö ma dɔ sowɔ.
normalised_text: tine na dokopiyari kiteli dongbo kuyi roni. ama na ro todo ma do suwo.

name: Jur Modo
text: Tine Bɔkoꞌba iya te, Iꞌdi wa ame ga ti dïdï yïmo ne konzi koso mï mini, kina iꞌdi yali köpu ti kebe tɔrɔ.
normalised_text: tine bokuba iya te, idi wa ame ga ti didi yimu ne kunzi kusu mi mini, kina idi yali kopu ti kebe toro.

name: Jur Modo
text: Kina bo koꞌdɔ yëyï zïnnï, iya te, Arake konzi kogba mï mini, kina yali gɔ kara konzi mï dɔyayi.
normalised_text: kina bu kudo yeyi zinni, iya te, arake kunzi kugba mi mini, kina yali go kara kunzi mi doyayi.

name: Jur Modo
text: Tine na dɔkɔpiyari kiteli dɔŋbɔ kuyï rönï. Ama na rɔ töꞌdö ma dɔ muyï.
normalised_text: tine na dokopiyari kiteli dongbo kuyi roni. ama na ro todo ma do muyi.

name: Jur Modo
text: Kina bo koꞌba bilaka lesi gɔ kïnë abo ꞌba Bɔkoꞌba ꞌdɔ lïjë këdï kɔzɔ bo tara. Bo oꞌba lïjë rɔ bɔtɔni ni ti ꞌja.
normalised_text: kina bu kuba bilaka lesi go kine abu ba bokuba do lije kedi kozo bu tara. bu uba lije ro botoni ni ti ja.

name: Jur Modo
text: Bo iya te, Miꞌdi wa ame ga këdï kana rɔ ꞌjɔ ne ꞌdeni ziye mï dɔyayi pili gbï ti ma këdï kana rɔ döŋgërï naga ziye rɔ akonyo.
normalised_text: bu iya te, midi wa ame ga kedi kana ro jo ne deni ziye mi doyayi pili gbi ti ma kedi kana ro dongeri naga ziye ro akunyu.

name: Jur Modo
text: Bɔkoꞌba oŋgɔ wa ame ga pili bo koꞌba ne, kina bo ti mï këyï gɔmo. Tine na dɔkɔpiyari kiteli dɔŋbɔ kuyï rönï. Ama na rɔ töꞌdö ma dɔ modɔɔkɔtɔ.
normalised_text: bokuba ungo wa ame ga pili bu kuba ne, kina bu ti mi keyi gomu. tine na dokopiyari kiteli dongbo kuyi roni. ama na ro todo ma do mudookoto.

name: Jur Modo
text: Tine ote toꞌba mïtɔrɔ ni ti dɔyayi ꞌdeni pili ti wa mo ga ame bo kiyija ne.
normalised_text: tine ute tuba mitoro ni ti doyayi deni pili ti wa mu ga ame bu kiyija ne.

name: Jur Modo
text: Mï töꞌdö dɔ modɔmorïyö tine Bɔkoꞌba ote ndɔbɔ pili abo ga ma bo koꞌdɔ ꞌdeni, na bo kindawo rɔ bo mï töꞌdö nima.
normalised_text: mi todo do mudomuriyo tine bokuba ute ndobo pili abu ga ma bu kudo deni, na bu kindawu ro bu mi todo nima.

name: Jur Modo
text: Tisaki ame ꞌdɔ kiꞌdi mïtɔrɔ ni ti dɔliŋɔ koꞌba rönï ne na kɔzɔ wa nima tara. Mï kada ma ŋere Bɔkoꞌba koꞌba mïtɔrɔ ni ti dɔliŋɔ.
normalised_text: tisaki ame do kidi mitoro ni ti dolingo kuba roni ne na kozo wa nima tara. mi kada ma ngere bokuba kuba mitoro ni ti dolingo.

name: Jur Modo
text: a mɔtɔ rɔ ŋgërï ni inza kina kupö ötu dë gbï römöyï bo iꞌdi tɔrɔ dë gba kaꞌdi, kina bɔtɔ mɔtɔ inza gbï ma ꞌdɔ korɔꞌdɔ yayi.
normalised_text: a moto ro ngeri ni inza kina kupo otu de gbi romoyi bu idi toro de gba kadi, kina boto moto inza gbi ma do kurodo yayi.

name: Jur Modo
text: Tine mini oloma tunzuꞌdï kako di mï yayi bërï kiyaꞌji dɔyayi.
normalised_text: tine mini uluma tunzudi kaku di mi yayi beri kiyaji doyayi.

name: Jur Modo
text: Tine na ŋere Bɔkoꞌba kogba yayi di mï dɔyayi koꞌba rɔ bilaka, kina bo kome lili ꞌba tiꞌdi dïdï kano mo kina bilaka nima ŋgï ti dïdï yïmo.
normalised_text: tine na ngere bokuba kugba yayi di mi doyayi kuba ro bilaka, kina bu kume lili ba tidi didi kano mu kina bilaka nima ngi ti didi yimu.

name: Jur Modo
text: Tine na ŋere Bɔkoꞌba kïdïyë nyaka mï Edene kapa kari yïbï. Kina bo kiꞌdi bilaka tönë bo koꞌba ne koloma yïmo yayi.
normalised_text: tine na ngere bokuba kidiye nyaka mi edene kapa kari yibi. kina bu kidi bilaka tone bu kuba ne kuluma yimu yayi.

name: Jur Modo
text: Yöpö oga rönï kɔlɔ kebe mï Edene kiyaꞌji mï nyaka nima. Di gönyï Edene yayi na koza dönï sowɔ.
normalised_text: yopo uga roni kolo kebe mi edene kiyaji mi nyaka nima. di gonyi edene yayi na kuza doni suwo.

name: Jur Modo
text: Yöpö ma dɔgba mo na rɔ ame kïdëkï rɔ Pisona ne, ɔlɔ ꞌbënï kebe mï dɔyayi ꞌba Awila.
normalised_text: yopo ma dogba mu na ro ame kideki ro pisuna ne, olo beni kebe mi doyayi ba awila.

name: Jur Modo
text: Gɔ bi nima na ti yamo ma köbököbö ma laka kulöwö teyi gbï ti ama kato kele ti lele ma kïnë köbö naga.
normalised_text: go bi nima na ti yamu ma kobokobo ma laka kulowo teyi gbi ti ama katu kele ti lele ma kine kobo naga.

name: Kaansa
text: Pãtɩ́ hũŋgi khɛɛrɩ ɩ̃ ná nanɩ Yésú Kírísi ʋ́ déeri Davíti wá kói ʋ́ déeri Ábráhám wá kói wɛra.
normalised_text: panti hunnggi kheeri in na nani yesu kirisi u dieri daviti wa koi u dieri abraham wa koi wera.

name: Kaansa
text: Ábráhámɩná hũni Ízákɩ , Ízákɩrá yaa hũni Jakɔ́pɩ , Jakɔ́pɩrá yaa hũni Júda ná ʋ́ mánɩ́khobi ná ʋ́ khɩ̃nɩbɩra.
normalised_text: abrahamina hunni izaki, izakira yaa hunni jakopi, jakopira yaa hunni juda na u manikhobi na u khinnibira.

name: Kaansa
text: Júdará yaa hũni Támâarná, Pɛ́ɛrɛ́zɩ ná Zéerá; Pɛ́ɛrɛ́zɩ̌ɩ yaa hũni Ɛ́sɩ́rɔ́m, Ɛ́sɩ́rɔ́mɩná yaa hũni Arámɩ.
normalised_text: judara yaa hunni tamearna, pierezi na ziera; pierezei yaa hunni esirom, esiromina yaa hunni arami.

name: Kaansa
text: Arámɩná yaa hũni Ámínádábɩ, Ámínádábɩrá yaa hũni Násɔ́nɩ, Násɔ̂ɔnná yaa hũni Sálmɔ́nɩ.
normalised_text: aramina yaa hunni aminadabi, aminadabira yaa hunni nasoni, nasuonna yaa hunni salmoni.

name: Kaansa
text: Sálmɔ́nɩná yaa hũni Arahábɩrá Bówázɩ; Bówázɩrá yaa hũni Urútirá Óbɛ́dɩ; Óbɛ́dɩrá yaa hũni Jésé.
normalised_text: salmonina yaa hunni arahabira bowazi; bowazira yaa hunni urutira obedi; obedira yaa hunni jese.

name: Kaansa
text: Jésérá yaa hũni ɩthakho Davíti. Davítirá yee Úrí wá harɩ ʋ́ ʋ huuri yɛ sɛ́ɛ wɛrɩ, ɩ̃ hũni ʋ́ bʋ Sálómɔ́ ;.
normalised_text: jesera yaa hunni itakho daviti. davitira yee uri wa hari u u huuri ye sie weri, in hunni u bu salomo;.

name: Kaansa
text: Sálómɔ́ná yaa hũni Óróbówám, Óróbówámɩná yaa hũni Ábɩ́yá, Ábɩ́yárá yaa hũni Ázáfɩ.

normalised_text: tamuno be ori ori enekubu mi ani ibime. se enekubu mi bu kanakana mi pusikimame.

name: Kirike
text: seni ọ̀ nwọse enekuḅu mị chịnmẹ Enekaka anịsịkị kanakana mị Ḍin. Anị ḅọrọso se saso na dede na simemẹ—anị tatarị ene mị-ẹ.
normalised_text: seni o nwose enekubu mi chinme enekaka anisiki kanakana mi din. ani boroso se saso na dede na simemeani tatari ene mie.

name: Kirike
text: Kpomgbo mị ọ̀ nwọse anị chịnmẹ So. Anị ḅọrọso se saso na dede na simemẹ—anị maịn karama ene mị-ẹ.
normalised_text: kpomgbo mi o nwose ani chinme so. ani boroso se saso na dede na simemeani main karama ene mie.

name: Kirike
text: Anịsịkị Tamụnọ Ḅe kụrọ pịrịmẹ Ye so mị chuku ḅie sime mengi mị ḅo gboloma gbọrị anga sime, mịẹse kiri pakaḅịa ḅara—anị pịkịna ọkọ sime mẹ.
normalised_text: anisiki tamuno be kuro pirime ye so mi chuku bie sime mengi mi bo gboloma gbori anga sime, miese kiri pakabia baraani pikina oko sime me.

name: Kirike
text: Ọ̀ nwọse paka nyọ mị chịnmẹ Kiri anịsịkị ḅo gboloma mengi mị ọ̀ nwọse anị chịnmẹ Tọrụ. Se Tamụnọ Ḅe ori ọrị kiri mị anị iḅimẹ.
normalised_text: o nwose paka nyo mi chinme kiri anisiki bo gboloma mengi mi o nwose ani chinme toru. se tamuno be ori ori kiri mi ani ibime.

name: Kirike
text: Se ọ̀ kụrọ pịrịmẹ, Ye kiri mị ịnyanya chụa, kịrịkịrị chịn na chịnmgbọlụ na pakụmaḅo—anị pịkịna ọkọ sime mẹ.
normalised_text: se o kuro pirime, ye kiri mi inyanya chua, kirikiri chin na chinmgbolu na pakumaboani pikina oko sime me.

name: Kirike
text: Anịẹrẹchị kiri mị ịnyanya chụa chịn ḅụ kịrịkịrị aye na kịrịkịrị fịaye chụa chịn na pakụmaḅomẹ, se Tamụnọ Ḅe ori ọrịye mị iḅimẹ.
normalised_text: anierechi kiri mi inyanya chua chin bu kirikiri aye na kirikiri fiaye chua chin na pakumabome, se tamuno be ori oriye mi ibime.

name: Kirike
text: Anị ḅọrọso se saso na dede simemẹ—anị tẹrẹ karama ene mị-ẹ.
normalised_text: ani boroso se saso na dede simemeani tere karama ene mie.

name: Kirike
text: àrị sotọrụ ḅịa se enekuḅu se kiri mị pịrịḅịa—anị pịkịna ọkọ mịẹmẹ.
normalised_text: ari sotoru bia se enekubu se kiri mi piribiaani pikina oko mieme.

name: Kirike
text: Anịḅụ Tamụnọ Ḅe mama opu tọnjie nwọ mịẹmẹ, ịrụa mị ḅẹrẹtọn enekaka mị pịrị, anịsịkị akalụ mị ḅẹrẹtọn ḍin mị pịrịḅịa; ọ̀ pịkịna loliama sọnị mịẹmẹ.
normalised_text: anibu tamuno be mama opu tonjie nwo mieme, irua mi bereton enekaka mi piri, anisiki akalu mi bereton din mi piribia; o pikina loliama soni mieme.

name: Kirike
text: Tọnjiema ò seni sotọrụ koromamẹ, àrị ḅịa paka kiri ọgọnọ saraḅịa ẹrẹchị.
normalised_text: tonjiema o seni sotoru koromame, ari bia paka kiri ogono sarabia erechi.

name: Kirike
text: àrị ḅẹrẹtọn enekaka mị na ḍin mị na pịrị, se pịkịna enekuḅu ḅụ kanakana mị pusikimamẹ. Se Tamụnọ Ḅe ori ọrịye mị anị iḅimẹ.
normalised_text: ari bereton enekaka mi na din mi na piri, se pikina enekubu bu kanakana mi pusikimame. se tamuno be ori oriye mi ani ibime.

name: Kirike
text: Anị ḅọrọso se saso na dede na simemẹ anị inein-a ḍin karama ene mị-ẹ.
normalised_text: ani boroso se saso na dede na simeme ani ineina din karama ene mie.

name: Kirike
text: Anịsịkị Tamụnọ Ḅe kụrọ pịrịmẹ, Ye kịrịkịrị pịkị ḍumo nyanaye mengi mị ḅie ḅein, pịkịna sotọrụ kịrịkịrị feni ḅein.
normalised_text: anisiki tamuno be kuro pirime, ye kirikiri piki dumo nyanaye mengi mi bie bein, pikina sotoru kirikiri feni bein.

name: Kirike
text: Anị ḅọrọso se saso na dede na simemẹ—anị sọnọ-a ḍin karama ene mị-ẹ.
normalised_text: ani boroso se saso na dede na simemeani sonoa din karama ene mie.

name: Kirike
text: Tamụnọ Ḅe arịmgba mịẹmẹ, ori ọrịye mị pịkị iḅimẹ.
normalised_text: tamuno be arimgba mieme, ori oriye mi piki ibime.

name: Kirike
text: Anịḅụ Tamụnọ Ḅe ò tomoni tẹmẹmẹ, ori ini mịẹmẹ ini ò simeọkụ simemẹ. Ori owuḅọ na eremeniḅọ na tẹmẹmẹ.
normalised_text: anibu tamuno be o tomoni tememe, ori ini mieme ini o simeoku simeme. ori owubo na eremenibo na tememe.

name: Kirike
text: Ọ́ fịḅịa kịrịkịrị ḍọkọḍọkọ fịaye mgbọlụ na, chịnmgbọlụma na, pịkịna jịn-a fịaye na à nwọseni ọ́ pịrịsam.
normalised_text: o fibia kirikiri dokodoko fiaye mgbolu na, chinmgboluma na, pikina jina fiaye na a nwoseni o pirisam.

name: Kirike
text: owoi-a nama mamgba na feni mamgba na, sẹkiri ḅụ ikiriaye na, ịnyanya na à nwọseni fịye ḅaraḅụ àrị pịrịsam—anị pịkịna ọkọ sime mẹ.
normalised_text: owoia nama mamgba na feni mamgba na, sekiri bu ikiriaye na, inyanya na a nwoseni fiye barabu ari pirisamani pikina oko sime me.

name: Kirike
text: Tamụnọ Ḅe ọ̀ mịẹsaye goyegoye ọ̀ nwọ pekele ḍikimẹ seni àrị pịkị iḅiọkụma iḅimẹ. Anị ḅọrọso se saso na dede na simemẹ—anị sonio-a ḍin karama ene mị-ẹ.
normalised_text: tamuno be o miesaye goyegoye o nwo pekele dikime seni ari piki ibiokuma ibime. ani boroso se saso na dede na simemeani sonioa din karama ene mie.

name: Kirike
text: Anịḅụ bebe tomonikiri mị mgba ḅo tẹmẹ karamaye sọmẹ.
normalised_text: anibu bebe tomonikiri mi mgba bo teme karamaye some.

name: Kirike
text: Sọnọma ḍin karama ene mị ḅụ Tamụnọ Ḅe ọ̀ mịẹarịye goyegoye nwọ mịẹfama seni ọ̀ fịrịnwẹngị ḅụ dachịẹmẹ.
normalised_text: sonoma din karama ene mi bu tamuno be o mieariye goyegoye nwo miefama seni o firinwengi bu dachieme.

name: Kirike
text: Tamụnọ Ḅe sọnọmẹ karama ene mị ḅẹlẹma mẹ, pịkị osi se anị pịrịmẹ, anịatịḅị anị ene mị ḅụ yetẹmẹ fịrị mị ọ̀ nwọ nwẹngị karamamẹ seni ori ịnyọsara mẹ.
normalised_text: tamuno be sonome karama ene mi belema me, piki osi se ani pirime, aniatibi ani ene mi bu yeteme firi mi o nwo nwengi karamame seni ori inyosara me.

name: Kirike
text: Anịḅara anị Tamụnọ Ḅe tomonikiri mị na, pịkịna anịa ḅie simeaye mamgba na tẹmẹ ọkụ-ẹ. Tamụnọ Nyanaḅọ Ḅe, so mị na tomonikiri mị na tẹmẹ sịkị.
normalised_text: anibara ani tamuno be tomonikiri mi na, pikina ania bie simeaye mamgba na teme okue. tamuno nyanabo be, so mi na tomonikiri mi na teme siki.

name: Kirike
text: ọkụma mengi kiri chuku ḅie pakaḅo se kiri mị pisima-pisimamẹ.
normalised_text: okuma mengi kiri chuku bie pakabo se kiri mi pisimapisimame.

name: Kirike
text: Anịsịkị Tamụnọ Nyanaḅọ Ḅe, Idẹn ḅie ịrụa mị pakapaka nyọ ḅụ ozu ḍipimẹ se ori anịju ḅụ ọ̀ tẹmẹḅọ ḅe seni koromamẹ.
normalised_text: anisiki tamuno nyanabo be, iden bie irua mi pakapaka nyo bu ozu dipime se ori aniju bu o temebo be seni koromame.

name: Kirike
text: Idẹn mị ḅie ideri mengi ḅọrọ se ozu mị pisima-pisimamẹ, anịnyọ Idẹn mị ḅụ sikima, anị ḅo inein-a ịkpangị nwọ pumẹ.
normalised_text: iden mi bie ideri mengi boro se ozu mi pisimapisimame, aninyo iden mi bu sikima, ani bo ineina ikpangi nwo pume.

name: Kirike
text: Tatarị tọrụ mị anị Pishọn mị-ẹ, anị ideri Havila sẹ mị kelemamẹ.
normalised_text: tatari toru mi ani pishon mie, ani ideri havila se mi kelemame.

name: Kirundi
text: Ubga mbere na mbere Imana yaremye ijuru nisi.
normalised_text: ubga mbere na mbere imana yaremye ijuru nisi.

name: Kirundi
text: Isi yar ikir i buziba, yarik ubusa gusa, kand umwiza war upfutse idamba: kandi Mpwemu wImana yatambatamba hejuru yamazi.
normalised_text: isi yar ikir i buziba, yarik ubusa gusa, kand umwiza war upfutse idamba kandi mpwemu wimana yatambatamba hejuru yamazi.

name: Kirundi
text: Imana iravuga iti: Nihabeho umuco, maze umuco ubaho.
normalised_text: imana iravuga iti nihabeho umuco, maze umuco ubaho.

name: Kirundi
text: Imana iravuga, iti Ni habeh umuco: umuco ubaho.
normalised_text: imana iravuga, iti ni habeh umuco umuco ubaho.

name: Kirundi
text: Imana ibona ko umuco ari mwiza, hanyuma iwutandukanya numwijima.
normalised_text: imana ibona ko umuco ari mwiza, hanyuma iwutandukanya numwijima.

name: Kirundi
text: Imana ibona umuco kw ari mwiza: iraheza itandukanya umuco numwiza.
normalised_text: imana ibona umuco kw ari mwiza iraheza itandukanya umuco numwiza.

name: Kirundi
text: Imana yita umuco umurango, umwijima na wo iwita ijoro. Nuko haza umugoroba hanyuma igitondo; uwo uba umusi wa mbere.
normalised_text: imana yita umuco umurango, umwijima na wo iwita ijoro. nuko haza umugoroba hanyuma igitondo; uwo uba umusi wa mbere.

name: Kirundi
text: Imana yita umuco umurango, umwiza iwita ijoro. Buragoroba, buraca: uwo numusi wa mbere.
normalised_text: imana yita umuco umurango, umwiza iwita ijoro. buragoroba, buraca uwo numusi wa mbere.

name: Kirundi
text: Imana iravuga iti: Nihabeho ikirere hagati yamazi nayandi, kugira ngo gitandukanye amazi yo hejuru nayo kwisi.
normalised_text: imana iravuga iti nihabeho ikirere hagati yamazi nayandi, kugira ngo gitandukanye amazi yo hejuru nayo kwisi.

name: Kirundi
text: Imana iravuga, iti Ni habeh itāzānure hagati yamazi, ritandukanye amazi nayandi.
normalised_text: imana iravuga, iti ni habeh itazanure hagati yamazi, ritandukanye amazi nayandi.

name: Kirundi
text: Imana iraritāzānura, itandukanya amazi yo musi yitāzānure nayo hejuru yaryo: biba kuno.
normalised_text: imana iraritazanura, itandukanya amazi yo musi yitazanure nayo hejuru yaryo biba kuno.

name: Kirundi
text: Nuko Imana ishiraho ikirere co gutandukanya amazi yo kwisi nayo hejuru.
normalised_text: nuko imana ishiraho ikirere co gutandukanya amazi yo kwisi nayo hejuru.

name: Kirundi
text: Imana yita ico kirere ijuru. Nuko haza umugoroba hanyuma igitondo; uwo uba umusi wa kabiri.
normalised_text: imana yita ico kirere ijuru. nuko haza umugoroba hanyuma igitondo; uwo uba umusi wa kabiri.

name: Kirundi
text: Maz iryo tāzānure Imana iryita Ijuru. Buragoroba, buraca: uwo numusi ugira kabiri.
normalised_text: maz iryo tazanure imana iryita ijuru. buragoroba, buraca uwo numusi ugira kabiri.

name: Kirundi
text: Imana iravuga iti: Amazi yo musi yijuru niyegeranire mu kibanza kimwe, hanyuma haboneke ahantu humutse. Nuko bigenda uko nyene.
normalised_text: imana iravuga iti amazi yo musi yijuru niyegeranire mu kibanza kimwe, hanyuma haboneke ahantu humutse. nuko bigenda uko nyene.

name: Kirundi
text: Imana iravuga, it Amazi yo musi yijuru nakoranire hamwe, i musozi na ho ni haboneke: biba kuno.
normalised_text: imana iravuga, it amazi yo musi yijuru nakoranire hamwe, i musozi na ho ni haboneke biba kuno.

name: Kirundi
text: Imana yita ahantu humutse isi, amazi yegeraniye hamwe na yo iyita ikiyaga. Imana ibona ko vyose ari vyiza.
normalised_text: imana yita ahantu humutse isi, amazi yegeraniye hamwe na yo iyita ikiyaga. imana ibona ko vyose ari vyiza.

name: Kirundi
text: Maz i musozi Imana ihita Isi, ikoraniro ryamazi na ryo iryita Ibiyaga: Imana ibona kw ari vyiza.
normalised_text: maz i musozi imana ihita isi, ikoraniro ryamazi na ryo iryita ibiyaga imana ibona kw ari vyiza.

name: Kirundi
text: Nuko haza umugoroba hanyuma igitondo; uwo uba umusi wa gatatu.
normalised_text: nuko haza umugoroba hanyuma igitondo; uwo uba umusi wa gatatu.

name: Kirundi
text: Imana iravuga iti: Nihabeho ivyaka kwijuru kugira ngo bitandukanye umurango nijoro; maze bibe ibimenyetso bitandukanya ibihe, imisi nimyaka.
normalised_text: imana iravuga iti nihabeho ivyaka kwijuru kugira ngo bitandukanye umurango nijoro; maze bibe ibimenyetso bitandukanya ibihe, imisi nimyaka.

name: Kirundi
text: Ivyo vyaka biri kwijuru nivyakire isi. Nuko bigenda uko.
normalised_text: ivyo vyaka biri kwijuru nivyakire isi. nuko bigenda uko.

name: Kirundi
text: kandi bibe ivyāka vyo mw itāzānure ry ijuru vyo kwākira isi: biba kuno.
normalised_text: kandi bibe ivyaka vyo mw itazanure ry ijuru vyo kwakira isi biba kuno.

name: Kirundi
text: Imana irema ivyaka bibiri binini: icaka cane co kuganza umurango nicaka bukebuke co kuganza ijoro. Yongera irema ninyenyeri.
normalised_text: imana irema ivyaka bibiri binini icaka cane co kuganza umurango nicaka bukebuke co kuganza ijoro. yongera irema ninyenyeri.

name: Kirundi
text: Imana irema ivyāka bibiri binini, icaka kinini co kuganza umurango, nicaka gitoya co kuganza ijoro, bo ninyenyeri.
normalised_text: imana irema ivyaka bibiri binini, icaka kinini co kuganza umurango, nicaka gitoya co kuganza ijoro, bo ninyenyeri.

name: Kirundi
text: Imana ibishira mw itāzānure ryijuru kugira ngo vyākire isi.
normalised_text: imana ibishira mw itazanure ryijuru kugira ngo vyakire isi.

name: Kirundi
text: Nuko Imana ibishira kwijuru kugira ngo biboneshereze isi.
normalised_text: nuko imana ibishira kwijuru kugira ngo biboneshereze isi.

name: Kirundi
text: biganze umurango nijoro, bitandukanye umuco numwiza; Imana ibona kw ari vyiza.
normalised_text: biganze umurango nijoro, bitandukanye umuco numwiza; imana ibona kw ari vyiza.

name: Kirundi
text: biganze umurango nijoro, vyongere bitandukanye umuco numwijima. Kandi Imana ibona ko ari vyiza.
normalised_text: biganze umurango nijoro, vyongere bitandukanye umuco numwijima. kandi imana ibona ko ari vyiza.

name: Kirundi
text: Nuko haza umugoroba hanyuma igitondo; uwo uba umusi wa kane.
normalised_text: nuko haza umugoroba hanyuma igitondo; uwo uba umusi wa kane.

name: Kirundi
text: Imana iravuga iti: Ibifise ubuzima nivyuzure mu mazi, inyoni na zo niziguruke hejuru yisi mu kirere.
normalised_text: imana iravuga iti ibifise ubuzima nivyuzure mu mazi, inyoni na zo niziguruke hejuru yisi mu kirere.

name: Kissi
text: O kandɔɔ tasoo , mí Hala cɔaw halataalaa a lɛŋnden.
normalised_text: o kanduo tasoo, mi hala choaw halataalaa a lengnden.

name: Kissi
text: Lɛŋnden le va tulumasaa , ɲɛ-ɲɛ ve lecoo le. Ɲumma bɛndu-bɛnduan ma va matoalaa kpingbi o mɛnndan coo. Kɔl Hala-o va o pɛɛngaa o mɛmma man coo.
normalised_text: lengnden le va tulumasaa, nyenye ve lechoo le. nyumma bendubenduan ma va matoalaa kpingbi o menndan coo. kol halao va o piengaa o memma man coo.

name: Kissi
text: Mí Hala dimi aa: «Ɲɔ́ɔ́ téngá!» Mí ɲɔɔ tèngà.
normalised_text: mi hala dimi aa "nyoo tenga!" mi nyuo tenga.

name: Kissi
text: Mí Hala ca maa ɲɛ-tengaa naŋ. O kon, mó sɛi ɲɛ-tengaa a ɲumndan.
normalised_text: mi hala cha maa nyetengaa nang. o kon, mo sei nyetengaa a nyumndan.

name: Kissi
text: Mó ke ɲɛ-tengaa diolan aa ipala, ɲumndan aa icɔl. Mí ɲɔɔ yɔŋnun icɔllo a ipalaa. Paale taselen le yɔŋnun nden ni.
normalised_text: mo ke nyetengaa diolan aa ipala, nyumndan aa ichol. mi nyuo yongnun ichollo a ipalaa. paale taselen le yongnun nden ni.

name: Kissi
text: Mí Hala dimi vɛlɛ aa: «Ɲɛ pandonndo fulá tɛ́ngɛ̀-tɛ́ngɛ̀ le mɛnndan sɛiyo tɛɛn kundala bɛndulan tan tiɔn.».
normalised_text: mi hala dimi vele aa "nye pandonndo fula tengetenge le menndan seiyo tien kundala bendulan tan tion.".

name: Kissi
text: Mí Hala soli ɲɛ pandonndo, mó handu ndu pɛɛngulan mɛmma co lebɛngu-an a mɛmma co lecoo-an tɛɛn. Mí ɲɔɔ tosan lende.
normalised_text: mi hala soli nye pandonndo, mo handu ndu piengulan memma cho lebenguan a memma cho lechooan tien. mi nyuo tosan lende.

name: Kissi
text: Mí Hala ke fonda sɛi kon mɛnndan-ndo diolan aa halataalaa. Mí ɲɔɔ yɔŋnun icɔllo a ipalaa. Paale diinndɔlen le yɔŋnun nden ni.
normalised_text: mi hala ke fonda sei kon menndanndo diolan aa halataalaa. mi nyuo yongnun ichollo a ipalaa. paale diinndolen le yongnun nden ni.

name: Kissi
text: Mí Hala dimi aa: «Mɛmma co o lɛŋnden coo-an mà diinún nɛɛ pilɛ mì kɔngɔ vesɛiyo lo baa pilɔɔ.» Mí ɲɔɔ tosan lende.
normalised_text: mi hala dimi aa "memma cho o lengnden cooan ma diinun nie pile mi kongo veseiyo lo baa piluo." mi nyuo tosan lende.

name: Kissi
text: Mí Hala ke kɔngɔ vesɛi fula-o diolan aa lɛŋnden, mó ke mɛmma diinun man nɛɛ pilɛ-an diolan aa mɛmma ihɛllan. Mí Hala ca maa ɲɔɔ naŋ.
normalised_text: mi hala ke kongo vesei fulao diolan aa lengnden, mo ke memma diinun man nie pilean diolan aa memma ihellan. mi hala cha maa nyuo nang.

name: Kissi
text: Mí ɲɔɔ yɔŋnun icɔllo a ipalaa. Paale yàándɔlen le yɔŋnun nden ni.
normalised_text: mi nyuo yongnun ichollo a ipalaa. paale yaandolen le yongnun nden ni.

name: Kroumen Tépo

name: Kroumen Tépo

name: Kuria
text: na ibhimörë bhiyö bhirabhiri ëkëbhara gukurua kuriöbha, gëkabha ke hayö.
normalised_text: na ivhimore vhiyo vhiravhiri ekevhara ghukurua kuriovha, ghekavha ke hayo.

name: Kuria
text: Ënooköë agakora ibhimörë bhibhërë ibhinene, iriöbha rebhaahë ömöbhasö nu umueri göbhaahe ubhutikö, guiki naakorrë ichinyunyuunyi.
normalised_text: enookoe aghakora ivhimore vhivhere ivhinene, iriovha revhaahe omovhaso nu umueri ghovhaahe uvhutiko, ghuiki naakore ichinyunyuunyi.

name: Kuria
text: Ënooköë agatööra ibhimörë bhiira igörö kuriöbha korri bhirabhiri ëkëbhara.
normalised_text: enookoe aghatuora ivhimore vhiira ighoro kuriovha kori vhiravhiri ekevhara.

name: Kuria
text: bhibhaahe ömöbhasö na ubhutikö na bhiaahökani öbhörabhu kurua kugisunte. Ënooköë akamaaha iga mbuuya.
normalised_text: vhivhaahe omovhaso na uvhutiko na vhiaahokani ovhoravhu kurua kughisunte. enookoe akamaaha igha mbuuya.

name: Kuria
text: Hakurua Ënooköë akagamba iga, Tiga amanchë gaichöre ibhiteemoa bhi ichituubho chonsui, na ibhinyunyi bhibhurruke igörö, kuriöbha köyö.
normalised_text: hakurua enookoe akaghamba igha, tigha amanche ghaichore ivhiteemoa vhi ichituuvho chonsui, na ivhinyunyi vhivhuruke ighoro, kuriovha koyo.

name: Kuria
text: Ënooköë agachiitabhiria chonsui akagamba iga, Ibhörana muichuri ichinyancha, na kubhinyunyi akagamba iga, Iyengeria gökëbhara.
normalised_text: enookoe aghachiitavhiria chonsui akaghamba igha, ivhorana muichuri ichinyancha, na kuvhinyunyi akaghamba igha, iyengheria ghokevhara.

name: Kuria
text: Igo, Ënooköë agakora ichitiinyi cha ibhara, ichitugo, na ibhiteemoa bhino bhikuing'uura hansë guchituubho chonsui. Ënooköë akamaaha iga mbuuya.
normalised_text: igho, enookoe aghakora ichitiinyi cha ivhara, ichitugho, na ivhiteemoa vhino vhikuinguura hanse ghuchituuvho chonsui. enookoe akamaaha igha mbuuya.

name: Kuria
text: Bhoono, Ënooköë agateema ömöntö gutuubho yaae umuene, gutuubho yaae naateemërë ömösaacha na ömökari.
normalised_text: vhoono, enookoe aghateema omonto ghutuuvho yaae umuene, ghutuuvho yaae naateemere omosaacha na omokari.

name: Kuria
text: Ënooköë akamaaha iga mbuuya kubhintö bhionsui bhino aateemërë, akagookeroa bhökong'u. Bhökaira na bhögakëa, urusikö ro gasansabha.
normalised_text: enookoe akamaaha igha mbuuya kuvhinto vhionsui vhino aateemere, akaghookeroa vhokongu. vhokaira na vhoghakea, urusiko ro ghasansavha.

name: Kuria
text: Nkeebhöyö, ëmërëmo ge göteema igörö kuriöbha na hansë gökëbhara hamui ni ibhintö bhiabhio bhionsui geesirrë.
normalised_text: nkeevhoyo, emeremo ghe ghoteema ighoro kuriovha na hanse ghokevhara hamui ni ivhinto vhiavhio vhionsui gheesire.

name: Kuria
text: Ënooköë agaitabhiria urusikö rö muhungatë na körösabhuura, akamuunya kugira urusikö röyö ndo aasookiri ëmërëmo gë göteema.
normalised_text: enookoe aghaitavhiria urusiko ro muhunghate na korosavhuura, akamuunya kughira urusiko royo ndo aasookiri emeremo ghe ghoteema.

name: Kuria
text: Niigo ëkëbhara na kuriöbha bhiateemëröë. Hano ÖMÖNENE Ënooköë aateemërë ëkëbhara na igörö kuriöbha.
normalised_text: niigho ekevhara na kuriovha vhiateemeroe. hano omonene enookoe aateemere ekevhara na ighoro kuriovha.

name: Kuria
text: Sibhoono urumi rökurua hansë gökëbhara rökanyihia irirobha rionsui.
normalised_text: sivhoono urumi rokurua hanse ghokevhara rokanyihia irirovha rionsui.

name: Kuria
text: Hakurua ÖMÖNENE Ënooköë akaimia irisamba Eteni, ëntahana ya rögörö, agatööra mo ömöntö ööra naanyoorrë aateemërë.
normalised_text: hakurua omonene enookoe akaimia irisamba eteni, entahana ya roghoro, aghatuora mo omonto uora naanyoore aateemere.

name: Kuria
text: Ömooro ngörëngë Eteni haara göno goorë kögera na köhömëërra irisamba rëyö, kurua hayö ömooro göyö gökaahökana gökabha imioro ënai.
normalised_text: omooro nghorenghe eteni haara ghono ghoore koghera na kohomiera irisamba reyo, kurua hayo omooro ghoyo ghokaahokana ghokavha imioro enai.

name: Kuria
text: Iriina riö ömooro go mbere niiga Bhisoni; ngo gukuinaara ënsë yonsui ya Habhira hano ësahaabhu ërë.
normalised_text: iriina rio omooro gho mbere niigha vhisoni; ngho ghukuinaara ense yonsui ya havhira hano esahaavhu ere.

name: Kuria
text: Ësahaabhu yë ënsë ëyö ni inchiiya bhökong'u. Guiki amaguta gano gakurumbaasa bhuuya na amagëna gi iriguri irinene ngötööka garë ho.
normalised_text: esahaavhu ye ense eyo ni inchiiya vhokongu. ghuiki amaghuta ghano ghakurumbaasa vhuuya na amaghena ghi irighuri irinene nghotuoka ghare ho.

name: Kuria
text: Iriina riö omooro gökabhërë niiga Gihoni; ngo gukuinaara ënsë yonsui ya Kusi.
normalised_text: iriina rio omooro ghokavhere niigha ghihoni; ngho ghukuinaara ense yonsui ya kusi.

name: Kuria
text: ÖMÖNENE Ënooköë akaimukia ömöntö ööra akamötööra guisamba re Eteni iga arërëme na körëmahëërra.
normalised_text: omonene enookoe akaimukia omonto uora akamotuora ghuisamba re eteni igha arereme na koremahiera.

name: Kuria
text: Hakurua ÖMÖNENE Ënooköë akamöteebhia iga, Nökaarëa amakö ga këra mötë göno görëngë guisamba;.
normalised_text: hakurua omonene enookoe akamoteevhia igha, nokaarea amako gha kera mote ghono ghorenghe ghuisamba;.

name: Kuria
text: sibhoono amakö gö ömötë gu ubhunguri bhua amaiya na amabhëëbhë, ötagaacha körëa, kugira röno örërëa amakö gö ömötë göyö, maheene nuurikua.
normalised_text: sivhoono amako gho omote ghu uvhunghuri vhua amaiya na amavhievhe, otaghaacha korea, kughira rono orerea amako gho omote ghoyo, maheene nuurikua.

name: Kusaal
text: Si'el da ka' teŋ la nii, ka zin'ig la wʋsa da an yɔɔg-yɔɔg, lik ma'aa da pɛ'ɛl, ka Wina'am Siig da laannɛ giligid ku'om la zug.
normalised_text: siel da ka teng la nii, ka zinig la wusa da an yoogyoog, lik maaa da peel, ka winaam siig da laanne giligid kuom la zug.

name: Kusaal
text: Ka Wina'am yɛl ye, Kɛl ka li an nyain. Ka li sid nie nyain.
normalised_text: ka winaam yel ye, kel ka li an nyain. ka li sid nie nyain.

name: Kusaal
text: Ka Wina'am nyɛ ka nɛɛsim la an sʋm ka o bak nɛɛsim la ka kɛ lik.
normalised_text: ka winaam nye ka neesim la an sum ka o bak neesim la ka ke lik.

name: Kusaal
text: Ka Wina'am buol nɛɛsim la ye, Nintaŋ ka buol lik la ye, Yʋ'ʋŋ. Ka yʋ'ʋŋ sɔb ka bɛog nie, linɛ da an yiiga dabisir.
normalised_text: ka winaam buol neesim la ye, nintang ka buol lik la ye, yuung. ka yuung sob ka beog nie, line da an yiiga dabisir.

name: Kusaal
text: Ka Wina'am yɛl ye, Kɛl ka si'el bɛɛ an lammiri bɛŋ ku'okanɛ bɛɛ agɔl la nɛ ku'okanɛ bɛ teŋir la.
normalised_text: ka winaam yel ye, kel ka siel bee an lammiri beng kuokane bee agol la ne kuokane be tengir la.

name: Kusaal
text: Ka Wina'am kɛ ka bʋnlammir la bɛŋ kuokanɛ bɛɛ agɔl la ka bas kuokanɛ bɛ teŋir la. Ka li sid niŋ ala.
normalised_text: ka winaam ke ka bunlammir la beng kuokane bee agol la ka bas kuokane be tengir la. ka li sid ning ala.

name: Kusaal
text: Ka Wina'am buol bʋnlammir dinɛ bɛɛ agɔl la ye, Saŋgbauŋ. Ka yʋ'ʋŋ da sɔb ka bɛog nie dabayi' daare la.
normalised_text: ka winaam buol bunlammir dine bee agol la ye, sanggbaung. ka yuung da sob ka beog nie dabayi daare la.

name: Kusaal
text: Ka Wina'am yɛl ye, Kɛl ka ku'okanɛ bɛ saŋgbauŋ la teŋir la la'as zin'ig yinne, ka kɛ ka li teŋir la nie. Ka li sid niŋ ala.
normalised_text: ka winaam yel ye, kel ka kuokane be sanggbaung la tengir la laas zinig yinne, ka ke ka li tengir la nie. ka li sid ning ala.

name: Kusaal
text: Ka Wina'am buol zin'ikanɛ nie ka kʋdig la ye, Teŋ, ka buol ku'om la ye, Atɛuk. Ka Wina'am nyɛ ka li an sʋm.
normalised_text: ka winaam buol zinikane nie ka kudig la ye, teng, ka buol kuom la ye, ateuk. ka winaam nye ka li an sum.

name: Kusaal
text: Ka teŋ la pɛ'ɛl nɛ zʋʋd nɛ tiis. Ka bʋmbʋʋda wʋsa du'a li buudi. Ka Wina'am nyɛ ka li an sʋm.
normalised_text: ka teng la peel ne zuud ne tiis. ka bumbuuda wusa dua li buudi. ka winaam nye ka li an sum.

name: Kusaal
text: Ka yʋ'ʋŋ sɔb ka bɛog nie daba atan' daare la.
normalised_text: ka yuung sob ka beog nie daba atan daare la.

name: Kusaal
text: Ka Wina'am yɛl ye, Kɛl ka bugum bɛɛ agɔl dinɛ na bak nintaŋ nɛ yʋ'ʋŋ ka an zanbin linɛ pa'an sɛɛung nɛ ʋʋn, nɛ dabisa nɛ yʋma.
normalised_text: ka winaam yel ye, kel ka bugum bee agol dine na bak nintang ne yuung ka an zanbin line paan seeung ne uun, ne dabisa ne yuma.

name: Kusaal
text: Ka kɛ ka bugum bɛ saŋgbauŋ la ni dinɛ na tis teŋgbauŋ la nɛɛsim. Ka li sid niŋ ala.
normalised_text: ka ke ka bugum be sanggbaung la ni dine na tis tenggbaung la neesim. ka li sid ning ala.

name: Kusaal
text: Wina'am da maal nɛ bugum kanda ayi'. Bugum tita'ar la da tisid nɛɛsim nintaŋ ka bugum si'asiŋ la tisid nɛɛsim yʋ'ʋŋ. O da lɛm maal nwadbibis.
normalised_text: winaam da maal ne bugum kanda ayi. bugum titaar la da tisid neesim nintang ka bugum siasing la tisid neesim yuung. o da lem maal nwadbibis.

name: Kusaal
text: Wina'am da maali ba niŋ saŋgbana la ni ye ba tis teŋgbauŋ la nɛɛsim.
normalised_text: winaam da maali ba ning sanggbana la ni ye ba tis tenggbaung la neesim.

name: Kusaal
text: ka sʋ'oe nintaŋ nɛ yʋ'ʋŋ ka wɛlig nɛɛsim yi likin. Ka Wina'am nyɛ ka li an sʋm.
normalised_text: ka suoe nintang ne yuung ka welig neesim yi likin. ka winaam nye ka li an sum.

name: Kusaal
text: Ka yʋ'ʋŋ da sɔb ka bɛog nie daba anaasi daare la.
normalised_text: ka yuung da sob ka beog nie daba anaasi daare la.

name: Kusaal
text: Ka Wina'am yɛl ye, Kɛl ka ku'om la mɔr zimi nɛ bʋnvʋya banɛ bɛ ku'omin wʋsa, ka kɛ ka niis buudi wʋsa ian'ad agɔla.
normalised_text: ka winaam yel ye, kel ka kuom la mor zimi ne bunvuya bane be kuomin wusa, ka ke ka niis buudi wusa ianad agola.

name: Kusaal
text: Ka Wina'am maal bʋnvʋbɛda banɛ bɛɛ atɛukʋn la, nɛ zimi nɛ ba buudi nɛ niis nɛ ba buudi. Ka Wina'am nyɛ ka li an sʋm.
normalised_text: ka winaam maal bunvubeda bane bee ateukun la, ne zimi ne ba buudi ne niis ne ba buudi. ka winaam nye ka li an sum.

name: Kusaal
text: Ka Wina'am niŋi ba zug bareka ka yɛl ye, Kɛl ka zimi la wiaki pɛ'ɛl atɛuk la ka kɛ ka niis la mɛ wiaki pɛ'ɛl teŋgbauŋ la.
normalised_text: ka winaam ningi ba zug bareka ka yel ye, kel ka zimi la wiaki peel ateuk la ka ke ka niis la me wiaki peel tenggbaung la.

name: Kusaal
text: Ka yʋ'ʋŋ da sɔb ka bɛog nie daba anu daare la.
normalised_text: ka yuung da sob ka beog nie daba anu daare la.

name: Kusaal
text: Ala ka Wina'am da maal ninsaal nwɛnɛ o mɛŋi an si'em la. Dau nɛ pu'a ka o da maal.
normalised_text: ala ka winaam da maal ninsaal nwene o mengi an siem la. dau ne pua ka o da maal.

name: Kusaal
text: Ka Wina'am yɛl ye, M tisi ya zʋʋd linɛ du'ad bielim teŋgbauŋ la zug wʋsa, nɛ tiis banɛ wan wala ka mɔr biili la wʋsa. Ba na an diibi tisi ya.
normalised_text: ka winaam yel ye, m tisi ya zuud line duad bielim tenggbaung la zug wusa, ne tiis bane wan wala ka mor biili la wusa. ba na an diibi tisi ya.

name: Kusaal
text: Wina'am da nyɛ on maal si'el la wʋsa ka li an sʋm. Ka yʋ'ʋŋ sɔb ka bɛog nie daba ayuobʋ daare la.
normalised_text: winaam da nye on maal siel la wusa ka li an sum. ka yuung sob ka beog nie daba ayuobu daare la.

name: Kusaal
text: Ala ka Wina'am da maal agɔl nɛ teŋ, nɛ bʋn linɛ bɛɛ ani la wʋsa naae.
normalised_text: ala ka winaam da maal agol ne teng, ne bun line bee ani la wusa naae.

name: Kusaal
text: Ka daba ayɔpɔi la daar o da naae o tʋʋma la wʋsa ka vʋ'ʋs daakan la.
normalised_text: ka daba ayopoi la daar o da naae o tuuma la wusa ka vuus daakan la.

name: Kusaal
text: Ka Wina'am niŋ daba ayɔpɔi la daar zug bareka ka kɛ ka li an kasi, bɔzugɔ on da maal agɔl nɛ teŋi naae la daakan ka o da vʋ'ʋs.
normalised_text: ka winaam ning daba ayopoi la daar zug bareka ka ke ka li an kasi, bozugo on da maal agol ne tengi naae la daakan ka o da vuus.

name: Kusaal
text: Agɔl nɛ teŋ maaligʋ da pin'il si'em nwa'. Zugsɔb Wina'am da maal agɔl nɛ teŋ la.
normalised_text: agol ne teng maaligu da pinil siem nwa. zugsob winaam da maal agol ne teng la.

name: Kusaal
text: tiis nɛ mɔɔd wʋsa da nam pʋ yi teŋ la zugɔ, bɔzugɔ Zugsɔb Wina'am da nam pʋ kɛ ka saa ni teŋ la zugɔ, ka ninsaal mɛ da nan kae na kua teŋ la.
normalised_text: tiis ne mood wusa da nam pu yi teng la zugo, bozugo zugsob winaam da nam pu ke ka saa ni teng la zugo, ka ninsaal me da nan kae na kua teng la.

name: Kusaal
text: Ka Zugsɔb Wina'am gbin'e tanni ya'ab dau ka vʋ'ʋs o mɛŋ vʋ'ʋsʋm niŋ o nyɔnya ni, ka dau la lieb ninsaal ka vʋ'ʋsid.
normalised_text: ka zugsob winaam gbine tanni yaab dau ka vuus o meng vuusum ning o nyonya ni, ka dau la lieb ninsaal ka vuusid.

name: Kutep
text: utense tsi rubwen, iken iki ta-yi uwae atang be, si nyáng kubunn ambyi, ti kufub ti sikyi yi. Ama kusung Rimam ku yang pakob risu ambyi.
normalised_text: utense tsi rubwen, iken iki tayi uwae atang be, si nyang kubunn ambyi, ti kufub ti sikyi yi. ama kusung rimam ku yang pakob risu ambyi.

name: Kutep
text: Ama Rimam ri baa, Kufarang ā ba tsi. Ama kufarang tsi.
normalised_text: ama rimam ri baa, kufarang a ba tsi. ama kufarang tsi.

name: Kutep
text: Ama Rimam sae kufarang wune baa, awu na nyang, ama awu kata kufarang wu te kufub.
normalised_text: ama rimam sae kufarang wune baa, awu na nyang, ama awu kata kufarang wu te kufub.

name: Kutep
text: Rimam kunn kufarang wu baa, Usirtaen. Kufub ama, awu kunn wu baa, Utitang. Ama usir sa te, ucwe sa famsi, uwae usir ti kinjo.
normalised_text: rimam kunn kufarang wu baa, usirtaen. kufub ama, awu kunn wu baa, utitang. ama usir sa te, ucwe sa famsi, uwae usir ti kinjo.

name: Kutep
text: Ama Rimam ri baa, Apwa tiyaen ā nae kutampwa ambyi, ti ayi ā kata ambyi ifaen.
normalised_text: ama rimam ri baa, apwa tiyaen a nae kutampwa ambyi, ti ayi a kata ambyi ifaen.

name: Kutep
text: Ikyaen yine Rimam kyae apwa, u kata ambyi ti riben tí ti apupwen. Ama ayi tsi pangma ti Rimam ri.
normalised_text: ikyaen yine rimam kyae apwa, u kata ambyi ti riben ti ti apupwen. ama ayi tsi pangma ti rimam ri.

name: Kutep
text: Rimam kunn apwa wu baa, Apwa apupwen. Ama usir sa te, ucwe sa famsi, uwae usir ti ifaen.
normalised_text: rimam kunn apwa wu baa, apwa apupwen. ama usir sa te, ucwe sa famsi, uwae usir ti ifaen.

name: Kutep
text: Ama Rimam ri baa, Ambyi ti munnkyi riben ā pu funn atso uwog kinjo, ti riben ā nae ise. Ama ayi nde pangma ti Rimam ri.
normalised_text: ama rimam ri baa, ambyi ti munnkyi riben a pu funn atso uwog kinjo, ti riben a nae ise. ama ayi nde pangma ti rimam ri.

name: Kutep
text: Rimam kunn riben ti nae ise ne baa, Akaen ise. Ambyi yi ti pu funn atso uwog kinjo ama awu kunn yi baa, Uyinn. Ama Rimam sae baa, ayi na nyang.
normalised_text: rimam kunn riben ti nae ise ne baa, akaen ise. ambyi yi ti pu funn atso uwog kinjo ama awu kunn yi baa, uyinn. ama rimam sae baa, ayi na nyang.

name: Kutep
text: Tiri Rimam ri baa, Afub ti irum ā tsoye. Ituku ti ku waen awaen, ti itso-yi meme, ā tsoye. Ama ayi nde pangma ti Rimam ri.
normalised_text: tiri rimam ri baa, afub ti irum a tsoye. ituku ti ku waen awaen, ti itsoyi meme, a tsoye. ama ayi nde pangma ti rimam ri.

name: Kutep
text: Ama irum ti ituku ti itsotso ti ku waen awaen tsoye meme. Ama Rimam sae baa, ayi na nyang.
normalised_text: ama irum ti ituku ti itsotso ti ku waen awaen tsoye meme. ama rimam sae baa, ayi na nyang.

name: Kutep
text: Ama usir sa te, ucwe sa famsi, uwae usir ti ita.
normalised_text: ama usir sa te, ucwe sa famsi, uwae usir ti ita.

name: Kutep
text: Ayi ā tsen apupwen, ti uwog ā paenine riben ike. Ama ayi nde pangma ti Rimam ri.
normalised_text: ayi a tsen apupwen, ti uwog a paenine riben ike. ama ayi nde pangma ti rimam ri.

name: Kutep
text: Rimam mam iken ifaen tiyang tiyang. Awu ti ko siskeb ā tsi usirtaen, awu ti ko sisi ama ā tsi utitang. Awu mam aswer fa ti atang meme.
normalised_text: rimam mam iken ifaen tiyang tiyang. awu ti ko siskeb a tsi usirtaen, awu ti ko sisi ama a tsi utitang. awu mam aswer fa ti atang meme.

name: Kutep
text: Rimam pu yi baefa apwa apupwen ti ititsen-yi ā nda riben ike saen paenine.
normalised_text: rimam pu yi baefa apwa apupwen ti ititsenyi a nda riben ike saen paenine.

name: Kutep
text: Ayi u ta risu usirtaen ti utitang, ti ayi ā kata kufarang ti kufub. Ama Rimam nung baa, ayi na nyang.
normalised_text: ayi u ta risu usirtaen ti utitang, ti ayi a kata kufarang ti kufub. ama rimam nung baa, ayi na nyang.

name: Kutep
text: Ama usir sa te, ucwe sa famsi, uwae usir ti inje.
normalised_text: ama usir sa te, ucwe sa famsi, uwae usir ti inje.

name: Kutep
text: Ama Rimam ri baa, Iken ti ku nyang unyang ti tsotso ā munnkyi uwae ambyi, inung ti tsotso ā pinn apupwen ko aka uwae utense.
normalised_text: ama rimam ri baa, iken ti ku nyang unyang ti tsotso a munnkyi uwae ambyi, inung ti tsotso a pinn apupwen ko aka uwae utense.

name: Kutep
text: Ama usir sa te, ucwe sa famsi, uwae usir ti itsong.
normalised_text: ama usir sa te, ucwe sa famsi, uwae usir ti itsong.

name: Kutep
text: Rimam mam ibye kutur ti itsotso ti asinn ti itsotso, fa ti iken ti ku kú riben txi txi txi. Ama Rimam sae baa, ayi na nyang.
normalised_text: rimam mam ibye kutur ti itsotso ti asinn ti itsotso, fa ti iken ti ku ku riben txi txi txi. ama rimam sae baa, ayi na nyang.

name: Kutep
text: Ama, Rimam kyae unde rukwer ijwe-wu. Awu kyae unde pangma ti awu Rimam si. Awu kyae ba, urom ti unda.
normalised_text: ama, rimam kyae unde rukwer ijwewu. awu kyae unde pangma ti awu rimam si. awu kyae ba, urom ti unda.

name: Kutep
text: Rimam sae meme iken ti awu kyae baa, ayi na nyang timambe. Ama usir sa te, ucwe sa fam si, uwae usir ti itsongnjo.

name: Kyode
text: Serubabelɛ mɔ-bi ne n gyɛ Abiwudi, Abiwudi mɔ-bi ne n gyɛ Eliyakim. Eliyakim mɔ-bi ne n gyɛ Asoro.
normalised_text: serubabele mobi ne n je abiwudi, abiwudi mobi ne n je eliyakim. eliyakim mobi ne n je asoro.

name: Kyode
text: Asoro mɔ-bi ne n gyɛ Sadokɛ. Sadokɛ mɔ-bi ne n gyɛ Akim, Akim mɔ-bi ne n gyɛ Eliwudi.
normalised_text: asoro mobi ne n je sadoke. sadoke mobi ne n je akim, akim mobi ne n je eliwudi.

name: Kyode
text: Eliwudi mɔ-bi ne n gyɛ Eliyeesa, Eliyeesa mɔ-bi ne n gyɛ Matan. Matan mɔ-bi ne n gyɛ Gyeekɔpo.
normalised_text: eliwudi mobi ne n je eliyeesa, eliyeesa mobi ne n je matan. matan mobi ne n je jeekopo.

name: Kyode
text: Ɔnyen ne ɔ laa korogɛ, ne fo laa yela mɔ-ginyen yɛɛ Yesu, i kya nyiile yɛɛ ɔ laa mɔlɛgɛ mɔ-adɛ lii mɔmɔ-ilaa nyɛnyɛn giwɔra dɔ.
normalised_text: onyen ne o laa koroge, ne fo laa yela moginyen yee yesu, i cha nyiile yee o laa molege moade lii momoilaa nyenyen giwora do.

name: Kyode
text: Ɔbono ɔ mɛŋ nyi ɔnyen mɔ laa da ɔtɔ de ɔꞌ korogɛ gɛbii nyensɛɛ, ne mɛ laa terɛ gɛmɔ yɛɛ Imanuɛlɛ.
normalised_text: obono o meng nyi onyen mo laa da oto de o koroge gebii nyensee, ne me laa tere gemo yee imanuele.

name: Kyode
text: Gyosɛfo gi kyingi mɔ, o kyule ilaa ibono Wurubuaarɛ dɔ ɔsɔɔ mɔ gi tɔgɛ mɔ mɔ, ne o kyu Mariya dena.
normalised_text: josefo gi chingi mo, o chule ilaa ibono wurubuaare do osoo mo gi toge mo mo, ne o chu mariya dena.

name: Kyode
text: Mɔ‑rɛ mɔ berɛ, mɛ mɛŋ dɛ ginyen de gikyii kaaborɛ ɔ korogɛ gɛbii mɔ. Ne Gyosɛfo gi yela mɔ-ginyen yɛɛ Yesu.
normalised_text: more mo bere, me meng de ginyen de gichii kaabore o koroge gebii mo. ne josefo gi yela moginyen yee yesu.

name: Kyode
text: Wura Hɛrodɛ gi nu ilaa ibono so mɛ naa mɔ, i kyogedɛ mɔ-gisen dɔ. Gɛnen kee ne i kyogedɛ Gyɛrusalem awura mɔ pɛwu asen dɔ ne.
normalised_text: wura herode gi nu ilaa ibono so me naa mo, i chogede mogisen do. genen kee ne i chogede jerusalem awura mo pewu asen do ne.

name: Kyode
text: Hɛrodɛ adɛ mɔ mɛ tɔgɛ mɔ gɛnen mɔ, ɔ terɛ asafo mɔ lii nkan, ne ɔ taasɛ ɔmɔ de ɔꞌ bii aberɛ abono mɛ wu gigyɛkpebi mɔ gi lii mɔ.
normalised_text: herode ade mo me toge mo genen mo, o tere asafo mo lii nkan, ne o taase omo de o bii abere abono me wu gijekpebi mo gi lii mo.

name: Kyode
text: Mɛ wu gigyɛkpebi mɔ gi yelɛ gɛnen mɔ, i wɔra ɔmɔ ɔkon gikyɔ kyɔde.
normalised_text: me wu gijekpebi mo gi yele genen mo, i wora omo okon gicho chode.

name: Kyode
text: Imɔ idɛ gɛmara mɔ, Wurubuaarɛ gi ka sa asafo mɔ oderi dɔ yɛɛ mɛŋꞌ baa kii naa de Hɛrodɛ asɛ. Imɔso mɛ kyu de ɔkpa banban ɔko kpe gɛwi.
normalised_text: imo ide gemara mo, wurubuaare gi ka sa asafo mo oderi do yee meng baa kii naa de herode ase. imoso me chu de okpa banban oko kpe gewi.

name: Kyode
text: Imɔso Gyosɛfo gi koso ne o puru gɛbii mɔ gɛmɔ‑rɛ gɛmɔ-nyi gɛnyɛ gɛbono selɛ kpe Igyipiti.
normalised_text: imoso josefo gi koso ne o puru gebii mo gemore gemonyi genye gebono sele kpe ijipiti.

name: Kyode
text: Wura Hɛrodɛ lɛwu gɛmara mɔ, Wurubuaarɛ dɔ ɔsɔɔ ɔko gi baa lɛɛ mɔ-nyoro nyiile Gyosɛfo oderi dɔ Igyipiti.
normalised_text: wura herode lewu gemara mo, wurubuaare do osoo oko gi baa lee monyoro nyiile josefo oderi do ijipiti.

name: Kyode
text: Ne ɔ tɔgɛ mɔ yɛɛ, Koso, puru gɛbii mɔ gɛmɔ‑rɛ gɛmɔ-nyi de foꞌ kii kpe Isirale gɛsinkpan so. Abono nkana mɛ kya laarɛ gɛbii mɔ-imɔɔten mɔ mɛ wuꞌ.
normalised_text: ne o toge mo yee, koso, puru gebii mo gemore gemonyi de fo kii kpe isirale gesinkpan so. abono nkana me cha laare gebii moimooten mo me wu.

name: Kyode
text: Gɛnen so Gyosɛfo gi koso puru gɛbii mɔ gɛmɔ‑rɛ gɛmɔ-nyi kii kpe Isirale gɛsinkpan so.
normalised_text: genen so josefo gi koso puru gebii mo gemore gemonyi kii kpe isirale gesinkpan so.

name: Kyode
text: Gɛnen owi ɔbono mɔ, Gyɔn ɔbono ɔ baa gyere asa Wurubuaarɛ sagyere mɔ gi kpe ɔ tɛ Gyudiya gipen dɔ ɔ kya tɔgɛ ɔ sa abono mɛ kya kpe mɔ asɛ mɔ yɛɛ.
normalised_text: genen owi obono mo, jon obono o baa jere asa wurubuaare sajere mo gi kpe o te judiya gipen do o cha toge o sa abono me cha kpe mo ase mo yee.

name: Kyode
text: Fɛꞌ nu fɛye-nyoro gɛsɛ de fɛꞌ kyɛɛgɛ lii ilaa nyɛnyɛn giwɔra dɔ. Idɛ kon ne Wurubuaarɛ laa yɛgɛ mɔ-gɛwuragyi dɔ akyenabi aꞌ ba asa dɔ.
normalised_text: fe nu feyenyoro gese de fe cheege lii ilaa nyenyen giwora do. ide kon ne wurubuaare laa yege mogewuraji do achenabi a ba asa do.

name: Kyode
text: Gyɔn gɛgbɛ suusɛ mɔ, mɛ kyu daa gɛkpatitii ifuu kyu luo gɛmɔ, ne o kyu gɛbuɛ ɔwolɛ wɔra liide. Mɔ-ilaa gyisɛ ne n gyɛ nkpenfuree nko oyuduu de ŋmasan.
normalised_text: jon gegbe suuse mo, me chu daa gekpatitii ifuu chu luo gemo, ne o chu gebue owole wora liide. moilaa jise ne n je nkpenfuree nko oyuduu de ngmasan.

name: Kyode
text: Mɛ kya kpaa lɛɛ ilaa nyɛnyɛn ibonoana mɛ wɔra mɔ tɔgɛ, ne ɔ kya gyere ɔmɔ Wurubuaarɛ sagyere Gyɔɔdan ɔbon dɔ.
normalised_text: me cha kpaa lee ilaa nyenyen ibonoana me wora mo toge, ne o cha jere omo wurubuaare sajere joodan obon do.

name: Kyode
text: Fɛꞌ wɔra ilaa wɔrasɛ ibono i laa lɛɛ nyiile yɛɛ fɛ nu fɛye-nyoro gɛsɛ gɛsintin mɔ daa.
normalised_text: fe wora ilaa worase ibono i laa lee nyiile yee fe nu feyenyoro gese gesintin mo daa.

name: Laka (Chad)
text: Maketourou gel ka dooudjé lo Jésus Christ, ngon lo David, ngon lo Abraham.
normalised_text: maketuru gel ka douje lo jesus christ, ngon lo david, ngon lo abraham.

name: Laka (Chad)
text: Mbede gəl kuji Jeju Kirisi , ngon ka Dabidi, ngon ka Abəraham .
normalised_text: mbede gel kuji jeju kirisi, ngon ka dabidi, ngon ka aberaham.

name: Laka (Chad)
text: Abraham to bò Isaac, Isaac to bò Jacob, Jacob to bò Juda ke ngaköèdjé.
normalised_text: abraham to bo isaac, isaac to bo jacob, jacob to bo juda ke ngakoneje.

name: Laka (Chad)
text: Abəraham uji Ijagə; Ijagə uji Jakobo; Jakobo uji Juda je gə ngan ko̰-ɛje;.
normalised_text: aberaham uji ijage; ijage uji jakobo; jakobo uji juda je ge ngan koeje;.

name: Laka (Chad)
text: Juda ta jene gə ri-a na Tamar uji ne Peret je gə Jera; Peret uji Ɛsərom; Ɛsərom uji Aram;.
normalised_text: juda ta jene ge ria na tamar uji ne peret je ge jera; peret uji eserom; eserom uji aram;.

name: Laka (Chad)
text: Juda to bò Pharès ke Zara ke Thamar oudjoudè sa. Pharès to bò Esrom, Esrom to bò Aram.
normalised_text: juda to bo phares ke zara ke thamar ujude sa. phares to bo esrom, esrom to bo aram.

name: Laka (Chad)
text: Aram to bò Aminadab, Aminadab to bò Naasson. Naasson to bò Salmon.
normalised_text: aram to bo aminadab, aminadab to bo naasson. naasson to bo salmon.

name: Laka (Chad)
text: Aram uji Aminadabə; Aminadabə uji Naso̰; Naso̰ uji Saləmo;.
normalised_text: aram uji aminadabe; aminadabe uji naso; naso uji salemo;.

name: Laka (Chad)
text: Salmon to bò Boaz ke Rahab oudjè sa. Boaz to bò Obed ke Ruth oudjè sa. Obed to bò Isaï.
normalised_text: salmon to bo boaz ke rahab uje sa. boaz to bo obed ke ruth uje sa. obed to bo isain.

name: Laka (Chad)
text: Saləmo ta Rahabə uji ne Booj; Booj ta Rudu uji ne Obɛd; Obɛd uji Jese;.
normalised_text: salemo ta rahabe uji ne booj; booj ta rudu uji ne obed; obed uji jese;.

name: Laka (Chad)
text: Isaï to bò David, ke to mbaibé ndja. David to bò Salomon ke dènè lo Urie oudjè sa.
normalised_text: isain to bo david, ke to mbaibe nja. david to bo salomon ke dene lo urie uje sa.

name: Laka (Chad)
text: Jese uji Dabidi. Mbay Dabidi ta jene lə Uri uji ne Salomo.
normalised_text: jese uji dabidi. mbay dabidi ta jene le uri uji ne salomo.

name: Laka (Chad)
text: Salomo uji Roboham; Roboham uji Abiya; Abiya uji Asa;.
normalised_text: salomo uji roboham; roboham uji abiya; abiya uji asa;.

name: Laka (Chad)
text: Salomon to bò Roboam, Roboam to bò Abia, Abia to bò Asa.
normalised_text: salomon to bo roboam, roboam to bo abia, abia to bo asa.

name: Laka (Chad)
text: Asa to bò Josaphat, Josaphat to bò Joram, Joram to bò Ozias.
normalised_text: asa to bo josaphat, josaphat to bo joram, joram to bo ozias.

name: Laka (Chad)
text: Asa uji Jojapa; Jojapa uji Yoram; Yoram uji Ojiyas;.
normalised_text: asa uji jojapa; jojapa uji yoram; yoram uji ojiyas;.

name: Laka (Chad)
text: Ojiyas uji Yotam; Yotam uji Ahas; Ahas uji Ejekiyas;.
normalised_text: ojiyas uji yotam; yotam uji ahas; ahas uji ejekiyas;.

name: Laka (Chad)
text: Ozias to bò Joatham, Joatham to bò Achaz, Achaz to bò Ézéchias.
normalised_text: ozias to bo joatham, joatham to bo achaz, achaz to bo ezechias.

name: Laka (Chad)
text: Ejekiyas uji Manase; Manase uji Amo; Amo uji Jojiyas;.
normalised_text: ejekiyas uji manase; manase uji amo; amo uji jojiyas;.

name: Laka (Chad)
text: Ézéchias to bò Manassé, Manassé to bò Amon, Amon to bò Josias.
normalised_text: ezechias to bo manasse, manasse to bo amon, amon to bo josias.

name: Laka (Chad)
text: Jojiyas uji Yekoniyas je gə ngan ko̰-ɛje. Dɔ ɓal gə d-uwa ne ngan Ijirayɛlje gə ɓərə d-aw gə je mə ɓe gə Babilon.
normalised_text: jojiyas uji yekoniyas je ge ngan koeje. do bal ge duwa ne ngan ijirayelje ge bere daw ge je me be ge babilon.

name: Laka (Chad)
text: Josias to bò Jéchonias ke ngaköèdjé, ndò té ke dèdè dwaadè dao kedè Babylone té.
normalised_text: josias to bo jechonias ke ngakoneje, ndo te ke dede dwaade dao kede babylone te.

name: Laka (Chad)
text: Go ɓərə gə d-uwa-je kəne mə ɓe gə Babilon le, Yekoniyas uji Səyalətiyɛl, Səyalətiyɛl uji Jorobabɛl;.
normalised_text: go bere ge duwaje kene me be ge babilon le, yekoniyas uji seyaletiyel, seyaletiyel uji jorobabel;.

name: Laka (Chad)
text: Goukoudang dao kedè Babylone té, Jéchonias to bò Salathiel, Salathiel to bò Zorobabel.
normalised_text: gukudang dao kede babylone te, jechonias to bo salathiel, salathiel to bo zorobabel.

name: Laka (Chad)
text: Jorobabɛl uji Abihud; Abihud uji Eliyakim; Eliyakim uji Ajɔr;.
normalised_text: jorobabel uji abihud; abihud uji eliyakim; eliyakim uji ajor;.

name: Laka (Chad)
text: Zorobabel to bò Abiud, Abiud to bò Éliakim, Éliakim to bò Azor.
normalised_text: zorobabel to bo abiud, abiud to bo eliakim, eliakim to bo azor.

name: Laka (Chad)
text: Ajɔr uji Sadɔk; Sadɔk uji Ahim; Ahim uji Eliyud;.
normalised_text: ajor uji sadok; sadok uji ahim; ahim uji eliyud;.

name: Laka (Chad)
text: Azor to bò Sadok, Sadok to bò Achim, Achim to bò Éliud.
normalised_text: azor to bo sadok, sadok to bo achim, achim to bo eliud.

name: Laka (Chad)
text: Eliyud uji Eleyajar; Eleyajar uji Mata̰; Mata̰ uji Jakobo;.
normalised_text: eliyud uji eleyajar; eleyajar uji mata; mata uji jakobo;.

name: Laka (Chad)
text: Éliud to bò Éléazar, Éléazar to bò Matthan, Matthan to bò Jacob.
normalised_text: eliud to bo eleazar, eleazar to bo matthan, matthan to bo jacob.

name: Lala-Roba
text: U nwa likarkar tuwa Yeso Almaseho au Dauda ya, au Ibrahim ya.
normalised_text: u nwa likarkar tuwa yeso almaseho au dauda ya, au ibrahim ya.

name: Lala-Roba
text: Ibrahim yǝ haa Ishaku, Ishaku yǝ haa Yakubu, Yakubu yǝ haa Yahuda ma koɓɓisa.
normalised_text: ibrahim ye haa ishaku, ishaku ye haa yakubu, yakubu ye haa yahuda ma kobbisa.

name: Lala-Roba
text: Yahuda yǝ haa Feresa ma Zera. Maa ɓose ndǝ Tamar, Feresa yǝ haa Hesruna, Hesruna yǝ haa Aram.
normalised_text: yahuda ye haa feresa ma zera. maa bose nde tamar, feresa ye haa hesruna, hesruna ye haa aram.

name: Lala-Roba
text: Aram yǝ haa Amminadab, Amminadab yǝ haa Nashon, Nashon yǝ haa Salmon.
normalised_text: aram ye haa amminadab, amminadab ye haa nashon, nashon ye haa salmon.

name: Lala-Roba
text: Salmon yǝ haa Boaza. Maasi ndǝ Rahab. Boaza yǝ haa Obida, Maasi ndǝ Rut, Obida yǝ haa Yesse.
normalised_text: salmon ye haa boaza. maasi nde rahab. boaza ye haa obida, maasi nde rut, obida ye haa yesse.

name: Lala-Roba
text: Yesse yǝ haa kuɓu Dauda. Dauda yǝ haa Sulemanu. Maasi ɗǝm ka ǝn toone Uriya ya.
normalised_text: yesse ye haa kubu dauda. dauda ye haa sulemanu. maasi dem ka en toone uriya ya.

name: Lala-Roba
text: Sulemanu yǝ haa Rehobowam, Rehobowam yǝ haa Abiya, Abiya yǝ haa Asa.
normalised_text: sulemanu ye haa rehobowam, rehobowam ye haa abiya, abiya ye haa asa.

name: Lala-Roba
text: Asa yǝ haa Yehoshafat, Yehoshafat yǝ haa Yoram, Yoram yǝ haa Azariya.
normalised_text: asa ye haa yehoshafat, yehoshafat ye haa yoram, yoram ye haa azariya.

name: Lala-Roba
text: Azariya yǝ haa Yotam, Yotam yǝ haa Ahaz, Ahaz yǝ haa Hezekiya.
normalised_text: azariya ye haa yotam, yotam ye haa ahaz, ahaz ye haa hezekiya.

name: Lala-Roba
text: Hezekiya yǝ haa Manassa, Manassa yǝ haa Amon, Amon yǝ haa Yosiya.
normalised_text: hezekiya ye haa manassa, manassa ye haa amon, amon ye haa yosiya.

name: Lala-Roba
text: Yosiya yǝ haa Yekoniya ma ɓaata ɓisa, a fer ɓaa haa ɓǝsǝ a ko a hooto Babila wa.
normalised_text: yosiya ye haa yekoniya ma baata bisa, a fer baa haa bese a ko a hooto babila wa.

name: Lala-Roba
text: Ndiira ɓaa ko ɓǝsǝ a hooto Babila wa, Yekoniya yǝ haa Sheyaltiyel, Sheyaltiyel yǝ haa Zarubabel.
normalised_text: ndiira baa ko bese a hooto babila wa, yekoniya ye haa sheyaltiyel, sheyaltiyel ye haa zarubabel.

name: Lala-Roba
text: Zarubabel yǝ haa Abihudu, Abihudu yǝ haa Eliyakim, Eliyakim yǝ haa Azuro.
normalised_text: zarubabel ye haa abihudu, abihudu ye haa eliyakim, eliyakim ye haa azuro.

name: Lala-Roba
text: Azuro yǝ haa Zadok, Zadok yǝ haa Akimu, Akimu yǝ haa Aliyuda.
normalised_text: azuro ye haa zadok, zadok ye haa akimu, akimu ye haa aliyuda.

name: Lala-Roba
text: Aliyuda yǝ haa Eleyazara, Eleyazara yǝ haa Matana, Matana yǝ haa Yakubu.
normalised_text: aliyuda ye haa eleyazara, eleyazara ye haa matana, matana ye haa yakubu.

name: Lala-Roba
text: Yakubu yǝ haa Yusufu ker Maryamu ya, yaa yǝ haasǝ Yeso ya, yaa ɓan yarsǝsǝ me Almaseho ya.
normalised_text: yakubu ye haa yusufu ker maryamu ya, yaa ye haase yeso ya, yaa ban yarsese me almaseho ya.

name: Lala-Roba
text: Si Yusufu kerisi ǝn yaa ɓongtǝra ya, ɗǝm yǝ yau me yaa na ɗuura nwaara a ɓeta ra, pa yǝ sen me kiyaa lee a nhuukǝra.
normalised_text: si yusufu kerisi en yaa bongtera ya, dem ye yau me yaa na duura nwaara a beta ra, pa ye sen me kiyaa lee a nhuukera.

name: Lala-Roba
text: Kiyǝ haa auwe parara, kǝnga ti ɗǝnda me Yeso me kiya kon nkweera ɓet ɓisa a tentenato ɓoso.
normalised_text: kiye haa auwe parara, kenga ti denda me yeso me kiya kon nkweera bet bisa a tentenato boso.

name: Lala-Roba
text: Mbu sǝsa nsaad tom me a kung mbu Ankundi nkeesǝ ma lau an nawanto ya me.
normalised_text: mbu sesa nsaad tom me a kung mbu ankundi nkeese ma lau an nawanto ya me.

name: Lala-Roba
text: Autoone kiya too kuɗa yǝ haa auwe parara, ɓaa ka ti ɗǝnda me Immanuwel Ən senme, Kaa yǝ ke ma ndase.
normalised_text: autoone kiya too kuda ye haa auwe parara, baa ka ti denda me immanuwel en senme, kaa ye ke ma ndase.

name: Lala-Roba
text: Pa Yusufu nisǝ a munda wa yǝ bǝɗ mbu antimira Ankundi ya nkeesǝsǝ ɓa, yǝ too Maryamu meen toonesi ɓǝ ko ɗuuru.
normalised_text: pa yusufu nise a munda wa ye bed mbu antimira ankundi ya nkeesese ba, ye too maryamu meen toonesi be ko duuru.

name: Lala-Roba
text: Pa yǝ maasǝ me yǝ toone ra, ndub ndiira fer yǝ haasǝ auwe parara wa, pa yaa ti ɗǝnda me Yeso.
normalised_text: pa ye maase me ye toone ra, ndub ndiira fer ye haase auwe parara wa, pa yaa ti denda me yeso.

name: Lala-Roba
text: ɓǝn nkee me, Yaa ɓaa haasǝsǝ meen kuɓ ɓaa Yahudawa ɓa wa ya, yǝ nau? Tǝ wǝr seklǝmera ira ma ɓoti ra, tǝ wo me taa nyoo.
normalised_text: ben nkee me, yaa baa haasese meen kub baa yahudawa ba wa ya, ye nau? te wer seklemera ira ma boti ra, te wo me taa nyoo.

name: Lala-Roba
text: Pa kuɓu Hiridus yǝ kurasǝ mbusa maaso wa, senta ita a nii ma ɓaa Urshalima nsaad.
normalised_text: pa kubu hiridus ye kurase mbusa maaso wa, senta ita a nii ma baa urshalima nsaad.

name: Lala-Roba
text: Pa yǝ kwau kuɓsa nek mbusa sa ma malǝmaa Masaka Musa sa, yǝ ɓǝ taa ham ɓaa ka haa Almaseho ɓa.
normalised_text: pa ye kwau kubsa nek mbusa sa ma malemaa masaka musa sa, ye be taa ham baa ka haa almaseho ba.

name: Lala-Roba
text: Ɓaa nkee me, A ur Baitalami a Yahudiya wa, me an nawanto kaya yǝ nyor maaso me.
normalised_text: baa nkee me, a ur baitalami a yahudiya wa, me an nawanto kaya ye nyor maaso me.

name: Lala-Roba
text: Pa Hiridus yǝ yar ɓan maa mbuka a seklǝmeta ɓa a nhuukǝra me yǝ maa a ɓoni fer ɓǝ wǝrsǝ seklǝmera kara wa.
normalised_text: pa hiridus ye yar ban maa mbuka a seklemeta ba a nhuukera me ye maa a boni fer be werse seklemera kara wa.

name: Lala-Roba
text: Pa yǝ ɓǝ tung Baitalami yǝ nkee me, Soo kosǝ kǝr ɓong ham au kaya yǝsǝ ɓa, me sǝ wǝrsǝn wosǝ nǝ nkee, me niina kǝn konaa nyoo.
normalised_text: pa ye be tung baitalami ye nkee me, soo kose ker bong ham au kaya yese ba, me se wersen wose ne nkee, me niina ken konaa nyoo.

text: A knti gbete shɔ see shɔ Israila yɛnɛ tipi Babilaː Jakoniya yee Shalitiyel kɛkn, a Shalitiyel yee sɔ̃njo Zerubabe.
normalised_text: a knti gbete sho see sho israila yene tipi babila jakoniya yee shalitiyel kekn, a shalitiyel yee sonnjo zerubabe.

name: Lame

name: Lame

name: Lame
text: Yakubu ukɔ yee Yusufu sɔ̃njo, Mariyamu ɓɛvɔ, ukɔ yee Yesɔ shɔ gbete shɔ ɓaunɛ kirisi rɛ.

name: Lame
text: Shompɛ nɔgbete shɔ yee Yesɔ kirisi yɛ, Aɗagbete Yusufu nta Mariyamu nya nɛn tɛutɔ, si jo tɛu pɛ̃niɓa, Mariyamu zɛrɛ yɛ kpaa jaatɔ a Ɗa suru.

name: Lame
text: Yusufu Mariyamu ɓɛvɔ usi shɔ tɔ̃vɨn ji kasiɓa nɛn ãu yusẽ ɓa. Aru nankɔ au sisɨn nɛn yau naa kaali aru shɔ yɛ ntarɛ.
normalised_text: yusufu mariyamu bevo usi sho tonvyn ji kasiba nen anu yusen ba. aru nanko au sisyn nen yau naa kaali aru sho ye ntare.

name: Lame
text: Vim piti kpai ɔ̃ nankɔ aru u yisinya vigbete Uɓeyelapa shayɛ au janyagadi nya nɛː.

name: Lame
text: <<Nyarã yɛ tuu yɛti a yee jaavɔshɔ, shɔ yɛ ɓau nii nɛ Imanuwe. >>Ukɔ ɔ̃rɛ, <<Ɗalapa a ukɔni.>>.

name: Lame

name: Lame

name: Lame
text: A knti gbete shɔ yee Yesɔ a Baitalami a tipi Yahudiya, a ɗagbete Hiridu roo kpati yɛ, shɔ sẽrẽ i a aka gɨnri yɛnɛ Urushalima.

name: Lame
text: i hɨn nɛ,<< Jaa gbete shɔ yeeyɛ neyɛ ɔ̃ kpati Yahudawa u piya? U zɛu sɛ a gɨnri u arɛ u basiu pɛ.>>.
normalised_text: i hyn ne, jaa gbete sho yeeye neye on kpati yahudawa u piya? u zeu se a gynri u are u basiu pe..

name: Lame
text: Hiridu toli shɔ nya piti a yupɛ̃ni shɔlansi wɛrɛ Ɗani, a shɔgbeteyi mati shɔ laabeene nya ãsine Musa, a hɨrɛ nɛ shɔ yɛ yee Shɔshɔraanɛ piɗɔpiya?.

name: Lame
text: I kasinyanɛ,<<Ɔ shɔ Baitalami a tipi Yahudiya, shompɛ vigbete janyagadi bee a ɗekɨn tɛ̃ɛ̃tɛ̃ɛ̃ː.
normalised_text: i kasinyane,o sho baitalami a tipi yahudiya, shompe vigbete janyagadi bee a dekyn tenentenen.

name: Lame

name: Lame

normalised_text: kedon hiridu shoyi ke baitalami ne, o yene o kana do jaau tonvyn, oke kpaune, n kasi n ntaato, n koma n yeu doo bassine pejo..

name: Langi
text: Ɨhɨ noo nkʉmbʉkɨra ya marina ya lʉkolo lwa Yéesu Kirisitʉ , mwaana wa Daúdi , mwaana wa Aburaháamu .

name: Langi

name: Langi

name: Langi
text: Yaakúupu akamʉvyaala Yooséefu, mʉlʉme wa Maríia. Maríia akamʉvyaala Yéesu ˆaánɨrɨrwaa Masía .

name: Langi
text: Kiichʉngʉla arɨ mwaana mʉlʉme, na mʉkemera ʉrɨ irina raachwe Yéesu, sa yeeye noo ˆarɨ valamurirya vaantʉ vaachwe fuma uvii waavo.
normalised_text: kiichungula ari mwaana mulume, na mukemera uri irina raachwe yiesu, sa yeeye noo ari valamurirya vaantu vaachwe fuma uvii waavo.

name: Langi
text: Aya yoosi yafʉ́mɨɨre, sa masáare Ijʉva ˆalʉʉsa kwa njɨra ya mʉláali na mʉtwe waachwe yakiimane.
normalised_text: aya yoosi yafumiire, sa maseare ijuva aluusa kwa njira ya muleali na mutwe waachwe yakiimane.

name: Langi
text: Laanga, mʉnjalʉ sʉmʉla arɨ ɨnda, yeeye vyaala arɨ mwaana mʉlʉme, novo mwaanɨrɨra varɨ irina raachwe Emanʉéeli, noo kʉsea, Mʉlʉʉngʉ nɨ na suusu arɨ.
normalised_text: laanga, munjalu sumula ari inda, yeeye vyaala ari mwaana mulume, novo mwaanirira vari irina raachwe emanuieli, noo kusea, muluungu ni na suusu ari.

name: Langi
text: Yooséefu ˆakiinʉke fuma tulwii, akabweeyya ja viintʉ murimʉ mʉʉja wa Ijʉva ˆʉjáa ʉmʉwyɨ́ɨrɨɨre. Aho, akamʉsʉmʉla Maríia akava muki waachwe.

name: Langi
text: Maa kaa, Yooséefu sɨ amʉseeserera Maríia tʉkʉ, fʉʉrʉ akiichʉngʉla mwaana wa kɨɨntʉ kɨlʉme. Yooséefu akamʉkemera irina raachwe Yéesu.

name: Langi
text: Mʉtemi Heróode ˆakateere ayo masáare, yakaanda muturikirya, hamwɨ na vaantʉ voosi va Yerusaléemu.

name: Langi
text: Akavaanɨrɨra vakʉ́ʉ́lʉ va veeneɨsɨ va Ijʉva na vakiindya va Miiro , maa akavuurya, Masía nɨ hai ˆarɨ vyaarɨrwa.
normalised_text: akavaanirira vakuulu va veeneisi va ijuva na vakiindya va miiro, maa akavuurya, masia ni hai ari vyaarirwa.

name: Langi
text: Voovo vakamʉsea, Vyaarɨrwa arɨ múujii wa Betelehéemu ˆʉrɨ ɨsɨ ya Yudéea. Jeyyo noo ˆvyeene mʉláali na mʉtwe wa Ijʉva aandɨka.
normalised_text: voovo vakamusea, vyaarirwa ari moujii wa betelehiemu uri isi ya yudiea. jeyyo noo vyeene muleali na mutwe wa ijuva aandika.

name: Langi
text: Aho, Heróode akavaanɨrɨra vara vamanyi va nyényeeri na kijiraawii, ʉko akavuurya mpɨɨndɨ mpɨɨndɨ ˆvɨɨyona ɨra nyényeeri.
normalised_text: aho, heruode akavaanirira vara vamanyi va nyenyeeri na kijiraawii, uko akavuurya mpiindi mpiindi viiyona ira nyenyeeri.

name: Langi
text: ˆVakɨɨyone ɨra nyényeeri, vakavyeenda maatʉkʉ vii.

name: Langi
text: Mʉlʉʉngʉ akavakaanʼya tulwii, karɨ vahɨndʉke na kwa Heróode tʉkʉ. Jeyyo, vakahɨndʉka na meevo, na vajáa vatweera na njɨra yɨɨngɨ.

text: Jeyyo, isáare ˆralʉʉswa nɨ Yeremía mʉláali na mʉtwe rɨkakiimana.

name: Lango
text: Baa ꞌthianaatta, baa ẽhẽnyta Nyekuci hẽẽtkujjieen hĩ looc.

name: Lango
text: Ma ho, õthõõth Nyekuci ĩĩ, Aꞌnyĩĩk lanyit haara. Nĩngĩtĩ aaranĩ lanyit nĩĩcĩ noho.
normalised_text: ma ho, othooth nyekuchi ii, anyiik lanyit haara. ningiti aarani lanyit niichi noho.

name: Lango
text: Ma baa adtuuha Nyekuci ngaatĩ abũnnayyĩ lanyit ko, ikia ẽꞌngẽr lanyit hĩ muguur haauto cũũmõ cũũmõ.
normalised_text: ma baa adtuuha nyekuchi ngaati abunnayyi lanyit ko, ikia enger lanyit hi muguur haauto chuumo chuumo.

name: Lango
text: nẽ akateek lanyit ꞌthaar ꞌcĩg kaĩ Waathĩn, nẽ akateek muguur ꞌthaar ꞌcĩg kaĩ, Baalin. Nĩngĩtĩ aku aayyi ꞌjiaatĩnĩ hĩ loohoth kõr ꞌcĩ oou.
normalised_text: ne akateek lanyit thaar chig kai waathin, ne akateek muguur thaar chig kai, baalin. ningiti aku aayyi jiaatini hi loohoth kor chi oou.

name: Lango
text: Ma ho, õthõõth Nyekuci tarĩ ĩĩ, Aꞌnyĩĩk haau nĩngĩtĩ ẽꞌngẽr maam hĩĩtõ ꞌgoolliok ꞌramma, maam cĩg lokoru hĩ maam cĩg lootu.
normalised_text: ma ho, othooth nyekuchi tari ii, anyiik haau ningiti enger maam hiito goolliok ramma, maam chig lokoru hi maam chig lootu.

name: Lango
text: Nĩngĩtĩ aarĩkĩ Nyekuci nĩngĩtĩ ẽꞌngẽr maam cĩg lokoru hĩ cĩg lootu haauto cũũmõ cũũmõ. Nẽ baa ꞌthẽk aau noho dĩdĩ.
normalised_text: ningiti aariki nyekuchi ningiti enger maam chig lokoru hi chig lootu haauto chuumo chuumo. ne baa thek aau noho didi.

name: Lango
text: Nẽ tarĩ ikia õthõõth Nyekuci ĩĩ, Aꞌnyĩĩk maam ꞌcĩg aattĩg loota hollooddik ngaatĩ hõdẽẽthõng, hátĩ hẽdẽẽnyta ꞌthẽẽma. Nẽ baa ĩdĩmanĩ noho dĩdĩ.
normalised_text: ne tari ikia othooth nyekuchi ii, anyiik maam chig aattig loota hollooddik ngaati hodeethong, hati hedeenyta theema. ne baa idimani noho didi.

name: Lango
text: Nĩngĩtĩ akannẽẽkĩ Nyekuci ꞌthẽẽm annẽẽkĩ, Looc, nẽ akateek maam ĩĩnnĩk, Bũlũc. Nẽ baa udtuuha Nyekuci ngaatĩ abũnnayyĩ hẽlẽggĩ cieeg vẽlẽk.
normalised_text: ningiti akanneeki nyekuchi theem anneeki, looch, ne akateek maam iinnik, buluch. ne baa udtuuha nyekuchi ngaati abunnayyi heleggi chieeg velek.

name: Lango
text: Ma nĩngaata, õthõõth Nyekuci tarĩ ĩĩ, Aꞌnyĩĩk hẽẽn hĩ artĩ hĩ haal ꞌcĩg aattĩg cũũmõ cũũmõ hubuꞌthia. Nẽ baa ĩdĩmanĩ noho dĩdĩ.
normalised_text: ma ningaata, othooth nyekuchi tari ii, anyiik heen hi arti hi haal chig aattig chuumo chuumo hubuthia. ne baa idimani noho didi.

name: Lango
text: Nĩngĩtĩ abũthaanĩ hẽẽna, hẽẽn ꞌcĩg abbiiri ꞌcĩg aꞌnyak bura cũũmõ cũũmõ. Nẽ baa udtuuha Nyekuci ngaatĩ abũnnayyĩ hẽlẽggĩ cieeg vẽlẽk.
normalised_text: ningiti abuthaani heena, heen chig abbiiri chig anyak bura chuumo chuumo. ne baa udtuuha nyekuchi ngaati abunnayyi heleggi chieeg velek.

name: Lango
text: Ma nĩngaata, iita aauto ꞌjiaatĩnĩ hĩ loohoth kõr ꞌcĩ ĩĩn iyyio.

name: Lango
text: Nẽ aꞌnyĩĩk ĩhõõggõ hẽdẽẽnyta hẽẽtahujjieen, hátĩ hũttũhũlĩt looc. Nẽ baa ĩdĩmanĩ noho dĩdĩ.
normalised_text: ne anyiik ihooggo hedeenyta heetahujjieen, hati huttuhulit looch. ne baa idimani noho didi.

name: Lango
text: Nĩngĩtĩ ẽhẽnytaanĩ Nyekuci kõr haara waath nẽ ẽtẽhẽnya nyĩlõk haara baal. Baa nẽ ẽtẽhẽnya nẽẽ mũnyũny buúk.
normalised_text: ningiti ehenytaani nyekuchi kor haara waath ne etehenya nyilok haara baal. baa ne etehenya nee munyuny buuk.

name: Lango
text: Nĩngĩtĩ aarĩkĩ nẽẽ kõr hĩ nyĩlõk hẽẽtahujjieen hũttũhũlĩt looc.
