text: Ɓamba tonda na nkyisa waa wɛnɛ ɓɛ́ɛ nyasɛɛsi mɛ atɛmi.
normalised_text: bamba tonda na nkyisa waa wene bie nyaseesi me atemi.

name: Lobala
text: Sima Ŋwaphongo amba ya ɓawɔlɛ o ndɔtɔ oɓokye ɓɛ́ɛ sakula butwa yaaka Elode. Emba ɓamba ya butwa o mokyisi ŋwa ɓɛ́ɛ mi nzela esuu.
normalised_text: sima ngwapongo amba ya bawole o ndoto oboche bie sakula butwa yaaka elode. emba bamba ya butwa o mochisi ngwa bie mi nzela esuu.

name: Lobala
text: Nde na muna mokɔlɔ, Zozefu aesi ya tɛmɛ, akpe ŋwana na nyango, amba yakyɛ miɓomba o Ezipito.
normalised_text: nde na muna mokolo, zozefu aesi ya teme, akpe ngwana na nyango, amba yache mibomba o ezipito.

name: Lobala
text: Maphɔɔ masɔ mamana makyelama ɓo wawɔkɔ moimosi Yilimiya oɓokye:.
normalised_text: mapoo maso mamana machelama bo wawoko moimosi yilimiya oboche.

name: Lobala
text: «Ɓaokyi ilela siute o Lama, malelo na imiima sa ngɔngɔ. Eli Layele kalele ɓana ɓɛ, taazingye oɓokye ɓamoɓɔndɔ phɔ ɓana ɓɛ́ɛ ɓawe.».
normalised_text: "baochi ilela siute o lama, malelo na imiima sa ngongo. eli layele kalele bana be, taazingye oboche bamobondo po bana bie bawe.".

name: Lobala
text: O sima ya iwaa sa Elode, anzelu wa Nkolo amba yelela Zozefu o ndɔtɔ o Ezipito.
normalised_text: o sima ya iwaa sa elode, anzelu wa nkolo amba yelela zozefu o ndoto o ezipito.

name: Lobala
text: Amba ya wɔ nɛ yokye: «Tɛmɛ, kpa ŋwana na nyango, butwa o Isalayɛlɛ, phɔ ɓaalukaka iɓoma ŋwana ɓawe.».
normalised_text: amba ya wo ne yoche "teme, kpa ngwana na nyango, butwa o isalayele, po baalukaka iboma ngwana bawe.".

name: Lobala
text: Zozefu amba ya tɛmɛ, aesi ya kpa ŋwana na nyango, amba ya butwa o Isalayɛlɛ.
normalised_text: zozefu amba ya teme, aesi ya kpa ngwana na nyango, amba ya butwa o isalayele.

name: Lobala
text: Amba ya kyɛ zala o Nazalɛtɛ. Maphɔɔ mamana makyelama phɔ ya ikokya maphɔɔ maawɔkɔ ɓaimosi ɓa Ŋwaphongo oɓokye: «Ɓaamoɓanga moto wa Nazalɛtɛ.».
normalised_text: amba ya che zala o nazalete. mapoo mamana machelama po ya ikocha mapoo maawoko baimosi ba ngwapongo oboche "baamobanga moto wa nazalete.".

name: Lobala
text: Sima ya mambula, Yoane Moɓatise akyɛkyɛ o bokye pha Yuda, akyɛkyɛ miteya ɓoɓo:.
normalised_text: sima ya mambula, yoane mobatise acheche o boche pa yuda, acheche miteya bobo.

name: Lobala
text: «Ɓongola mandondo, phɔ ɓokonzi pha ikolo ɓokomi phɛnɛphɛ.».
normalised_text: "bongola mandondo, po bokonzi pa ikolo bokomi penepe.".

name: Lobala
text: Yoane aɓaka kalate etobu eya kyela ɓɛ́ɛ na nkungyɛ ya nyama na nkombo shamo, na nkamba ya lopho la nyama o mobimbi, aɓaka kaze nde ntɛtɛ na maɓoo.
normalised_text: yoane abaka kalate etobu eya chela bie na nkungye ya nyama na nkombo shamo, na nkamba ya lopo la nyama o mobimbi, abaka kaze nde ntete na maboo.

name: Lobala
text: Ɓato ɓa Yelusalɛmɛ na ɓato ɓasɔ ɓa Yuda na ɓaa mokyisi mooli phɛnɛphɛ na ebale ya Yaladɛnɛ, ɓaɓaka ɓakyɛ oka yɛ.
normalised_text: bato ba yelusaleme na bato baso ba yuda na baa mochisi mooli penepe na ebale ya yaladene, babaka bache oka ye.

name: Lobala
text: Ɓaimolaka masumu ma ɓɛ́ɛ o ɓoo pha ɓato ɓasɔ, Yoane aɓaka kaɓaɓatisa o eɓale ya Yaladɛnɛ.
normalised_text: baimolaka masumu ma bie o boo pa bato baso, yoane abaka kababatisa o ebale ya yaladene.

name: Lobala
text: Ɓambo ɓɔngyɛ ikoko phɔ ya ikpɛtɛ nkanga ya nzete; ŋwete munsɔ mote moɓote mbuma ndaa, ɓaamokpɛtɛ, ɓamba movaka o nweya.
normalised_text: bambo bongye ikoko po ya ikpete nkanga ya nzete; ngwete munso mote mobote mbuma ndaa, baamokpete, bamba movaka o nweya.

name: Lobala
text: Aphisi enyɛngyɛlɛ o maɓɔkɔ phɔ ya ikaɓola mbuma na nkata. Amoɓomba mbuma o ɓompɛndɛ, kasi amotumba nkata o ŋwenya moote moozime.».
normalised_text: apisi enyengyele o maboko po ya ikabola mbuma na nkata. amobomba mbuma o bompende, kasi amotumba nkata o ngwenya moote moozime.".

name: Lobala
text: Mokɔlɔ mɔnɔmɔ Yesu autaka o Galileya aesi o Yaladɛnɛ, amba ya koma ooli Yoane phɔ aɓatisame.
normalised_text: mokolo monomo yesu autaka o galileya aesi o yaladene, amba ya koma ooli yoane po abatisame.

name: Lobi
text: Thɩ kɔ̃ ʋrɛraakɛ Jeju Kirisitiikɛ dɔnɩ Davɩdɩɩ bi məl, Abɩrahamɩ məl thenɩ.
normalised_text: ti kon ureraake jeju kirisitiike doni davidii bi mel, abirahami mel teni.

name: Lobi
text: Abɩraham kɔɔ kɔna Ɩjakɩ, dɩ Ɩjakɩ kɔ̃ Jakɔbɩ, dɩ Jakɔbɩ gba kɔ̃ Juda na ɔɔ õkuunsɔ;.
normalised_text: abiraham koo kona ijaki, di ijaki kon jakobi, di jakobi gba kon juda na oo onkuunso;.

name: Lobi
text: dɩ Juda gba kɔ̃ Farɛsɩ na Jara khɛr ʋrɛraakɛ wɩ‐n wenɩ Tamaar, dɩ Farɛsɩra kɔna Ɛsɩrɔm, dɩ Ɛsɩrɔm gba kɔ̃ Aram;.
normalised_text: di juda gba kon faresi na jara ker ureraake win weni tamaar, di faresira kona esirom, di esirom gba kon aram;.

name: Lobi
text: dɩ Aram kɔ̃ Amɩnadabɩ, dɩ Amɩnadabɩ gba kɔ̃ Nasɔ̃, dɩ Nasɔ̃ gba kɔ̃ Salmɔ̃;.
normalised_text: di aram kon aminadabi, di aminadabi gba kon nason, di nason gba kon salmon;.

name: Lobi
text: dɩ Salmɔ̃ gba kɔ̃ Boajɩ khɛr ʋrɛraakɛ wɩ‐n wenɩ Rahabɩ, dɩ Boajɩ gba kɔ̃ Obɛɛdɩ khɛr ʋrɛraakɛ wɩ‐n wenɩ Ruti;.
normalised_text: di salmon gba kon boaji ker ureraake win weni rahabi, di boaji gba kon obeedi ker ureraake win weni ruti;.

name: Lobi
text: dɩ Obɛɛdɩ kɔ̃ Ɩjaɩ, dɩ Ɩjaɩ gba kɔ̃ Davɩdɩɩkɛ dɔnɩ fãgadaar. Dɩ Davɩdɩ gba kɔ̃ Salomɔ̃ khɛrraakɛ kɔɔ dɔnɩ Urii khɛr;.
normalised_text: di obeedi kon ijai, di ijai gba kon davidiike doni fangadaar. di davidi gba kon salomon kerraake koo doni urii ker;.

name: Lobi
text: dɩ Salomɔ̃ gba kɔ̃ Roboam, dɩ Roboam gba kɔ̃ Abɩa, dɩ Abɩa gba kɔ̃ Aja;.
normalised_text: di salomon gba kon roboam, di roboam gba kon abia, di abia gba kon aja;.

name: Lobi
text: dɩ Aja gba kɔ̃ Jojafatɩ, dɩ Jojafatɩ gba kɔ̃ Joram, sɩ Ojɩasɩ dor Joramɩ məl;.
normalised_text: di aja gba kon jojafati, di jojafati gba kon joram, si ojiasi dor jorami mel;.

name: Lobi
text: dɩ Ojɩasɩ gba kɔ̃ Joatam, dɩ Joatam gba kɔ̃ Akaajɩ, dɩ Akaajɩ gba kɔ̃ Ejekɩasɩ;.
normalised_text: di ojiasi gba kon joatam, di joatam gba kon akaaji, di akaaji gba kon ejekiasi;.

name: Lobi
text: dɩ Ejekɩasɩ gba kɔ̃ Manase, dɩ Manase gba kɔ̃ Amɔ̃, dɩ Amɔ̃ gba kɔ̃ Jojɩasɩ;.
normalised_text: di ejekiasi gba kon manase, di manase gba kon amon, di amon gba kon jojiasi;.

name: Lobi
text: dɩ Jojɩasɩ gba kɔ̃ Jekonɩasɩ na ɔɔ õkuunsɔ, bɔɔkɛ wɩ fʋlɛnɩ Ɩjɩrayɛldara a jalna Babɩlɔn.
normalised_text: di jojiasi gba kon jekoniasi na oo onkuunso, booke wi fuleni ijirayeldara a jalna babilon.

name: Lobi
text: Ɔbɔɔkɛ wɩ kɔɔ fʋlɛnɩ Ɩjɩrayɛldara a jalna Babɩlɔn pɩ, gɛr Jekonɩasɩ kɔɔ kʋɔn Salatɩɛl, dɩ Salatɩɛl gba kɔ̃ Jorobabɛl;.
normalised_text: obooke wi koo fuleni ijirayeldara a jalna babilon pi, ger jekoniasi koo kuon salatiel, di salatiel gba kon jorobabel;.

name: Lobi
text: dɩ Jorobabɛl gba kɔ̃ Abiyudi, dɩ Abiyudi gba kɔ̃ Elɩakɩm, dɩ Elɩakɩm gba kɔ̃ Ajɔɔr;.
normalised_text: di jorobabel gba kon abiyudi, di abiyudi gba kon eliakim, di eliakim gba kon ajoor;.

name: Lobi
text: dɩ Ajɔɔr gba kɔ̃ Sadɔkɩ, dɩ Sadɔkɩ gba kɔ̃ Akɩm, dɩ Akɩm gba kɔ̃ Eliyudi;.
normalised_text: di ajoor gba kon sadoki, di sadoki gba kon akim, di akim gba kon eliyudi;.

name: Lobi
text: dɩ Eliyudi gba kɔ̃ Eleajaar, dɩ Eleajaar gba kɔ̃ Matã, dɩ Matã gba kɔ̃ Jakɔbɩ;.
normalised_text: di eliyudi gba kon eleajaar, di eleajaar gba kon matan, di matan gba kon jakobi;.

name: Lobi
text: dɩ Jakɔbɩ gba kɔ̃ Jojɛfɩɩkɛ dɔnɩ Marɩɩ ko, Marɩɩkɛra kɔɔ kɔnanɩ Jejuukɛ wɩ‐n wenɩ Kirisiti.
normalised_text: di jakobi gba kon jojefiike doni marii ko, mariikera koo konani jejuuke win weni kirisiti.

name: Lobi
text: Hɩnɛ mɔ̃ gɩ kɔɔ danɩ sɩ dɩ wɩ kɔ̃ Jeju Kirisiti. Jojɛfɩ kɔɔ wɛna Jejuu nɩ Marɩ, sɩ wa kɔɔ dã kha paˈ, sɩ Thu Phuu cʋgɛɛ dɩ hana pɛmɛr.
normalised_text: hine mon gi koo dani si di wi kon jeju kirisiti. jojefi koo wena jejuu ni mari, si wa koo dan ka pa, si thu phuu chugee di hana pemer.

name: Lobi
text: Sɩ gɩdonɩ ɔɔ ko Jojɛfɩ dor tɩɩ sarʋ, aa ƴaal a kʋɛsʋʋ ire tibil jɔra ga, sɩ ɔɔ hara a kpɩɛr sa yɩ ɩna fagʋʋrɛ gbulu.
normalised_text: si gidoni oo ko jojefi dor tii saru, aa jaal a kuesuu ire tibil jora ga, si oo hara a kpier sa yi ina faguure gbulu.

name: Lobi
text: Kũubir a na kɔ̃ dɩ fa dʋʋ ire Jeju, gɩdonɩ ɔr dɔ ʋrɛ na taanɩ ɔɔ too awɩ sopugosɔra.
normalised_text: kunubir a na kon di fa duu ire jeju, gidoni or do ure na taani oo too awi sopugosora.

name: Lobi
text: Gɩrɛ fɛʋ daan, gɩ cʋʋ gɩrɛ Kɔ̃tɩn kɔɔ gbanɩ ɔɔ bobonɩ nɔ a mɩɩna gɩ ha oti, gɩ sor:.
normalised_text: gire feu daan, gi chuu gire kontin koo gbani oo boboni no a miina gi ha oti, gi sor.

name: Lobi
text: Hɩnɛ, khɛ biireekɛ na jɛnɩ kuun paˈ, a na hananɛ pɛmɛr a na kɔ̃ kũubir, wɩ haa ire Emanʋɛl, i kɩrʋ dʋɔn Thãgba har kha na sɛrɛ.
normalised_text: hine, ke biireeke na jeni kuun pa, a na hanane pemer a na kon kunubir, wi haa ire emanuel, i kiru duon tangba har ka na sere.

name: Lobi
text: Dɩ ɔbɔɔkɛ Jojɛfɩra jaanɩ, a cʋʋrɛ gɩrɛɛkɛ Kɔ̃tɩnɩ thɔ̃thɔ̃daar thurə sʋʋraanɩ, dɩ a kpar ɔɔ khɛrra a kɔna.
normalised_text: di obooke jojefira jaani, a chuure gireeke kontini tontondaar ture suuraani, di a kpar oo kerra a kona.

name: Lobi
text: sɩ aa‐n phɩnaa ga, phaphapha dɩ kɔ̃ kũubirrə a haa irera Jeju.
normalised_text: si aan phinaa ga, phaphapha di kon kunubirre a haa irera jeju.

name: Lobi
text: dɩ wa‐n bule ayɩ: Juifisɔɔ fãgadaarɩkɛ wɩ kɔnɩ, kana a ha? Gɩdonɩ ɔɔ ƴepələ̃bi sɩ kɔɔ yɩ kɩrrɔ a ɩ̃ sɩ fʋɔrʋʋ.
normalised_text: di wan bule ayi juifisoo fangadaarike wi koni, kana a ha? gidoni oo jepelenbi si koo yi kirro a in si fuoruu.

name: Lobi
text: Ɔbɔɔkɛ Ɛrɔɔdɩ fãgadaar nɩɛnɩ gele, ɔɔ kpɩɛr nyanyaanɛ na wɩrɛ fɛʋʋkɛ hanaanɩ kha le Jerujalɛm.
normalised_text: obooke eroodi fangadaar nieni gele, oo kpier nyanyaane na wire feuuke hanaani ka le jerujalem.

name: Lobi
text: Dɩ a kpar bonɩ jidaar kɔ̃tɩna fɛʋ nakha tɩbɩlaa jɔfʋ dɩɩrdaarsɔ, a bule wi ka teananɩ wɩ kɔna Kirisitira.
normalised_text: di a kpar boni jidaar kontina feu naka tibilaa jofu diirdaarso, a bule wi ka teanani wi kona kirisitira.

name: Lobi
text: Dɩ wɩ sʋʋraa: Bɛtɩlɛhɛm Jude dɩɩra gɩ, gɩdonɩ gɛr dɔ gɩrɛ Thãgbaa bobon kɔɔ kherenɩ, gɩ sor ayɩ:.
normalised_text: di wi suuraa betilehem jude diira gi, gidoni ger do gire tangbaa bobon koo kereni, gi sor ayi.

name: Lobi
text: Le Ɛrɔɔdɩ wolõ a we tɩɩ kpɛsɛsɔ, a jɩɩ bule wi a jɩɩ jɩ bɔɔbɔɔ bɔɔkɛ ƴepələ̃bireelera phanɩ.
normalised_text: le eroodi wolon a we tii kpeseso, a jii bule wi a jii ji booboo booke jepelenbireelera phani.

name: Lobi
text: Agɩpɩ dɩ thɔ̃ wɩ Bɛtɩlɛhɛm dɩɩra ayɩ: Nɩ jala a jɩɛ ˈlo bɩsaanɩdaalera; ado nɩ yɩɩ, nɩ dɔ ɩ̃ nɩɛ ɩ̃ jal dakha mer ɩ̃ fʋɔrʋʋ.
normalised_text: agipi di ton wi betilehem diira ayi ni jala a jie lo bisaanidaalera; ado ni yii, ni do in nie in jal daka mer in fuoruu.

name: Lobi
text: Ɔbɔɔkɛ wɩ yɩnɩ ƴepələ̃bireele, da kɔ̃tɩ̃ɩ kɔɔ fʋ wɛr na sobɔr.
normalised_text: obooke wi yini jepelenbireele, da kontini koo fu wer na sobor.

name: Logoti
text: Buku Yesu Kristuni tizo di, akodi Dawidini mva e, akodi Iburaimuni mva e.
normalised_text: buku yesu kristuni tizo di, akodi dawidini mva e, akodi iburaimuni mva e.

name: Logoti
text: Àbàrámà ti tá Ɨ̀sákà, Ɨ̀sákà dré Yàkóbhò nɨ tìzo gò, Yàkóbhò dré Yúdà kɨ tìzo adrúpi nɨ ɨ́be.
normalised_text: abarama ti ta ysaka, ysaka de yakobo ny tizo go, yakobo de yuda ky tizo adupi ny ybe.

name: Logoti
text: Iburaimu ti Yisaka dre; Yisaka dre Yakobo tizo; Yakobo dre Yuda akodia adrupia be tizo;.
normalised_text: iburaimu ti yisaka de; yisaka de yakobo tizo; yakobo de yuda akodia adupia be tizo;.

name: Logoti
text: Yuda dre Perese, Zera be tizo Tamaru; Perese dre Eserome tizo; Eseroma dre Arama tizo;.
normalised_text: yuda de perese, zera be tizo tamaru; perese de eserome tizo; eseroma de arama tizo;.

name: Logoti
text: Yúdà ɨ Tàmárà be dhɨ ɨ̀ dré Fàrésà kɨ tìzo Zárà be. Fàrésà dré Èsèrómà nɨ tìzo, Èsèrómà dré Àrámà nɨ tìzo.
normalised_text: yuda y tamara be dy y de faresa ky tizo zara be. faresa de eseroma ny tizo, eseroma de arama ny tizo.

name: Logoti
text: Arama dre Aminadaba tizo; Aminadaba dre Nasona tizo; Nasona dre Salamona tizo.
normalised_text: arama de aminadaba tizo; aminadaba de nasona tizo; nasona de salamona tizo.

name: Logoti
text: Àrámà dré Àmìnàdábà nɨ tìzo, Àmìnàdábà dré Nàsónà nɨ tìzo, Nàsónà dré Sàlòmónà nɨ tìzo.
normalised_text: arama de aminadaba ny tizo, aminadaba de nasona ny tizo, nasona de salomona ny tizo.

name: Logoti
text: Salamona dre Boaza tizo Raabaru; Boaza dre Obede tizo Rutaru; Obede dre Yisai tizo;.
normalised_text: salamona de boaza tizo raabaru; boaza de obede tizo rutaru; obede de yisai tizo;.

name: Logoti
text: Sàlòmónà ɨ Rábà be dhɨ ɨ̀ dré Bòwésà nɨ tìzo. Bòwésà ɨ Rútà be dhɨ ɨ̀ dré Yòbédè nɨ tìzo. Yòbédè dré Yésè nɨ tìzo.
normalised_text: salomona y raba be dy y de bowesa ny tizo. bowesa y ruta be dy y de yobede ny tizo. yobede de yese ny tizo.

name: Logoti
text: Yésè dré ópɨ́ Dàwídì nɨ tìzo. Dàwídì ɨ Ùríyà nɨ tòkó be dhɨ ɨ̀ dré Sòlòmónò nɨ tìzo.
normalised_text: yese de opy dawidi ny tizo. dawidi y uriya ny toko be dy y de solomono ny tizo.

name: Logoti
text: Yisai dre Dawidi, akodi mokonziro di, tizo. Dawidi dre Solomo tizo akodiru, akodi dridri Uriyani toko e;.
normalised_text: yisai de dawidi, akodi mokonziro di, tizo. dawidi de solomo tizo akodiru, akodi didi uriyani toko e;.

name: Logoti
text: Solomo dre Rabama tizo; Rabama dre Aiya tizo; Aiya dre Asa tizo;.
normalised_text: solomo de rabama tizo; rabama de aiya tizo; aiya de asa tizo;.

name: Logoti
text: Sòlòmónò dré Ròbòwámà nɨ tìzo, Ròbòwámà dré Àbɨ́yà nɨ tìzo, Àbɨ́yà dré Àsáfà nɨ tìzo.
normalised_text: solomono de robowama ny tizo, robowama de abiya ny tizo, abiya de asafa ny tizo.

name: Logoti
text: Asa dre Yosafata tizo; Yosafata dre Yorama tizo; Yorama dre Uziya tizo;.
normalised_text: asa de yosafata tizo; yosafata de yorama tizo; yorama de uziya tizo;.

name: Logoti
text: Àsáfà dré Yòsàfátà nɨ tìzo, Yòsàfátà dré Yòrámà nɨ tìzo, Yòrámà dré Òzɨ́yà nɨ tìzo.
normalised_text: asafa de yosafata ny tizo, yosafata de yorama ny tizo, yorama de oziya ny tizo.

name: Logoti
text: Òzɨ́yà dré Yòwàtámà nɨ tìzo, Yòwàtámà dré Àkázà nɨ tìzo, Àkázà dré Èzèkɨ́yà nɨ tìzo.
normalised_text: oziya de yowatama ny tizo, yowatama de akaza ny tizo, akaza de ezekiya ny tizo.

name: Logoti
text: Uziya dre Yotama tizo; Yotama dre Aza tizo; Aza dre Izikiya tizo;.
normalised_text: uziya de yotama tizo; yotama de aza tizo; aza de izikiya tizo;.

name: Logoti
text: Èzèkɨ́yà dré Mànásè nɨ tìzo, Mànásè dré Àmónà nɨ tìzo, Àmónà dré Yòsɨ́yà nɨ tìzo.
normalised_text: ezekiya de manase ny tizo, manase de amona ny tizo, amona de yosiya ny tizo.

name: Logoti
text: Izikiya dre Manase tizo; Manase dre Amona tizo; Amona dre Yosiya tizo;.
normalised_text: izikiya de manase tizo; manase de amona tizo; amona de yosiya tizo;.

name: Logoti
text: Yosiya dre Yekoña tizo adrupie be, vese mundia drizo Babela a di.
normalised_text: yosiya de yekona tizo adupie be, vese mundia dizo babela a di.

name: Logoti
text: Yòsɨ́yà dré Yèkònɨ́yà kɨ tìzo adrúpi nɨ ɨ́be, lókyá Ɨ̀sèrélè ànzɨ kɨ rùzo dòle Bàbìlónà na àdzú sè dhɨ ꞌá.

name: Logoti
text: Àyɨ nda kɨ dòma Bàbìlónà na dhɨ àmvolésè dhɨ, Yèkònɨ́yà dré Sàlàtɨ̀yélè nɨ tìzo, Sàlàtɨ̀yélè dré Zòròbàbélè nɨ tìzo.

normalised_text: azora de sadoka ny tizo, sadoka de akima ny tizo, akima de eliyuda ny tizo.

name: Logoti

name: Logoti
text: Yakobo dre Yosefa ago Maria adea ni tizo, a ti Yesu, i dre zile Kristu akodiru.

name: Loma (Liberia)
text: Nii ɣa é ga Ziizɛ Kolai malɔlɔgi. Tɔ ga nui nii kuloai Deeve manu zuwui zu, kuloai wɔnɔ Eeƃɔlɔhɛ̃ɛ manu zuwui zu.
normalised_text: nii gha e ga ziize kolai malologi. to ga nui nii kuloai deeve manu zuwui zu, kuloai wono eebolohene manu zuwui zu.

name: Loma (Liberia)
text: Eeƃɔlɔhɛ̃ɛ ɣa é ɣɛni ga Aize keea, Aize ga Yeekɔ keea, Yeekɔ wɔ ge ga Juda ƃɔga diɛni ta deɣeitiɛ te ɣeea.
normalised_text: eebolohene gha e gheni ga aize keea, aize ga yeeko keea, yeeko wo ge ga juda boga dieni ta degheitie te gheea.

name: Loma (Liberia)
text: Na ɣa ɣɛɛ na Juda ɣa é ɣɛni ga Pɛɛlɛ ƃɔga Zɛla te ɣeea. É te ɣaani Tama va. Pɛɛlɛ ɣa é ɣɛni ga Hɛzɛlɔ̃ keea, Hɛzɛlɔ̃ wɔ ge ga Lɔ̃i keea.
normalised_text: na gha ghee na juda gha e gheni ga peele boga zela te gheea. e te ghaani tama va. peele gha e gheni ga hezelon keea, hezelon wo ge ga loni keea.

name: Loma (Liberia)
text: Lɔ̃i ɣa é ɣɛni ga Aminada keea, Aminada ga Naisɔ̃ keea, Naisɔ̃ ga Saamɔ̃ keea.
normalised_text: loni gha e gheni ga aminada keea, aminada ga naison keea, naison ga saamon keea.

name: Loma (Liberia)
text: Saamɔ ɣa é ɣɛni ga Boa keea. É kaani Lɔihɛɛ va. Boa ɣa é ɣɛni ga Wobɛi keea. É Wobɛi ɣaani Luufi va. Wobɛi ɣa é ɣɛni ga Jɛsi keea.

name: Loma (Liberia)
text: Jɛsi wɔ ka é ɣɛni ga ɣalaso gwalai Deeve keea. Deeve ɣa é ɣɛni ga Salamɔ̃ keea. É kaani Yulaiya ŋazai va.
normalised_text: jesi wo ka e gheni ga ghalaso gwalai deeve keea. deeve gha e gheni ga salamon keea. e kaani yulaiya ngazai va.

name: Loma (Liberia)
text: Salamɔ̃ ɣa é ɣɛni ga Luiyiɛ‐bõa keea, Luiyiɛ‐bõa wɔ ge ga Abija keea. Abija wɔ é ɣɛni ga Asa keea.
normalised_text: salamon gha e gheni ga luiyiebona keea, luiyiebona wo ge ga abija keea. abija wo e gheni ga asa keea.

name: Loma (Liberia)
text: Asa ɣa é ɣɛni ga Jehoo‐safa keea, Jehoo‐safa ga Joolɛ̃ keea, Joolɛ̃ ga Yuzaiya keea.

name: Loma (Liberia)
text: Na ɣa ɣɛɛ na Yuzaiya ɣa é ɣɛni ga Joodɛ̃ keea, Joodɛ̃ wɔ ge ga Eehai keea, Eehai ga Hɛzɛkaiya keea.
normalised_text: na gha ghee na yuzaiya gha e gheni ga jooden keea, jooden wo ge ga eehai keea, eehai ga hezekaiya keea.

name: Loma (Liberia)
text: Hɛzɛkaiya ɣa é ɣɛni ga Manaasɛ keea, Manaasɛ ga Eemɔ keea, Eemɔ ga Joosaiya keea.

name: Loma (Liberia)
text: Joosaiya wɔ ka é ɣɛni ga Jɛkonaiya ƃɔga deɣe zinaitiɛ te ɣeea. Na ɣɛni ga siɛgi te numaitiɛ wuloni la ta yui va te li ga tiɛ Babelɔ̃ lai zu.

name: Loma (Liberia)
text: Te lii ʋai ga tiɛ Babelɔ̃, tei na wuloni ba, Jɛkonaiya ɣa é ɣɛni ga Salatiɛ keea, Salatiɛ ga Zɛluu‐bɛbɛ keea.

normalised_text: azo gha e gheni ga zadoki keea, zadoki ga akini keea, akini ga elia keea.

name: Loma (Liberia)
text: Yeekɔ wɔ ka é ɣɛni ga Zoosɛ keea. Na ɣa ga Zoosɛ nii é ɣɛni ga Meele pɔɔ nui nii é Ziizɛi nii ɣaani dáa ga Kolai.

name: Loma (Liberia)
text: Tei tɔwɔ pɔɔ nui Zoosɛ ɣɛni ga tele‐bo tuo‐wo nu, ɛ́ lɛ ŋɛni wõini ga é ƃaa wulo Meele ma kpɔ saama, é deʋeni ga é yee wulo maʋaa zu sĩi.

name: Loma (Liberia)
text: Tɔ vaazu zunu luu ɣaazu. Na ɣa ɣɛɛ na yà lopoi laa zei ga Ziizɛ, ƃɔvɛlaale towaa ná numaitiɛ wulo ta ʋaa yowũitiɛ zu.

text: Nii ɣaazɔ ɣɛɛni kɛɛ ʋaa ma nii de maliɣii pua dáa woo‐wo nui la é bo nà leve ma.

text: Tei te Ziizɛ ɣaani Bɛfelehɛ̃ɛ lai zu Yudiiya yui zu, masagi Yɛloo na yɛmini su, kele‐ɣele bea te wuloni ga folo wulo‐zu vele te va Yɛlusulɛɛ lai zu.

text: Tei masagi Yɛloo é nii mɛnini, é ɣɛni pɔ̃ɔ ta Yɛlusulɛɛ vea ɣaazɔ.

text: Te lɛnɛ pele ma ga te ze‐su vele ga te mɛ lɛ leve ga Yɛloo wɔ vele, te leveni ga pele ta ƃɔnɔ te li wɔ taa zu.

name: Lomwe
text: Nyenya mmalamulo a Yehova ti muri otheya wawe; Nave mmalamulo awe annupuwelela othana ni ohiyu.

name: Lomwe
text: Yowo antoko mwiri wawaliwa mithe va mihiche ya mahi; Wawima yawimáya va mahiku aya, Nikukhu naya hannanyála; Nave sothe sene oneriye onniphwanyeryano.
normalised_text: yowo antoko mwiri wawaliwa mithe va mihiche ya mahi; wawima yawimaya va mahiku aya, nikukhu naya hannanyala; nave sothe sene oneriye onniphwanyeryano.

text: Alipa‐onanara heni hono hoe; Nyenya antoko mutcharapo wovavihiwa etcheku.

text: Amalapo enanyakulelani, Nave atchu enanyiheryelani itheru sene?.

text: Muruméleni Yehova ni wova, Nave hakalalani ni othukumela.

name: Lomwe

text: Yehova! Khwo! manki ahacha ókihosha miyo! Yawo enakivinyerya miyo tanchiene.

text: Anchipale enalocha sokumi aka, Hanono ovulusha mwa Muluku.

name: Lubila
text: Jekɔb uhon Josɛf. Josɛf uwɛ urenɛ urum Mery ɔka Jizɔz onewɛ uchegɛ bara iyem dɔnaŋi bara.

name: Lubila
text: Iki wanmạŋ woŋ onerum. Awɛ awu ebuni ayemạŋ dokom Jizɔz, uwuŋinɛ iri segɛ ane bɛbɛ kokpo ayinɛ.

text: Amaa ba daa bu la'am taaba n‑dooni halli ka Mariama ti dɔ'ai u pɔ'asaridɔ'am, bidibga; ka Gyoosɛfi daa puri u yuuri Yisa.
normalised_text: amaa ba daa bu laam taaba ndooni halli ka mariama ti doai u poasaridoam, bidibga; ka joosefi daa puri u yuuri yisa.

name: Mampruli
text: Ka NaaHɛroodi ŋɔn daa wum ba lala boosigu maa, di daa gyɛri u pampam - ŋɔn ni u niriba ban bɛ Gyɛrusalɛm zaa - ka ba sufu daa sa'am.
normalised_text: ka naaheroodi ngon daa vum ba lala boosigu maa, di daa jeri u pampam ngon ni u niriba ban be jerusalem zaa ka ba sufu daa saam.

name: Mampruli
text: Ka ba daa labsi n‑yɛli u, ni, Bɛtlihɛm tiŋŋa kan bɛ Gyuudiiya suulinsi ni la ka ba nin dɔ'ai u. Ni, dama anabidima daa sɔbi n‑zaali, ni#:-.
normalised_text: ka ba daa labsi nyeli u, ni, betlihem tingnga kan be juudiiya suulinsi ni la ka ba nin doai u. ni, dama anabidima daa sobi nzaali, ni.

name: Mampruli
text: Ka u daa yɛli ba, Ya kyɛm Bɛtlihɛm nti bɔ bii maa lahabaari. Ka ya yi ti paai n‑nya u, ya tumma yooma na n‑yɛli ma, ka man gba nin kyaŋŋi nti gyeem u.
normalised_text: ka u daa yeli ba, ya chem betlihem nti bo bii maa lahabaari. ka ya yi ti paai nnya u, ya tumma yooma na nyeli ma, ka man gba nin changngi nti jeem u.

name: Mampruli
text: Tɔ; ka Naawunni daa kyɛ ka ba zaasi zaasimni m‑bugsi ba, ni, ba di naa n‑labi NaaHɛroodi saani, ka dizugu ba daa lɔkki sɔseaa n‑labi n‑kuli ba tiŋŋa.
normalised_text: to; ka naavunni daa che ka ba zaasi zaasimni mbugsi ba, ni, ba di naa nlabi naaheroodi saani, ka dizugu ba daa lokki soseaa nlabi nkuli ba tingnga.

name: Mampruli
text: Ka u daa doaai yuŋŋu n‑zaŋŋi u pɔ'a ni bii maa n‑yisigi n‑kyaŋŋi Igyipti.
normalised_text: ka u daa doaai yungngu nzangngi u poa ni bii maa nyisigi nchangngi ijipti.

name: Mampruli
text: Di saha di siri daa niŋi hoo Anabi Gyɛrimaaya ŋɔn daa tɔ'asi anabitiri yɛliseelli, ni#:-.
normalised_text: di saha di siri daa ningi hoo anabi jerimaaya ngon daa toasi anabitiri yeliseelli, ni.

name: Mampruli
text: Tɔ. Ka NaaHɛroodi kum nyaaŋŋa, Gyoosɛfi daa zaasi zaasimni, ka ti Dugma malaaka daa laa n‑kyɛ u saani na.
normalised_text: to. ka naaheroodi kum nyaangnga, joosefi daa zaasi zaasimni, ka ti dugma malaaka daa laa nche u saani na.

name: Mampruli
text: nti yɛli u, ni, Doaama n‑zaŋŋi bii maa ni u ma la n‑labi Izraɛli tingbaŋŋu ni, dama ninvugseeba ban daa boori ba ku bii maa la kpiya.
normalised_text: nti yeli u, ni, doaama nzangngi bii maa ni u ma la nlabi izraeli tingbangngu ni, dama ninvugseeba ban daa boori ba ku bii maa la kpiya.

name: Mampruli
text: Ka dizugu u daa doaai n‑zaŋŋi bii maa ni u ma la n‑labi Izraɛli tingbaŋŋu ni.

name: Mampruli
text: n‑yɛtti, ni, Ya kyɛli ya teesibeeri ni ya tumbeeri zaa, dama Arizana naam bɛ la ya saani.

name: Mandinka
text: Duniyaa maŋ sawura soto, feŋ te jee. Diboo le ye jiyo kunkaŋo bee muuri. Alla la Nooroo be yaara kaŋ jiyo santo.
normalised_text: duniyaa mang sawura soto, feng te jee. diboo le ye jiyo kunkango bee muuri. alla la nooroo be yaara kang jiyo santo.

name: Mandinka
text: Bituŋ Alla kumata ko, Maloo ye ke. Maloo keta.
normalised_text: bitung alla kumata ko, maloo ye ke. maloo keta.

name: Mandinka
text: Alla ye a je ko, maloo beteyaata le, bituŋ a ye maloo niŋ diboo bondi ñoo to.
normalised_text: alla ye a je ko, maloo beteyaata le, bitung a ye maloo ning diboo bondi nyoo to.

name: Mandinka
text: Alla ye maloo kumandi tiloo la, a ye diboo kumandi suutoo la. Bituŋ wulaaroo naata soto, aniŋ soomandaa, tili foloo la.
normalised_text: alla ye maloo kumandi tiloo la, a ye diboo kumandi suutoo la. bitung wulaaroo naata soto, aning soomandaa, tili foloo la.

name: Mandinka
text: Bituŋ Alla kumata ko, Saŋ fatoo ye soto jiyolu teema, a ye jiyolu bondi ñoo to.
normalised_text: bitung alla kumata ko, sang fatoo ye soto jiyolu teema, a ye jiyolu bondi nyoo to.

name: Mandinka
text: Wo le to Alla ye saŋ fatoo daa, a ye jiyolu bondi ñoo to, mennu be saŋ fatoo ye duuma la, aniŋ mennu be a ye santo la. Aduŋ a keta wo le ñaama.
normalised_text: wo le to alla ye sang fatoo daa, a ye jiyolu bondi nyoo to, mennu be sang fatoo ye duuma la, aning mennu be a ye santo la. adung a keta wo le nyaama.

name: Mandinka
text: Bituŋ Alla naata saŋ fatoo kumandi saŋo la. Wulaaroo niŋ soomandaa sotota, tili fulanjaŋ luŋo la.
normalised_text: bitung alla naata sang fatoo kumandi sango la. wulaaroo ning soomandaa sotota, tili fulanjang lungo la.

name: Mandinka
text: Bituŋ Alla kumata ko, Jiyolu mennu be saŋo duuma la, bee ye kafu ñoo ma dulaa kiliŋ, dulaa jaaroo ye finti. Aduŋ a keta wo le ñaama.
normalised_text: bitung alla kumata ko, jiyolu mennu be sango duuma la, bee ye kafu nyoo ma dulaa kiling, dulaa jaaroo ye finti. adung a keta wo le nyaama.

name: Mandinka
text: Alla ye dulaa jaaroo kumandi bankoo la. Bituŋ jiyolu mennu kafuta ñoo ma, a ye wolu kumandi fankaasoolu la. Alla ye a je ko, a beteyaata le.
normalised_text: alla ye dulaa jaaroo kumandi bankoo la. bitung jiyolu mennu kafuta nyoo ma, a ye wolu kumandi fankaasoolu la. alla ye a je ko, a beteyaata le.

name: Mandinka
text: Wo le to bankoo naata fiifeŋolu siifaa-wo-siifaa soto, aniŋ yiroolu siifaa-wo-siifaa, mennu ka diŋ. Alla ye a je ko, a beteyaata le.
normalised_text: wo le to bankoo naata fiifengolu siifaawosiifaa soto, aning yiroolu siifaawosiifaa, mennu ka ding. alla ye a je ko, a beteyaata le.

name: Mandinka
text: Wulaaroo niŋ soomandaa sotota, tili sabanjaŋ luŋo la.

normalised_text: aning i ye ke malafengolu ti sango bala ka mala duniyaa kono. adung a keta wo le nyaama.

name: Mandinka
text: Alla ye ì ke saŋo bala le, ka mala duniyaa kono.
normalised_text: alla ye i ke sango bala le, ka mala duniyaa kono.

name: Mandinka
text: ka mara suutoo niŋ tiloo ma, aniŋ ka maloo niŋ diboo bondi ñoo to. Bituŋ Alla ye a je ko, a beteyaata le.

name: Mandinka
text: Wulaaroo niŋ soomandaa sotota, tili naaninjaŋ luŋo la.
normalised_text: wulaaroo ning soomandaa sotota, tili naaninjang lungo la.

name: Mandinka
text: Bituŋ Alla kumata ko, Jiyo kono ye faa niilamaa feŋolu la, kunoolu ye tii santo.
normalised_text: bitung alla kumata ko, jiyo kono ye faa niilamaa fengolu la, kunoolu ye tii santo.

name: Mandinka
text: Wo le to Alla naata baakono feŋ baalu daa, aniŋ niilamaa feŋolu bee, mennu be baa kono, aniŋ kunu siifaa-wo-siifaa. Alla ye a je ko, a beteyaata le.
normalised_text: wo le to alla naata baakono feng baalu daa, aning niilamaa fengolu bee, mennu be baa kono, aning kunu siifaawosiifaa. alla ye a je ko, a beteyaata le.

name: Mandinka
text: Alla neemata ì ma, a ko, Ali ke jiidilaalu ti, ali ye siyaa, ali ye baajiyolu kono bee fandi, aniŋ kunoolu ye siyaa duniyaa kono.
normalised_text: alla neemata i ma, a ko, ali ke jiidilaalu ti, ali ye siyaa, ali ye baajiyolu kono bee fandi, aning kunoolu ye siyaa duniyaa kono.

name: Mandinka
text: Wulaaroo niŋ soomandaa sotota, tili luulunjaŋ luŋo la.
normalised_text: wulaaroo ning soomandaa sotota, tili luulunjang lungo la.

name: Mandinka
text: Wo le to Alla ye moo daa a faŋo sawuroo la, a faŋo sawuroo, a ye ì daa wo le la. A ye moo daa musoo niŋ kewo ti.
normalised_text: wo le to alla ye moo daa a fango sawuroo la, a fango sawuroo, a ye i daa wo le la. a ye moo daa musoo ning kewo ti.

name: Mandinka
text: Alla ye a je ko, a ye feŋolu mennu bee daa, beteyaata baake le. Wulaaroo niŋ soomandaa sotota, tili wooronjaŋ luŋo la.
normalised_text: alla ye a je ko, a ye fengolu mennu bee daa, beteyaata baake le. wulaaroo ning soomandaa sotota, tili wooronjang lungo la.

name: Mandinka
text: Bituŋ saŋo niŋ bankoo banta daa la, ì niŋ ì konokono feŋolu bee.
normalised_text: bitung sango ning bankoo banta daa la, i ning i konokono fengolu bee.

name: Mandinka
text: Tili wooronjaŋo, Alla ye dookuwo baŋ, a tarata meŋ ke kaŋ. Bituŋ a ye i dahaa tili woorowulanjaŋ luŋo.
normalised_text: tili wooronjango, alla ye dookuwo bang, a tarata meng ke kang. bitung a ye i dahaa tili woorowulanjang lungo.

name: Mandinka
text: Alla neemata tili woorowulanjaŋ luŋo ma, aduŋ a ye a kuliyaa. Kaatu ate mu luŋ ne ti, luŋo meŋ Alla ye i dahaa daaroo bee la, a tarata meŋ ke kaŋ.
normalised_text: alla neemata tili woorowulanjang lungo ma, adung a ye a kuliyaa. kaatu ate mu lung ne ti, lungo meng alla ye i dahaa daaroo bee la, a tarata meng ke kang.

name: Mandinka
text: Ñiŋ ne keta saŋo niŋ bankoo la taarikoo ti, kabiriŋ Alla ye ì daa. Kabiriŋ Yaawe* Alla ye saŋo niŋ bankoo daa.
normalised_text: nying ne keta sango ning bankoo la taarikoo ti, kabiring alla ye i daa. kabiring yaawe alla ye sango ning bankoo daa.

name: Mandinka
text: Bari jiyo fintita naŋ bankoo kono le, a bolondimmaa, a woyita bankoo bee kaŋ.

name: Mandinka
text: Bituŋ Yaawe Alla naata bankumunkoo doo taa, a ye Adama daa a la. A ye baluwo niijii foñoo fee a nuŋ huwolu kono. Bituŋ Adama ye a dati ka baluu.
normalised_text: bitung yaawe alla naata bankumunkoo doo taa, a ye adama daa a la. a ye baluwo niijii fonyoo fee a nung huwolu kono. bitung adama ye a dati ka baluu.

name: Mandinka
text: Bituŋ Yaawe Alla naata naakoo ke Edeni kono, tilibo karoo la. Bituŋ a ye Adama bula a kono, a ye meŋ daa.
normalised_text: bitung yaawe alla naata naakoo ke edeni kono, tilibo karoo la. bitung a ye adama bula a kono, a ye meng daa.

name: Mandinka
text: Boloŋo bota Edeni, a jiyo ka woyi naakoo ñiŋ kono. Ka bo naakoo ñiŋ kono la, a ka talaa ka ke jii bulu naani ti.
normalised_text: bolongo bota edeni, a jiyo ka woyi naakoo nying kono. ka bo naakoo nying kono la, a ka talaa ka ke jii bulu naani ti.

name: Mandinka
text: Jii bulu foloo, wo too mu Pisoni le ti. Ate le jiyo ka bori Hawila bankoo bee kaŋ, sanoo be daameŋ.
normalised_text: jii bulu foloo, wo too mu pisoni le ti. ate le jiyo ka bori hawila bankoo bee kang, sanoo be daameng.

name: Mandjak
text: Ulibëru un piban wi pëbuka Yeesu Këristu, nul nan cii abuk Dawid, a Dawid ci abuk Abraam:.
normalised_text: uliberu un piban wi pebuka yeesu keristu, nul nan chii abuk dawid, a dawid chi abuk abraam.

name: Mandjak
text: Abraam buk un Isaak, Isaak buk un Jakob, Jakob buk un Juda ni ban tsaar biki ni nul.
normalised_text: abraam buk un isaak, isaak buk un jakob, jakob buk un juda ni ban tsaar biki ni nul.

name: Mandjak
text: Juda buk un Peres ni Sera, a Tamar ci-un anin bukul; Peres buk un Esrom, Esrom buk un Aram.
normalised_text: juda buk un peres ni sera, a tamar chiun anin bukul; peres buk un esrom, esrom buk un aram.

name: Mandjak
text: Aram buk un Aminadabi, Aminadabi buk un Naason, Naason buk un Salëmon.
normalised_text: aram buk un aminadabi, aminadabi buk un naason, naason buk un salemon.

name: Mandjak
text: Salëmon buk un Boas, Raab ci-un anin Boas; a Boas buk un Obed, Ruuti ci-un anin Obed; a Obed buk un Jese.
normalised_text: salemon buk un boas, raab chiun anin boas; a boas buk un obed, ruuti chiun anin obed; a obed buk un jese.

name: Mandjak
text: Jese buk un Dawid nasien. A Dawid buk un Salomon; anin Salomondo un ci aar Urias;.
normalised_text: jese buk un dawid nasien. a dawid buk un salomon; anin salomondo un chi aar urias;.

name: Mandjak
text: Salomon buk un Reoboan, Reoboan buk un Abia, Abia buk un Asa.
normalised_text: salomon buk un reoboan, reoboan buk un abia, abia buk un asa.

name: Mandjak
text: Asa buk un Josafat, Josafat buk un Joram, Joram buk un Osias.
normalised_text: asa buk un josafat, josafat buk un joram, joram buk un osias.

name: Mandjak
text: Osias buk un Jotam, Jotam buk un Akaas, Akaas buk un Esekiyas.
normalised_text: osias buk un jotam, jotam buk un akaas, akaas buk un esekiyas.

name: Mandjak
text: Esekiyas buk un Manase, Manase buk un Amon, Amon buk un Josias.
normalised_text: esekiyas buk un manase, manase buk un amon, amon buk un josias.

name: Mandjak
text: Josias buk un Jekonias ni ban tsaar biki ni nul; bu bëka tsi uwal wi bañaan-ucaak Israel moba wi a ba tsëpanda ucaak Babiloonia.
normalised_text: josias buk un jekonias ni ban tsaar biki ni nul; bu beka tsi uwal wi banyaanuchaak israel moba wi a ba tsepanda uchaak babiloonia.

name: Mandjak
text: Bi ba tsëpanda bi Babiloonia, a Jekonias bi buk Salatiel; a Salatiel buk un Sorobabel.
normalised_text: bi ba tsepanda bi babiloonia, a jekonias bi buk salatiel; a salatiel buk un sorobabel.

name: Mandjak
text: Sorobabel buk un Abiuud, Abiuud buk un Eliakim, Eliakim buk un Asor.
normalised_text: sorobabel buk un abiuud, abiuud buk un eliakim, eliakim buk un asor.

name: Mandjak
text: Asor buk un Sadoki, Sadoki buk un Akim, Akim buk un Eliuud.
normalised_text: asor buk un sadoki, sadoki buk un akim, akim buk un eliuud.

name: Mandjak
text: Eliuud buk un Eleasar, Eleasar buk un Matan, Matan buk un Jakob.
normalised_text: eliuud buk un eleasar, eleasar buk un matan, matan buk un jakob.

name: Mandjak
text: Jakob buk un Juse, ayën Maaria nan buki Yeesu, nul ni ka n jakee Këristu.
normalised_text: jakob buk un juse, ayen maaria nan buki yeesu, nul ni ka n jakee keristu.

name: Mandjak
text: Ubukara Yeesu, iink di u ci run: Maaria aninul aci nampëli Juse; maa bë netse ka tsoar a na mob pëpës tsi pëyëlan Uwejats-ujënts.
normalised_text: ubukara yeesu, iink di u chi run maaria aninul achi nampeli juse; maa be netse ka tsoar a na mob pepes tsi peyelan uwejatsujents.

name: Mandjak
text: Juse ayënul aci niints na mabi, ŋalats pëkawaranul, na wejats pëgar ni nul te ñaan di ka me ko un ka wi.
normalised_text: juse ayenul achi niints na mabi, ngalats pekawaranul, na wejats pegar ni nul te nyaan di ka me ko un ka wi.

name: Mandjak
text: Ka buk napäts niints, kë tsuul katim, Yeesu. Par nul ka bueran un bañaanul tsi ngëjuban bukul.
normalised_text: ka buk napats niints, ke tsuul katim, yeesu. par nul ka bueran un banyaanul tsi ngejuban bukul.

name: Mandjak
text: A ko wan bëlieng ci, pa pëpibanaan u ci wun wi Ajug ro wi ja nayëlia na ja; iink di na ja run:.
normalised_text: a ko wan belieng chi, pa pepibanaan u chi wun wi ajug ro wi ja nayelia na ja; iink di na ja run.

name: Mandjak
text: Teenan-e! Ŋaats na meetsi niints kee mob pëpës, në buk napäts niints, nuu jaka, Emanuel, un ci wi, Nasien-batsi ni nja uci pa colësiaara.
normalised_text: teenane! ngaats na meetsi niints kee mob pepes, ne buk napats niints, nuu jaka, emanuel, un chi wi, nasienbatsi ni nja uchi pa cholesiaara.

name: Mandjak
text: Bi Juse teeni bi, a na ro ko wi uwaanju Ajug jaul wi, a na yank aarul;.
normalised_text: bi juse teeni bi, a na ro ko wi uwaanju ajug jaul wi, a na yank aarul;.

name: Mandjak
text: maa meets ruetsul, te aarul tsënkëne buk napäts niints. A Juse tsuul katim, Yeesu.
normalised_text: maa meets ruetsul, te aarul tsenkene buk napats niints. a juse tsuul katim, yeesu.

name: Mandjak
text: Bi Yeesu bëka bi di Betëleem tsi pëboos Judeeya, tsi uwal wi Eroodis ro wi ci nasien, a bame-ngëme pëni uleka umay-unu, a ba baandi Jerusalem.
normalised_text: bi yeesu beka bi di beteleem tsi peboos judeeya, tsi uwal wi eroodis ro wi chi nasien, a bamengeme peni uleka umayunu, a ba baandi jerusalem.

name: Mandjak
text: A ba yepar aja: Nasien Bajudeu na ndu buka, aci tsum-i? Wund awin upesajul di umay-unu, a wund bi pëbëndanul.
normalised_text: a ba yepar aja nasien bajudeu na ndu buka, achi tsumi? wund awin upesajul di umayunu, a wund bi pebendanul.

name: Mandjak
text: Bi Eroodis, nasien, te bi irim yan a na lënk, a bañaan Jerusalem lënkand bëlieng.
normalised_text: bi eroodis, nasien, te bi irim yan a na lenk, a banyaan jerusalem lenkand belieng.

name: Mandjak
text: A na júkëlën bawiak-bajakan, ni bapican-ulua bañaan-ucaak, a na yepar bukul tsi Këristu ka tsi pëbukëna.
normalised_text: a na jukelen bawiakbajakan, ni bapichanulua banyaanuchaak, a na yepar bukul tsi keristu ka tsi pebukena.

name: Mandjak
text: A ba yankul aja: Di Betëleem Judeeya. Par ko wi, wi nayëlia pican wun, aja:.
normalised_text: a ba yankul aja di beteleem judeeya. par ko wi, wi nayelia pichan wun, aja.

name: Mandjak
text: Din a Eroodis rui bame-ngëme, te ñaan meets; a na ja bukul ba leentsul tsi ko un jënts wi, uwal wi upesaj cili wi.
normalised_text: din a eroodis rui bamengeme, te nyaan meets; a na ja bukul ba leentsul tsi ko un jents wi, uwal wi upesaj chili wi.

name: Mandjak
text: Bi ba win bi upesaj, a ba cum ni ulílan uwiak.
normalised_text: bi ba win bi upesaj, a ba chum ni ulilan uwiak.

name: Manga Kanuri
text: Akko kitawu kaariya Isa Almasiwu tada Mai Daudaye, ti ye tada Nawi Ibrahimbedǝyedǝ:.
normalised_text: akko kitawu kaariya isa almasiwu tada mai daudaye, ti ye tada nawi ibrahimbedeyede.

name: Manga Kanuri
text: Ibrahim Isakua kembo, Isaku ye Yakubaa kembo, Yakuba ye Yahuda-a awaanawanju-aa kembo.
normalised_text: ibrahim isakua kembo, isaku ye yakubaa kembo, yakuba ye yahudaa awaanawanjuaa kembo.

name: Manga Kanuri
text: Yahuda ye Feres-a Jera-aa kembo, yanja Tamar, Feres ye Hesronna kembo, Hesron ye Aramba kembo.
normalised_text: yahuda ye feresa jeraaa kembo, yanja tamar, feres ye hesronna kembo, hesron ye aramba kembo.

name: Manga Kanuri
text: Aram ye Aminadabba kembo, Aminadab ye Nashonna kembo, Nashon ye Salmonna kembo.
normalised_text: aram ye aminadabba kembo, aminadab ye nashonna kembo, nashon ye salmonna kembo.

name: Manga Kanuri
text: Salmon ye Bowossa kembo, ya Bowosse Rahab, Bowos ye Abidaa kembo, ya Abidaye Rut, Abida ye Yisaia kembo.
normalised_text: salmon ye bowossa kembo, ya bowosse rahab, bowos ye abidaa kembo, ya abidaye rut, abida ye yisaia kembo.

name: Manga Kanuri
text: Yisai ye Mai Daudaa kembo. Mai Dauda Sulemanaa kembo, calan ya Sulemanayedǝ kamu Uriyaye.
normalised_text: yisai ye mai daudaa kembo. mai dauda sulemanaa kembo, chalan ya sulemanayede kamu uriyaye.

name: Manga Kanuri
text: Sulemana ye Rehobowamba kembo, Rehobowam ye Abiyaa kembo, Abiya ye Asaa kembo.
normalised_text: sulemana ye rehobowamba kembo, rehobowam ye abiyaa kembo, abiya ye asaa kembo.

name: Manga Kanuri
text: Asa ye Yosafatta kembo, Yosafat ye Yoramba kembo, Yoram ye Wojiyassa kembo.

name: Manga Kanuri

normalised_text: ajor ye jadokka kembo, jadok ye akimba kembo, akim ye alihudda kembo.

name: Manga Kanuri
text: Alihud ye Aliyasarra kembo, Aliyasar ye Matanna kembo, Matan ye Yakubaa kembo.

name: Manga Kanuri
text: Yakuba ye Isuwua kembo, Isuwudǝ kwa Merambe, Meram ye Isa tia Almasiwulan bowojaidǝa kembo.

name: Manga Kanuri
text: Akko lawar tambo Isa Almasiwuye. Yanju Meramdǝ tǝmaji Isuwuye, amma kawu larusa cade rokko dasayiro, Ruhu Alaye cakke curoaro walyeno.

name: Manga Kanuri
text: Isuwu tǝmajinjudǝ kam jirema, fuwu jamayen tia nanguro njakko cǝraannidǝro, asǝrlan tia kolduro nia ngoyeno.

name: Manga Kanuri
text: Adǝgaima awo Kǝmande kuren ci nawiyen wuljǝnadǝ wakkayeno.

name: Manga Kanuri

name: Manga Kanuri
text: Kǝnǝmlan fayenniya, Isuwu awo malaiya Kǝmandeye tiro wuljǝgǝnadǝa cǝde Meramba kamuro ngoyeno.

name: Manga Kanuri
text: Jaman Isa bǝla Baitalami cidi Yahudiyayen tambǝnadǝn, Hirudus ti mai duwon, ilmuwu laa cidi adinnambe cijane Jerujalembo isane:.
normalised_text: jaman isa bela baitalami chidi yahudiyayen tambenaden, hirudus ti mai duwon, ilmuwu laa chidi adinnambe chijane jerujalembo isane.

name: Manga Kanuri
text: «Nda ti Mai Yaudiyaye tambǝnadǝ? Sillowunju adinnamlan culuwuna ruiye tiro ambǝttuwuro kadiye,» cane keworo.
normalised_text: "nda ti mai yaudiyaye tambenade? sillowunju adinnamlan chuluwuna ruiye tiro ambettuwuro kadiye," cane keworo.

name: Manga Kanuri
text: Mai Hirudus adǝa fangenniya, hangalnju caa ciyeno, am Jerujalembe samma ye ngai.

name: Manga Kanuri
text: «Ni Baitalami cidi Yahudaye, curo bǝlawa Yahudayedǝn darajanǝm gana gǝni, dalilnjudǝ curonǝmlaman mai culuwi, mai duwon jamani Israyilayea cunodidǝ.».
normalised_text: "ni baitalami chidi yahudaye, churo belawa yahudayeden darajanem gana geni, dalilnjude churonemlaman mai chuluwi, mai duwon jamani israyilayea chunodide.".

name: Manga Kanuri
text: Daji Mai Hirudus asǝrlan ilmuwudǝa bowoje sa sillowudǝ tayiro fǝledǝgǝnadǝa cuwore tabbatkeyeranniya.
normalised_text: daji mai hirudus aserlan ilmuwudea bowoje sa sillowude tayiro feledegenadea chuwore tabbatkeyeranniya.

name: Mango
text: Kɔr ginka Jeju Kristɨ kɨ́ ngonka Dabidɨ, kɨ́ ngonka Abrakam ə́n:.
normalised_text: kor ginka jeju kristy ky ngonka dabidy, ky ngonka abrakam en.

name: Mango
text: Abrakam ojɨ Isakɨ; Isakɨ ojɨ Jakobɨ; Jakobɨ ojɨ Juda kɨ̀ ngankɔ̰-é-je;.
normalised_text: abrakam ojy isaky; isaky ojy jakoby; jakoby ojy juda ky ngankoneje;.

name: Mango
text: Juda dḛ kɨ̀ Tamar dꞌojɨ Parɛsɨ, kɨ̀ Jera; Parɛsɨ ojɨ Esrɔm; Esrɔm ojɨ Aram;.
normalised_text: juda den ky tamar dojy paresy, ky jera; paresy ojy esrom; esrom ojy aram;.

name: Mango
text: Aram ojɨ Aminadabɨ; Aminadabɨ ojɨ Nasɔ̰; Nasɔ̰ ojɨ Salmɔ̰;.
normalised_text: aram ojy aminadaby; aminadaby ojy nason; nason ojy salmon;.

name: Mango
text: Salmɔ̰ dḛ kɨ̀ Rakabɨ dꞌojɨ Bowajɨ; Bowajɨ dḛ kɨ̀ Rutɨ dꞌojɨ Obɛdɨ; Obɛdɨ ojɨ Jese;.
normalised_text: salmon den ky rakaby dojy bowajy; bowajy den ky ruty dojy obedy; obedy ojy jese;.

name: Mango
text: Jese ojɨ ngar Dabidɨ; Dabidɨ taa ne Uri ojɨ-né Salomɔ̰;.
normalised_text: jese ojy ngar dabidy; dabidy taa ne uri ojyne salomon;.

name: Mango
text: Salomɔ̰ ojɨ Robowam; Robowam ojɨ Abiya; Abiya ojɨ Aja;.
normalised_text: salomon ojy robowam; robowam ojy abiya; abiya ojy aja;.

name: Mango
text: Aja ojɨ Jojapatɨ; Jojapatɨ ojɨ Joram; Joram ojɨ Ojiyasɨ;.
normalised_text: aja ojy jojapaty; jojapaty ojy joram; joram ojy ojiyasy;.

name: Mango
text: Ojiyasɨ ojɨ Jowatam; Jowatam ojɨ Akajɨ; Akajɨ ojɨ Ejekiyasɨ;.
normalised_text: ojiyasy ojy jowatam; jowatam ojy akajy; akajy ojy ejekiyasy;.

name: Mango
text: Ejekiyasɨ ojɨ Manasɨ; Manasɨ ojɨ Amɔ̰; Amɔ̰ ojɨ Jojiyasɨ;.
normalised_text: ejekiyasy ojy manasy; manasy ojy amon; amon ojy jojiyasy;.

name: Mango
text: Jojiyasɨ ojɨ Jekoniyasɨ kɨ̀ ngankɔ̰-é-je. Dɔgangɨ ɓal-é-je-tɨ kin ə́ dꞌuwə-né dow-je kɨ́ Jorijalḛm dꞌɔw sə-dé ɓə Babilɔ̰n-tɨ.
normalised_text: jojiyasy ojy jekoniyasy ky ngankoneje. dogangy balejety kin e duwene dowje ky jorijalenm dow sede be babilonnty.

name: Mango
text: Lokɨ dꞌɔw sə-dé Babilɔ̰n-tɨ lé, Jekoniyasɨ ojɨ Salatiyɛl, Salatiyɛl ojɨ Jorobabɛl.
normalised_text: loky dow sede babilonnty le, jekoniyasy ojy salatiyel, salatiyel ojy jorobabel.

name: Mango
text: Jorobabɛl ojɨ Abiyudɨ, Abiyudɨ ojɨ Eliyakim, Eliyakim ojɨ Ajɔr.
normalised_text: jorobabel ojy abiyudy, abiyudy ojy eliyakim, eliyakim ojy ajor.

name: Mango

normalised_text: ajor ojy sadoky, sadoky ojy akim, akim ojy eliyudy.

name: Mango
text: Eliyudɨ ojɨ Eleyajar, Eleyajar ojɨ Mata̰, Mata̰ ojɨ Jakobɨ.
normalised_text: eliyudy ojy eleyajar, eleyajar ojy matan, matan ojy jakoby.

name: Mango
text: Jakobɨ ojɨ Jojepɨ kɨ́ ngɔw Mari. Rəmə Mari ojɨ Jeju kɨ́ ꞌɓa-é Kristɨ .
normalised_text: jakoby ojy jojepy ky ngow mari. reme mari ojy jeju ky bae kristy.

name: Mango
text: Ḛ à kojɨ ngon kɨ́ dingəm ə ꞌa kində ri-é lə Jeju, kdɔ ḛ ɓá à to dow kɨ́ à kajɨ dow-je liə mḛḛ majal-je-tɨ lə-dé.
normalised_text: en a kojy ngon ky dingem e a kinde rie le jeju, kdo en ba a to dow ky a kajy dowje lie menen majaljety lede.

name: Mango
text: Né-je kin lay ra-né bè kdɔ kadɨ ta kɨ́ ꞌƁaɓe adɨ njèpata kɨ́ ta-é-tɨ pa kete lé né-é ra né.
normalised_text: neje kin lay rane be kdo kady ta ky babe ady njepata ky taety pa kete le nee ra ne.

name: Mango
text: Lokɨ Jojepɨ ḭ dɔ ɓi-tɨ lé, ra titɨ kɨ́ malayka lə ꞌƁaɓe idə-é-né lé, adɨ ḛ taa Mari lé.
normalised_text: loky jojepy in do bity le, ra tity ky malayka le babe ideene le, ady en taa mari le.

name: Mango
text: Dḛ ꞌgə-na̰ dené kɨ̀ dingəm al ya sar Mari ojɨ-né ngon kɨ́ dingəm, adɨ Jojepɨ ində ri-é lə Jeju.
normalised_text: den genan dene ky dingem al ya sar mari ojyne ngon ky dingem, ady jojepy inde rie le jeju.

name: Mango
text: ꞌdəjɨ ꞌpanè: «Ngar lə jipɨ-je kɨ́ dꞌojɨ-é lé tò rá wa? Jꞌoo kərwəḭ liə lo kubə kàdɨ̀-tɨ ɓá jꞌree kdɔ kɔsɨ dɔ-ji nangɨ nɔ̰̀-é-tɨ.».
normalised_text: dejy pane "ngar le jipyje ky dojye le to ra wa? joo kerwein lie lo kube kadyty ba jree kdo kosy doji nangy noety.".

name: Mango
text: Lokɨ ngar Erodɨ oo ta kin bè lé, mḛḛ-é gangɨ man rəm, ɓá dow-je kɨ́ Jorijalḛm lay ya mḛḛ-dé gangɨ man siə rəm tɔ.
normalised_text: loky ngar erody oo ta kin be le, menene gangy man rem, ba dowje ky jorijalenm lay ya menende gangy man sie rem to.

name: Mango
text: Beɓa ḛ ɓa njékun dɔ njégugné-je lə Lubə, kɨ̀ njéndó dow-je ndukun-je dəjɨ-dé se lo kɨ́ rá ɓá dꞌa kojɨ Kristɨ lé titɨ wa?.
normalised_text: beba en ba njekun do njegugneje le lube, ky njendo dowje ndukunje dejyde se lo ky ra ba da kojy kristy le tity wa?.

name: Mango
text: Dḛ dꞌidə-é ꞌpanè: «Dꞌa kojɨ-é Bɛtlekɛm, dɔnangɨ Jude-tɨ, kdɔ ta kɨ́ njèpata kɨ́ ta Lubə-tɨ pa ə́n:.
normalised_text: den didee pane "da kojye betlekem, donangy judety, kdo ta ky njepata ky ta lubety pa en.

name: Mango
text: Beɓa Erodɨ ɓa njénégə-je kɨ́ dɔ kərwəḭ-je-tɨ gidɨ ngə̰y, dəjɨ-dé se dɔkaglo kɨ́ rá-tɨ ya bangɨ ə́ kərwəḭ lé tḛḛ-né wa?.
normalised_text: beba erody ba njenegeje ky do kerweinjety gidy ngeny, dejyde se dokaglo ky raty ya bangy e kerwein le tenenne wa?.

name: Mango
text: Lokɨ dꞌoo kərwəḭ a̰ nangɨ lé, rɔ-dé nəl-dé n̰a̰.
normalised_text: loky doo kerwein an nangy le, rode nelde nan.

name: Mango
text: Go-tɨ, Lubə idə-dé mḛḛ nḭ-tɨ kadɨ ꞌtəl kɨ̀ rəbɨ kɨ́ dɔ Erodɨ-tɨ gogɨ al ngá. Beɓa dḛ ꞌtəl dꞌɔw ɓe lə-dé kɨ̀ rəbɨ kɨ́ rangɨ.
normalised_text: goty, lube idede menen ninty kady tel ky reby ky do erodyty gogy al nga. beba den tel dow be lede ky reby ky rangy.

name: Mango
text: Beɓa Jojepɨ ḭ taá ndɔɔ nɔ̰ɔ̰ ya, un ngon kɨ́ bər kɨ̀ kɔ̰-é ɔw sə-dé Ejiptɨ.
normalised_text: beba jojepy in tea ndoo nonon ya, un ngon ky ber ky kone ow sede ejipty.

name: Mango
text: Beɓa ta kɨ́ Jeremi kɨ́ njèpata kɨ́ ta Lubə-tɨ pa lé né-é ra né. Ḛ panè:.
normalised_text: beba ta ky jeremi ky njepata ky ta lubety pa le nee ra ne. en pane.

name: Mango
text: «Sukùkú, kɨ̀ ndi nɔ̰-je, kɨ̀ ɓaata-je ɓa gitɨ-gitɨ mḛḛ ɓe-tɨ kɨ́ Rama̰, Rasəl nɔ̰ kdɔtalə ngan-é, ḛ ndigɨ kadɨ dow gɔr-é al, Kdɔtalə dꞌoy lay.».
normalised_text: "sukuku, ky ndi nonje, ky baataje ba gitygity menen bety ky raman, rasel non kdotale ngane, en ndigy kady dow gore al, kdotale doy lay.".

name: Mano
text: Zízɛ̀ Kɛ́lɛ̀ì, lɛ́ e kɛ Dèɓé sùu‐là‐mì ká, ɛ̃́ɛ̃́ lɛ́ Dèɓé bɛ̃̀ɛ̃ e kɛ Éɓɔ́lɔ́hã́ã̀ sùu‐là‐mì káa, ye‐gã̀ mɔ́ɔ̀ kii lɛ́ e kéa.
normalised_text: zize kelei, le e ke debe soulami ka, ee le debe been e ke ebolohea soulami kea, yega muo kii le e kea.

name: Mano
text: Éɓɔ́lɔ́hã́ã̀ e kɛ Áázè dàa ká. Áázè bɛ̃̀ɛ̃ e kɛ Zékɔ̀ dàa ká. Zékɔ̀ bɛ̃̀ɛ̃ e kɛ Zúdà wà e lèe‐gé vɔ̀ o dàa ká.
normalised_text: ebolohea e ke aaze dea ka. aaze been e ke zeko dea ka. zeko been e ke zuda wa e liege vo o dea ka.

name: Mano
text: Zúdà bɛ̃̀ɛ̃ e kɛ Pílì wà Zílà o dàa ká. O lòóò lɛ́ e kɛ Tímà káa. Pílì e kília bɛ̃̀ɛ̃ e kɛ Hɛ́zɔ̃̀ dàa ká. Hɛ́zɔ̃̀ bɛ̃̀ɛ̃ e kɛ Wáláũ̀ dàa ká.
normalised_text: zuda been e ke pili wa zila o dea ka. o luoo le e ke tima kea. pili e kilia been e ke hezo dea ka. hezo been e ke walau dea ka.

name: Mano
text: Wáláũ̀ bɛ̃̀ɛ̃ e kɛ Àmínídà dàa ká. Àmínídà bɛ̃̀ɛ̃ e kɛ Násɔ̃̀ dàa ká. Násɔ̃̀ bɛ̃̀ɛ̃ e kɛ Sámà dàa ká.
normalised_text: walau been e ke aminida dea ka. aminida been e ke naso dea ka. naso been e ke sama dea ka.

name: Mano
text: Sámà e kɛ Bóà dàa ká. À lòóò lɛ́ e kɛ Wéléháà káa. Bóà bɛ̃̀ɛ̃ e kɛ Óbɛ̀ dàa ká. À lòóò lɛ́ e kɛ Wúlúfè káa. Óbɛ̀ e kília e kɛ Zɛ́sè dàa ká.
normalised_text: sama e ke boa dea ka. a luoo le e ke welehea kea. boa been e ke obe dea ka. a luoo le e ke wulufe kea. obe e kilia e ke zese dea ka.

name: Mano
text: Zɛ́sè e kɛ Dèɓé lɛ́ e kɛ sɛ́lɛ́ líé‐sí‐mì gbùò káa dàa ká. Dèɓé e kɛ Sɔ́lómɔ̀ dàa ká. À lòóò aà kɛ do Yùláyà na ká.
normalised_text: zese e ke debe le e ke sele liesimi gbuo kea dea ka. debe e ke solomo dea ka. a luoo ea ke do yulaya na ka.

name: Mano
text: Sɔ́lómɔ̀ e kɛ Liòbóà dàa ká. Liòbóà bɛ̃̀ɛ̃ e kɛ Àbáyà dàa ká. Àbáyà e kília bɛ̃̀ɛ̃ e kɛ Ésà dàa ká.
normalised_text: solomo e ke lioboa dea ka. lioboa been e ke abaya dea ka. abaya e kilia been e ke esa dea ka.

name: Mano
text: Ésà bɛ̃̀ɛ̃ e kɛ Zìɔ́séfà dàa ká. Zìɔ́séfà bɛ̃̀ɛ̃ e kɛ Zɔ́lɔ̀ũ̀ dàa ká. Zɔ́lɔ̀ũ̀ e kília bɛ̃̀ɛ̃ e kɛ Yùzáyà dàa ká.
normalised_text: esa been e ke ziosefa dea ka. ziosefa been e ke zolou dea ka. zolou e kilia been e ke yuzaya dea ka.

name: Mano
text: Yùzáyà bɛ̃̀ɛ̃ e kɛ Zótɔ̃̀ dàa ká. Zótɔ̃̀ bɛ̃̀ɛ̃ e kɛ Éháà dàa ká. Éháà bɛ̃̀ɛ̃ e kɛ Hɛzèkáyà dàa ká.
normalised_text: yuzaya been e ke zoto dea ka. zoto been e ke ehea dea ka. ehea been e ke hezekaya dea ka.

name: Mano
text: Hɛzèkáyà e kɛ Mànásè dàa ká. Mànásè bɛ̃̀ɛ̃ e kɛ Émɔ̀ dàa ká. Émɔ̀ bɛ̃̀ɛ̃ e kɛ Zòsáyà dàa ká.
normalised_text: hezekaya e ke manase dea ka. manase been e ke emo dea ka. emo been e ke zosaya dea ka.

name: Mano
text: Zòsáyà bɛ̃̀ɛ̃ e kɛ Zɛkònáyà wà e lèe‐gé nì o dàa ká, lɛ̀ lɛ́ o Éézɛ̀lɛ̀‐mìà sí, wáà lò o ká Bábɛ́lɔ́ũ̀a ká.
normalised_text: zosaya been e ke zekonaya wa e liege ni o dea ka, le le o eezelemia si, wea lo o ka babeloua ka.

name: Mano
text: Lɛ̀ lɛ́ o ló míáa ká Bábɛ́lɔ́ũ̀a, Zɛkònáyà e Sìátíà ye gbaa. Sìátíà bɛ̃̀ɛ̃ e kɛ Zàlábábò dàa ká.
normalised_text: le le o lo miea ka babeloua, zekonaya e siatia ye gbaa. siatia been e ke zalababo dea ka.

name: Mano
text: Zàlábábò bɛ̃̀ɛ̃ e kɛ Ábíyà dàa ká. Ábíyà bɛ̃̀ɛ̃ e kɛ Ìláyákɛ̀ dàa ká. Ìláyákɛ̀ bɛ̃̀ɛ̃ e kɛ Ézɔ̀ dàa ká.

normalised_text: nagata ay mi liyn ma wingnga, va may kadi. jufunda ay kuloo kay liyn ma zulla, ngusta vi lawna ka ged kuloo kay niyna.

name: Masana
text: Lawna wi ala haraŋa nam va ma ŋaa'a. Bugol kayni nam mun jar haraŋa goy hiɗi jufunda.
normalised_text: lawna wi ala haranga nam va ma ngaaa. bugol kayni nam mun jar haranga goy hidi jufunda.

name: Masana
text: Lawn di'e: Hin liyn ma wiŋŋa kal jar niyna, kay nam ma ɓuraw jar niyn goyo.
normalised_text: lawn die hin liyn ma wingnga kal jar niyna, kay nam ma buraw jar niyn goyo.

name: Masana
text: Lawn li liyn ma wiŋŋa, nam ɓuraw jar niyna ma ka gaa kuɗ liyn ma wiŋŋa hiɗi niyn ma ka kulo kalamna. Van kayni li nala may.
normalised_text: lawn li liyn ma wingnga, nam buraw jar niyna ma ka gaa kud liyn ma wingnga hidi niyn ma ka kulo kalamna. van kayni li nala may.

name: Masana
text: Liyn ma wiŋŋa Lawn tunum selem ala dukalawna. Ki kayn nala vulatita li'e, grawta li'e, buurta ma'ta laawa.
normalised_text: liyn ma wingnga lawn tunum selem ala dukalawna. ki kayn nala vulatita lie, grawta lie, buurta mata laawa.

name: Masana
text: Lawn di'e: niyna ma gaa kuɗ dukalawna ma tap hay liyn kepe, kay yam liyn ma so goyo. Van kayni li nala may.
normalised_text: lawn die niyna ma gaa kud dukalawna ma tap hay liyn kepe, kay yam liyn ma so goyo. van kayni li nala may.

name: Masana
text: Liyn ma soy goyna Lawn tunum selem ala nagata, niyn ma tapayna nam tunum selem ala niy-lum ma ŋolla may. Lawna wi ala van kayni nam ŋaa'a.
normalised_text: liyn ma soy goyna lawn tunum selem ala nagata, niyn ma tapayna nam tunum selem ala niylum ma ngolla may. lawna wi ala van kayni nam ngaaa.

name: Masana
text: Ki kayn nala vulatita li'e grawta li'e, buurta ɦidita laawa.
normalised_text: ki kayn nala vulatita lie grawta lie, buurta hidita laawa.

name: Masana
text: nam ma lin mi sle ma vul haraŋa kulo hay liyn ma wiŋŋa hay dukalawna, kay fo yam nagat goy haraŋi. Van kayni li nala may.
normalised_text: nam ma lin mi sle ma vul haranga kulo hay liyn ma wingnga hay dukalawna, kay fo yam nagat goy harangi. van kayni li nala may.

name: Masana
text: Lawna li slen ma ŋulona ma vul haraŋa ma' ma ŋol suwna kay mus mul kay falayta, ma ir goora kay mus mul kay henjeta; nam kot mislekŋa kaw.
normalised_text: lawna li slen ma ngulona ma vul haranga ma ma ngol suwna kay mus mul kay falayta, ma ir goora kay mus mul kay henjeta; nam kot misleknga kaw.

name: Masana
text: Nam lakam kulo'o hay liyn ma wiŋŋa jar dukalawna kay li haraŋ kay nagata.
normalised_text: nam lakam kuloo hay liyn ma wingnga jar dukalawna kay li harang kay nagata.

name: Masana
text: kay lak mul kay falayta hiɗi henjeta, kay ɓuraw jar jufunda hiɗi haraŋa. Lawna wi ala kayni mi va ma ŋaa'a.
normalised_text: kay lak mul kay falayta hidi henjeta, kay buraw jar jufunda hidi haranga. lawna wi ala kayni mi va ma ngaaa.

name: Masana
text: Ki kayn nala vulatita li'e, grawta li'e, buurta fiɗita laawa.
normalised_text: ki kayn nala vulatita lie, grawta lie, buurta fidita laawa.

name: Masana
text: Lawna di'e: Hin muuriyan ma sukka hayamna biya ŋolo hay niyna, layayn kaw fok kulo kay nagata hay liyn ma wiŋŋa jar dukalawna.
normalised_text: lawna die hin muuriyan ma sukka hayamna biya ngolo hay niyna, layayn kaw fok kulo kay nagata hay liyn ma wingnga jar dukalawna.

name: Masana
text: Lawn gum bolo di'e: Biyaŋ ŋol tiksilik', laŋ ŋolo, hobaŋ niy-lum ma ŋolla, layayn kaw biya gaa kay nagat ŋol lay.
normalised_text: lawn gum bolo die biyang ngol tiksilik, lang ngolo, hobang niylum ma ngolla, layayn kaw biya gaa kay nagat ngol lay.

name: Masana
text: Ki kayn nala vulatita li'e, grawta li'e, buurta vaslta laawa.
normalised_text: ki kayn nala vulatita lie, grawta lie, buurta vaslta laawa.

name: Masana
text: Lawna li muuriyan ma gaa kay nagatna kuɗ jafamu jafamu, farayn kuɗ jafamu jafamu, muur ma harmatna kuɗ jafamu jafamu. Lawna wi kayni nam ŋaa ŋolo.
normalised_text: lawna li muuriyan ma gaa kay nagatna kud jafamu jafamu, farayn kud jafamu jafamu, muur ma harmatna kud jafamu jafamu. lawna wi kayni nam ngaa ngolo.

name: Masana
text: Lawna in sana ki nir tuwam nala, san slum nam Lawn nala. Nam insiya jufna hiɗi cata.
normalised_text: lawna in sana ki nir tuwam nala, san slum nam lawn nala. nam insiya jufna hidi chata.

name: Masana
text: Lawna ɗuw sle ma nam lumna kaf, sle namna ay ŋaa'a ŋolo. Ki kayn nala vulatita li'e, grawta li'e, buurta karkiyata laawa.
normalised_text: lawna duw sle ma nam lumna kaf, sle namna ay ngaaa ngolo. ki kayn nala vulatita lie, grawta lie, buurta karkiyata laawa.

name: Masana
text: Ki kayn nala Lawna vat inda vi wuralawna hiɗi nagata hiɗi vokŋa valam kafe.
normalised_text: ki kayn nala lawna vat inda vi wuralawna hidi nagata hidi voknga valam kafe.

name: Masana
text: Hay buurta siɗiyata Lawna vat vun lopna valam ma nam lum kafna, hay buurta siɗiyata nam tun sukamu kay lopna valam ma nam lum kafna.
normalised_text: hay buurta sidiyata lawna vat vun lopna valam ma nam lum kafna, hay buurta sidiyata nam tun sukamu kay lopna valam ma nam lum kafna.

name: Masana
text: Nam gi bol kay buurta siɗiyata, nam la' goy peldete, kay hay buur na'ta nam tun sukamu kay lopna valam ma nam lumna kaf.
normalised_text: nam gi bol kay buurta sidiyata, nam la goy peldete, kay hay buur nata nam tun sukamu kay lopna valam ma nam lumna kaf.

name: Masana
text: Kayni mi labara vi tun-cawta vi dukalawna hiɗi nagata. Hay li ma Lawna Ma-Vatɗina li nagata hiɗi wuralawn kayni.
normalised_text: kayni mi labara vi tunchawta vi dukalawna hidi nagata. hay li ma lawna mavatdina li nagata hidi wuralawn kayni.

name: Masana
text: May ɗugulla kalay goy hay nagat pa, nam muɗ yam nagat pet lomgo'o.
normalised_text: may dugulla kalay goy hay nagat pa, nam mud yam nagat pet lomgoo.

name: Masana
text: Lawna Ma-Vatɗina in sana hiɗi buɗufna nagata, nam fo sukŋa vi irita hay cinamu, san muɗi goy ciwta irita.
normalised_text: lawna mavatdina in sana hidi budufna nagata, nam fo suknga vi irita hay chinamu, san mudi goy chiwta irita.

name: Masana
text: Bugolda Lawn Ma-Vatɗina kot sinen Edena, hay gal ma kuɗuwna, san ma nam inimna nam musum hayamu.
normalised_text: bugolda lawn mavatdina kot sinen edena, hay gal ma kuduwna, san ma nam inimna nam musum hayamu.

name: Masana
text: Niy-lumna kalay goy hay Edena pa, jaŋ gaa kuɗ guna, goy ɗawni nam ɓuraw iram goy ir fiɗi'.
normalised_text: niylumna kalay goy hay edena pa, jang gaa kud guna, goy dawni nam buraw iram goy ir fidi.

name: Masana
text: Niy-lum ma jewna yum Pison, namu mi ma ka ŋuy nagata vi Havila noŋ kafe, or ka hay liy namna.
normalised_text: niylum ma jewna yum pison, namu mi ma ka nguy nagata vi havila nong kafe, or ka hay liy namna.

name: Masana
text: Or ma hay naga na'ta nam voy goy haɓ siyok', bideliyum ka haya, hiɗiyn oniks. ka haya kaw.
normalised_text: or ma hay naga nata nam voy goy hab siyok, bideliyum ka haya, hidiyn oniks. ka haya kaw.

name: Mashi
text: Ou po odiyo mundandwe o mathzina o dihumo dya Yesu Krisitu ku tunderera kwa Davida, o mu mukuta wa Aburahama.
normalised_text: ou po odiyo mundandwe o madzina o dihumo dya yesu krisitu ku tunderera kwa davida, o mu mukuta wa aburahama.

name: Mashi
text: Aburahama yo tata wa Isaka, Isaka yo tata wa Jakovo, Jakovo yo tata wa Juda nakurwenthzi naminenthzi.
normalised_text: aburahama yo tata wa isaka, isaka yo tata wa jakovo, jakovo yo tata wa juda nakurwendzi naminendzi.

name: Mashi
text: Juda yo tata wa Paresi na Zera, mama wo po Tamare, Paresi yo tata wa Hesiromi, Hesiromi yo tata wa Rama.
normalised_text: juda yo tata wa paresi na zera, mama wo po tamare, paresi yo tata wa hesiromi, hesiromi yo tata wa rama.

name: Mashi
text: Rama yo tata wa Aminadabi, Aminadabi yo tata wa Nashoni, Nashoni yo tata wa Salimoni.
normalised_text: rama yo tata wa aminadabi, aminadabi yo tata wa nashoni, nashoni yo tata wa salimoni.

name: Mashi
text: Salimoni yo tata wa Boazi, mama wenthzi po nedi Rahaba, Boazi yo tata wa Obedi, mama wenthzi po nedi Ruti, Obedi yo tata wa Jese.
normalised_text: salimoni yo tata wa boazi, mama wendzi po nedi rahaba, boazi yo tata wa obedi, mama wendzi po nedi ruti, obedi yo tata wa jese.

name: Mashi
text: Jese yo tata wa Fumu Davida. Davida yo tata wa Solomoni, mama wenthzi po nedi munu wa Uria.
normalised_text: jese yo tata wa fumu davida. davida yo tata wa solomoni, mama wendzi po nedi munu wa uria.

name: Mashi
text: Solomoni yo tata wa Rehoboami, Rehoboami yo tata wa Abiya, Abiya yo tata wa Asa.
normalised_text: solomoni yo tata wa rehoboami, rehoboami yo tata wa abiya, abiya yo tata wa asa.

name: Mashi
text: Asa yo tata wa Jehoshafati, Jehoshafati yo tata wa Jorami, Jorami yo tata wa Uziya.
normalised_text: asa yo tata wa jehoshafati, jehoshafati yo tata wa jorami, jorami yo tata wa uziya.

name: Mashi
text: Uziya yo tata wa Jotami, Jotami yo tata wa Ahazi, Ahazi yo tata wa Hezekia.
normalised_text: uziya yo tata wa jotami, jotami yo tata wa ahazi, ahazi yo tata wa hezekia.

name: Mashi
text: Hezekia yo tata wa Manase, Manase yo tata wa Amoni, Amoni yo tata wa Josaya.
normalised_text: hezekia yo tata wa manase, manase yo tata wa amoni, amoni yo tata wa josaya.

name: Mashi
text: Josaya yo tata wa Jekonia naminenthzi mu thsikati ethsi a twariwire kupika ku Babilona.
normalised_text: josaya yo tata wa jekonia naminendzi mu tsikati etsi a twariwire kupika ku babilona.

name: Mashi
text: Munyima thzo ku twariwa kupika ku Babilona: Jekonia wa kerekire Salatiele, Salatiele yo tata wa Zerubabele.
normalised_text: munyima dzo ku twariwa kupika ku babilona jekonia wa kerekire salatiele, salatiele yo tata wa zerubabele.

name: Mashi
text: Zerubabele yo tata wa Abiudi, Abiudi yo tata wa Eliakimi, Eliakimi yo tata wa Azori.
normalised_text: zerubabele yo tata wa abiudi, abiudi yo tata wa eliakimi, eliakimi yo tata wa azori.

name: Mashi
text: Azori yo tata wa Sadoki, Sadoki yo tata wa Akimi, Akimi yo tata wa Eliudi.
normalised_text: azori yo tata wa sadoki, sadoki yo tata wa akimi, akimi yo tata wa eliudi.

name: Mashi
text: Eliudi yo tata wa Eliazare, Eliazare yo tata wa Matani, Matani yo tata wa Jakovo.
normalised_text: eliudi yo tata wa eliazare, eliazare yo tata wa matani, matani yo tata wa jakovo.

name: Mashi
text: Jakovo yo tata wa Josefa munu wa Madiya, mama wa Yesu oyu nethsiwa ci Mesiya.
normalised_text: jakovo yo tata wa josefa munu wa madiya, mama wa yesu oyu netsiwa chi mesiya.

name: Mashi
text: Kenge a kwereka mukwerumeana, wangu wa ku mute dithzina dyo Yesu, inene kenge a ku yoyithsa anuenthzi kwivi yo.
normalised_text: kenge a kwereka mukwerumeana, wangu wa ku mute didzina dyo yesu, inene kenge a ku yoyitsa anuendzi kwivi yo.

name: Mashi
text: Eyi yoihe shime ya tendaharire ci i citombore neyi a ambire Fumu ka mukwakukethza ci:.
normalised_text: eyi yoihe shime ya tendaharire chi i chitombore neyi a ambire fumu ka mukwakukedza chi.

name: Mashi
text: Diungu kenge mba a thza poremu no kwereka mwana o mukwerumeana, kenge mba mwithsa ci Imanuele, ku amba ci Nyambi netu a di.
normalised_text: diungu kenge mba a dza poremu no kwereka mwana o mukwerumeana, kenge mba mwitsa chi imanuele, ku amba chi nyambi netu a di.

name: Mashi
text: Josefa ou a pindukire, wa tendire eyi ka mu raererire kangeru ka Fumu. Wa shimbire Madiya kwikara munuwenthzi.
normalised_text: josefa ou a pindukire, wa tendire eyi ka mu raererire kangeru ka fumu. wa shimbire madiya kwikara munuwendzi.

name: Mashi
text: Uno honi ka a rarire nenthzi shime ku ka kuma pa kwerekiwa kwa mwanenthzi. Josefa wa mu tire dithzina dyo Yesu.
normalised_text: uno honi ka a rarire nendzi shime ku ka kuma pa kwerekiwa kwa mwanendzi. josefa wa mu tire didzina dyo yesu.

name: Mashi
text: Fumu Heroda ou a i yuvire wa karuperire nene, mofoci kengeyo nanu wahe o mu Yerusalema.
normalised_text: fumu heroda ou a i yuvire wa karuperire nene, mofochi kengeyo nanu wahe o mu yerusalema.

name: Mashi
text: Wa wanekire akuru o mapurisita wahe narongithsi o murao no kwipura ci: Oyu Mesiya ne kupi a na roera kwerekiwera.
normalised_text: wa wanekire akuru o mapurisita wahe narongitsi o murao no kwipura chi oyu mesiya ne kupi a na roera kwerekiwera.

name: Mashi
text: A mu tawire ci: Mu Betelehema mbongi thzo mu ditunga dya Judea. Inene eyi a ñorire mukwakukethza po eyi:.
normalised_text: a mu tawire chi mu betelehema mbongi dzo mu ditunga dya judea. inene eyi a nyorire mukwakukedza po eyi.

name: Mashi
text: Heroda ngou ethserire ku mukunda awo akwerume owanyanyami no ku wepwerikethza thsikati shemwa ethsi dya monaharire edyo ditungwethzi.
normalised_text: heroda ngou etserire ku mukunda awo akwerume owanyanyami no ku wepwerikedza tsikati shemwa etsi dya monaharire edyo ditungwedzi.

name: Mashi
text: A nyanyukire nene shemwa ou a monine edyo ditungwethzi.
normalised_text: a nyanyukire nene shemwa ou a monine edyo ditungwedzi.

name: Mashi
text: Pakuninga ci Nyambi wa wa nomenithsire ku turo ci a ku huka kwa Heroda, a hukire ku ditunga dyo ko dikuñwa dyadyo.
normalised_text: pakuninga chi nyambi wa wa nomenitsire ku turo chi a ku huka kwa heroda, a hukire ku ditunga dyo ko dikunywa dyadyo.

name: Mashi
text: Oo othsiku Josefa wa pindukire no ku shimba mwanuke na mama wenthzi ku thza ku Egepita.
normalised_text: oo otsiku josefa wa pindukire no ku shimba mwanuke na mama wendzi ku dza ku egepita.

name: Mashi
text: Mweyo, eyi a tendire Heroda ya citomborire neyi a ambire mukwakukethza Jeremia ci:.
normalised_text: mweyo, eyi a tendire heroda ya chitomborire neyi a ambire mukwakukedza jeremia chi.

name: Mashi
text: Heroda ou a fire, kangeru ka Fumu ka hokokire kwa Josefa ku turo mu Egepita.
normalised_text: heroda ou a fire, kangeru ka fumu ka hokokire kwa josefa ku turo mu egepita.

name: Matal
text: Aganay sləm aŋa azla­baba madzi­dziga aŋa Yesu Kristu, bəzi aŋa David, bəzi aŋa Abəraham.
normalised_text: aganay hlem anga adlababa madzidziga anga yesu kristu, bezi anga david, bezi anga aberaham.

name: Matal
text: Abəraham ayyà Isak; Isak ayyà Yakuba; Yakuba ayyà Yahuda la azla­deda aŋha;.
normalised_text: aberaham ayya isak; isak ayya yakuba; yakuba ayya yahuda la adladeda angha;.

name: Matal
text: Yahuda ayyà Farəs atà la Zara, ; Farəs ayyà Esərom; Esərom ayyà Aram;.
normalised_text: yahuda ayya fares ata la zara,; fares ayya eserom; eserom ayya aram;.

name: Matal
text: Aram ayyà Ami­nadab; Ami­nadab ayyà Naheson; Naheson ayyà Salmon;.
normalised_text: aram ayya aminadab; aminadab ayya naheson; naheson ayya salmon;.

name: Matal
text: Salmon ayyà Bowas, ; Bowas ayyà Obed, ; Obed ayyà Isay;.
normalised_text: salmon ayya bowas,; bowas ayya obed,; obed ayya isay;.

name: Matal
text: Isay ayyà sufəl David. David ayyà Salomon, ;.
normalised_text: isay ayya sufel david. david ayya salomon,;.

name: Matal
text: Salomon ayyà Re­ha­beham; Re­ha­beham ayyà Abiya; Abiya ayyà Asa;.
normalised_text: salomon ayya rehabeham; rehabeham ayya abiya; abiya ayya asa;.

name: Matal
text: Asa ayyà Yosafat; Yosafat ayyà Yoram; Yoram ayyà Ozəya;.
normalised_text: asa ayya yosafat; yosafat ayya yoram; yoram ayya ozeya;.

name: Matal
text: Ozəya ayyà Yotam; Yotam ayyà Ahaz; Ahaz ayyà He­səkiya;.
normalised_text: ozeya ayya yotam; yotam ayya ahaz; ahaz ayya hesekiya;.

name: Matal
text: He­səkiya ayyà Manase; Manase ayyà Amon; Amon ayyà Yosəya;.
normalised_text: hesekiya ayya manase; manase ayya amon; amon ayya yoseya;.

name: Matal
text: Yosəya ayyà Ye­ko­niya atà la azla­deda aŋha, la mok uwana tahəl azlabəza Isərayel à Babila.
normalised_text: yoseya ayya yekoniya ata la adladeda angha, la mok uwana tahel adlabeza iserayel a babila.

name: Matal
text: Mok uwana tadàla atà bokuba azla­mayà à Babila kà, Ye­ko­niya ayyà Sala­tiyel; Sala­tiyel ayyà Zoro­babel;.
normalised_text: mok uwana tadala ata bokuba adlamaya a babila ka, yekoniya ayya salatiyel; salatiyel ayya zorobabel;.

name: Matal
text: Zoro­babel ayyà Abiyud; Abiyud ayyà Eli­yakim; Eli­yakim ayyà Azor;.
normalised_text: zorobabel ayya abiyud; abiyud ayya eliyakim; eliyakim ayya azor;.

name: Matal
text: Azor ayyà Sadok; Sadok ayyà Akim; Akim ayyà Eliyud;.
normalised_text: azor ayya sadok; sadok ayya akim; akim ayya eliyud;.

name: Matal
text: Eliyud ayyà Ele­yazar; Ele­yazar ayyà Matan; Matan ayyà Yakuba;.
normalised_text: eliyud ayya eleyazar; eleyazar ayya matan; matan ayya yakuba;.

name: Matal
text: Yakuba ayyà Yusufu, zil aŋa Mari­yama uwana ayyà Yesu, uwana Kristu tagoɗal.
normalised_text: yakuba ayya yusufu, zil anga mariyama uwana ayya yesu, uwana kristu tagodal.

name: Matal
text: Ama Yusufu mawɗa aŋha kà dza dziriga, asal masəla à uda la dazu­waya la huma à azladza aw, adzùgw masak à mawɗa aŋha la səbàh.
normalised_text: ama yusufu mawda angha ka dza dziriga, asal masela a uda la dazuwaya la huma a adladza aw, adzugw masak a mawda angha la sebah.

name: Matal
text: Masla adàyyi bəzi zilga, uwana kadàvàl sləm Yesu, uwana adàɓəl tsəhay aŋha la tsakana aŋatà la abà gesina.
normalised_text: mahla adayyi bezi zilga, uwana kadaval hlem yesu, uwana adabel tsehay angha la tsakana angata la aba gesina.

name: Matal
text: Tatak uwaga gesina apakà vok kà magəɗ à afik bokuba uwana Sufəl Zəzagəla apə̀h à ahàl aŋa azlaməna mapəh à atà gay à ahàl kà mapàh à azladza:.
normalised_text: tatak uwaga gesina apaka vok ka maged a afik bokuba uwana sufel zezagela apeh a ahal anga adlamena mapeh a ata gay a ahal ka mapah a adladza.

name: Matal
text: ˈDa­halay uwana asəl zil aw, adàzəɓ bəzi à huɗ, adàyyi bəzi zilga, tadàvàl sləm Ema­nuyel.ˈ.
normalised_text: dahalay uwana asel zil aw, adazeb bezi a hud, adayyi bezi zilga, tadaval hlem emanuyel..

name: Matal
text: Mok uwana Yusufu adatsən ala kà, aɗahàŋ bokuba uwana malika aŋa Sufəl Zəzagəla apə̀hal la mase­siŋay, ŋgaha azə̀ɓ Mari­yama mawɗa aŋha kà mis.
normalised_text: mok uwana yusufu adatsen ala ka, adahang bokuba uwana malika anga sufel zezagela apehal la masesingay, nggaha azeb mariyama mawda angha ka mis.

name: Matal
text: Ama Yusufu ahənà à ahəŋ la masla tsəràh à mayyi kona aŋha, uwana Yusufu avàl sləm Yesu, aw.
normalised_text: ama yusufu ahena a aheng la mahla tserah a mayyi kona angha, uwana yusufu aval hlem yesu, aw.

name: Matal
text: Kay, mok uwana sufəl Herod atsə̀n uwaga, guba akəs, gəl akàɗal à vok la azlaməna madz à ahəŋ la Uru­sa­lima gesina.
normalised_text: kay, mok uwana sufel herod atsen uwaga, guba akes, gel akadal a vok la adlamena madz a aheng la urusalima gesina.

name: Matal
text: Tagoɗal: La Be­te­lehem, la kutso Yahu­diya la abà. Kà uwana aganay azlaməna mapəh à atà gay à ahàl tatsetsèr:.

name: Mokpwe
text: Jɛ̀rzɛ̀ mɔ̀ ndi à mà hwɛ è rzàŋgò yà ama kiŋgɛ̀ Dàhwitì. Kiŋgɛ Dàhwitì nà jòjìyɛ̀ wà ama Urziya wɔ̀ ndi hwa mà ŋya Rzòlòmɔ̀nì.
