name: Mumuye
text: Ɓɔɔ Yusufu naa seepaa kaa nɛɛ hingro, a naa palɛ vuu ɓɔɔ zang nyaa shonang Kpanti Laa ɓɔɔ ka lapa kɔɔ wu ɓɛɛ kati. Shing soro ɓiɓɛ Marayamu kati.
normalised_text: boo yusufu naa seepaa kaa nee hingro, a naa pale vuu boo zang nyaa shonang kpanti laa boo ka lapa koo wu bee kati. shing soro bibe marayamu kati.

name: Mumuye
text: Yusufu ɓang bii nɛɛ Marayamu doo gbete kpang, a Marayamu naa yi jaa kaa zang varɛ, a Yusufu ɓaa nung ɓiɓɛ nɛɛ Yeesɔ.
normalised_text: yusufu bang bii nee marayamu doo gbete kpang, a marayamu naa yi jaa kaa zang vare, a yusufu baa nung bibe nee yeeso.

name: Mumuye
text: Ɓu doo ɓɔɔ Kpanti Hiridu tãa naa weɓe, yeti ɓiɓɛ lasɛ dɔɔli nɛɛ ɓɔ̀ɔ́ zang ɓɔɔ ri ka Urushalima nandon.
normalised_text: bu doo boo kpanti hiridu tana naa webe, yeti bibe lase dooli nee buo zang boo ri ka urushalima nandon.

name: Mumuye
text: A ri kɔɔ wu tɔɔ, Ka Bɛtalami ɓɔɔ ka tipi Yahudi ɓɛɛ. Zang nyaa shonang Laa bée nɔngkɔ ka tĩng tɛ̃ɛ tɛ̃ɛ. Zang nyaa shonang Laa beeyi tɔɔ.
normalised_text: a ri koo wu too, ka betalami boo ka tipi yahudi bee. zang nyaa shonang laa bie nongko ka tinng tene tene. zang nyaa shonang laa beeyi too.

name: Mumuye
text: A Hiridu ɓáa nyaa ka zang ɓɔɔ ri zili sang ɓɛɛ dang gbete, nɛɛ wu tãa diki ɓɔɔ sang nwang nyaa tĩng shɔɔnang ka bii ɓarɛ ɓɛɛ.
normalised_text: a hiridu bea nyaa ka zang boo ri zili sang bee dang gbete, nee wu tana diki boo sang nwang nyaa tinng shoonang ka bii bare bee.

name: Mumuye
text: A shong ri ka Bɛtalami, nɛɛ, Nɔɔ dita, nɔɔ daa kãa nɔng jaa keɓe tɔ̃ɔ tɔ̃ɔ. Nɔɔ nɛɛ ĩi wu tɔ, nɔɔ naa kɔɔ m, tɔɔ n daa bang wu kaa jong.
normalised_text: a shong ri ka betalami, nee, noo dita, noo daa kana nong jaa kebe tono tono. noo nee ini wu to, noo naa koo m, too n daa bang wu kaa jong.

name: Mumuye
text: a ri sɔɔ gbalang ɓɔɔgn, ri daa gãa ɓarɛ kati, ka ruu ɓɔɔ, Kpanti Laa shaarɛ ri nyaa ka yeti rɔ̃kɔnang, nɛɛ ri sɔ̀ɔ bii kpanti Hiridu takpang ɓɛɛ.
normalised_text: a ri soo gbalang boogn, ri daa gana bare kati, ka ruu boo, kpanti laa shaare ri nyaa ka yeti ronkonang, nee ri suo bii kpanti hiridu takpang bee.

name: Mumuye
text: A Yusufu seepaa tuu jaa nɛɛ niiɓɛ, nɛɛ zĩi, a daa nɔng ka tipi Masara.
normalised_text: a yusufu seepaa tuu jaa nee niibe, nee zini, a daa nong ka tipi masara.

name: Mumuye
text: Vuu keɓe nwang, ka naa vuu ɓɔɔ Irimiya zang nyaa shonang Laa kɔɔ ka tĩng tɛ̃ɛ tɛ̃ɛ ɓɛɛ. Irimiya kɔɔyi tɔɔ.
normalised_text: vuu kebe nwang, ka naa vuu boo irimiya zang nyaa shonang laa koo ka tinng tene tene bee. irimiya kooyi too.

name: Mumuye
text: Zang tãa nyavɔ ka Rama. Rahila kaa nyavɔ wujɛ ɓiɓɛ, ɓɔɔ vɔlɔ ɓɛɛ. Kasɛ nɛɛ zang bakɛ wu kpang.
normalised_text: zang tana nyavo ka rama. rahila kaa nyavo wuje bibe, boo volo bee. kase nee zang bake wu kpang.

name: Mundang
text: ka sǝr ah zyeɓ vǝr a ba, a tǝkolle. Bii no cok daŋ, so cokfuu no tǝtǝl ahe, Tǝ'yak Masǝŋ a kiŋ tǝ bii ahe.
normalised_text: ka ser ah zyeb ver a ba, a tekolle. bii no chok dang, so chokfuu no tetel ahe, teyak maseng a king te bii ahe.

name: Mundang
text: Masǝŋ kwo cokfãi ah pǝsãhe, so woŋ kǝsyil cokfãi ne cokfuu.
normalised_text: maseng kwo chokfani ah pesanhe, so wong kesyil chokfani ne chokfuu.

name: Mundang
text: Masǝŋ so ɗii cokfãi ah ne comme, ɗii cokfuu ah ne suŋni. So lil joŋni, zah'nan so joŋni, zah'nan vaŋno ah yo.
normalised_text: maseng so dii chokfani ah ne chomme, dii chokfuu ah ne sungni. so lil jongni, zahnan so jongni, zahnan vangno ah yo.

name: Mundang
text: Masǝŋ faa ka cok makol mo yea kǝsyil bii ka woŋ kǝsyil ɓǝǝra. Fan ah joŋ ta.
normalised_text: maseng faa ka chok makol mo yea kesyil bii ka wong kesyil beera. fan ah jong ta.

name: Mundang
text: Masǝŋ joŋ cok makol ka woŋ kǝsyil bii ma sǝŋ ne ma morkǝsǝŋ.
normalised_text: maseng jong chok makol ka wong kesyil bii ma seng ne ma morkeseng.

name: Mundang
text: Masǝŋ ɗii sǝŋ ne masyiibamme. So lil joŋni, zah'nan joŋni, zah'nan gwa ah yo.
normalised_text: maseng dii seng ne masyiibamme. so lil jongni, zahnan jongni, zahnan gwa ah yo.

name: Mundang
text: So Masǝŋ faa ka bii ma mor masyiibam sǝŋ mo tai cok vaŋno, ka cok yak mo pǝ̃ǝ ge lalle. Fan ah joŋ ta.
normalised_text: so maseng faa ka bii ma mor masyiibam seng mo tai chok vangno, ka chok yak mo pene ge lalle. fan ah jong ta.

name: Mundang
text: So ɗii cok yak ne sǝrri, ɗii cok mai bii mo ɓoo ɓo gŋ ne mabii. Masǝŋ ẽe fan ahe, so kwo a pǝsãhe.
normalised_text: so dii chok yak ne serri, dii chok mai bii mo boo bo gng ne mabii. maseng ene fan ahe, so kwo a pesanhe.

name: Mundang
text: Masǝŋ so faa ka sǝr mo ciŋ fãa ne ban fan ma ceciŋ mai moo leeni, tǝkine kpuu ma lee syẽm ne ban ah camcam. Fan ah joŋ ta.
normalised_text: maseng so faa ka ser mo ching fana ne ban fan ma cheching mai moo leeni, tekine kpuu ma lee syenm ne ban ah chamcham. fan ah jong ta.

name: Mundang
text: So sǝr ciŋ fãa ne ban fan ma ceciŋ mai moo leeni, tǝkine kpuu ma lee syẽm ne ban ah camcam. Masǝŋ ẽe fan ahe, so kwo a pǝsãhe.
normalised_text: so ser ching fana ne ban fan ma cheching mai moo leeni, tekine kpuu ma lee syenm ne ban ah chamcham. maseng ene fan ahe, so kwo a pesanhe.

name: Mundang
text: Masǝŋ faa ka cokfãi camcam mo joŋ tǝ masyiibam sǝŋ mor ka woŋ kǝsyil com ne suŋni, ka mo yea na fan ma cuu cokki, tǝgba faa: zah'nan tǝkine syii.
normalised_text: maseng faa ka chokfani chamcham mo jong te masyiibam seng mor ka wong kesyil com ne sungni, ka mo yea na fan ma chuu chokki, tegba faa zahnan tekine syii.

name: Mundang
text: mor ka mo sǝǝra cok ge tǝ sǝrri. Fan ah joŋ ta.
normalised_text: mor ka mo seera chok ge te serri. fan ah jong ta.

name: Mundang
text: So nǝǝ cokfãi maluu ah gwa, malii ah mor ka sǝǝ cok ne comme, malaŋ mor ka sǝǝ cok ne suŋni, so joŋ ŋwǝǝmǝŋgai ta.
normalised_text: so nee chokfani maluu ah gwa, malii ah mor ka see chok ne chomme, malang mor ka see chok ne sungni, so jong ngweemenggai ta.

name: Mundang
text: So rǝk ra tǝ masyiibam sǝŋ ka mo sǝǝ cok ge tǝ sǝrri.
normalised_text: so rek ra te masyiibam seng ka mo see chok ge te serri.

name: Mundang
text: mor ka sǝǝ cok ne com ne suŋni, ka woŋ kǝsyil cokfãi ne cokfuu. Masǝŋ ẽe fan ahe, so kwo a pǝsãhe.
normalised_text: mor ka see chok ne com ne sungni, ka wong kesyil chokfani ne chokfuu. maseng ene fan ahe, so kwo a pesanhe.

name: Mundang
text: Masǝŋ faa ka bii mo syer fan ma ne cee pǝlli, ka juu mo zoora tǝ sǝr ge sǝŋ.
normalised_text: maseng faa ka bii mo syer fan ma ne chee pelli, ka juu mo zoora te ser ge seng.

name: Mundang
text: So Masǝŋ joŋ fan maluu ma pǝ bii, ne fan ma ne cee mai bii mo syer ɓo ne ban ɓǝǝ daŋ, joŋ juu ne ban ah camcam ta. Masǝŋ ẽe fan ahe, so kwo a pǝsãhe.
normalised_text: so maseng jong fan maluu ma pe bii, ne fan ma ne chee mai bii mo syer bo ne ban bee dang, jong juu ne ban ah chamcham ta. maseng ene fan ahe, so kwo a pesanhe.

name: Mundang
text: Masǝŋ ẽe ra faa: We bemme, we ɓoo ge pelle, ka we baa mabii, ka juu laŋ mo ɓoora tǝ sǝrri.
normalised_text: maseng ene ra faa we bemme, we boo ge pelle, ka we baa mabii, ka juu lang mo boora te serri.

name: Mundang
text: Lil joŋni, zah'nan joŋni, zah'nan dappe ah yo.
normalised_text: lil jongni, zahnan jongni, zahnan dappe ah yo.

name: Mundang
text: Masǝŋ mo joŋ fan marai ne ban ah camcam daŋ, so kwo fan ah pǝsãhe.
normalised_text: maseng mo jong fan marai ne ban ah chamcham dang, so kwo fan ah pesanhe.

name: Mundang
text: So joŋ dǝfuu na ko, joŋ ko jur ne suu ahe, joŋ dǝwor ne madǝwinni.
normalised_text: so jong defuu na ko, jong ko jur ne suu ahe, jong dewor ne madewinni.

name: Mundang
text: Masǝŋ faa: Me nyi fan ma ceciŋ ah mai moo leeni, tǝkine kpuu ma lee syẽm ah daŋ ka we re.
normalised_text: maseng faa me nyi fan ma cheching ah mai moo leeni, tekine kpuu ma lee syenm ah dang ka we re.

name: Mundang
text: Me nyi fãa pǝ̃ǝ ne lee syẽm kpuu nyi nǝǝ cok tǝkine juu ka mo rera. Fan ah joŋ ta.
normalised_text: me nyi fana pene ne lee syenm kpuu nyi nee chok tekine juu ka mo rera. fan ah jong ta.

name: Mundang
text: Masǝŋ ẽe fan mai mo joŋko daŋ, so faa a pǝsãh pǝlli. Lil joŋni, zah'nan joŋni, zah'nan yea ah yo.
normalised_text: maseng ene fan mai mo jongko dang, so faa a pesanh pelli. lil jongni, zahnan jongni, zahnan yea ah yo.

name: Mundang
text: Masǝŋ joŋ sǝŋ ne sǝr tǝkine fan mo no gŋ daŋ vǝrri.
normalised_text: maseng jong seng ne ser tekine fan mo no gng dang verri.

name: Mundang
text: Zah'nan rǝŋ ah mo ge dai o, ka joŋ yeɓ ah vǝr ɓe. Tǝ zah'nan rǝŋ ah 'yak ne ko.
normalised_text: zahnan reng ah mo ge dai o, ka jong yeb ah ver be. te zahnan reng ah yak ne ko.

name: Mundang
text: Masǝŋ ẽe zah'nan rǝŋ ahe, joŋ daŋdaŋ, mor ne zah'nan ah Masǝŋ 'yak ne yeɓ mai mo joŋko daŋ.
normalised_text: maseng ene zahnan reng ahe, jong dangdang, mor ne zahnan ah maseng yak ne yeb mai mo jongko dang.

name: Mundang
text: Ɓǝ joŋ sǝŋ ne sǝr mo joŋ, a naiko. Ne cok Dǝɓlii Masǝŋ mo joŋ sǝŋ ne sǝrri.
normalised_text: be jong seng ne ser mo jong, a naiko. ne chok deblii maseng mo jong seng ne serri.

name: Mundang
text: ka kpuu kǝka wo sǝr a ba, koo fãa vaŋno laŋ ka ɓah ciŋ tǝ sǝr a, mor Masǝŋ ɓah tan bam ge tǝ sǝr a, ne cok ah ka dǝfuu ma pǝǝ sǝr laŋ kǝka ba ta.
normalised_text: ka kpuu keka wo ser a ba, koo fana vangno lang ka bah ching te ser a, mor maseng bah tan bam ge te ser a, ne chok ah ka defuu ma pee ser lang keka ba ta.

name: Mundang
text: Amma zah'nan daŋ bii pǝ̃ǝ gin mor sǝr ginni, a nǝn mahm tǝ sǝr daŋ.
normalised_text: amma zahnan dang bii pene gin mor ser ginni, a nen mahm te ser dang.

name: Mundani
text: Eyaa wu bètǎt nyaꞋ Yesò Klistò wu tà lè wu wòt ləlob Fɔ̧̀ Dàbid wu tà li ngu wòt ləlob Abàlàghâm la.
normalised_text: eyaa wu betat nya yeso klisto wu ta le wu wot lelob fo dabid wu ta li ngu wot lelob abalagham la.

name: Mundani
text: Abàlàghâm lè wu tǎt Asàk, Asàk wu tǎt Jàkɔ̂b, Jàkɔ̂b wu tǎt Judà bɔ̂ bɔnyɨ bi.
normalised_text: abalagham le wu tat asak, asak wu tat jakob, jakob wu tat juda bo bonyu bi.

name: Mundani
text: Judà lè wu tǎt Pelèz bɔ̂ Zelà, nyɨ̌ awɔb wu Tamà. Pelèz lè wu tǎt Eslɔ̀n, Eslɔ̀n wu tǎt Lam.
normalised_text: juda le wu tat peley bo yela, nyu awob wu tama. peley le wu tat eslon, eslon wu tat lam.

name: Mundani
text: Lam wu tǎt Àminadàb, Àminadàb wu tǎt Nashòn, Nashòn wu tǎt Sàlemun.
normalised_text: lam wu tat aminadab, aminadab wu tat nashon, nashon wu tat salemun.

name: Mundani
text: Sàlemun lè wu tǎt Boà wu nyɨ̌ tò lè wu Leghàb la, Boà wu tǎt Obèd wu nyɨ̌ tò le wu Luêt la. Obèd lè wu tǎt Jesì.
normalised_text: salemun le wu tat boa wu nyu to le wu leghab la, boa wu tat obed wu nyu to le wu luet la. obed le wu tat jesi.

name: Mundani
text: Jesì wu tǎt fɔ̧̀ Dàbid. Dàbid lè wu tǎt Sàlemun wu nyɨ̌ tò lè lɔ̂Ꞌ ngu vi Yulìà la.
normalised_text: jesi wu tat fo dabid. dabid le wu tat salemun wu nyu to le lo ngu wi yulia la.

name: Mundani
text: Sàlemun lè wu tǎt Lèoboàm, Lèoboàm wu tǎt Àbijà, Àbijà wu tǎt Asà.
normalised_text: salemun le wu tat leoboam, leoboam wu tat abija, abija wu tat asa.

name: Mundani
text: Asà lè wu tǎt Jèghoshafàt, Jèghoshafàt wu tǎt Jolàm, Jolàm wu tǎt Yuzìà.
normalised_text: asa le wu tat jeghoshafat, jeghoshafat wu tat jolam, jolam wu tat yuyia.

name: Mundani
text: Yuzìà wu tǎt Jotàm, Jotàm wu tǎt Aghàs, Aghàs wu tǎt Ezedìà.
normalised_text: yuyia wu tat jotam, jotam wu tat aghas, aghas wu tat eyedia.

name: Mundani
text: Ezedìà wu tǎt Mànasì, Mànasì wu tǎt Amòn, Amòn wu tǎt Jòsià.
normalised_text: eyedia wu tat manasi, manasi wu tat amon, amon wu tat josia.

name: Mundani
text: Jòsià wu tǎt Jèkonìà nè bɔnyɨ bi àfɨ̀Ꞌ yu bɔ li mbà̧aã bòt Izəèlȩê nɨŋ ngà a Babilɔ̀n la.
normalised_text: josia wu tat jekonia ne bonyu bi afu yu bo li mbeaa bot iyielie nung nga a babilon la.

name: Mundani
text: Bɔ li ngà a Babilɔ̀n ale, Jèkonìà bia Shialtièl, tà lɔ̀Ꞌ mbia Zèlubabèl.
normalised_text: bo li nga a babilon ale, jekonia bia shialtiel, ta lo mbia yelubabel.

name: Mundani
text: Zèlubabèl lɔ̀Ꞌ mbia Abùd. Abùd lè wu tǎt Èliakìm, Èliakìm wu tǎt Azɔ̀.
normalised_text: yelubabel lo mbia abud. abud le wu tat eliakim, eliakim wu tat ayo.

name: Mundani
text: Azɔ̀ wu tǎt Zadɔ̀k, Zadɔ̀k wu tǎt Achìm, Achìm wu tǎt Elùd.
normalised_text: ayo wu tat yadok, yadok wu tat achhim, achhim wu tat elud.

name: Mundani
text: Elùd lè wu tǎt Èlèazà, Èlèazà wu tǎt Matàn, Matàn wu tǎt Jàkɔ̂b.
normalised_text: elud le wu tat eleaya, eleaya wu tat matan, matan wu tat jakob.

name: Mundani
text: Jàkɔ̂b wu tǎt Jòsêb lu̧ Màlià wu tà lè bia Yesò wu bɔ̀ le wua ntɔ̌ tò nê Klistò la.
normalised_text: jakob wu tat joseb lu malia wu ta le bia yeso wu bo le wua nto to ne klisto la.

name: Mundani
text: Taa bi wambâ̧ bɨa tsì èlen tò nê Yesò, nkàà nê taa li tsǐ bòt bi a èbem mènəè kàbɔ̀ŋ mɔb e ghɨ̌ bɔɔ peme.
normalised_text: taa bi wamba bua tsi elen to ne yeso, nkaa ne taa li tsi bot bi a ebem menie kabong mob e ghu boo peme.

name: Mundani
text: Èghɨ bàa e li ngɨ̀ anè mbɨ̀Ꞌɨ̀ e ghɨ̌ mènəè mu Mbɔ̧ɔ̧mà li ngɨ̀ ndàꞋàtɔŋ vi shu la, naa wu nkûŋ. NdàꞋàtɔŋ wu li shu nê.
normalised_text: eghu bea e li ngu ane mbuu e ghu menie mu mbooma li ngu ndaatong wi shu la, naa wu nkung. ndaatong wu li shu ne.

name: Mundani
text: Angɔ̧̀ kà ko mbâ̧ naa li kɔɔle, ebi wambâ̧, bɔɔ tsì èlen tò nê Manuà.
normalised_text: ango ka ko mba naa li koole, ebi wamba, boo tsi elen to ne manua.

name: Mundani
text: ÀfɨꞋa Jòsêb lɔ̀Ꞌɔ a kèlɔ la, tà ghɨ̀ mbɨ̀Ꞌɨ̀ wantu̧ Mbɔ̧ɔ̧mà è shu la, nɨ̀ èleè vi Màlià.
normalised_text: afua joseb loo a kelo la, ta ghu mbuu wantu mbooma e shu la, nu elie wi malia.

name: Mundani
text: Tà nɨ atò ale, ka tà kà nɔ̀ŋkè bɔ̂ tò tè tà ghɨ̀ mbì wambâ̧ wu, tà tsì èlen tò nê Yesò.
normalised_text: ta nu ato ale, ka ta ka nongke bo to te ta ghu mbi wamba wu, ta tsi elen to ne yeso.

name: Mundani
text: Bɔ kɨꞋɨ ale, me biite nê, Waã wu bɔ bi, tàa wu Fɔ̧̀ Bèjuê la nàa wa à? Baa ye kěnto̧ tò àbâ yu nyèm nàa sàꞋa la ka nkɨ̀Ꞌɨ̂ ewùꞋte atò.
normalised_text: bo kuu ale, me biite ne, waa wu bo bi, tea wu fo bejue la nea wa a? baa ye kento to aba yu nyem nea saa la ka nkuu ewute ato.

name: Mundani
text: Mbɨ̀Ꞌɨ̀ Elɔ̀d zə ànəê yaa la, àtsəa tò a bɨ, tà taꞋa bɔa tè bòt Jèlusalèm bàgème e mè mbɔ̀a àyɔb mɨ̧̂.
normalised_text: mbuu elod ye anie yaa la, atsea to a bu, ta taa boa te bot jelusalem bageme e me mboa ayob mu.

name: Mundani
text: Bɔ bɨ̀ɨ̀lè nê, Àbot à wu a Betèlèghêm a èbem àlaꞋ a Jùdià, mbɨ̀Ꞌɨ̀ ndɨ ndàꞋàtɔŋ Mbɔ̧ɔ̧mà li shɨŋ la.
normalised_text: bo buule ne, abot a wu a beteleghem a ebem ala a judia, mbuu ndu ndaatong mbooma li shung la.

name: Mundani
text: Elɔ̀d zə ale, ntɔ bòt èyì bu à ntsèm, mbììte awɔb ngule àfɨ̀Ꞌ yu kěnto̧ fu ke ghɨ̂ saꞋ la.
normalised_text: elod ye ale, nto bot eyi bu a ntsem, mbiite awob ngule afu yu kento fu ke ghu sa la.

name: Mundani
text: Jòsêb zə ale, ndɔ̀Ꞌ a si nɨ̀ waã wu bɔ nyɨ̌ vi ètsəꞋ wu mbà̧à̧ èlu̧ Ejìb.
normalised_text: joseb ye ale, ndo a si nu waa wu bo nyu wi etse wu mbaa elu ejib.

name: Mundani
text: A li ngɨ̀ anè, ànəa ndàꞋàtɔŋ Mbɔ̧ɔ̧mà, Jèlèmìà li shu la a wu nkûŋ.
normalised_text: a li ngu ane, anea ndaatong mbooma, jelemia li shu la a wu nkung.

name: Mundani
text: ÀfɨꞋa Elɔ̀d li mpfə la, wantu̧ Mbɔ̧ɔ̧mà kɨ̀Ꞌɨ̂ a ndzò̧ abua Jòsêb mbɨ̀Ꞌɨ̀ tà bele a Ejìb la shu abua tò nê.
normalised_text: afua elod li mpe la, wantu mbooma kuu a ndzo abua joseb mbuu ta bele a ejib la shu abua to ne.

name: Mundani
text: Lɔ̀Ꞌɔ a si nɨ̀ waã wu bɔ nyɨ̌ vi nɨŋ ngwènè a Izəèlȩê, nkàà nè bòt bu bɔ le wua nkɨ ebùŋe atò la e pfəꞋte.
normalised_text: loo a si nu waa wu bo nyu wi nung ngwene a iyielie, nkaa ne bot bu bo le wua nku ebunge ato la e pete.

name: Mundani
text: Tà lɔ̀Ꞌɔ a si nɨ waã wu bɔ nyɨ̌ vi me ghǎ a Izəèlȩê.
normalised_text: ta loo a si nu waa wu bo nyu wi me gha a iyielie.

name: Murle
text: Baale ɔɔwa e ɛɛnyca Jooi tammu taden ki looc.

name: Murle
text: Izi ni Jooi nɛ, Abon abil vooritin tɔ, ma didi anai vooritin wak.

name: Murle
text: Ma acin Jooi vooritin nico abon ɔrɔɔt. Ɛŋɛr ni niini vooritin kibeen muur.

name: Murle
text: Ma awo vooritin azi nɛ waazin, ma awo muur azi nɛ baalin. Nica baale iiten o oowu nɛɛn.

name: Murle
text: Izi ni Jooi nɛ, Abon anyak ŋinti aŋɛr maama lak ram.

name: Murle
text: Ɛtɛɛnya ni niini tammu kɛŋ ka kɛŋɛr maam ci ɛɛl loota o kibeen maam ci ɛɛl tadena o. Ma agooni didi zɔɔz nici nɔkɔ.
normalised_text: eteenya ni niini tammu keng ka kenger maam chi eel loota o kibeen maam chi eel tadena o. ma agooni didi zooz nichi noko.

name: Murle
text: Ma awo niini ŋinti aŋɛrɔn maama o azi nɛ tammu kɛŋ. Nica zin waanice iiten ween ram nɛɛn.
normalised_text: ma awo niini nginti angeron maama o azi ne tammu keng. nicha zin waaniche iiten ween ram neen.

name: Murle
text: Ma bodo azi Jooi nɛ, Abon aromɛ maama ci ɛɛl loota o dook ŋaatodoi ka keyelizyai ŋinti adɔi akɔm maam. Ma didi agooni nɔkɔ.
normalised_text: ma bodo azi jooi ne, abon arome maama chi eel loota o dook ngaatodoi ka keyelizyai nginti adoi akom maam. ma didi agooni noko.

name: Murle
text: Ma awo Jooi ŋinti akɔm maam o azi nɛ tɔdɔ, ma awo vitɛn ci anyak maam o azi nɛ liilok. Ma acin niini gi nico abon ɔrɔɔt.
normalised_text: ma awo jooi nginti akom maam o azi ne todo, ma awo viten chi anyak maam o azi ne liilok. ma achin niini gi nicho abon oroot.

name: Murle
text: Izi ni Jooi nɛ, Anyek tɔdɔ kuduntai kaal ci abiir kanyayit kɛbɛrɛ ci aduŋna bodo kiyo niigi o. Ma agooni didi gi nici nɔkɔ.
normalised_text: izi ni jooi ne, anyek todo kuduntai kaal chi abiir kanyayit kebere chi adungna bodo kiyo niigi o. ma agooni didi gi nichi noko.

name: Murle
text: Udunai didi tɔdɔwa kɛɛn kibeen artɛ ci abiirna gɔnɔgi ci ɛɛl kiyo niigi o. Ma acin Jooi kaal nicoko abon ɔrɔɔt.
normalised_text: udunai didi todowa keen kibeen arte chi abiirna gonogi chi eel kiyo niigi o. ma achin jooi kaal nichoko abon oroot.

name: Murle
text: Ma ɛɛnyca niini ii kibeen nyelok, ka ii kizi ci waazinu, maje nyɛlɔyi ka kizi ci baalinu. Ma ɛɛnyca buk niini monyony.
normalised_text: ma eenycha niini ii kibeen nyelok, ka ii kizi chi waazinu, maje nyeloyi ka kizi chi baalinu. ma eenycha buk niini monyony.

name: Murle
text: Ma azi bodo Jooi nɛ, Abon anyak liilowa kaal ci meel arogi. Abon buk anyak kibaali ci akul tammu kɛŋa.
normalised_text: ma azi bodo jooi ne, abon anyak liilowa kaal chi meel arogi. abon buk anyak kibaali chi akul tammu kenga.

name: Murle
text: Amayuk ni Jooi nɔɔgɔ enek nɛ, Itirit iziti mɛɛlɛ ɔrɔɔt. Ibitizit maam ci liilu noko. Ma anek buk kibaali nɛ, Itirit iziti mɛɛlɛ.
normalised_text: amayuk ni jooi noogo enek ne, itirit iziti meele oroot. ibitizit maam chi liilu noko. ma anek buk kibaali ne, itirit iziti meele.

name: Murle
text: Ma ɛɛnyca Jooi didi kɛlɛk o too, ki kaal o kabal, been kaal o ababat keŋtine. Ma acin Jooi kaal nicoko abon ɔrɔɔt.
normalised_text: ma eenycha jooi didi kelek o too, ki kaal o kabal, been kaal o ababat kengtine. ma achin jooi kaal nichoko abon oroot.

name: Murle
text: Ɛtɛɛnya ni Jooi eet ci deer kizi riritɔn cin. Ɛɛnyca eet ci mac kibeen ŋaa.
normalised_text: eteenya ni jooi eet chi deer kizi ririton chin. eenycha eet chi mac kibeen ngaa.

name: Murle
text: Ma anek bodo Jooi nɔɔgɔ nɛ, Kanyuŋ igeet kɛbɛrɛ ci abiirna kɛɛna o kibeen ci abiirna artɛ o dook kizi dayiin cugooc.
normalised_text: ma anek bodo jooi noogo ne, kanyung igeet kebere chi abiirna keena o kibeen chi abiirna arte o dook kizi dayiin chugooch.

name: Murle
text: Maje kɛlɛk dook, kibeen kibaali, kibeen kaal o ababat keŋtinɛ kanyi nɔɔgɔ artɛ ki kɛɛn ci colai o kizi dayiin cigeec. Ma didi agooni gi nici nɔkɔ.
normalised_text: maje kelek dook, kibeen kibaali, kibeen kaal o ababat kengtine kanyi noogo arte ki keen chi cholai o kizi dayiin chigeech. ma didi agooni gi nichi noko.

name: Murle
text: Ma acin Jooi kaal ci ɛɛnyca o dook abon ɔrɔɔt. Nica waanice iiten ween tɔrkɔnɔm nɛɛn.

name: Murle
text: Nici zin gɔl baal ɛɛnycanɛ Jooi tammu taden ki looc been kaal dook e nɛɛn.

name: Murle
text: Ma iitene ween torgɛrɛm idica Jooi liŋliŋɔn onin. Uyubuz ni.

name: Murle
text: Nici zin gɔl o ɛɛnycanɛ Jooi tammu taden ki looc nɛɛn.
normalised_text: nichi zin gol o eenychane jooi tammu taden ki looch neen.

name: Murle
text: Bar olla waanice anyak lɔɔci ziizi ci anyamat looc dook.

name: Murle
text: Ɛtɛɛnya ni Jooi eet ci deer tɔdɔwaca. Ma avoŋek nɔɔnɔ vɔŋiz o rogeto. Makacin didi urugun ɛɛti nici.
normalised_text: eteenya ni jooi eet chi deer todowacha. ma avongek noono vongiz o rogeto. makachin didi urugun eeti nichi.

name: Murle
text: Ma agɔɔna Jooi mana libire ci jenu e ŋaati kazi Idan, ma arek eet ci ona ɛɛnyca o ŋinaante.

name: Murle
text: Anyak zin liil ci ariiya Idana ka kanyamat mana, ma ŋinaante aŋeryi liili nici lak wec.

text: Ma liil ceen iiyu o kazi zaar nɛ Tigariz ariik niini looce o kazi Asiriya libire ci jenu e. Maje liil ween wec o kazi zaar nɛ Yuparatiz.

name: Musey
text: Lona gijaŋŋa ay jewni li huulona, li ndaŋgara.

name: Musey
text: Ndaŋgara ay ka liiɗi, va ay ka kaɗɗi lay. Lina ay kuluɓi, ndufunda kay mbo ŋgolna, Musuk Lonara mbusuk kolo kay mbona.
normalised_text: ndangara ay ka liidi, va ay ka kaddi lay. lina ay kulubi, ndufunda kay mbo ngolna, musuk lonara mbusuk kolo kay mbona.

name: Musey
text: Lona wi ana kiɗikka jiviya ni, nam ɓorow duk kiɗikka ki u ndufunda.
normalised_text: lona wi ana kidikka jiviya ni, nam borow duk kidikka ki u ndufunda.

name: Musey
text: Lona yi kiɗikka ana faalira, nam yi ndufunda ana njeŋgera. Njeŋgera liya, maɗiira fo may, ni buu dew.
normalised_text: lona yi kidikka ana faalira, nam yi ndufunda ana njengera. njengera liya, madiira fo may, ni buu dew.

name: Musey
text: Lona di ana, «Ko va ma ŋgol li a ɓorow duk hoŋ mbona ki mba'!».
normalised_text: lona di ana, "ko va ma ngol li a borow duk hong mbona ki mba!".

name: Musey
text: Lona hin li va namma ɓorow duk ɦoŋ mbo ma kaŋgana ki u ma kolona. Nam hin li na gaw may.
normalised_text: lona hin li va namma borow duk hong mbo ma kangana ki u ma kolona. nam hin li na gaw may.

name: Musey
text: Lona yi va namma ana huulona. Njeŋgera liya, maɗiira fo may, ni buu ma mbana.
normalised_text: lona yi va namma ana huulona. njengera liya, madiira fo may, ni buu ma mbana.

name: Musey
text: Lona di olo ana, «Mbo ma kaŋgana tok ki hu lina dew, kay yam ndaŋgara tak ki kiɗiki!» ndaɗ hin li na gaw may.
normalised_text: lona di olo ana, "mbo ma kangana tok ki hu lina dew, kay yam ndangara tak ki kidiki!" ndad hin li na gaw may.

name: Musey
text: Lona yi li ki sooyna ana ndaŋgara, li ma mbona huna nam yam ana lum ŋgolna. Lona wi ana dla ndaɗta ni jiviya.
normalised_text: lona yi li ki sooyna ana ndangara, li ma mbona huna nam yam ana lum ngolna. lona wi ana dla ndadta ni jiviya.

name: Musey
text: Njeŋgera liya, maɗiira fo may, ni buu ma hindina.

name: Musey
text: Lona li tlesuu ŋgolo suu li kiɗikka mba', ta ŋgolla li a mul kiɗikka faalira, ma goona li a mul kiɗikka njeŋgera may. Nam li ki ciciwra may.
normalised_text: lona li hlesuu ngolo suu li kidikka mba, ta ngolla li a mul kidikka faalira, ma goona li a mul kidikka njengera may. nam li ki chichiwra may.

name: Musey
text: Lona njarasi ay kolo a li kiɗikka kay ndaŋgara.

name: Musey
text: Kay a ti mulla kay faalira u njeŋgera, kay a ɓorow ii kiɗikka ki u ndufunda. Lona wi ana dla ndaɗta ni jiviya.
normalised_text: kay a ti mulla kay faalira u njengera, kay a borow ii kidikka ki u ndufunda. lona wi ana dla ndadta ni jiviya.

name: Musey
text: Njeŋgera liya, maɗiira fo may, ni buu ma fiɗina.

normalised_text: lona di ana, "ko hlesuu iirina li duk mbona na ngamat ngamat, layagina pii kolo kay ndangara huulona may!".

text: Lona paɗ vunum kasiya, ɦasi saɓakŋa ana asi vuɗa, zul duk mbona, oy lumma ŋgolna ki lay, layagina zul kay ndaŋgara na may.

normalised_text: lona di ana, "ko ndangara zul hlesuu iirina u njafasi zed zed, hlesuu tud u sesina, hlesuu haram kangana, u mburi suu bagina lay!" asi hin li na may.

name: Musey
text: Lona li sana ko tamba na. Nam lammi tli tam u Lona. Nam li sa njufna may li cara may.

text: Lona di ana, «Gola an ɦagi tlesuu ŋgolom suu kay ndaŋgara u irisi hu halaŋ, u guguni suu tira u vuɗusi halaŋ lay, asi hinni a tiigina.
normalised_text: lona di ana, "gola an hagi hlesuu ngolom suu kay ndangara u irisi hu halang, u guguni suu tira u vudusi halang lay, asi hinni a tiigina.

name: Musey
text: Lona wi ana tlesuu nam lasina halaŋ jivi cocoo. Njeŋgera liya, maɗiira fo may, ni buu ma karkiyana.

text: Tlesuu kolo huulona, ndaŋgara u tlesuu kaɗna halaŋ li ay ni na.

name: Musey
text: Ni huulona u ndaŋgara Lona lasi ay ni na. Hu li ma Yawe Lona li ndaŋgara u kolora ni.

name: Musey

name: Muyang
text: Yezu *Krist ti naŋ wur huɗ ge Devit, wur huɗ ga Abraham daya. Slimi ga ata bəŋ ga bəŋani ti nday hi :.

name: Muyang
text: Abraham èwi Izak, Izak èwi Zekʉp, Zekʉp èwi Zʉda akaba bəza ga məŋani ndahaŋ.
normalised_text: abraham ewi izak, izak ewi zekup, zekup ewi zuda akaba beza ga mengani ndahang.

name: Muyang
text: Zʉda èwifiŋa ata Ferez nday ata Zara kà Tamar a, Ferez èwi Esroŋ, Esroŋ èwi Aram.

name: Muyang

name: Muyang
text: Zuziyas èwi Zesʉniyas akaba bəza ga məŋani. Ka sarta gani nani ti tə̀həloru ndam *Zʉde ka haɗ Babiloŋ.

normalised_text: oru ya noyo ardhiyo ngema futi, ikisa viwapo vyengine tena kamba sheru yakunuwira pakulu na mawe a pansi akunganira.

name: Mwani
text: Muto wa piri ndi Giyoni, uzungúriza inti ya Kushi piya.
normalised_text: muto wa piri ndi giyoni, uzunguriza inti ya kushi piya.

name: Mwani
text: Muto wa tatu ndi Tigiri, upita upande wa malawira-juwa wa inti ya Ashuru. Muto wa ane ndi Farati.
normalised_text: muto wa tatu ndi tigiri, upita upande wa malawirajuwa wa inti ya ashuru. muto wa ane ndi farati.

name: Mwani
text: Basi Mwenyezimungu Mola wetu kantula Adamu mbushtani ya Edeni, arime na ekarire.
normalised_text: basi mwenyezimungu mola wetu kantula adamu mbushtani ya edeni, arime na ekarire.

name: Mwani
text: Mwenyezimungu Mola wetu akinlaizira ámuri kamba ezi akisema javi: Irya kisumo ca muti usaka kuwa onse mbushtani-mu.
normalised_text: mwenyezimungu mola wetu akinlaizira amuri kamba ezi akisema javi irya kisumo ca muti usaka kuwa onse mbushtanimu.

name: Myene
text: Ni ntye yavegageyangeyangerevô; ni mpiri yavegagi gôzô wôronga, niṉiṉa ny Anyambyè nyavegagi gôlômba waṉingô.
normalised_text: ni ntje yavegageyangeyangerevo; ni mpiri yavegagi gozo woronga, ninginga ny anyambje nyavegagi golomba wangingo.

name: Myene
text: Nawulyi Anyambyè inè: Ga lwaṉôzange, narweṉôzange.
normalised_text: nawulyi anyambje ine ga lwangozange, narwengozange.

name: Myene
text: Nayeṉi Anyambyè ôzange inè, wi rômbya; nageri Anyambyè ôzange avila gô mpiri.
normalised_text: nayengi anyambje ozange ine, wi rombja; nageri anyambje ozange avila go mpiri.

name: Myene
text: Naweyi Anyambyè ôzange inè, ôm̃anda, aweye mpiri inè, ôgwèra; narweṉi nkôlô, narweṉi kè ibanga: yô ne ntyugu nônga.
normalised_text: naweyi anyambje ozange ine, omanda, aweye mpiri ine, ogwera; narwengi nkolo, narwengi ke ibanga yo ne ntjugu nonga.

name: Myene
text: Nawulyi Anyambyè inè: Ga lwaṉigom̃a gô gare yaṉingô; nyi ga geraṉingô avila gwaṉingô.
normalised_text: nawulyi anyambje ine ga lwangigoma go gare yangingo; nyi ga gerangingo avila gwangingo.

name: Myene
text: Navangi Anyambyè igom̃a, ageraṉingô mavegagi gôdôlôngô wigom̃a avila gwaṉingô mavegagi gwigôṉô nyigom̃a; narweṉi yeṉo.
normalised_text: navangi anyambje igoma, agerangingo mavegagi godolongo wigoma avila gwangingo mavegagi gwigongo nyigoma; narwengi yengo.

name: Myene
text: Naweyi Anyambyè igom̃a inè, ôrôṽa; narweṉi nkôlô, narweṉi kè ibanga: yô ne ntyugu yi mbaṉi.
normalised_text: naweyi anyambje igoma ine, orova; narwengi nkolo, narwengi ke ibanga yo ne ntjugu yi mbangi.

name: Myene
text: Nawulyi Anyambyè inè: Aṉingô mi re gôdôlôngô wôrôṽa mi ga lataṉe gô mbôra mô, ko ntye ya kaka bôm̃unya; narweṉi yeṉo.
normalised_text: nawulyi anyambje ine angingo mi re godolongo worova mi ga latange go mbora mo, ko ntje ya kaka bomunya; narwengi yengo.

name: Myene
text: Naweyi Anyambyè mbôra ya kaka inè, ntye; nidataṉa ta saṉingô aweyi sô inè, intyuṽa. Nayeṉi Anyambyè inè, yô yi re mbya.
normalised_text: naweyi anyambje mbora ya kaka ine, ntje; nidatanga ta sangingo aweyi so ine, intjuva. nayengi anyambje ine, yo yi re mbja.

name: Myene
text: Nayaṉi ntye am̃aṉi, agônjô mi jaṉilônda ôṉongo wèmè, ni rere yi jaṉilônda yi jaṉilônda yômè ôṉongo wèmè. Nayeṉi Anyambyè inè, yô yi re mbya.
normalised_text: nayangi ntje amangi, agonjo mi jangilonda ongongo weme, ni rere yi jangilonda yi jangilonda yome ongongo weme. nayengi anyambje ine, yo yi re mbja.

name: Myene
text: Narweṉi nkôlô, narweṉi kè ibanga: yô ne ntyugu yi ntyarô.
normalised_text: narwengi nkolo, narwengi ke ibanga yo ne ntjugu yi ntjaro.

name: Myene
text: Nawulyi Anyambyè inè: Ga lwaṉe izange gwigom̃a nyôrôṽa gô kerômanda avila gôgwèra; yi ga lwaṉe vo lemba ni gômbe vintyugu nimpum̃a;.
normalised_text: nawulyi anyambje ine ga lwange izange gwigoma nyorova go keromanda avila gogwera; yi ga lwange vo lemba ni gombe vintjugu nimpuma;.

name: Myene
text: ko yô dwaṉizange gwigom̃a nyôrôṽa gô bamba gô ntye; narweṉi yeṉo.
normalised_text: ko yo dwangizange gwigoma nyorova go bamba go ntje; narwengi yengo.

name: Myene
text: Navangi Anyambyè izangimpôlô imbaṉi: ôzange ômpôlômè gô pangiṉôm̃anda, nôzange ômwangô gô pangiṉôgwèra; navangi yè igègèṉi kè.
normalised_text: navangi anyambje izangimpolo imbangi ozange ompolome go pangingomanda, nozange omwango go pangingogwera; navangi ye igegengi ke.

name: Myene
text: Anyambyè aṽali yô kè gwigom̃a nyôrôṽa gô bamba gô ntye.
normalised_text: anyambje avali yo ke gwigoma nyorova go bamba go ntje.

name: Myene
text: na gô pangiṉôm̃anda nôgwèra, na gô kerôzange avila gô mpiri. Nayeṉi Anyambyè inè, yô yi re mbya.
normalised_text: na go pangingomanda nogwera, na go kerozange avila go mpiri. nayengi anyambje ine, yo yi re mbja.

name: Myene
text: Narweṉi nkôlô, narweṉi kè ibanga: yô ne ntyugu yi nay.
normalised_text: narwengi nkolo, narwengi ke ibanga yo ne ntjugu yi nay.

name: Myene
text: Nawulyi Anyambyè inè: Aṉingô mi ga wuṉize vugiṉa yi dandalanda na yi fwelômwèy, ninyoṉi si dôgwa gwigôṉô nyi ntye gwigom̃a nyôrôṽa.
normalised_text: nawulyi anyambje ine angingo mi ga wungize vuginga yi dandalanda na yi fwelomwey, ninyongi si dogwa gwigongo nyi ntje gwigoma nyorova.

name: Myene
text: Nazaviṉô yô nAnyambyè inè: Yaṉaṉi ko buṉaṉi, ayônyaṉingô gô ntyuṽa ralyè; ninyoṉi si ga wuṉe gô ntye.
normalised_text: nazavingo yo nanyambje ine yangangi ko bungangi, ayonyangingo go ntjuva ralye; ninyongi si ga wunge go ntje.

name: Myene
text: Narweṉi nkôlô, narweṉi kè ibanga: yô ne ntyugu yôtaṉè.
normalised_text: narwengi nkolo, narwengi ke ibanga yo ne ntjugu yotange.

name: Myene
text: Nawulyi Anyambyè inè: Ntye yi ga wuṉizinyam̃a sa bo ôṉongo wè, ninyare, ni ya yi dandalanda, ninyam̃a si ntye ôṉongo wè; narweṉi yeṉo.
normalised_text: nawulyi anyambje ine ntje yi ga wungizinyama sa bo ongongo we, ninyare, ni ya yi dandalanda, ninyama si ntje ongongo we; narwengi yengo.

name: Myene
text: Navangi Anyambyè vugiṉa yi ntye ôṉongo wè, ni nyare ôṉongo wè, nezom̃edu zi dandalanda gô ntye. Nayeṉi Anyambyè inè, yô yi re mbya.
normalised_text: navangi anyambje vuginga yi ntje ongongo we, ni nyare ongongo we, nezomedu zi dandalanda go ntje. nayengi anyambje ine, yo yi re mbja.

name: Myene
text: Navangi Anyambyè ôma negolaṉi zèmè; avangyè yè negolaṉi zAnyambyè; avangi yè ôṉôm̃e nômwantô.
normalised_text: navangi anyambje oma negolangi zeme; avangye ye negolangi zanyambje; avangi ye ongome nomwanto.

name: Myene
text: Nayeṉi Anyambyè ezom̃edu zavangyô yè; na vôna, zavegageṽya pôlô. Narweṉi nkôlô, narweṉi kè ibanga: yô ne ntyugu yôrôṽa.
normalised_text: nayengi anyambje ezomedu zavangyo ye; na vona, zavegagevya polo. narwengi nkolo, narwengi ke ibanga yo ne ntjugu yorova.

name: Myene
text: Yeṉo amaṉi ôrôṽa ni ntye, ni yom̃a yôdu yi re gô yô.
normalised_text: yengo amangi orova ni ntje, ni yoma yodu yi re go yo.

name: Myene
text: Na gô ntyugu yôrwageṉô amaṉizi Anyambyè eṽilô zaliwô zajanjyô yè; nayowi yè gô ntyugu yôrwageṉô avila gweṽilô zè zôdu zajanjyô yè.
normalised_text: na go ntjugu yorwagengo amangizi anyambje evilo zaliwo zajanjyo ye; nayowi ye go ntjugu yorwagengo avila gwevilo ze zodu zajanjyo ye.

name: Myene
text: Nazaviṉi Anyambyè ntyugu yôrwageṉô, avanga yô ôrunda, konde gô yô ayowi yè avila gweṽilô zè zôdu zayanjyô yè gô panga.
normalised_text: nazavingi anyambje ntjugu yorwagengo, avanga yo orunda, konde go yo ayowi ye avila gwevilo ze zodu zayanjyo ye go panga.

name: Myene
text: Ndô ôlumbôtôṽa wavandi avila gô ntye, arèṽizôzô wi ntye wôdu.
normalised_text: ndo olumbotova wavandi avila go ntje, arevizozo wi ntje wodu.

name: Myene
text: Navangi Yeôva Anyambyè avangôṉôm̃e niroy yi ntye, avunjiṉa gwisoguṉi yè ômwèy wem̃èṉo, narweṉi ôṉôm̃e iṉiṉa nyabo.
normalised_text: navangi yeova anyambje avangongome niroy yi ntje, avunjinga gwisogungi ye omwey wemengo, narwengi ongome inginga nyabo.

name: Myene
text: Avila vovo Yeôva Anyambyè aṽèṉi ntyaga gwEdèn gô nkôṽa yi tongwa ni nkômbe, naweli yè ôṉôm̃e wavangyô yè gô yô.
normalised_text: avila vovo yeova anyambje avengi ntjaga gweden go nkova yi tongwa ni nkombe, naweli ye ongome wavangyo ye go yo.

name: Ménik
text: Ŝüda koɓerëm Péres ëng Ŝéra. Lümɓün ɓër Péres ëng Ŝéra Tamar yéɗ kënɓiyó. Péres komarëm Esërom. Esërom komarëm Aram.
normalised_text: shuda koberem peres eng shera. lumbun ber peres eng shera tamar yed kenbiyo. peres komarem eserom. eserom komarem aram.

name: Ménik
text: Aram komarëm Aminadab. Aminadab komarëm Nahasoŋ. Nahasoŋ komarëm Salëmaŋ.
normalised_text: aram komarem aminadap. aminadap komarem nahasong. nahasong komarem salemang.

name: Ménik
text: Salëmaŋ komarëm Bos. Lümɓün ɓër Bos Rahab yéɗ kënɓiyó. Awa. Bos komarëm Obed. Lümɓün ɓër Obed Rüt yéɗ kënɓiyó. Obed komarëm Ŝesé.
normalised_text: salemang komarem pos. lumbun ber pos rahap yed kenbiyo. awa. pos komarem oped. lumbun ber oped rut yed kenbiyo. oped komarem shese.

name: Ménik
text: Awa. Salomoŋ komarëm Roboham. Roboham komarëm Abiya. Abiya komarëm Asaf.
normalised_text: awa. salomong komarem ropoham. ropoham komarem apiya. apiya komarem asaf.

name: Ménik
text: Asaf komarëm Ŝosafat. Ŝosafat komarëm Ŝoram. Ŝoram komarëm Osiyas.
normalised_text: asaf komarem shosafat. shosafat komarem shoram. shoram komarem osiyas.

name: Ménik
text: Osiyas komarëm Ŝohatam. Ŝohatam komarëm Akaŝ. Akaŝ komarëm Ésékiyas.
normalised_text: osiyas komarem shohatam. shohatam komarem akash. akash komarem esekiyas.

name: Ménik
text: Ésékiyas komarëm Manasé. Manasé komarëm Amoŋ. Amoŋ komarëm Ŝosiyas.
normalised_text: esekiyas komarem manase. manase komarem among. among komarem shosiyas.

name: Ménik
text: Sóróbabel komarëm Abiyid. Abiyid komarëm Éliyakim. Éliyakim komarëm Asor.
normalised_text: soropapel komarem apiyid. apiyid komarem eliyakim. eliyakim komarem asor.

name: Ménik
text: Asor komarëm Sadok. Sadok komarëm Aŝim. Aŝim komarëm Éliyid.
normalised_text: asor komarem sadok. sadok komarem ashim. ashim komarem eliyid.

name: Ménik
text: Éliyid komarëm Éléyasar. Éléyasar komarëm Mataŋ. Mataŋ komarëm Ŝakob.
normalised_text: eliyid komarem eleyasar. eleyasar komarem matang. matang komarem shakop.

name: Ménik
text: Ŝakob komarëm Ŝosef aŝan ar Mari ale. Mari üwum yék lümɓün ɓër Ŝésü Ar Ɗóŋóluko Urün ale hara noŋ mage Ŝosef remɗëkëma Ŝésü.
normalised_text: shakop komarem shosef ashan ar mari ale. mari uwum yek lumbun ber shesu ar dongoluko urun ale hara nong mage shosef remdekema shesu.

name: Ménik
text: Ŝosef gang lügütéko, adiɗ ngër gang reɗëkoma aɗaŋal ar Urün ale le. Komamaɗ Mari. Kogé asówar aróm.
normalised_text: shosef gang luguteko, adid nger gang redekoma adangal ar urun ale le. komamad mari. koge asowar arom.

name: Ménik
text: Kono mënɓarɗelaŋ gañar ëng Ŝosef haŋ fo rëmkoma Mari ñaŋëso ñaŋ le. Gang rëmkoma, Ŝosef amatapëɗ ñaŋëso ñungum Ŝésü.
normalised_text: kono menbardelang ganyar eng shosef hang fo remkoma mari nyangeso nyang le. gang remkoma, shosef amataped nyangeso nyungum shesu.

name: Ménik
text: Awa. Imbalingum Érod koɓiyó ŝapol ɓër ŝóluɗük ŝafëliñal ɓële. Koɓiñün iyi iɗé kiɗima luɗëkën ekor eɗ gang eŋëg. Kënmafëɗ ɗér lukën.
normalised_text: awa. imbalingum erod kobiyo shapol ber sholuduk shafelinyal bele. kobinyun iyi ide kidima ludeken ekor ed gang engeg. kenmafed der luken.

name: Ménik
text: Gang lukën ekor eɗ halëk ngër kak le, këɓelëngal sobe.
normalised_text: gang luken ekor ed halek nger kak le, kebelengal sope.

name: Ménik
text: Awa. Imbalingum Urün oɗ koɓiŝaŋëta gonëkëɗ laŋ. Koɓere iyi ɓakëɓët déƴ gan Érod aŋ. Awa. Kënɗëk gangam gingélüm. Kënmaŝ ŝan elóɗ idóɓün.
normalised_text: awa. imbalingum urun od kobishangeta goneked lang. kobere iyi bakebet dej gan erod ang. awa. kendek gangam gingelum. kenmash shan elod idobun.

name: Ménik
text: Awa. Ŝosef kohal gümüɗ gümüɗ. Koɓimaɗ ñaŋëso ñaŋ ëng lüm. Kënƴe han Éŝipët.
normalised_text: awa. shosef kohal gumud gumud. kobimad nyangeso nyang eng lum. kenje han eshipet.

name: Ménik
text: Imbalingum gang lëmko Érod, aɗaŋal ar Urün ale komaŝaŋëta Ŝosef gonëkëɗ laŋ ñan woko ŝan Éŝipët laŋ.
normalised_text: imbalingum gang lemko erod, adangal ar urun ale komashangeta shosef goneked lang nyan woko shan eshipet lang.

name: Ménik
text: Komare: —Ikal. Iɓimaɗ ñaŋëso ñaŋ ëng lüm. Ëënɓët, ëënmaŝ ŝan elóɗ er Ɓër Isërayel ɓawo ɓër yékëma mañanga ñaŋëso ënmaɗam ɓële, ɓakeca mëlëm.
normalised_text: komare ikal. ibimad nyangeso nyang eng lum. eenbet, eenmash shan elod er ber iserayel bawo ber yekema manyanga nyangeso enmadam bele, bakecha melem.

name: Ménik
text: Awa. Ñungum Ŝaŋ añëmb ar ɓal ale kosumu ŝan ijün er elóɗ er kënyó Ŝüdé. Koɓilapal mare ɓal ɓële.
normalised_text: awa. nyungum shang anyemb ar bal ale kosumu shan ijun er elod er kenyo shude. kobilapal mare bal bele.

name: Ménik
text: Gang sëmkën, idértén yékënma Urün oɗ emekën idóɓün eɗ ƴëngën ër ɓal. Kenaŋ Ŝaŋ oɓeñëmb han bühëɓ ër Ŝurdeŋ.
normalised_text: gang semken, iderten yekenma urun od emeken idobun ed jengen er bal. kenang shang obenyemb han puheb er shurdeng.

name: Ménik
text: Gungum e gëngër amënpër ëmmënñëmb, ëëndi gon ënlangal ɓal iyi ëcënlëmbët makaŝaɓi móndón oŋ. Gungum e ëëntëɓ gangam an ɓiñüŋüla aŋ.
normalised_text: gungum e genger amenper emmennyemb, eendi gon enlangal bal iyi echenlembet makashabi mondon ong. gungum e eenteb gangam an binyungula ang.

name: Ménik
text: Awa. Ŝésü koŝólu ŝan elóɗ er Galilé. Koƴe ŝan bühëɓ ër kënyó Ŝurdeŋ. Kosëm han Ŝaŋ omañëmb le.
normalised_text: awa. shesu kosholu shan elod er galile. koje shan puheb er kenyo shurdeng. kosem han shang omanyemb le.

name: Ménik
text: Gang sëmko, komare iyi omañëmb. Kono Ŝaŋ mamaŋɗelaŋ. Komare: —No ñüdük meƴeɗ ŝóndój ënjeñëmb.
normalised_text: gang semko, komare iyi omanyemb. kono shang mamangdelang. komare no nyuduk mejed shondoj engyenyemb.

name: Ménik
text: Kono Ŝésü komayaka. Komare: —Imaŋ ogé ngër kak weƴ ñaŋ ñaŋ ɓawo ëng imaŋ, gon fërkëma Urün oŋ kiɗima ejedi. Awa. Kisaŋ Ŝaŋ komaŋ. Komañëmb Ŝésü.
normalised_text: kono shesu komayaka. komare imang oge nger kak wej nyang nyang bawo eng imang, gon ferkema urun ong kidima ejedi. awa. kisang shang komang. komanyemb shesu.

name: Ménik
text: Gang ñëmbëkoma tuŋ, Ŝésü kofërëta mëngé laŋ. Kisaŋ ŝan ewo Urün këɓaŋëta. Ŝésü kolu Genjëm en Urün eŋ gang eñükütégu óróm laŋ mëndër ngër idaɓal.
normalised_text: gang nyembekoma tung, shesu kofereta menge lang. kisang shan ewo urun kebangeta. shesu kolu gengyem en urun eng gang enyukutegu orom lang mender nger idabal.

name: Ménik
text: Awa. Genjëm en Urün eŋ komaŋé Ŝésü ŝan ijün iyi Ibilisa omalókól ëmba Ŝésü omamékününe Urün oɗ le.
normalised_text: awa. gengyem en urun eng komange shesu shan ijun iyi ipilisa omalokol emba shesu omamekunune urun od le.

name: Ménik
text: Awa. Ŝésü kosém make mafó mala gümüɗ e gümëdëɓ e. Awa. Gang hucék make mungum, këmaɗëk ñémbé ñaŋ.
normalised_text: awa. shesu kosem make mafo mala gumud e gumedeb e. awa. gang huchek make mungum, kemadek nyembe nyang.

name: Ménik
text: Ibilisa ar kënyó ce ayüfé ar ɓal ale komasana. Komare: —Ɓawo ñaŋëso ñan Urün tigi ej, icësün mahañ maŋ maŋo olëmbëta ëmburó.
normalised_text: ipilisa ar kenyo che ayufe ar bal ale komasana. komare bawo nyangeso nyan urun tigi ej, ichesun mahany mang mango olembeta emburo.

name: Ménik
text: Awa. Ibilisa komaŋé Ŝésü ŝan ikón er Ŝérüsalem. Ikón igum to e ganamët an Urün ɓawo kunaŋ ër Urün la wo yéɗük la. Komahót ŝan tëŋ ër kunaŋ ër Urün.
normalised_text: awa. ipilisa komange shesu shan ikon er sherusalem. ikon igum to e ganamet an urun bawo kunang er urun la wo yeduk la. komahot shan teng er kunang er urun.

name: Mündü
text: Ta gügü, te enga gina, Me o tö ake kpï me-ye.
normalised_text: ta gugu, te enga gina, me o to ake kpi meye.

name: Mündü
text: Ta gbü sïkpï la, ngu ngbü ka-ye füh kotö ne bü faaa. Fü sü angbü ꞌduwa mbirrri. Fü *Nzïla Wazi Me akoro angbü endoro füh ngu la, da emere tima.
normalised_text: ta gbu sikpi la, ngu ngbu kaye fuh koto ne bu faaa. fu su angbu duwa mbirrri. fu nzila wazi me akoro angbu endoro fuh ngu la, da emere tima.

name: Mündü
text: Fü Me ayia amala ngü, gü ba dene, Sü lofo elofo. Fü sü ayia alofo ꞌduwa raaa!.
normalised_text: fu me ayia amala ngu, gu ba dene, su lofo elofo. fu su ayia alofo duwa raaa!.

name: Nawdem
text: Kanan mʋ nɩɩ Yesu Krisito kakʋʋgɛ tɔ kɩnaana ki du ndee. Yesu Krisito lɩɩ Owura Dawidi kanaan tɔ, nɩɩ Dawidi mɔɔ lɩɩ Abraham kanaan tɔ.

name: Nawdem
text: Abraham mu‐bii ɩ gyɛ Isaki, nɩɩ Isaki mu‐bii ɩ gyɛ Gyekobu, nɩɩ Gyekobu mɔɔ mu‐bii ana ɩ gyɛ Gyuda maa mu‐supu ana.

name: Nawdem

name: Nawdem

name: Nawdem
text: Solomon mu‐bii ɩ gyɛ Rehobowam, nɩɩ Rehobowam mu‐bii ɩ gyɛ Abigya, nɩɩ Abigya mu‐bii ɩ gyɛ Asa.
normalised_text: solomon mubii i gye rehobowam, nii rehobowam mubii i gye abigya, nii abigya mubii i gye asa.

name: Nawdem
text: Nɩɩ Gyekobu mu‐bii ɩ gyɛ Gyosefu, Mɛɛrɩ mu‐kuli mʋ. Nɩɩ Mɛɛrɩ maŋa ɩ kʋʋgɛ Yesu mʋ nɩɩ bɛɛ tɩɩ yɛ Krisito mʋ.

name: Ncane
text: Manɛ le maŋkuŋ ma bachiji kfuu chi Jiso Kletu: Jiso gɛ̀ bee mwa wu a kfuu chi Nfoŋ Dabi wù gɛ̀ bee mwa wu a kfuu chi Ablaham le.

name: Ncane
text: Ablaham gɛ̀ bee chiji Asik, Asik gɛ̀ bee chiji Yakob, Yakob gɛ̀ bee chiji Juda bɛ booŋ bachiji.

name: Ncane

text: Mwɛɛ munɛ munchii gɛ̀ kooshɛ ki fi to fi kojɛ no Tada gɛ̀ jɛmɛ wa jwe wu muh we wu tuŋ le lɛ.

name: Ngbaka
text: 'DO ki ni, nɛ Gale tɔ̃ 'bɔ na: Ma wia na, nu kpala okɔyɔ kpi do kpi do sa'de lì, wa dunu 'dɔ lìnɔ. Nɛ ma wia 'bɔ na, onɔɛ wa bũlũ do li ngɔ i.

name: Nkonya
text: Ansɩ igyi ɔha ánɩ́ ɔtamagyi aha lalahɛ asʋnsʋ, ɔtamabwɛ lakpan abwɛpʋ bwɛhɛ, ɔtamatsia ɔblɔla abwɛpʋtɔ.

name: Nkonya
text: Mʋ́ ɔma a, ɔbɛ́bla amʋ́ asʋn ɔblɔsʋ, wa ɩyɩn wa amʋ́ ɔbɛɛ.
normalised_text: mu oma a, obebla amu asun oblosu, wa iyin wa amu obie.

name: Nkonya
text: Owie amʋ ɔbɛɛ, nɛ́bla mlɩ asʋn ánɩ́ Nana Bulu lablɩ. Ɔlɛbla mɩ ɔbɛɛ, Mɩ Bi gyi fʋ. Ndɛ nabwɛ fʋ Sɩ.
normalised_text: owie amu obie, nebla mli asun ani nana bulu labli. olebla mi obie, mi bi ji fu. nde nabwe fu si.

name: Nkonya
text: Kʋlɩ mɩ, nɔ́pʋ ɔsʋlʋsʋ ɔmá fɛ́ɛ́ ha fʋ; fégyi mʋ́sʋ yeyi ɔyɩ ɔka.
normalised_text: kuli mi, nopu osulusu oma fee ha fu; feji musu yeyi oyi oka.

name: Nkonya
text: Mʋ́ sʋ awie, mlɩtɩn ansɩ. Ɩsʋ agyipʋ, mlɩkɩ wanklaan.
normalised_text: mu su awie, mlitin ansi. isu ajipu, mliki wanklaan.

name: Nkonya
text: Mlɩpʋ ifu sum Nana Bulu. Ɩwɩ ɩkpɩnkɩ mlɩ, amlɩnya ansigyi.
normalised_text: mlipu ifu sum nana bulu. iwi ikpinki mli, amlinya ansiji.

name: Nkonya
text: Mlɩba ɩwɩasɩ ha Bulu mʋ bi amʋ, mɛnɩ oméenya ɔblɔ, mlɩmɛ́ɛta ɔkpatɔ. Tsufɛ mʋ ɔblɔ tɔkɔsɩ wa ɩyɩn. Ansɩ igyi aha ánɩ́ bʋtɛsrɩ tanʋ mʋ.
normalised_text: mliba iwiasi ha bulu mu bi amu, meni omeenya oblo, mlimeeta okpato. tsufe mu oblo tokosi wa iyin. ansi iji aha ani butesri tanu mu.

name: Nkonya
text: Oo Nana Bulu, mɩ alupʋ badʋbɩ! Adʋn bakʋsʋ mɩsʋ!.
normalised_text: oo nana bulu, mi alupu badubi! adun bakusu misu!.

name: Nkonya
text: Bʋdɛtɔɩ mɩsʋ bɛɛ, Bulu mɔ́ɔhɔ mʋ ɛkɛkɛɛkɛ! Ɩya.
normalised_text: budetoi misu bie, bulu mooho mu ekekieke! iya.

name: Nkonya
text: Oo Nana Bulu, fʋlegyi ɩban wa mɩ. Fʋgyi mɩ numnyam, fʋtotsu mɩ ansɩtɔ fʋa.
normalised_text: oo nana bulu, fuleji iban wa mi. fuji mi numnyam, futotsu mi ansito fua.

name: Nkonya
text: Nosu kpoli Nana Bulu kʋklʋkʋʋ. Ɔlɔsɔ mɩ ɔnɔ tsu mʋ onuto ɩbʋ amʋsʋ. Ɩya.
normalised_text: nosu kpoli nana bulu kuklukuu. oloso mi ono tsu mu onuto ibu amusu. iya.

name: Nkonya
text: Nɛklɛdɩ dɩdɩ. Nalatsinki, tsufɛ Nana Bulu togyo mɩ ɩwɩ.
normalised_text: nekledi didi. nalatsinki, tsufe nana bulu tojo mi iwi.

name: Nkonya
text: Alupʋ idu-lafa babomli mɩ, mmɛdɛ amʋ́ ifu nya.
normalised_text: alupu idulafa babomli mi, mmede amu ifu nya.

name: Nkonya
text: Oo Nana Bulu, kʋsʋ. Mɩ Bulu, hɔ mɩ. Tsufɛ fʋtɛda mɩ alupʋ lɛ da, kpa awuntɔlɩnpʋ abɩn.
normalised_text: oo nana bulu, kusu. mi bulu, ho mi. tsufe futeda mi alupu le da, kpa awuntolinpu abin.

name: Nkonya
text: Nana Bulu, fʋ ɩbɩtɔ nkpahɔ bʋ. Ha fʋ oyula ɩba fʋ abisʋ. Ɩya.
normalised_text: nana bulu, fu ibito nkpaho bu. ha fu oyula iba fu abisu. iya.

name: Nkonya
text: Oo Bulu, nɩ nosu kpoli fʋ a, sɔ mɩ ɔnɔ. Fʋtɛha ntegyi asʋ! Brɛá mbʋ ɩkplantɔ a, fɛlɛ mɩ. Wun mɩ nwɛ, afʋsɔ mɩ ɔnɔ.
normalised_text: oo bulu, ni nosu kpoli fu a, so mi ono. futeha nteji asu! brea mbu ikplanto a, fele mi. wun mi nwe, afuso mi ono.

name: Nkonya
text: Oo anyankpʋsa, mlɩméesi mɩ kpɔɩ? Mlɩméesi asʋn ánɩ́ ɩma labi ɔma gya, si afunu buo? Ɩya.
normalised_text: oo anyankpusa, mlimeesi mi kpoi? mlimeesi asun ani ima labi oma ja, si afunu buo? iya.

name: Nkonya
text: Mlɩbɩá Nana Bulu lalɛ ɔha ánɩ́ ɔtamakpa mʋ ɔma yaɩ ha mʋ ɩwɩ. Nɩ nokpoli mʋ a, ɔtɔsɔ mɩ ɔnɔ.
normalised_text: mlibia nana bulu lale oha ani otamakpa mu oma yai ha mu iwi. ni nokpoli mu a, otoso mi ono.

name: Nkonya
text: Ɔblɔ ɩkɩta mlɩ a, ɩmáha amlɩbwɛ lakpan. Nɩ mlɩda mlɩ ɔklansʋ a, mlɩbwɛ diin amlɩyɔ mlɩ ɩklʋntɔ. Ɩya.
normalised_text: oblo ikita mli a, imaha amlibwe lakpan. ni mlida mli oklansu a, mlibwe diin amliyo mli iklunto. iya.

name: Nkonya
text: Mlɩbɔ afɔdɩɛ wanklaan, amlɩpʋ ansɩ dɩnka Nana Bulusʋ.
normalised_text: mlibo afodie wanklaan, amlipu ansi dinka nana bulusu.

name: Nkonya
text: Aha tsɔtsɔɔtsɔ bʋdɛblɩ bɛɛ, Ma ɔbɔ́bwɛ yile ha anɩ? Oo Nana Bulu, wa awɩtɔlɛ ha anɩ.
normalised_text: aha tsotsuotso budebli bie, ma obobwe yile ha ani? oo nana bulu, wa awitole ha ani.

name: Noni
text: Ɛyan nu ɛdiee ɛ bo'icee kfuu di bo Jisos Klistu le. Jisos Klistu to nu waa Nfon Dawe wvù to nu waa Abla'am.
normalised_text: eyan nu ediee e boichee kfuu di bo jisos klistu le. jisos klistu to nu waa nfon dawe wvu to nu waa ablaam.

name: Noni
text: Abla'am to nu icee Aysik, ɛ Aysik nu icee Yakow, ɛ Yakow nu icee Judas bô boom bo ice le.
normalised_text: ablaam to nu ichee aysik, e aysik nu ichee yakow, e yakow nu ichee judas bo boom bo ice le.

name: Noni
text: ɛ Judas nu icee Bɛlɛs bô Sɛla bò bwee bó to nu Tama. Ɛ Bɛlɛs nu icee Ɛslon, ɛ Ɛslon nu icee Lam.
normalised_text: e judas nu ichee beles bo sela bo bwee bo to nu tama. e beles nu ichee eslon, e eslon nu ichee lam.

name: Noni
text: Ɛ Lam nu icee Aminada, ɛ Aminada nu icee Na'shon, ɛ Na'shon nu icee Salmon.
normalised_text: e lam nu ichee aminada, e aminada nu ichee nashon, e nashon nu ichee salmon.

name: Noni
text: Ɛ Salmon nu icee Boas wvù bwee to nu La'ab. Ɛ Boas nu icee Obɛd wvù bwee to nu Lut. Ɛ Obɛd nu icee Jɛɛse.
normalised_text: e salmon nu ichee boas wvu bwee to nu laab. e boas nu ichee obed wvu bwee to nu lut. e obed nu ichee jeese.

name: Noni
text: Ɛ Jɛɛse nu icee Nfon Dawe. Ɛ Nfon Dawe nu icee Saamun wvù bwee to nu kpwɛɛ Uliaa.
normalised_text: e jeese nu ichee nfon dawe. e nfon dawe nu ichee saamun wvu bwee to nu kpwee uliaa.

name: Noni
text: Ɛ Saamun nu icee Lɛ'ubwam, ɛ Lɛ'ubwam nu icee Abija, ɛ Abija nu icee Asa.
normalised_text: e saamun nu ichee leubwam, e leubwam nu ichee abija, e abija nu ichee asa.

name: Noni
text: Ɛ Asa nu icee Jɛ'ushɛfat, ɛ Jɛ'ushɛfat nu icee Jolam, ɛ Jolam nu icee Usaya.
normalised_text: e asa nu ichee jeushefat, e jeushefat nu ichee jolam, e jolam nu ichee usaya.

name: Noni
text: Ɛ Usaya nu icee Jotam, ɛ Jotam nu icee A'as, ɛ A'as nu icee Ɛsikaya.
normalised_text: e usaya nu ichee jotam, e jotam nu ichee aas, e aas nu ichee esikaya.

name: Noni
text: ɛ Ɛsikaya nu icee Manase, ɛ Manase nu icee Amos, ɛ Amo nu icee Josaya.
normalised_text: e esikaya nu ichee manase, e manase nu ichee amos, e amo nu ichee josaya.

name: Noni
text: Ɛjim jodvu, no bó to kooyɛɛ bonyii bo Islael gɛn dvú Babilon, ɛ Jɛkonaya no nu icee Shiltia, ɛ Shiltia nu icee Sɛlubabɛl.
normalised_text: ejim jodvu, no bo to kooyee bonyii bo islael gen dvu babilon, e jekonaya no nu ichee shiltia, e shiltia nu ichee selubabel.

name: Noni
text: ɛ Sɛlubabɛl nu icee Abiud, ɛ Abiud nu icee Ɛliakim, ɛ Ɛliakim nu icee Aso.
normalised_text: e selubabel nu ichee abiud, e abiud nu ichee eliakim, e eliakim nu ichee aso.

name: Noni
text: ɛ Aso nu icee Sadok, ɛ Sadok nu icee Akim, ɛ Akim nu icee Ɛliyu.
normalised_text: e aso nu ichee sadok, e sadok nu ichee akim, e akim nu ichee eliyu.

name: Noni
text: ɛ Ɛliyu nu icee Ɛliɛsa, ɛ Ɛliɛsa nu icee Matan, ɛ Matan nu icee Yakow.
normalised_text: e eliyu nu ichee eliesa, e eliesa nu ichee matan, e matan nu ichee yakow.

name: Noni
text: Ɛ Yakow nu icee Yosɛw wvù dwee Maalia, ɛ Maalia nu wvù to bokɛɛ Jisos wvù bó teŋe lɛ Klistu.
normalised_text: e yakow nu ichee yosew wvu dwee maalia, e maalia nu wvu to bokee jisos wvu bo tenge le klistu.

name: Noni
text: No fí kooyɛɛ nonɛn, ɛ Yosɛw wvù dweese, no ɛ̀ to nu wee wvu teytey yaa kooŋke keeshoose wvú kɛ, mum yɛn lɛ wen nu egawsɛn bô wvú ɛ ɛ̀ nu ɛjim ɛjim.
normalised_text: no fi kooyee nonen, e yosew wvu dweese, no e to nu wee wvu teytey yaa koongke keeshoose wvu ke, mum yen le wen nu egawsen bo wvu e e nu ejim ejim.

name: Noni
text: Wvú nu ke eboo wan diemsɛn ɛ́ wo ecu diee diew lɛ Jisos, njefo wvú nu ke eboyse bonyii bew can bibefɛ bibole.
normalised_text: wvu nu ke eboo wan diemsen e wo ecu diee diew le jisos, njefo wvu nu ke eboyse bonyii bew can bibefe bibole.

name: Noni
text: Mwɛɛm mvun mvunciim to kooyi keege ɛ́ fí eto ekocɛn no Tata to jemyɛɛ wase diuw wee we ntum e lɛ.
normalised_text: mweem mvun mvunchiim to kooyi keege e fi eto ekochen no tata to jemyee wase diuw wee we ntum e le.

name: Noni
text: Ben eyekɛ eyuw, wan wvu tfu mvu nu ke eleem bô fue, eboo wan diemsɛn ɛ́ bó eteŋe wvú lɛ Ɛmanwɛl. Diee din nu lɛ, Nyo' nu beene ɛ bó.
normalised_text: ben eyeke eyuw, wan wvu tfu mvu nu ke eleem bo fue, eboo wan diemsen e bo etenge wvu le emanwel. diee din nu le, nyo nu beene e bo.

name: Noni
text: No ɛfilɛ kiɛ lamɛɛ Yosɛw nonɛn, ɛ wvú ke kamse mum ge kɛ no nceendaa Tata gayɛɛ ɛ̂ wvú. Wvú to nu ɛ jo Maalia bwee yew we le.
normalised_text: no efile kie lamee yosew nonen, e wvu ke kamse mum ge ke no ncheendaa tata gayee e wvu. wvu to nu e jo maalia bwee yew we le.

name: Noni
text: Nfon Bojuu wvù bó boke wɛ nu fɛɛ? Bese biwci nɛn njefo bese nu ɛ yɛn jon ye le ɛ̂ keba kè diuu sane le, ɛ mum ɛ no too keebun wvú.
normalised_text: nfon bojuu wvu bo boke we nu fee? bese biwchi nen njefo bese nu e yen jon ye le e keba ke diuu sane le, e mum e no too keebun wvu.

name: Noni
text: Ɛ Nfon 'Ɛlod dioo yuw saaka wvun ɛ wvú shiw fitele fiew, shiw noo fi bonyii bo Jɛlusalɛm e bocii.
normalised_text: e nfon elod dioo yuw saaka wvun e wvu shiw fitele fiew, shiw noo fi bonyii bo jelusalem e bochii.

name: Noni
text: Ɛ bó tfuse lɛ, Bó to nu keeke eboo ntɛw wvù Bɛtelɛ'ɛm wvu ɛ̂ keba kè Judea le. Fifin nu no wee ntum Nyo' to saŋɛɛ lɛ.
normalised_text: e bo tfuse le, bo to nu keeke eboo ntew wvu beteleem wvu e keba ke judea le. fifin nu no wee ntum nyo to sangee le.

name: Noni
text: Ɛ Nfon 'Ɛlod mum tooy tɛn bogoyfee ba ɛjim ɛjim biwcɛ yuw ɛ̂ bó ntay kefew kè jon yidvu to buyɛɛ.
normalised_text: e nfon elod mum tooy ten bogoyfee ba ejim ejim biwche yuw e bo ntay kefew ke jon yidvu to buyee.

name: Noni
text: No bó yɛnɛɛ jon yidvu le nonɛn, ɛ njoŋ yuwyɛ bó baay, ɛ ye no jee bó.
normalised_text: no bo yenee jon yidvu le nonen, e njong yuwye bo baay, e ye no jee bo.

name: Noni
text: Ɛ Nyo' ke ciise lo ɛ̂ bó ɛ̂ ɛfilɛ le lɛ bó eyɛne fo bó ebvuu etu jim lɛ bó eyɛn Nfon 'Ɛlod e kɛ. Ɛ bó ke mum tu wase jim woŋ wvubole ɛ̂ je mi le jɛɛy.
normalised_text: e nyo ke chiise lo e bo e efile le le bo eyene fo bo ebvuu etu jim le bo eyen nfon elod e ke. e bo ke mum tu wase jim wong wvubole e je mi le jeey.

name: Noni
text: Ɛ Yosɛw mum ja we, jo wan bô bwee ɛntaŋ nɛ gɛn Ijiw.
normalised_text: e yosew mum ja we, jo wan bo bwee entang ne gen ijiw.

name: Noni
text: Ɛ bó gɛn yuwyɛ boom ba nonɛn, ɛ fí mum kocɛn no wee ntum Nyo' wvù Yɛlimia to jemyɛɛ wase lɛ.
normalised_text: e bo gen yuwye boom ba nonen, e fi mum kochen no wee ntum nyo wvu yelimia to jemyee wase le.

name: Noni
text: Ɛ Nfon 'Ɛlod ke dioo la, ɛ fí kooy lɛ nceendaa Tata to nu ɛ buynɛn fô Yosɛw e ɛ̂ ɛfilɛ le woŋ wvù Ijiw e, gay ɛ̂ wvú lɛ.
normalised_text: e nfon elod ke dioo la, e fi kooy le ncheendaa tata to nu e buynen fo yosew e e efile le wong wvu ijiw e, gay e wvu le.

name: Noni
text: Ja we ejo wan bô bwee ɛ́ ben ɛ bó ekase etu jim woŋ wvù Islael e, njefo bó ba bò se gomte keeyu wan wvun nu ɛ kpwekɛn wase.
normalised_text: ja we ejo wan bo bwee e ben e bo ekase etu jim wong wvu islael e, njefo bo ba bo se gomte keeyu wan wvun nu e kpweken wase.

name: Noon
text: Níilii caasamuncii Yéesu Kiristaa , kucaasamunkii Dëwít , ee Dëwít yiima en kucaasamun Abarahamɗa , wërí wii:.
normalised_text: neilii chaasamunchii yiesu kiristaa, kuchaasamunkii dewit, ee dewit yiima en kuchaasamun abarahamda, weri wii.

name: Noon
text: Abaraham límmba Ísaak . Ísaak límmba Yakoop. Yakoop límmba Yúdaa , ya na ɓikëmëeŋkíci.
normalised_text: abaraham limmba isaak. isaak limmba yakoop. yakoop limmba yudaa, ya na bikemiengkichi.

name: Noon
text: Yúdaa límmba Farees na Sara, eewɓa teeksee Tamaꞌ. Farees límmba Esarom. Esarom límmba Aram.
normalised_text: yudaa limmba farees na sara, eewba teeksee tama. farees limmba esarom. esarom limmba aram.

name: Noon
text: Aram límmba Amínadap. Amínadap límmba Naason. Naason límmba Salmoon.
normalised_text: aram limmba aminadap. aminadap limmba naason. naason limmba salmoon.

name: Noon
text: Salmoon laakka na Rahap Boos. Boos laakka na Rut Yobet. Yobet límmba Yesee.
normalised_text: salmoon laakka na rahap boos. boos laakka na rut yobet. yobet limmba yesee.

name: Noon
text: Yesee límmba buuꞌ Dëwít. Dëwít laakka na ɓeti Úríꞌ Salmoon.
normalised_text: yesee limmba buu dewit. dewit laakka na beti uri salmoon.

name: Noon
text: Salmoon límmba Robowaan. Robowaan límmba Abíyaa . Abíyaa límmba Asaf.
normalised_text: salmoon limmba robowaan. robowaan limmba abiyaa. abiyaa limmba asaf.

name: Noon
text: Asaf límmba Yosafat. Yosafat límmba Yoraam. Yoraam límmba Osiyaas.
normalised_text: asaf limmba yosafat. yosafat limmba yoraam. yoraam limmba osiyaas.

name: Noon
text: Osiyaas límmba Yotaam. Yotaam límmba Akaas. Akaas límmba Esekíyaas.
normalised_text: osiyaas limmba yotaam. yotaam limmba akaas. akaas limmba esekiyaas.

name: Noon
text: Esekíyaas límmba Manasee. Manasee límmba Amoos. Amoos límmba Yosiyaas.
normalised_text: esekiyaas limmba manasee. manasee limmba amoos. amoos limmba yosiyaas.

name: Noon
text: Yosiyaas límmba Yekoñaas na ɓikëmëeŋkíci ga jamaanaa ɓu-Isarayeel toolohu na dooli ga kúlkaa Babíloonɗa .
normalised_text: yosiyaas limmba yekonyaas na bikemiengkichi ga jamaanaa buisarayeel toolohu na dooli ga kulkaa babiloonda.

name: Noon
text: Ga waa ɓu-Isarayeel toolu Babíloonɗa, Yekoñaas límmba Salaceel. Salaceel límmba Sorobabeel.
normalised_text: ga waa buisarayeel toolu babiloonda, yekonyaas limmba salacheel. salacheel limmba sorobabeel.

name: Noon
text: Sorobabeel límmba Abíyút. Abíyút límmba Elíyakím. Elíyakím límmba Aasooꞌ.
normalised_text: sorobabeel limmba abiyut. abiyut limmba eliyakim. eliyakim limmba aasoo.

name: Noon
text: Aasooꞌ límmba Sadok. Sadok límmba Akím. Akím límmba Elíyút.
normalised_text: aasoo limmba sadok. sadok limmba akim. akim limmba eliyut.

name: Noon
text: Elíyút límmba Eleyasaaꞌ. Eleyasaaꞌ límmba Matan. Matan límmba Yakoop.
normalised_text: eliyut limmba eleyasaa. eleyasaa limmba matan. matan limmba yakoop.

name: Noon
text: Yakoop límmba Yoseef, ƴaal Mariyaama, yaa en eew Yéesu yii ɓaysi Kiristaaniiɗa.
normalised_text: yakoop limmba yoseef, jaal mariyaama, yaa en eew yiesu yii baysi kiristaaniida.

name: Noon
text: Yoseef fiilaagari enee ɓoꞌ yijúwíꞌ, ee iñaama tah ya waaréeríiri kiwíiñ ga fíkíi ɓuwaa, ya nammbari kiheel kifoñ ee ken yéegoo.
normalised_text: yoseef fiilaagari enee bo yijuwi, ee inyaama tah ya waariereiri kiweiny ga fikei buwaa, ya nammbari kiheel kifony ee ken yiegoo.

name: Noon
text: Ya hay kilaak kowu kiƴaal, ee fu teekanka Yéesu, ndaga yërí ƴah kimúsal ɓuwiigari ga baakaaꞌciigaɓa.
normalised_text: ya hay kilaak kowu kijaal, ee fu teekanka yiesu, ndaga yeri jah kimusal buwiigari ga baakaachiigaba.

name: Noon
text: Tóoh iñcaama laakka doonaa iñaa Haꞌmudii, woꞌee kooroh ga kúuwkaa sëldíiga-Koohaaɗa mat.
normalised_text: tuoh inychaama laakka doonaa inyaa hamudii, woee kooroh ga kouwkaa seldeigakoohaada mat.

name: Noon
text: Ya woꞌee an: «Oomaa-jowaa ínohoo ƴaal hay kiꞌen na look, ya laak kowu kiƴaal kaa ƴah kiteeku Emanuweel.» Teekaama wërí en Kooh yii naruu.
normalised_text: ya woee an "oomaajowaa inohoo jaal hay kien na look, ya laak kowu kijaal kaa jah kiteeku emanuweel." teekaama weri en kooh yii naruu.

name: Noon
text: Ga waa Yoseef yúudukɗa, ya tummba fodaa daa malaakaa Haꞌmudii nakeerikaɗa: ya haydohha ɓetici Mariyaama kaanci.
normalised_text: ga waa yoseef youdukda, ya tummba fodaa daa malaakaa hamudii nakeerikada ya haydohha betichi mariyaama kaanchi.

name: Noon
text: Wayee ya ínohhiiri bi ga daa Mariyaama laak kowu kiƴaalɗa, ya teekkaka Yéesu .

name: Nzema
text: Ɔyɛle ɛhye mɔ ɔzieziele anwomanyunlu anwuma lɔ kɛ bɛda bɛmaa wienyi ɛrɛla azɛlɛ ye azo.
normalised_text: oyele ehye mo ozieziele anwomanyunlu anwuma lo ke beda bemaa wienyi erela azele ye azo.

name: Nzema
text: Ɔyɛle kɛ bɛda alehyenlɛ nee aledwolɛ nu, amaa bɛade wienyi ne bɛavi awozinli ne anwo. Na Nyamenle nwunle mɔɔ yeyɛ la kɛ ɔle kpalɛ.
normalised_text: oyele ke beda alehyenle nee aledwole nu, amaa beade wienyi ne beavi awozinli ne anwo. na nyamenle nwunle moo yeye la ke ole kpale.

name: Nzema
text: Aleɛ dwole na aleɛ hyenle; kenle ne mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nna la ɛne.
normalised_text: alie dwole na alie hyenle; kenle ne moo to zole nna la ene.

name: Nzema
text: Na Nyamenle zele kɛ, Nzule nu anyewɔzo abɔdeɛ ngakyile muala ɛrɛla, na nloma mɔɔ tu dua anwomanyunlu la ɛrɛla.
normalised_text: na nyamenle zele ke, nzule nu anyewozo abodie ngakyile muala erela, na nloma moo tu dua anwomanyunlu la erela.

name: Nzema
text: Nyamenle yilale bɛ muala na ɔzele kɛ, Bɛlɔ, bɛyɛ dɔɔnwo bɛyi azule nee nyevile, na ɔzele nloma noko kɛ, Bɛdabɛ bɛda, bɛyɛ mɔnwo mɔnwo wɔ azɛlɛ ye azo.
normalised_text: nyamenle yilale be muala na ozele ke, belo, beye doonwo beyi azule nee nyevile, na ozele nloma noko ke, bedabe beda, beye monwo monwo wo azele ye azo.

name: Nzema
text: Aleɛ dwole na aleɛ hyenle; kenle ne mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nnu la ɛne.
normalised_text: alie dwole na alie hyenle; kenle ne moo to zole nnu la ene.

name: Nzema
text: Yemɔti Nyamenle bɔle sonla kɛ ɔdaye ye ɛsaso la; ɔdaye Nyamenle mumua ne ye ɛsaso a ɔnleanle ɔbɔle sonla a. Ɔbɔle bɛ nrenya nee raalɛ.
normalised_text: yemoti nyamenle bole sonla ke odaye ye esaso la; odaye nyamenle mumua ne ye esaso a onleanle obole sonla a. obole be nrenya nee raale.

name: Nzema
text: Na Nyamenle zele kɛ, Bɛnlea, meva mbaka muala mɔɔ so ma nee baka biala mɔɔ ma wɔ ye nzoleɛ nu, mɔɔ wɔ azɛlɛ ye azo la amuala memaa bɛ kɛ bɛli.
normalised_text: na nyamenle zele ke, benlea, meva mbaka muala moo so ma nee baka biala moo ma wo ye nzolie nu, moo wo azele ye azo la amuala memaa be ke beli.

name: Nzema
text: Na Nyamenle nwunle kɛ debie biala mɔɔ yeyɛ la le kpalɛ kpole. Aleɛ dwole na aleɛ hyenle; kenle ne mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nsia la ɛne.
normalised_text: na nyamenle nwunle ke debie biala moo yeye la le kpale kpole. alie dwole na alie hyenle; kenle ne moo to zole nsia la ene.

name: Nzema
text: Ɛnee kɛ Nyamenle zile bɔle anwuma nee aze, nee ninyɛne mɔɔ wɔ nu la amuala la ɛne.
normalised_text: enee ke nyamenle zile bole anwuma nee aze, nee ninyene moo wo nu la amuala la ene.

name: Nzema
text: Kenle nsuu ne azo, Nyamenle wiele ye gyima ne yɛ bɔkɔɔ na ɔliele ye ɛnwomenle wɔ kenle nsuu ne azo, na ɔyele ɔ sa ɔvile gyima mɔɔ yeyɛ la amuala anwo.
normalised_text: kenle nsuu ne azo, nyamenle wiele ye gyima ne ye bokoo na oliele ye enwomenle wo kenle nsuu ne azo, na oyele o sa ovile gyima moo yeye la amuala anwo.

name: Nzema
text: Ɛnee kɛ Nyamenle zile bɔle anwuma nee aze la ɛne. Mekɛ mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Nyamenle bɔle anwuma nee azɛlɛ ye la.
normalised_text: enee ke nyamenle zile bole anwuma nee aze la ene. meke moo edenkema nyamenle bole anwuma nee azele ye la.

name: Nzema
text: Noko ɛnee nzule vi azɛlɛ bo finde bu azɛlɛ ne azo amuala tɛloo.
normalised_text: noko enee nzule vi azele bo finde bu azele ne azo amuala teloo.

name: Nzema
text: Na Ɛdɛnkɛma Nyamenle vale ndɛtɛlɛ nwonle sonla na ɔliele ngoane ɛnwomenle ɔguale ɔ bonyi nu, na sonla nyianle ngoane.
normalised_text: na edenkema nyamenle vale ndetele nwonle sonla na oliele ngoane enwomenle oguale o bonyi nu, na sonla nyianle ngoane.

name: Nzema
text: Akee Ɛdɛnkɛma Nyamenle hyele tola wɔ Yidɛn, wɔ aduduleɛ nehane, na ɔmanle sonla ne mɔɔ yebɔ la dɛnlanle ɛkɛ.
normalised_text: akee edenkema nyamenle hyele tola wo yiden, wo adudulie nehane, na omanle sonla ne moo yebo la denlanle eke.

name: Nzema
text: Azule la Yidɛn na ɔse ɔdoɔloa tola ne anu. Azule ne dwu tola ne anu a, ɔkpakye nna.
normalised_text: azule la yiden na ose oduoloa tola ne anu. azule ne dwu tola ne anu a, okpakye nna.

name: Nzema
text: Bɛfɛlɛ azule ne asa ɛhane ne mɔɔ lumua la Paehyɔn; ɔse ɔdua Havelaa azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ ezukoa nvutuke wɔ zolɛ la azo.
normalised_text: befele azule ne asa ehane ne moo lumua la paehyon; ose odua havelaa azele ne moo ezukoa nvutuke wo zole la azo.

name: Nzema
text: Azule ne asa ɛhane ne mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nwiɔ la, bɛfɛlɛ ye Gaehyɔn; ɔse ɔdua Kɛhye azɛlɛ ne azo.
normalised_text: azule ne asa ehane ne moo to zole nwio la, befele ye gaehyon; ose odua kehye azele ne azo.

name: Nzema
text: Mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nsa la, bɛfɛlɛ ye Taegelese; ɔse ɔdua Aselea maanle ne aduduleɛ, yɛɛ mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nna la, bɛfɛlɛ ye Yufileti.
normalised_text: moo to zole nsa la, befele ye taegelese; ose odua aselea maanle ne adudulie, yee moo to zole nna la, befele ye yufileti.

name: Obolo
text: Awaji onenitumu ibe, Utoon̄ ikup! Utoon̄ okukup.
normalised_text: awaji onenitumu ibe, utoong ikup! utoong okukup.

name: Obolo
text: Awaji omumun̄ ibe ke utoon̄ ya îjaan̄, mè iniche utoon̄ ya isan̄a me lek udun ya.
normalised_text: awaji omumung ibe ke utoong ya ijaang, me iniche utoong ya isanga me lek udun ya.

name: Obolo
text: mè igwen utoon̄ ya egwe, mè inigwen udun ya eririeen̄. Eririeen̄ okukup, egwe okukup. Eya orere adasi usen.
normalised_text: me igen utoong ya ege, me inigen udun ya eririeeng. eririeeng okukup, ege okukup. eya orere adasi usen.

name: Obolo
text: Awaji onenitumu ibe, Ofok ikup me eden̄ mun̄, mè iche mun̄ ya irek iba! Irek ge ikup me inyọn̄, mè irek ge ikup me irak.
normalised_text: awaji onenitumu ibe, ofok ikup me edeng mung, me iche mung ya irek iba! irek ge ikup me inyong, me irek ge ikup me irak.

name: Obolo
text: Ikeya ke Awaji orom ofok ya, mè iche mun̄ eyi òkup me irak ofok ya isan̄a me lek eyi òkup me inyọn̄ ofok ya. Ikukup ikeya.
normalised_text: ikeya ke awaji orom ofok ya, me iche mung eyi okup me irak ofok ya isanga me lek eyi okup me inyong ofok ya. ikukup ikeya.

name: Obolo
text: Awaji onenigwen ofok ya akpabin. Eririeen̄ okukup, egwe okukup. Eya orere òso usen iba.
normalised_text: awaji onenigen ofok ya akpabin. eririeeng okukup, ege okukup. eya orere oso usen iba.

name: Obolo
text: Awaji onenitumu ibe, Mun̄ òkup me agan̄ irak akpabin ikwọọk igba ititiin̄ me agan̄ ge, inyi nchat ijọn̄ isibi ikeke! Ikukup ikeya.
normalised_text: awaji onenitumu ibe, mung okup me agang irak akpabin ikwuok igba ititiing me agang ge, inyi nchat ijong isibi ikeke! ikukup ikeya.

name: Obolo
text: Awaji ogwegwen nchat ijọn̄ ya ijọn̄, mè igwen èdọ mun̄ ya okwaan̄. Awaji okpọkpọ, mè imun̄ ibe ke inu cha îjaan̄.
normalised_text: awaji ogegen nchat ijong ya ijong, me igen edo mung ya okwaang. awaji okpokpo, me imung ibe ke inu cha ijaang.

name: Obolo
text: Eririeen̄ okukup, egwe okukup. Eya orere òso usen ita.
normalised_text: eririeeng okukup, ege okukup. eya orere oso usen ita.

name: Obolo
text: mè ema ekup me akpabin inyọn̄ ekenyi utoon̄ me linyọn̄! Ikukup ikeya.
normalised_text: me ema ekup me akpabin inyong ekenyi utoong me linyong! ikukup ikeya.

name: Obolo
text: Awaji onenisun̄ ura mè onyan̄ mè ebi kè ntoronyan̄ cha me akpabin inyọn̄ ibe ekenyi utoon̄ me linyọn̄.
normalised_text: awaji onenisung ura me onyang me ebi ke ntoronyang cha me akpabin inyong ibe ekenyi utoong me linyong.

name: Obolo
text: mè ekekpulu me egwe mè eririeen̄, inyi ekeche utoon̄ esan̄a me lek udun. Awaji okpọkpọ, mè imun̄ ibe ke inu cha îjaan̄.
normalised_text: me ekekpulu me ege me eririeeng, inyi ekeche utoong esanga me lek udun. awaji okpokpo, me imung ibe ke inu cha ijaang.

name: Obolo
text: Eririeen̄ okukup, egwe okukup. Eya orere òso usen ini.
normalised_text: eririeeng okukup, ege okukup. eya orere oso usen ini.

name: Obolo
text: Awaji onenigbana ema ibe, Ìmumana, mè ìwa me otu ifuk, mè ìjot okwaan̄. Enyi ebi kè unọn, ìmumana ìjot linyọn̄.
normalised_text: awaji onenigbana ema ibe, imumana, me iwa me otu ifuk, me ijot okwaang. enyi ebi ke unon, imumana ijot linyong.

name: Obolo
text: Eririeen̄ okukup, egwe okukup. Eya orere òso usen go.
normalised_text: eririeeng okukup, ege okukup. eya orere oso usen go.

name: Obolo
text: Sa me ikeya ke Awaji orom ene me mbet kan̄. Ìrom ene me mbet Awaji. Ìrom ema enerieen̄ mè enenwaan̄.
normalised_text: sa me ikeya ke awaji orom ene me mbet kang. irom ene me mbet awaji. irom ema enerieeng me enenwaang.

name: Obolo
text: Awaji onenikpọ otutuuk inu geelek îrombe, mè imun̄ ibe ke îjaan̄ enenen. Eririeen̄ okukup, egwe okukup. Eya orere òso usen gweregwen.
normalised_text: awaji onenikpo otutuuk inu geelek irombe, me imung ibe ke ijaang enenen. eririeeng okukup, ege okukup. eya orere oso usen geregen.

name: Obolo
text: Ikeyi ke Awaji osa irom inyọn̄ mè ijọn̄ mè urum inu geelek òkup me emen kiban̄ isan̄a.
normalised_text: ikeyi ke awaji osa irom inyong me ijong me urum inu geelek okup me emen kibang isanga.

name: Obolo
text: Me òso usen jaaba, Awaji îwuuk lek isi ikwaan̄ kan̄ otutuuk isan̄a kpai. Awaji osisiki efuuk me òso usen jaaba ya, ìkasi ikwaan̄ geege usen ya.
normalised_text: me oso usen jaaba, awaji iwuuk lek isi ikwaang kang otutuuk isanga kpai. awaji osisiki efuuk me oso usen jaaba ya, ikasi ikwaang geege usen ya.

name: Obolo
text: Awaji ogbagbana òso usen jaaba, mè isun̄ usen ya me mbuban, mije, îre me usen ya ke îsiki efuuk mgbọ îrombe otutuuk inu isan̄a.
normalised_text: awaji ogbagbana oso usen jaaba, me isung usen ya me mbuban, mije, ire me usen ya ke isiki efuuk mgbo irombe otutuuk inu isanga.

name: Obolo
text: Mfufuk ubọk Awaji osabe irom inyọn̄ mè ijọn̄ ìje ikeyi: Mgbọ Okumugwem Awaji orombe inyọn̄ mè ijọn̄.
normalised_text: mfufuk ubok awaji osabe irom inyong me ijong ije ikeyi mgbo okumugem awaji orombe inyong me ijong.

name: Obolo
text: Àbaan̄ ibot okekinan̄a me irak ijọn̄ isibi, mè inikireke otutuuk inyọn̄ ijọn̄.
normalised_text: abaang ibot okekinanga me irak ijong isibi, me inikireke otutuuk inyong ijong.

name: Obolo
text: Okumugwem Awaji onenisa mfuun̄ ijọn̄ irom enerieen̄, mè ifuuk efuuk ugwem itap me udọn̄ inwọm iba kan̄, ogwu enerieen̄ ya okakana ogwu òkiluluk ugwem.
normalised_text: okumugem awaji onenisa mfuung ijong irom enerieeng, me ifuuk efuuk ugem itap me udong inwom iba kang, ogu enerieeng ya okakana ogu okiluluk ugem.

name: Obolo
text: Okumugwem Awaji îwop uko ge me agan̄ mbum-ura me ere ekigwen Iden. Emen uko ya ke îtap ogwu enerieen̄ ya îrombe.
normalised_text: okumugem awaji iwop uko ge me agang mbumura me ere ekigen iden. emen uko ya ke itap ogu enerieeng ya irombe.

name: Obolo
text: Îkaan̄ okwaan̄ ge òkup me Iden, eyi mun̄ kan̄ okilibi inireke uko ya. Okwaan̄ yi isisibi me Iden, ibubum ikana okwaan̄ ini.
normalised_text: ikaang okwaang ge okup me iden, eyi mung kang okilibi inireke uko ya. okwaang yi isisibi me iden, ibubum ikana okwaang ini.

name: Obolo
text: Adasi me lek okwaan̄ ini cha, eyi ekigwen Pisọn, ìje kọnọkọnọkọnọ itibi otutuuk inyọn̄ ijọn̄ ekigwen Abila, ere alata araran̄ okupbe.
normalised_text: adasi me lek okwaang ini cha, eyi ekigen pison, ije konokonokono itibi otutuuk inyong ijong ekigen abila, ere alata ararang okupbe.

name: Obolo
text: Okwaan̄ eyi òso iba eyi ekigwen Giyọn ìkukọnọ itibi otutuuk inyọn̄ ijọn̄ ekigwen Kus.
normalised_text: okwaang eyi oso iba eyi ekigen giyon ikukono itibi otutuuk inyong ijong ekigen kus.

name: Obolo
text: Okwaan̄ eyi òso ita eyi ekigwen Tigiris ìje itibi me agan̄ mbum-ura eyi ama Asuru. Okwaan̄ eyi òso ini ke ekigwen Yuferetis.
normalised_text: okwaang eyi oso ita eyi ekigen tigiris ije itibi me agang mbumura eyi ama asuru. okwaang eyi oso ini ke ekigen yuferetis.

name: Obolo
text: Okumugwem Awaji osasa enerieen̄ ya isi itap me emen uko Iden ibe ikisi ikwaan̄ me emen, mè ikikpọ chieen̄ me lek.
normalised_text: okumugem awaji osasa enerieeng ya isi itap me emen uko iden ibe ikisi ikwaang me emen, me ikikpo chieeng me lek.

name: Obolo
text: Okumugwem Awaji onyinyi ogwu enerieen̄ ya ikan ibe, Owu môkọt irie mfut uti geelek òkup me emen uko yi.
normalised_text: okumugem awaji onyinyi ogu enerieeng ya ikan ibe, owu mokot irie mfut uti geelek okup me emen uko yi.

name: Odual
text: Oobho eghun otu obho ạJizos Kraist ạḅol bọ aru tẹmar-arōoy obho. Odi olꞌeghun otu taDevid ọony ọobhe tEbrạhạm.
normalised_text: oovo eghun otu ovo ejizos kraist ebol bo aru temararooy ovo. odi oleghun otu tadevid uony uove tebrehem.

name: Odual
text: ọde tẠizik, ọde tạJekob. ẠJekob ọde taJuda nꞌaburumōr odi.
normalised_text: ode teizik, ode tejekob. ejekob ode tajuda naburumor odi.

name: Odual
text: AJuda ọde tạPerez nꞌaZera, oniin eedi ughōl ạTama. ẠPerez ọde tạHezron, ọde tạRam.
normalised_text: ajuda ode teperez nazera, oniin eedi ughol etama. eperez ode tehezron, ode teram.

name: Odual
text: ọde tạBoaz . ẠBoaz ọde tObed . Obed ọde tạJesi.
normalised_text: ode teboaz. eboaz ode tobed. obed ode tejesi.

name: Odual
text: ẠSolomon ọde taRihoboam, ọde tAbaija, ọde tẠsa.
normalised_text: esolomon ode tarihoboam, ode tabaija, ode tesa.

name: Odual
text: ọde tạJekonaya nꞌaburumōr odi, tamen obho ubhin rōoy tIzirẹl ubhin ụghi tạBabilon.
normalised_text: ode tejekonaya naburumor odi, tamen ovo uvin rooy tizirel uvin ughi tebabilon.

name: Odual
text: Tamen obho moobhin rōoy obho ubhin ụghi tạBabilon, ạJekonaya ọde tạSealtiel, ọde tạZerubabel.
normalised_text: tamen ovo moovin rooy ovo uvin ughi tebabilon, ejekonaya ode tesealtiel, ode tezerubabel.

name: Odual
text: ọde taJosef olom taMeri obho aru moniin tạJizos obho ughōl bọ mạMesaya.
normalised_text: ode tajosef olom tameri ovo aru moniin tejizos ovo ughol bo memesaya.

name: Odual
text: AJosef olom obhꞌodi ooḅi ōoy molo ọva ḍio mọloki odi rẹgheer mi teesoḍia arōoy, podi ạatua tologhi odi be mọgbaranuan odi mi tẹḅokia.
normalised_text: ajosef olom ovodi oobi ooy molo ova dio moloki odi regheer mi teesodia arooy, podi eatua tologhi odi be mogbaranuan odi mi tebokia.

name: Odual
text: Odi tạmar molobhir ọony keḍio ạna takōl ḍien odi ạJizos, ebum obho odi tạpel rōoy odi atẹnẹmi tịkarabh eedi obho.
normalised_text: odi temar molovir uony kedio ena takol dien odi ejizos, ebum ovo odi tepel rooy odi atenemi tikarav eedi ovo.

name: Odual
text: Iibha bho imute kua moḍighi obhulughi tibha Obạmọogh obho abhin tọnu ozil obho ạkpete bọ aghōl.
normalised_text: iiva vo imute kua modighi ovulughi tiva obemuogh ovo avin tonu ozil ovo ekpete bo aghol.

name: Odual
text: Iinon, onyiin ọkpur ọnyani taamōr ni ạmar molobhir ọony, keḍio tokōl ḍien obhꞌodi Ịmanuel. Ẹnaan odi nꞌezira, pẹmu obho.
normalised_text: iinon, onyiin okpur onyani taamor ni emar molovir uony, kedio tokol dien ovodi imanuel. enaan odi nezira, pemu ovo.

name: Odual
text: Amen aJosef ạsuma tạramala bho, podi ạtuugh aḍighi mibha otelema tObạmọogh obho ạkpete ạnogho odi obho, ạghi abhin maMeri.
normalised_text: amen ajosef esuma teramala vo, podi etuugh adighi miva otelema tobemuogh ovo ekpete enogho odi ovo, eghi avin mameri.

name: Odual
text: Odi omunuom io zodi ninii odi aru ạmar molobhir ọony obho, keḍio odi aJosef aghōl ḍien odi ạJizos.
normalised_text: odi omunuom io zodi ninii odi aru emar molovir uony ovo, kedio odi ajosef aghol dien odi ejizos.

name: Odual
text: Amen ạHerod ọolema ạmoghon miibha bho, pekpom odi ạbhur magey. Onyiin ẹzo bho nạ mi toomo obo bho idi taJerusạlẹm obho.
normalised_text: amen eherod uolema emoghon miiva vo, pekpom odi evur magey. onyiin ezo vo ne mi toomo obo vo idi tajeruselem ovo.

name: Odual
text: Podi abheleghi aakōbhōghi moomo aruvẹmụ arōoy iḅo miiḅua bho nꞌobo ịtughumiom araalōgh obho, apuruan kua zeedi, Tọmar teḍighen maKraist obho.
normalised_text: podi aveleghi aakovoghi moomo aruvemu arooy ibo miibua vo nobo itughumiom araalogh ovo, apuruan kua zeedi, tomar tedighen makraist ovo.

name: Odual
text: Peedi ịbhagharana kua, Tọmar tạBetilihem obho ebhugh obhꞌaJudia. Ozil obho ạge kua.
normalised_text: peedi ivagharana kua, tomar tebetilihem ovo evugh ovajudia. ozil ovo ege kua.

name: Odual
text: PạHerod abheleghi milōghōm ạar arōoy obho mi tẹḅokia ạva teedi alōghōm mạkar amen obho ẹenaany obho amute bho.
normalised_text: peherod aveleghi miloghom ear arooy ovo mi tebokia eva teedi aloghom mekar amen ovo ienaany ovo amute vo.

name: Odual
text: Amen eedi ịmiin mẹenaany obho nạamara, mịin ẹzo ologhi eedi ạḅaal kilo eedi neesi tạnyu-ẹnaan.

normalised_text: na aram gwilingidhi aminadhabng, na aminadhab gwilingidhi nasunng, na nasun gwilingidhi salimunng.

name: Otoro

normalised_text: na isigiya gwilingidhi manasang, na manasa gwilingidhi amunang na amuna gwilingidhi yuchaiang.

normalised_text: na yuchaia gwilingidhi yakuniang na limegin kaja gun gugwuludhilge dhi babil.

name: Otoro
text: na kaja gun gugwuluḏɩlge ḏi babil yakunia gwilɩŋiḏi salaṯailŋ, na salaṯail gwilɩŋiḏi sarubabilŋ.
normalised_text: na kaja gun gugwuludhilge dhi babil yakunia gwilingidhi salathailng, na salathail gwilingidhi sarubabilng.

normalised_text: na sarubabil gwilingidhi abiudhng, na abiudha gwilingidhi aliyakamng, na aliyakam gwilingidhi asurng.

name: Otoro

normalised_text: na asur gwilingidhi sadugng, na sadug gwilingidhi akimang, na akima gwilingidhi aliyadhng.

normalised_text: na aliyadha gwilingidhi liasarng, na liasar gwilingidhi mathanng, na mathan gwilingidhi yagubng.

name: Otoro
text: na yagub gwilɩŋiḏi yusibŋ gwun gwiro gwəmɩnyo gweḏi mariam gwun gwilɩŋiḏi yecuŋ, gwun gwan kɩrisṯo.
normalised_text: na yagub gwilingidhi yusibng gwun gwiro gweminyo gwedhi mariam gwun gwilingidhi yechung, gwun gwan kiristho.

name: Otoro
text: na yusib, gwun gwiro gwəmɩnyo gwuŋun gwiŋir, nate nuəmɩnyi gwaduji ḏare gi jei ganu jeḏi liji no, nuarno gwude nyɩkwom.
normalised_text: na yusib, gwun gwiro gweminyo gwungun gwingir, nate nueminyi gwaduji dhare gi jei ganu jedhi liji no, nuarno gwude nyikwom.

name: Otoro
text: na gwalɩŋe ŋaɽe ŋun ŋiro gwəmɩnyo, naŋaḏəḏə jiri jan yecu, gi gwune ŋu gwəkədə liji luŋun galo ŋuɽun ŋagin ŋun ŋɩki.
normalised_text: na gwalinge ngare ngun ngiro gweminyo, nangadhedhe jiri jan yechu, gi gwune ngu gwekede liji lungun galo ngurun ngagin ngun ngiki.

name: Otoro

name: Otoro
text: na yusib diɽo ŋwar nuarre ŋuɽuna ŋun ŋuməḏijɩlo gwiji gweḏi kanyin gweḏi gwele, nuape gwa gwuŋun.
normalised_text: na yusib diro ngwar nuarre nguruna ngun ngumedhijilo gwiji gwedhi kanyin gwedhi gwele, nuape gwa gwungun.

name: Otoro

normalised_text: ate nanigwidhire no kebe nulinge ngare ngun ngiro lra ngun ngiro gweminyo; nudhedhe jiri jan yechu.

name: Otoro

normalised_text: gwune na yechu lingini bethlam gwedhi yaudhia kaja gedhi erudus gwun gwiro gwele, na liji wila uruchelim kalo gun gathin anyin abudha lun lilingidhi nguruna ngutu.

name: Otoro
text: nalarno, ŋu gwaḏa gwun gwilɩŋinu gwun gwiro gwele gweḏi liju? gi gwune anaŋəḏi luḏuma luŋun kalo gun gaṯɩn anyin abuḏa, nanila gwanorṯeḏa.
normalised_text: nalarno, ngu gwadha gwun gwilinginu gwun gwiro gwele gwedhi liju? gi gwune anangedhi ludhuma lungun kalo gun gathin anyin abudha, nanila gwanorthedha.

name: Otoro
text: gwune na ərudus diŋɩni gwun gwiro gwele, nuubəga na ḏugwor mɩɽi, na liji wei leḏi urucəlim lun lijille dino.
normalised_text: gwune na erudus dingini gwun gwiro gwele, nuubega na dhugwor miri, na liji wei ledhi uruchelim lun lijille dino.

name: Otoro
text: gwune nuwəɽeice jɩsis wei idu jun jɩbuḏo na jalgaṯɩm jeḏi liji, nulɽoṯəḏɩjo galo ge gun gar gan kɩrisṯo lɩŋane.
normalised_text: gwune nuwereiche jisis wei idu jun jibudho na jalgathim jedhi liji, nulrothedhijo galo ge gun gar gan kiristho lingane.

name: Otoro
text: naluməḏɩjo naleicɩno, beṯlam gweḏi yauḏia; gi gwune ŋulilo nebi dino:.
