name: Otoro
text: ŋa beṯlam, amɩrɩgen yeḏi yauḏia, ŋa gwate gwɩlieno gi lele leḏi yauḏia no, gi gwune lugwuŋa gwədio mudirŋ gwaʼi liji linyi lun liro lisreiyil.
normalised_text: nga bethlam, amirigen yedhi yaudhia, nga gwate gwilieno gi lele ledhi yaudhia no, gi gwune lugwunga gwedio mudirng gwai liji linyi lun liro lisreiyil.

name: Otoro
text: na gwune na ərudus orniḏa liji lun lilɩŋiḏi ŋuɽuna ŋutu nyɩkwom, nuɽoṯeḏe lagin gworki jaḏo gwiro gwaŋingwe ludum.
normalised_text: na gwune na erudus ornidha liji lun lilingidhi nguruna ngutu nyikwom, nurothedhe lagin gworki jadho gwiro gwangingwe ludum.

name: Otoro
text: nulwəje beṯlam nuleicɩno, wiḏɩl nyabunyi ŋaɽe muma ŋun ŋoga, na ḏa ŋɩmanyabuja nyamɩni aɽuwa nyiluməḏɩjo, kani nyiwele dino nyiorṯeḏa.
normalised_text: nulweje bethlam nuleichino, widhil nyabunyi ngare muma ngun ngoga, na dha ngimanyabuja nyamini aruwa nyilumedhijo, kani nyiwele dino nyiorthedha.

name: Paasaal
text: Yesu Krisita doho nala rɛ nyɛ. Ʋ naabaa rɛ gyɩ yaa Deviti, Deviti mɛ naabaa yaa Abɩraham.
normalised_text: yesu krisita doho nala re nye. u naabaa re ji yaa deviti, deviti me naabaa yaa abiraham.

name: Paasaal
text: Abɩraham nɛ gyɩ lʋl Azɩkɩ. Azɩkɩ mɛ sii lʋl Gyeekɔbɩ. Gyeekɔbɩ mɛ sii lʋl Gyuda abee ʋ naabiisi.
normalised_text: abiraham ne ji lul aziki. aziki me sii lul jeekobi. jeekobi me sii lul juda abee u naabiisi.

name: Paasaal
text: Gyuda mɛ sii lʋl Pɛrɛsɩ abee Zɛra. Pɛrɛsɩ mɛ bɩl sii lʋl Hɛzʋrɔŋ. Hɛzʋrɔŋ mɛ sii lʋl Rami.
normalised_text: juda me sii lul peresi abee zera. peresi me bil sii lul hezurong. hezurong me sii lul rami.

name: Paasaal
text: Rami mɛ sii lʋl Amiinadabu. Amiinadabu mɛ sii lʋl Naasuŋ. Naasuŋ mɛ sii lʋl Salmɔŋ.
normalised_text: rami me sii lul amiinadabu. amiinadabu me sii lul naasung. naasung me sii lul salmong.

name: Paasaal
text: Salmɔŋ mɛ sii lʋl Buwasi. Buwasi mɛ sii lʋl Obɛdɩ. Obɛdɩ mɛ sii lʋl Gyesi.
normalised_text: salmong me sii lul buwasi. buwasi me sii lul obedi. obedi me sii lul jesi.

name: Paasaal
text: Gyesi mɛ sii lʋl kuwori Deviti. Deviti mɛ sii lʋl Solomɔn. .
normalised_text: jesi me sii lul kuwori deviti. deviti me sii lul solomon..

name: Paasaal
text: Solomɔn mɛ sii lʋl Rehobʋwam. Rehobʋwam mɛ sii lʋl Abigya. Abigya mɛ sii lʋl Asa.
normalised_text: solomon me sii lul rehobuwam. rehobuwam me sii lul abija. abija me sii lul asa.

name: Paasaal
text: Asa mɛ sii lʋl Gyihosafati. Gyihosafati mɛ sii lʋl Gyɔram. Gyɔram mɛ sii lʋl Yuzaya.
normalised_text: asa me sii lul jihosafati. jihosafati me sii lul joram. joram me sii lul yuzaya.

name: Paasaal
text: Yuzaya mɛ sii lʋl Gyotam. Gyotam mɛ sii lʋl Ahazɩ. Ahazɩ mɛ sii lʋl Hezikaya.
normalised_text: yuzaya me sii lul jotam. jotam me sii lul ahazi. ahazi me sii lul hezikaya.

name: Paasaal
text: Hezikaya mɛ sii lʋl Manaasi. Manaasi mɛ sii lʋl Amɔn. Amɔn mɛ sii lʋl Gyosaya.
normalised_text: hezikaya me sii lul manaasi. manaasi me sii lul amon. amon me sii lul josaya.

name: Paasaal
text: Gyosaya mɛ sii lʋl Gyekonaya abee ʋ naabiisi. Saŋa no tɩyaŋ nɛ ba kasɩ Iziral tɩmma mʋ Baabilɔŋ paalʋʋ.
normalised_text: josaya me sii lul jekonaya abee u naabiisi. sanga no tiyang ne ba kasi iziral timma mu baabilong paaluu.

name: Paasaal
text: Ba gyɩ aa kasɩ Iziral tɩmma mʋ Baabilɔŋ paalʋʋ hal tɩyaŋ nɛ, Gyekonaya lʋl Siyatiil, Siyatiil mɛ sii lʋl Zerubabɛl.
normalised_text: ba ji aa kasi iziral timma mu baabilong paaluu hal tiyang ne, jekonaya lul siyatiil, siyatiil me sii lul zerubabel.

name: Paasaal
text: Zerubabɛl mɛ sii lʋl Abiyudi. Abiyudi mɛ sii lʋl Ɛliyakim. Ɛliyakim mɛ sii lʋl Azɔ.
normalised_text: zerubabel me sii lul abiyudi. abiyudi me sii lul eliyakim. eliyakim me sii lul azo.

name: Paasaal
text: Azɔ mɛ sii lʋl Zadɔkɩ. Zadɔkɩ mɛ sii lʋl Akimu. Akimu mɛ sii lʋl Ɛliyudu.
normalised_text: azo me sii lul zadoki. zadoki me sii lul akimu. akimu me sii lul eliyudu.

name: Paasaal
text: Ɛliyudu mɛ sii lʋl Ɛliyeza. Ɛliyeza mɛ sii lʋl Maataŋ. Maataŋ mɛ bɩl sii lʋl Gyeekɔbɩ.
normalised_text: eliyudu me sii lul eliyeza. eliyeza me sii lul maatang. maatang me bil sii lul jeekobi.

name: Paasaal
text: Gyeekɔbɩ mɛ rɛ yaŋ sii lʋl Gyosɛfʋ. Gyosɛfʋ mɛ sii kpa Mɛɛrɩ, nal hʋ aa lʋl Yesu, ba kɩ yɩrɩ Krisita, laataal hʋ Wɩɩsɩ aa lɩya.
normalised_text: jeekobi me re yang sii lul josefu. josefu me sii kpa meeri, nal hu aa lul yesu, ba ki yiri krisita, laataal hu wiisi aa liya.

name: Paasaal
text: Gyosɛfʋ gyɩ yaa tɩpʋlʋŋ tɩɩna rɛ. Ɛɛ wɩya ʋ gyɩ bee kyɛ dɩ ʋ we Mɛɛrɩ hɩɩsɩ gyamaa tɩyaŋ, aŋ gyɩ kɩ kyɛ dɩ ʋ lʋwɔlɩ vɩya ʋ.
normalised_text: josefu ji yaa tipulung tiina re. ee wiya u ji bee che di u we meeri hiisi jamaa tiyang, ang ji ki che di u luwoli viya u.

name: Paasaal
text: Ʋ sɩ lʋl boyoŋbiye, dɩ ɩ we ʋ feŋ Yesu. Feŋ hʋ memii rɛ yaa Laataal, beewɩya ʋ rɛ sɩ laa ʋ nala ta ba wɩbɔmɔ tɩyaŋ.
normalised_text: u si lul boyongbiye, di i we u feng yesu. feng hu memii re yaa laataal, beewiya u re si laa u nala ta ba wibomo tiyang.

name: Paasaal
text: Wɩya no buloŋ gyɩ yaa rɛ dɩ wɩya hʋ á Tɩɩna Wɩɩsɩ gyɩ aa tɩŋ ʋ tɩŋdaal kɩdɩgɩ tɩyaŋ basɩ ko su ba bʋʋsɩ. Ʋ gyɩ tɩŋ ʋ tɩŋdaal no tɩyaŋ nɛ a baa.
normalised_text: wiya no bulong ji yaa re di wiya hu a tiina wiisi ji aa ting u tingdaal kidigi tiyang basi ko su ba buusi. u ji ting u tingdaal no tiyang ne a baa.

name: Paasaal
text: Hatoluu kɩdɩgɩ ha aa bɩ gyɩŋ baal sɩ kaŋ luwol a lʋl boyoŋbiye dɩ ba kana ʋ kɩ yɩrɩ Imanuwɛl.
normalised_text: hatoluu kidigi ha aa bi jing baal si kang luwol a lul boyongbiye di ba kana u ki yiri imanuwel.

name: Paasaal
text: Gyosɛfʋ aa sii doo sɩya tɩyaŋ, ʋ gyɩ yaa gɛɛ hʋ malɩka hʋ aa basɩ tɩya ʋ rɛ, a gyɩ kpa Mɛɛrɩ mʋ ʋ dɩya a yaa ʋ haaŋ.
normalised_text: josefu aa sii doo siya tiyang, u ji yaa gee hu malika hu aa basi tiya u re, a ji kpa meeri mu u diya a yaa u haang.

name: Paasaal
text: Amɛ ʋ beel-ʋ ha gyɩ bɩ gyɩŋ dɔmɔŋ anɩɩ baal bee haaŋ aŋka Mɛɛrɩ lʋl boyoŋbiye. Nyɛ rɛ Gyosɛfʋ we biye hʋ feŋ Yesu.
normalised_text: ame u beelu ha ji bi jing domong anii baal bee haang angka meeri lul boyongbiye. nye re josefu we biye hu feng yesu.

name: Paasaal
text: Kuwori Hɛrɔtɩ gyɩ aa nɩɩ wɩɩ no, kambɩŋ gyɩ kaŋ ʋ bee Gyerusalɛm tɩmma buloŋ nɛ kɩŋkaŋ.
normalised_text: kuwori heroti ji aa nii wii no, kambing ji kang u bee jerusalem timma bulong ne kingkang.

name: Paasaal
text: Ɛɛ rɛ ba basɩ tɩya ʋ a baa, Ba sɩ lʋla ʋ Bɛtɩlɛhɛm aa we Gyudɩya paalʋʋ tɩyaŋ. Ɛɛ rɛ Wɩɩsɩ tɩŋdaal hʋ gyɩ sabɩ. Ʋ gyɩ baa dɩ.
normalised_text: ee re ba basi tiya u a baa, ba si lula u betilehem aa we judiya paaluu tiyang. ee re wiisi tingdaal hu ji sabi. u ji baa di.

name: Paasaal
text: Ba aa nɩɩ gɛɛ, ba lɩɩ kpa ŋmanɩɩ a kɩ mʋ, kyɩŋwʋlɩɩ hʋ ba fa aa naa tɩɩmemii bɩl laa ba sɩya gɛɛɛ, a mʋ sɩŋ kyugili lee hʋ biye aa we.
normalised_text: ba aa nii gee, ba lii kpa ngmanii a ki mu, chingwulii hu ba fa aa naa tiimemii bil laa ba siya geee, a mu sing chugili lee hu biye aa we.

name: Paasaal
text: Ba aa naa kyɩŋwʋlɩɩ hʋ gɛɛ, ba tenni buloŋ fɩyɛlɩ, ba kɩ gyʋwɔsɩ.
normalised_text: ba aa naa chingwulii hu gee, ba tenni bulong fiyeli, ba ki juwosi.

name: Paasaal
text: Ɛɛ rɛ Wɩɩsɩ basɩ tɩya ba, ba duwoso tɩyaŋ abee sɩfɩyasɩ anɩɩ ba ta ko mɩɩgɩ mʋ Kuwori Hɛrɔtɩ lee. Nyɛ rɛ ba sii a tɩŋ ŋmaŋdɩma a mɩɩgɩ mʋ ba paalʋʋ.
normalised_text: ee re wiisi basi tiya ba, ba duwoso tiyang abee sifiyasi anii ba ta ko miigi mu kuwori heroti lee. nye re ba sii a ting ngmangdima a miigi mu ba paaluu.

name: Paasaal
text: Ɛɛ rɛ Gyosɛfʋ gyɩ sii kpa biye hʋ bee ʋ naa buloŋ a mʋ Igyipiti paalʋʋ tebine. Doŋ tɩyaŋ nɛ ba gyɩ we a mʋ pele saŋa hʋ Kuwori Hɛrɔtɩ gyɩ aa ko sʋba.
normalised_text: ee re josefu ji sii kpa biye hu bee u naa bulong a mu ijipiti paaluu tebine. dong tiyang ne ba ji we a mu pele sanga hu kuwori heroti ji aa ko suba.

name: Paasaal
text: Wɩɩ no gyɩ yaa rɛ dɩ wɩɩ hʋ Wɩɩsɩ gyɩ aa tɩŋ ʋ tɩŋdaal tɩyaŋ basɩ ko yaa wɩtɩɩ. Wɩɩsɩ gyɩ baa, Ŋ biye gyɩ we Igyipiti paalʋʋ tɩyaŋ nɛ ŋ lɩɩ ʋ.
normalised_text: wii no ji yaa re di wii hu wiisi ji aa ting u tingdaal tiyang basi ko yaa witii. wiisi ji baa, ng biye ji we ijipiti paaluu tiyang ne ng lii u.

name: Paasaal
text: Wɩɩ no leŋ wɩɩ hʋ Wɩɩsɩ gyɩ aa tɩŋ ʋ tɩŋdaal Gyɛrimaya tɩyaŋ basɩ ko yaa wɩtɩɩ rɛ.
normalised_text: wii no leng wii hu wiisi ji aa ting u tingdaal jerimaya tiyang basi ko yaa witii re.

name: Pana
text: Sɛ̧w a Zezú Kiris, gun a Davít, gun a Abaraham.
normalised_text: senw a zezu kiris, gun a davit, gun a abaraham.

name: Pana
text: Abaraham mbuŋ Izák, Izák mbuŋ Zakob, Zakob mbuŋ Juda, rá̧ nyîn nɛ́rí̧.
normalised_text: abaraham mbung izak, izak mbung zakob, zakob mbung juda, ran nyin nerin.

text: Maaŋ mɛŋkooŋ mɛ bɛte kini ki Jiso Krai-i: Tɛ̀ nuuŋ ŋwanɛ kini ki Mfɔŋ Daafi-i wu tɛ̀ nuuŋ ŋwanɛ kini ki Abraha-aŋ.

name: Sari
text: Abrahaŋ tɛ̀ nuuŋ te Adzi, Adzi nuuŋ te Yakɔ, Yakɔ nuuŋ te Judas bee bɛŋwaantee.

name: Sari
text: Judas nuuŋ te Pɛrɛs bɛ Dzara ɛ ni wu be tɛ̀ nuuŋ Tama. Pɛrɛs nuuŋ te Hɛsrɔŋ, Hɛsrɔŋ nuuŋ te Lam.

name: Sari
text: Salmɔŋ nuuŋ te Bwaas wu ni tɛ̀ nuuŋ Lahab. Bwaas nuuŋ te Obɛd wu ni tɛ̀ nuuŋ Lut. Obɛd nuuŋ te Jɛɛsi.

name: Sari

name: Sari
text: Salimu nuuŋ te Lehobwam, Lehobwam nuuŋ te Abija, Abija nuuŋ te Asa.

normalised_text: asa nuung te jehoshafat, jehoshafat nuung te jora, jora nuung te yusaya.

text: Yusaya nuuŋ te Jotam, Jotam nuuŋ te Ahas, Ahas nuuŋ te Hɛsɛkaya.
normalised_text: yusaya nuung te jotam, jotam nuung te ahas, ahas nuung te hesekaya.

text: Hɛsɛkaya nuuŋ te Manasi, Manasi nuuŋ te Emɔ, Emɔ nuuŋ te Josaya.
normalised_text: hesekaya nuung te manasi, manasi nuung te emo, emo nuung te josaya.

name: Sari
text: Josaya nuuŋ te Jɛkonaya bee bɛŋwaantee. Bɛ tɛ̀ biɛ be nuuŋ mfi wu bɛniiŋ bɛ Babilɔŋ tɛ̀ kɔɔ bɛniiŋ bɛ Isɛlɛɛ be gɛɛŋ bɛ be li kwɛɛŋ wube wu Babilɔ-ɔŋ.
normalised_text: josaya nuung te jekonaya bee bengwaantee. be te bie be nuung mfi wu beniing be babilong te koo beniing be iselee be geeng be be li kweeng wube wu babiloong.

name: Sari
text: Lɛjiŋ lɛlu, si bɛ tɛ̀ kɔɔyɛ bɛniiŋ bɛ Isɛlɛɛ bɛ giiŋgi bɛ be Babilɔŋ lɛ, Jɛkonaya tɛ̀ nuuŋ te Shitiya, Shitiya nuuŋ te Sɛlubabɛ.
normalised_text: lejing lelu, si be te kooye beniing be iselee be giinggi be be babilong le, jekonaya te nuung te shitiya, shitiya nuung te selubabe.

name: Sari
text: Sɛlubabɛ nuuŋ te Abiyut, Abiyut nuuŋ te Ɛliakiŋ, Ɛliakiŋ nuuŋ te Aso.
normalised_text: selubabe nuung te abiyut, abiyut nuung te eliaking, eliaking nuung te aso.

name: Sari
text: Aso nuuŋ te Sadok, Sadok nuuŋ te Akiŋ, Akiŋ nuuŋ te Ɛliyut.
normalised_text: aso nuung te sadok, sadok nuung te aking, aking nuung te eliyut.

name: Sari
text: Ɛliyut nuuŋ te Ɛliasa, Ɛliasa nuuŋ te Mataŋ, Mataŋ nuuŋ te Yakɔ.

name: Sari
text: Yakɔ nuuŋ te Jɔsɛ wu nyumɛ Maariya, Maariya nuuŋ wu wu tɛ̀ biɛ Jiso wu bɛ tɛ̀ teenyi le Krai Kinsofu ki Nyɔ tɛ̀ kaachɛ.

name: Sari
text: Si fi tɛ̀ kɛti lɛ, Jɔsɛ wu nyumi, si tɛ̀ nuuŋ wi wu tsaaŋ lɛ, tɛ̀ gii kɔŋgisi yɛ le chɔɔri wu kɛ, se beechɛ nuuŋ le gatɛ bee wu lɛjiŋ lɛjiŋ.
normalised_text: si fi te keti le, jose wu nyumi, si te nuung wi wu tsaang le, te gii konggisi ye le choori wu ke, se beeche nuung le gate bee wu lejing lejing.

name: Sari
text: Gii biɛ ŋwaŋ wu nyuŋ bɛ nyɛ bukooŋ bwee le Jiso, kifɛ gii naa soo bɛniiŋ bee li ŋgɛ wu bibifi bi bee.
normalised_text: gii bie ngwang wu nyung be nye bukoong bwee le jiso, kife gii naa soo beniing bee li ngge wu bibifi bi bee.

name: Sari
text: Biee bini bichu tɛ̀ ka le fi bɛ fi kɔchɛ si Taa tɛ̀ tee li kimfimɛ ki ntomfɔŋ we-e le.

name: Sari
text: Yikɛ yɛɛŋ nɛ woo, ŋwaakwɛɛŋ wu kii yɛ nyuŋ kɛ wumu gii fwee, biɛ ŋwaŋ wu nyuŋ bɛ teeŋ wu le Imaniwe. Bukooŋ buni nuuŋ le, Nyɔ yɛ bɛ bee.
normalised_text: yike yeeng ne woo, ngwaakweeng wu kii ye nyung ke wumu gii fwee, bie ngwang wu nyung be teeng wu le imaniwe. bukoong buni nuung le, nyo ye be bee.

name: Sari
text: Si kifiee kɛɛ laŋɛ li Jɔsɛ-ɛ lɛ, le kaaŋgi biee fɛ nɛɛ si nchindaa wu Taa bee tee li wuu lɛ. Tɛ̀ dzɔ Maariya li ni yih we.
normalised_text: si kifiee kee lange li josee le, le kaanggi biee fe nee si nchindaa wu taa bee tee li wuu le. te dzo maariya li ni yih we.

name: Sari
text: Mfɔŋ wu Bɛjuu wu bɛ biɛ wɛ nuuŋ fɛŋ le? Tɛ biiti ni kifɛ tɛ bee tɛ ŋɛŋ fintsɔŋ fiee lɛ kimbɛ ki jobɛ tɛti-i, tɛ se bɛ le tɛ boŋ wu.
normalised_text: mfong wu bejuu wu be bie we nuung feng le? te biiti ni kife te bee te ngeng fintsong fiee le kimbe ki jobe tetii, te se be le te bong wu.

name: Sari
text: Le Mfɔŋ Hɛrɔ tuu woo ntoŋ wuni, shéŋ tɔŋ wu, yi tɔŋ tɛ mɔɔ bɛniiŋ bɛ Jɛrosalɛŋ bɛchu.
normalised_text: le mfong hero tuu woo ntong wuni, sheng tong wu, yi tong te moo beniing be jerosaleng bechu.

name: Sari
text: Be tuu le, Bɛ tɛ̀ nuuŋ le bɛ gii bɛ biɛ ki li kitoŋ ki Bɛtɛlɛhɛŋ ki nuuŋ kimbɛ ki Judiya. Fini nuuŋ si ntomfɔŋ wu Nyɔ tɛ̀ tsɛɛ le.
normalised_text: be tuu le, be te nuung le be gii be bie ki li kitong ki beteleheng ki nuung kimbe ki judiya. fini nuung si ntomfong wu nyo te tsee le.

name: Sari
text: Mfɔŋ Hɛrɔ se konchɛ tɛ bɛ bufii lɛ baa lɛjiŋ lɛjiŋ bii woo bujɔŋ, mfi wu fintsɔŋ filu tɛ̀ bo.

name: Sari
text: Le woo, biee toŋ be Bɛtɛlɛhɛŋ tee le, Gɛnɛ yɛɛŋ nɛ bɔsɛyi nɛ gɔɔŋ ŋwaŋ wulu bujɔŋ. Ɛ nɛ gɔɔŋ nɛ ŋɛŋ wu, nɛ kaari nɛ bɛ nɛ tee mi nse ŋgɛɛŋ tɛ mboŋ wu.
normalised_text: le woo, biee tong be beteleheng tee le, gene yeeng ne boseyi ne goong ngwang wulu bujong. e ne goong ne ngeng wu, ne kaari ne be ne tee mi nse nggeeng te mbong wu.

name: Sari
text: Si be tɛ̀ ŋɛŋ fintsɔŋ filu lɛ, be kɛmɛ kinɛɛtinɛ ŋge yi dzɔɔŋ be.
normalised_text: si be te ngeng fintsong filu le, be keme kineetine ngge yi dzoong be.

name: Sari
text: Nyɔ chiinsɛ li bee lɛ kifiee li le kiiŋ be ni kaari be to lijiŋ le be ŋɛŋ Mfɔŋ Hɛrɔ kɛ. Be dza be to lijiŋ li kwɛɛŋ wu bee lɛ dze yi jetɛ-ɛ.

text: Jɔsɛ biee dza we, dzɔ ŋwaŋ wulu bee ni butuu butuu be dza be gɛɛŋ Ijip.

name: Sari
text: Le be gɛɛŋ be woyɛ bɔɔŋ baa lɛ, fi se kɔchɛ si ntomfɔŋ wu Nyɔ-ɔ wu Jeremaya tɛ̀ saa wu tee le.

name: Sehwi
text: Né aseɛ te sesakaa bɔ olle bɔbea biala ɔ. Né awosii akata buma ne anye; na né Nyameɛ Sunzum natenate nzue ne anyeso faa.
normalised_text: ne asie te sesakaa bo olle bobea biala o. ne awosii akata buma ne anye; na ne nyamie sunzum natenate nzue ne anyeso faa.

name: Sehwi
text: Na Nyameɛ hane kyɛ, Ɔ́ta hyireinn! Na ɔtale hyireinn.

name: Sehwi
text: Nyameɛ nwuni kyɛ hyireinn ne te paa, na ɔtele hyireinn ne fili awosii ne anwo.
normalised_text: nyamie nywuni che hyireinn ne te paa, na otele hyireinn ne fili awosii ne anywo.

name: Sehwi
text: Nyameɛ tole hyireinn ne dumaa Alehyeleɛ, yeɛ ɔtole awosii ne dumaa Alesaleɛ. Aleɛ sane, na aleɛ hyene: kyẽa bɔ oli moa ɛne.

name: Sehwi
text: Na Nyameɛ hane kyɛ, Ewienu bra, na ɔɔtete nzue nemɔ anu! Na ɔwale nu sɔ.
normalised_text: na nyamie hane che, ewienu bra, na ootete nzue nemo anu! na owale nu so.

name: Sehwi
text: Nyameɛ yɔle ewienu, na ɔtele nzue bɔ ɔwɔ ewienu bo fili bɔ ɔwɔ ewienu anwuro nwo.

name: Sehwi
text: Nyameɛ tole ewienu ne dumaa Anwuro. Aleɛ sane, na aleɛ hyene: kyẽa bɔ ɔtɔ so nyɔ ɛne.

name: Sehwi
text: Na Nyameɛ hane kyɛ, Nzue bɔ ɔwɔ ewienu bo ne, ɔ́boa ye noa neka horɛ, na aseɛ wosee bra! Na ɔwale nu sɔ.

name: Sehwi
text: Nyameɛ tole nekaa wosee ne dumaa Aseɛ, yeɛ nzue bɔ ye noa aboa ne koso, ɔtole ye dumaa Ɛpo. Na Nyameɛ nwuni kyɛ ɔte paa.

name: Sehwi
text: Na Nyameɛ hane kyɛ, Aseɛ ófifi ndire, mmakaa bɔ osu mmaa, ɔne mmakaa bɔ ye mma wɔ ye aleɛ nu, ebiala kyɛbɔ ye sue si te ɔ wɔ aseɛ so! Na ɔwale nu sɔ.

name: Sehwi
text: Aseɛ fifili ndire, mmakaa bɔ osu mmaa, ɔne mmakaa bɔ mmaa wɔ ye aleɛ nu, ebiala kyɛbɔ ye sue si te ɔ. Na Nyameɛ nwuni kyɛ ɔte paa.
normalised_text: asie fifili ndire, mmakaa bo osu mmaa, one mmakaa bo mmaa wo ye alie nu, ebiala chebo ye sue si te o. na nyamie nywuni che ote paa.

name: Sehwi
text: Na Nyameɛ hane kyɛ, Nganea bra ewienu, na bɛɛtete alehyeleɛ ne alesaleɛ bɛ nu, na bɛ́yɛ mmerɛ, ngyẽa ne afoɛ mɔ nwo nzɛngyerɛnneɛ;.

name: Sehwi
text: Yiti Nyameɛ yɔle nganea mbiri nyɔ ne, kyɛ pirikua ne oli alehyeleɛ so, na kaaba ne oli alesaleɛ so; ɔyɔle nzramaa mɔ koso.
normalised_text: yiti nyamie yole nganea mbiri nyo ne, che pirikua ne oli alehyelie so, na kaaba ne oli alesalie so; oyole nzramaa mo koso.

normalised_text: che beli alehyelie ne alesalie so, na betete hyireinn ne awosii ne anu. na nyamie nywuni che ote paa.

name: Sehwi
text: Na Nyameɛ hane kyɛ, Nzue ɔlɔ abɔdeɛ ahoroɔ pee bɔ bele ngoa ɔ, ná nnomaa koso bétu bɛ́fa aseɛ so wɔ ewienu.

name: Sehwi
text: Nyameɛ yirale bɛ, na ɔhane kyɛ, Ɛ́mɔwo ná ɛmɔlɔ pee, ná ɛ́mɔyi ɛpo nu tɛkyɛ; nnomaa koso ɛ́mɔta pee wɔ aseɛ so.
normalised_text: nyamie yirale be, na ohane che, emowo na emolo pee, na emoyi epo nu teche; nnomaa koso emota pee wo asie so.

name: Sehwi
text: Na Nyameɛ yɔle aseɛ so ngaka mbiri, awuro ngaka, yeɛ ngaka mmaa ne ngaka bɔ bɛtwe bɛ nwo ase, kyɛbɔ bɛ sue si te ɔ. Na Nyameɛ nwuni kyɛ ɔte paa.

name: Sehwi
text: Yiti Nyameɛ bɔle sona kyɛ ye bɔbɔ ye sɛso, Nyameɛ sɛso yeɛ ɔbɔle ye ɔ; ɔbɔle bienzua ne brasua.
normalised_text: yiti nyamie bole sona che ye bobo ye seso, nyamie seso yie obole ye o; obole bienzua ne brasua.

name: Sehwi
text: Na Nyameɛ sele kyɛ, Ɛ́mɔtie, mafa bakaa biala bɔ osu mmaa wɔ aseɛ so, ɔne bakaa biala bɔ mmaa wɔ ye aleɛ nu mama ɛmɔ, kyɛ ɛmɔ aleɛ ɛne.
normalised_text: na nyamie sele che, emotie, mafa bakaa biala bo osu mmaa wo asie so, one bakaa biala bo mmaa wo ye alie nu mama emo, che emo alie ene.

name: Sehwi
text: Nyameɛ nwuni kyɛ nningyein bɔ wayɔ ne amukoraa te paa paa. Aleɛ sane, na aleɛ hyene: kyẽa bɔ ɔtɔ so nzia ɛne.
normalised_text: nyamie nywuni che nningyein bo wayo ne amukoraa te paa paa. alie sane, na alie hyene chena bo oto so nzia ene.

name: Sehwi
text: Yiti sɔ yeɛ Nyameɛ bɔle anwuro ne aseɛ ne bɛ nu nningyein mukoraa yiele ɔ.
normalised_text: yiti so yie nyamie bole anywuro ne asie ne be nu nningyein mukoraa yiele o.

name: Sehwi
text: Kyẽa bɔ ɔtɔ so nzoo nen, né Nyameɛ ayie ye adwuma bɔ ɔyɔle ne yɔ; na kyẽa bɔ ɔtɔ so nzoo ne, olili afofi wɔ ye adwuma bɔ ɔyɔle amukoraa nwo.
normalised_text: chena bo oto so nzoo nen, ne nyamie ayie ye ajuma bo oyole ne yo; na chena bo oto so nzoo ne, olili afofi wo ye ajuma bo oyole amukoraa nywo.

name: Sehwi
text: Kyɛbɔ Ɛdangama si bɔle anwuro ne aseɛ ne, ye nwo dwirɛ ɛhe. Mmerɛ bɔ AWURADE Nyameɛ bɔle aseɛ ne anwuro ne.
normalised_text: chebo edangama si bole anywuro ne asie ne, ye nywo jire ehe. mmere bo awurade nyamie bole asie ne anywuro ne.

name: Sehwi
text: Nakoso nzue fili aseɛnwo loaloale aseɛ so amukoraa.

name: Sehwi
text: Na AWURADE Nyameɛ fale aseɛnwo nnɛterɛ nwone kuro sona, na olele ngoa nwomeɛ guale ye bonyi anu, na kuro sona ɔɔyɛle teasefoɛ.

name: Sekpele
text: Aye nyamfo ni bana ba ǝsuǝ Yesu Kristo wǝ ni Oka David eto ufluflu lɛbɔ utsyi, nya David ni ufluflu wǝ lɛbɔ utsyi Abraham eto kafo.
normalised_text: aye nyamfo ni bana ba esue yesu kristo we ni oka david eto ufluflu lebo uchi, nya david ni ufluflu we lebo uchi abraham eto kafo.

name: Sekpele
text: Idu lǝ Abraham ibǝ Oka David ǝsuǝǝ, nnyǝ antomǝ ba ntǝkǝ lǝ bǝtsyuǝ ǝsuǝ. Abraham léle Isak wǝ léle Yakob wǝ léle.
normalised_text: idu le abraham ibe oka david esuee, nnye antome ba nteke le bechue esue. abraham lele isak we lele yakob we lele.

name: Sekpele
text: Yuda ku wǝ bayimisani. Yuda ku wǝ usiǝ Tamai léle Perez ku Zera, nya Perez léle Hezron. Hezron léle Aram, nya wuntsya léle Aminadab.
normalised_text: yuda ku we bayimisani. yuda ku we usie tamai lele perez ku zera, nya perez lele hezron. hezron lele aram, nya wuncha lele aminadab.

name: Sekpele
text: Salmon ku Rahab léle Boaz, nya Boaz ku Rut léle Obed. Obed léle Isai.
normalised_text: salmon ku rahab lele boaz, nya boaz ku rut lele obed. obed lele isai.

name: Sekpele
text: Salomo ále Rehoboam wǝ léle Abiya. Abiya tsya léle Asa.
normalised_text: salomo ale rehoboam we lele abiya. abiya cha lele asa.

name: Sekpele
text: nya Asa léle Yosefat. Yosefat léle Yoram wǝ léle Uziya.
normalised_text: nya asa lele yosefat. yosefat lele yoram we lele uziya.

name: Sekpele
text: Uziya léle Yotam wǝ léle Ahaz wǝ léle Hezekiya wǝ léle Manase.
normalised_text: uziya lele yotam we lele ahaz we lele hezekiya we lele manase.

name: Sekpele
text: Manase léle Amon, nya Amon léle Yosiya wǝ léle.
normalised_text: manase lele amon, nya amon lele yosiya we lele.

name: Sekpele
text: Yekoniya ku wǝ bayimisani lǝ Babilonia lɛkɛfe.
normalised_text: yekoniya ku we bayimisani le babilonia lekefe.

name: Sekpele
text: Abihud, nya wuntsya léle Elyakim. Elyakim léle Azur.
normalised_text: abihud, nya wuncha lele elyakim. elyakim lele azur.

name: Sekpele
text: nya Azur léle Sadok wǝ léle Akim wǝ léle Elihud.
normalised_text: nya azur lele sadok we lele akim we lele elihud.

name: Sekpele
text: Elihud léle Eleazar, nya Eleazar léle Matan, nya wuntsya léle.
normalised_text: elihud lele eleazar, nya eleazar lele matan, nya wuncha lele.

name: Sekpele
text: Yakob wǝ léle Yosef wǝ dífi Maria wǝ léle Yesu wǝ baakpo Nwǝ Onanto Lékpo Ɔhile Utsyǝ.
normalised_text: yakob we lele yosef we difi maria we lele yesu we baakpo nwe onanto lekpo ohile uche.

name: Sekpele
text: Nya woole ubisaibi. Nya fǝ Yosef luutǝkǝ wǝ diye fǝ Yesu, itsyise wǝ ni nwǝ luulǝkǝ wǝ betidi utsyiko lǝ abua ǝsuǝ nɛ.
normalised_text: nya woole ubisaibi. nya fe yosef luuteke we diye fe yesu, ichise we ni nwe luuleke we betidi uchiko le abua esue ne.

name: Sekpele
text: Asa nyamfo ǝbǝ itǝ lǝ Maria ǝsuǝ fe kase Onanto lɛtɛyi utsyǝ ɛyɛ lǝ wǝ unyɛlǝkǝtidi ǝsuǝ nkǝ yuubǝ itǝ sitinti. Ɔ́tɛyi nkǝ.
normalised_text: asa nyamfo ebe ite le maria esue fe kase onanto leteyi uche eye le we unyeleketidi esue nke yuube ite sitinti. oteyi nke.

name: Sekpele
text: Kebitɛ kǝtsyuǝ ka lenyi osani ǝbɔlɛ kafo nya woole ubisaibi. Nya betidi lookpo wǝ bǝnkǝ Imanuel. Nnya kasɔ ni bǝnkǝ Onanto si ko bo.
normalised_text: kebite kechue ka lenyi osani ebole kafo nya woole ubisaibi. nya betidi lookpo we benke imanuel. nnya kaso ni benke onanto si ko bo.

name: Sekpele
text: Lǝ nyaso se Yosef lésanklii, ókpa Maria, úyifo wǝ usiǝ fe kase Onanto eto ɔtɔnkpe ǝmǝ lɛtɛyi wǝ.
normalised_text: le nyaso se yosef lesanklii, okpa maria, uyifo we usie fe kase onanto eto otonkpe eme leteyi we.

name: Sekpele
text: Fɛɛ Yosef ku Maria mánte bǝtsyuǝ fe usǝ ku usiǝ isu ese lefe nǝ óle wǝ ubisaibi ǝmǝ. Nya Yosef dítǝkǝ wǝ diye nkǝ Yesu.
normalised_text: fee yosef ku maria mante bechue fe use ku usie isu ese lefe ne ole we ubisaibi eme. nya yosef diteke we diye nke yesu.

name: Sekpele
text: Nya bátɔ bǝnkǝ, Sieti bále ubi wǝ luudi Yudafɔ eto oka ǝmǝ? Búnyǝ wǝ sefandebi lǝ kofekatokɔ. Nya búbǝ boǝ boesumu wǝ.
normalised_text: nya bato benke, sieti bale ubi we luudi yudafo eto oka eme? bunye we sefandebi le kofekatoko. nya bube boe boesumu we.

name: Sekpele
text: Lefe nǝ Oka Herodes lɛnɔ ditiki nǝmfoo, difufu ǝmuǝ wǝ ku betidi ba kenke lɛkɛ lǝ Yerusalem mfó.
normalised_text: lefe ne oka herodes leno ditiki nemfoo, difufu emue we ku betidi ba kenke leke le yerusalem mfo.

name: Sekpele
text: Nyaso ókpadi Onanto eto besunyǝ ninǝ ku afi eto bateasa nya ɔ́tɔ mǝ nkǝ, Sieti boole Nwǝ Onanto Lékpo Ɔhile Utsyǝ ǝmǝ.
normalised_text: nyaso okpadi onanto eto besunye nine ku afi eto bateasa nya oto me nke, sieti boole nwe onanto lekpo ohile uche eme.

name: Sekpele
text: Mfó nya bátɛyi wǝ bǝnkǝ, Betlehem lǝ Yudea eto kasɔ, itsyise nko Onanto eto Unyɛlǝkǝtidi lɛwɔni útsyǝ nkǝ.
normalised_text: mfo nya bateyi we benke, betlehem le yudea eto kaso, ichise nko onanto eto unyeleketidi lewoni uche nke.

name: Sekpele
text: Lǝ nnya kamaa, Onanto ǝlǝkǝ óte mǝ lǝ kola kǝmiǝ nkǝ bénsisinkli bayɛ Oka Herodes ɔflɔ. Nyaso báyɛ kusu bamba bésinkli bésu mǝ kasɔ.
normalised_text: le nnya kamaa, onanto eleke ote me le kola kemie nke bensisinkli baye oka herodes oflo. nyaso baye kusu bamba besinkli besu me kaso.

name: Sekpele
text: Ketsye kamfoo, Yosef átaka úfi ubi ǝmǝ ku wǝ ambe útsyetsyiko bésu Egipte eto kasɔ.
normalised_text: keche kamfoo, yosef ataka ufi ubi eme ku we ambe uchechiko besu egipte eto kaso.

name: Sekpele
text: Mmǝ ibǝ bǝ Onanto eto Unyɛlǝkǝtidi Yeremiya eto lesa nǝ ɔ́tɛyi útsyǝǝ, ǝbǝ itǝ nko sitinti, nnya nlɛ bɔtɛyi nkǝ.
normalised_text: mme ibe be onanto eto unyeleketidi yeremiya eto lesa ne oteyi uchee, ebe ite nko sitinti, nnya nle boteyi nke.

name: Sekpele
text: Se Oka Herodes díkpǝ eto kamaa, Onanto eto ɔtɔnkpe utsyuǝ ǝlǝkǝ ǝsuǝ óte Yosef lǝ kola kǝmiǝ lǝ Egipte.
normalised_text: se oka herodes dikpe eto kamaa, onanto eto otonkpe uchue eleke esue ote yosef le kola kemie le egipte.

name: Sekpele
text: Nya ɔ́tɛyi wǝ nkǝ, Taka, lǝ efi ubi ǝmǝ ku wǝ ambe lǝ bisinkli bisu Israel eto kasɔ, itsyise mba léla bǝ baalo ubi ǝmǝ ébukpǝ.
normalised_text: nya oteyi we nke, taka, le efi ubi eme ku we ambe le bisinkli bisu israel eto kaso, ichise mba lela be baalo ubi eme ebukpe.

name: Sekpele
text: Lǝ nyaso Yosef átaka nya ókpa dikpefi nǝmǝ ku ni ambe nya bédu bésu Israel eto kasɔ.
normalised_text: le nyaso yosef ataka nya okpa dikpefi neme ku ni ambe nya bedu besu israel eto kaso.

name: Sekpele
text: Lǝ lefe nǝmfó ǝsuǝǝ, Ntuflǝsǝtidi Yohanes ésu mfiminti lǝ Yudea eto kasɔ, nya útsyiko letsya bobe katɛyi.
normalised_text: le lefe nemfo esuee, ntuflesetidi yohanes esu mfiminti le yudea eto kaso, nya uchiko lecha bobe kateyi.

name: Sekpele
text: nkǝ, Bítsyi mi akɔɛsi bɛwuninsǝ lǝ abuayifoyifo ǝsuǝ, itsyise Onanto eto Sekadidi eboyo selo.
normalised_text: nke, bichi mi akoesi bewuninse le abuayifoyifo esue, ichise onanto eto sekadidi eboyo selo.

name: Selee
text: Ni di Yaa labuɛ alɛ <<Ta dikpa>> ni diakpa nɛ.
normalised_text: ni di yaa labue ale ta dikpa ni diakpa ne.

name: Selee
text: Ni di Yaa lanya lɛkpa nwu alɛ dilɛ, ni aasɛ lɛkpa nwu ku ditunu ntɛɛ nɛ.
normalised_text: ni di yaa lanya lekpa ngwu ale dile, ni aase lekpa ngwu ku ditunu ntee ne.

name: Selee
text: Ni di Yaa lalɛɛ lɛkpa nwu alɛ <<Dii,>> ni aalɛɛ ditunu nwu kafɔɔ alɛ <<Kakyɛ>> nɛ. Ninfɛ kaale laloo, ni kaasɛ, dii kasale nɛ.
normalised_text: ni di yaa lalee lekpa ngwu ale dii, ni aalee ditunu ngwu kafoo ale kache ne. ninfe kaale laloo, ni kaase, dii kasale ne.

name: Selee
text: Ni di Yaa labuɛ alɛ, <<Obo kute di ntu ntɛɛ, kuɛsɛ ntu be ninkpe ni di osi ku kasɔ ntɛɛ.>>.
normalised_text: ni di yaa labue ale, obo kute di ntu ntee, kuese ntu be ninkpe ni di osi ku kaso ntee..

name: Selee
text: Nkpo oso Yaa labla obo kuasɛ ntu be ninkpe ni di obo nwu kalɔ ku mbe ninkpe ni di osi ntɛɛ. Ni diawa kaanya nɛ.
normalised_text: nkpo oso yaa labla obo kuase ntu be ninkpe ni di obo ngwu kalo ku mbe ninkpe ni di osi ntee. ni diawa kaanya ne.

name: Selee
text: Ni di Yaa lalɛɛ obo nwu alɛ, <<Kolo>> nɛ. Ni kaale laloo, ni kaasɛ, dii nyɔɔfa nɛ.
normalised_text: ni di yaa lalee obo ngwu ale, kolo ne. ni kaale laloo, ni kaase, dii nyoofa ne.

name: Selee
text: Ninfɛ di Yaa labuɛ alɛ, <<Ntu be ninkpe ni koolo kalɔ disi di lɛba ninwiii, di kasɔ kosole kadie.>> Ni diawa kaanya nɛ.
normalised_text: ninfe di yaa labue ale, ntu be ninkpe ni koolo kalo disi di leba ningwiii, di kaso kosole kadie. ni diawa kaanya ne.

name: Selee
text: Ni di Yaa lalɛɛ kakosolekɔ nwu alɛ, <<Kasɔ>>, ni aalɛɛ ntu be niasi ni lɛɛba ninwii alɛ, <<Lekpo>> nɛ. Ni di Yaa lanya alɛ dilɛ nɛ.
normalised_text: ni di yaa lalee kakosoleko ngwu ale, kaso, ni aalee ntu be niasi ni leeba ningwii ale, lekpo ne. ni di yaa lanya ale dile ne.

name: Selee
text: Ni di kasɔ lakɔntɔ sɛfa bokoboko, sɛfa se nintika ni abi ku awoso ya nintika ni awosobi ku abi ninya ate ate nɛ. Ni di Yaa lanya alɛ dilɛ nɛ.
normalised_text: ni di kaso lakonto sefa bokoboko, sefa se nintika ni abi ku awoso ya nintika ni awosobi ku abi ninya ate ate ne. ni di yaa lanya ale dile ne.

name: Selee
text: Ninfɛ di Yaa labuɛ alɛ, <<Ta sɛtɔ sidie di kolo suoto, siɛsɛ dii ku kakyɛ ntɛɛ, alɛ aale atuosaa ya nimate antootuo ni obe, ayi ku alɛɛ.
normalised_text: ninfe di yaa labue ale, ta seto sidie di kolo suoto, siese dii ku kache ntee, ale aale atuosaa ya nimate antootuo ni obe, ayi ku alee.

name: Selee
text: alɛ siale sɛtɔ di kolo suoto sintɔɔkpa di kasɔ suoto.>> Ni diawa kaanya nɛ.
normalised_text: ale siale seto di kolo suoto sintookpa di kaso suoto. ni diawa kaanya ne.

name: Selee
text: Yaa labla ɛtɔ nwu di kolo suoto alɛ siakpa di kasɔ suoto.
normalised_text: yaa labla eto ngwu di kolo suoto ale siakpa di kaso suoto.

name: Selee
text: alɛ siabla sɛkpɛ di dii ku kakyɛ kamɛ, sinsɛ lɛkpa ku ditunu ntɛɛ. Ni di Yaa lanya alɛ dilɛ nɛ.
normalised_text: ale siabla sekpe di dii ku kache kame, sinse lekpa ku ditunu ntee. ni di yaa lanya ale dile ne.

name: Selee
text: Ninfɛ di Yaa labuɛ alɛ, <<Ta asaa ya ninkpe ni nkpa ateate ayii ntu nwu kamɛ, di bakansiɛ baflɛlɛtɛ bafe di kasɔ osi di kolo anu.>>.
normalised_text: ninfe di yaa labue ale, ta asaa ya ninkpe ni nkpa ateate ayii ntu ngwu kame, di bakansie baflelete bafe di kaso osi di kolo anu..

name: Selee
text: Ninfɛ di Yaa lawii ma lɛyɔɔ aabuɛ alɛ, <<Bilofo, biɛkpɛ biyii lekpo ntu kamɛ, bakansiɛ kafɔɔ bakpɛ bayii kayi.>>.
normalised_text: ninfe di yaa lawii ma leyoo aabue ale, bilofo, biekpe biyii lekpo ntu kame, bakansie kafoo bakpe bayii kayi..

name: Selee
text: Nioso Yaa labla osuɔtɔ di nnwɔɔ omu nɔɔ letembi kanya; di Yaa letembi kanya aabla nwɔ; osuɔtɔ ku ɔsanko aabla ma.
normalised_text: nioso yaa labla osuoto di nngwoo omu noo letembi kanya; di yaa letembi kanya aabla ngwo; osuoto ku osanko aabla ma.

name: Selee
text: Ninfɛ di Yaa labuɛ alɛ, <<Lɛyɔ ɔfa biala nintika ni abi kaasɔ kamuu suoto ku kowoso biala ninkpe ni abi kaamɛ lɛta ye; alɛ aale ye alesaa.
normalised_text: ninfe di yaa labue ale, leyo ofa biala nintika ni abi kaaso kamuu suoto ku kowoso biala ninkpe ni abi kaame leta ye; ale aale ye alesaa.

name: Selee
text: Ni di Yaa lanya asaa ya amuu aabla nii alɛ ɛɛtɛ alɛ. Ninfɛ kaale laloo, ni kaasɛ, dii kuɔnle nɛ.
normalised_text: ni di yaa lanya asaa ya amuu aabla nii ale eete ale. ninfe kaale laloo, ni kaase, dii kuonle ne.

name: Selee
text: Nioso nkpo aaloo osi ku kasɔ ku asaa ya amuu ninsi ni kaamɛ ɔbla nɛ.
normalised_text: nioso nkpo aaloo osi ku kaso ku asaa ya amuu ninsi ni kaame obla ne.

name: Selee
text: Di dii kuɛnsinle Yaa laloo ɔkpɛ wɔ aatɔɔbla ni ɔbla, ni aatɛ ɔnyɛɛ di dii kuɛnsinle nwu nkpo suoto di sɛkpɛ nɔɔ ɔbla kamɛ nɛ.
normalised_text: di dii kuensinle yaa laloo okpe wo aatoobla ni obla, ni aate onyee di dii kuensinle ngwu nkpo suoto di sekpe noo obla kame ne.

name: Selee
text: Nnya mmle okle diawa ni di obe wɔ baabla ni osi ku kasɔ. Obe wɔ di SAATE Yaa labla ni kasɔ ku osi yi.
normalised_text: nnya mmle okle diawa ni di obe wo baabla ni osi ku kaso. obe wo di saate yaa labla ni kaso ku osi yi.

name: Selee
text: lepoo kamɛ kowoso kukunwii ditayila kaasɔ ee ɔfa kuonwii ditayila, diekye SAATE Yaa diita kanto anɔɔ akpete ka ee otii kuonwii nnaa abakpɛ ka nii.
normalised_text: lepoo kame kowoso kukungwii ditayila kaaso ee ofa kuongwii ditayila, dieche saate yaa diita kanto anoo akpete ka ee otii kuongwii nnaa abakpe ka nii.

name: Selee
text: Kafɔɔ seklenyii ntaa sinkye kasɔ kamɛ simakpekpete kaasɔ nwu kamuu anu.
normalised_text: kafoo seklenyii ntaa sinche kaso kame simakpekpete kaaso ngwu kamuu anu.

name: Selee
text: Ninfɛ di Saate Yaa layɔ kɔtɛ kaasɔ aabla osuɔtɔ, ni aanwuna nkpa ninwuna aakpete nwɔ di onwu kamɛ, ni di osuɔtɔ nwu lakple otii wɔ ninkpe ni nkpa nɛ.
normalised_text: ninfe di saate yaa layo kote kaaso aabla osuoto, ni aangwuna nkpa ningwuna aakpete ngwo di ongwu kame, ni di osuoto ngwu lakple otii wo ninkpe ni nkpa ne.

name: Selee
text: Ninfɛ di Saate Yaa labla kɔba di Eden, di kufĩ katunkɔ, ni aayɔ osuɔtɔ wɔ aabla nii aalaakpee ninfa nɛ.
normalised_text: ninfe di saate yaa labla koba di eden, di kufin katunko, ni aayo osuoto wo aabla nii aalaakpee ninfa ne.

name: Selee
text: Okle onwii labiɛ kuakye Eden kuatookpete kɔba nwu ntu; diayɔ ni ninfa kuasɛ kuabla ekle ɛna.
normalised_text: okle ongwii labie kuache eden kuatookpete koba ngwu ntu; diayo ni ninfa kuase kuabla ekle ena.

name: Selee
text: Ɔkasale leyooto ninle Pison, nwu ninle okle wɔ niebiɛ kuokyi ni Hawila kasɔ kamuu suoto, nfũ kooto sɛɛle nkpe ni nɛ.
normalised_text: okasale leyooto ninle pison, ngwu ninle okle wo niebie kuochi ni hawila kaso kamuu suoto, nfun kooto seele nkpe ni ne.

name: Selee
text: Okle nyɔɔfa leyooto ninle Gison, kuobiɛ kuokyi Kus kasɔ kamuu suoto.
normalised_text: okle nyoofa leyooto ninle gison, kuobie kuochi kus kaso kamuu suoto.

name: Selee
text: Okle tiɛfa leyooto ninle Tiklis nwu kuobiɛ kuofe di Assur kasɔ suoto di kufĩ katunkɔ. Okle naafa kafɔɔ ninle Eufrate nɛ.
normalised_text: okle tiefa leyooto ninle tiklis ngwu kuobie kuofe di assur kaso suoto di kufin katunko. okle naafa kafoo ninle eufrate ne.

name: Selee
text: Ninfɛ di Saate Yaa layɔ otii aakpee di Eden kɔba nwu kamɛ alɛ akpɛ aatoonyu kũ nɛ.
normalised_text: ninfe di saate yaa layo otii aakpee di eden koba ngwu kame ale akpe aatoonyu kun ne.

name: Sena
text: Apapela djakuBhelekiwa kaka Yesu Kristo, agnwAna‐Davida, gnwAna‐Abrahama.

normalised_text: saka mwari akaita nzvimbo uye akaparadzanisa mvura yakanga iri pasi penzvimbo iyi kubva pamvura yakanga iri pamusoro payo. uye zvakaita saizvozvo.

name: Shona
text: Mwari akatumidza nzvimbo iyi kuti denga. Uye madekwana akavapo, namangwanani akavapo, zuva rechipiri.

name: Shona

normalised_text: mwari akatumidza nzvimbo, akati denga. madeko akavapo, namangwanani akavapo, zuva repiri.

name: Shona
text: Mwari akatumidza ziendanakuenda riya kuti denga. Kwakasviba kukaedza, iri rakava zuva rechipiri.
normalised_text: mwari akatumidza ziendanakuenda riya kuti denga. kwakasviba kukaedza, iri rakava zuva rechipiri.

name: Shoo-Minda-Nye
text: A Kwã nang cwa ya ka daa aganggang Yesɔ Almasihuː, ka lado kwə Dauda, angye nang kanə lado Ibrayi ni.
normalised_text: a kwan nang chwa ya ka daa aganggang yeso almasihu, ka lado kwe dauda, angye nang kane lado ibrayi ni.

name: Shoo-Minda-Nye
text: Ibrayi mya Ishaku, Ishaku mya Yakubu, Yakubu mya Yahuda ɓa nwi naa gɔ ɓa.
normalised_text: ibrayi mya ishaku, ishaku mya yakubu, yakubu mya yahuda ba nwi naa go ba.

name: Shoo-Minda-Nye
text: Yahuda mya Feresa, ɓa Zera, naa gaɓa ka Tamar, Feresa mya Hasruna, Hasruna mya Aram.
normalised_text: yahuda mya feresa, ba zera, naa gaba ka tamar, feresa mya hasruna, hasruna mya aram.

name: Shoo-Minda-Nye
text: Aram mya Amminadab, Amminadab mya Nashoo, Nashoo mya Salmon.
normalised_text: aram mya amminadab, amminadab mya nashoo, nashoo mya salmon.

name: Shoo-Minda-Nye
text: Salmon mya Boaza, nɛ Rahab, Boaza mya Obida nɛ Rut Obida mya Yesse.
normalised_text: salmon mya boaza, ne rahab, boaza mya obida ne rut obida mya yesse.

name: Shoo-Minda-Nye
text: Jesse mya kwə Dauda. Dauda mya Solomo angye nang nlo naa gɔ kanə gwa wii Uriya ni.
normalised_text: jesse mya kwe dauda. dauda mya solomo angye nang nlo naa go kane gwa wii uriya ni.

name: Shoo-Minda-Nye
text: Solomo mya Rehobowam, Rehobowam mya Abija, Abija mya Asa.
normalised_text: solomo mya rehobowam, rehobowam mya abija, abija mya asa.

name: Shoo-Minda-Nye
text: Asa mya Jehoshafat, Jehoshafat mya Yoram, Yoram mya Azariya.
normalised_text: asa mya jehoshafat, jehoshafat mya yoram, yoram mya azariya.

name: Shoo-Minda-Nye
text: Azariya mya Jotam, Jotam mya Ahaz, Ahaz mya Hezekiya.
normalised_text: azariya mya jotam, jotam mya ahaz, ahaz mya hezekiya.

name: Shoo-Minda-Nye
text: Hezekiya mya Manase, Manase mya Ama, Ama mya Josiya.
normalised_text: hezekiya mya manase, manase mya ama, ama mya josiya.

name: Shoo-Minda-Nye
text: Josiya mya Jikoniya, ɓa nwinyɔ ɓa sade nang mu ɓanə gha nə la kəmi Babila.
normalised_text: josiya mya jikoniya, ba nwinyo ba sade nang mu bane gha ne la kemi babila.

name: Shoo-Minda-Nye
text: La zənze nang ɓa mu nə ngwi Isrela gha nə la Babila niː kə Jikoniya mya nə Shayatiyel, Shayatiyel mya Zerubabel.
normalised_text: la zenze nang ba mu ne ngwi isrela gha ne la babila ni ke jikoniya mya ne shayatiyel, shayatiyel mya zerubabel.

name: Shoo-Minda-Nye
text: Zerubabel mya Abihudu, Abihudu mya Eliyakim, Eliyakim mya Azuro.
normalised_text: zerubabel mya abihudu, abihudu mya eliyakim, eliyakim mya azuro.

name: Shoo-Minda-Nye
text: Azuro mya Zadok, Zadok mya Akimu, Akimu mya Aliyuda.
normalised_text: azuro mya zadok, zadok mya akimu, akimu mya aliyuda.

name: Shoo-Minda-Nye
text: Aliyuda mya Eleyaza, Eleyaza mya matana, matana mya Yakubu.
normalised_text: aliyuda mya eleyaza, eleyaza mya matana, matana mya yakubu.

name: Shoo-Minda-Nye
text: Yakubu mya Yusufu ogɔn Maryamu nang mya Yesɔ ni. Angye nang ɓa kwi wanə Almasihuː ni.
normalised_text: yakubu mya yusufu ogon maryamu nang mya yeso ni. angye nang ba kwi wane almasihu ni.

name: Shoo-Minda-Nye
text: Ka nang mya yi Yesɔ Almasihuː yaː Yusufu na vuta sa nɛ Yesɔ Maryamu, ama bako gɔ lu fyewa ni, ku mewa ɓa lanə lasa Yingu Nyimoː.
normalised_text: ka nang mya yi yeso almasihu ya yusufu na vuta sa ne yeso maryamu, ama bako go lu fyewa ni, ku mewa ba lane lasa yingu nyimo.

name: Shoo-Minda-Nye
text: Yonəmani Yusufu nwinwon gɔ ka ngwi adede fi shan la na nawa sako lasa nəngwi ɓa. Kə cheng la sɛgwɔn wa shã na tawa ɓe lakənkən.
normalised_text: yonemani yusufu nwinwon go ka ngwi adede fi shan la na nawa sako lasa nengwi ba. ke cheng la segwon wa shan na tawa be lakenken.

name: Shoo-Minda-Nye
text: U mya Nwi, ka nayɔ Yesɔ yonəmani u pong ngwi gɔɓa lasa nang anjɔ gaɓa.>>.
normalised_text: u mya nwi, ka nayo yeso yonemani u pong ngwi goba lasa nang anjo gaba..

name: Shoo-Minda-Nye
text: Nang ɓani ku nə nang ni yona pɛ nang Daa shayonki cwanə la dang ngwi dangdoswɔn ɓa ya;.
normalised_text: nang bani ku ne nang ni yona pe nang daa shayonki chwane la dang ngwi dangdoswon ba ya;.

name: Shoo-Minda-Nye
text: <<Nwi anəngwa nang nyinə nyənənwon lani u cwe la u mya nwi, ɛ nayɔ wa Immanuwel.>> danfĩ yaa Immanuwel Kəɓənə, << Nyimoː ngənə ɓɛ.>>.
normalised_text: nwi anengwa nang nyine nyenenwon lani u chwe la u mya nwi, e nayo wa immanuwel. danfin yaa immanuwel kebene, nyimo ngene be..

name: Shoo-Minda-Nye
text: Sade nang Yusufu lwe nə la yinga ni, ku nənang maleka Daa shayonki cwa wanə ni, kə u cwe Maryamu ngə nə gwa wa.
normalised_text: sade nang yusufu lwe ne la yinga ni, ku nenang maleka daa shayonki chwa wane ni, ke u chwe maryamu nge ne gwa wa.

name: Shoo-Minda-Nye
text: Ama u nyi wanə nyəngwa nla, kə lazənze mya nə nwi ni, kəfi Yusufu nayɔ Yesɔ.
normalised_text: ama u nyi wane nyengwa nla, ke lazenze mya ne nwi ni, kefi yusufu nayo yeso.

name: Shoo-Minda-Nye
text: A mya Yesɔ la Betalami la kəmi Yahudiya, la sapyang nang Hiridu kanə kwə ni, kə ngwi nyi byə̃ng ɓa lwe ɓenwe mɓa la Urshelima.
normalised_text: a mya yeso la betalami la kemi yahudiya, la sapyang nang hiridu kane kwe ni, ke ngwi nyi byenng ba lwe benwe mba la urshelima.

name: Shoo-Minda-Nye
text: kə ɓa byədo, <<laje kəɓa mya nə kwə Yahudawa ɓani ma? Je sang byə gɔ la ɓenwe kə mɓa ɓi nawa gang.>>.
normalised_text: ke ba byedo, laje keba mya ne kwe yahudawa bani ma? je sang bye go la benwe ke mba bi nawa gang..

name: Shoo-Minda-Nye
text: Sadə nang kwə Hiridu wanə na nangni kə yii gwa wa, ɓa ngwi Urshelima ɓaku.
normalised_text: sade nang kwe hiridu wane na nangni ke yii gwa wa, ba ngwi urshelima baku.

name: Shoo-Minda-Nye
text: Hiridu ɓwanə nwanye ngwi nyanang ɓa, ngwi maɓesa nangzhĩ Musa ɓa kə ɓyə ɓa yido anwa a mya nə Almasihuː ni.
normalised_text: hiridu bwane nwanye ngwi nyanang ba, ngwi mabesa nangzhin musa ba ke bye ba yido anwa a mya ne almasihu ni.

name: Shoo-Minda-Nye
text: kəɓa ye waya la Betalami, la kəmi Yahudiya, yonemani nankenə ngwi dangdoswɔn jwanə.
normalised_text: keba ye waya la betalami, la kemi yahudiya, yonemani nankene ngwi dangdoswon jwane.

name: Shoo-Minda-Nye
text: kə Hiridu kwi ngwi nyi byəng ɓa sɔ kə byə ɓa jwanjwa, yona u nyi nən laloo ɓa sang nə sɛ ni.
normalised_text: ke hiridu kwi ngwi nyi byeng ba so ke bye ba jwanjwa, yona u nyi nen laloo ba sang ne se ni.

name: Shoo-Minda-Nye
text: kə swon ɓa la betalami ku ya,<<bang sang nwi sɔ nəɓwɔ, sade nang u mewa ngɔn ni kə gəmə nyi, yonəmani kə gəmə ma gha nawa gang.>> gema nwami jua.
normalised_text: ke swon ba la betalami ku ya,bang sang nwi so nebwo, sade nang u mewa ngon ni ke geme nyi, yonemani ke geme ma gha nawa gang. gema nwami jua.

name: Sisaala, Tumulung
text: Dʋnɩa fa bɩ kʋŋkala naga, ʋ fa pɩŋ hoi nɛ. Leriŋ kala fa bire nɛ, ka Wɩa Dɩma zɩzaarɛ lɩɩŋ nyuŋ.
normalised_text: dunia fa bi kungkala naga, u fa ping hoi ne. lering kala fa bire ne, ka wia dima zizaare liing nyung.

name: Sisaala, Tumulung
text: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa bʋl, Leŋ dɩ pʋlʋmʋŋ chaanɛ, ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ chaanɛ.
normalised_text: ngii ne wia bul, leng di pulumung chaane, ngii ne u chaane.

name: Sisaala, Tumulung
text: Wɩa na pʋlʋmʋŋ zɔmɔ, ʋ kɛŋ pʋlʋmʋŋ arɩ birimiŋ kaa pɔrɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ.
normalised_text: wia na pulumung zomo, u keng pulumung ari biriming kaa pore dongo le.

name: Sisaala, Tumulung
text: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa kɛŋ pʋlʋmʋŋ kaa yɩyɩrɛ wɩɩhɛyɛ aŋ kɛŋ birimiŋ ma yɩyɩrɛ tɩtaŋɩŋ. Wɩa jʋʋ dɩdaanɩŋ, taŋ pʋl chʋchʋɔŋ, chɛ-bumbuŋ nɛ ŋɩɩ.
normalised_text: ngii ne wia keng pulumung kaa yiyire wiiheye ang keng biriming ma yiyire titanging. wia juu didaaning, tang pul chuchuong, chebumbung ne ngii.

name: Sisaala, Tumulung
text: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa bʋl, Leŋ dɩ lɩɩŋ kpaa balɩa aŋ ka wuoluŋ pɩŋ.
normalised_text: ngii ne wia bul, leng di liing kpaa balia ang ka wuolung ping.

name: Sisaala, Tumulung
text: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ kpaa, aŋ ka wuoluŋ, dɔŋɔ hɛ nyuŋ, dɔŋɔ ma hɛ bʋbʋɔŋ.
normalised_text: ngii ne u kpaa, ang ka wuolung, dongo he nyung, dongo ma he bubuong.

name: Sisaala, Tumulung
text: Wɩa kɛŋ wuol-la sɩ hɛ ba pɛgɛ kaa yɩyɩrɛ wɩa-nyuŋ. Wɩa jʋʋ dɩdaanɩŋ, taŋ pʋl chʋchʋɔŋ, chɛ-lɩamɩŋ nɛ ŋɩɩ.
normalised_text: wia keng wuolla si he ba pege kaa yiyire wianyung. wia juu didaaning, tang pul chuchuong, cheliaming ne ngii.

name: Sisaala, Tumulung
text: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa bʋl, Leŋ dɩ lɩɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ bʋbʋɔŋ kʋ hɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ aŋ ka tintee-hɩlɩŋ, ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ ŋaa.
normalised_text: ngii ne wia bul, leng di liing kala si he bubuong ku he dongo le ang ka tinteehiling, ngii ne u ngaa.

name: Sisaala, Tumulung
text: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa kɛŋ dɩ-hɩlɩɩ-la kaa yɩyɩrɛ tinteeŋ aŋ kɛŋ lɩɩ-la sɩ hɛ bʋbʋɔŋ ma yɩyɩrɛ mʋgʋ-balɩŋ. Wɩa na dɩ ʋ zɔmɔ.
normalised_text: ngii ne wia keng dihiliila kaa yiyire tinteeng ang keng liila si he bubuong ma yiyire mugubaling. wia na di u zomo.

name: Sisaala, Tumulung
text: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa bʋl, Leŋ dɩ kʋŋkala sɩɩ nɛŋ, yaŋ arɩ tɩɩsɩŋ, nyʋ. Ŋɩɩ sɛnɛ ŋaa.
normalised_text: ngii ne wia bul, leng di kungkala sii neng, yang ari tiising, nyu. ngii sene ngaa.

name: Sisaala, Tumulung
text: Ŋɩɩ nɛ yaŋ arɩ tɩɩsɩ-la nyʋ a kɛŋ doho. Ʋ na dɩ ba kala zɔmɔ.
normalised_text: ngii ne yang ari tiisila nyu a keng doho. u na di ba kala zomo.

name: Sisaala, Tumulung
text: Wɩa jʋʋ dɩdaanɩŋ, taŋ pʋl chʋchʋɔŋ, chɛ-torimuŋ chɛɛŋ nɛ ŋɩɩ.
normalised_text: wia juu didaaning, tang pul chuchuong, chetorimung cheeng ne ngii.

name: Sisaala, Tumulung
text: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa bɩra bʋl, Leŋ dɩ pʋlʋmʋŋ chaanɛ wɩa-nyuŋ a kɛŋ wɩɩhɛyɛ arɩ tɩtaŋɩŋ pɔrɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ, a magɩlɛ tapʋlaa, chɛnsɩŋ arɩ jɩsɩŋ dɩ-suomuŋ.
normalised_text: ngii ne wia bira bul, leng di pulumung chaane wianyung a keng wiiheye ari titanging pore dongo le, a magile tapulaa, chensing ari jising disuomung.

name: Sisaala, Tumulung
text: dɩ ba chaanɛ wɩa-nyuŋ dɩ tinteeŋ kɛŋ pʋlʋmʋŋ. Ŋɩɩ sɛnɛ ŋaa.
normalised_text: di ba chaane wianyung di tinteeng keng pulumung. ngii sene ngaa.

name: Sisaala, Tumulung
text: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa ŋaa pʋlʋŋ balaa balɩa, ba tʋɔŋ kʋbalɩŋ pʋpɔsɛ wɩɩhɛyɛ, ka kʋbie ma pʋpɔsɛ tɩtaŋɩŋ, a ŋaa chɛnwʋlaa ma.
normalised_text: ngii ne wia ngaa pulung balaa balia, ba tuong kubaling pupose wiiheye, ka kubie ma pupose titanging, a ngaa chenwulaa ma.

name: Sisaala, Tumulung
text: Wɩa ŋaa pʋlʋŋ bala-la hɛ wɩa-nyuŋ nɛ dɩ ba chɩchaanɛ tinteeŋ.
normalised_text: wia ngaa pulung balala he wianyung ne di ba chichaane tinteeng.

name: Sisaala, Tumulung
text: dɩ ba pʋpɔsɛ wɩɩhɛyɛ arɩ tɩtaŋɩŋ a kɛŋ pʋlʋmʋŋ arɩ birimiŋ pɔrɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa na dɩ ba zɔmɔ.
normalised_text: di ba pupose wiiheye ari titanging a keng pulumung ari biriming pore dongo le. ngii ne wia na di ba zomo.

name: Sisaala, Tumulung
text: Wɩa jʋʋ dɩdaanɩŋ, taŋ pʋl chʋchʋɔŋ, chɛ-nɛsɩmɩŋ nɛ ŋɩɩ.
normalised_text: wia juu didaaning, tang pul chuchuong, chenesiming ne ngii.

name: Sisaala, Tumulung
text: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa bʋl, Leŋ dɩ kɩalɩŋ sɩ jaŋ hɛ lɩɩŋ tʋɔŋ a kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ kɔ, dɩ wɩa-nyuŋ fillee maa zaarɛ.
normalised_text: ngii ne wia bul, leng di kialing si jang he liing tuong a keng miising ko, di wianyung fillee maa zaare.

name: Sisaala, Tumulung
text: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa ŋaa lɩɩ-jʋʋraa arɩ mʋgʋ-balɩŋ tʋɔŋ kɩaa doho doho arɩ fillee kala sɩ hɛ wɩa-nyuŋ. Wɩa na dɩ ba zɔmɔ.
normalised_text: ngii ne wia ngaa liijuuraa ari mugubaling tuong kiaa doho doho ari fillee kala si he wianyung. wia na di ba zomo.

name: Sisaala, Tumulung
text: Wɩa pɛ ba lɛ aŋ bʋl, Má pʋŋa su lɩɩŋ kala aŋ ka fillee ma pʋŋa su tinteeŋ.
normalised_text: wia pe ba le ang bul, ma punga su liing kala ang ka fillee ma punga su tinteeng.

name: Sisaala, Tumulung
text: Wɩa jʋʋ dɩdaanɩŋ, taŋ pʋl chʋchʋɔŋ, chɛ-nɔmʋŋ nɛ ŋɩɩ.
normalised_text: wia juu didaaning, tang pul chuchuong, chenomung ne ngii.

name: Sisaala, Tumulung
text: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa bʋl, Leŋ dɩ bagɩlaa arɩ pʋsʋŋ kala arɩ kɩalɩŋ kala sɩɩ tuuri tinteeŋ kɛŋ doho. Ba kala hɛ nɩmɛ a kɛŋ doho. Ŋɩɩ sɛnɛ ŋaa.
normalised_text: ngii ne wia bul, leng di bagilaa ari pusung kala ari kialing kala sii tuuri tinteeng keng doho. ba kala he nime a keng doho. ngii sene ngaa.

name: Sisaala, Tumulung
text: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa ŋaa nuhuobiinee ba nagʋ, baal arɩ haal.
normalised_text: ngii ne wia ngaa nuhuobiinee ba nagu, baal ari haal.

name: Sisaala, Tumulung
text: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa bʋl, Mɩ joŋ kʋnɛnɛɛ arɩ tɩɩnɛnɛɛ kala pɩma nɛ, ba jaŋ ŋaa ma kʋdiilee.
normalised_text: ngii ne wia bul, mi jong kunenee ari tiinenee kala pima ne, ba jang ngaa ma kudiilee.

name: Sisaala, Tumulung
text: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa bee na kɩalɩŋ kala ʋ sɩ ŋaa dɩ ba zɔmɔ woruŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ wɩa jʋʋ dɩdaanɩŋ, taŋ pʋl chʋchʋɔŋ, chɛ-dʋmʋŋ nɛ ŋɩɩ.
normalised_text: ngii ne wia bee na kialing kala u si ngaa di ba zomo worung. ngii ne wia juu didaaning, tang pul chuchuong, chedumung ne ngii.

name: Sisaala, Tumulung
text: Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ ŋaa tinteeŋ arɩ wɩa-nyuŋ arɩ kɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ ba lɛ dɛrɛ.
normalised_text: ngii ne u ngaa tinteeng ari wianyung ari kialing kala si he ba le dere.

name: Sisaala, Tumulung
text: Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa dɛrɛ ʋ tɩntɩŋŋaa aŋ wiesi chɛ-pɛmɩŋ.
normalised_text: ngii ne wia dere u tintingngaa ang wiesi chepeming.

name: Sisaala, Tumulung
text: Wɩa joŋ ʋ nɩsɩŋ daŋ tapʋl-pɛɩ-la lɛ a leŋ ʋ ŋaa tapʋl-zɔŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa tapʋlɩɩ-la nɛ ʋ tɩŋ ʋ tɩntɩŋŋaa dɛrɛ aŋ wiesi.
normalised_text: wia jong u nising dang tapulpeila le a leng u ngaa tapulzong, bee wiaa tapuliila ne u ting u tintingngaa dere ang wiesi.

name: Sisaala, Tumulung
text: Wɩa-nyuŋ arɩ tinteeŋ ŋaanɩŋ naasɩŋ nɛ ŋɩɩ. La TƖƖNA Wɩa fa sɩ ŋaa wɩa-nyuŋ arɩ tinteeŋ.
normalised_text: wianyung ari tinteeng ngaaning naasing ne ngii. la tiina wia fa si ngaa wianyung ari tinteeng.

name: Siwu
text: Yesu Kristo gɔ nɖe Igara David ɔwa tɛtɛ, fiɛ David ɔ̃ wũ ɔɖe Abraham ɔwa ɔɣekparɛ i ngbe ne.
normalised_text: yesu kristo go nde igara david owa tete, fie david on wun ode abraham owa oghekpare i ngbe ne.

name: Siwu
text: Abraham ɔɣe Isak, Isak ɔ̃ wũ ɔɣe Yakob gɔ loɣe Yuda ku ɔ̃ manyiibi.
normalised_text: abraham oghe isak, isak on wun oghe yakob go loghe yuda ku on manyiibi.

name: Siwu
text: Yuda gu ɔ̃ ɔre Tamai ɔɣe Perez gu Zera, fiɛ Perez ɔɣe Hezron, Hezron ɔɣe Aram.
normalised_text: yuda gu on ore tamai oghe perez gu zera, fie perez oghe hezron, hezron oghe aram.

name: Siwu
text: Aram ɔ̃ wũ ɔɣe Aminadab, Aminadab ɔɣe Naheson, Naheson ɔɣe Salmon.
normalised_text: aram on wun oghe aminadab, aminadab oghe naheson, naheson oghe salmon.

name: Siwu
text: Salmon gu ɔ̃ ɔre Rahab ɔɣe Boaz fiɛ Boaz gu ɔ̃ ɔre Rut ɔɣe Obed, Obed ɔɣe Isai.
normalised_text: salmon gu on ore rahab oghe boaz fie boaz gu on ore rut oghe obed, obed oghe isai.

name: Siwu
text: Salomo ɔɣe Rehoboam, Rehoboam ɔ̃ wũ ɔɣe Abiya, Abiya ɔɣe Asa.
normalised_text: salomo oghe rehoboam, rehoboam on wun oghe abiya, abiya oghe asa.

name: Siwu
text: Asa ɔɣe Yosafat, Yosafat ɔɣe Yoram, fiɛ Yoram ɔɣe Uzia.
normalised_text: asa oghe yosafat, yosafat oghe yoram, fie yoram oghe uzia.

name: Siwu
text: Uzia ɔɣe Yotam fiɛ Yotam ɔɣe Ahaz, Ahaz ɔɣe Hezekia.
normalised_text: uzia oghe yotam fie yotam oghe ahaz, ahaz oghe hezekia.

name: Siwu
text: fiɛ Hezekia ɔɣe Manase gɔ loɣe Amon, Amon ɔɣe Yosia.
normalised_text: fie hezekia oghe manase go loghe amon, amon oghe yosia.

name: Siwu
text: Yosia ɔɣe Yekoniya gu ɔ̃ manyiibi ku ɔwi gɔ makɛlɛ sisande ame i Babilonia.
normalised_text: yosia oghe yekoniya gu on manyiibi ku owi go makele sisande ame i babilonia.

name: Siwu
text: Gɔ mabɔrɛ i sisande ame i Babilonia maba kama ne, Yekoniya ɔɣe Sealtiel fiɛ Sealtiel ɔɣe Zerubabel.
normalised_text: go mabore i sisande ame i babilonia maba kama ne, yekoniya oghe sealtiel fie sealtiel oghe zerubabel.

name: Siwu
text: Zerubabel ɔɣe Abihud, Abihud ɔ̃ wũ ɔɣe Elyakim fiɛ Elyakim ɔɣe Azur.
normalised_text: zerubabel oghe abihud, abihud on wun oghe elyakim fie elyakim oghe azur.

name: Siwu
text: Azur ɔɣe Zadok, Zadok ɔɣe Akim, Akim ɔɣe Elihud.
normalised_text: azur oghe zadok, zadok oghe akim, akim oghe elihud.

name: Siwu
text: Elihud ɔɣe Eleazar, Eleazar ɔɣe Matan, fiɛ Matan ɔɣe Yakob.
normalised_text: elihud oghe eleazar, eleazar oghe matan, fie matan oghe yakob.

name: Siwu
text: Yakob ɔɣe Yosef gɔ loyiri Maria, Maria gɔ loɣe Yesu gɔ marɔ sɔ Kristo.
normalised_text: yakob oghe yosef go loyiri maria, maria go loghe yesu go maro so kristo.

name: Siwu
text: Yosef ɖe ɔturi bɔlɔlɔa i Ɣaa anɔ, ɣɛɛ gɔ ɔ̃ito ɔbie sɔ ɔ̃apia Maria kunuarɛ ɔso ne, ɔbie sɔ ɔ̃anyua ɔrɔ̃go i iwɛrɛ ame.
normalised_text: yosef de oturi bololoa i ghaa ano, ghee go onito obie so onapia maria kunuare oso ne, obie so onanyua orongo i iwere ame.

name: Siwu
text: Ɔto ɔ̃aɣe ɔbirɛrɛĩ, tã wũ iyere sɔ Yesu, alasɔ ɔ̃ loaɖi ɔ̃ maturi ɔbɔrɛgu i ma akpi ame ne.
normalised_text: oto onaghe obirerein, tan wun iyere so yesu, alaso on loadi on maturi oboregu i ma akpi ame ne.

name: Siwu
text: Nwagbe ɔɖuɖu ɔba sɔ si nnɛ i Ɣaa ɔɣɛ ɔkigu i ɔ̃ kanyaɖidze ɔwɛ̃ iso aaba i ne ame sɔ.
normalised_text: nwagbe odudu oba so si nne i ghaa oghe okigu i on kanyadije owen iso aaba i ne ame so.

name: Siwu
text: Ɔbitɛ gɔ loiɣe ɔrɛrɛ̃ to ɔ̃ala kayiri ɔɣe ɔbi birɛrɛĩ. Maatã wũ iyere sɔ Imanuel, gɔ karɔ̃ nɖe sɔ Ɣaa piagu bo.
normalised_text: obite go loighe oreren to onala kayiri oghe obi birerein. maatan wun iyere so imanuel, go karon nde so ghaa piagu bo.

name: Siwu
text: Ne ɔso gɔ Yosef ɔta ne, ɔyiri Maria lɛ kumɛgɔ i Ɣaa kpabo ɔɣere wũ awe.
normalised_text: ne oso go yosef ota ne, oyiri maria le kumego i ghaa kpabo oghere wun awe.

name: Siwu
text: Ɣɛɛ ne, Yosef iirɛgu wũ gbɔgbɔɔgbɔ Maria ɔɣe ɔ̃ ɔbi ɖeakatɔ̃ gɔ nɖe ɔbi birɛrɛĩ, fiɛ Yosef ɔtã wũ iyere sɔ Yesu.
normalised_text: ghee ne, yosef iiregu wun gbogboogbo maria oghe on obi deakaton go nde obi birerein, fie yosef otan wun iyere so yesu.

name: Siwu
text: Gɔ maba ne, makarɛ sɔ, Lɛ maɣe ɔbi gɔ loaɖe ma Yudase igara? Bonya ɔ̃ iwãmi i kuɣɛ̃kabɔrɛkɔ̃ ɔso boba sɔ si boba boasumu wũ.
normalised_text: go maba ne, makare so, le maghe obi go loade ma yudase igara? bonya on iwanmi i kughenkaborekon oso boba so si boba boasumu wun.

name: Siwu
text: Gɔ Igara Herodes ɔnɔ itɔ̃me nɛgbe ne, itidza ɔ̃ gu mma ɔɖuɖu mpia i Yerusalem gbaã.
normalised_text: go igara herodes ono itonme negbe ne, itija on gu mma odudu mpia i yerusalem gbaan.

name: Siwu
text: Ne ɔso ɔkpere masɔrɛdze makpakpa ɔɖuɖu gu mmara matedze ɔsirakanya ɔkarɛ ma sɔ, Lɛ maaɣe Kristo.
normalised_text: ne oso okpere masoreje makpakpa odudu gu mmara mateje osirakanya okare ma so, le maaghe kristo.

name: Siwu
text: Ne maɣere wũ sɔ, Maɣɛ sɔ maaɣe wũ i Betlehem ɔmagɛ̃ ame i Yudea ala Ɣaa kanyaɖidze ɔwɛ̃ ɔtsɛrɛ ɔsɛ sɔ.
normalised_text: ne maghere wun so, maghe so maaghe wun i betlehem omagen ame i yudea ala ghaa kanyadije owen ochere ose so.

name: Siwu
text: Ne kama ne, Herodes ɔkpere mafɔ ma lobɔrɛ i kuɣɛ̃kabɔrɛkɔ̃ ɔnɔwɛ̃ ɔkɛlɛgu kawɛrɛkɔ̃ sɔ si ɔtsue ɔwi gɔ tutuutu manya iwãmi nɛmɔ.
normalised_text: ne kama ne, herodes okpere mafo ma lobore i kughenkaborekon onowen okelegu kawerekon so si ochue owi go tutuutu manya iwanmi nemo.

name: Siwu
text: Ne kama gɔ makpese ne, Ɣaa ɔsɛ̃ ɔtã ma i kurɛ ame sɔ madaasɛ maaki i Herodes kɔrɛ. Ne ɔso maki ɔri mama marui makɛlɛ ma aɖe.
normalised_text: ne kama go makpese ne, ghaa osen otan ma i kure ame so madaase maaki i herodes kore. ne oso maki ori mama marui makele ma ade.

name: Siwu
text: Kasɛ̃ gamɔ ame ame ne, Yosef ɔta ɔkɔ ɔbi gu ɔnyi marui matere makɛlɛ Egipte.
normalised_text: kasen gamo ame ame ne, yosef ota oko obi gu onyi marui matere makele egipte.

name: Siwu
text: Mawe i mmɔ gbɔgbɔɔgbɔ Herodes ɔkpi. Iba ngbɔ sɔ si nnɛ i Ɣaa kanyaɖidze ɔwɛ̃ ɔtsɛrɛ ɔsɛ aaba i ne ame sɔ, Ta Egipte lokpere wũ Ɔbi lobɔrɛgu.
normalised_text: mawe i mmo gbogboogbo herodes okpi. iba ngbo so si nne i ghaa kanyadije owen ochere ose aaba i ne ame so, ta egipte lokpere wun obi loboregu.

name: Siwu
text: Mabi iɖoe nɛgbe ɔba sɔ si nnɛ i Ɣaa kanyaɖidze Yeremia ɔɣɛ ɔsɛ aaba i ne ame sɔ.
normalised_text: mabi idoe negbe oba so si nne i ghaa kanyadije yeremia oghe ose aaba i ne ame so.

name: Soga
text: Ensi yali ndhereere era nga ntabuletabule enzikiiza yali egemye ku nhandha, era ng'omwoyo gwa Katonda gumaamiire amaadhi.
normalised_text: ensi yari ndhereere era nga ntavuretavure enzikiiza yari egemye ku nhandha, era ngomwoyo gwa katonda gumaamiire amaadhi.

name: Soga
text: Agho Katonda yaakoba ati: Ghabeegho obutangaavu, Era obutangaavu bwabaagho.
normalised_text: agho katonda yaakova ati ghaveegho ovutangaavu, era ovutangaavu vwavaagho.

name: Soga
text: Katonda yaabona nga kikalamu okubaagho obutangaavu. Agho yaayawula obutangaavu ku nzikiiza.
normalised_text: katonda yaavona nga kikaramu okuvaagho ovutangaavu. agho yaayawura ovutangaavu ku nzikiiza.

name: Soga
text: Obutangaavu yaabweta Omusana, ate enzikiiza yaagyeta Obwire. Bwaziba era bwakya olwo lwaba nga n'olunaku olusooka.
normalised_text: ovutangaavu yaavweta omusana, ate enzikiiza yaajeta ovwire. vwaziva era vwacha orwo rwava nga norunaku orusooka.

name: Soga
text: Agho Katonda yaakoba ati: Ghabeegho ekyawulamu amaadhi, kyawulengamu amaadhi ghabiri. Era kyaba kityo.

name: Soga
text: Katonda yaataagho ekyawulamu amaadhi agali ghaigulu n'ago agali ghansi.
normalised_text: katonda yaataagho echawuramu amaadhi agari ghaiguru nago agari ghansi.

text: Ekyawulamu ekyo Katonda yaakyeta Eigulu. Bwaziba era bwakya olwo lwaba nga n'olunaku olwokubiri.

name: Soga
text: Agho Katonda yaakoba ati: Amaadhi agali ghansi gh'eigulu geesololeze ghalala, olwo obukalu buboneke. Era kyaba kityo.
normalised_text: agho katonda yaakova ati amaadhi agari ghansi gheiguru geesororeze gharara, orwo ovukaru vuvoneke. era chava kityo.

name: Soga
text: Obukalu obwo Katonda yaabweta Ensi, ate amaadhi agaali geesoloiza yageeta Enhandha. Katonda yaakibona nga kikalamu.

name: Soga
text: Agho Katonda yaakoba ati: Ensi eidheku ebimera ebya buli nsambo: ebyo ebitaaku ensigo, n'emiti egitaaku ebibala omuli ensigo dhaagyo. Era kyaba kityo.
normalised_text: agho katonda yaakova ati ensi eidheku evimera evya vuri nsambo evyo evitaaku ensigo, nemiti egitaaku evivara omuri ensigo dhaajo. era chava kityo.

name: Soga
text: Ensi yaidhaku ebimera ebya buli nsambo ebyo ebitaaku ensigo, n'emiti egitaaku ebibala omuli ensigo dhaagyo. Katonda yaakibona nga kikalamu.
normalised_text: ensi yaidhaku evimera evya vuri nsambo evyo evitaaku ensigo, nemiti egitaaku evivara omuri ensigo dhaajo. katonda yaakivona nga kikaramu.

text: Agho Katonda yaakoba ati: Ghabeegho ebyaka ku igulu, okwawulagho omusana n'obwire bibenga obumanhiso obw'ebiseera, obw'enaku, n'obw'emyaka.
normalised_text: agho katonda yaakova ati ghaveegho evyaka ku iguru, okwawuragho omusana novwire vivenga ovumanhiso ovweviseera, ovwenaku, novwemyaka.

name: Soga
text: era byakirenga ku igulu okumuliikirira ensi. Era kyaba kityo.
normalised_text: era vyakirenga ku iguru okumuriikirira ensi. era chava kityo.

text: Katonda yaakola ebyaka ebikologho bibiri ekyaka einho nga kya kufuganga musana, ate ekyaka akatono nga kya kufuganga bwire. Era yaakola n'emuunienie.

normalised_text: vifugenga omusana novwire, era vyawurengagho ovutangaavu ku nzikiiza. katonda yaakivona nga kikaramu.

name: Soga
text: Bwaziba era bwakya, olwo lwaba nga n'olunaku olwokuna.

text: Agho Katonda yaakoba ati: Amaadhi gabeemu ebitonde ebiramu ebya buli nsambo, era mu ibbanga mubeemu enhonhi nga dhiguluka.

name: Soga
text: Yaabigha enkabi ati: Muzaale, mwale, mwidhuze enhandha, era n'enhonhi dhaale ku nsi.
normalised_text: yaavigha enkavi ati muzaare, mware, mwidhuze enhandha, era nenhonhi dhaare ku nsi.

name: Soga
text: Agho Katonda yaakoba ati: Ensi eidheku ebiramu ebya buli nsambo: ensolo enfuge, n'edh'omu nsiko, n'ebyeghaluliza ku itaka. Era kyaba kityo.
normalised_text: agho katonda yaakova ati ensi eidheku eviramu evya vuri nsambo ensoro emfuge, nedhomu nsiko, nevyegharuriza ku itaka. era chava kityo.

text: Agho Katonda yaatonda abantu mu mboneka ye yeene, yaatonda omusaadha n'omukazi.

name: Soga
text: Era yaabagha enkabi, yaabakoba ati: Muzaale, mwale, mwidhuze ensi, mugifuge. Mufugenga ebyenhandha n'enhonhi, na kiisi kiramu ekitambula ku nsi.
normalised_text: era yaavagha enkavi, yaavakova ati muzaare, mware, mwidhuze ensi, mugifuge. mufugenga evyenhandha nenhonhi, na kiisi kiramu ekitambura ku nsi.

name: Soga
text: Katonda yaabona bye yakola, byamusangaaza inho. Bwaziba era bwakya olwo lwaba nga n'olunaku olwomukaaga.
normalised_text: katonda yaavona bye yakora, vyamusangaaza inho. vwaziva era vwacha orwo rwava nga norunaku orwomukaaga.

text: Olwo ni, eigulu n'ensi, ni byonabyona ebirimu, byamalirizibwa okukolebwa.
normalised_text: orwo ni, eiguru nensi, ni vyonavyona evirimu, vyamaririzivwa okukorevwa.

name: Soga
text: Yaagha olunaku olwo olwomusanvu enkabi era yaalutukuza. Kuba olwo lwe yawuumuliraku emirimo gye gyonagyona egy'okutonda.
normalised_text: yaagha orunaku orwo orwomusanvu enkavi era yaarutukuza. kuva orwo rwe yawuumuriraku emirimo je jonajona ejokutonda.

name: Soga
text: Kale ni eyo n'ensambo eigulu n'ensi ye byatondebwamu. Ku lunaku Musengwa Katonda lwe yakoleraku ensi n'eigulu.
normalised_text: kale ni eyo nensambo eiguru nensi ye vyatondevwamu. ku runaku musengwa katonda rwe yakoreraku ensi neiguru.

name: Soga
text: Aye oluudhiruudhi lwavanga mu itaka lwaboza ensi yoonayoona.
normalised_text: aye oruudhiruudhi rwavanga mu itaka rwavoza ensi yoonayoona.

name: Soga
text: Agho Musengwa Katonda yaawumba omuntu mu itaka, yaamufuuwa mu nhindo omuuka ogw'obulamu olwo omuntu yaatoolera okuba omulamu.
normalised_text: agho musengwa katonda yaawumba omuntu mu itaka, yaamufuuwa mu nhindo omuuka ogwovuramu orwo omuntu yaatoorera okuva omuramu.

name: Somrai
text: Jakob dɨndaw me mwàgɨraw me pad da, nem nare gɨnɨn̰ wurgɨsubu. Me Jakob gorndɨw gɨ Josep da, ilə alə sɨn̰a dɨ Ejibtɨ lə pii ɗɨm.
normalised_text: jakob dyndaw me mwagyraw me pad da, nem nare gynyn wurgysubu. me jakob gorndyw gy josep da, ile ale syna dy ejibty le pii dym.

name: Somrai
text: Ɨr̰ɨ Josep me chamraw nə pad di me margɨ bam. Nare nə ta di mar ꞌyen̰ bam pad swaa dayyə.
normalised_text: yry josep me shamraw ne pad di me margy bam. nare ne ta di mar yen bam pad swaa dayye.

name: Somrai
text: Caga da, i dole gɨ geche gɨ dɨrway me yala dam lam dwãr̰ĩ sɨn̰a dɨ Ejibtɨ lə an̰ju. Dole gɨ ta di ꞌwocn̰ Josep di bədə.
normalised_text: chaga da, i dole gy geshe gy dyrway me yala dam lam dwari syna dy ejibty le anju. dole gy ta di wochn josep di bede.

name: Somrai
text: An̰ji waygɨ nare duwa ba da: «Yarna, nare nə Israyel di yala ꞌyarbar nan̰e me àl dwana nan̰ ɗoyndɨ bam me ca.
normalised_text: anji waygy nare duwa ba da "yarna, nare ne israyel di yala yarbar nane me al dwana nan doyndy bam me cha.

name: Somrai
text: Mwom da, cendi àl nare nə Israyel di kwaynani nan̰ ɗoy bam bi.
normalised_text: mwom da, chendi al nare ne israyel di kwaynani nan doy bam bi.

name: Somrai
text: «Mana gɨ anə dara yàa nare nə Ebɨrə namdagɨ da, yarna dwe di le. Dwe di ina i abe da, ꞌyánaw bam, me ina i deme da, kalnadɨ dɨ bɨlnə le.».
normalised_text: "mana gy ane dara yea nare ne ebyre namdagy da, yarna dwe di le. dwe di ina i abe da, yanaw bam, me ina i deme da, kalnady dy bylne le.".

name: Somrai
text: Me namde woni yàa kwandagɨ di lán̰ɨw Mãr̰ĩ le, cendi àl mani nə dole waygɨ di bədə, ꞌyə dine nə abje di bədə, kalgɨ pad bɨl.
normalised_text: me namde woni yea kwandagy di lanyw mari le, chendi al mani ne dole waygy di bede, ye dine ne abje di bede, kalgy pad byl.

name: Somrai
text: Ɨr̰ɨ dole di ꞌwaga namde woni yàa kwandagɨ di sɨwə me ùrgɨ ba da: «Dana me anə àl yande mo? Dana me anə kal dine nə abje di bɨl mo?».

name: Southern Birifor

name: Suba-Simbiti
text: Eno hano ne-tongoterano iya amariina agha eka iyaabho Yëësu Kiristo. Yëësu Kiristo yaarë uwa eka iya Daudi ono yaarë uwa eka iya Ibhurahimu.

name: Suba-Simbiti
text: Amangʼana ghayö ghonswe igho ghaabhaayë igho, okore ghahekerane ghaara Omonene Waryobha yaaghambirë okohetera kö ömörööti uwaaye Isaaya igha.
normalised_text: amangana ghayo ghonswe igho ghaavaaye igho, okore ghahekerane ghaara omonene waryova yaaghambire okohetera ko omoruoti uwaaye isaaya igha.

name: Suba-Simbiti
text: Hano Yusufu yaabhöökirë, akakora kya bhoora maraika uwa Omonene Waryobha yaamoraghërrëëyi. Akateta Maryamu.
normalised_text: hano yusufu yaavuokire, akakora kya voora maraika uwa omonene waryova yaamoragherrieyi. akateta maryamu.

name: Suba-Simbiti
text: Kasi tiyaaraayë na mokaaye uyö hë, okohekera hano Maryamu yaaibhööyë omoona uwa ikishaasha. Yusufu akaroka omoona uyö igha, Yëësu.
normalised_text: kasi tiyaaraaye na mokaaye uyo he, okohekera hano maryamu yaaivuoye omoona uwa ikishaasha. yusufu akaroka omoona uyo igha, yiesu.

name: Suba-Simbiti
text: Bhakamohonshora igha, Naryebhorrwa mu-mughi ughwa Bhëtërëhëëmu ghono ghörëngë Yudea. Ko bhoora ni-igho ömörööti Mika yaandëkirë. Yaandëkirë igha.
normalised_text: vakamohonshora igha, naryevorrwa mumughi ughwa veterehiemu ghono ghorenge yudea. ko voora niigho omoruoti mika yaandekire. yaandekire igha.

name: Suba-Simbiti
text: Hano bhaarööshë inyota eera, bhakashomerwa bhököngʼu.
normalised_text: hano vaaruoshe inyota eera, vakashomerwa vokongu.

name: Suba-Simbiti
text: Mbe, Yusufu akabhooka ubhutikö bhuyöbhuyö, akaghegha mokaaye na omoona, bhakangʼosa bhöngöbhöngö ukughya mu-kyaro ikya Miisiri.
normalised_text: mbe, yusufu akavooka uvutiko vuyovuyo, akaghegha mokaaye na omoona, vakangosa vongovongo ukughya mukyaro ikya miisiri.

name: Suba-Simbiti
text: Ku bhuyö engʼana eera yaaghambirwë na ömörööti Yeremia, ekahekerana. Ömörööti Yeremia yaaghambirë igha.
normalised_text: ku vuyo engana eera yaaghambirwe na omoruoti yeremia, ekahekerana. omoruoti yeremia yaaghambire igha.

name: Suba-Simbiti
text: Hano omokama Herode yaakuurë, tamaaha, maraika uwa Omonene Waryobha akabhooshokera Yusufu mo-kerooto Miisiri eera.
normalised_text: hano omokama herode yaakuure, tamaaha, maraika uwa omonene waryova akavooshokera yusufu mokerooto miisiri eera.

name: Suba-Simbiti
text: akamötëëbhya igha, Bhooka! Ghegha omoona na nyakuwaabho ukyore mu-kyaro ikya Isiraëri, ko bhoora abhantö bhano bhaatunanga ukwita omoona, bhakuurë.
normalised_text: akamotievya igha, vooka! ghegha omoona na nyakuwaavo ukyore mukyaro ikya isiraeri, ko voora avanto vano vaatunanga ukwita omoona, vakuure.

name: Suba-Simbiti
text: Mbe, Yusufu akaghegha omoona hamwë na nyakuwaabho, akatanora, akakyora mu-kyaro ikya Isiraëri.
normalised_text: mbe, yusufu akaghegha omoona hamwe na nyakuwaavo, akatanora, akakyora mukyaro ikya isiraeri.

name: Suba-Simbiti
text: Bhëënyu, ni-igha mohongore ëbhëbhë ibhyënyu, ko bhoora enkaagha iya Obhokama ubhwa Waryobha n-haangʼë ërë.
normalised_text: vienyu, niigha mohongore eveve ivyenyu, ko voora enkaagha iya ovokama uvwa waryova nhaange ere.

name: Suba-Simbiti
text: Yohana akabhabhatiisya mo-mooro ughwa Yorodani, na eno bharaghamba harabhu igho ëbhëbhë ibhyabho.
normalised_text: yohana akavavatiisya momooro ughwa yorodani, na eno varaghamba haravu igho eveve ivyavo.

name: Suba-Simbiti
text: Nyoore m-maheene igha nkutuna mörë mbabhatiisi, ëkëntö ekenene ni-igha, mokorenga amangʼana ghano ghakwörökya igha, möhöngööyë ëbhëbhë ibhyënyu.
normalised_text: nyoore mmaheene igha nkutuna more mbavatiisi, ekento ekenene niigha, mokorenga amangana ghano ghakworokya igha, mohonguoye eveve ivyenyu.

name: Suba-Simbiti
text: Mbe, enkaagha iyö, Yëësu yaaruurë mo-mokowa ughwa Ghariraaya, akaghya ko-mooro ughwa Yorodani ku-Yohana, okore abhatiisibhwi na Yohana.
normalised_text: mbe, enkaagha iyo, yiesu yaaruure momokowa ughwa ghariraaya, akaghya komooro ughwa yorodani kuyohana, okore avatiisivwi na yohana.

name: Sukuma
text: A ha wandījo wa kūseema, ū Mulungu akaseema igūlū na sī.
normalised_text: a ha wandijo wa kuseema, u mulungu akaseema igulu na si.

name: Sukuma
text: Hūna ū Mulungu ūhaya gīkī, Ni lībizage ho isana ng'hana lyūbiza ho isana.
normalised_text: huna u mulungu uhaya giki, ni libizage ho isana nghana lyubiza ho isana.

name: Sukuma
text: Ū Mulungu ūbona yabeelela ū kūbiza ho ī lisana; ī lisana ūlīlekanya nī giiti.
normalised_text: u mulungu ubona yabeelela u kubiza ho i lisana; i lisana ulilekanya ni giiti.

name: Sukuma
text: Ū Mulungu ūliitana ī lisana līīmi, ī giiti ūshiitana būjikū. Yūbiza mhīndī, yūbiza dilū, lūshikū lwa kwandīja.
normalised_text: u mulungu uliitana i lisana liimi, i giiti ushiitana bujiku. yubiza mhindi, yubiza dilu, lushiku lwa kwandija.

name: Sukuma
text: Hangī ū Mulungu ūhaya gīkī, Ni gūbizage ho ng'wanya gwa kūgalekanya a minzī.
normalised_text: hangi u mulungu uhaya giki, ni gubizage ho ngwanya gwa kugalekanya a minzi.

name: Sukuma
text: Ū Mulungu ūbeeja ng'wanya gwa kūgalekanya a minzī. Gangī gūbiza kwigūlya, a gangī kū sīlīlī ya ng'wanya gwenūyo.
normalised_text: u mulungu ubeeja ngwanya gwa kugalekanya a minzi. gangi gubiza kwigulya, a gangi ku silili ya ngwanya gwenuyo.

name: Sukuma
text: Ū Mulungu ūgwitana ū ng'wanya gwenūyo igūlū. Yūbiza mhīndī, yūbiza dilū, lūshikū lwa kabīlī.
normalised_text: u mulungu ugwitana u ngwanya gwenuyo igulu. yubiza mhindi, yubiza dilu, lushiku lwa kabili.

name: Sukuma
text: Hūna ū Mulungu ūhaya hangī gīkī, A minzī ayo galī ha sīlīlī y'igūlū gikuminge hamò, yilonge sī nyūmu; ng'hana yūbiza gīko.
normalised_text: huna u mulungu uhaya hangi giki, a minzi ayo gali ha silili yigulu gikuminge hamo, yilonge si nyumu; nghana yubiza giko.

name: Sukuma
text: Ī lipandī lya sī īyo ītī na minzī, ū Mulungu ūlitana Sī nyūmu; alīyo a minzī ayo gakikuminga ūgitana Nyanza. Ū Mulungu ūbona yabeelela.
normalised_text: i lipandi lya si iyo iti na minzi, u mulungu ulitana si nyumu; aliyo a minzi ayo gakikuminga ugitana nyanza. u mulungu ubona yabeelela.

name: Sukuma
text: Yūbiza mhīndī, yūbiza dilū, lūshikū lwa kadatū.
normalised_text: yubiza mhindi, yubiza dilu, lushiku lwa kadatu.

name: Sukuma
text: Nīyo shibize sha kūtūūla isana ū mu ng'wanya gwigūlū, na kwītwimīla ī sī. Ng'hana yūbiza gīko.
normalised_text: niyo shibize sha kutuula isana u mu ngwanya gwigulu, na kwitwimila i si. nghana yubiza giko.

name: Sukuma
text: Ū Mulungu ūshitūūla ī shikolo shenīsho ū mu ng'wanya gw'igūlū, gīkī shiyūyītwimīl'ī sī.
normalised_text: u mulungu ushituula i shikolo shenisho u mu ngwanya gwigulu, giki shiyuyitwimili si.

name: Sukuma
text: Na gīkī shigasuge a makanza ga līīmi na a ga būjikū, na kūshilekanya ī giiti nī lisana. Ū Mulungu ūbona yabeelela.
normalised_text: na giki shigasuge a makanza ga liimi na a ga bujiku, na kushilekanya i giiti ni lisana. u mulungu ubona yabeelela.

name: Sukuma
text: Ī shiseeng'wa shenīsho ūshifuuha alīhaya gīkī, Ibyalanagi mukwīle, mugookaje pa a minzī ga mu nyanza; nī noni jookale hose pyī ū mu sī.
normalised_text: i shiseengwa shenisho ushifuuha alihaya giki, ibyalanagi mukwile, mugookaje pa a minzi ga mu nyanza; ni noni jookale hose pyi u mu si.

name: Sukuma
text: Yūbiza mhīndī, yūbiza dilū, lūshikū lwa katanò.
normalised_text: yubiza mhindi, yubiza dilu, lushiku lwa katano.

name: Sukuma
text: Hūna ū Mulungu ūnseema munhū mu suso yakwe, mu suso yakwe ū Mulungu ūnseema, ūbaseema ngosha na nkīma.
normalised_text: huna u mulungu unseema munhu mu suso yakwe, mu suso yakwe u mulungu unseema, ubaseema ngosha na nkima.

name: Sukuma
text: Hūna ū Mulungu ūbona gīkī, pyī īsho akashibeeja shilī shawiza no. Yūbiza mhīndī, yūbiza dilū, lūshikū lwa katandatū.
normalised_text: huna u mulungu ubona giki, pyi isho akashibeeja shili shawiza no. yubiza mhindi, yubiza dilu, lushiku lwa katandatu.

name: Sukuma
text: Hūna lūūlū, ī ligūlū nī sī shūbiza shamala ū kūbeejiwa, na a mabità gose ayo galīmo.
normalised_text: huna luulu, i ligulu ni si shubiza shamala u kubeejiwa, na a mabita gose ayo galimo.

name: Sukuma
text: Ū mu lūshikū lwa mpugatī, ū Mulungu ūsangwa wamalile ū kūtūmama; hūna lūūlū wifuula ī milīmo yakwe pyī ī yose.
normalised_text: u mu lushiku lwa mpugati, u mulungu usangwa wamalile u kutumama; huna luulu wifuula i milimo yakwe pyi i yose.

name: Sukuma
text: Ū Mulungu ūlūfuuha ū lūshikū lwa mpungatī, ūlweeja; nguno ū mu lūshikū lwenūlo akifuula pyī ī milīmo yakwe īyo akabeeja mu kaseemele kakwe.
normalised_text: u mulungu ulufuuha u lushiku lwa mpungati, ulweeja; nguno u mu lushiku lwenulo akifuula pyi i milimo yakwe iyo akabeeja mu kaseemele kakwe.

name: Sukuma
text: Ū būsombooji ūbū būlī bo mihayo ya shiseeng'wa sha ng'wigūlū na mu sī gīt'umo shikabeegejiwa. Ū SEEBA Mulungu aho wamala kūseema ī sī nī ligūlū.
normalised_text: u busombooji ubu buli bo mihayo ya shiseengwa sha ngwigulu na mu si gitumo shikabeegejiwa. u seeba mulungu aho wamala kuseema i si ni ligulu.

name: Sukuma
text: Gwike jalīho nzwīlo jenhaga minzī kūfuma mu gatī ya sī, bobiza ho būdoto a ha sī.
normalised_text: gwike jaliho nzwilo jenhaga minzi kufuma mu gati ya si, bobiza ho budoto a ha si.

name: Sukuma
text: Hūna lūūlū ū SEEBA Mulungu ūmeeja munhū kūfuma mu malongo ga ha sī; ūng'haahīla myūyī ya būpanga ū mu mūūlū gakwe ū munhū ng'wenūyo, ūbiza mpanga.
normalised_text: huna luulu u seeba mulungu umeeja munhu kufuma mu malongo ga ha si; unghaahila myuyi ya bupanga u mu muulu gakwe u munhu ngwenuyo, ubiza mpanga.

name: Sukuma
text: Ū SEEBA Mulungu walī wagolanya ngūnda ipandī lya kīya, mu Edeni; ūntūūla ng'wenūmo ū munhū ūyo akamūmba.
normalised_text: u seeba mulungu wali wagolanya ngunda ipandi lya kiya, mu edeni; untuula ngwenumo u munhu uyo akamumba.

name: Sukuma
text: Ī zahabu ja mu sī yenīyo jalī niza no, jalīmo na delamu na lapisi lazuli.
normalised_text: i zahabu ja mu si yeniyo jali niza no, jalimo na delamu na lapisi lazuli.

name: Sukuma
text: Ū go kabīlī gwitanagwa Gihoni, nū gwene gwalī gūjile gūkūtūlaga kuluba kūbītīla mu sī ya Kushi.
normalised_text: u go kabili gwitanagwa gihoni, nu gwene gwali gujile gukutulaga kuluba kubitila mu si ya kushi.

name: Sukuma
text: Ū gwa kadatū gwitanagwa Hidekeli, ū goyi gūtūlile kuluba kūja kīya ya sī ya Ashulu. Lelo ū gwa kanè gwalī Flati.
normalised_text: u gwa kadatu gwitanagwa hidekeli, u goyi gutulile kuluba kuja kiya ya si ya ashulu. lelo u gwa kane gwali flati.

name: Sukuma
text: Ū SEEBA Mulungu ūnsola ū munhū, ūntūūla ū mu ngūnda gwa Edeni gīkī ayūgūlīma na kūgūlang'hana.
normalised_text: u seeba mulungu unsola u munhu, untuula u mu ngunda gwa edeni giki ayugulima na kugulanghana.

name: Sukuma
text: Hūna ū SEEBA Mulungu ūnagīla ū munhū alīhaya gīkī, Ūdūgije kūlya matwajo ga ntī gose gose ū mu ngūnda.
normalised_text: huna u seeba mulungu unagila u munhu alihaya giki, udugije kulya matwajo ga nti gose gose u mu ngunda.

name: Sukuma
text: Alīyo yaya ū kūgalya a matwajo ga ntī gwa kūmana misoga na mibi; nguno ūlū ūūgalya ūkūcha gete.
normalised_text: aliyo yaya u kugalya a matwajo ga nti gwa kumana misoga na mibi; nguno ulu uugalya ukuchha gete.

name: Supyire Senoufo
text: Ɲìŋke yyaha baa woge niŋgage ku mpyi. Lùbwɔhɔ ná numpini mpyi ku cyeyi puni i. *Kile Munaani sí mpyi na mpéele kuru lùbwɔhe nìɲyiŋi na.
normalised_text: nyingke yyaha baa woge ninggage ku mpyi. lubwoho na numpini mpyi ku chyeyi puni i. kile munaani si mpyi na mpeele kuru lubwohe ninyyingi na.

name: Supyire Senoufo
text: Ka Kile si jwo: «Bɛ̀ɛnmpe pu fworo» ka bɛ̀ɛnmpe si fworo.
normalised_text: ka kile si jwo "beenmpe pu fworo" ka beenmpe si fworo.

name: Supyire Senoufo
text: Kile à bɛ̀ɛnmpe ɲya p'à ɲwɔ, ka u u pu ná numpini láha yiye na.
normalised_text: kile a beenmpe nyya pa nywo, ka u u pu na numpini laha yiye na.

name: Supyire Senoufo
text: Maa bɛ̀ɛnmpe mɛge le canŋke, maa numpini mɛge le numpilage. Ka numpilage si wwɔ̀, ka ɲyɛ̀ge si múgo, ka kuru si mpyi canɲcyiige.
normalised_text: maa beenmpe mege le channgke, maa numpini mege le numpilage. ka numpilage si wwo, ka nyyege si mugo, ka kuru si mpyi channychyiige.

name: Supyire Senoufo
text: Ɲyɛ ka Kile si núr'a jwo: «Lwɔhe ku táa, laaga ku pyi ku shwɔhɔl'e.».
normalised_text: nyye ka kile si nura jwo "lwohe ku taa, laaga ku pyi ku shwohole.".

name: Supyire Senoufo
text: Maa kuru laage yaa, mà tɛ̀g'a ɲìŋke lwɔhe ná nìɲyiŋi lwɔhe láha yiye na. Ka lire si mpyi li jwuŋkanni na.
normalised_text: maa kuru laage yaa, ma tega nyingke lwohe na ninyyingi lwohe laha yiye na. ka lire si mpyi li jwungkanni na.

name: Supyire Senoufo
text: Ka Kile si kuru laage mɛge le nìɲyiŋi. Ka numpilage si wwɔ̀, ka ɲyɛ̀ge si múgo, ka kuru si mpyi canzhɔnwoge.
normalised_text: ka kile si kuru laage mege le ninyyingi. ka numpilage si wwo, ka nyyege si mugo, ka kuru si mpyi chanzhonwoge.

name: Supyire Senoufo
text: Ɲyɛ ka Kile si núr'a jwo: «Nìɲyiŋi ɲwɔhɔ lwɔhe ku bínni cyaga niŋkin i, cyage sanŋke ku pyi tawaga.» Ka lire si mpyi li jwuŋkanni na.
normalised_text: nyye ka kile si nura jwo "ninyyingi nywoho lwohe ku binni chyaga ningkin i, chyage sanngke ku pyi tawaga." ka lire si mpyi li jwungkanni na.

name: Supyire Senoufo
text: Ka u u tawage mɛge le ɲìŋke, lwɔh'à bínni cyage ŋkemu i ke, maa kuru mɛge le suumpe lwɔhe. Maa lire ɲya l'à ɲwɔ.
normalised_text: ka u u tawage mege le nyingke, lwoha binni chyage ngkemu i ke, maa kuru mege le suumpe lwohe. maa lire nyya la nywo.

name: Supyire Senoufo
text: Ɲyɛ ka Kile si jwo na yaayi shiŋi puni yi fyîn ɲìŋke na, sùmaŋi ná cire, yi i yasɛrɛ pyi yi tàanna ná yi shiŋi i. Ka lire si mpyi li jwuŋkanni na.
normalised_text: nyye ka kile si jwo na yaayi shingi puni yi fyin nyingke na, sumangi na chire, yi i yasere pyi yi taanna na yi shingi i. ka lire si mpyi li jwungkanni na.

name: Supyire Senoufo
text: Ka yaayi shiŋi puni si fyîn ɲìŋke na, sùmaŋi ná cire, maa yasɛrɛ pyi mà tàanna ná yi shiŋi i. Ka Kile si lire ɲya l'à ɲwɔ.
normalised_text: ka yaayi shingi puni si fyin nyingke na, sumangi na chire, maa yasere pyi ma taanna na yi shingi i. ka kile si lire nyya la nywo.

name: Supyire Senoufo
text: Ka numpilage si wwɔ̀, ka ɲyɛ̀ge si múgo, ka kuru si mpyi canntanrawoge.
normalised_text: ka numpilage si wwo, ka nyyege si mugo, ka kuru si mpyi channtanrawoge.

name: Supyire Senoufo
text: Yire yaayi yi pyi nìɲyiŋi na, yi raa bɛ̀ɛnmpe tîrige ɲìŋke na. Ka lire si mpyi li jwuŋkanni na.
normalised_text: yire yaayi yi pyi ninyyingi na, yi raa beenmpe tirige nyingke na. ka lire si mpyi li jwungkanni na.

name: Supyire Senoufo
text: Ka Kile si bɛ̀ɛnmɛ yaaya nimbwoyo shuunni yaa. Maa yi puni nimbwɔhe yaha canŋke ɲùŋɔ na, maa nimbileni yaha numpilage ɲùŋɔ na. Maa wɔrigii mú yaa.
normalised_text: ka kile si beenme yaaya nimbwoyo shuunni yaa. maa yi puni nimbwohe yaha channgke nyungo na, maa nimbileni yaha numpilage nyungo na. maa worigii mu yaa.

name: Supyire Senoufo
text: Kile à yire yaayi yaha nìɲyiŋi na, bà yi si mpyi s'a bɛ̀ɛnmpe kaan ɲìŋke na mɛ.
normalised_text: kile a yire yaayi yaha ninyyingi na, ba yi si mpyi sa beenmpe kaan nyingke na me.

name: Supyire Senoufo
text: Maa yi tìŋɛ canŋke ná numpilage ɲùŋɔ na, bà yi si mpyi si numpini ná bɛ̀ɛnmpe tɛgɛni láha yiye na mɛ. Ka Kile si lire ɲya l'à ɲwɔ.
normalised_text: maa yi tinge channgke na numpilage nyungo na, ba yi si mpyi si numpini na beenmpe tegeni laha yiye na me. ka kile si lire nyya la nywo.

name: Supyire Senoufo
text: Ka numpilage si wwɔ̀, ka ɲyɛ̀ge si múgo, ka kuru si mpyi cansicyɛre woge.
normalised_text: ka numpilage si wwo, ka nyyege si mugo, ka kuru si mpyi chansichyere woge.

name: Supyire Senoufo
text: Ɲyɛ ka Kile si núr'a jwo: «Ɲyii yaayi yi ɲyaha teetee lwɔhe e, saɲcyɛɛnre mú ti yîri t'a mpéele ɲjaampe e.».
normalised_text: nyye ka kile si nura jwo "nyyii yaayi yi nyyaha teetee lwohe e, sanychyeenre mu ti yiri ta mpeele nyjaampe e.".

name: Supyire Senoufo
text: Kile à jwó le y'á, maa jwo yi si teetee yi i suumpe lwɔhe ɲî. Maa jwo na saɲcyɛɛnre mú ti ɲyaha ɲìŋke na.
normalised_text: kile a jwo le ya, maa jwo yi si teetee yi i suumpe lwohe nyi. maa jwo na sanychyeenre mu ti nyyaha nyingke na.

name: Supyire Senoufo
text: Ka numpilage si wwɔ̀, ka ɲyɛ̀ge si múgo, ka kuru si mpyi canŋkaŋkuro woge.
normalised_text: ka numpilage si wwo, ka nyyege si mugo, ka kuru si mpyi channgkangkuro woge.

name: Supyire Senoufo
text: Ka Kile si sige yaare yaa ti shiŋi puni, maa yatɔɔre yaa ti shiŋi puni, maa ɲìŋke yafiliyi yaa yi shiŋi puni mú. Ka u u lire ɲya l'à ɲwɔ.
normalised_text: ka kile si sige yaare yaa ti shingi puni, maa yatoore yaa ti shingi puni, maa nyingke yafiliyi yaa yi shingi puni mu. ka u u lire nyya la nywo.

name: Supyire Senoufo
text: Ka Kile si sùpyaŋi yaa uye málwɔrɔ. U à u yaa u yabiliŋi fiige. Maa u yaa nɔ̀ ná ceewe.
