normalised_text: ba fune hiisi chene, koosa fun sem ba a li ba deesi ni a ngo, ma ta bur la herod wati. doone ba fun si a ting nyinbaan digi a kaali ba toha.

name: Tampulma
text: Josɛf fun si lalaga a zer be ti awa o niina dusum ti ni a kaali Ijipt.
normalised_text: josef fun si lalaga a zer be ti awa o niina dusum ti ni a kaali ijipt.

name: Tangale
text: Shum mum banu Elimelek, shum oropni Naomi, shum lalinnim rap Malon ka Kilyon, mi mọ Eparata mọ Bet‐leem‐yuda. Dam yin podgọ yil Moab, diwu pi taiji.
normalised_text: shum mum banu elimelek, shum oropni naomi, shum lalinnim rap malon ka kilyon, mi mo eparata mo betleemyuda. dam yin podgo yil moab, diwu pi taiji.

name: Tangale
text: Dam Elimelek mẹ Naomi mudgọ; mundun ta ka lalindọm rap.
normalised_text: dam elimelek me naomi mudgo; mundun ta ka lalindom rap.

name: Tangale
text: Anambẹna wargọ orop Moab kaḍi yan oropwu; shum mọnj dok Orpa, shum mọnj dok Rut: kurau pi taiji shọri uka kwọmọ.
normalised_text: anambena wargo orop moab kadi yan oropwu; shum monj dok orpa, shum monj dok rut kurau pi taiji shori uka kwomo.

name: Tangale
text: Pon Malon ka Kilyon motun pip rap; dam orop m banu di nẹ kẹnd lalindọm rap ka mẹdo.
normalised_text: pon malon ka kilyon motun pip rap; dam orop m banu di ne kend lalindom rap ka medo.

name: Tangale
text: Dam wargọ ilut ka anaurugdu, ka, ka d shitọ mund yil Moab: aṇ ki ta komgọ ta yil Moab ka Yahweh meg muniṇ unuk wamọnjana.
normalised_text: dam wargo ilut ka anaurugdu, ka, ka d shito mund yil moab ang ki ta komgo ta yil moab ka yahweh meg muning unuk wamonjana.

name: Tangale
text: Wargọ podutọ pidim ta dizhin, anaurugdum rap pip ka nda; ba mirgi ọkọ shiwu yil Yuda.
normalised_text: wargo poduto pidim ta dizhin, anaurugdum rap pip ka nda; ba mirgi oko shiwu yil yuda.

name: Tangale
text: Pon Naomi nẹ to anaurugdum rap, ka, Ma waku, ma shiku, noṇ noṇ ta ma nondọ: Yahweh yadak togor, uk sh ma yag ka mim mushi ka na.
normalised_text: pon naomi ne to anaurugdum rap, ka, ma waku, ma shiku, nong nong ta ma nondo yahweh yadak togor, uk sh ma yag ka mim mushi ka na.

name: Tangale
text: Yahweh undaku ka ma we shinọ noṇ noṇ ta ma mẹdọ. Pon wargọ yini ọbi itu; dam yin tak dil ba, badau uzhi.
normalised_text: yahweh undaku ka ma we shino nong nong ta ma medo. pon wargo yini obi itu; dam yin tak dil ba, badau uzhi.

name: Tangale
text: Yin nẹ mbashtam ka, Nn, mini shimu tọm mi mọ manji ka nji.
normalised_text: yin ne mbashtam ka, nn, mini shimu tom mi mo manji ka nji.

name: Tangale
text: Naomi ka, Ma shiku pidei, lalinnọ, ma wa mish ka na ki naṇ? tib na ṇa lalin ta anọ, ka yin ya mẹgu?.
normalised_text: naomi ka, ma shiku pidei, lalinno, ma wa mish ka na ki nang? tib na nga lalin ta ano, ka yin ya megu?.

name: Tangale
text: Ma shiku pidei, lalinnọ, ma waku, aṇ ki na manshi po wezh wanam. Yokot n da nẹ i ṇa po‐wezhi nẹ, yokot gan n da ṇa mẹmi tẹm ta shum, lain lalin;.
normalised_text: ma shiku pidei, lalinno, ma waku, ang ki na manshi po wezh wanam. yokot n da ne i nga powezhi ne, yokot gan n da nga memi tem ta shum, lain lalin;.

name: Tangale
text: ma wa anji podun yin yan kudi? ma wa kwat iku wana? nn, lalinnọ; a ndaki kẹrik m yazhi inu yok maṇku, aṇ ki yar Yahweh pon tam badutọ yazhnọ.
normalised_text: ma wa anji podun yin yan kudi? ma wa kwat iku wana? nn, lalinno; a ndaki kerik m yazhi inu yok mangku, ang ki yar yahweh pon tam baduto yazhno.

name: Tangale
text: Pon yin tak dil ba, badau uzh taki: Orpa ọb ondọ itu; pon Rut edutu iki.
normalised_text: pon yin tak dil ba, badau uzh taki orpa ob ondo itu; pon rut edutu iki.

name: Tangale
text: Pon ta ka, Mọ, shẹrshi shitkọ tọm mi mọ mandọ pidei, tọm yambdọ tibi; shishi ad pi shẹrshi.
normalised_text: pon ta ka, mo, shershi shitko tom mi mo mando pidei, tom yambdo tibi; shishi ad pi shershi.

name: Tangale
text: pidim ji monu, n monu, wallọ nda pi taiji taki: Yahweh yanọ uk mọ, ka mọnj yokọ, ka wazh dok abudmu ka nji, mudundumm.
normalised_text: pidim ji monu, n monu, wallo nda pi taiji taki yahweh yano uk mo, ka monj yoko, ka wazh dok abudmu ka nji, mudundumm.

name: Tangale
text: Ta megu mbashtam eshi i mish ka nda, wargọ mund yazh shab ga nda.
normalised_text: ta megu mbashtam eshi i mish ka nda, wargo mund yazh shab ga nda.

name: Tangale
text: Dam yini pip rap kum mishi podun Bet‐leem. Pon m yin podgọ Bet‐leem, mi mọ manim pip yan shọgzhọk ki; mim orop ba nẹzhi ka, Shi Naomi?.
normalised_text: dam yini pip rap kum mishi podun betleem. pon m yin podgo betleem, mi mo manim pip yan shogzhok ki; mim orop ba nezhi ka, shi naomi?.

name: Tangale
text: Dam ta nẹ to yini ka, Ma dunọ Naomim, ma dunọ Mara; taki Ponon aduk kurru ya kẹrik tamatama.
normalised_text: dam ta ne to yini ka, ma duno naomim, ma duno mara; taki ponon aduk kurru ya kerik tamatama.

name: Tangale
text: N yag podoknọ na nogzhi, dam Yamb atungọ watun mana pidei in gai; aṇ ki naṇ m ma dun na Naomi, pon Yahweh yag kọl inu, tib Ponon rẹingọ?.
normalised_text: n yag podokno na nogzhi, dam yamb atungo watun mana pidei in gai; ang ki nang m ma dun na naomi, pon yahweh yag kol inu, tib ponon reingo?.

name: Tangale
text: Naomi shidudgọ uk mọ, ashin Rut itu, mọ nji Moab urugdum shidudgọ mundtu yil Moab: yin podgọ Bet‐leem nda tub‐tul pet barli.
normalised_text: naomi shidudgo uk mo, ashin rut itu, mo nji moab urugdum shidudgo mundtu yil moab yin podgo betleem nda tubtul pet barli.

name: Tangale
text: Dam Naomi a ṇa shẹr mẹdọm dok, mum tom ga kwada, aṇ ma Elimelek; shumi Boaz.
normalised_text: dam naomi a nga sher medom dok, mum tom ga kwada, ang ma elimelek; shumi boaz.

name: Tangale
text: Dam Rut mọ nji Moab, nẹ to Naomi ka, Di na wa yaya, ka n ya raga to pi mum na wezh togor tọmei. Ta nẹ to ta ka, Wash, launọ.
normalised_text: dam rut mo nji moab, ne to naomi ka, di na wa yaya, ka n ya raga to pi mum na wezh togor tomei. ta ne to ta ka, wash, launo.

name: Tangale
text: Wargọ watọ ta wargọ ba rag ta yaya to pi anambet‐wa: yaigọ yaizhi mbashtam podun big ka‐yai Boaz m banu ma Elimelek.
normalised_text: wargo wato ta wargo ba rag ta yaya to pi anambetwa yaigo yaizhi mbashtam podun big kayai boaz m banu ma elimelek.

name: Tangale
text: Pon mọ, Boaz watun Bet‐leem, nẹ anambet‐wa, ka, Yahweh ya ka maga. Yin tọb poki ka, Yahweh yaduk togor.
normalised_text: pon mo, boaz watun betleem, ne anambetwa, ka, yahweh ya ka maga. yin tob poki ka, yahweh yaduk togor.

name: Tangale
text: Pon Boaz nẹ to launim lizhi ki anambet‐wa ka, Ob zhi lau noṇ?.
normalised_text: pon boaz ne to launim lizhi ki anambetwa ka, ob zhi lau nong?.

name: Tangale
text: Lawọm ban lizhi ki anambet‐wa tọbi ka, A lau Moab m shin ga Naomi ta yil Moab:.
normalised_text: lawom ban lizhi ki anambetwa tobi ka, a lau moab m shin ga naomi ta yil moab.

name: Tangale
text: Pon Boaz nẹ to Rut ka, Shi komgọm, launọ? Mọ zh wa rag yayam ṇaim, tib mọ zh shagu mund pi shim, edish ga lalinnọm orop dama.
normalised_text: pon boaz ne to rut ka, shi komgom, launo? mo zh wa rag yayam ngaim, tib mo zh shagu mund pi shim, edish ga lalinnom orop dama.

name: Tangale
text: Badishi shib yayam yini peti, ka zhi ad pi: n yag pula i ananwaḍakm, ka dam ta ishim? ka nji ṇa kum‐am, wash po lala, ẹ wam ananwaḍak kwina.
normalised_text: badishi shib yayam yini peti, ka zhi ad pi n yag pula i ananwadakm, ka dam ta ishim? ka nji nga kumam, wash po lala, e wam ananwadak kwina.

name: Tangale
text: Pon ta bul sha‐itu, tumut tili, nẹ to yi ka, A ṇaka n weg togor tọmgọ, kaṇ kwinnọ, n roṇo?.
normalised_text: pon ta bul shaitu, tumut tili, ne to yi ka, a ngaka n weg togor tomgo, kang kwinno, n rongo?.

name: Tangale
text: Yahweh shẹt ki wotẹnji, Yahweh, Yamb Yishrael m shi wana wezh koron tul bubukni, aṇ posh kwiṇ.
normalised_text: yahweh shet ki wotenji, yahweh, yamb yishrael m shi wana wezh koron tul bubukni, ang posh kwing.

name: Tarifit
text: Wa ḏ lkitab n ȓejḏuḏ n Ƹisa Lmasiḥ, wenni iǧan zi ddurriṯ n Dawed ḏ Brahim.
normalised_text: wa dh lkitab n rejdhudh n cisa lmasih, wenni ijan zi ddurrith n dawed dh brahim.

name: Tarifit
text: وَا ذ لْكِتَاب ن ڒجْذُوْذ ن عِيْسَى لْمَسِيح، ونِّي يدْجَان زِي دُّوْرِّيث ن دَاود ذ بْرَاهِيم.
normalised_text: waa th lkitaab n rjthuwth n iysaa lmasiyh, wniy ydjaan ziy duwriyth n daawd th braahiym.

name: Tarifit
text: Brahim ijja-d Isḥaq. Isḥaq ijja-d Yaƹqub. Yaƹqub ijja-d Yahuḏa ḏ ayṯmas.
normalised_text: brahim ijjad ishaq. ishaq ijjad yacqub. yacqub ijjad yahudha dh aythmas.

name: Tarifit
text: بْرَاهِيم يجَّا-د إِسْحَاق. إِسْحَاق يجَّا-د يَعْقُوْب. يَعْقُوْب يجَّا-د يَهُوْذَا ذ أَيثْمَاس.
normalised_text: braahiym yjaad iishaaq. iishaaq yjaad yaquwb. yaquwb yjaad yahuwthaa th aaythmaas.

name: Tarifit
text: Yahuḏa ijja-d Faris ḏ Zaraḥ ak ṯemɣarṯ nnes Ṯamra. Faris ijja-d Ḥaṣrun. Ḥaṣrun ijja-d Aram.
normalised_text: yahudha ijjad faris dh zarah ak themgharth nnes thamra. faris ijjad hasrun. hasrun ijjad aram.

name: Tarifit
text: يَهُوْذَا يجَّا-د فَارِس ذ زَارَح اَك ثمْغَارْث نّس ثَامْرَا. فَارِس يجَّا-د حَصْرُوْن. حَصْرُوْن يجَّا-د أَرَام.
normalised_text: yahuwthaa yjaad faaris th zaarah aak thmghaarth ns thaamraa. faaris yjaad hasruwn. hasruwn yjaad aaraam.

name: Tarifit
text: Aram ijja-d Ƹaminadab. Ƹaminadab ijja-d Nassun. Nassun ijja-d Salmun.
normalised_text: aram ijjad caminadab. caminadab ijjad nassun. nassun ijjad salmun.

name: Tarifit
text: أَرَام يجَّا-د عَمِينَادَاب. عَمِينَادَاب يجَّا-د نَسُّوْن. نَسُّوْن يجَّا-د سَلْمُوْن.
normalised_text: aaraam yjaad amiynaadaab. amiynaadaab yjaad nasuwn. nasuwn yjaad salmuwn.

name: Tarifit
text: Salmun ijja-d Buƹazza ak ṯemɣarṯ nnes Riḥab. Buƹazza ijja-d Ƹubayd ak ṯemɣarṯ nnes Raƹuṯ. Ƹubayd ijja-d Yassa.
normalised_text: salmun ijjad bucazza ak themgharth nnes rihab. bucazza ijjad cubayd ak themgharth nnes racuth. cubayd ijjad yassa.

name: Tarifit
text: سَلْمُوْن يجَّا-د بُوْعَزَّا اَك ثمْغَارْث نّس رِيحَاب. بُوْعَزَّا يجَّا-د عُوْبَايْد اَك ثمْغَارْث نّس رَاعُوْث. عُوْبَايْد يجَّا-د يَسَّى.
normalised_text: salmuwn yjaad buwazaa aak thmghaarth ns riyhaab. buwazaa yjaad uwbaayd aak thmghaarth ns raauwth. uwbaayd yjaad yasaa.

name: Tarifit
text: Yassa ijja-d Dawed azeǧiḏ. Dawed azeǧiḏ ijja-d Suliman zi ṯenni tuɣa iǧan ḏ ṯamɣarṯ n Uryaḥ.
normalised_text: yassa ijjad dawed azejidh. dawed azejidh ijjad suliman zi thenni tugha ijan dh thamgharth n uryah.

name: Tarifit
text: يَسَّى يجَّا-د دَاود اَزدْجِيذ. دَاود اَزدْجِيذ يجَّا-د سُلِيْمَان زِي ثنِّي تُوْغَا يدْجَان ذ ثَمْغَارْث ن أُوْرْيَاح.
normalised_text: yasaa yjaad daawd aazdjiyth. daawd aazdjiyth yjaad suliymaan ziy thniy tuwghaa ydjaan th thamghaarth n auwryaah.

name: Tarifit
text: Suliman ijja-d Raḥubƹam. Raḥubƹam ijja-d Abiya. Abiya ijja-d Asa.
normalised_text: suliman ijjad rahubcam. rahubcam ijjad abiya. abiya ijjad asa.

name: Tarifit
text: سُلِيْمَان يجَّا-د رَحُبْعَام. رَحُبْعَام يجَّا-د أَبِيَا. أَبِيَا يجَّا-د أَسَا.
normalised_text: suliymaan yjaad rahubaam. rahubaam yjaad aabiyaa. aabiyaa yjaad aasaa.

name: Tarifit
text: Asa ijja-d Yahucafaṭ. Yahucafaṭ ijja-d Yuram. Yuram ijja-d Ƹuzzaya.
normalised_text: asa ijjad yahushafat. yahushafat ijjad yuram. yuram ijjad cuzzaya.

name: Tarifit
text: أَسَا يجَّا-د يَهُوْشَافَاط. يَهُوْشَافَاط يجَّا-د يُوْرَام. يُوْرَام يجَّا-د عُزَّيَا.
normalised_text: aasaa yjaad yahuwshaafaat. yahuwshaafaat yjaad yuwraam. yuwraam yjaad uzayaa.

name: Tarifit
text: Ƹuzzaya ijja-d Yuṯam. Yuṯam ijja-d Aḥaz. Aḥaz ijja-d Ḥisqi.
normalised_text: cuzzaya ijjad yutham. yutham ijjad ahaz. ahaz ijjad hisqi.

name: Tarifit
text: عُزَّيَا يجَّا-د يُوْثَام. يُوْثَام يجَّا-د أَحَاز. أَحَاز يجَّا-د حِسْقِي.
normalised_text: uzayaa yjaad yuwthaam. yuwthaam yjaad aahaaz. aahaaz yjaad hisqiy.

name: Tarifit
text: حِسْقِي يجَّا-د مَنَسَّى. مَنَسَّى يجَّا-د أَمُوْن. أَمُوْن يجَّا-د يُوْشِيَا.
normalised_text: hisqiy yjaad manasaa. manasaa yjaad aamuwn. aamuwn yjaad yuwshiyaa.

name: Tarifit
text: Ḥisqi ijja-d Manassa. Manassa ijja-d Amun. Amun ijja-d Yuciya.
normalised_text: hisqi ijjad manassa. manassa ijjad amun. amun ijjad yushiya.

name: Tarifit
text: Yuciya ijja-d Yakunya ḏ ayṯmas ḏi ȓweqṯ nni wami twasufɣen ɣar Babil.
normalised_text: yushiya ijjad yakunya dh aythmas dhi rweqth nni wami twasufghen ghar babil.

name: Tarifit
text: يُوْشِيَا يجَّا-د يَكُنْيَا ذ أَيثْمَاس ذِي ڒْوقْث نِّي وَامِي تْوَاسُوْفْغن غَار بَابِل.
normalised_text: yuwshiyaa yjaad yakunyaa th aaythmaas thiy rwqth niy waamiy twaasuwfghn ghaar baabil.

name: Tarifit
text: Menbaƹd i ȓweqṯ nni wami twasufɣen ɣar Babil, Yakunya ijja-d Cƹaltihil. Cƹaltihil ijja-d Zarubbabil.
normalised_text: menbacd i rweqth nni wami twasufghen ghar babil, yakunya ijjad shcaltihil. shcaltihil ijjad zarubbabil.

name: Tarifit
text: منْبَعْد إِ ڒْوقْث نِّي وَامِي تْوَاسُوْفْغن غَار بَابِل، يَكُنْيَا يجَّا-د شْعَالْتِيهِيل. شْعَالْتِيهِيل يجَّا-د زَرُبَّابِل.
normalised_text: mnbad ii rwqth niy waamiy twaasuwfghn ghaar baabil, yakunyaa yjaad shaaltiyhiyl. shaaltiyhiyl yjaad zarubaabil.

name: Tarifit
text: Zarubbabil ijja-d Abihud. Abihud ijja-d Lyaqim. Lyaqim ijja-d Ƹazur.
normalised_text: zarubbabil ijjad abihud. abihud ijjad lyaqim. lyaqim ijjad cazur.

name: Tarifit
text: زَرُبَّابِل يجَّا-د أَبِيهُوْد. أَبِيهُوْد يجَّا-د لْيَاقِيم. لْيَاقِيم يجَّا-د عَازُوْر.
normalised_text: zarubaabil yjaad aabiyhuwd. aabiyhuwd yjaad lyaaqiym. lyaaqiym yjaad aazuwr.

name: Tarifit
text: Ƹazur ijja-d Ṣaduq. Ṣaduq ijja-d Axim. Axim ijja-d Alyud.
normalised_text: cazur ijjad saduq. saduq ijjad akhim. akhim ijjad alyud.

name: Tarifit
text: عَازُوْر يجَّا-د صَادُوْق. صَادُوْق يجَّا-د أَخِيم. أَخِيم يجَّا-د أَلْيُوْد.
normalised_text: aazuwr yjaad saaduwq. saaduwq yjaad aakhiym. aakhiym yjaad aalyuwd.

name: Tarifit
text: Alyud ijja-d Lƹizar. Lƹizar ijja-d Mattan. Mattan ijja-d Yaƹqub.
normalised_text: alyud ijjad lcizar. lcizar ijjad mattan. mattan ijjad yacqub.

name: Tarifit
text: أَلْيُوْد يجَّا-د لْعِزَار. لْعِزَار يجَّا-د مَتَّان. مَتَّان يجَّا-د يَعْقُوْب.
normalised_text: aalyuwd yjaad lizaar. lizaar yjaad mataan. mataan yjaad yaquwb.

name: Tashelhayt
text: ih̬wa‑wakal, ur‑gis‑illi yat. tillas ad‑kullu‑idln aman dranin, ar‑itkka rruḥ n‑rbbi f‑iggi n‑waman.
normalised_text: ikhwawakal, urgisilli yat. tillas adkulluidln aman dranin, aritkka rruh nrbbi figgi nwaman.

name: Tashelhayt
text: iẓr rbbi is‑tfulki tifawt. ibḍu rbbi tifawt d‑tillas.
normalised_text: izr rbbi istfulki tifawt. ibdu rbbi tifawt dtillas.

name: Tashelhayt
text: ig i‑tifawt ‹azal›, ig i‑tillas ‹iḍ›. tzri‑tdggʷat ifaw ṣbaḥ, ig ass amzwaru.
normalised_text: ig itifawt azal, ig itillas id. tzritdggat ifaw sbah, ig ass amzwaru.

name: Tashelhayt
text: yini rbbi: «a‑yili lhawa ġ‑wammas n‑waman a‑tn‑ibḍu s‑sin,».
normalised_text: yini rbbi "ayili lhawa ghwammas nwaman atnibdu ssin,".

name: Tashelhayt
text: s‑illa ġmkan. iskr rbbi lhawa, ibḍu srs aman n‑ddu lhawa d‑waman n‑iggi n‑lhawa.
normalised_text: silla ghmkan. iskr rbbi lhawa, ibdu srs aman nddu lhawa dwaman niggi nlhawa.

name: Tashelhayt
text: ig i‑lhawa ‹ignwan›. tzri‑tdggʷat ifaw ṣbaḥ, ig wis sin‑uwssan.
normalised_text: ig ilhawa ignwan. tzritdggat ifaw sbah, ig wis sinuwssan.

name: Tashelhayt
text: yini rbbi: «ad‑kullu‑munn‑waman n‑ddu ignwan ġ‑yat‑tsga, f‑a‑di‑tban taġart,» s‑illa ġmkan.

name: Tennet

name: Tennet

name: Tennet

name: Tennet
text: Azi bo̱do̱k imma zar ne Tigiris ci a̱ri̱k je̱e̱ne̱ ci lo̱o̱c ci een Assyria, kar zin liili ci een we̱c ko̱ zara kize Yuvurataz.

name: Tharaka

name: Tharaka
text: Barî Mbabironi, Njekonia aaciara Ciateeri, îthe wa Cerubabeeri.
normalised_text: vari mbavironi, njekonia aashiara shiateeri, idhe wa sheruvaveeri.

name: Tharaka
text: Cerubabeeri aarî îthe wa Abiûndi, na Abiûndi aarî îthe wa Eriakimu ûra aarî îthe wa Asoori.
normalised_text: sheruvaveeri aari idhe wa aviundi, na aviundi aari idhe wa eriakimu ura aari idhe wa asoori.

name: Tharaka
text: Asoori aarî îthe wa Sandoko ûra aarî îthe wa Akimû, îthe wa Eriundi.
normalised_text: asoori aari idhe wa sandoko ura aari idhe wa akimu, idhe wa eriundi.

name: Tharaka
text: Eriundi aarî îthe wa Eriasa ûra aarî îthe wa Mathani, îthe wa Njakubu.
normalised_text: eriundi aari idhe wa eriasa ura aari idhe wa madhani, idhe wa njakuvu.

name: Tharaka
text: Njakubu aarî îthe wa Njosebu, mûrûme wa Maria gina wa Yiesû Kîrîstû.
normalised_text: njakuvu aari idhe wa njosevu, murume wa maria gina wa yiesu kiristu.

name: Tharaka
text: Gûciarwa kwa Yiesû Kîrîstû gwakari ûûgû. Gina, Maria, agîkeethagua i Njosebu mbere ya bagûrana ooneka akamatîîte nda ya Kîrundu Ûmûtheru.
normalised_text: ghushiarwa kwa yiesu kiristu ghwakari uughu. gina, maria, aghikeedhaghua i njosevu mbere ya vaghurana ooneka akamatiite nda ya kirundu umudheru.

name: Tharaka
text: N'ûntû Njosebu aarî muntû ûmwagîru aathûgaania gûtiga Maria na witho n'ûntû ateendaga kûmwira îgi.
normalised_text: nuntu njosevu aari muntu umwaghiru aadhughaania ghutigha maria na widho nuntu ateendagha kumwira ighi.

name: Tharaka
text: Agaaciara kaana ga kaîyî ûgeete Yiesû, n'ûntû n'we akoonokia antû baume meeyiani.
normalised_text: aghaashiara kaana gha kaiyi ugheete yiesu, nuntu nwe akoonokia antu vaume meeyiani.

name: Tharaka
text: Mantû mamu monthe maakarire ûgu kaingo mantû mara maariirue i Mwathani gûkûrûkîîra kanyuani ga kîroria maûyûra, rîra augire.
normalised_text: mantu mamu monthe maakarire ughu kaingo mantu mara maariirue i mwadhani ghukurukiira kanyuani gha kiroria mauyura, rira aughire.

name: Tharaka
text: Mwana wa mwarî akaagîa nda aciare kaana ga kaîyî geetwe Imanueri.
normalised_text: mwana wa mwari akaaghia nda ashiare kaana gha kaiyi gheetwe imanueri.

name: Tharaka
text: Rîra Njosebu aûkire torooni, aarûtha wabûra mûraîka wa Mwathani aamwîrîîte. Aathûkia Maria arî mwekûrû wake.
normalised_text: rira njosevu aukire torooni, aarudha wavura muraika wa mwadhani aamwiriite. aadhukia maria ari mwekuru wake.

name: Tharaka
text: Njosebu ataamaama na mwekûrû wake mwanka aamba aaciara kaana ga kaîyî, ageeta Yiesû.
normalised_text: njosevu ataamaama na mwekuru wake mwanka aamba aashiara kaana gha kaiyi, agheeta yiesu.

name: Tharaka
text: Rîra mûnene Eronde aakinyîîrwe i mantû mamu eegua aatangîka mathûgaaniani maake. Na t'we wenka i Njerusaremu akubî yonthe.
normalised_text: rira munene eronde aakinyiirwe i mantu mamu eeghua aatangika madhughaaniani maake. na twe wenka i njerusaremu akuvi yonthe.

name: Tharaka
text: Eeta *athînjîri bara banene ba Ngai na aarimû ba watho bonthe amwe, abaûria i na kû kweerirwe Kîrîstû agaaciarwa.
normalised_text: eeta adhinjiri vara vanene va ngai na aarimu va wadho vonthe amwe, avauria i na ku kweerirwe kiristu aghaashiarwa.

name: Tharaka
text: Bamwîra, I taûni ya Bethireemu gîteereeni kîa Njundea, n'ûntû ûûgû i bu kwandîkîîtwe i kîroria.
normalised_text: vamwira, i tauni ya vedhireemu ghiteereeni kia njundea, nuntu uughu i vu kwandikiitwe i kiroria.

name: Tharaka
text: Woû, Bethireemu nthîgûrû ya Njunda, naka na woû ûtirî mûkai kîrî atongoria ba Njunda, n'ûntû ûkauma mûtongoria ûra akaatha antû baakwa ba Isiraeri. .
normalised_text: wou, vedhireemu nthighuru ya njunda, naka na wou utiri mukai kiri atongoria va njunda, nuntu ukauma mutongoria ura akaadha antu vaakwa va isiraeri..

name: Tharaka
text: Mûnene Eronde eeta antû babu baûgî kajûri, abaûria rîra rîongwa nthata înu yonekire.
normalised_text: munene eronde eeta antu vavu vaughi kajuri, avauria rira riongwa nthata inu yonekire.

name: Tharaka
text: Abatûma Bethireemu abeera, Îthiini bûcûnkûûne mantû ma kaana gaku. Bwakoona bûcookeere aaga bûkîmmenyithia kaingo na niû nthi gûkagonga.
normalised_text: avatuma vedhireemu aveera, idhiini vushunkuune mantu ma kaana ghaku. vwakoona vushookeere aagha vukimmenyidhia kaingo na niu nthi ghukaghonga.

name: Tharaka
text: Ngai abakaania kîrootooni abeera, Bûtigaacookeere kwa Mûnene Eronde kaîrî. Kwoogu bakîînûka baacookire na njîra îngî.
normalised_text: ngai avakaania kirootooni aveera, vutighaashookeere kwa munene eronde kairi. kwooghu vakiinuka vaashookire na njira ingi.

name: Themne
text: Ȧkȧfȧ ka rȧkom ra Yisɔs Krayst ɔWan ka Debid, ɔwan ka Ebraham, ki ake.
normalised_text: akafa ka rakom ra yisos krayst owan ka debid, owan ka ebraham, ki ake.

name: Themne
text: Ebrahamȧŋ ɔ kom Aysakȧŋ, Aysak ɔ kom Yekɔbȧŋ, Yekɔb ɔ kom Yudasȧŋ yi aŋwɔnt ŋɔŋ aruni.
normalised_text: ebrahamang o kom aysakang, aysak o kom yekobang, yekob o kom yudasang yi angwont ngong aruni.

name: Themne
text: Yudasȧŋ ɔ kom Ferɛs yi Sara ka Temar; Ferɛsȧŋ ɔ kom Hɛsrɔn; ka Hɛsrɔnȧŋ ɔ kom Aram;.
normalised_text: yudasang o kom feres yi sara ka temar; feresang o kom hesron; ka hesronang o kom aram;.

name: Themne
text: Eramȧŋ ɔ kom Aminadab; ka Aminadabȧŋ ɔ kom Nesɔn; ka Nesɔnȧŋ ɔ kom Salmɔn;.
normalised_text: eramang o kom aminadab; ka aminadabang o kom neson; ka nesonang o kom salmon;.

name: Themne
text: ɔwa Salmɔnȧŋ ɔ kom Bowas ka Rehab; ka Bowasȧŋ ɔ kom Obɛd ka Ruth; ka Obɛdȧŋ ɔ kom Yɛsi;.
normalised_text: owa salmonang o kom bowas ka rehab; ka bowasang o kom obed ka ruth; ka obedang o kom yesi;.

name: Themne
text: Yɛsiȧŋ ɔ kom Debidȧŋ ɔbȧy; ka Debid ɔbȧy ɔ kom Sɔlɔmɔn ka ɔrani ka Urayas;.
normalised_text: yesiang o kom debidang obay; ka debid obay o kom solomon ka orani ka urayas;.

name: Themne
text: Sɔlɔmɔnȧŋ ɔ kom Rihoboam; ka Rihoboamȧŋ ɔ kom Abaya; ka Abayaŋ ɔ kom Asa;.
normalised_text: solomonang o kom rihoboam; ka rihoboamang o kom abaya; ka abayang o kom asa;.

name: Themne
text: Asaŋ ɔ kom Yehosafat; ka Yehosafatȧŋ ɔ kom Yoram; ka Yoramȧŋ ɔ kom Osaya;.
normalised_text: asang o kom yehosafat; ka yehosafatang o kom yoram; ka yoramang o kom osaya;.

name: Themne
text: ka Osayaŋ ɔ kom Yotham; ka Yothamȧŋ ɔ kom Ehas; ka Ehasȧŋ ɔ kom Hɛsikaya;.
normalised_text: ka osayang o kom yotham; ka yothamang o kom ehas; ka ehasang o kom hesikaya;.

name: Themne
text: ka Hɛsikayaŋ ɔ kom Manasɛ; ka Manasɛŋ ɔ kom Emɔs; ka Amanȧŋ ɔ kom Yosaya;.
normalised_text: ka hesikayang o kom manase; ka manaseng o kom emos; ka amanang o kom yosaya;.

name: Themne
text: ka Yosayaŋ ɔ kom Yɛkonaya, yi aŋwɔnt ŋɔŋ aruni ka ȧŋlɔkɔ a kera ŋa ro Babilɔn.
normalised_text: ka yosayang o kom yekonaya, yi angwont ngong aruni ka angloko a kera nga ro babilon.

name: Themne
text: Kǝdarǝŋ ka ma a kera ŋa ro Babilɔn-e, Yɛkonayaŋ ɔ kom Salathiyɛl; ka Salathiɛlȧŋ ɔ kom Sirɔbabɛl;.
normalised_text: kedareng ka ma a kera nga ro babilone, yekonayang o kom salathiyel; ka salathielang o kom sirobabel;.

name: Themne
text: ka Sirɔbabɛlȧŋ ɔ kom Abiud; ka Abiudȧŋ ɔ kom Ilayakim; ka Ilayakimȧŋ ɔ kom Asɔr;.
normalised_text: ka sirobabelang o kom abiud; ka abiudang o kom ilayakim; ka ilayakimang o kom asor;.

name: Themne
text: ka Asɔr ɔ kom Sedɔk; ka Sedɔkȧŋ ɔ kom Akim; ka Akimȧŋ ɔ kom Ilayud;.
normalised_text: ka asor o kom sedok; ka sedokang o kom akim; ka akimang o kom ilayud;.

name: Themne
text: ka Ilayudȧŋ ɔ kom Ɛliyesar; ka Ɛliyesarȧŋ ɔ kom Mȧthan; ka Mȧthanȧŋ ɔ kom Yekɔb;.
normalised_text: ka ilayudang o kom eliyesar; ka eliyesarang o kom mathan; ka mathanang o kom yekob;.

name: Themne
text: ka Yekɔbȧŋ ɔ kom Yosɛf ɔwos ka Meri ɔwe kom Yisɔsȧŋ, ɔwe a bont Krayst.
normalised_text: ka yekobang o kom yosef owos ka meri owe kom yisosang, owe a bont krayst.

name: Themne
text: Ɔwa kakom ka Yisɔs kǝ yi yaŋ; ma Yosɛf ɔ po fath Meriȧŋ ɔkara ka Yisɔs, yeŋka aŋ yiranɛ-e, a fir kǝpa ɔ yi ukor ka ɔYina mǝsǝm.
normalised_text: owa kakom ka yisos ke yi yang; ma yosef o po fath meriang okara ka yisos, yengka ang yiranee, a fir kepa o yi ukor ka oyina mesem.

name: Themne
text: Kɛrɛ Yosɛfȧŋ ɔwos kɔŋ-e, ma ɔ yi wuni lompi-e, ɔ yema hɛ wɔŋȧ kɔ mǝlap-e, ɔ nanɛ tǝ kǝter kɔ sɔy.
normalised_text: kere yosefang owos konge, ma o yi wuni lompie, o yema he wonga ko melape, o nane te keter ko soy.

name: Themne
text: Ɔ tǝ kom wath uruni. Ɔwa mǝ yi tǝ kǝbont kɔ ŋes Yisɔs, kotȧy-e kɔnɔ mǝ kisis aŋfǝm ŋɔŋ ka ɛhakɛ yaŋ.
normalised_text: o te kom wath uruni. owa me yi te kebont ko nges yisos, kotaye kono me kisis angfem ngong ka ehake yang.

name: Themne
text: Ȧte bɛ tǝ yɔnɛ kȧmȧ ȧrim ra ɔMarki rǝ lasǝr ka tapa ta aŋnabi-e, kepa.
normalised_text: ate be te yone kama arim ra omarki re laser ka tapa ta angnabie, kepa.

name: Themne
text: Kǝla, ufanɛ ɔ tǝ gbasi kor, Ɔ tǝ kom wath uruni, Ɔwa a tǝ bont kɔ ŋes, Imanuɛl, .
normalised_text: kela, ufane o te gbasi kor, o te kom wath uruni, owa a te bont ko nges, imanuel,.

name: Themne
text: Ɔwa ma Yosɛf ɔ thǝmɛ ka mȧrey mɔŋ-e, ɔ yɔ mɔ mǝ ɔmaleka ka ɔMarki ɔ yamari kɔ, kɔ gbasi ɔrani kɔŋ ro seth kɔŋ.
normalised_text: owa ma yosef o theme ka marey monge, o yo mo me omaleka ka omarki o yamari ko, ko gbasi orani kong ro seth kong.

name: Themne
text: Kɛrɛ ɔ tɛ hɛ kɔ haŋ ɔ po kom ɔwan kɔŋ uruni utɔtɔkɔ. Ka a bont kɔ ŋes Yisɔs.
normalised_text: kere o te he ko hang o po kom owan kong uruni utotoko. ka a bont ko nges yisos.

name: Themne
text: Ɔwa ma a kom Yisɔsȧŋ ro Bɛthlihɛm ȧke ro Yudia ka mȧrey ma Hɛrɔd ɔbay-e, kǝla, afǝm atempi aŋ der ro Yerusalɛm kǝyɛfȧ ro thɔrɔŋ.
normalised_text: owa ma a kom yisosang ro bethlihem ake ro yudia ka marey ma herod obaye, kela, afem atempi ang der ro yerusalem keyefa ro thorong.

name: Themne
text: kaŋ pa, Kɔn-a ɔwe a kom ubȧy ka aŋYuda-a? kotȧy-e sǝ po nənk akɔs kɔŋ ro thɔrɔŋ, ɔwa sǝ der tǝ kǝbatho kɔ.
normalised_text: kang pa, kona owe a kom ubay ka angyudaa? kotaye se po nenk akos kong ro thorong, owa se der te kebatho ko.

name: Themne
text: Ma Herodȧŋ ɔbȧy ɔ tǝl ti-e, pǝ sɔmpa kɔ yi aŋfǝm bɛ ro Yerusalɛm.
normalised_text: ma herodang obay o tel tie, pe sompa ko yi angfem be ro yerusalem.

name: Themne
text: kɔ thoŋkla aŋfode ȧbana yi aŋkarmɔkɔ ŋa aŋfǝme, ɔ yifǝth ŋa ta ro a yi tǝ kǝkom ɔKrayst.
normalised_text: ko thongkla angfode abana yi angkarmoko nga angfeme, o yifeth nga ta ro a yi te kekom okrayst.

name: Themne
text: kaŋ pa ro ŋɔŋ, Ro Bɛthlihɛm ȧke ka ȧŋthɔf ŋa ro Yudia; kotȧy-e yaŋ ɔnȧbi ɔ gbal kǝpa.
normalised_text: kang pa ro ngong, ro bethlihem ake ka angthof nga ro yudia; kotaye yang onabi o gbal kepa.

name: Themne
text: Munɔ Bɛthlihɛm, ka ȧŋthɔf ŋa Yuda, Mǝ yi hɛ ulɔl pǝthas aŋkərbomp ŋa aŋ Yuda; kotȧy-e ugbǝkȧ ɔ tǝwur ro mu Ɔwe mǝ yi ɔbumǝr ka aŋfǝm a mi aŋIsrɛl.
normalised_text: muno bethlihem, ka angthof nga yuda, me yi he ulol pethas angkerbomp nga ang yuda; kotaye ugbeka o tewur ro mu owe me yi obumer ka angfem a mi angisrel.

name: Themne
text: Ka Herodȧŋ ɔ tela aŋfǝm atempi sɔy, kɔ yifǝth ŋa finɔ ta ȧŋlɔkɔ aŋa akɔs kǝ tɔrinɛ.
normalised_text: ka herodang o tela angfem atempi soy, ko yifeth nga fino ta angloko anga akos ke torine.

name: Thur
text: Lobo onwongo obedo atata na gin mörö ope ïë, pïny na cöl onwongo oumo pii na tye ï nam ëka Tipo k'Obanga onwongo olyero ï wi pii.
normalised_text: lobo onwongo obedo atata na gin moro ope ie, piny na chol onwongo oumo pii na tye i nam eka tipo kobanga onwongo olyero i wi pii.

name: Thur
text: Cë Obanga okobo nï, Ëk tar obed na tye, ëka tar obedo na tye.
normalised_text: che obanga okobo ni, ek tar obed na tye, eka tar obedo na tye.

name: Thur
text: Obanga önënö nï tar onwongo bër, ëka ën opoko tar kï ï kom pïny na cöl.
normalised_text: obanga oneno ni tar onwongo ber, eka en opoko tar ki i kom piny na chol.

name: Thur
text: Obanga öcakö nyïng tar nï kiceng, ëka pïny na cöl nï kiwor. Pïny ocido ëka pïny oru—manön nïnö më acël.
normalised_text: obanga ochako nying tar ni kicheng, eka piny na chol ni kiwor. piny ochido eka piny orumanon nino me achel.

name: Thur
text: Cë Obanga okobo nï, Ëk gin n'öpëdhërë obed na tye ï dyere pii na poko pii kï ï kom pii.
normalised_text: che obanga okobo ni, ek gin nopedhere obed na tye i dyere pii na poko pii ki i kom pii.

name: Thur
text: Obanga ocweo gin n'öpëdhërë na poko pii na tye pïny kï ï kom pii na tye malö. Ëka obedo nï kömanön.
normalised_text: obanga ochweo gin nopedhere na poko pii na tye piny ki i kom pii na tye malo. eka obedo ni komanon.

name: Thur
text: Obanga öcakö nyïng gin n'öpëdhërë na poko pii nï polo. Pïny ocido ëka pïny oru—manön nïnö më arïö.
normalised_text: obanga ochako nying gin nopedhere na poko pii ni polo. piny ochido eka piny orumanon nino me ario.

name: Thur
text: Cë Obanga okobo nï, Ëk pii na tye ï thë polo ögürë kanya acël ï kabedo acël ëk ngöm n'öthwö onen. Ëka obedo nï kömanön.
normalised_text: che obanga okobo ni, ek pii na tye i the polo ogure kanya achel i kabedo achel ek ngom nothwo onen. eka obedo ni komanon.

name: Thur
text: Obanga öcakö nyïng ngöm n'öthwö nï lobo ëka pii n'ögürë kanya acël öcakö nyïngë nï nam. Ëka Obanga önënö onwongo nï bër.
normalised_text: obanga ochako nying ngom nothwo ni lobo eka pii nogure kanya achel ochako nyinge ni nam. eka obanga oneno onwongo ni ber.

name: Thur
text: Cë Obanga okobo nï, Ëk jami na mïö tar obed na tye ï wi polo më poko kiceng kï ï kom kiwor, ëk gïn obed na calö anyuth më poko karë, nïnö ëka mwaka.
normalised_text: che obanga okobo ni, ek jami na mio tar obed na tye i wi polo me poko kicheng ki i kom kiwor, ek gin obed na chalo anyuth me poko kare, nino eka mwaka.

name: Thur
text: ëk obed gïnï tar na ryëny kï ï wi polo më mënyö wi lobo. Ëka obedo nï kömanön.
normalised_text: ek obed gini tar na ryeny ki i wi polo me menyo wi lobo. eka obedo ni komanon.

name: Thur
text: Obanga ocweo jami arïö na thwon na ryëny—mana thwönë më löönö kiceng, ëka mana tïdï më löönö kiwor. Ën thon oketho cër.
normalised_text: obanga ochweo jami ario na thwon na ryenymana thwone me loono kicheng, eka mana tidi me loono kiwor. en thon oketho cher.

name: Thur
text: më löönö kiceng ëka kiwor, ëka më poko tar kï ï kom pïny na cöl. Ëka Obanga önënö onwongo nï bër.
normalised_text: me loono kicheng eka kiwor, eka me poko tar ki i kom piny na chol. eka obanga oneno onwongo ni ber.

name: Thur
text: Pïny ocido ëka pïny oru—manön nïnö më angwën.
normalised_text: piny ochido eka piny orumanon nino me angwen.

name: Thur
text: Cë Obanga okobo nï, Ëk gin na kwö opong ï pii më nam, ëka wïny öngwëc gïnï malö ï wi polo.
normalised_text: che obanga okobo ni, ek gin na kwo opong i pii me nam, eka winy ongwech gini malo i wi polo.

name: Thur
text: Obanga ömïögï gum ëka okobo nï, Nywöl ïnya unu, ipong unu ï pii na tye ï nam, ëka wïny thon önya ï wi lobo.
normalised_text: obanga omiogi gum eka okobo ni, nywol inya unu, ipong unu i pii na tye i nam, eka winy thon onya i wi lobo.

name: Thur
text: Cë Obanga ocweo dhanö ï cal mërë kikokome, Obanga ocweogï ï cal mërë, ocweo ëcwö ëka dhakö.
normalised_text: che obanga ochweo dhano i cal mere kikokome, obanga ochweogi i cal mere, ochweo echwo eka dhako.

name: Thur
text: Cë Obanga okobo nï, An amïöwu kodhi kïbëc më wi lobo thükül na nyakö nyig-gï ëka yen kïbëc na nyakö nyig-gï na kodhi tye ï ïgï. Un ibino camögï.
normalised_text: che obanga okobo ni, an amiowu kodhi kibech me wi lobo thukul na nyako nyiggi eka yen kibech na nyako nyiggi na kodhi tye i igi. un ibino chamogi.

name: Thur
text: Obanga önënö jami kïbëc na ën ocweo, ëka onwongo nï bër rwök. Pïny ocido ëka pïny oru—manön nïnö më abicël.
normalised_text: obanga oneno jami kibech na en ochweo, eka onwongo ni ber rwok. piny ochido eka piny orumanon nino me abichel.

name: Thur
text: Cë Obanga otyeko cweno polo ëka lobo kï jami kïbëc na tye ïë.
normalised_text: che obanga otyeko chweno polo eka lobo ki jami kibech na tye ie.

name: Thur
text: Ï nïnö më abïrö, Obanga onwongo otyeko tic mërë na ën obedo ka tïmö, ëka oyweo kï ï kom tic mërë kïbëc.
normalised_text: i nino me abiro, obanga onwongo otyeko tic mere na en obedo ka timo, eka oyweo ki i kom tic mere kibech.

name: Thur
text: Ëka Obanga ömïö gum ï kom nïnö më abïrö cë ömïö ödökö na leng, pïën ï nïnö nön ën oyweo kï ï kom tic mërë kïbëc më cwec na ën otio.
normalised_text: eka obanga omio gum i kom nino me abiro che omio odoko na leng, pien i nino non en oyweo ki i kom tic mere kibech me chwech na en otio.

name: Thur
text: Man ënë kite na polo ëka lobo öcakërë ködë ï karë n'ecweogï. Ï karë na Rwoth Obanga ocweo lobo ëka polo—.
normalised_text: man ene kite na polo eka lobo ochakere kode i kare nechweogi. i kare na rwoth obanga ochweo lobo eka polo.

name: Tigon Mbembe
text: Srakàda atehuŋ ma ke kú Yeso Kristò edɛ Ŋwa àfα Devì á yá ma Ŋwa Abràha huŋ.

name: Tigon Mbembe
text: Abràha yá ma so Izìk, Izìk yá ma so Jèkɔp, Jèkɔp yá ma so Judà wo zhyɛnyɔ̀ ge hɛ.
normalised_text: abraha ya ma so izik, izik ya ma so jekop, jekop ya ma so juda wo zhyenyo ge he.

name: Tigon Mbembe
text: Judà yá ma so Perè wo Zɛrà. Nyɔ̀ bo yá ma Tamà. Perè yá ma so Hɛzrɔ̀, Hɛzrɔ̀ so Ram.
normalised_text: juda ya ma so pere wo zera. nyo bo ya ma tama. pere ya ma so hezro, hezro so ram.

name: Tigon Mbembe
text: Ram yá ma so Ammìnadà, Ammìnadà so Nashyò. Nashyò yá ma so Salmù.
normalised_text: ram ya ma so amminada, amminada so nashyo. nashyo ya ma so salmu.

name: Tigon Mbembe
text: Salmù so Bowà, yi nyɔ̀wé yá ma Rahà huŋ. Bowà yá ma so Obɛ̀t, yi nyɔ̀wé yá ma Rot huŋ, Obɛ̀t yá ma so Jesì.

name: Tigon Mbembe
text: Jesì yá ma so àfα Devì. Devì yá ma so Solomù, yi nyɔ̀wé yá ma va Yuryà huŋ.

name: Tigon Mbembe
text: Solomù yá ma so Rèhobwam, Rèhobwam yá ma so Àbijà, Àbijà yá ma so Àsa.

name: Tigon Mbembe
text: Àsa yá ma so Jèhoshafat. Jèhoshafat yá ma so Joràm, Joràm yá ma so Ùzayà.

name: Tigon Mbembe
text: Ùzayà yá ma so Jotàm, Jotàm yá ma so Áhàs, Áhàs yá ma so Hèzikyà.

name: Tigon Mbembe
text: Hèzikyà yá ma so Mànasè, Mànasè yá ma so Emɔ̀n, Emɔ̀n yá ma so Jòzayà.
normalised_text: hezikya ya ma so manase, manase ya ma so emon, emon ya ma so jozaya.

name: Tigon Mbembe
text: Jòzayà yá ma so Jèkoníyà wo zhyɛnyɔ̀ ge. Bo yá mbà bo ebɔ bo yá kpɛdɔte wo wa Izrὰ ŋɛ Babilɔ̀ huŋ.

name: Tigon Mbembe
text: Ebɔ bo yá kpɛdɔtegbα wo bo ŋɛ Babilɔ̀ huŋ, Jèkoníyà yá ma so Shyɛtɛ, Shyɛtɛ yá ma so Zerobabɛ̀l.
normalised_text: ebo bo ya kpedotegba wo bo nge babilo hung, jekoniya ya ma so shyete, shyete ya ma so zerobabel.

name: Tigon Mbembe
text: Zerobabɛ̀l yá ma so Abyɔ̀t, Abyɔ̀t yá ma so Èliyakìm, Èliyakìm yá ma so Azù.

name: Tigon Mbembe
text: Azù yá ma so Zádɔ̀k, Zádɔ̀k yá ma so Áchìm, Áchìm yá ma so Eliyùt.

name: Tigon Mbembe
text: Eliyùt yá ma so Èliyazà, Èliyazà yá ma so Matàn, Matàn yá ma so Jèkɔp.

name: Tigon Mbembe
text: Jèkɔp yá ma so Jòsɛ á ma nwa Mɛ̀ri á yá mbà Yeso, yi bo yi bé lɛ, Kristò huŋ.

name: Tigon Mbembe
text: Ngè pyɔ atehuŋ, yi bo yá mbà Yeso Kristò yi. Jòsɛ yá zète Mɛ̀ri. Bɛ bo lɛ̀ bαmí dribo huŋ, yi Mɛ̀ri fyegbα pre kokro ngre Vomwɛ Achacha.
normalised_text: nge pyo atehung, yi bo ya mba yeso kristo yi. jose ya zete meri. be bo le bami dribo hung, yi meri fyegba pre kokro ngre vomwe achacha.

name: Tigon Mbembe
text: Nwa ge Jòsɛ, yi zrɔbye ge yá setetemɔ ju Mbɔchù huŋ, yá katê ke ŋɔ bα pyɔ ewɛ́ ke mbu ge mu, ngè è yá sepɔ pyɔ bombò gè ke bé bα eví yi.

name: Tigon Mbembe
text: È ke mbà ŋwa ngunwa, nɛ ke bé ge lɛ, Yeso, ke è ke pofye wa é abebe bo yi.

name: Tigon Mbembe
text: Chyα atehɛ mbri ya ju endɛndɛ be Mpwèmya yá yate é ngru pwὰpwὰ Mbɔchù lɛ.

name: Tigon Mbembe
text: Vè nɛ mû, nguva á yá yipɔ̂ ngunwa mu huŋ ke fye pre, è ke mbà ŋwa ngunwa. Zre ge ke ma lɛ, Èmanwɛ̀. Yacha ge ma lɛ, Mbɔchù mafɔ̀ wo nyi.
normalised_text: ve ne mu, nguva a ya yipo ngunwa mu hung ke fye pre, e ke mba ngwa ngunwa. zre ge ke ma le, emanwe. yacha ge ma le, mbochu mafo wo nyi.

name: Tigon Mbembe
text: Ebɔ Jòsɛ fɔzhi enru huŋ, è tɔwa be nchènda Mbɔchù huŋ, yaŋa ge huŋ, ngè è bαwa Mɛ̀ri.

name: Tigon Mbembe
text: Bɛhuŋ, bombò ge yá gbòkotê mu, tètè be è yá mbà ŋwa ngunwa, è yá chè ge zre lɛ, Yeso.

name: Tigon Mbembe
text: Ebɔ àfα Hɛrɔ̀ yá pɔ chyα atehɛ, ge yá nɛ̀ ge shyɛ wo wa Jèrosalɛ̀ hɛ mbri.

name: Tigon Mbembe
text: È yá bégbòko washyé e tá Mbɔchù wo chɔche bɔ̀bye, è bipɔ bo bre bo ma ke mbà gè Kristò huŋ.

name: Tigon Mbembe

name: Tigon Mbembe
text: Ebɔ bo vè vasɔ huŋ ndate huŋ, pushyɛ bo yá ŋwɛ̀te wo enɛmɔ gbαwa.

name: Tigon Mbembe

name: Tigon Mbembe
text: Fɔnzo huŋ, Jòsɛ yá chitɔmɔ, è mbu ŋwashyò huŋ, wo nyɔ̀wé ché alɔhuŋ ke dɔ Ijìp yi.

name: Tigrinya
text: ምድሪ እውን ጥራሓ ነበረት፤ ዝኾነ ነገርውን ኣይነበራን። ፀልማት ከዓ ኣብ ልዕሊ መዓሙቝ ነበረ። መንፈስ እግዚኣብሄር ድማ ኣብ ልዕሊ ማያት ይዝምቢ ነበረ።.

normalised_text: akaa angan ka mhii u akaa a sha man a tar zum u i gba a je la. sha iyange i ter aondo er sha man tar la yo.

name: Tiv
text: saa di irkpiigh tsô, lu gban, ndôhôr tar cii ye.
normalised_text: saa di irkpiigh tso, lu gban, ndohor tar chii ye.

name: Tiv
text: TER Aôndo maa or sha vuulevu u inyaagh, fehe nan iôôn i uma ken ahenga, or la maa hingir or u uma:.
normalised_text: ter aondo maa or sha vuulevu u inyaagh, fehe nan ioon i uma ken ahenga, or la maa hingir or u uma.

name: Tiv
text: TER Aôndo er sule ken Eden vegher u sha ityoughkitaregh, ver or u A er la keregh.
normalised_text: ter aondo er sule ken eden vegher u sha ityoughkitaregh, ver or u a er la keregh.

name: Tiv
text: Ifi kpaa due ken Eden sha u ndôhôr sule la, ka haala a pav a ta agbaa a anyiin ye.
normalised_text: ifi kpaa due ken eden sha u ndohor sule la, ka haala a pav a ta agbaa a anyiin ye.

name: Toma
text: Tɔɔzeizu mɔunpa GALA ge geeɠɔlɔgi ta zooi ɓɛtɛni.
normalised_text: tuozeizu mounpa gala ge geegologi ta zooi beteni.

name: Toma
text: Kɛʋele ɠila ge la ɠɛni zooi ʋa, suɲakai ɠɛni de. Kpidii ʋɛɛni ziɛ zɛbɛlɛ golai ɠa. GALA Zɛnvui ɠɛni leʋeteʋesu ziɛi ɠa.
normalised_text: keuele gila ge la geni zooi ua, sunyakai geni de. kpidii uieni zie zebele golai ga. gala zenvui geni leueteuesu ziei ga.

name: Toma
text: GALA ge ɠɛni ma: «Wozakalagi ɠula.» Wozakalagi ma ge ɠula.
normalised_text: gala ge geni ma "wozakalagi gula." wozakalagi ma ge gula.

name: Toma
text: GALA ge kaani ga wozakalagi ʋagɛ. GALA ge wozakalagi ta kpidii yeeɠaaɠwɛɛni.
normalised_text: gala ge kaani ga wozakalagi uage. gala ge wozakalagi ta kpidii yeegaagwieni.

name: Toma
text: GALA ge wozakalagi laasei pɛɛni ga foloi, é kpidii laasei pɛɛ ga kuai. Kpidii ʋɛɛni, geelaalao: naa ɠɛni ga folo mɔungi.
normalised_text: gala ge wozakalagi laasei pieni ga foloi, e kpidii laasei pie ga kuai. kpidii uieni, geelaalao naa geni ga folo moungi.

name: Toma
text: GALA ge ɠɛni ma: «Zɔɠɔzu ɠɛ ziɛiti ba, é ziɛiti zeeɠaaɠwɛ ta ziɛiti.».
normalised_text: gala ge geni ma "zogozu ge zieiti ba, e zieiti zeegaagwe ta zieiti.".

name: Toma
text: GALA ge zɔɠɔzu ɠɛɛni ziɛiti ba, niiti ti buu ʋelei, ta niiti ti maazu ʋelei. Naa ɠɛɛni ɠana nɔ.
normalised_text: gala ge zogozu gieni zieiti ba, niiti ti buu uelei, ta niiti ti maazu uelei. naa gieni gana no.

name: Toma
text: GALA ge zɔɠɔzuʋɛ laasei pɛɛni ga geeɠɔlɔgi. Kpidii ʋɛɛni, geelaalao: naa ɠɛni ga foloi velesiɛi.
normalised_text: gala ge zogozoue laasei pieni ga geegologi. kpidii uieni, geelaalao naa geni ga foloi velesiei.

name: Toma
text: GALA ge ɠɛni ma: «Ziɛiti ti geeɠɔlɔgi wu, naati ti ɠaalɛ ba ada ɠila, ada vɔɔi ɠula kɛlɛma.» Naa ɠɛɛni ɠana nɔ.
normalised_text: gala ge geni ma "zieiti ti geegologi wu, naati ti gaale ba ada gila, ada vuoi gula kelema." naa gieni gana no.

name: Toma
text: GALA ge ma vɔɔi laasei pɛɛni ga zooi. Ziɛiti ti ɠaalɛai ba, é naati daasei pɛɛ ga kpoloɗɛiti. GALA ge kaani ga naa ʋagɛ.
normalised_text: gala ge ma vuoi laasei pieni ga zooi. zieiti ti gaaleai ba, e naati daasei pie ga kpolodeiti. gala ge kaani ga naa uage.

name: Toma
text: Kpidii ʋɛɛni, geelaalao: naa ɠɛni ga foloi zaʋasiɛi.

name: Toma
text: ti ɠɛ ga wozakalagiti geei ɠaaʋɛ, ti eteai zuɠala.» Naa ɠɛɛni ɠana nɔ.
normalised_text: ti ge ga wozakalagiti geei gaaue, ti eteai zugala." naa gieni gana no.

name: Toma
text: GALA ge wozakala gola felegɔiti kpɛtɛni, ma wola gelei ɗa zei foloi unda, ma go gelei ɗa zei kuai unda. É somideɠaiti ɓalaa kpɛtɛni.
normalised_text: gala ge wozakala gola felegoiti kpeteni, ma wola gelei da zei foloi unda, ma go gelei da zei kuai unda. e somidegaiti balaa kpeteni.

name: Toma
text: GALA ge ti zɛlɛni geei ɠaaʋɛ ga ti ɗa eteai zuɠala.

name: Toma
text: ti zei foloi ta kuai unda, ti wozakalagi ta kpidii yeeɠaaɠwɛ. GALA ge kaani ga naa ʋagɛ.

name: Toma
text: Kpidii ʋɛɛni, geelaalao: naa ɠɛni ga foloi naanisiɛi.

name: Toma
text: GALA ge ɠɛni ma: «Ziɛ wu ani vuluiti ti wola mɔin ziɛiti bu, wɔniiti ti ɗa ɠoʋe geezuʋɛ, zooi maazu.».
normalised_text: gala ge geni ma "zie wu ani vuluiti ti wola moin zieiti bu, woniiti ti da goue geezoue, zooi maazu.".

name: Toma
text: GALA ge tuya looni ti ʋɛ, é ɠɛ ma: «À ɓuɠu, wo mɔin, wo kpoloɗɛiti buulaave, wɔniiti ti mɔin eteai zu.».
normalised_text: gala ge tuya looni ti ue, e ge ma "a bugu, wo moin, wo kpolodeiti buulaave, woniiti ti moin eteai zu.".

name: Toma
text: Kpidii ʋɛɛni, geelaalao: naa ɠɛni ga foloi lɔɔlusiɛi.

name: Toma
text: GALA ge nuɓusɛi ɓɛtɛni ga tɔ ɓɔɠɔi maaniinigi, é kpɛtɛni ga GALA maaniinigi. É zunui ta anzanui ɓɛtɛni.
normalised_text: gala ge nubusei beteni ga to bogoi maaniinigi, e kpeteni ga gala maaniinigi. e zunui ta anzanui beteni.

name: Toma
text: Gè tufa wundui vea ga daamianigi zou ɠa zuaiti pɛ bɛ, ta wɔniiti, ta nii kpein é ɓokposu zooi ma, nii nɔpɛ zɛnvu viilɛi su.» Naa ɠɛɛni ɠana nɔ.
normalised_text: ge tufa wundui vea ga daamianigi zou ga zuaiti pe be, ta woniiti, ta nii kpein e bokposu zooi ma, nii nope zenvu viilei su." naa gieni gana no.

name: Toma
text: GALA ge kaani ga nii kpein é kpɛtɛai, ti wola ʋagɛ. Kpidii ʋɛɛni, geelaalao: naa ɠɛni ga foloi lɔzitasiɛi.

name: Toma
text: Pele ɠana geeɠɔlɔgi ɓɛtɛ vai ɓeni la ta zooi, ta ti zu aniiti kpein.

name: Toma
text: Foloi lɔfelasiɛi, GALA kpegai ma ga ná-botii ɠaaɓela, é looɠoni ná-botii pɛ ba, nii é kɛɛni.

name: Toma
text: GALA ge tuya looni foloi lɔfelasiɛi ʋɛ, é makɛ ɓɔɠɔ ʋɛ, tɔɔzei naama voloi é looɠoni, é lo ná-botii pɛ ba, aniiti kpɛtɛ vai zu é kɛɛni.

name: Toma
text: Geeɠɔlɔgi ta zooi lɔɔzei ʋelei ɠa é ga nii, siɛgi zu ti ɓɛtɛni la. Siɛgi zu Ɠɔoɠɔ GALAGI zooi ta geeɠɔlɔgi ɓɛtɛni la.

name: Toma
text: Kɛlɛ ɓumugi ɠɛni wuzeɠezu, é ɗa zooi ma yɛɓɛ.

name: Toma
text: Ɠɔoɠɔ GALAGI zooi ma ʋɔlɔi zeɠeni, é kpɛtɛ ga zunui, é zɛnvu viilɛi ʋu sokpayeɠeiti su, zunui ɠɛ ga zɛnvu su anii.
normalised_text: guogo galagi zooi ma uoloi zegeni, e kpete ga zunui, e zenvu viilei ou sokpayegeiti su, zunui ge ga zenvu su anii.

name: Toma
text: Naa ʋolu Ɠɔoɠɔ GALAGI kpelei leʋeni Edɛn yooi zu, folo ɠulazu ʋelei. É zunui ʋilɛni su, nii é kpɛtɛai.

name: Toma
text: Ziɛ wolai ɠɛni ɠulazu Edɛn yooi zu, é ɗa ʋu kpelei ma. Kulaai ma ná ʋa, gaaɠwɛɛni su ga ma ɓeke naanigɔ.

normalised_text: na onyankopon kaa se asase mfifiri nwira, mfudie, nnuaba sedie won su tie wo asase so. na eyee saa.

name: Twi
text: Na Onyankopɔn kae sɛ asase mfifi nwura frɔmfrɔm, nhaban a ɛsow aba, nnua a ɛsow nnuaba sɛnea ne su te a n'aba wɔ mu, wɔ asase so. Na ɛyɛɛ sa.
normalised_text: na onyankopon kae se asase mfifi nwura fromfrom, nhaban a esow aba, nnua a esow nnuaba senea ne su te a naba wo mu, wo asase so. na eyee sa.

name: Twi
text: Afifide a ɛsow aba ne nnua fifii wɔ asase so na nʼaba no nyin yɛɛ nnua ne afifide sɛ ne sɛso. Onyankopɔn hui sɛ eye.
normalised_text: afifide a esow aba ne nnua fifii wo asase so na naba no nyin yee nnua ne afifide se ne seso. onyankopon hui se eye.

name: Tyap
text: Á̱si̱ bani bya yet nche a̱yaatyia̱ a̱khwop Yesu a̱ yet Kristi, a̱tyu nang A̱gwaza kup gu tyok a̱ni. Nggu wa yet a̱ka̱mbwon Da̱wuda ma̱ng Ibrahim.
normalised_text: esi bani bya yet nche eyaatyie ekhwop yesu e yet kristi, etyu nang egwaza kup gu tyok eni. ngu wa yet ekembwon dewuda meng ibrahim.

name: Tyap
text: Ibrahim wa yet a̱tyia̱ Ishaku. Ishaku si̱ yet a̱tyia̱ Yakubu. Yakubu si̱ yet a̱tyia̱ Yahuda ma̱ng á̱na̱nyiuk Yahuda ba.
normalised_text: ibrahim wa yet etyie ishaku. ishaku si yet etyie yakubu. yakubu si yet etyie yahuda meng enenyiuk yahuda ba.

name: Tyap
text: Yahuda si̱ yet a̱tyia̱ Fa̱risa ma̱ng Zera . Fa̱risa si̱ yet a̱tyia̱ Ha̱sa̱ron. Ha̱sa̱ron si̱ yet a̱tyia̱ A̱ram .
normalised_text: yahuda si yet etyie ferisa meng zera. ferisa si yet etyie heseron. heseron si yet etyie eram.

name: Tyap
text: A̱ram si̱ yet a̱tyia̱ A̱minadap. A̱minadap si̱ yet a̱tyia̱ Nashon. Nashon si̱ yet a̱tyia̱ Salmun.
normalised_text: eram si yet etyie eminadap. eminadap si yet etyie nashon. nashon si yet etyie salmun.

name: Tyap
text: Salmun si̱ yet a̱tyia̱ Bowat . Bowat si̱ yet a̱tyia̱ Obed . Obed si̱ yet a̱tyia̱ Yesi.
normalised_text: salmun si yet etyie bowat. bowat si yet etyie obed. obed si yet etyie yesi.

name: Tyap
text: Yesi si̱ yet a̱tyia̱ a̱gwam Da̱wuda. A̱gwam Da̱wuda si̱ ma ngyet a̱tyia̱ Solomon. .
normalised_text: yesi si yet etyie egwam dewuda. egwam dewuda si ma ngyet etyie solomon..

name: Tyap
text: Solomon si̱ yet a̱tyia̱ Ra̱habam. Ra̱habam si̱ yet a̱tyia̱ A̱biya. A̱biya si̱ yet a̱tyia̱ Asa .
normalised_text: solomon si yet etyie rehabam. rehabam si yet etyie ebiya. ebiya si yet etyie asa.

name: Tyap
text: Asa si̱ yet a̱tyia̱ Ja̱hushafat. Ja̱hushafat si̱ yet a̱tyia̱ Joram . Joram si̱ yet a̱tyia̱ Uziya.
normalised_text: asa si yet etyie jehushafat. jehushafat si yet etyie joram. joram si yet etyie uziya.

name: Tyap
text: Uziya si̱ yet a̱tyia̱ Jotam. Jotam si̱ yet a̱tyia̱ Ahaz. Ahaz si̱ yet a̱tyia̱ Hezikiya.
normalised_text: uziya si yet etyie jotam. jotam si yet etyie ahaz. ahaz si yet etyie hezikiya.

name: Tyap
text: Hezikiya si̱ yet a̱tyia̱ Ma̱nasa. Ma̱nasa si̱ yet a̱tyia̱ Amon . Amon si̱ yet a̱tyia̱ Josiya.
normalised_text: hezikiya si yet etyie menasa. menasa si yet etyie amon. amon si yet etyie josiya.

name: Tyap
text: Josiya si̱ yet a̱tyia̱ Jehoyakim ma̱ng á̱na̱nyiuk nggu ba.
normalised_text: josiya si yet etyie jehoyakim meng enenyiuk ngu ba.

name: Tyap
text: Nang ba̱ ku ntyak khwo hu ma̱ a̱byin Babila ka a̱ni, Jehoyakim si̱ yet a̱tyia̱ Sha̱li̱tiyel. Sha̱li̱tiyel si̱ yet a̱tyia̱ Za̱rubabel.
normalised_text: nang be ku ntyak khwo hu me ebyin babila ka eni, jehoyakim si yet etyie shelitiyel. shelitiyel si yet etyie zerubabel.

name: Tyap
text: Za̱rubabel si̱ yet a̱tyia̱ Abihudu. Abihudu si̱ yet a̱tyia̱ A̱li̱yakim. A̱li̱yakim si̱ yet a̱tyia̱ Azuro.
normalised_text: zerubabel si yet etyie abihudu. abihudu si yet etyie eliyakim. eliyakim si yet etyie azuro.

name: Tyap
text: Azuro si̱ yet a̱tyia̱ Za̱dok. Za̱dok si̱ yet a̱tyia̱ A̱kim. A̱kim si̱ yet a̱tyia̱ A̱li̱yudu.
normalised_text: azuro si yet etyie zedok. zedok si yet etyie ekim. ekim si yet etyie eliyudu.

name: Tyap
text: A̱li̱yudu si̱ yet a̱tyia̱ A̱li̱yazar. A̱li̱yazar si̱ yet a̱tyia̱ Ma̱tana. Ma̱tana si̱ yet a̱tyia̱ Yakubu.
normalised_text: eliyudu si yet etyie eliyazar. eliyazar si yet etyie metana. metana si yet etyie yakubu.

name: Tyap
text: Yakubu si̱ yet a̱tyia̱ Isuu a̱tyok Ma̱ryamu a̱ byin Yesu a̱ yet Kristi, a̱tyu nang A̱gwaza kup gu tyok a̱ni.
normalised_text: yakubu si yet etyie isuu etyok meramu e byin yesu e yet kristi, etyu nang egwaza kup gu tyok eni.

name: Tyap
text: A̱wot a̱ na byin nggwon a̱sam, a na ntyia̱ nggu a̱lyoot Yesu . Mat a̱lyoot ka fa, nggu wa na san á̱niet nggu ba da̱ a̱ka̱tuk nyia̱ mba wu.
normalised_text: ewot e na byin ngwon esam, a na ntyie ngu elyoot yesu. mat elyoot ka fa, ngu wa na san eniet ngu ba de eketuk nyie mba wu.

name: Tyap
text: A̱mgba̱m nkyang nani bai ma̱ cha̱chaat ma̱ng kyang hu nang A̱gwaza ku hyia̱ a̱bwonu Ishaya a̱ta̱m a̱kwonu nggu wu, nyia̱.
normalised_text: emgbem nkyang nani bai me chechaat meng kyang hu nang egwaza ku shie ebwonu ishaya etem ekwonu ngu wu, nyie.

name: Tyap
text: A̱wot Isuu du myia̱ ma̱ng Ma̱ryamu bah, ba̱ng si̱ nat jen nang gu mbyin nggwon a̱sam nggu ka a̱ni. A̱ si̱ tyia̱ nka a̱lyoot Yesu.
normalised_text: ewot isuu du myie meng meramu bah, beng si nat jen nang gu mbyin ngwon esam ngu ka eni. e si tyie nka elyoot yesu.

name: Tyap
text: Nang a̱gwam Hiridut nfa̱k a̱nia a̱ni, fwuo nggu hu si̱ myia̱ bah. Ma a̱nia wa á̱niet ma̱ a̱di̱di̱t ma̱ a̱keang Urusha̱lima ka si̱ nfa̱k.
normalised_text: nang egwam hiridut nfek enia eni, fwuo ngu hu si myie bah. ma enia wa eniet me edidit me ekeang urushelima ka si nfek.

name: Tyap
text: A̱gwam Hiridut si̱ bu yorong a̱yaagwak lyen á̱ta̱ngwat a̱bya da̱ bang, da̱nian gu ka lyen a̱cha̱chaat njen wu nang ba̱ ndi a̱ta̱ngwat ka nghwut a̱ni.
normalised_text: egwam hiridut si bu yorong eyaagwak lyen etengwat ebya de bang, denian gu ka lyen echechaat njen wu nang be ndi etengwat ka nghwut eni.

name: Tyap
text: Nang ba̱ ndi a̱ta̱ngwat ka a̱ni, ba̱ si̱ fa̱k a̱sai a̱lyia̱, ba̱ si̱ gwai ba̱t!.
normalised_text: nang be ndi etengwat ka eni, be si fek esai elyie, be si gwai bet!.

name: Tyap
text: A̱tyetuk a̱kya, Isuu si̱ doot a̱ si̱ kyiak nggwon ka ma̱ng a̱yang nka wu, ba̱ si̱ nkat Ma̱sa̱r.
normalised_text: etyetuk ekya, isuu si doot e si kyiak ngwon ka meng eyang nka wu, be si nkat meser.

name: Tyap
text: A̱ka̱kpa̱t a̱gwam Hiridut na nat cha̱chaat ma̱ng kyang hu nang Iri̱miya a̱ta̱m a̱kwonu A̱gwaza ku ntak á̱zanson gbangbang a̱ni, nyia̱.
normalised_text: ekekpet egwam hiridut na nat chechaat meng kyang hu nang irimiya etem ekwonu egwaza ku ntak ezanson gbangbang eni, nyie.

name: Tyap
text: Jen nang a̱gwam Hiridut nkhwu a̱ni, a̱ta̱m tswa A̱gwaza si̱ tak ma̱ng Isuu ma̱ a̱laat mi̱ Ma̱sa̱r nyia̱.
normalised_text: jen nang egwam hiridut nkhwu eni, etem tswa egwaza si tak meng isuu me elaat mi meser nyie.

name: Tyap
text: Doot! A kyiak nggwon ka ma̱ng a̱yang wu, nyi bwuok nat a̱byin Isi̱rela. Mat á̱niet ba̱ chat ba̱ hyat nggwon ka a̱ni, wa ka̱n kwi.
normalised_text: doot! a kyiak ngwon ka meng eyang wu, nyi bwuok nat ebyin isirela. mat eniet be chat be shat ngwon ka eni, wa ken kwi.

name: Tyap
text: Huhwa Isuu si̱ doot a̱ si̱ kyiak nggwon ka ma̱ng a̱yang nka wu, ba̱ si̱ bwuok á̱ nat a̱byin Isi̱rela.

name: Tyap
text: Mi̱ mam a̱nia, Yoona a̱tyu nyia̱ ba̱ptisman si̱ bai a̱ shei A̱lyiat A̱gwaza mi̱ tswa a̱yit mi̱ fam a̱byin Yahudiya nyia̱.

name: Tyap
text: Nyi ghwon a̱ka̱tuk nyia̱ wu nyi khwi A̱gwaza, mat Tyok Ma A̱gwaza tswazwa hu bai kpa̱mkpaan.

name: Tyap
text: Á̱niet si̱ bai da̱ a̱vwuo gu neet Urusha̱lima, ma̱ng a̱mgba̱m fam a̱byin Yahudiya ma̱ng a̱ka̱keang na̱ hyia̱k a̱ghyui Urdun ka a̱ni.

name: Uduk
text: Ka muŋkup̱ mo tani Arumgimis uḵki momis dhali monycesh mo.

name: Uduk
text: Dhali Arumgimis ki o gwo mo ki: Dhalki moŋkush piyid mo. Dhali moŋkush dikid mo.
normalised_text: dhali arumgimis ki o gwo mo ki dhalki mongkush piyid mo. dhali mongkush dikid mo.

name: Uduk
text: Dhali Arumgimis p̱arki moŋkush e ki adi borabor mo. Dhali Arumgimis ki ḵwa/ moŋkush bwa peni mondhurumid mo.

name: Uduk
text: Dhali Arumgimis ki yuḵa balany ki Momis mo. Dhali mompimpili/ dikid mo dhali monthamo/ dikid mo, adi jin tada cim su/ mo.

text: Dhali mompimpili/ dikid mo dhali monthamo/ dikid mo, adi jin tada cimi kwara mo.

text: Dhali Arumgimis ki dhu uni eya balany gi momis mo mmoc̱i moŋkush buni ap̱o/ monycesh mo.

text: Dhali mompimpili/ dikid mo dhali monthamo/ dikid mo, adi jin tada cimi doŋon mo.

name: Uduk
text: Dhali mompimpili/ dikid mo dhali monthamo/ dikid mo, adi jin tada cim ma mudhed mo.

name: Uduk
text: Wakan momis dhali monycesh uni baarkunu mo dhali aris to kun koni bwaman uni mo.

name: Uduk
text: Hili jasa shile/ adi icuki mis peni monycesh mo dhali yath bwam/e gi monycesh ki jap̱em piti mo –.

name: Uduk
text: Dhali Tap̱a Arumgimis thosonki bwaagoŋ e Idin, e mompeshok mo dhali e mun mo adi ki kar wathi/ jin uḵkina adi icine/ mo.
normalised_text: dhali tapa arumgimis thosonki bwaagong e idin, e mompeshok mo dhali e mun mo adi ki kar wathi jin ukkina adi ichine mo.

name: Uduk
text: Yide/ guskid peni bwaman ma goŋ ma Idin mo, adi jin wolkid e bwaagoŋ mo dhali adi ḵwa/kunu bwa mo mmoko kusi doŋon mo.
normalised_text: yide guskid peni bwaman ma gong ma idin mo, adi jin wolkid e bwaagong mo dhali adi kwakunu bwa mo mmoko kusi dongon mo.

name: Uduk
text: Dhali gway gi yide/ jin ṯwa/a/ yuḵu gway ka P̱ishun mo, adi jin guskid mmokulum bampa/ gi Pam Hawiila isi baar mo e mo jin kokina dolkon gana/ mo.
normalised_text: dhali gway gi yide jin twaa yuku gway ka pishun mo, adi jin guskid mmokulum bampa gi pam hawiila isi baar mo e mo jin kokina dolkon gana mo.

name: Uduk
text: Dhali dolkon gana/ gi monycesh yan mo tani uni borabor mo. Dhala bica wasin dhela/ dhala wasin dhela/ jin tada jamas kush mo uni kokin mo.
normalised_text: dhali dolkon gana gi monychesh yan mo tani uni borabor mo. dhala bicha wasin dhela dhala wasin dhela jin tada jamas kush mo uni kokin mo.

name: Uduk
text: Dhali gway ḵumma/ yide/ jin kon ma p̱o/i su/ mo tani yuḵu gway ka Jihun mo, adin ṯal de/ jin guskid mo mmokama cesh gi Paŋ Kush is mo.
normalised_text: dhali gway kumma yide jin kon ma poi su mo tani yuku gway ka jihun mo, adin tal de jin guskid mo mmokama chesh gi pang kush is mo.

name: Uduk
text: Dhali Tap̱a Arumgimis ki buth wathimpa enthi/ mo mmokar adi e bwaagoŋ ma Idin mmoḵorki adi mo dhali mmokar adi mo.
normalised_text: dhali tapa arumgimis ki buth wathimpa enthi mo mmokar adi e bwaagong ma idin mmokorki adi mo dhali mmokar adi mo.

name: Uduk
text: Dhali Tap̱a Arumgimis ḵanki wathimpa enthi/ gwo mo mmo/o gwo mo ki: /E mini shwa aris cwa gi bwaman bwaagoŋ baḵany mo.
normalised_text: dhali tapa arumgimis kanki wathimpa enthi gwo mo mmoo gwo mo ki e mini shwa aris chwa gi bwaman bwaagong bakany mo.

name: Uduk
text: Dhali pena simaŋ gwar jin buthkina Tap̱a Arumgimis peni wathiŋ gwaṯẖ mo tani adi ki uḵ adi mmota abom mo dhali guya yim e wathiŋ gwaṯẖ mo.
normalised_text: dhali pena simang gwar jin buthkina tapa arumgimis peni wathing gwath mo tani adi ki uk adi mmota abom mo dhali guya yim e wathing gwath mo.

name: Uduk
text: Dhali wathiŋ gwaṯẖ dhali ashim piti mo tani uni ko ki is te/ mo dhali uni kona is ki theya the mo.
normalised_text: dhali wathing gwath dhali ashim piti mo tani uni ko ki is te mo dhali uni kona is ki theya the mo.

name: Uduk
text: Dhala bom ki thoḵ tasha/ gwo mo ki: Aman dhalu bway mmoshwa aris maman cwa gi bwaagoŋ mo.
normalised_text: dhala bom ki thok tasha gwo mo ki aman dhalu bway mmoshwa aris maman chwa gi bwaagong mo.

name: Uduk
text: Hili tasha/ ki owa bom gwo mo ki: Um mini wu mo yisa.
normalised_text: hili tasha ki owa bom gwo mo ki um mini wu mo yisa.

name: Uduk
text: Hili Tap̱a Arumgimis yuḵki wathi/ mo dhali o adi gwo mo ki: /E dini mana?.

text: Adi o gwo mo ki: Kaja iṯor /e gwo mo ki /e di is te/a? Ki /e ishwaki cwa jin ḵanka/ /e gwo mo ki: /E mini mii dhalku/ adi ki shwa mo?.
normalised_text: adi o gwo mo ki kaja itor e gwo mo ki e di is tea? ki e ishwaki chwa jin kanka e gwo mo ki e mini mii dhalku adi ki shwa mo?.

text: Dhali wathi/ ki o gwo mo ki: Abom adi jin c̱ikina /e mmonyaḵ c̱ab ki aha/ mo tani ayim adi ic̱iki aha/ maman cwa mo dhali aha/ shwakina adi mo.
normalised_text: dhali wathi ki o gwo mo ki abom adi jin chikina e mmonyak chab ki aha mo tani ayim adi ichiki aha maman chwa mo dhali aha shwakina adi mo.

name: Uduk
text: Ade/ dhala liṯ uni mini ka gom /e mo, dhali /e mini shwa to kun sinu peni bunto mo.

name: Uduk
text: Dhali wathi/ ki yuḵ ash gway ka Hawwa mo, adi jin ta pemen gwo jin onu ki: To jin did ki e mo, haali/ ayim tada atada ma ris to baar kun kon ki e mo.
normalised_text: dhali wathi ki yuk ash gway ka hawwa mo, adi jin ta pemen gwo jin onu ki to jin did ki e mo, haali ayim tada atada ma ris to baar kun kon ki e mo.

name: Uduk
text: Dhali Tap̱a Arumgimis ki uḵ ka Aadam dhali gom ashim piti burrinye/ pena yic mo, dhali hithki uni i is mo.

name: Uduk
text: Dhala Aadam mishkida Hawwa jin ta ash mo, dhali ayim bwaakid mo dhali dhodha Kayiin mo mmo/o gwo mo ki: Aha/ gamkina aciŋgwaṯẖ ki mowoṯẖ gi Tap̱a mo.

name: Uduk
text: Dhali doḵ/e ayim dhothkida kam piti jin yuḵu gway ka Habiil mo. Dhala Habiil tada manhil ḵabal mo dhala Kayiin tada manḵora cesh mo.

name: Umbundu
text: Osi ya kala ño upolokoso, ka mua kaile cimue. Owelema wa sikilĩlĩle ocipala cokalunga. Espiritu lia Suku lia endela kilu liovava.

name: Umbundu
text: Suku yu wa linga hati, Ku iye ocinyi kuenje ocinyi ceya.

name: Umbundu
text: Suku wa mõla ocinyi okuti ca posoka. Suku wa tepisa ocinyi lowelema.

text: Suku wa luka ocinyi hati, Utanya. Owelema wo luka hati, Uteke. Kuenje kua kala oñolõsi, kua kalavo omẽle, eteke liaco olio mosi.
normalised_text: suku wa luka ocinyi hati, utanya. owelema wo luka hati, uteke. kuenje kua kala onolosi, kua kalavo omele, eteke liaco olio mosi.

name: Umbundu
text: Suku yu wa linga hati, Pokati kovava pa kale epuluvi, li tepise ovava lovava.

name: Umbundu

name: Urhobo
text: Akpọ na da de dia reghe reghe diodi, ebrin da enu rẹ akpọ na duvwu; Erhi rẹ Ọghẹnẹ kọye re yan vwẹ enu rẹ ame na.
normalised_text: akpo na da de dia reghe reghe diodi, ebrin da enu re akpo na duvmu; erhi re oghene koye re yan vme enu re ame na.

name: Urhobo
text: Etiyin Ọghẹnẹ da ta, E gbe jẹn orẹmrẹ dia, orẹmrẹ da ghene dia.
normalised_text: etiyin oghene da ta, e gbe yen oremre dia, oremre da ghene dia.

name: Urhobo
text: Ọghẹnẹ da mrẹ nẹ orẹmrẹ na yoma; Ọghẹnẹ da hẹriẹ orẹmrẹ na nẹ ebrin na.
normalised_text: oghene da mre ne oremre na yoma; oghene da kherie oremre na ne ebrin na.

name: Urhobo
text: Ọghẹnẹ de se orẹmrẹ na Uvo, o de rhe se ebrin na Ason. Te ovwọnvwọn te irhiọke da dia ẹdẹ rẹsosuọ.
normalised_text: oghene de se oremre na uvo, o de rhe se ebrin na ason. te ovmonvmon te irhioke da dia ede resosuo.

name: Urhobo
text: Ọghẹnẹ da tanẹ, Gbe jẹn irharheghe dia uherevie rẹ ame na, rere ọ hẹriẹ ame na vwo nẹ ame na.
normalised_text: oghene da tane, gbe yen irharheghe dia ukherevie re ame na, rere o kherie ame na vmo ne ame na.

name: Urhobo
text: Ọghẹnẹ da ma irharheghe na o da hẹriẹ ame rọ obotọ rẹ irharheghe na vwo nẹ ame rọ obenu rẹ irharheghe na. O da ghene dia ọtiọye.
normalised_text: oghene da ma irharheghe na o da kherie ame ro oboto re irharheghe na vmo ne ame ro obenu re irharheghe na. o da ghene dia otioye.

name: Urhobo
text: Ọghẹnẹ de se irharheghe na Odjuvwu. Te ovwọnvwọn te irhiọke da dia ẹdẹ rivẹ.
normalised_text: oghene de se irharheghe na ojuvmu. te ovmonvmon te irhioke da dia ede rive.

name: Urhobo
text: Ọghẹnẹ da ta, Gbe jẹn ame rẹ otọ rẹ odjuvwu na rhi koko oma vwẹ asan ọvo, rere e ji otọ ọyaya vwẹ oma phia. Ọ da ghene dia ọtiọye.
normalised_text: oghene da ta, gbe yen ame re oto re ojuvmu na rhi koko oma vme asan ovo, rere e yi oto oyaya vme oma fia. o da ghene dia otioye.

name: Urhobo
text: Ọghẹnẹ se otọ ọyaya na Otọ, ame rọ rha ghwe koko asan ọvo na o de rhe se Urhie, Ọghẹnẹ da mrẹ ne oyoma.
normalised_text: oghene se oto oyaya na oto, ame ro rha ghe koko asan ovo na o de rhe se urhie, oghene da mre ne oyoma.

name: Urhobo
text: Otọ na de ghine di ẹbe, irhe re mọn emamọ durhe doghere rọye kugbe irhe re mọn emamọ rẹ ibi dia evun rayen, durhe doghẹre rọye Ọghẹnẹ da mrẹ nẹ oyoma.
normalised_text: oto na de ghine di ebe, irhe re mon emamo durhe doghere roye kugbe irhe re mon emamo re ibi dia evun rayen, durhe doghere roye oghene da mre ne oyoma.

name: Urhobo
text: Ọghẹnẹ da ta, Gbe jẹn orẹmrẹ phia vwẹ evun rẹ irharheghe rẹ odjuvwu na rọ hẹriẹ uvo nẹ ason, re ayen dia kẹ oka kugbe ọke vẹ ẹdẹ te ukpe.

name: Urhobo
text: Ọghẹnẹ da ma irhukpẹ ride ive, urhukpẹ rode na kọye ri sun uvo, urhukpẹ re otete na kọye ri sun ason, ọ ke je ma isio rhe.

name: Urhobo
text: Ọghẹnẹ de phi ayen phihọ irharheghe rẹ odjuvwu na re ọ vwẹ orẹmrẹ kẹ akpọ na.

name: Urhobo

name: Urhobo
text: Ọghẹnẹ da ta, Gbe jẹn obo ri vwo arhọ ejobi vọn evun rẹ ame na, rere ephran rhan vwẹ enu rẹ akpọ na vwẹ irharheghe rẹ odjuvwu.

name: Urhobo
text: Ọghẹnẹ da nẹ ẹrhovwo kẹ ayen tanẹ, We vwiẹ ri we bun phihọ re wa vọn ame rẹ urhie na, rere ephran rhe bun phihọ vwẹ enu rẹ akpọ na.
normalised_text: oghene da ne erhovmo ke ayen tane, we vmie ri we bun fikho re wa von ame re urhie na, rere efran rhe bun fikho vme enu re akpo na.

name: Urhobo
text: Ọghẹnẹ da ma eranvwe rẹ akpọ na, deranvwe doka rayen kugbe uchuru okoka rọye, kugbe emu kemu ri kpono vwẹ otọ na okoka rọye. Ọghẹnẹ da mrẹ nẹ oyoma.

name: Urhobo
text: Kọye Ọghẹnẹ da ma ohwo vwẹ oma rọye, oma rẹ Ọghẹnẹ ọye ọ vwọ ma ayen, ọshare vẹ aye ọ ma ayen.

name: Urhobo
text: Ọghẹnẹ da ta, Nighe, Me reyọ urhe kurhe rọ mọn ubi ejobi rọ enu rẹ otọ na vwọ kẹ wẹ, kugbe urhe kurhe rọ mọn emamọ kọ dia emuọre kẹ ovwan.
normalised_text: oghene da ta, nighe, me reyo urhe kurhe ro mon ubi eyobi ro enu re oto na vmo ke we, kugbe urhe kurhe ro mon emamo ko dia emuore ke ovman.

name: Urhobo
text: Ọghẹnẹ da mrẹ emu kemu rọ mare na, nighe, oyovwiri gangan Te ovwọnvwọn te irhiọke da dia ẹdẹ resan.
normalised_text: oghene da mre emu kemu ro mare na, nighe, oyovmiri gangan te ovmonvmon te irhioke da dia ede resan.

name: Urhobo
text: Kẹnẹ a ma odjuvwu vẹ akpọ kugbe obo re vọnrọ ejobi wan.

name: Urhobo
text: Vwẹ ẹdẹ rẹ ighwrẹ iruo rẹ emama rẹ Ọghẹnẹ ruru ejobi de rhi re, o de rovwoma vwẹ ẹdẹ rẹ ighwrẹ na vwẹ enu rẹ iruo ro ruru.

name: Urhobo
text: Ọtiọye Ọghẹnẹ de bruphihọ ẹdẹ rẹ ighwrẹ na, ọ da vwẹ ọghọ kẹ, fikiridie ẹdẹ yena Ọghẹnẹ vwo rovwoma vwẹ enu rẹ iruo ro ruru vwẹ emama rọye.

name: Urhobo
text: Enana keye uvwiẹ rẹ odjuvwu vẹ akpọ vwẹ ọke ra vwọ ma ayen. Vwẹ ẹdẹ rẹ Ọrovwohwo Ọghẹnẹ vwọ ma akpọ vẹ odjuvwu nu.

name: Urhobo

name: Urhobo
text: kọye Ọrovwohwo Ọghẹnẹ da vwẹ ekpẹn rẹ otọ na vwọ ma ohwo, ọ da wẹn ẹwẹn rẹ arhọ na phihọ iwen rọye, ohwo de hirhe ohwo ọkpokpọ.
normalised_text: koye orovmokho oghene da vme ekpen re oto na vmo ma okho, o da wen ewen re arho na fikho iwen roye, okho de khirhe okho okpokpo.

name: Urhobo
text: Ọrovwohwo Ọghẹnẹ de voro udju phihọ Idẹn vwẹ ẹbẹre rẹ ọnre da vacha, kẹ Etiyin o phi ohwo rọ mare na phihọ.

name: Urhobo
text: Urhie da va phia vwẹ Idẹn rere ọrhuọrhuọ udju na, Etiyin ọ da jẹn eghọn ẹne.

name: Urhobo
text: Odẹ rẹ ọrẹsosuọ Pishọn, ọna re djẹ nene ubrotọ ri Havila, ra da mrẹ oro;.

name: ut-Ma’in
text: U̱r-taku̱n, Ru̱-u̱ no̱mu̱g do̱m u-ru̱, u-dak-ne̱.

name: ut-Ma’in
text: Se̱ Ru̱-u̱ zu̱, <<Yage̱ u̱ zu̱n-mu̱ rwu̱u̱n.>> Se̱ zu̱n-mu̱ mok.

name: ut-Ma’in
text: Se̱ Ru̱-u̱ hog u̱r-zwar u̱ zu̱n-mu̱ mok-te̱. Se̱ wa ké m-zu̱n du̱gu̱ u-cwu̱m.

name: ut-Ma’in
text: Ru̱-u̱ fog m-zu̱n <<U-ho̱.>> Tu̱msu̱ wa fog u-cwu̱m <<M-gyu̱p.>> U̱ da-u o̱ na kume̱ m-rim tu̱msu̱ na kum u̱r-wu̱n. De̱ o̱ ho̱-du̱ u̱r-taku̱n.

name: ut-Ma’in

name: ut-Ma’in
text: U̱ da-u o̱ na kume̱ m-rim tu̱msu̱ na kum u̱r-wu̱n, de̱ o̱ u̱ ho̱-du̱ u-tu̱tu̱rse̱.

normalised_text: remu e nomut farukdu uho mgyup ne, tumsu u ke mzun dugu ucwum. se ruu hyen nomu wa nome nong u soo.

name: ut-Ma’in
text: U̱ da-u o̱ na kume̱ m-rim tu̱msu̱ na kum u̱r-wu̱n, de̱ o̱o̱ge̱ ho̱-du̱ u-nasu̱rse̱.
normalised_text: u dau o na kume mrim tumsu na kum urwun, de ooge hodu unasurse.

name: ut-Ma’in
text: Se̱ Ru̱-u̱ zu̱, <<Yage̱ u̱ bu̱-mu̱ rwu̱u̱tu̱n no̱m u̱r-fat u̱ shi m-bu̱, tu̱msu̱ u̱ no ne̱ u̱ yu̱ne̱ u̱t-kap u̱ do̱m hu̱k-du̱ u-ru̱.>>.
normalised_text: se ruu zu, yage u bumu rwuutun nom urfat u shi mbu, tumsu u no ne u yune utkap u dom hukdu uru..

name: ut-Ma’in
text: Se̱ Ru̱-u̱ wa'-u̱ to̱ nu-u so̱-o̱ wa zu̱, <<De̱e̱n no̱ mat yaag no̱ sur u-tát no̱ shi m-sa, tu̱msu̱ yage̱ no e̱ sur u-tát e̱ shi u-dak.>>.
normalised_text: se ruu wau to nuu soo wa zu, deen no mat yaag no sur utat no shi msa, tumsu yage no e sur utat e shi udak..

name: ut-Ma’in
text: U̱ da-u o̱ na kume̱ m-rim tu̱msu̱ na kum u̱r-wu̱n, de̱ o̱ ho̱-du̱ u-tanu̱rse̱.
normalised_text: u dau o na kume mrim tumsu na kum urwun, de o hodu utanurse.

name: ut-Ma’in
text: I ya-o̱ Ru̱-u̱ no̱m-te̱ ne̱t u̱-me̱ sha-m wa, u̱-me̱ sha-mu̱ Ru̱-u̱ o̱, Ru̱-u̱ no̱m-te̱ ne̱t, campa u̱ ne̱ta Ru̱-u̱ nom e̱.
normalised_text: i yao ruu nomte net ume sham wa, ume shamu ruu o, ruu nomte net, campa u neta ruu nom e.

name: ut-Ma’in
text: Se̱ Ru̱-u̱ hyen no̱m-u̱ wa no̱me̱ u-be̱e̱t, o̱ no̱mu̱g u̱ so̱-o̱ sok. Se̱ na kum u̱r-wu̱n tu̱msu̱ na kum m-rim, de̱ o̱ ho̱-du̱ u̱t-shishin.
normalised_text: se ruu hyen nomu wa nome ubeet, o nomug u soo sok. se na kum urwun tumsu na kum mrim, de o hodu utshishin.

name: ut-Ma’in
text: Iya-o̱ Ru̱-u̱ taaste̱ no̱m-du̱ do̱m u-ru̱ u-dak-ne̱, u̱ no̱m-tu̱ o̱ me̱ ne̱ u̱t-be̱e̱t.
normalised_text: iyao ruu taaste nomdu dom uru udakne, u nomtu o me ne utbeet.

name: ut-Ma’in
text: Kanda ho̱-du̱ u̱r-ta'er u̱, Ru̱-u̱ taaste̱ no̱m-du̱ ank-mu̱ wa o̱o̱ge̱ u̱t-no̱m u-be̱e̱t; se̱ wa hure̱ du̱gu̱ ank-m wa u̱ ho̱-du̱ u̱r-ta'er.
normalised_text: kanda hodu urtaer u, ruu taaste nomdu ankmu wa ooge utnom ubeet; se wa hure dugu ankm wa u hodu urtaer.

name: ut-Ma’in
text: Tun-to̱ to̱ o̱o̱ge̱ ogu̱r-tu̱ do̱m u-ru̱ u̱ u-dak-ne̱ da na tase̱ no̱m-du̱ to̱. Da Yawe u-Ru̱ no̱me̱ u-dak u̱ do̱m u-ru̱ ne̱.
normalised_text: tunto to ooge ogurtu dom uru u udakne da na tase nomdu to. da yawe uru nome udak u dom uru ne.

name: ut-Ma’in
text: Se̱di rap-u̱t u̱ rwu̱u̱n du̱gu̱ u-dak, o̱ mu̱st u-dak u-be̱e̱t.
normalised_text: sedi raput u rwuun dugu udak, o must udak ubeet.

name: ut-Ma’in
text: Se̱ Yawe u-Ru̱ nom ne̱t u̱ rwab-tu̱ u-dak. Wa fur mya-mu̱ u̱r-fat u̱ swa-du̱ ne̱t, se̱ ne̱t kum u̱r-fat.
normalised_text: se yawe uru nom net u rwabtu udak. wa fur myamu urfat u swadu net, se net kum urfat.

name: ut-Ma’in
text: Yawe u-Ru̱ zo̱ngte̱ u-tak, u̱ de̱ku̱n be-de̱ du̱ na foge̱ Idin, gas-u̱ ho̱-du̱ rwu̱tu̱n. Ku̱na wa cinte̱ ne̱t-u̱ wa no̱me̱.
normalised_text: yawe uru zongte utak, u dekun bede du na foge idin, gasu hodu rwutun. kuna wa cinte netu wa nome.

name: ut-Ma’in
text: Gi-yu̱ yu̱'e̱ u-tak m-bu̱ ya jagu̱n du̱gu̱ Idin, du̱gu̱ ku̱n ya mot m-te u̱s-gi u̱s-nas.
normalised_text: giyu yue utak mbu ya jagun dugu idin, dugu kun ya mot mte usgi usnas.

name: ut-Ma’in
text: Dim-du̱ gi-yu̱ u̱r-taku̱n na zu̱ ya Piso̱n. Gi-u ya gu̱pe̱ m-nar gas-u̱ dak-u̱ Havira u-be̱e̱t, be-du̱ o̱tte̱ kwam-tu̱ shik tu̱ bu̱-mu̱ u̱t-ro.
normalised_text: dimdu giyu urtakun na zu ya pison. giu ya gupe mnar gasu daku havira ubeet, bedu otte kwamtu shik tu bumu utro.

name: ut-Ma’in
text: Dim-du̱ gi-yu̱ u-yu̱ru̱mse̱ na zu̱ ya Giho̱n, gi-u ya gu̱p m-nar u̱ gas-u̱ dak-u̱ Kus u-be̱e̱t.
normalised_text: dimdu giyu uyurumse na zu ya gihon, giu ya gup mnar u gasu daku kus ubeet.

name: ut-Ma’in
text: Dim-du̱ gi-yu̱ u-tu̱tu̱rse̱ Tigris, ja-mu̱ gi-u ya gu̱p u̱ gas-u̱ u-do̱m u̱ gu̱r-u̱ Asur. Dim-du̱ gi-yu̱ u-nasu̱rse̱ na zu̱ ya Yupireti.
normalised_text: dimdu giyu ututurse tigris, jamu giu ya gup u gasu udom u guru asur. dimdu giyu unasurse na zu ya yupireti.

name: ut-Ma’in
text: Yawe u-Ru̱ wu̱ ne̱t u̱-me̱ u-tak u̱ Idin, remu̱ ne̱t-u̱ no̱m-u̱t to̱m-du̱ o̱ tu̱msu̱ wa gwat o̱.
normalised_text: yawe uru wu net ume utak u idin, remu netu nomut tomdu o tumsu wa gwat o.

name: ut-Ma’in
text: Se̱ Yawe u-Ru̱ no̱mu̱ ne̱t-u̱ wa u̱t-him, <<Bo̱ keru̱ re̱-du̱ yaa-tu̱ u̱s-te u̱s-be̱e̱t su̱ o̱ u-tak.
normalised_text: se yawe uru nomu netu wa uthim, bo keru redu yaatu uste usbeet su o utak.

name: ut-Ma’in
text: se̱di A-bo̱ re̱ yaa-tu̱ te-yu̱ nap-mu̱ no̱m-u̱t so̱-to̱ u̱ tu̱ yo̱-to̱ ne̱ da, remu̱ zu̱ ho̱-du̱ bo̱ re̱ yaa-tu̱ te-u ya bo̱ de̱ m-mar za u-sakna.>>.
normalised_text: sedi abo re yaatu teyu napmu nomut soto u tu yoto ne da, remu zu hodu bo re yaatu teu ya bo de mmar za usakna..

name: ut-Ma’in
text: Se̱ Yawe u-Ru̱ zu̱, <<No̱ng u̱r-zwar u̱ ne̱t u̱ shu̱'u̱t wa u-gan da. Yage̱ u̱m no̱mu̱ wa, wa-u̱r-se̱ge̱ wu̱ o̱ ho̱n-ho̱n u̱ wu̱n ne̱.>>.
normalised_text: se yawe uru zu, nong urzwar u net u shuut wa ugan da. yage um nomu wa, waursege wu o honhon u wun ne..

name: Vagala
text: Lugli la, Kɔraawiizi faa ta chiŋ ni hɛri maanii.
normalised_text: lugli la, koraawiizi faa ta ching ni heri maanii.

name: Vagala
text: Hɛri faa waa duula dɔɔwɛ, di chɔɔ woo. Bɔbiri tintintiŋ, faa tɔ a nii ni. Kɔraawiizi Duma faa guali u ni, di ra bar.
normalised_text: heri faa waa duula doowe, di choo woo. bobiri tintinting, faa to a nii ni. koraawiizi duma faa guali u ni, di ra bar.

name: Vagala
text: Denii Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ, Gil bɔr chaani! Awia, bɔr chaani.
normalised_text: dinii koraawiizi ngo, gil bor chaani! awia, bor chaani.

name: Vagala
text: U binni bɔchaaŋ la, di u wesso. U bargi bɔchaaŋ la lii bɔbiri la ni.
normalised_text: u binni bochaang la, di u wisso. u bargi bochaang la lii bobiri la ni.

name: Vagala
text: di ra yir bɔchaaŋ la hɔpizaa, di ra yir bɔbiri la ge hamuŋa. Bɔr duani, hɔpizi chɔɔzi, di ɛɛ a lugli hɔpizii.
normalised_text: di ra yir bochaang la hopizaa, di ra yir bobiri la gi hamunga. bor duani, hopizi choozi, di ee a lugli hopizii.

name: Vagala
text: Denii Kɔraawiizi kaa ŋɔ, Gil chiŋ bargi a niiri.
normalised_text: dinii koraawiizi kaa ngo, gil ching bargi a niiri.

name: Vagala
text: U gil chiŋ bargi a niiri, aŋhina du u zɛɛ, aŋhina ge du u chiŋ. Guŋ kaa ɛɛ.
normalised_text: u gil ching bargi a niiri, anghina du u zee, anghina gi du u ching. gung kaa ee.

name: Vagala
text: U ra yir kunla n du a baambaaŋ la, chiŋ. Bɔr kaa duani, hɔɔ kaa pizi. A hɔpizaa anɛɛ hinnɛ guŋ.
normalised_text: u ra yir kunla n du a baambaang la, ching. bor kaa duani, hoo kaa pizi. a hopizaa anee hinne gung.

name: Vagala
text: Kɔraawiizi kaa ŋɔ, Gil niiri la n du a chiŋ zɛɛ la chaali chɔɔ bɔkpaŋ, ka bɔ́hilii lii. Guŋ himmaa kaa ɛɛ.
normalised_text: koraawiizi kaa ngo, gil niiri la n du a ching zee la chaali choo bokpang, ka bohilii lii. gung himmaa kaa ee.

name: Vagala
text: U ra yir bɔhilii la hɛri, di kaa ra yir a niiri la n chaali bɔkpaŋ la ge muuzenaa. Kɔraawiizi kaa naa di a wesso.
normalised_text: u ra yir bohilii la heri, di kaa ra yir a niiri la n chaali bokpang la gi muuzinaa. koraawiizi kaa naa di a wisso.

name: Vagala
text: Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ, Gil a hɛri lii kooree ni daazi irizi maa. Anla n na du bee ani anla n na nɔŋ di ra du bee a biine maa. Guŋ himmaa ge kaa ɛɛ.
normalised_text: koraawiizi ngo, gil a heri lii koorii ni daazi irizi maa. anla n na du bee ani anla n na nong di ra du bee a biini maa. gung himmaa gi kaa ee.

name: Vagala
text: Hɛri lii kooree ni daazi irizi maa. Anla n na du bee ni daazi la n na nɔŋ di ra du bee. Kɔraawiizi binni, di a wesso.
normalised_text: heri lii koorii ni daazi irizi maa. anla n na du bee ni daazi la n na nong di ra du bee. koraawiizi binni, di a wisso.

name: Vagala
text: Bɔr duani, hɔɔ kaa pizi. Hɔpizaa ahoro hinnɛ guŋ.
normalised_text: bor duani, hoo kaa pizi. hopizaa ahoro hinne gung.

name: Vagala
text: Kɔraawiizi kaa ŋɔ, Gil nine du chiŋ, di bargi hɔpizaa ni hamuŋa. Aabuu ninna bagli saŋazi ni hɔpizaa ani binni.
normalised_text: koraawiizi kaa ngo, gil nine du ching, di bargi hopizaa ni hamunga. aabuu ninna bagli sangazi ni hopizaa ani binni.

name: Vagala
text: di gil a du chiŋ, di ra chaani hɛri. Guŋ kaa ɛɛ.
normalised_text: di gil a du ching, di ra chaani heri. gung kaa ee.

name: Vagala
text: Denii Kɔraawiizi ta ninzenaa anɛɛ, zeŋhiŋ a chaani hɔpizaa, jigahiŋ ge ra chaani hamuŋa. U kaa ta chinchiŋwilaa ge jaa.
normalised_text: dinii koraawiizi ta ninzinaa anee, zinghing a chaani hopizaa, jigahing gi ra chaani hamunga. u kaa ta chinchingwilaa gi jaa.

name: Vagala
text: di ra bagli hɔpizaa ni bɔr biraa, di kaa bargi bɔchaaŋ ni bɔbiri la ge dɔŋa ni. Kɔraawiizi binnaa, di a wesso.
normalised_text: di ra bagli hopizaa ni bor biraa, di kaa bargi bochaang ni bobiri la gi donga ni. koraawiizi binnaa, di a wisso.

name: Vagala
text: Bɔr duani, hɔɔ kaa pizi. A hɔpizaa anaazu hinnɛ guŋ.
normalised_text: bor duani, hoo kaa pizi. a hopizaa anaazu hinne gung.

name: Vagala
text: Kɔraawiizi kaa ŋɔ, Gil kunnyinee lii su a nii biini, zumbizi ge ni a dizi su chiŋ, di zaah ra bar.
normalised_text: koraawiizi kaa ngo, gil kunnyinii lii su a nii biini, zumbizi gi ni a dizi su ching, di zaah ra bar.

name: Vagala
text: Denii u kissi a maa, di ŋɔ, Ií ra lul di wazi, di su niiri la biine, zumbizi la ge lul su hɛri la maa.
normalised_text: dinii u kissi a maa, di ngo, ii ra lul di wazi, di su niiri la biini, zumbizi la gi lul su heri la maa.

name: Vagala
text: Bɔr kaa duani, hɔɔ kaa pizi. A hɔpizaa anue hinnɛ guŋ.
normalised_text: bor kaa duani, hoo kaa pizi. a hopizaa anui hinne gung.

name: Vagala
text: Denii Kɔraawiizi kaa ŋɔ, Gil kunnyinee maa ni a dizi lii su hɛri, kundɛɛzaa, kuntuuzaa ani pir sela ni a dizi maa. Guŋ kaa ɛɛ.
normalised_text: dinii koraawiizi kaa ngo, gil kunnyinii maa ni a dizi lii su heri, kundeezaa, kuntuuzaa ani pir sila ni a dizi maa. gung kaa ee.

name: Vagala
text: U ta pir sela ni a dizi, kundɛɛzaa ni a dizi, kuntuuzaa maa ni a dizi. Denii u binnaa, di a wesso.
normalised_text: u ta pir sila ni a dizi, kundeezaa ni a dizi, kuntuuzaa maa ni a dizi. dinii u binnaa, di a wisso.

name: Vagala
text: Awia, u ta newea, ba liu. U ta baabuu ba du u himmaa duula, di ɛɛ baal ni haaŋ.
normalised_text: awia, u ta niwia, ba liu. u ta baabuu ba du u himmaa duula, di ee baal ni haang.

name: Vagala
text: Kɔraawiizi kissi baa di ŋɔ, Ií lul su a hɛri maa, di ra binni u ni. Ii daŋ dɔɔ fɔŋŋa, nyinni, zumbizi ani kunnyinee irizi maa ni.
normalised_text: koraawiizi kissi baa di ngo, ii lul su a heri maa, di ra binni u ni. ii dang doo fongnga, nyinni, zumbizi ani kunnyinii irizi maa ni.

name: Vagala
text: Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ, Ií na, n tɛɛ iabuu kuna irizi la maa n na du bee ani daazi la n na nɔŋ di ra du bee, ií ra di.
normalised_text: koraawiizi ngo, ii na, n tee iabuu kuna irizi la maa n na du bee ani daazi la n na nong di ra du bee, ii ra di.

name: Vagala
text: N kaa tɛɛ pir sela, zumbizi, kuntuuzaa ani kunnyinee maa paŋhoori ni kooree, á ra di. A guŋ ge ɛɛ.
normalised_text: n kaa tee pir sila, zumbizi, kuntuuzaa ani kunnyinii maa panghoori ni koorii, a ra di. a gung gi ee.

name: Vagala
text: Denii u jaa binni kuna la maa un tawɛɛ la, di a wesso werge maa, u bɔra sɔɔni. Bɔr kaa duani, hɔɔ kaa pizi. A hɔpizaa anumbɛl hinnɛ guŋ.
normalised_text: dinii u jaa binni kuna la maa un tawee la, di a wisso wirgi maa, u bora sooni. bor kaa duani, hoo kaa pizi. a hopizaa anumbel hinne gung.

name: Vagala
text: Too, gunnɛ Kɔraawiizi ta chiŋ ni hɛri ani kuna la maa n du a biine.
normalised_text: too, gunne koraawiizi ta ching ni heri ani kuna la maa n du a biini.

name: Vagala
text: Hɔpizaa aniidaanɛɛhiŋ n wa helle, di Kɔraawiizi tuŋ huma la maa unna hum. Awia, u faa heezi.
normalised_text: hopizaa aniidaaneehing n wa helle, di koraawiizi tung huma la maa unna hum. awia, u faa hiizi.

name: Vai
text: ꕮꔻꕳ ꔤꕢ ꗃꕎ ꕚꕎꕌ ꖷ ꖸ ꗏ, ꕉꖸ ꘈ, ꕉ ꕎ ꖷ ꗃꕎ ꕃꘋ ꕜꕴꕜ ꗪ ꔤꔬꕞꔦꕮ ꗏ.
normalised_text: masihoo isa bowa tawaha mu nu lo, anu me, a wa mu bowa king dhawoodha be ibilahima lo.

name: Vai
text: ꔤꔬꕞꔦꕮ ꔳꕩ ꔤꔻꕩꕪ ꕘ ꖏ, ꕉꖷ ꔤꔻꕩꕪ ꔳꕩ ꕧꘋꖴꕒ ꕘ ꖏ, ꕉꖷ ꕧꘋꖴꕒ ꔳꕩ ꖱꕜ ꗪ ꕉ ꗠꗞꗢ ꖸ ꕘ ꖏ.
normalised_text: ibilahima tiya isiyaka fa koo, amu isiyaka tiya jangkuba fa koo, amu jangkuba tiya judha be a nyomoen nu fa koo.

name: Vai
text: ꕉꖷ ꖱꕜ ꔳꕩ ꗨꗷ ꗪ ꗽꕞ ꕘ ꖏ, ꖷꖬꘂ ꔎꕮꕊ ꕞ. ꕉꖷ ꗨꗷ ꔳꕩ ꗤꕤꕞꘋ ꕘ ꖏ, ꕉꖷ ꗤꕤꕞꘋ ꔳꕩ ꕞꘋ ꕘ ꖏ.
normalised_text: amu judha tiya pele be zela fa koo, musuye teemaan la. amu pele tiya hezalang fa koo, amu hezalang tiya lang fa koo.

name: Vai
text: ꕉꖷ ꕞꘋ ꔳꕩ ꕉꕆꕯꕜ ꕘ ꖏ, ꕉꖷ ꕉꕆꕯꕜ ꔳꕩ ꕯꕊꗓꘋ ꕘ ꖏ, ꕉꖷ ꕯꕊꗓꘋ ꔳꕩ ꕢꕌꗞꘋ ꕘ ꖏ.
normalised_text: amu lang tiya aminadha fa koo, amu aminadha tiya naansong fa koo, amu naansong tiya sahamong fa koo.

name: Vai
text: ꕉꖷ ꕢꕌꗞꘋ ꔳꕩ ꕷꕎꔻ ꕘ ꖏ, ꖷꖬꘂ ꔒꕌ ꕞ. ꕉꖷ ꕷꕎꔻ ꔳꕩ ꕱꗩꗡ ꕘ ꖏ, ꖷꖬꘂ ꖨꔱ ꕞ. ꕉꖷ ꕱꗩꗡ ꔳꕩ ꘀꔖ ꕘ ꖏ.
normalised_text: amu sahamong tiya bhoowasi fa koo, musuye leeha la. amu bhoowasi tiya oobhee fa koo, musuye lufi la. amu oobhee tiya jesee fa koo.

name: Vai
text: ꕉꖷ ꘀꔖ ꔳꕩ ꕃꘋ ꕜꕴꕜ ꕘ ꖏ. ꕃꘋ ꕜꕴꕜ ꔳꕩ ꖬꕞꔤꕮꕊꕯ ꕘ ꖏ, ꖳꕞꕩ ꕞ ꖷꖬꘂ ꕞ.
normalised_text: amu jesee tiya king dhawoodha fa koo. king dhawoodha tiya sulaimaanna fa koo, yulaya la musuye la.

name: Vai
text: ꕉꖷ ꖬꕞꔤꕮꕊꕯ ꔳꕩ ꔒꕌꕸꕎꘋ ꕘ ꖏ, ꕉꖷ ꔒꕌꕸꕎꘋ ꔳꕩ ꕉꕒꔤꕧ ꕘ ꖏ, ꕉꖷ ꕉꕒꔤꕧ ꔳꕩ ꔀꕢ ꕘ ꖏ.
normalised_text: amu sulaimaanna tiya leehaboowang fa koo, amu leehaboowang tiya abaija fa koo, amu abaija tiya eesa fa koo.

name: Vai
text: ꕉꖷ ꔀꕢ ꔳꕩ ꕀꖽꕢꕘ ꕘ ꖏ, ꕉꖷ ꕀꖽꕢꕘ ꔳꕩ ꖌꕞꘋ ꕘ ꖏ, ꕉꖷ ꖌꕞꘋ ꔳꕩ ꖳꕤꕩ ꕘ ꖏ.
normalised_text: amu eesa tiya jihosafa fa koo, amu jihosafa tiya joolang fa koo, amu joolang tiya yuzaya fa koo.

name: Vai
text: ꕉꖷ ꖳꕤꕩ ꔳꕩ ꖌꕚꘋ ꕘ ꖏ, ꕉꖷ ꖌꕚꘋ ꔳꕩ ꔀꕌꔽ ꕘ ꖏ, ꕉꖷ ꔀꕌꔽ ꔳꕩ ꗤꕤꕪꕩ ꕘ ꖏ.
normalised_text: amu yuzaya tiya jootang fa koo, amu jootang tiya eehazi fa koo, amu eehazi tiya hezakaya fa koo.

name: Vai
text: ꕉꖷ ꗤꕤꕪꕩ ꔳꕩ ꕮꕯꗻ ꕘ ꖏ, ꕉꖷ ꕮꕯꗻ ꔳꕩ ꔀꗞꔻ ꕘ ꖏ, ꕉꖷ ꔀꗞꔻ ꔳꕩ ꖌꕢꕩ ꕘ ꖏ.
normalised_text: amu hezakaya tiya manase fa koo, amu manase tiya eemosi fa koo, amu eemosi tiya joosaya fa koo.

name: Vai
