text: Nùb jííb ɗəŋhȩ àám káŋyerɨ̀bì rè, Hèrôdə̀ ɨ́ ɓê ŋgáb yoó, fɔ́nɨ ŋgáb ɓwâ ŋge á ŋgáb ya pə́ káŋyerè ɓə̀nɨ.
normalised_text: nub jiib denghen aam kangyerybi re, herode y be ngab yoo, fony ngab bwa nge a ngab ya pe kangyere beny.

name: Vute
text: Hȩ ŋgáb pə́cu káŋyerè kíì, ŋgáb ɨ́ ókɓà mɨ̀tù cei.
normalised_text: hen ngab pechu kangyere kii, ngab y okba mytu chei.

name: Vute
text: Kí á hȩ Mèín ya lə́ ŋgáb wumí ŋgáb yá Hèrôdə̀ féíncùwáá, ŋgáb ɨ́ pèìn jɨ̀r. Ŋgáb ɨ́ gɨ̀cù ɓo ti̧í̧ jɨ̀r jií no.
normalised_text: ki a hen mein ya le ngab wumi ngab ya herode feinchuwaa, ngab y pein jyr. ngab y gychu bo tiin jyr jii no.

name: Vwanji
text: Agha ghe matavua agha kɨkolo kya Yesu Kɨlɨsite ʉmhʉma mʉ kɨsina kya ntwa ʉDavɨdi, ɨkɨsina kya Abulahamu.
normalised_text: agha ghe matavua agha kikolo kya yesu kilisite umhuma mu kisina kya ntwa udavidi, ikisina kya abulahamu.

name: Vwanji
text: ɄAbulahamu akampaapa ʉIsaka, ʉIsaka akampaapa ʉYakovo, ʉYakovo akampaapa ʉYuuda na vanine.
normalised_text: uabulahamu akampaapa uisaka, uisaka akampaapa uyakovo, uyakovo akampaapa uyuuda na vanine.

name: Vwanji
text: ɄYuuda akampaapa ʉPelesi nʉ Sela mwa Tamali, ʉPelesi akampaapa ʉHesiloni, ʉHesiloni akampaapa ʉAlamu.
normalised_text: uyuuda akampaapa upelesi nu sela mwa tamali, upelesi akampaapa uhesiloni, uhesiloni akampaapa ualamu.

name: Vwanji
text: ɄAlamu akampaapa ʉAminadabu, ʉAminadabu akampaapa ʉNasoni, ʉNasoni akampaapa ʉSalimoni.
normalised_text: ualamu akampaapa uaminadabu, uaminadabu akampaapa unasoni, unasoni akampaapa usalimoni.

name: Vwanji
text: ɄSalimoni akampaapa ʉBohasi mwa Lahavu, ʉBohasi akampaapa ʉObedi mwa Lʉti, ʉObedi akampaapa ʉYese.
normalised_text: usalimoni akampaapa ubohasi mwa lahavu, ubohasi akampaapa uobedi mwa luti, uobedi akampaapa uyese.

name: Vwanji
text: ghwope ʉYese akampaapa ʉntwa ʉDavɨdi. ɄDavɨdi akampaapa ʉSolomoni mwa mʉkɨjʉʉva jʉno alyale nʼdala ghwa Ulia.
normalised_text: ghwope uyese akampaapa untwa udavidi. udavidi akampaapa usolomoni mwa mukijuuva juno alyale ndala ghwa ulia.

name: Vwanji
text: ɄSolomoni akampaapa ʉLehoboamu, ʉLehoboamu akampaapa ʉAbia, ʉAbia akampaapa ʉAsa.
normalised_text: usolomoni akampaapa ulehoboamu, ulehoboamu akampaapa uabia, uabia akampaapa uasa.

name: Vwanji
text: ɄAsa akampaapa ʉYehoshafati, ʉYehoshafati akampaapa ʉYolamu, ʉYolamu akampaapa ʉUsia.
normalised_text: uasa akampaapa uyehoshafati, uyehoshafati akampaapa uyolamu, uyolamu akampaapa ousia.

name: Vwanji
text: ɄUsia akampaapa ʉYotamu, ʉYotamu akampaapa ʉAhasi, ʉAhasi akampaapa ʉHesekia.
normalised_text: ousia akampaapa uyotamu, uyotamu akampaapa uahasi, uahasi akampaapa uhesekia.

name: Vwanji
text: ɄHesekia akampaapa ʉManase, ʉManase akampaapa ʉAmoni, ghwope ʉAmoni akampaapa ʉYosia.
normalised_text: uhesekia akampaapa umanase, umanase akampaapa uamoni, ghwope uamoni akampaapa uyosia.

name: Vwanji
text: ɄYosia akampaapa ʉYekonia na vanine ʉnsiki ghʉno aVaisilaeli ye vatwalilue kʉ vʉhesia, kʉ Babeli.
normalised_text: uyosia akampaapa uyekonia na vanine unsiki ghuno avaisilaeli ye vatwalilue ku vuhesia, ku babeli.

name: Vwanji
text: Ye vatwalilue kʉ vʉhesia kʉ Babeli, ʉYekonia akampaapa ʉSalatieli, ʉSalatieli akampaapa ʉSelubabeli.
normalised_text: ye vatwalilue ku vuhesia ku babeli, uyekonia akampaapa usalatieli, usalatieli akampaapa uselubabeli.

name: Vwanji
text: ɄSelubabeli akampaapa ʉAbihudi, ʉAbihudi akampaapa ʉEliakimu, ʉEliakimu akampaapa ʉAsoli.
normalised_text: uselubabeli akampaapa uabihudi, uabihudi akampaapa ueliakimu, ueliakimu akampaapa uasoli.

name: Vwanji
text: ɄAsoli akampaapa ʉSadoki, ʉSadoki akampaapa ʉAkimu, ʉAkimu akampaapa ʉEliudi.
normalised_text: uasoli akampaapa usadoki, usadoki akampaapa uakimu, uakimu akampaapa ueliudi.

name: Vwanji
text: ɄEliudi akampaapa ʉElieseli, ʉElieseli akampaapa ʉMatani, ghwope ʉMatani akampaapa ʉYakovo.
normalised_text: ueliudi akampaapa uelieseli, uelieseli akampaapa umatani, ghwope umatani akampaapa uyakovo.

name: Vwanji
text: ɄYakovo akampaapa ʉYosefu ʉmʉghoosi ghwa Maliya. ɄMaliya ghwe jʉno akampapile ʉYesu jʉno ghwe Kɨlɨsite.
normalised_text: uyakovo akampaapa uyosefu umughoosi ghwa maliya. umaliya ghwe juno akampapile uyesu juno ghwe kilisite.

name: Vwanji
text: Neke ipaapa ʉmwana ʉnʼdɨɨmi, ʉkʉmpeela ɨlɨtavua ɨlɨ Yesu, ʉlwakʉva ilikʉvapokagha avaanhu vaake mʉ nyɨvi saave.
normalised_text: neke ipaapa umwana undiimi, ukumpeela ilitavua ili yesu, ulwakuva ilikuvapokagha avaanhu vaake mu nyivi saave.

name: Vwanji
text: Sooni isio silyavombiike enendɨɨkɨ kukwɨlanɨsia ɨlɨsio lɨno ʉMʉtwa alyajovile kukilila ʉmʼbɨli ghwake kuuti.
normalised_text: sooni isio silyavombiike enendiiki kukwilanisia ilisio lino umutwa alyajovile kukilila umbili ghwake kuuti.

name: Vwanji
text: ɄYosefu akasisimuka, akavomba ndavʉle ʉnyamhola ghwa Mʉtwa vʉle amʼbʉlile, akantoola ʉMaliya kuuva nʼdala ghwake.
normalised_text: uyosefu akasisimuka, akavomba ndavule unyamhola ghwa mutwa vule ambulile, akantoola umaliya kuuva ndala ghwake.

name: Vwanji
text: Looli naakaghelile kughona naghwo kuhanga ʉnsiki ghʉno ʉMaliya ipaapa ʉmwana ʉnʼdɨɨmi. Pe ʉYosefu akampeela ʉmwana ʉjuo ɨlɨtavua ɨlɨ Yesu.
normalised_text: looli naakaghelile kughona naghwo kuhanga unsiki ghuno umaliya ipaapa umwana undiimi. pe uyosefu akampeela umwana ujuo ilitavua ili yesu.

name: Vwanji
text: Ʉntwa ʉHelode ye apʉliike isio, akapumuka mʉ mwojo ghwake. Nava vaanhu vooni ava mʉ lɨkaaja ɨlya Yelusalemu voope vakapumuka.
normalised_text: untwa uhelode ye apuliike isio, akapumuka mu mwojo ghwake. nava vaanhu vooni ava mu likaaja ilya yelusalemu voope vakapumuka.

name: Vwanji
text: Pepano akakongʼhania avavaha va vatekesi vooni palɨkɨmo na vavʉlanɨsi va ndaghɨlo, akavaposia akati, ɄKɨlɨsite iholua kʉʉghi.
normalised_text: pepano akakonghania avavaha va vatekesi vooni palikimo na vavulanisi va ndaghilo, akavaposia akati, ukilisite iholua kuughi.

name: Vwanji
text: Aveene vakamwamʉla vakati, Iholua mʉ kɨkaaja ɨkya Betelehemu, mʉ kɨghavo ɨkya Yudea. Tʉkagwile isio, ʉlwakʉva se sino alyalembile ʉmʼbɨli kuuti.
normalised_text: aveene vakamwamula vakati, iholua mu kikaaja ikya betelehemu, mu kighavo ikya yudea. tukagwile isio, ulwakuva se sino alyalembile umbili kuuti.

name: Vwanji
text: Pe ʉHelode akavakemeela kʉ vʉsyefu avakagʉsi vala ava nhondue, kuuti vamʼbʉʉle vʉnono ʉnsiki ghʉno vajaghile ɨnhondue jɨla.
normalised_text: pe uhelode akavakemeela ku vusyefu avakagusi vala ava nhondue, kuuti vambuule vunono unsiki ghuno vajaghile inhondue jila.

name: Vwanji
text: Ye vajaghile kange ɨnhondue jɨla, vakahovoka kyongo.
normalised_text: ye vajaghile kange inhondue jila, vakahovoka kyongo.

name: Vwanji
text: ɄNgʉlʉve akavapavɨla mʉ njosi kuuti, navangakililaghe kange kwa Helode. Pe vakakilila ɨsɨla ɨjɨngɨ kugomoka kʉ lɨkaaja lyave.
normalised_text: unguluve akavapavila mu njosi kuuti, navangakililaghe kange kwa helode. pe vakakilila isila ijingi kugomoka ku likaaja lyave.

name: Vwanji
text: Ɨkɨlo jɨla jɨla ʉYosefu akasisimuka, akantoola ʉmwana nʉ ngʼina, akakɨmbɨlɨla kʉ Misili.
normalised_text: ikilo jila jila uyosefu akasisimuka, akantoola umwana nu ngina, akakimbilila ku misili.

name: Vwanji
text: Ʉluo lʉlyavombiike kukwɨlanɨsia ɨlɨsio lɨno ʉMʉtwa alyajovile kukilila ʉmʼbɨli ghwake ʉYelemia kuuti.
normalised_text: uluo lulyavombiike kukwilanisia ilisio lino umutwa alyajovile kukilila umbili ghwake uyelemia kuuti.

name: Vwanji
text: Pambele ʉHelode akafua. ɄYosefu ye ajiighe kʉ Misili, ʉnyamhola ghwa Mʉtwa akamʼbonekela kange mʉ njosi.
normalised_text: pambele uhelode akafua. uyosefu ye ajiighe ku misili, unyamhola ghwa mutwa akambonekela kange mu njosi.

name: Vwanji
text: Akamʼbʉʉla akati, Sisimuka! Ʉntoole ʉmwana nʉ ngʼina, ʉgomoke mʉ ɨɨsi ɨja Isilaeli, ʉlwakʉva vano valondagha kʉkʉmʼbuda ʉmwana, vafwile.
normalised_text: akambuula akati, sisimuka! untoole umwana nu ngina, ugomoke mu iisi ija isilaeli, ulwakuva vano valondagha kukumbuda umwana, vafwile.

name: Wamey
text: Ante pëgwëko W̃ën ntind viỹë ŋa, ambin ŋa g'inkal iŋa ntiko ten.
normalised_text: ante pegweko wnen ntind viyne nga, ambin nga ginkal inga ntiko ten.

name: Wamey
text: Awa W̃ënu ŋa më ntehnëk: «Araɓi humpen ha nke!» Do humpen ha nkelehn.
normalised_text: awa wnenu nga me ntehnek "arabi humpen ha nke!" do humpen ha nkelehn.

name: Wamey
text: W̃ënu ŋa njëkëko do nëŋëkawo gë hutac; më pitëndëlehnëk humpen ha g'umëhwëry uŋa.
normalised_text: wnenu nga njekeko do nengekawo ge hutach; me pitendelehnek humpen ha gumehwery unga.

name: Wamey
text: W̃ënu ŋa më macëk humpen ha «fac» do mëhwëry uŋa «umëɗ». Nkeho umëɗ, tac gë fac; fac ryënkwëryënkw ỹa yeho.
normalised_text: wnenu nga me machek humpen ha "fach" do mehwery unga "umed". nkeho umed, tach ge fach; fach ryenkweryenkw yna yeho.

name: Wamey
text: W̃ënu ŋa më mbok ntehnëk: «Araɓi igwac nke fagant w̃ënka hna, pitëlahn w̃ënka ŋa.».
normalised_text: wnenu nga me mbok ntehnek "arabi igwach nke fagant wnenka hna, pitelahn wnenka nga.".

name: Wamey
text: Do koyëna nkeho. W̃ënu ŋa koyëna ntiko igwac nte fitëndëlehnëk w̃ënka waɓë gëɗ ŋa gë waɓë g'ambin ŋa.
normalised_text: do koyena nkeho. wnenu nga koyena ntiko igwach nte fitendelehnek wnenka wabe ged nga ge wabe gambin nga.

name: Wamey
text: W̃ënu ŋa më macëk igwac tac «ambin». Nkelehn umëɗ, tac gë fac; fac higëna ỹa yeho.
normalised_text: wnenu nga me machek igwach tach "ambin". nkelehn umed, tach ge fach; fach higena yna yeho.

name: Wamey
text: W̃ënu ŋa më mbok ntehnëk kat: «Araɓi w̃ënka wante sëpëk ambin ŋi mbarëpël sëñ ryampo fo nkehahn nkal iŋa!» Do koyëna nkeho.
normalised_text: wnenu nga me mbok ntehnek kat "arabi wnenka wante sepek ambin ngi mbarepel sen ryampo fo nkehahn nkal inga!" do koyena nkeho.

name: Wamey
text: W̃ënu ŋa më macëk hn'ile nkok gena w̃ënka hna «nkal» do w̃ënka wante varëpëlëk ŋa «wov». Njëkëko do nëŋëkawo gë rac.
normalised_text: wnenu nga me machek hnile nkok gena wnenka hna "nkal" do wnenka wante varepelek nga "wov". njekeko do nengekawo ge rach.

name: Wamey
text: Araɓi nke ambin hna wahumpen pëtënahn nkal iŋa!» Do koyëna nkeho.
normalised_text: arabi nke ambin hna wahumpen petenahn nkal inga!" do koyena nkeho.

name: Wamey
text: W̃ënu ŋa g'ambin kwëtëko soŋe pëtënënd nkal iŋa.
normalised_text: wnenu nga gambin kweteko songe petenend nkal inga.

name: Wamey
text: soŋe fac ỹa g'umëɗ uŋa do pitëndëlehn humpen ha gë umëhwëry uŋa. W̃ënu ŋa njëkëko do nëŋëkawo gë rac.
normalised_text: songe fach yna gumed unga do pitendelehn humpen ha ge umehwery unga. wnenu nga njekeko do nengekawo ge rach.

name: Wamey
text: W̃ënu ŋa më mbok ntehnëk kat: «Araɓi sifa viỹë fop pëɓëni wov hna, do wusëry w̃a nkwayëndëni g'ambin, cëpëni nkal iŋi!».
normalised_text: wnenu nga me mbok ntehnek kat "arabi sifa viyne fop pebeni wov hna, do wusery wna nkwayendeni gambin, chepeni nkal ingi!".

name: Wamey
text: W̃ënu ŋa më ndëwakëhni ntehnëhni: «Araɓi fop vile ye w̃ënka vi nagëlëni, njaɓëni, pëɓëni wov hna do araɓi wusëry w̃a fëna njaɓëni nkal li.».
normalised_text: wnenu nga me ndewakehni ntehnehni "arabi fop vile ye wnenka vi nageleni, njabeni, pebeni wov hna do arabi wusery wna fena njabeni nkal li.".

name: Wamey
text: W̃ënu ŋa më mbok ntehnëk kat: «Araɓi nkeni nkal li wasifa w̃a fop: wusaw̃, gë wulaw̃ do gë fop vihaw̃ary vile yasëɗ nkal li! Do koyëna nkeho.».
normalised_text: wnenu nga me mbok ntehnek kat "arabi nkeni nkal li wasifa wna fop wusawn, ge wulawn do ge fop vihawnary vile yased nkal li! do koyena nkeho.".

name: Wamey
text: Awa W̃ënu ŋa ntikëhni vahnë va mëntëlëni g'umë dënk; ntikëhni asan g'asëval.
normalised_text: awa wnenu nga ntikehni vahne va menteleni gume denk; ntikehni asan gaseval.

name: Wamey
text: Ntehnëkëhniwo fëna: «Njëɗamu arokëndu wanëɗa wante lëw̃ëɗ nkal ŋi fop do gë vatëh vante lëw̃ëɗ vi fop.
normalised_text: ntehnekehniwo fena "njedamu arokendu waneda wante lewned nkal ngi fop do ge vateh vante lewned vi fop.

name: Wamey
text: W̃ënu ŋa njëkëko fop ile ntiko ỹa do nëŋëkawo ɗus gë rac. Nkeho umëɗ, tac gë fac; fac hwëhn mbëɗ gë ryaw̃ ỹa yeho.
normalised_text: wnenu nga njekeko fop ile ntiko yna do nengekawo dus ge rach. nkeho umed, tach ge fach; fach hwehn mbed ge ryawn yna yeho.

name: Wamey
text: Koyëna puhnako W̃ënu ŋa idi ambin ŋa gë ɗuniỹa ỹi do gë fop ile yehëhna hnam ỹa.
normalised_text: koyena puhnako wnenu nga idi ambin nga ge duniyna yni do ge fop ile yehehna hnam yna.

name: Wamey
text: Ga tëkëk hnë fac hwëhn mbëɗ gë wahi hna, kamahnëko ɗoku lëw̃u ỹa puk do tiw̃ako. Awa hnë fac hwëhn mbëɗ gë wahi hna tiw̃ako.
normalised_text: ga tekek hne fach hwehn mbed ge wahi hna, kamahneko doku lewnu yna puk do tiwnako. awa hne fach hwehn mbed ge wahi hna tiwnako.

name: Wamey
text: Më ntik fac hwëhn mbëɗ gë wahi rac fac ryëwayik, do nti fac ile riw̃ahnëɗe, kaɓi hnë fac rac tiw̃ako hnë waɗoku wante ntiɗëho hna fop.
normalised_text: me ntik fach hwehn mbed ge wahi rach fach ryewayik, do nti fach ile riwnahnede, kabi hne fach rach tiwnako hne wadoku wante ntideho hna fop.

name: Wamey
text: Koyëna ntiko W̃ënu ŋa ambin ŋa gë ɗuniỹa ỹi. Ante ntiko Ahwëhn a W̃ënu ŋa ambin ŋa gë ɗuniỹa ỹi.
normalised_text: koyena ntiko wnenu nga ambin nga ge duniyna yni. ante ntiko ahwehn a wnenu nga ambin nga ge duniyna yni.

name: Wamey
text: Ɓare le ye had fampul sahnëɗëho nkal hna do turëɗëho nkal iŋa fop.
normalised_text: bare le ye had fampul sahnedeho nkal hna do turedeho nkal inga fop.

name: Wamey
text: Ahwëhn a W̃ënu ŋa më nufëk nkal do ñahanëka asan . Tac më cëlëka wasëhn hna sël paryi ỹa, uwám w̃a, do asan arac nkelehn ale yënëɗ.
normalised_text: ahwehn a wnenu nga me nufek nkal do nahaneka asan. tach me cheleka wasehn hna sel paryi yna, uwam wna, do asan arach nkelehn ale yened.

name: Wamey
text: Tac, Ahwëhn a W̃ënu ŋa më pëlëk sarëɗiŋ hnë Eden hna, gë cape pëhna lav ka, do kwëta hnam asan ale ñahanëko ỹa.
normalised_text: tach, ahwehn a wnenu nga me pelek sareding hne eden hna, ge cape pehna lav ka, do kweta hnam asan ale nahaneko yna.

name: Wamey
text: Sën w̃atiɗëho hn'inkal Eden hna turënd sarëɗiŋ ỹa. Pëgw hnam, vunkaryëla vunah pitëlëko.
normalised_text: sen wnatideho hninkal eden hna turend sareding yna. pegw hnam, vunkaryela vunah piteleko.

name: Wamey
text: Fandënkwëryënkw fa Pison maciko: fatac rënkëko inkal Havila hna. Hn'inkal tac nkeho sanu ỹa.
normalised_text: fandenkweryenkw fa pison machiko fatach renkeko inkal havila hna. hninkal tach nkeho sanu yna.

name: Wamey
text: do sanu rac përënako ɗus. Nkeho vatëh vante liɗe ɗatikola do fëna nkeho itaka nte yaɓëka nafa ỹa.
normalised_text: do sanu rach perenako dus. nkeho vateh vante lide datikola do fena nkeho itaka nte yabeka nafa yna.

name: Wamey
text: Fakigëna fa Gihon maciko: inkal Kuc ŋa fop tënkëko.
normalised_text: fakigena fa gihon machiko inkal kuch nga fop tenkeko.

name: Wamey
text: Fatarëna fa Saw̃ maciko: fatac yaryëɗëho gë cape pëhna lav g'ankol Asur ka. Do fanahëna fa Efërat maciko.
normalised_text: fatarena fa sawn machiko fatach yaryedeho ge cape pehna lav gankol asur ka. do fanahena fa eferat machiko.

name: Wannu
text: Azyì àwu áwádako wu mbùkú wa ngyèké àwu Yesu Kristi, ángode-ngode kpendu àwu Dawuda wàyi ngode-ngode kpendu àwu Ibrahim lá.
normalised_text: azhi awu awadako wu mbuku wa ngyeke awu yesu kristi, angodengode kpendu awu dawuda wayi ngodengode kpendu awu ibrahim la.

name: Wannu
text: Ibrahim mbà Ishaku, Ishaku mbà Yakubu, Yakubu mbà Yahuda wa ázyēyī'a.
normalised_text: ibrahim mba ishaku, ishaku mba yakubu, yakubu mba yahuda wa azheyia.

name: Wannu
text: Yahuda mbà Peresa wa Zera, áyī'wa yi Tamar, Perez mbà Hezron, Hezron mbà Ram.
normalised_text: yahuda mba peresa wa zera, ayiwa yi tamar, perez mba hezron, hezron mba ram.

name: Wannu
text: Ram mbà Aminadab, Aminadab mbà Nashon, Nashon mbà Salmon.

text: Kɛnɛŋ kɛ́ Ɛlóod kɛáság kiim əgiig, əə́gú. Uŋun ó maʼtom ó Sə́dúk wááság kiiʼkini kiim əbúnigi Yósɛb kɛlɛm a Əsíibtə.
normalised_text: keneng ke eluod keasag kiim egiig, iegu. ungun o matom o seduk waasag kiikini kiim ebunigi yoseb kelem a eseibte.

name: Yambeta
text: wɔ́nɔ́ na nyɔ́lɛ́: Tɛ́ɛ́mɛn, siəd na mɔɔ́n na ŋŋí, púúlini a nigúu nɛ́ Ɛ́sɛlayɛl lɛ́ pɔɔd pá páyɛ́ɛ əguunə koon mɔɔ́n nyóon pə́ʼkuguə́ʼkən.
normalised_text: wono na nyole teemen, sied na muon na ngngi, puulini a nigou ne eselayel le pood pa payie eguune koon muon nyuon pekugueken.

name: Yambeta
text: Yósɛb aáság kodɛ́ɛmɛn, əə́siəd na mɔɔ́n na ŋŋí, pááság kaag a ngə́ əguúli a Ɛ́sɛlayɛl.
normalised_text: yoseb easag kodiemen, iesied na muon na ngngi, paasag kaag a nge egouli a eselayel.

name: Yambeta
text: A mədúg móom, Sɛ́aŋ Ɔsɔgɛn pɔɔd yɛɛ́lón a Siudə́ə, a kɛnɔ kɛ́ kifələ́ə́n. Ayɛ́ɛ əgiim álɔɛgɛ ɔnɔ́:.
normalised_text: a medug muom, seang osogen pood yielon a siudie, a keno ke kifeleen. ayie egiim aloege ono.

name: Yambeta
text: «Ə́súʼkíən óo! Liogíən ongoo a mabɛ́! Kɛnɛŋ kɛ́ Táán kiim alaamɛɛ́ kɛándɛ kɔ!».
normalised_text: "esukien uo! liogien ongoo a mabe! keneng ke taan kiim alaamie keande ko!".

name: Yambeta
text: Náa, wɛ nyɔ́ umíim, waayaŋ kaáwála unuʼ a mabɛ́ mááŋ, a udi ó mɔɔd ungim ná ágoósɔgɛn anɛ́ɛ́n a noom nó Siuludɛ́ɛŋ.
normalised_text: nea, we nyo umeim, waayang keawala unu a mabe maang, a udi o mood ungim na aguosogen aneen a noom no siuludieng.

name: Yambeta
text: Ooo yi, kɛbán kɛ́dɛɔ́gɔ! Ɛlɛ́an anɛ́ɛ́n pɛbán pɛ́ píoloodi lɛ́ puə́ʼkəə́suʼki, puóʼkuliogi ongoo a pɛbán pɛ́ pɛbɛ́.
normalised_text: ooo yi, keban kedeogo! elean aneen peban pe pioloodi le puekiesuki, puokuliogi ongoo a peban pe pebe.

name: Yambeta
text: Taa, yaá áa yɛ́ɛnɛ yándɛɛ́ a ombɔg lɛ́ pásóma piɛd a ngaŋ. Kiɛd kiim kɛ́ kídiə́guúmíí modámádám mólaŋ, pálɛ́ɛ́ kosom, páadagɛdɛ a yug.
normalised_text: taa, yea ea yiene yandie a ombog le pasoma pied a ngang. kied kiim ke kidiegoumii modamadam molang, palee kosom, peadagede a yug.

name: Yangben
text: Ɔmbɔp ú niólín ni Yésus Kilíis, nindaanda ni Tafíit, nindaanda ni Ápilaháam:.

name: Yangben
text: Ápilaháamɛ weepíen Isaákɛ, Isaákɛ weepíen Yákɔpɛ, Yákupɛ weepíen Yútɛ na paandimán pɛ́ɛ́yɛ́ pɛɛnúmɛndɔ́.
normalised_text: apilahaame weepien isaake, isaake weepien yakope, yakupe weepien yute na paandiman peeye peenumendo.

name: Yangben
text: Yútɛ weepíen Fálisɛ na Sála ká akányí wɛɛyɛ́ Tamáal, Fálisɛ weepíen Ɛsɛlúmɛ, Ɛsɛlúmɛ weepíen Aláamɛ.
normalised_text: yute weepien falise na sala ka akanyi weeye tamaal, falise weepien eselume, eselume weepien alaame.

name: Yangben
text: Aláamɛ weepíen Aminatápɛ, Aminatápɛ weepíen Naasúnɛ, Naasúnɛ weepíen Sálmunɛ.
normalised_text: alaame weepien aminatape, aminatape weepien naasune, naasune weepien salmune.

name: Yangben
text: Sálmunɛ weepíen Púuse, ká akányí wɛɛyɛ́ Láhap, Púuse weepíen ópííte, ká akányí wɛɛyɛ́ Lút, Ópííte weepíen Yesé.

name: Yangben

name: Yangben

name: Yangben
text: Yósiásɛ weepíen Yékoníasɛ na paandimán pɛ́ɛ́yɛ́ pɛɛnúmɛndɔ́; á kisikɛl ekí Papilɔn mɛɛ́tikɛn pɛɛnd pí Isilayɛ́l iŋólí.
normalised_text: yosiase weepien yekoniase na paandiman peeye peenumendo; a kisikel eki papilon meetiken peend pi isilayel ingoli.

name: Yangben
text: É kélém kú kiɛtikinɛ kí Papilɔn, Yekoníasɛ weepíen Salatiɛ́lɛ, Salatiɛ́lɛ weepíen Solopapɛ́lɛ.
normalised_text: e kelem ku kietikine ki papilon, yekoniase weepien salatiele, salatiele weepien solopapele.

name: Yangben

name: Yangben
text: Yákupɛ weepíen Yúsipɛ, ɔnɛ́m Malía, wɔ́ wɛɛ́tɛ, akányí meépíén Yésuse, ewú pápílanɛ́ ɛ́ɛ́ Kilíise.
normalised_text: yakupe weepien yusipe, onem malia, wo weete, akanyi meepien yesuse, ewu papilane ee kiliise.

text: ukepíen mɔnɔ́ ɛnúmɛndɔ́, áluka wɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́ Yésuse, á kíáki ɛ́ɛ́ wɔ́ weényítúkunené nikúli níɛ́yɛ́ kɔ́ɔ́p á pifal.».
normalised_text: ukepien mono enumendo, aluka wo ee yesuse, a kiaki ee wo weenyitukunene nikuli nieye koop a pifal.".

name: Yangben
text: Púmɛ́píɛ́lɛ́ anakáánɛ́ ɛ́ɛ́ epú Ɔkɔ́n mɔɔ́yɛ́t é peémímekelíé píwóónyi:.
normalised_text: pumepiele anakaane ee epu okon mooyet e peemimekelie piwoonyi.

name: Yangben
text: Ɛ́ɛ́ ɔmbɔl epílitíkén ɔ́ɔ́nyíkɔ́l niim, upíén mɔnɔ́ ɛ́númɛndɔ́, páluka wɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́ Imánuɛlɛ, anakáánɛ́ kúnyɛɛ́: «Támbákɛ́ɛ ɔlɔŋ naasɔ́.».
normalised_text: ee ombol epilitiken oonyikol niim, upien mono enumendo, paluka wo ee imanuele, anakaane kunyee "tambakee olong naaso.".

name: Yangben
text: Yúsɛp mɛɛlɛ́ wɛɛnyukɛn, wɛɛl aná Éŋele u Ɔkɔ́n maátíán wɔ: wɔɔkɔ́l akányí kuɛyɛ́.

name: Yangben
text: maná utimapítɛm nɛɛyɛ́ kuám aná umeépíén mɔnɔ́ ɛnúmɛndɔ́, waaluka wɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́ Yésuse.

name: Yangben
text: Pémepíén Yésuse Pɛ́tílɛhɛm é Yúté, á kisikɛl kí efuŋ Elóot, peenúní muótiótio kuólin á nipálɛ́n ní ɔɔ́nyí mányaám Yelúsalɛm.
normalised_text: pemepien yesuse petilehem e yute, a kisikel ki efung eloot, peenuni muotiotio kuolin a nipalen ni oonyi manyaam yelusalem.

text: poówun ɛ́ɛ́: «Naánɛ́ efuŋ u Pɛyúútɛn pɛ́ɛ́nyɛ́kɛ́t epíén nyɛɛ́? Tumɛ́ɛ́n yoótiótio yɛ́ɛ́yɛ́ á nipálɛ́n ní ɔɔ́nyí, kúúkɔ́ túmónyoól é kuesikúmésí wɔ.».
normalised_text: poowun ee "naane efung u peyuuten peenyeket epien nyee? tumeen yootiotio yeeye a nipalen ni oonyi, kuuko tumonyool e kuesikumesi wo.".

name: Yangben
text: Niɔy nikáánɛ́ níepueŋitenyi efuŋ Elóote táásɛ ne Yelúsalɛm kitikit.
normalised_text: nioy nikaane niepuengitenyi efung eloote taase ne yelusalem kitikit.

name: Yangben
text: Elóote weelumenyi pɔkɔ́n pá pafunɔ́fɔn ne pemenyí pikotí pɔ́ kitɔŋ é kumenyi naánɛ́ pɛ́mɛɛ́síkɛ́ɛ́nɛ́n kupíén Kilíise.
normalised_text: eloote weelumenyi pokon pa pafunofon ne pemenyi pikoti po kitong e kumenyi naane pemeesikeenen kupien kiliise.

text: Póokondinyi wɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́: «Pɛtɛlɛhɛm é Yuté, á kiákí ɛ́ɛ́ púúpú eŋémímekélíe má Támbák mɔɔ́ŋ ɛ́ɛ́:.
normalised_text: pookondinyi wo ee "petelehem e yute, a kiaki ee puupu engemimekelie ma tambak moong ee.

name: Yangben
text: Elóote waapílikɛn peenúní muótíótio kí insunsue ɛ́ɛ́ pɛ́sɛɛkunin wɔ́ peseé kisikɛl ekí yoótíótio siásuunɔk.

name: Yangben
text: Efuŋ manana kuɔyɔ anakáánɛ́, pɔ́ɔ́kɔ́l iŋilí; yoótíótio pɛ́mɛɛ́nɛ́n á nipálɛ́n ní ɔɔ́nyí yáasuŋɔn kuám aná ímeényétélímít kɔɔ́mɔ aká kiendine maápá.

name: Yangben
text: Pɛ́ɛ́nɛn yoótíótio, pɔ́ɔ́p kiándákáand kí anyamɔ́.
normalised_text: peenen yootiotio, poop kiandakaand ki anyamo.

name: Yangben
text: É kélém akáánɛ́ Támbákɛ́ɛ weesitíínyí pɔ́ kí ilimí ɛ́ɛ́ pótiondín yi Elóot, péepítúnúkin ó kuond kɔ́ɔ́p ɔ́ kitɔŋ kí iŋilí ilotí.
normalised_text: e kelem akaane tambakee weesitiinyi po ki ilimi ee potiondin yi eloot, peepitunukin o kuond koop o kitong ki ingili iloti.

name: Yansi
text: Un'kaan a un'lwaaŋ a Yɛsu Klistɔ, itoo a David, itoo a Abàlam.

text: Abàlam kàbör Isak, Isak kàbör Yakɔb, Yakɔb kàbör Yudà anà atɔŋ ande.

normalised_text: yosja kabor yekonya ana atong ande, u panga basool baan a isalel nsi u babilon.

normalised_text: ungo a nsool a nsi, yekonya kabor salatyel, salatyel kabor zorobabel.

name: Yansi

text: Yakɔb kàbör Yɔsɛfi, un'dim a Màlye awà kàbör Yɛsu awà bàfàbel naa Klistɔ.

name: Yansi
text: Undiir awun, nde ayàbɔr mwan baal, ngye ayun'pà ikɔb a Yɛsu, ntɔn nde asàtswà mɔ̈ɔ̈ a un'sɛŋ ande unsà man'be a wa. ».
normalised_text: undiir awun, nde ayabor mwan baal, nggje ayun.pa ikob a yesu, nton nde asatswa moo a un.seng ande unsa man.be a wa. ".

name: Yansi
text: Ndaa ayi yanswà yà ntɔn undiir kàtɛn Mwol u mun a ŋangɔɔm ande ukwe:.
normalised_text: ndaa ayi yanswa ya nton undiir katen mwol u mun a ngangoom ande ukwe.

name: Yansi
text: « Le, mwan un'kaar unkɔr asàkal yöm, nde asàbɔr mwan baal, bàsun'beelà Mànwel », iswaŋà naa « Nzam wà uboo a bi ».
normalised_text: " le, mwan un.kaar unkor asakal yom, nde asabor mwan baal, basun.beela manwel ", iswanga naa " nzam wa uboo a bi ".

text: Mpal kàwiyà nde u twaal, Yɔsefi kàkyer ndaa kun'swɛŋ un'kyeey a Mwol, waa nde kàsi un'kyay ande u ndwà.
normalised_text: mpal kawiya nde u twaal, yosefi kakjer ndaa kun.sweng un.kjeey a mwol, waa nde kasi un.kjay ande u ndwa.

name: Yansi
text: Wɛɛ nde kàtüüb anki ndür anà nde tii mpal kàbör nde mwan baal awà kàpɛ nde ikɔb a Yɛsu.
normalised_text: wee nde katuub anki ndur ana nde tii mpal kabor nde mwan baal awa kape nde ikob a yesu.

name: Yansi
text: waa bàfuul naa: « Wà ken Mfum a Ayudà ban'bɔr benàben awà? Bi kàmɛn mbwaar ande mper làfàsɛnà taaŋ, lalan kan'yà bi mukun'kömà. ».
normalised_text: waa bafuul naa " wa ken mfum a ayuda ban.bor benaben awa? bi kamen mbwaar ande mper lafasena taang, lalan kan.ya bi mukun.koma. ".

text: Mpal kàwem mfum Ɛlɔdi làsaŋ alà, nde kàkyer atɛɛr, anà Yɛlusàlɛm lanswà mbwo mwɛy anà nde.
normalised_text: mpal kawem mfum elodi lasang ala, nde kakjer ateer, ana yelusalem lanswa mbwo mwey ana nde.

name: Yansi
text: Nde kàtüüb andwer angaŋ anà alɔɔŋ a Un'kɔɔn, ntɔn mukafuul naa Klistɔ bàlun'bɔr ken.
normalised_text: nde katuub andwer angang ana aloong a un.koon, nton mukafuul naa klisto balun.bor ken.

name: Yansi
text: Ba bun'fuur naa: « U Bɛtelɛm a Yuday. Ntɔn ŋangɔɔm kàsön abà:.
normalised_text: ba bun.fuur naa " u betelem a yuday. nton ngangoom kason aba.

name: Yansi
text: « Le, ngye Bɛtelɛm, u nsi a Yuday, ngye kà awà bul làkɔ̈ɔ̈n ndöŋ anki u Yuday, ntɔn mfum asàdii un'sɛŋ amɛ Isàlɛl, asàtoo uboo a ngye. ».
normalised_text: " le, nggje betelem, u nsi a yuday, nggje ka awa bul lakoon ndong anki u yuday, nton mfum asadii un.seng ame isalel, asatoo uboo a nggje. ".

name: Yansi
text: Apan, Ɛlɔdi kàbel aŋan'yeerà kà unku, ntɔn ba bun'kyään ubwaŋàbwaŋ taaŋ nà mbwaar kàmɛnà.

name: Yansi
text: Ungö apan, Nzam kakyään u ndwɛy naa ba bàkɔɔn afurà akà Ɛlɔdi, ba waa bàfurà nsi aba u mbwo asin.

name: Zulgo-Gemzek
text: Aləka Yasufa a piɗeke ka, a ge dər kamala biy na gawla Mbulum ata a tsiker a. I dəba ŋa ya, a zlaba Mariya aà daala ŋgar kuɗa.

name: Zulgo-Gemzek
